verses.sanskrit: यथा सर्वेषु देवेषु वरिष्ठो भगवान् भवः तथा स्तवो वरिष्ठो ऽयं स्तवानां दक्षनिर्मितः
verses.transliteration: yathā sarveṣu deveṣu variṣṭho bhagavān bhavaḥ tathā stavo variṣṭho 'yaṃ stavānāṃ dakṣanirmitaḥ
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यशःस्वर्गसुरैश्वर्यवित्तादिजयकाङ्क्षिभिः स्तोतव्यो भक्तिम् आस्थाय विद्याकामैश् च यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: yaśaḥsvargasuraiśvaryavittādijayakāṅkṣibhiḥ stotavyo bhaktim āsthāya vidyākāmaiś ca yatnataḥ
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: व्याधितो दुःखितो दीनो नरो ग्रस्तो भयादिभिः राजकार्यनियुक्तो वा मुच्यते महतो भयात्
verses.transliteration: vyādhito duḥkhito dīno naro grasto bhayādibhiḥ rājakāryaniyukto vā mucyate mahato bhayāt
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनेनैव च देहेन गणानां च महेश्वरात् इह लोके सुखं प्राप्य गणराड् उपजायते
verses.transliteration: anenaiva ca dehena gaṇānāṃ ca maheśvarāt iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya gaṇarāḍ upajāyate
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न यक्षा न पिशाचा वा न नागा न विनायकाः कुर्युर् विघ्नं गृहे तस्य यत्र संस्तूयते भवः
verses.transliteration: na yakṣā na piśācā vā na nāgā na vināyakāḥ kuryur vighnaṃ gṛhe tasya yatra saṃstūyate bhavaḥ
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणुयाद् वा इदं नारी भक्त्याथ भवभाविता पितृपक्षे भर्तृपक्षे पूज्या भवति चैव ह
verses.transliteration: śṛṇuyād vā idaṃ nārī bhaktyātha bhavabhāvitā pitṛpakṣe bhartṛpakṣe pūjyā bhavati caiva ha
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणुयाद् वा इदं सर्वं कीर्तयेद् वाप्य् अभीक्ष्णशः तस्य सर्वाणि कार्याणि सिद्धिं गच्छन्त्य् अविघ्नतः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇuyād vā idaṃ sarvaṃ kīrtayed vāpy abhīkṣṇaśaḥ tasya sarvāṇi kāryāṇi siddhiṃ gacchanty avighnataḥ
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मनसा चिन्तितं यच् च यच् च वाचाप्य् उदाहृतम् सर्वं संपद्यते तस्य स्तवस्यास्यानुकीर्तनात्
verses.transliteration: manasā cintitaṃ yac ca yac ca vācāpy udāhṛtam sarvaṃ saṃpadyate tasya stavasyāsyānukīrtanāt
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवस्य सगुहस्याथ देव्या नन्दीश्वरस्य च बलिं विभजतः कृत्वा दमेन नियमेन च
verses.transliteration: devasya saguhasyātha devyā nandīśvarasya ca baliṃ vibhajataḥ kṛtvā damena niyamena ca
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रयुक्तो गृह्णीयान् नामान्य् आशु यथाक्रमम् ईप्सितांल् लभते ऽप्य् अर्थान् कामान् भोगांश् च मानवः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prayukto gṛhṇīyān nāmāny āśu yathākramam īpsitāṃl labhate 'py arthān kāmān bhogāṃś ca mānavaḥ
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृतश् च स्वर्गम् आप्नोति स्त्रीसहस्रसमावृतः सर्वकामसुयुक्तो वा युक्तो वा सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: mṛtaś ca svargam āpnoti strīsahasrasamāvṛtaḥ sarvakāmasuyukto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पठन् दक्षकृतं स्तोत्रं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते मृतश् च गणसायुज्यं पूज्यमानः सुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration: paṭhan dakṣakṛtaṃ stotraṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate mṛtaś ca gaṇasāyujyaṃ pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वृषेण विनियुक्तेन विमानेन विराजते आभूतसंप्लवस्थायी रुद्रस्यानुचरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vṛṣeṇa viniyuktena vimānena virājate ābhūtasaṃplavasthāyī rudrasyānucaro bhavet
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् आह भगवान् व्यासः पराशरसुतः प्रभुः नैतद् वेदयते कश्चिन् नैतच् छ्राव्यं च कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: ity āha bhagavān vyāsaḥ parāśarasutaḥ prabhuḥ naitad vedayate kaścin naitac chrāvyaṃ ca kasyacit
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वेमं परमं गुह्यं ये ऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः वैश्याः स्त्रियश् च शूद्राश् च रुद्रलोकम् अवाप्नुयुः
verses.transliteration: śrutvemaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ ye 'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ vaiśyāḥ striyaś ca śūdrāś ca rudralokam avāpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रावयेद् यश् च विप्रेभ्यः सदा पर्वसु पर्वसु रुद्रलोकम् अवाप्नोति द्विजो वै नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: śrāvayed yaś ca viprebhyaḥ sadā parvasu parvasu rudralokam avāpnoti dvijo vai nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वैवं वै मुनिश्रेष्ठाः कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् रुद्रक्रोधोद्भवां पुण्यां व्यासस्य वदतो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: śrutvaivaṃ vai muniśreṣṭhāḥ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm rudrakrodhodbhavāṃ puṇyāṃ vyāsasya vadato dvijāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the story mentioned by Brahmi, the leading sages were delighted. Their hairs stood on ends. They praised the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पार्वत्याश् च तथा रोषं क्रोधं शंभोश् च दुःसहम् उत्पत्तिं वीरभद्रस्य भद्रकाल्याश् च संभवम्
verses.transliteration: pārvatyāś ca tathā roṣaṃ krodhaṃ śaṃbhoś ca duḥsaham utpattiṃ vīrabhadrasya bhadrakālyāś ca saṃbhavam
verses.translation: On hearing their words, the fburiaced lord of worlds recounted that holy centre of lord 3iva which yields worldly pleasures and salvation on this voy earth itself.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दक्षयज्ञविनाशं च वीर्यं शंभोस् तथाद्भुतम् पुनः प्रसादं देवस्य दक्षस्य सुमहात्मनः
verses.transliteration: dakṣayajñavināśaṃ ca vīryaṃ śaṃbhos tathādbhutam punaḥ prasādaṃ devasya dakṣasya sumahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, in the previous Kalpa, there was a single Mango tree there by which name, the holy centre came to be known as Ekamra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञभागं च रुद्रस्य दक्षस्य च फलं क्रतोः हृष्टा बभूवुः संप्रीता विस्मिताश् च पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: yajñabhāgaṃ ca rudrasya dakṣasya ca phalaṃ kratoḥ hṛṣṭā babhūvuḥ saṃprītā vismitāś ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: It contained massive doorways arranged in groups of three. A white outer wall enhanced its beauty. It was well guarded by weapons and beautified by moats and trenches.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पप्रच्छुश् च पुनर् व्यासं कथाशेषं तथा द्विजाः पृष्टः प्रोवाच तान् व्यासः क्षेत्रम् एकाम्रकं पुनः
verses.transliteration: papracchuś ca punar vyāsaṃ kathāśeṣaṃ tathā dvijāḥ pṛṣṭaḥ provāca tān vyāsaḥ kṣetram ekāmrakaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: The people were gay and joyous in perpetual festivities with various kinds of musical instruments such as Che lute, Sute and drums. The area was adorned with slings fcM* hurling missiles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मप्रोक्तां कथां पुण्यां श्रुत्वा तु ऋषिपुंगवाः प्रशशंसुस् तदा हृष्टा रोमाञ्चिततनूरुहाः
verses.transliteration: brahmaproktāṃ kathāṃ puṇyāṃ śrutvā tu ṛṣipuṃgavāḥ praśaśaṃsus tadā hṛṣṭā romāñcitatanūruhāḥ
verses.translation: There were many temples of gods embellished by outer walls and gardens. The ways of worship therein were wonder¬ ful and they enhanced the beauty of the holy centre.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहो देवस्य माहात्म्यं त्वया शंभोः प्रकीर्तितम् दक्षस्य च सुरश्रेष्ठ यज्ञविध्वंसनं तथा
verses.transliteration: aho devasya māhātmyaṃ tvayā śaṃbhoḥ prakīrtitam dakṣasya ca suraśreṣṭha yajñavidhvaṃsanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The men too were richly endowed with their noble traits and bedecked in all ornaments. They appeared to be haughty by virtue of their youth and handsome features.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकाम्रकं क्षेत्रवरं वक्तुम् अर्हसि सांप्रतम् श्रोतुम् इच्छामहे ब्रह्मन् परं कौतूहलं हि नः
verses.transliteration: ekāmrakaṃ kṣetravaraṃ vaktum arhasi sāṃpratam śrotum icchāmahe brahman paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, they were brahmins, Ktriyas, Vaijyas and 8udras. Those who lived there were very virtuous and engaged in their respective profession.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा लोकनाथश् चतुर्मुखः प्रोवाच शंभोस् तत् क्षेत्रं भूतले दुष्कृतच्छदम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tad vacanaṃ śrutvā lokanāthaś caturmukhaḥ provāca śaṃbhos tat kṣetraṃ bhūtale duṣkṛtacchadam
verses.translation: These beautiful women, pleasing to behold were experts in conversation and side-glancing at people. None of them was bereft of beauty, none harassed others, none could be called wicked or evil in their activities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं मुनिशार्दूलाः प्रवक्ष्यामि समासतः सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं क्षेत्रं परमदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham
verses.translation: The intelligent people who visit the lord at any time, are liberated from their sins. They go to the world of lord Siva.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गकोटिसमायुक्तं वाराणसीसमं शुभम् एकाम्रकेति विख्यातं तीर्थाष्टकसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: liṅgakoṭisamāyuktaṃ vārāṇasīsamaṃ śubham ekāmraketi vikhyātaṃ tīrthāṣṭakasamanvitam
verses.translation: The holy centre extending to two and a half Yojanas to the West, East, North and South of the lord is an area that yields worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकाम्रवृक्षस् तत्रासीत् पुरा कल्पे द्विजोत्तमाः नाम्ना तस्यैव तत् क्षेत्रम् एकाम्रकम् इति श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: ekāmravṛkṣas tatrāsīt purā kalpe dvijottamāḥ nāmnā tasyaiva tat kṣetram ekāmrakam iti śrutam
verses.translation: Even a woman, O leadii brahmins, attains the benefit if she worships in due faith. No doubt need be entertain¬ ed in this respect.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णं नरनारीसमन्वितम् विद्वांसगण भूयिष्ठं धनधान्यादिसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇaṃ naranārīsamanvitam vidvāṃsagaṇa bhūyiṣṭhaṃ dhanadhānyādisaṃyutam
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गृहगोपुरसंबाधं त्रिकचाद्वारभूषितम् नानावणिक्समाकीर्णं नानारत्नोपशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: gṛhagopurasaṃbādhaṃ trikacādvārabhūṣitam nānāvaṇiksamākīrṇaṃ nānāratnopaśobhitam
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुराट्टालकसंयुक्तं रथिभिः समलंकृतम् राजहंसनिभैः शुभ्रैः प्रासादैर् उपशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: purāṭṭālakasaṃyuktaṃ rathibhiḥ samalaṃkṛtam rājahaṃsanibhaiḥ śubhraiḥ prāsādair upaśobhitam
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मार्गगद्वारसंयुक्तं सितप्राकारशोभितम् रक्षितं शस्त्रसंघैश् च परिखाभिर् अलंकृतम्
verses.transliteration: mārgagadvārasaṃyuktaṃ sitaprākāraśobhitam rakṣitaṃ śastrasaṃghaiś ca parikhābhir alaṃkṛtam
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सितरक्तैस् तथा पीतैः कृष्णश्यामैश् च वर्णकैः समीरणोद्धताभिश् च पताकाभिर् अलंकृतम्
verses.transliteration: sitaraktais tathā pītaiḥ kṛṣṇaśyāmaiś ca varṇakaiḥ samīraṇoddhatābhiś ca patākābhir alaṃkṛtam
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नित्योत्सवप्रमुदितं नानावादित्रनिस्वनैः वीणावेणुमृदङ्गैश् च क्षेपणीभिर् अलंकृतम्
verses.transliteration: nityotsavapramuditaṃ nānāvāditranisvanaiḥ vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgaiś ca kṣepaṇībhir alaṃkṛtam
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवतायतनैर् दिव्यैः प्राकारोद्यानमण्डितैः पूजाविचित्ररचितैः सर्वत्र समलंकृतम्
verses.transliteration: devatāyatanair divyaiḥ prākārodyānamaṇḍitaiḥ pūjāvicitraracitaiḥ sarvatra samalaṃkṛtam
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियः प्रमुदितास् तत्र दृश्यन्ते तनुमध्यमाः हारैर् अलंकृतग्रीवाः पद्मपत्त्रायतेक्षणाः
verses.transliteration: striyaḥ pramuditās tatra dṛśyante tanumadhyamāḥ hārair alaṃkṛtagrīvāḥ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पीनोन्नतकुचाः श्यामाः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाः स्थिरालकाः सुकपोलाः काञ्चीनूपुरनादिताः
verses.transliteration: pīnonnatakucāḥ śyāmāḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanāḥ sthirālakāḥ sukapolāḥ kāñcīnūpuranāditāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुकेश्यश् चारुजघनाः कर्णान्तायतलोचनाः सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नाः सर्वाभरणभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: sukeśyaś cārujaghanāḥ karṇāntāyatalocanāḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यवस्त्रधराः शुभ्राः काश्चित् काञ्चनसंनिभाः हंसवारणगामिन्यः कुचभारावनामिताः
verses.transliteration: divyavastradharāḥ śubhrāḥ kāścit kāñcanasaṃnibhāḥ haṃsavāraṇagāminyaḥ kucabhārāvanāmitāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यगन्धानुलिप्ताङ्गाः कर्णाभरणभूषिताः मदालसाश् च सुश्रोण्यो नित्यं प्रहसिताननाः
verses.transliteration: divyagandhānuliptāṅgāḥ karṇābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ madālasāś ca suśroṇyo nityaṃ prahasitānanāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ईषद्विस्पष्टदशना बिम्बौष्ठा मधुरस्वराः ताम्बूलरञ्जितमुखा विदग्धाः प्रियदर्शनाः
verses.transliteration: īṣadvispaṣṭadaśanā bimbauṣṭhā madhurasvarāḥ tāmbūlarañjitamukhā vidagdhāḥ priyadarśanāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुभगाः प्रियवादिन्यो नित्यं यौवनगर्विताः दिव्यवस्त्रधराः सर्वाः सदा चारित्रमण्डिताः
verses.transliteration: subhagāḥ priyavādinyo nityaṃ yauvanagarvitāḥ divyavastradharāḥ sarvāḥ sadā cāritramaṇḍitāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडन्ति ताः सदा तत्र स्त्रियश् चाप्सरसोपमाः स्वे स्वे गृहे प्रमुदिता दिवा रात्रौ वराननाः
verses.transliteration: krīḍanti tāḥ sadā tatra striyaś cāpsarasopamāḥ sve sve gṛhe pramuditā divā rātrau varānanāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषास् तत्र दृश्यन्ते रूपयौवनगर्विताः सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नाः सुमृष्टमणिकुण्डलाः
verses.transliteration: puruṣās tatra dṛśyante rūpayauvanagarvitāḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāḥ sumṛṣṭamaṇikuṇḍalāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्राश् च मुनिसत्तमाः स्वधर्मनिरतास् तत्र निवसन्ति सुधार्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāś ca munisattamāḥ svadharmaniratās tatra nivasanti sudhārmikāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्याश् च तत्र तिष्ठन्ति वारमुख्याः सुलोचनाः घृताचीमेनकातुल्यास् तथा समतिलोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: anyāś ca tatra tiṣṭhanti vāramukhyāḥ sulocanāḥ ghṛtācīmenakātulyās tathā samatilottamāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उर्वशीसदृशाश् चैव विप्रचित्तिनिभास् तथा विश्वाचीसहजन्याभाः प्रम्लोचासदृशास् तथा
verses.transliteration: urvaśīsadṛśāś caiva vipracittinibhās tathā viśvācīsahajanyābhāḥ pramlocāsadṛśās tathā
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वास् ताः प्रियवादिन्यः सर्वा विहसिताननाः कलाकौशलसंयुक्ताः सर्वास् ता गुणसंयुताः
verses.transliteration: sarvās tāḥ priyavādinyaḥ sarvā vihasitānanāḥ kalākauśalasaṃyuktāḥ sarvās tā guṇasaṃyutāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं पण्यस्त्रियस् तत्र नृत्यगीतविशारदाः निवसन्ति मुनिश्रेष्ठाः सर्वस्त्रीगुणगर्विताः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ paṇyastriyas tatra nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ nivasanti muniśreṣṭhāḥ sarvastrīguṇagarvitāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रेक्षणालापकुशलाः सुन्दर्यः प्रियदर्शनाः न रूपहीना दुर्वृत्ता न परद्रोहकारिकाः
verses.transliteration: prekṣaṇālāpakuśalāḥ sundaryaḥ priyadarśanāḥ na rūpahīnā durvṛttā na paradrohakārikāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यासां कटाक्षपातेन मोहं गच्छन्ति मानवाः न तत्र निर्धनाः सन्ति न मूर्खा न परद्विषः
verses.transliteration: yāsāṃ kaṭākṣapātena mohaṃ gacchanti mānavāḥ na tatra nirdhanāḥ santi na mūrkhā na paradviṣaḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न रोगिणो न मलिना न कदर्या न मायिनः न रूपहीना दुर्वृत्ता न परद्रोहकारिणः
verses.transliteration: na rogiṇo na malinā na kadaryā na māyinaḥ na rūpahīnā durvṛttā na paradrohakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठन्ति मानवास् तत्र क्षेत्रे जगति विश्रुते सर्वत्र सुखसंचारं सर्वसत्त्वसुखावहम्
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭhanti mānavās tatra kṣetre jagati viśrute sarvatra sukhasaṃcāraṃ sarvasattvasukhāvaham
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नानाजनसमाकीर्णं सर्वसस्यसमन्वितम् कर्णिकारैश् च पनसैश् चम्पकैर् नागकेसरैः
verses.transliteration: nānājanasamākīrṇaṃ sarvasasyasamanvitam karṇikāraiś ca panasaiś campakair nāgakesaraiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पाटलाशोकबकुलैः कपित्थैर् बहुलैर् धवैः चूतनिम्बकदम्बैश् च तथान्यैः पुष्पजातिभिः
verses.transliteration: pāṭalāśokabakulaiḥ kapitthair bahulair dhavaiḥ cūtanimbakadambaiś ca tathānyaiḥ puṣpajātibhiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नीपकैर् धवखदिरैर् लताभिश् च विराजितम् शालैस् तालैस् तमालैश् च नारिकेलैः शुभाञ्जनैः
verses.transliteration: nīpakair dhavakhadirair latābhiś ca virājitam śālais tālais tamālaiś ca nārikelaiḥ śubhāñjanaiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुनैः समपर्णैश् च कोविदारैः सपिप्पलैः लकुचैः सरलैर् लोध्रैर् हिन्तालैर् देवदारुभिः
verses.transliteration: arjunaiḥ samaparṇaiś ca kovidāraiḥ sapippalaiḥ lakucaiḥ saralair lodhrair hintālair devadārubhiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पलाशैर् मुचुकुन्दैश् च पारिजातैः सकुब्जकैः कदलीवनखण्डैश् च जम्बूपूगफलैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: palāśair mucukundaiś ca pārijātaiḥ sakubjakaiḥ kadalīvanakhaṇḍaiś ca jambūpūgaphalais tathā
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: केतकीकरवीरैश् च अतिमुक्तैश् च किंशुकैः मन्दारकुन्दपुष्पैश् च तथान्यैः पुष्पजातिभिः
verses.transliteration: ketakīkaravīraiś ca atimuktaiś ca kiṃśukaiḥ mandārakundapuṣpaiś ca tathānyaiḥ puṣpajātibhiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नानापक्षिरुतैः सेव्यैर् उद्यानैर् नन्दनोपमैः फलभारानतैर् वृक्षैः सर्वर्तुकुसुमोत्करैः
verses.transliteration: nānāpakṣirutaiḥ sevyair udyānair nandanopamaiḥ phalabhārānatair vṛkṣaiḥ sarvartukusumotkaraiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चकोरैः शतपत्त्रैश् च भृङ्गराजैश् च कोकिलैः कलविङ्कैर् मयूरैश् च प्रियपुत्रैः शुकैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: cakoraiḥ śatapattraiś ca bhṛṅgarājaiś ca kokilaiḥ kalaviṅkair mayūraiś ca priyaputraiḥ śukais tathā
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जीवंजीवकहारीतैश् चातकैर् वनवेष्टितैः नानापक्षिगणैश् चान्यैः कूजद्भिर् मधुरस्वरैः
verses.transliteration: jīvaṃjīvakahārītaiś cātakair vanaveṣṭitaiḥ nānāpakṣigaṇaiś cānyaiḥ kūjadbhir madhurasvaraiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घिकाभिस् तडागैश् च पुष्करिणीभिश् च वापिभिः नानाजलाशयैश् चान्यैः पद्मिनीखण्डमण्डितैः
verses.transliteration: dīrghikābhis taḍāgaiś ca puṣkariṇībhiś ca vāpibhiḥ nānājalāśayaiś cānyaiḥ padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitaiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुमुदैः पुण्डरीकैश् च तथा नीलोत्पलैः शुभैः कादम्बैश् चक्रवाकैश् च तथैव जलकुक्कुटैः
verses.transliteration: kumudaiḥ puṇḍarīkaiś ca tathā nīlotpalaiḥ śubhaiḥ kādambaiś cakravākaiś ca tathaiva jalakukkuṭaiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कारण्डवैः प्लवैर् हंसैस् तथान्यैर् जलचारिभिः एवं नानाविधैर् वृक्षैः पुष्पैर् नानाविधैर् वरैः
verses.transliteration: kāraṇḍavaiḥ plavair haṃsais tathānyair jalacāribhiḥ evaṃ nānāvidhair vṛkṣaiḥ puṣpair nānāvidhair varaiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नानाजलाशयैः पुण्यैः शोभितं तत् समन्ततः आस्ते तत्र स्वयं देवः कृत्तिवासा वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: nānājalāśayaiḥ puṇyaiḥ śobhitaṃ tat samantataḥ āste tatra svayaṃ devaḥ kṛttivāsā vṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हिताय सर्वलोकस्य भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदः शिवः पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि सरितश् च सरांसि च
verses.transliteration: hitāya sarvalokasya bhuktimuktipradaḥ śivaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni saritaś ca sarāṃsi ca
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुष्करिण्यस् तडागानि वाप्यः कूपाश् च सागराः तेभ्यः पूर्वं समाहृत्य जलबिन्दून् पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: puṣkariṇyas taḍāgāni vāpyaḥ kūpāś ca sāgarāḥ tebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ samāhṛtya jalabindūn pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकहितार्थाय रुद्रः सर्वसुरैः सह तीर्थं बिन्दुसरो नाम तस्मिन् क्षेत्रे द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sarvalokahitārthāya rudraḥ sarvasuraiḥ saha tīrthaṃ bindusaro nāma tasmin kṣetre dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चकार ऋषिभिः सार्धं तेन बिन्दुसरः स्मृतम् अष्टम्यां बहुले पक्षे मार्गशीर्षे द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: cakāra ṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ tena bindusaraḥ smṛtam aṣṭamyāṃ bahule pakṣe mārgaśīrṣe dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस् तत्र यात्रां कुरुते विषुवे विजितेन्द्रियः विधिवद् बिन्दुसरसि स्नात्वा श्रद्धासमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: yas tatra yātrāṃ kurute viṣuve vijitendriyaḥ vidhivad bindusarasi snātvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवान् ऋषीन् मनुष्यांश् च पितॄन् संतर्प्य वाग्यतः तिलोदकेन विधिना नामगोत्रविधानवित्
verses.transliteration: devān ṛṣīn manuṣyāṃś ca pitṝn saṃtarpya vāgyataḥ tilodakena vidhinā nāmagotravidhānavit
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वैवं विधिवत् तत्र सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ग्रहोपरागे विषुवे संक्रान्त्याम् अयने तथा
verses.transliteration: snātvaivaṃ vidhivat tatra so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet grahoparāge viṣuve saṃkrāntyām ayane tathā
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: युगादिषु षडशीत्यां तथान्यत्र शुभे तिथौ ये तत्र दानं विप्रेभ्यः प्रयच्छन्ति धनादिकम्
verses.transliteration: yugādiṣu ṣaḍaśītyāṃ tathānyatra śubhe tithau ye tatra dānaṃ viprebhyaḥ prayacchanti dhanādikam
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्यतीर्थाच् छतगुणं फलं ते प्राप्नुवन्ति वै पिण्डं ये संप्रयच्छन्ति पितृभ्यः सरसस् तटे
verses.transliteration: anyatīrthāc chataguṇaṃ phalaṃ te prāpnuvanti vai piṇḍaṃ ye saṃprayacchanti pitṛbhyaḥ sarasas taṭe
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पितॄणाम् अक्षयां तृप्तिं ते कुर्वन्ति न संशयः ततः शंभोर् गृहं गत्वा वाग्यतः संयतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: pitṝṇām akṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ te kurvanti na saṃśayaḥ tataḥ śaṃbhor gṛhaṃ gatvā vāgyataḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य पूजयेच् छर्वं कृत्वा तं त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम् घृतक्षीरादिभिः स्नानं कारयित्वा भवं शुचिः
verses.transliteration: praviśya pūjayec charvaṃ kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam ghṛtakṣīrādibhiḥ snānaṃ kārayitvā bhavaṃ śuciḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चन्दनेन सुगन्धेन विलिप्य कुङ्कुमेन च ततः संपूजयेद् देवं चन्द्रमौलिम् उमापतिम्
verses.transliteration: candanena sugandhena vilipya kuṅkumena ca tataḥ saṃpūjayed devaṃ candramaulim umāpatim
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पैर् नानाविधैर् मेध्यैर् बिल्वार्ककमलादिभिः आगमोक्तेन मन्त्रेण वेदोक्तेन च शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: puṣpair nānāvidhair medhyair bilvārkakamalādibhiḥ āgamoktena mantreṇa vedoktena ca śaṃkaram
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अदीक्षितस् तु नाम्नैव मूलमन्त्रेण चार्चयेत् एवं संपूज्य तं देवं गन्धपुष्पानुरागिभिः
verses.transliteration: adīkṣitas tu nāmnaiva mūlamantreṇa cārcayet evaṃ saṃpūjya taṃ devaṃ gandhapuṣpānurāgibhiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धूपदीपैश् च नैवेद्यैर् उपहारैस् तथा स्तवैः दण्डवत्प्रणिपातैश् च गीतैर् वाद्यैर् मनोहरैः
verses.transliteration: dhūpadīpaiś ca naivedyair upahārais tathā stavaiḥ daṇḍavatpraṇipātaiś ca gītair vādyair manoharaiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यजप्यनमस्कारैर् जयशब्दैः प्रदक्षिणैः एवं संपूज्य विधिवद् देवदेवम् उमापतिम्
verses.transliteration: nṛtyajapyanamaskārair jayaśabdaiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad devadevam umāpatim
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो रूपयौवनगर्वितः कुलैकविंशम् उद्धृत्य दिव्याभरणभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmukto rūpayauvanagarvitaḥ kulaikaviṃśam uddhṛtya divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सौवर्णेन विमानेन किङ्किणीजालमालिना उपगीयमानो गन्धर्वैर् अप्सरोभिर् अलंकृतः
verses.transliteration: sauvarṇena vimānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā upagīyamāno gandharvair apsarobhir alaṃkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उद्द्योतयन् दिशः सर्वाः शिवलोकं स गच्छति भुक्त्वा तत्र सुखं विप्रा मनसः प्रीतिदायकम्
verses.transliteration: uddyotayan diśaḥ sarvāḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati bhuktvā tatra sukhaṃ viprā manasaḥ prītidāyakam
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तल्लोकवासिभिः सार्धं यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम् ततस् तस्माद् इहायातः पृथिव्यां पुण्यसंक्षये
verses.transliteration: tallokavāsibhiḥ sārdhaṃ yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam tatas tasmād ihāyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ puṇyasaṃkṣaye
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जायते योगिनां गेहे चतुर्वेदी द्विजोत्तमाः योगं पाशुपतं प्राप्य ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: jāyate yogināṃ gehe caturvedī dvijottamāḥ yogaṃ pāśupataṃ prāpya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शयनोत्थापने चैव संक्रान्त्याम् अयने तथा अशोकाख्यां तथाष्टम्यां पवित्रारोपणे तथा
verses.transliteration: śayanotthāpane caiva saṃkrāntyām ayane tathā aśokākhyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ pavitrāropaṇe tathā
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये च पश्यन्ति तं देवं कृत्तिवाससम् उत्तमम् विमानेनार्कवर्णेन शिवलोकं व्रजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: ye ca paśyanti taṃ devaṃ kṛttivāsasam uttamam vimānenārkavarṇena śivalokaṃ vrajanti te
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकाले ऽपि तं देवं ये पश्यन्ति सुमेधसः ते ऽपि पापविनिर्मुक्ताः शिवलोकं व्रजन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: sarvakāle 'pi taṃ devaṃ ye paśyanti sumedhasaḥ te 'pi pāpavinirmuktāḥ śivalokaṃ vrajanti vai
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवस्य पश्चिमे पूर्वे दक्षिणे चोत्तरे तथा योजनद्वितयं सार्धं क्षेत्रं तद् भुक्तिमुक्तिदम्
verses.transliteration: devasya paścime pūrve dakṣiṇe cottare tathā yojanadvitayaṃ sārdhaṃ kṣetraṃ tad bhuktimuktidam
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे लिङ्गं भास्करेश्वरसंज्ञितम् पश्यन्ति ये तु तं देवं स्नात्वा कुण्डे महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tasmin kṣetravare liṅgaṃ bhāskareśvarasaṃjñitam paśyanti ye tu taṃ devaṃ snātvā kuṇḍe maheśvaram
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आदित्येनार्चितं पूर्वं देवदेवं त्रिलोचनम् सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्ता विमानवरम् आस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: ādityenārcitaṃ pūrvaṃ devadevaṃ trilocanam sarvapāpavinirmuktā vimānavaram āsthitāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपगीयमाना गन्धर्वैः शिवलोकं व्रजन्ति ते तिष्ठन्ति तत्र मुदिताः कल्पम् एकं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: upagīyamānā gandharvaiḥ śivalokaṃ vrajanti te tiṣṭhanti tatra muditāḥ kalpam ekaṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान् भोगाञ् शिवलोके मनोरमान् पुण्यक्षयाद् इहायाता जायन्ते प्रवरे कुले
verses.transliteration: bhuktvā tu vipulān bhogāñ śivaloke manoramān puṇyakṣayād ihāyātā jāyante pravare kule
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अथवा योगिनां गेहे वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः उत्पद्यन्ते द्विजवराः सर्वभूतहिते रताः
verses.transliteration: athavā yogināṃ gehe vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ utpadyante dvijavarāḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षशास्त्रार्थकुशलाः सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः योगं शंभोर् वरं प्राप्य ततो मोक्षं व्रजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: mokṣaśāstrārthakuśalāḥ sarvatra samabuddhayaḥ yogaṃ śaṃbhor varaṃ prāpya tato mokṣaṃ vrajanti te
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे पुण्ये लिङ्गं यद् दृश्यते द्विजाः पूज्यापूज्यं च सर्वत्र वने रथ्यान्तरे ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: tasmin kṣetravare puṇye liṅgaṃ yad dṛśyate dvijāḥ pūjyāpūjyaṃ ca sarvatra vane rathyāntare 'pi vā
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चतुष्पथे श्मशाने वा यत्र कुत्र च तिष्ठति दृष्ट्वा तल् लिङ्गम् अव्यग्रः श्रद्धया सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: catuṣpathe śmaśāne vā yatra kutra ca tiṣṭhati dṛṣṭvā tal liṅgam avyagraḥ śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयित्वा तु तं भक्त्या गन्धैः पुष्पैर् मनोहरैः धूपैर् दीपैः सनैवेद्यैर् नमस्कारैस् तथा स्तवैः
verses.transliteration: snāpayitvā tu taṃ bhaktyā gandhaiḥ puṣpair manoharaiḥ dhūpair dīpaiḥ sanaivedyair namaskārais tathā stavaiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दण्डवत्प्रणिपातैश् च नृत्यगीतादिभिस् तथा संपूज्यैवं विधानेन शिवलोकं व्रजेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: daṇḍavatpraṇipātaiś ca nṛtyagītādibhis tathā saṃpūjyaivaṃ vidhānena śivalokaṃ vrajen naraḥ
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नारी वा द्विजशार्दूलाः संपूज्य श्रद्धयान्विता पूर्वोक्तं फलम् आप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: nārī vā dvijaśārdūlāḥ saṃpūjya śraddhayānvitā pūrvoktaṃ phalam āpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कः शक्नोति गुणान् वक्तुं समग्रान् मुनिसत्तमाः तस्य क्षेत्रवरस्याथ ऋते देवान् महेश्वरात्
verses.transliteration: kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ samagrān munisattamāḥ tasya kṣetravarasyātha ṛte devān maheśvarāt
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् क्षेत्रोत्तमे गत्वा श्रद्धयाश्रद्धयापि वा माधवादिषु मासेषु नरो वा यदि वाङ्गना
verses.transliteration: tasmin kṣetrottame gatvā śraddhayāśraddhayāpi vā mādhavādiṣu māseṣu naro vā yadi vāṅganā
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् यस्मिंस् तिथौ विप्राः स्नात्वा बिन्दुसरोम्भसि पश्येद् देवं विरूपाक्षं देवीं च वरदां शिवाम्
verses.transliteration: yasmin yasmiṃs tithau viprāḥ snātvā bindusarombhasi paśyed devaṃ virūpākṣaṃ devīṃ ca varadāṃ śivām
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गणं चण्डं कार्त्तिकेयं गणेशं वृषभं तथा कल्पद्रुमं च सावित्रीं शिवलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: gaṇaṃ caṇḍaṃ kārttikeyaṃ gaṇeśaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tathā kalpadrumaṃ ca sāvitrīṃ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा च कापिले तीर्थे विधिवत् पापनाशने प्राप्नोत्य् अभिमतान् कामाञ् शिवलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: snātvā ca kāpile tīrthe vidhivat pāpanāśane prāpnoty abhimatān kāmāñ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यः स्तम्भ्यं तत्र विधिवत् करोति नियतेन्द्रियः कुलैकविंशम् उद्धृत्य शिवलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: yaḥ stambhyaṃ tatra vidhivat karoti niyatendriyaḥ kulaikaviṃśam uddhṛtya śivalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकाम्रके शिवक्षेत्रे वाराणसीसमे शुभे स्नानं करोति यस् तत्र मोक्षं स लभते ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: ekāmrake śivakṣetre vārāṇasīsame śubhe snānaṃ karoti yas tatra mokṣaṃ sa labhate dhruvam
verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विरजे विरजा माता ब्रह्माणी संप्रतिष्ठिता यस्याः संदर्शनान् मर्त्यः पुनात्य् आसप्तमं कुलम्
verses.transliteration: viraje virajā mātā brahmāṇī saṃpratiṣṭhitā yasyāḥ saṃdarśanān martyaḥ punāty āsaptamaṃ kulam
verses.translation: By visiting that goddess even for once and by worshipp¬ ing and bowing to her with devotion a man redeems hii family and goes to my world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सकृद् दृष्ट्वा तु तां देवीं भक्त्यापूज्य प्रणम्य च नरः स्ववंशम् उद्धृत्य मम लोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: sakṛd dṛṣṭvā tu tāṃ devīṃ bhaktyāpūjya praṇamya ca naraḥ svavaṃśam uddhṛtya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: The other mothers of the world who stand in Viraja are goddesses who dispel sins and bestow boons. They are &vour- ably disposed to the devotees.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्याश् च तत्र तिष्ठन्ति विरजे लोकमातरः सर्वपापहरा देव्यो वरदा भक्तिवत्सलाः
verses.transliteration: anyāś ca tatra tiṣṭhanti viraje lokamātaraḥ sarvapāpaharā devyo varadā bhaktivatsalāḥ
verses.translation: The self*bom lord Vi|iu stays there in the form of a Boar. By visiting him and bowing to him with devotim man goes to Vifnu's abode.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते वैतरणी तत्र सर्वपापहरा नदी यस्यां स्नात्वा नरश्रेष्ठः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: āste vaitaraṇī tatra sarvapāpaharā nadī yasyāṃ snātvā naraśreṣṭhaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: He who offers balls of rice in Viraja* my holy centre* shall undoubtedly accord ever-lasting satisfaction to the manes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते स्वयंभूस् तत्रैव क्रोडरूपी हरिः स्वयम् दृष्ट्वा प्रणम्य तं भक्त्या परं विष्णुं व्रजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: āste svayaṃbhūs tatraiva kroḍarūpī hariḥ svayam dṛṣṭvā praṇamya taṃ bhaktyā paraṃ viṣṇuṃ vrajanti te
verses.translation: O excellent ses* men who cast off their body in Viraja my holy centre* do attain salvation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कापिले गोग्रहे सोमे तीर्थे चालाबुसंज्ञिते मृत्युंजये क्रोडतीर्थे वासुके सिद्धकेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: kāpile gograhe some tīrthe cālābusaṃjñite mṛtyuṃjaye kroḍatīrthe vāsuke siddhakeśvare
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थेष्व् एतेषु मतिमान् विरजे संयतेन्द्रियः गत्वाष्टतीर्थं विधिवत् स्नात्वा देवान् प्रणम्य च
verses.transliteration: tīrtheṣv eteṣu matimān viraje saṃyatendriyaḥ gatvāṣṭatīrthaṃ vidhivat snātvā devān praṇamya ca
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विमानवरम् आस्थितः उपगीयमानो गन्धर्वैर् मम लोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmukto vimānavaram āsthitaḥ upagīyamāno gandharvair mama loke mahīyate
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विरजे यो मम क्षेत्रे पिण्डदानं करोति वै स करोत्य् अक्षयां तृप्तिं पितॄणां नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: viraje yo mama kṣetre piṇḍadānaṃ karoti vai sa karoty akṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ pitṝṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मम क्षेत्रे मुनिश्रेष्ठा विरजे ये कलेवरम् परित्यजन्ति पुरुषास् ते मोक्षं प्राप्नुवन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: mama kṣetre muniśreṣṭhā viraje ye kalevaram parityajanti puruṣās te mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti vai
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा यः सागरे मर्त्यो दृष्ट्वा च कपिलं हरिम् पश्येद् देवीं च वाराहीं स याति त्रिदशालयम्
verses.transliteration: snātvā yaḥ sāgare martyo dṛṣṭvā ca kapilaṃ harim paśyed devīṃ ca vārāhīṃ sa yāti tridaśālayam
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सन्ति चान्यानि तीर्थानि पुण्यान्य् आयतनानि च तत्काले तु मुनिश्रेष्ठा वेदितव्यानि तानि वै
verses.transliteration: santi cānyāni tīrthāni puṇyāny āyatanāni ca tatkāle tu muniśreṣṭhā veditavyāni tāni vai
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रस्योत्तरे तीरे तस्मिन् देशे द्विजोत्तमाः आस्ते गुह्यं परं क्षेत्रं मुक्तिदं पापनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: samudrasyottare tīre tasmin deśe dvijottamāḥ āste guhyaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ muktidaṃ pāpanāśanam
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र वालुकाकीर्णं पवित्रं सर्वकामदम् दशयोजनविस्तीर्णं क्षेत्रं परमदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: sarvatra vālukākīrṇaṃ pavitraṃ sarvakāmadam daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अशोकार्जुनपुंनागैर् बकुलैः सरलद्रुमैः पनसैर् नारिकेलैश् च शालैस् तालैः कपित्थकैः
verses.transliteration: aśokārjunapuṃnāgair bakulaiḥ saraladrumaiḥ panasair nārikelaiś ca śālais tālaiḥ kapitthakaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चम्पकैः कर्णिकारैश् च चूतबिल्वैः सपाटलैः कदम्बैः कोविदारैश् च लकुचैर् नागकेसरैः
verses.transliteration: campakaiḥ karṇikāraiś ca cūtabilvaiḥ sapāṭalaiḥ kadambaiḥ kovidāraiś ca lakucair nāgakesaraiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्राचीनामलकैर् लोध्रैर् नारङ्गैर् धवखादिरैः सर्जभूर्जाश्वकर्णैश् च तमालैर् देवदारुभिः
verses.transliteration: prācīnāmalakair lodhrair nāraṅgair dhavakhādiraiḥ sarjabhūrjāśvakarṇaiś ca tamālair devadārubhiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मन्दारैः पारिजातैश् च न्यग्रोधागुरुचन्दनैः खर्जूराम्रातकैः सिद्धैर् मुचुकुन्दैः सकिंशुकैः
verses.transliteration: mandāraiḥ pārijātaiś ca nyagrodhāgurucandanaiḥ kharjūrāmrātakaiḥ siddhair mucukundaiḥ sakiṃśukaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थैः सप्तपर्णैश् च मधुधारशुभाञ्जनैः शिंशपामलकैर् नीपैर् निम्बतिन्दुविभीतकैः
verses.transliteration: aśvatthaiḥ saptaparṇaiś ca madhudhāraśubhāñjanaiḥ śiṃśapāmalakair nīpair nimbatinduvibhītakaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वर्तुफलगन्धाढ्यैः सर्वर्तुकुसुमोज्ज्वलैः मनोह्लादकरैः शुभ्रैर् नानाविहगनादितैः
verses.transliteration: sarvartuphalagandhāḍhyaiḥ sarvartukusumojjvalaiḥ manohlādakaraiḥ śubhrair nānāvihaganāditaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्ररम्यैः सुमधुरैर् बलनिर्मदनेरितैः मनसः प्रीतिजनकैः शब्दैः खगमुखेरितैः
verses.transliteration: śrotraramyaiḥ sumadhurair balanirmadaneritaiḥ manasaḥ prītijanakaiḥ śabdaiḥ khagamukheritaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).

verses.sanskrit: चकोरैः शतपत्त्रैश् च भृङ्गराजैस् तथा शुकैः कोकिलैः कलविङ्कैश् च हारीतैर् जीवजीवकैः
verses.transliteration: cakoraiḥ śatapattraiś ca bhṛṅgarājais tathā śukaiḥ kokilaiḥ kalaviṅkaiś ca hārītair jīvajīvakaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रियपुत्रैश् चातकैश् च तथान्यैर् मधुरस्वरैः श्रोत्ररम्यैः प्रियकरैः कूजद्भिश् चार्वधिष्ठितैः
verses.transliteration: priyaputraiś cātakaiś ca tathānyair madhurasvaraiḥ śrotraramyaiḥ priyakaraiḥ kūjadbhiś cārvadhiṣṭhitaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).

verses.sanskrit: केतकीवनखण्डैश् च अतिमुक्तैः सकुब्जकैः मालतीकुन्दबाणैश् च करवीरैः सितेतरैः
verses.transliteration: ketakīvanakhaṇḍaiś ca atimuktaiḥ sakubjakaiḥ mālatīkundabāṇaiś ca karavīraiḥ sitetaraiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जम्बीरकरुणाङ्कोलैर् दाडिमैर् बीजपूरकैः मातुलुङ्गैः पूगफलैर् हिन्तालैः कदलीवनैः
verses.transliteration: jambīrakaruṇāṅkolair dāḍimair bījapūrakaiḥ mātuluṅgaiḥ pūgaphalair hintālaiḥ kadalīvanaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्यैश् च विविधैर् वृक्षैः पुष्पैश् चान्यैर् मनोहरैः लतावितानगुल्मैश् च विविधैश् च जलाशयैः
verses.transliteration: anyaiś ca vividhair vṛkṣaiḥ puṣpaiś cānyair manoharaiḥ latāvitānagulmaiś ca vividhaiś ca jalāśayaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घिकाभिस् तडागैश् च पुष्करिणीभिश् च वापिभिः नानाजलाशयैः पुण्यैः पद्मिनीखण्डमण्डितैः
verses.transliteration: dīrghikābhis taḍāgaiś ca puṣkariṇībhiś ca vāpibhiḥ nānājalāśayaiḥ puṇyaiḥ padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सरांसि च मनोज्ञानि प्रसन्नसलिलानि च कुमुदैः पुण्डरीकैश् च तथा नीलोत्पलैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: sarāṃsi ca manojñāni prasannasalilāni ca kumudaiḥ puṇḍarīkaiś ca tathā nīlotpalaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).

verses.sanskrit: कह्लारैः कमलैश् चापि आचितानि समन्ततः कादम्बैश् चक्रवाकैश् च तथैव जलकुक्कुटैः
verses.transliteration: kahlāraiḥ kamalaiś cāpi ācitāni samantataḥ kādambaiś cakravākaiś ca tathaiva jalakukkuṭaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कारण्डवैः प्लवैर् हंसैः कूर्मैर् मत्स्यैश् च मद्गुभिः दात्यूहसारसाकीर्णैः कोयष्टिबकशोभितैः
verses.transliteration: kāraṇḍavaiḥ plavair haṃsaiḥ kūrmair matsyaiś ca madgubhiḥ dātyūhasārasākīrṇaiḥ koyaṣṭibakaśobhitaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतैश् चान्यैश् च कूजद्भिः समन्ताज् जलचारिभिः खगैर् जलचरैश् चान्यैः कुसुमैश् च जलोद्भवैः
verses.transliteration: etaiś cānyaiś ca kūjadbhiḥ samantāj jalacāribhiḥ khagair jalacaraiś cānyaiḥ kusumaiś ca jalodbhavaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).

verses.sanskrit: एवं नानाविधैर् वृक्षैः पुष्पैः स्थलजलोद्भवैः ब्रह्मचारिगृहस्थैश् च वानप्रस्थैश् च भिक्षुभिः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ nānāvidhair vṛkṣaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sthalajalodbhavaiḥ brahmacārigṛhasthaiś ca vānaprasthaiś ca bhikṣubhiḥ

verses.sanskrit: स्वधर्मनिरतैर् वर्णैस् तथान्यैः समलंकृतम् हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णं नरनारीसमाकुलम्
verses.transliteration: svadharmaniratair varṇais tathānyaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇaṃ naranārīsamākulam
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).

verses.sanskrit: अशेषविद्यानिलयं सर्वधर्मगुणाकरम् एवं सर्वगुणोपेतं क्षेत्रं परमदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: aśeṣavidyānilayaṃ sarvadharmaguṇākaram evaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते तत्र मुनिश्रेष्ठा विख्यातः पुरुषोत्तमः यावद् उत्कलमर्यादा दिक् क्रमेण प्रकीर्तिता
verses.transliteration: āste tatra muniśreṣṭhā vikhyātaḥ puruṣottamaḥ yāvad utkalamaryādā dik krameṇa prakīrtitā
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).

verses.sanskrit: तावत् कृष्णप्रसादेन देशः पुण्यतमो हि सः यत्र तिष्ठति विश्वात्मा देशे स पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tāvat kṛṣṇaprasādena deśaḥ puṇyatamo hi saḥ yatra tiṣṭhati viśvātmā deśe sa puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जगद्व्यापी जगन्नाथस् तत्र सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् अहं रुद्रश् च शक्रश् च देवाश् चाग्निपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: jagadvyāpī jagannāthas tatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ahaṃ rudraś ca śakraś ca devāś cāgnipurogamāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निवसामो मुनिश्रेष्ठास् तस्मिन् देशे सदा वयम् गन्धर्वाप्सरसः सर्वाः पितरो देवमानुषाः
verses.transliteration: nivasāmo muniśreṣṭhās tasmin deśe sadā vayam gandharvāpsarasaḥ sarvāḥ pitaro devamānuṣāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यक्षा विद्याधराः सिद्धा मुनयः संशितव्रताः ऋषयो वालखिल्याश् च कश्यपाद्याः प्रजेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: yakṣā vidyādharāḥ siddhā munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ṛṣayo vālakhilyāś ca kaśyapādyāḥ prajeśvarāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्णाः किंनरा नागास् तथान्ये स्वर्गवासिनः साङ्गाश् च चतुरो वेदाः शास्त्राणि विविधानि च
verses.transliteration: suparṇāḥ kiṃnarā nāgās tathānye svargavāsinaḥ sāṅgāś ca caturo vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इतिहासपुराणानि यज्ञाश् च वरदक्षिणाः नद्यश् च विविधाः पुण्यास् तीर्थान्य् आयतनानि च
verses.transliteration: itihāsapurāṇāni yajñāś ca varadakṣiṇāḥ nadyaś ca vividhāḥ puṇyās tīrthāny āyatanāni ca
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सागराश् च तथा शैलास् तस्मिन् देशे व्यवस्थिताः एवं पुण्यतमे देशे देवर्षिपितृसेविते
verses.transliteration: sāgarāś ca tathā śailās tasmin deśe vyavasthitāḥ evaṃ puṇyatame deśe devarṣipitṛsevite
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोपभोगसहिते वासः कस्य न रोचते श्रेष्ठत्वं कस्य देशस्य किं चान्यद् अधिकं ततः
verses.transliteration: sarvopabhogasahite vāsaḥ kasya na rocate śreṣṭhatvaṃ kasya deśasya kiṃ cānyad adhikaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते यत्र स्वयं देवो मुक्तिदः पुरुषोत्तमः धन्यास् ते विबुधप्रख्या ये वसन्त्य् उत्कले नराः
verses.transliteration: āste yatra svayaṃ devo muktidaḥ puruṣottamaḥ dhanyās te vibudhaprakhyā ye vasanty utkale narāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थराजजले स्नात्वा पश्यन्ति पुरुषोत्तमम् स्वर्गे वसन्ति ते मर्त्या न ते यान्ति यमालये
verses.transliteration: tīrtharājajale snātvā paśyanti puruṣottamam svarge vasanti te martyā na te yānti yamālaye
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये वसन्त्य् उत्कले क्षेत्रे पुण्ये श्रीपुरुषोत्तमे सफलं जीवितं तेषाम् उत्कलानां सुमेधसाम्
verses.transliteration: ye vasanty utkale kṣetre puṇye śrīpuruṣottame saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ teṣām utkalānāṃ sumedhasām
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये पश्यन्ति सुरश्रेष्ठं प्रसन्नायतलोचनम् चारुभ्रूकेशमुकुटं चारुकर्णावतंसकम्
verses.transliteration: ye paśyanti suraśreṣṭhaṃ prasannāyatalocanam cārubhrūkeśamukuṭaṃ cārukarṇāvataṃsakam
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चारुस्मितं चारुदन्तं चारुकुण्डलमण्डितम् सुनासं सुकपोलं च सुललाटं सुलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: cārusmitaṃ cārudantaṃ cārukuṇḍalamaṇḍitam sunāsaṃ sukapolaṃ ca sulalāṭaṃ sulakṣaṇam
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यानन्दजननं कृष्णस्य मुखपङ्कजम्
verses.transliteration: trailokyānandajananaṃ kṛṣṇasya mukhapaṅkajam
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरा कृतयुगे विप्राः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः बभूव नृपतिः श्रीमान् इन्द्रद्युम्न इति श्रुतः
verses.transliteration: purā kṛtayuge viprāḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ babhūva nṛpatiḥ śrīmān indradyumna iti śrutaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, formerly, in the Krtayuga there was a glorious king who was known as Indradyumna. He was as valor¬ ous asIndra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सत्यवादी शुचिर् दक्षः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः रूपवान् सुभगः शूरो दाता भोक्ता प्रियंवदः
verses.transliteration: satyavādī śucir dakṣaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ rūpavān subhagaḥ śūro dātā bhoktā priyaṃvadaḥ
verses.translation: While that king, the repository of good qualities, ruled over the Earth he thought of propitiating Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यष्टा समस्तयज्ञानां ब्रह्मण्यः सत्यसंगरः धनुर्वेदे च वेदे च शास्त्रे च निपुणः कृती
verses.transliteration: yaṣṭā samastayajñānāṃ brahmaṇyaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ dhanurvede ca vede ca śāstre ca nipuṇaḥ kṛtī
verses.translation: "How shall I propitiate Visjriu, the lord ofDevas? In which holy centre or sacred spot or the river bank or hermitage shall it be?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वल्लभो नरनारीणां पौर्णमास्यां यथा शशी आदित्य इव दुष्प्रेक्ष्यः शत्रुसंघभयंकरः
verses.transliteration: vallabho naranārīṇāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ yathā śaśī āditya iva duṣprekṣyaḥ śatrusaṃghabhayaṃkaraḥ
verses.translation: The king went there accompanied by his flourishing army and vehicles. He duly performed a horse sacrifice where much wealth was distributed as gift.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैष्णवः सत्त्वसंपन्नो जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः अध्येता योगसांख्यानां मुमुक्षुर् धर्मतत्परः
verses.transliteration: vaiṣṇavaḥ sattvasaṃpanno jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ adhyetā yogasāṃkhyānāṃ mumukṣur dharmatatparaḥ
verses.translation: The city of Avanti 1 in Malava, known as the most excellent one over the earth, was the capital of that monarch.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं स पालयन् पृथ्वीं राजा सर्वगुणाकरः तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना हरेर् आराधनं प्रति
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa pālayan pṛthvīṃ rājā sarvaguṇākaraḥ tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā harer ārādhanaṃ prati
verses.translation: They were liberal donors of jewels and the enjoyers of riches. O excellent sages, charming women were seen in that splendid land.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कथम् आराधयिष्यामि देवदेवं जनार्दनम् कस्मिन् क्षेत्रे ऽथवा तीर्थे नदीतीरे तथाश्रमे
verses.transliteration: katham ārādhayiṣyāmi devadevaṃ janārdanam kasmin kṣetre 'thavā tīrthe nadītīre tathāśrame
verses.translation: Their tresses were glossy and beautiful. Their cheeks were fine and their forelocks steady. Their teeth were like the clearly \ Isible lightning streaks. Their faces were like the full moon. They bent their necks in exhibiting their emotions with gesticulation and charming twists; their ears were adorned with ornaments.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं चिन्तापरः सो ऽथ निरीक्ष्य मनसा महीम् आलोक्य सर्वतीर्थानि क्षेत्राण्य् अथ पुराण्य् अपि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ cintāparaḥ so 'tha nirīkṣya manasā mahīm ālokya sarvatīrthāni kṣetrāṇy atha purāṇy api
verses.translation: Their lips were red like Bimba fruits. They shone with their mouths coloured by chewing betal leaves. They were bedecked in golden ornaments.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तानि सर्वाणि संत्यज्य जगामायतनं पुनः विख्यातं परमं क्षेत्रं मुक्तिदं पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tāni sarvāṇi saṃtyajya jagāmāyatanaṃ punaḥ vikhyātaṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ muktidaṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: Some were dark-complexioned, some were fair-comple- xioned; they had fine buttocks, their girdles and armlets produc¬ ed charming sounds-. They wore divine garlands and garments; they applied divine scents and unguents over their bodies.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स गत्वा तत् क्षेत्रवरं समृद्धबलवाहनः अयजच् चाश्वमेधेन विधिवद् भूरिदक्षिणः
verses.transliteration: sa gatvā tat kṣetravaraṃ samṛddhabalavāhanaḥ ayajac cāśvamedhena vidhivad bhūridakṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: The women were clever and competent. They were lovely with attractive faces and charming limbs. They were pleasing to look at. They were endowed with beauty and good colour and form. They had smiling faces.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कारयित्वा महोत्सेधं प्रासादं चैव विश्रुतम् तत्र संकर्षणं कृष्णं सुभद्रां स्थाप्य वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: kārayitvā mahotsedhaṃ prāsādaṃ caiva viśrutam tatra saṃkarṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ sthāpya vīryavān
verses.translation: Mad and intoxicated they sported about in assemblies and quadrangular court-yards. They delighted others by songs, instrumental music and spicy conversation.

verses.translation: The chiefs of harlots, experts in dancing and singing could also be found there. They were experts in the art of con¬ versation, scanning and scrutiny. They were endued with femi¬ nine charms and fine qualities.

verses.transliteration: bhaktyā cārādhya vidhivat pratyahaṃ puruṣottamam prasādād devadevasya tato mokṣam avāptavān
verses.translation: There were others too, the women of noble families endowed with noble traits, chaste, fortunate and embellished by all good qualities.

verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ sāgare cendradyumnākhye snātvā mokṣaṃ labhed dhruvam
verses.translation: Nandana: name of a celestial garden.
