verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmukto naro yāti triviṣṭapam evaṃ sā nagarī ramyā rājasiṃhena pālitā
verses.translation: Amardvati. The capital city of Indra. Its location is as follows: Brah¬ ma's world extends over 10,000 Yojanas on Mahameru mountain. There are eight cities—each 2,500 square yojanas in extent—of the asfadikpalas in parts of this Brahmapuri:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नित्योत्सवप्रमुदिता यथेन्द्रस्यामरावती पुराष्टादशसंयुक्ता सुविस्तीर्णचतुष्पथा
verses.transliteration: nityotsavapramuditā yathendrasyāmarāvatī purāṣṭādaśasaṃyuktā suvistīrṇacatuṣpathā
verses.translation: Amardvati. The capital city of Indra. Its location is as follows: Brah¬ ma's world extends over 10,000 Yojanas on Mahameru mountain. There are eight cities—each 2,500 square yojanas in extent—of the asfadikpalas in parts of this Brahmapuri:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धनुर्ज्याघोषनिनदा सिद्धसंगमभूषिता विद्यावद्गणभूयिष्ठा वेदनिर्घोषनादिता
verses.transliteration: dhanurjyāghoṣaninadā siddhasaṃgamabhūṣitā vidyāvadgaṇabhūyiṣṭhā vedanirghoṣanāditā
verses.translation: Amardvati. The capital city of Indra. Its location is as follows: Brah¬ ma's world extends over 10,000 Yojanas on Mahameru mountain. There are eight cities—each 2,500 square yojanas in extent—of the asfadikpalas in parts of this Brahmapuri:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इतिहासपुराणानि शास्त्राणि विविधानि च काव्यालापकथाश् चैव श्रूयन्ते ऽहर्निशं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: itihāsapurāṇāni śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca kāvyālāpakathāś caiva śrūyante 'harniśaṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Amardvati. The capital city of Indra. Its location is as follows: Brah¬ ma's world extends over 10,000 Yojanas on Mahameru mountain. There are eight cities—each 2,500 square yojanas in extent—of the asfadikpalas in parts of this Brahmapuri:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं मया गुणाढ्या सा तदुयिनी?? समुदाहृता यस्यां राजाभवत् पूर्वम् इन्द्रद्युम्नो महामतिः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ mayā guṇāḍhyā sā taduyinī?? samudāhṛtā yasyāṃ rājābhavat pūrvam indradyumno mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: Amardvati. The capital city of Indra. Its location is as follows: Brah¬ ma's world extends over 10,000 Yojanas on Mahameru mountain. There are eight cities—each 2,500 square yojanas in extent—of the asfadikpalas in parts of this Brahmapuri:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां स नृपतिः पूर्वं कुर्वन् राज्यम् अनुत्तमम् पालयाम् आस मतिमान् प्रजाः पुत्रान् इवौरसान्
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ sa nṛpatiḥ pūrvaṃ kurvan rājyam anuttamam pālayām āsa matimān prajāḥ putrān ivaurasān
verses.translation: Administering the excellent country formerly, from that city, that king of great intellect, protected his subjects like his own bosom-born sons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सत्यवादी महाप्राज्ञः शूरः सर्वगुणाकरः मतिमान् धर्मसंपन्नः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः
verses.transliteration: satyavādī mahāprājñaḥ śūraḥ sarvaguṇākaraḥ matimān dharmasaṃpannaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: Thus endowed with riches and adorned by good qualities the king administered the excellent kingdom with his mind assured of realizing all cherished desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सत्यवाञ् शीलवान् दान्तः श्रीमान् परपुरंजयः आदित्य इव तेजोभी रूपैर् आश्विनयोर् इव
verses.transliteration: satyavāñ śīlavān dāntaḥ śrīmān parapuraṃjayaḥ āditya iva tejobhī rūpair āśvinayor iva
verses.translation: Once he pondered over this, in mind—"How shall I propitiate Visnu, the lord of all Yogas? How shall I propitiate lord who bestows worldly pleasures and salvation?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वर्धमानसुराश्चर्यः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः शारदेन्दुर् इवाभाति लक्षणैः समलंकृतः
verses.transliteration: vardhamānasurāścaryaḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ śāradendur ivābhāti lakṣaṇaiḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After realising the greatest entity, the unchanging lord Vasudeva, he passed beyond all illusory knowledge. 1 Restraining his sense-organs, he became a seeker of liberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आहर्ता सर्वयज्ञानां हयमेधादिकृत् तथा दानैर् यज्ञैस् तपोभिश् च तत्तुल्यो नास्ति भूपतिः
verses.transliteration: āhartā sarvayajñānāṃ hayamedhādikṛt tathā dānair yajñais tapobhiś ca tattulyo nāsti bhūpatiḥ
verses.translation: The Charioteer-soldiers followed him in chariots resem¬ bling aerial vehicles. They were decorated with flag-staffs and fanners. The soldiers carried weapons in their arms.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णमणिमुक्तानां गजाश्वानां च भूपतिः प्रददौ विप्रमुख्येभ्यो यागे यागे महाधनम्
verses.transliteration: suvarṇamaṇimuktānāṃ gajāśvānāṃ ca bhūpatiḥ pradadau vipramukhyebhyo yāge yāge mahādhanam
verses.translation: bhr&nti-jfl&na —illusory knowledge, such as the knowledge of "snake in rope or of silver in a shell". This is known as the pratibhisika jnana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हस्त्यश्वरथमुख्यानां कम्बलाजिनवाससाम् रत्नानां धनधान्यानाम् अन्तस् तस्य न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: hastyaśvarathamukhyānāṃ kambalājinavāsasām ratnānāṃ dhanadhānyānām antas tasya na vidyate
verses.translation: The cavalry men followed the king with horses on a par with the wind. They carried javelins and iron clubs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं सर्वधनैर् युक्तो गुणैः सर्वैर् अलंकृतः सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा कुर्वन् राज्यम् अकण्टकम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sarvadhanair yukto guṇaiḥ sarvair alaṃkṛtaḥ sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā kurvan rājyam akaṇṭakam
verses.translation: There were people who sold missiles, those who sustain¬ ed themselves by trading in betal leaves, the sellers of grass, the sellers of fuel.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्येयं मतिर् उत्पन्ना सर्वयोगेश्वरं हरिम् कथम् आराधयिष्यामि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: tasyeyaṃ matir utpannā sarvayogeśvaraṃ harim katham ārādhayiṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradaṃ prabhum
verses.translation: All those who sustained themselves by the stage, those who sold meat, oil-mongers and cloth merchants followed him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विचार्य सर्वशास्त्राणि तन्त्राण्य् आगमविस्तरम् इतिहासपुराणानि वेदाङ्गानि च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: vicārya sarvaśāstrāṇi tantrāṇy āgamavistaram itihāsapurāṇāni vedāṅgāni ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Sellers of fruits, those who sold leaves, those who tiansported grass and fodder and thousands of washermen (followed him).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धर्मशास्त्राणि सर्वाणि नियमान् ऋषिभाषितान् वेदाङ्गानि च शास्त्राणि विद्यास्थानानि यानि च
verses.transliteration: dharmaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi niyamān ṛṣibhāṣitān vedāṅgāni ca śāstrāṇi vidyāsthānāni yāni ca
verses.translation: There were cowherds, barbers, tailors, shepherds, goat¬ herds and those who tended deer and swans.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गुरुं संसेव्य यत्नेन ब्राह्मणान् वेदपारगान् आधाय परमां काष्ठां कृतकृत्यो ऽभवत् तदा
verses.transliteration: guruṃ saṃsevya yatnena brāhmaṇān vedapāragān ādhāya paramāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ kṛtakṛtyo 'bhavat tadā
verses.translation: There were people who sold foodgrains, powdered fried grains, gaggery and salt.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्य परमं तत्त्वं वासुदेवाख्यम् अव्ययम् भ्रान्तिज्ञानाद् अतीतस् तु मुमुक्षुः संयतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: saṃprāpya paramaṃ tattvaṃ vāsudevākhyam avyayam bhrāntijñānād atītas tu mumukṣuḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ
verses.translation: There were musicians, dancers, bards, actors, story-tellers and those who are experts in Puranas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कथम् आराधयिष्यामि देवदेवं सनातनम् पीतवस्त्रं चतुर्बाहुं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम्
verses.transliteration: katham ārādhayiṣyāmi devadevaṃ sanātanam pītavastraṃ caturbāhuṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
verses.translation: There were poets, versifiers, composers of poems, experts in different poems, followers of Garutfa who dispel poison and those who test different jewels.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वनमालावृतोरस्कं पद्मपत्त्रायतेक्षणम् श्रीवत्सोरःसमायुक्तं मुकुटाङ्गदशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: vanamālāvṛtoraskaṃ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇam śrīvatsoraḥsamāyuktaṃ mukuṭāṅgadaśobhitam
verses.translation: There were blacksmiths, coppersmiths, those who work in bellmctal, Ruthakas?, those who make scabbards, painters, turners and Pavakas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वपुरात् स तु निष्क्रान्त उज्जयिन्याः प्रजापतिः बलेन महता युक्तः सभृत्यः सपुरोहितः
verses.transliteration: svapurāt sa tu niṣkrānta ujjayinyāḥ prajāpatiḥ balena mahatā yuktaḥ sabhṛtyaḥ sapurohitaḥ
verses.translation: There 'were makers of sticks and batons, those who make swords, those who maintain by selling ale or gambling;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनुजग्मुस् तु तं सर्वे रथिनः शस्त्रपाणयः रथैर् विमानसंकाशैः पताकाध्वजसेवितैः
verses.transliteration: anujagmus tu taṃ sarve rathinaḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ rathair vimānasaṃkāśaiḥ patākādhvajasevitaiḥ
verses.translation: All these citizens and those who have not yet been mentioned followed him. The entire residents of the city followed him too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सादिनश् च तथा सर्वे प्रासतोमरपाणयः अश्वैः पवनसंकाशैर् अनुजग्मुस् तु तं नृपम्
verses.transliteration: sādinaś ca tathā sarve prāsatomarapāṇayaḥ aśvaiḥ pavanasaṃkāśair anujagmus tu taṃ nṛpam
verses.translation: Just as the sons eager to sec other villages follow their father who proceeds ahead so also those citizens followed him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हिमवत्संभवैर् मत्तैर् वारणैः पर्वतोपमैः ईषादन्तैः सदा मत्तैः प्रचण्डैः षष्टिहायनैः
verses.transliteration: himavatsaṃbhavair mattair vāraṇaiḥ parvatopamaiḥ īṣādantaiḥ sadā mattaiḥ pracaṇḍaiḥ ṣaṣṭihāyanaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus the glorious king surrounded by a great concourse of people as well as (the four divisions of the army viz the ele¬ phants, horses, chariots and infantry, proceeded slowly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हेमकक्षैः सपताकैर् घण्टारवविभूषितैः अनुजग्मुश् च तं सर्वे गजयुद्धविशारदाः
verses.transliteration: hemakakṣaiḥ sapatākair ghaṇṭāravavibhūṣitaiḥ anujagmuś ca taṃ sarve gajayuddhaviśāradāḥ
verses.translation: Going ahead thus, followed by the armies the king reached the shore of the Southern sea after a long time.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: असंख्येयाश् च पादाता धनुष्प्रासासिपाणयः दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरा दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनाः
verses.transliteration: asaṃkhyeyāś ca pādātā dhanuṣprāsāsipāṇayaḥ divyamālyāmbaradharā divyagandhānulepanāḥ
verses.translation: . After reaching the sea-shore the king encamped there in a beautiful holy land endowed with the qualities of a good land.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनुजग्मुश् च तं सर्वे युवानो मृष्टकुण्डलाः सर्वास्त्रकुशलाः शूराः सदा संग्रामलालसाः
verses.transliteration: anujagmuś ca taṃ sarve yuvāno mṛṣṭakuṇḍalāḥ sarvāstrakuśalāḥ śūrāḥ sadā saṃgrāmalālasāḥ
verses.translation: Listen you all. I shall succinctly mention the story of some past incidents. It is a story that destroys sins: Formerly, Lord Visnu was asked by Laksmx.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःपुरनिवासिन्यः स्त्रियः सर्वाः स्वलंकृताः बिम्बौष्ठचारुदशनाः सर्वाभरणभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: antaḥpuranivāsinyaḥ striyaḥ sarvāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ bimbauṣṭhacārudaśanāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: On the wonder-inspiring golden peak of Sumeru, the lotus-born goddess bowed to the unchanging creator of all worlds, named Vasudeva.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यवस्त्रधराः सर्वा दिव्यमाल्यविभूषिताः दिव्यगन्धानुलिप्ताङ्गाः शरच्चन्द्रनिभाननाः
verses.transliteration: divyavastradharāḥ sarvā divyamālyavibhūṣitāḥ divyagandhānuliptāṅgāḥ śaraccandranibhānanāḥ
verses.translation: Balakhilyas or Vdlakhilyas —Sixty thousand hermits bom to Kratu, a hermit, by his wife Santati. Everyone of them was of the size of half a thumb, but they were as bright as the blazing sun and had attained control over their senses.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुमध्यमाश् चारुवेषाश् चारुकर्णालकाञ्चिताः ताम्बूलरञ्जितमुखा रक्षिभिश् च सुरक्षिताः
verses.transliteration: sumadhyamāś cāruveṣāś cārukarṇālakāñcitāḥ tāmbūlarañjitamukhā rakṣibhiś ca surakṣitāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing those words of his consort, Visnu the lord of Devas spoke with pleasure. What he said was nectarlike. It was the great essence.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यानैर् उच्चावचैः शुभ्रैर् मणिकाञ्चनभूषितैः उपगीयमानास् ताः सर्वा गायनैः स्तुतिपाठकैः
verses.transliteration: yānair uccāvacaiḥ śubhrair maṇikāñcanabhūṣitaiḥ upagīyamānās tāḥ sarvā gāyanaiḥ stutipāṭhakaiḥ
verses.translation: At the conclusion of his Yogic slumber he created
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वेष्टिताः शस्त्रहस्तैश् च पद्मपत्त्रायतेक्षणाः ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्या अनुजग्मुश् च तं नृपम्
verses.transliteration: veṣṭitāḥ śastrahastaiś ca padmapattrāyatekṣaṇāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā anujagmuś ca taṃ nṛpam
verses.translation: On the shore of the Southern ocean a place extending to ten Yojanas all round the place where there stands a holy big tree, is the rarest of all holy centres.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वणिग्ग्रामगणाः सर्वे नानापुरनिवासिनः धनै रत्नैः सुवर्णैश् च सदाराः सपरिच्छदाः
verses.transliteration: vaṇiggrāmagaṇāḥ sarve nānāpuranivāsinaḥ dhanai ratnaiḥ suvarṇaiś ca sadārāḥ saparicchadāḥ
verses.translation: This holy fig tree does not perish when the Kalpa comes to a close and the dissolution of all the worlds starts. It remains there as before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्रविक्रयकाश् चैव ताम्बूलपण्यजीविनः तृणविक्रयकाश् चैव काष्ठविक्रयकारकाः
verses.transliteration: astravikrayakāś caiva tāmbūlapaṇyajīvinaḥ tṛṇavikrayakāś caiva kāṣṭhavikrayakārakāḥ
verses.translation: All those creatures who circumambulate and make obeisance, shake oft their sins and go to the abode of lord Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रङ्गोपजीविनः सर्वे मांसविक्रयिणस् तथा तैलविक्रयकाश् चैव वस्त्रविक्रयकास् तथा
verses.transliteration: raṅgopajīvinaḥ sarve māṃsavikrayiṇas tathā tailavikrayakāś caiva vastravikrayakās tathā
verses.translation: O my beloved, on seeing men (and women devotees) going thus, (God of death) came near me once, bowed to me with the bent head, and said thus:—
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: फलविक्रयिणश् चैव पत्त्रविक्रयिणस् तथा तथा जवसहाराश् च रजकाश् च सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: phalavikrayiṇaś caiva pattravikrayiṇas tathā tathā javasahārāś ca rajakāś ca sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: $a —Adisesa, Chief of the Nagas, is the reposing bed of Visu. But he is also represented as supporting the earth at the behest of Brahma. According to a myth, Balabhadra Rama, the elder brother of Srikr§na was born from a portion of Sesa.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गोपाला नापिताश् चैव तथान्ये वस्त्रसूचकाः मेषपालाश् चाजपाला मृगपालाश् च हंसकाः
verses.transliteration: gopālā nāpitāś caiva tathānye vastrasūcakāḥ meṣapālāś cājapālā mṛgapālāś ca haṃsakāḥ
verses.translation: O highly blessed lady, on seeing him standing outside with palms joined in reverence, I asked the (God of Death) about the purpose for which I had been eulogised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धान्यविक्रयिणश् चैव सक्तुविक्रयिणश् च ये गुडविक्रयिकाश् चैव तथा लवणजीविनः
verses.transliteration: dhānyavikrayiṇaś caiva saktuvikrayiṇaś ca ye guḍavikrayikāś caiva tathā lavaṇajīvinaḥ
verses.translation: O Vaivasvata of long brawny arms, indeed, you arc the most excellent of all Devas. Why did you eulogise me? Tell me all in brief.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गायना नर्तकाश् चैव तथा मङ्गलपाठकाः शैलूषाः कथकाश् चैव पुराणार्थविशारदाः
verses.transliteration: gāyanā nartakāś caiva tathā maṅgalapāṭhakāḥ śailūṣāḥ kathakāś caiva purāṇārthaviśāradāḥ
verses.translation: In this meritorious shrine known as Purusottama, there is an excellent idol made of sapphire. It bestows all cherished desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कवयः काव्यकर्तारो नानाकाव्यविशारदाः विषघ्ना गारुडाश् चैव नानारत्नपरीक्षकाः
verses.transliteration: kavayaḥ kāvyakartāro nānākāvyaviśāradāḥ viṣaghnā gāruḍāś caiva nānāratnaparīkṣakāḥ
verses.translation: O lotus-eyed lord, by visiting it with emotional fervour and faith, even men devoid of desires go to the abode called Sveta. 1
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: व्योकारास् ताम्रकाराश् च कांस्यकाराश् च रूठकाः कौषकाराश् चित्रकाराः कुन्दकाराश् च पावकाः
verses.transliteration: vyokārās tāmrakārāś ca kāṃsyakārāś ca rūṭhakāḥ kauṣakārāś citrakārāḥ kundakārāś ca pāvakāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O slayer of enemies I am notable to carry on my activities. O great lord, be pleased. O lord, withdraw the idol.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दण्डकाराश् चासिकाराः सुराधूतोपजीविनः मल्ला दूताश् च कायस्था ये चान्ये कर्मकारिणः
verses.transliteration: daṇḍakārāś cāsikārāḥ surādhūtopajīvinaḥ mallā dūtāś ca kāyasthā ye cānye karmakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Yama I spoke to him: O Yama, I shall conceal it with sands all round.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tantuvāyā rūpakārā vārtikās tailapāṭhakāḥ lāvajīvās taittirikā mṛgapakṣyupajīvinaḥ
verses.translation: Suela or Svetadvlpa —Colonel Wilford identifies it with Britain— J. Dowson. Hindu Mythology and Religion p. 315.

verses.sanskrit: गजवैद्याश् च वैद्याश् च नरवैद्याश् च ये नराः वृक्षवैद्याश् च गोवैद्या ये चान्ये छेददाहकाः
verses.transliteration: gajavaidyāś ca vaidyāś ca naravaidyāś ca ye narāḥ vṛkṣavaidyāś ca govaidyā ye cānye chedadāhakāḥ
verses.translation: Suela or Svetadvlpa —Colonel Wilford identifies it with Britain— J. Dowson. Hindu Mythology and Religion p. 315.

verses.transliteration: yathā vrajantaṃ pitaraṃ grāmāntaraṃ samutsukāḥ anuyānti yathā putrās tathā taṃ te 'pi nāgarāḥ

verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa nṛpatiḥ śrīmān vṛtaḥ sarvair mahājanaiḥ hastyaśvarathapādātair jagāma ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ

verses.sanskrit: ददर्श सागरं रम्यं नृत्यन्तम् इव च स्थितम् अनेकशतसाहस्रैर् ऊर्मिभिश् च समाकुलम्

verses.transliteration: tīrtharājaṃ mahāśabdam apāraṃ subhayaṃkaram meghavṛndapratīkāśam agādhaṃ makarālayam

verses.transliteration: lavaṇodaṃ hareḥ sthānaṃ śayanasya nadīpatim sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvavāñchāphalapradam

verses.transliteration: anekāvartagambhīraṃ dānavānāṃ samāśrayam amṛtasyāraṇiṃ divyaṃ devayonim apāṃ patim

verses.transliteration: viśiṣṭaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ prāṇināṃ jīvadhāraṇam supavitraṃ pavitrāṇāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानाम् उत्तमं तीर्थम् अव्ययं यादसां पतिम् चन्द्रवृद्धिक्षयस्येव यस्य मानं प्रतिष्ठितम्

verses.sanskrit: दशयोजनविस्तीर्णं पञ्चयोजनम् आयतम् नानाश्चर्यसमायुक्तं क्षेत्रं परमदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ pañcayojanam āyatam nānāścaryasamāyuktaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham
verses.translation: Suela or Svetadvlpa —Colonel Wilford identifies it with Britain— J. Dowson. Hindu Mythology and Religion p. 315.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे पुण्ये वैष्णवे पुरुषोत्तमे किं तत्र प्रतिमा पूर्वं न स्थिता वैष्णवी प्रभो
verses.transliteration: tasmin kṣetravare puṇye vaiṣṇave puruṣottame kiṃ tatra pratimā pūrvaṃ na sthitā vaiṣṇavī prabho
verses.translation: (All round the sacrificial chamber) hundreds of palaces were built. They were beautiful and they resembled the abode of Indra. They were bedecked in gold and jewels. Excellent gems enhanced their beauty.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: येनासौ नृपतिस् तत्र गत्वा सबलवाहनः स्थापयाम् आस कृष्णं च रामं भद्रां शुभप्रदाम्
verses.transliteration: yenāsau nṛpatis tatra gatvā sabalavāhanaḥ sthāpayām āsa kṛṣṇaṃ ca rāmaṃ bhadrāṃ śubhapradām
verses.translation: He got constructed many comfortable houses and residences for the Brahmins and VaiSyas who had come there from different lands.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संशयो नो महान् अत्र विस्मयश् च जगत्पते श्रोतुम् इच्छामहे सर्वं ब्रूहि तत्कारणं च नः
verses.transliteration: saṃśayo no mahān atra vismayaś ca jagatpate śrotum icchāmahe sarvaṃ brūhi tatkāraṇaṃ ca naḥ
verses.translation: As those noble persons enjoyed themselves in their
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं पूर्वसंवृत्तां कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् प्रवक्ष्यामि समासेन श्रिया पृष्टः पुरा हरिः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ pūrvasaṃvṛttāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm pravakṣyāmi samāsena śriyā pṛṣṭaḥ purā hariḥ
verses.translation: Delicious foodstuffs of various kinds prepared with rice, sugarcane, barley milk and milk products were served to guests. The excellent king himself approached them and ordered for the immediate supply of things they wanted.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुमेरोः काञ्चने शृङ्गे सर्वाश्चर्यसमन्विते सिद्धविद्याधरैर् यक्षैः किंनरैर् उपशोभिते
verses.transliteration: sumeroḥ kāñcane śṛṅge sarvāścaryasamanvite siddhavidyādharair yakṣaiḥ kiṃnarair upaśobhite
verses.translation: Paflcar&tra —a system of spiritual doctrines, by following which one attains, the position of Uparicara.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवदानवगन्धर्वैर् नागैर् अप्सरसां गणैः मुनिभिर् गुह्यकैः सिद्धैः सौपर्णैः समरुद्गणैः
verses.transliteration: devadānavagandharvair nāgair apsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ munibhir guhyakaiḥ siddhaiḥ sauparṇaiḥ samarudgaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: O great Boar 1 just as the earth had been formerly lifted up by you by your curved fangs, from the nether worlds so also save me from the ocean of misery.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्यैर् देवालयैः साध्यैः कश्यपाद्यैः प्रजेश्वरैः वालखिल्यादिभिश् चैव शोभिते सुमनोहरे
verses.transliteration: anyair devālayaiḥ sādhyaiḥ kaśyapādyaiḥ prajeśvaraiḥ vālakhilyādibhiś caiva śobhite sumanohare
verses.translation: O lord Krsna, these idols of yours, the bestowers of boons, have been eulogised by me. You, Baladeva and others, are stationed in separate forms.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कर्णिकारवनैर् दिव्यैः सर्वर्तुकुसुमोत्करैः जातरूपप्रतीकाशैर् भूषिते सूर्यसंनिभैः
verses.transliteration: karṇikāravanair divyaiḥ sarvartukusumotkaraiḥ jātarūpapratīkāśair bhūṣite sūryasaṃnibhaiḥ
verses.translation: This refers to the Boar incarnation of VisijLU. The boar entered the sea and found out the earth that had sunk. The boar lifted the earth at his tusks, came out of the ocean and set the earth firm over the water. On the way, the fierce and wicked Hiranyaksa hindered him. The Boar killed Hirayaksa and disappeared.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्यैश् च बहुभिर् वृक्षैः शालतालादिभिर् वनैः पुंनागाशोकसरलन्यग्रोधाम्रातकार्जुनैः
verses.transliteration: anyaiś ca bahubhir vṛkṣaiḥ śālatālādibhir vanaiḥ puṃnāgāśokasaralanyagrodhāmrātakārjunaiḥ
verses.translation: Guardians of quarters —lokapalas. They are sometimes regarded as the guardian deities of different orders of beings, but more commonly of the four cardinal and four intermediate points of the world. They are 1 Indra, of East; 2 Agni of South-east; 3 Yama of South; 4 Surya of South¬ west; 5 Varuna of West; 6 Vayu of North-west; 7 Kubera of North; 8 liana of North-east. Others substitute Nirfti for Surya and Iiani or Pfthivi for liana. According to Dharraa-saiigraha, the Buddhists enumerate 14 lokapalas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पारिजाताम्रखदिरनीपबिल्वकदम्बकैः धवखादिरपालाशशीर्षामलकतिन्दुकैः
verses.transliteration: pārijātāmrakhadiranīpabilvakadambakaiḥ dhavakhādirapālāśaśīrṣāmalakatindukaiḥ
verses.translation: Hara, Sankarsana and others who have been glorified as your variant forms, have been evolved for your worship. They are dependent on you, they resort to you for support.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नारिङ्गकोलबकुललोध्रदाडिमदारुकैः सर्जैश् च कर्णैस् तगरैः शिशिभूर्जवनिम्बकैः
verses.transliteration: nāriṅgakolabakulalodhradāḍimadārukaiḥ sarjaiś ca karṇais tagaraiḥ śiśibhūrjavanimbakaiḥ
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, in fact, you have no other form separate from you. The various forms of yours are only for your worship by the devotees.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्यैश् च काञ्चनैश् चैव फलभारैश् च नामितैः नानाकुसुमगन्धाढ्यैर् भूषिते पुष्पपादपैः
verses.transliteration: anyaiś ca kāñcanaiś caiva phalabhāraiś ca nāmitaiḥ nānākusumagandhāḍhyair bhūṣite puṣpapādapaiḥ
verses.translation: O lord, how can man mention you as twofold, you who are one and only one. You are all-pervading Consciousness by nature and you are unsullied.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मालतीयूथिकामल्लीकुन्दबाणकुरुण्टकैः पाटलागस्त्यकुटजमन्दारकुसुमादिभिः
verses.transliteration: mālatīyūthikāmallīkundabāṇakuruṇṭakaiḥ pāṭalāgastyakuṭajamandārakusumādibhiḥ
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, most excellent one among Devas, O bestower of freedom from fear on devotees, O deity with eyes like the petals of lotus, save me. I am immersed in the ocean of sexual objects.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्यैश् च विविधैः पुष्पैर् मनसः प्रीतिदायकैः नानाविहगसंघैश् च कूजद्भिर् मधुरस्वरैः
verses.transliteration: anyaiś ca vividhaiḥ puṣpair manasaḥ prītidāyakaiḥ nānāvihagasaṃghaiś ca kūjadbhir madhurasvaraiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you, O lord of worlds, O husband of Lak§ml, I do not see any one in whom I can seek refuge. O slayer of Madhu, 1 be pleased.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुंस्कोकिलरुतैर् दिव्यैर् मत्तबर्हिणनादितैः एवं नानाविधैर् वृक्षैः पुष्पैर् नानाविधैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: puṃskokilarutair divyair mattabarhiṇanāditaiḥ evaṃ nānāvidhair vṛkṣaiḥ puṣpair nānāvidhais tathā
verses.translation: O slayer of Madhu. Madhu and Kaifabha sprang from the ears of Visnu. They were about to kill Brahma who was lying on the lotus sprin¬ ging from Visnu's navel. Visnu killed them and obtained the names: Kaitabhari and Madhusudana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: खगैर् नानाविधैश् चैव शोभिते सुरसेविते तत्र स्थितं जगन्नाथं जगत्स्रष्टारम् अव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: khagair nānāvidhaiś caiva śobhite surasevite tatra sthitaṃ jagannāthaṃ jagatsraṣṭāram avyayam
verses.translation: O lord, I have passed through births, thousands and ten thousands of them of diverse kinds, in this world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकविधातारं वासुदेवाख्यम् अव्ययम् प्रणम्य शिरसा देवी लोकानां हितकाम्यया पप्रच्छेमं महाप्रश्नं पद्मजा तम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sarvalokavidhātāraṃ vāsudevākhyam avyayam praṇamya śirasā devī lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā papracchemaṃ mahāpraśnaṃ padmajā tam anuttamam
verses.translation: Separations from and union with wives, enemies, friends and kinsmen have been faced by me. Many and many kinds of fathers have been seen by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रूहि त्वं सर्वलोकेश संशयं मे हृदि स्थितम् मर्त्यलोके महाश्चर्ये कर्मभूमौ सुदुर्लभे
verses.transliteration: brūhi tvaṃ sarvalokeśa saṃśayaṃ me hṛdi sthitam martyaloke mahāścarye karmabhūmau sudurlabhe
verses.translation: Many miseries have been experienced by me. Many miseries have been misunderstood and enjoyed as pleasures by me. I have had cousins and kinsmen, sons and brothers, in plenty.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लोभमोहग्रहग्रस्ते कामक्रोधमहार्णवे येन मुच्येत देवेश अस्मात् संसारसागरात्
verses.transliteration: lobhamohagrahagraste kāmakrodhamahārṇave yena mucyeta deveśa asmāt saṃsārasāgarāt
verses.translation: I have lived within the belly of women that abounds in urine and floating masses of faeces. O lord, great misery has been experienced by me while staying in womb.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आचक्ष्व सर्वदेवेश प्रणतां यदि मन्यसे त्वदृते नास्ति लोके ऽस्मिन् वक्ता संशयनिर्णये
verses.transliteration: ācakṣva sarvadeveśa praṇatāṃ yadi manyase tvadṛte nāsti loke 'smin vaktā saṃśayanirṇaye
verses.translation: O lord, all those miseries that are usual in childhood, youth and old age have been suffered by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वैवं वचनं तस्या देवदेवो जनार्दनः प्रोवाच परया प्रीत्या परं सारामृतोपमम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tasyā devadevo janārdanaḥ provāca parayā prītyā paraṃ sārāmṛtopamam
verses.translation: The miseries at death, in the path and the abode of Yama as also the tortures in hell have been experienced by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुखोपास्यः सुसाध्यश् च ऽभिरामश् च सुसत्फलः आस्ते तीर्थवरे देवि विख्यातः पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: sukhopāsyaḥ susādhyaś ca 'bhirāmaś ca susatphalaḥ āste tīrthavare devi vikhyātaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, many times I have been the slave of glorious prosperous men. From the impoverished state I had attained the state of a lord and master.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न तेन सदृशः कश्चित् त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते कीर्तनाद् यस्य देवेशि मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: na tena sadṛśaḥ kaścit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate kīrtanād yasya deveśi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: Many were killed by me. I have been killed by many. I have caused death to many and my death has been caused by many. Much had been given to me by others and many times gifts have been distributed by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न विज्ञातो ऽमरैः सर्वैर् न दैत्यैर् न च दानवैः मरीच्याद्यैर् मुनिवरैर् गोपितं मे वरानने
verses.transliteration: na vijñāto 'maraiḥ sarvair na daityair na ca dānavaiḥ marīcyādyair munivarair gopitaṃ me varānane
verses.translation: A fugitive (terrified of life) attacked by grief and greed I have become senseless. Now, O lord, utterly helpless and confused, I seek refuge in you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत् ते ऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि तीर्थराजं च सांप्रतम् भावेनैकेन सुश्रोणि शृणुष्व वरवर्णिनि
verses.transliteration: tat te 'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tīrtharājaṃ ca sāṃpratam bhāvenaikena suśroṇi śṛṇuṣva varavarṇini
verses.translation: O lord, save me who have become miserable and immersed in the ocean of worldly existence. O lord of the uni¬ verse, if you consider me your devotee have pity on me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आसीत् कल्पे समुत्पन्ने नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे प्रलीना देवगन्धर्वदैत्यविद्याधरोरगाः
verses.transliteration: āsīt kalpe samutpanne naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame pralīnā devagandharvadaityavidyādharoragāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तमोभूतम् इदं सर्वं न प्राज्ञायत किंचन तस्मिञ् जागर्ति भूतात्मा परमात्मा जगद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: tamobhūtam idaṃ sarvaṃ na prājñāyata kiṃcana tasmiñ jāgarti bhūtātmā paramātmā jagadguruḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमांस् त्रिमूर्तिकृद् देवो जगत्कर्ता महेश्वरः वासुदेवेति विख्यातो योगात्मा हरिर् ईश्वरः
verses.transliteration: śrīmāṃs trimūrtikṛd devo jagatkartā maheśvaraḥ vāsudeveti vikhyāto yogātmā harir īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽसृजद् योगनिद्रान्ते नाभ्यम्भोरुहमध्यगम् पद्मकेशरसंकाशं ब्रह्माणं भूतम् अव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: so 'sṛjad yoganidrānte nābhyambhoruhamadhyagam padmakeśarasaṃkāśaṃ brahmāṇaṃ bhūtam avyayam
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तादृग्भूतस् ततो ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकमहेश्वरः पञ्चभूतसमायुक्तं सृजते च शनैः शनैः
verses.transliteration: tādṛgbhūtas tato brahmā sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ pañcabhūtasamāyuktaṃ sṛjate ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मात्रायोनीनि भूतानि स्थूलसूक्ष्माणि यानि च चतुर्विधानि सर्वाणि स्थावराणि चराणि च
verses.transliteration: mātrāyonīni bhūtāni sthūlasūkṣmāṇi yāni ca caturvidhāni sarvāṇi sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रजापतिर् ब्रह्मा चक्रे सर्वं चराचरम् संचिन्त्य मनसात्मानं ससर्ज विविधाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prajāpatir brahmā cakre sarvaṃ carācaram saṃcintya manasātmānaṃ sasarja vividhāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मरीच्यादीन् मुनीन् सर्वान् देवासुरपितॄन् अपि यक्षविद्याधरांश् चान्यान् गङ्गाद्याः सरितस् तथा
verses.transliteration: marīcyādīn munīn sarvān devāsurapitṝn api yakṣavidyādharāṃś cānyān gaṅgādyāḥ saritas tathā
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नरवानरसिंहांश् च विविधांश् च विहंगमान् जरायून् अण्डजान् देवि स्वेदजोद्भेदजांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: naravānarasiṃhāṃś ca vividhāṃś ca vihaṃgamān jarāyūn aṇḍajān devi svedajodbhedajāṃs tathā
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म क्षत्रं तथा वैश्यं शूद्रं चैव चतुष्टयम् अन्त्यजातांश् च म्लेच्छांश् च ससर्ज विविधान् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: brahma kṣatraṃ tathā vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ caiva catuṣṭayam antyajātāṃś ca mlecchāṃś ca sasarja vividhān pṛthak
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत् किंचिज् जीवसंज्ञं तु तृणगुल्मपिपीलिकम् ब्रह्मा भूत्वा जगत् सर्वं निर्ममे स चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: yat kiṃcij jīvasaṃjñaṃ tu tṛṇagulmapipīlikam brahmā bhūtvā jagat sarvaṃ nirmame sa carācaram
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणाङ्गे तथात्मानं संचिन्त्य पुरुषं स्वयम् वामे चैव तु नारीं स द्विधा भूतम् अकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāṅge tathātmānaṃ saṃcintya puruṣaṃ svayam vāme caiva tu nārīṃ sa dvidhā bhūtam akalpayat
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति लोके ऽस्मिन् प्रजा मैथुनसंभवाः अधमोत्तममध्याश् च मम क्षेत्राणि यानि च
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti loke 'smin prajā maithunasaṃbhavāḥ adhamottamamadhyāś ca mama kṣetrāṇi yāni ca
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं संचिन्त्य देवो ऽसौ पुरा सलिलयोनिजः जगाम ध्यानम् आस्थाय वासुदेवात्मिकां तनुम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃcintya devo 'sau purā salilayonijaḥ jagāma dhyānam āsthāya vāsudevātmikāṃ tanum
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानमात्रेण देवेन स्वयम् एव जनार्दनः तस्मिन् क्षणे समुत्पन्नः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात्
verses.transliteration: dhyānamātreṇa devena svayam eva janārdanaḥ tasmin kṣaṇe samutpannaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः पुण्डरीकनिभेक्षणः सलिलध्वान्तमेघाभः श्रीमाञ् श्रीवत्सलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ saliladhvāntameghābhaḥ śrīmāñ śrīvatsalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यत् सहसा तं तु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः आसनैर् अर्घ्यपाद्यैश् च अक्षतैर् अभिनन्द्य च
verses.transliteration: apaśyat sahasā taṃ tu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ āsanair arghyapādyaiś ca akṣatair abhinandya ca
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टाव परमैः स्तोत्रैर् विरिञ्चिः सुसमाहितः ततो ऽहम् उक्तवान् देवं ब्रह्माणं कमलोद्भवम् कारणं वद मां तात मम ध्यानस्य सांप्रतम्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭāva paramaiḥ stotrair viriñciḥ susamāhitaḥ tato 'ham uktavān devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavam kāraṇaṃ vada māṃ tāta mama dhyānasya sāṃpratam
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.

verses.sanskrit: जगद्धिताय देवेश मर्त्यलोकैश् च दुर्लभम् स्वर्गद्वारस्य मार्गाणि यज्ञदानव्रतानि च
verses.transliteration: jagaddhitāya deveśa martyalokaiś ca durlabham svargadvārasya mārgāṇi yajñadānavratāni ca
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: योगः सत्यं तपः श्रद्धा तीर्थानि विविधानि च विहाय सर्वम् एतेषां सुखं तत्साधनं वद
verses.transliteration: yogaḥ satyaṃ tapaḥ śraddhā tīrthāni vividhāni ca vihāya sarvam eteṣāṃ sukhaṃ tatsādhanaṃ vada
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्थानं जगत्पते मह्याम् उत्कृष्टं च यद् उच्यते सर्वेषाम् उत्तमं स्थानं ब्रूहि मे पुरुषोत्तम
verses.transliteration: sthānaṃ jagatpate mahyām utkṛṣṭaṃ ca yad ucyate sarveṣām uttamaṃ sthānaṃ brūhi me puruṣottama
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.

verses.sanskrit: विधातुर् वचनं श्रुत्वा ततो ऽहं प्रोक्तवान् प्रिये शृणु ब्रह्मन् प्रवक्ष्यामि निर्मलं भुवि दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: vidhātur vacanaṃ śrutvā tato 'haṃ proktavān priye śṛṇu brahman pravakṣyāmi nirmalaṃ bhuvi durlabham
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमं सर्वक्षेत्राणां धन्यं संसारतारणम् गोब्राह्मणहितं पुण्यं चातुर्वर्ण्यसुखोदयम्
verses.transliteration: uttamaṃ sarvakṣetrāṇāṃ dhanyaṃ saṃsāratāraṇam gobrāhmaṇahitaṃ puṇyaṃ cāturvarṇyasukhodayam
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.

verses.sanskrit: भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं नॄणां क्षेत्रं परमदुर्लभम् महापुण्यं तु सर्वेषां सिद्धिदं वै पितामहे
verses.transliteration: bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṝṇāṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham mahāpuṇyaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ siddhidaṃ vai pitāmahe
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् आसीत् समुत्पन्नं तीर्थराजं सनातनम् विख्यातं परमं क्षेत्रं चतुर्युगनिषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: tasmād āsīt samutpannaṃ tīrtharājaṃ sanātanam vikhyātaṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ caturyuganiṣevitam
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषाम् एव देवानाम् ऋषीणां ब्रह्मचारिणाम् दैत्यदानवसिद्धानां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣām eva devānām ṛṣīṇāṃ brahmacāriṇām daityadānavasiddhānāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.

verses.sanskrit: नागविद्याधराणां च स्थावरस्य चरस्य च उत्तमः पुरुषो यस्मात् तस्मात् स पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: nāgavidyādharāṇāṃ ca sthāvarasya carasya ca uttamaḥ puruṣo yasmāt tasmāt sa puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणस्योदधेस् तीरे न्यग्रोधो यत्र तिष्ठति दशयोजनविस्तीर्णं क्षेत्रं परमदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇasyodadhes tīre nyagrodho yatra tiṣṭhati daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस् तु कल्पे समुत्पन्ने महदुल्कानिबर्हणे विनाशं नैवम् अभ्येति स्वयं तत्रैवम् आस्थितः
verses.transliteration: yas tu kalpe samutpanne mahadulkānibarhaṇe vināśaṃ naivam abhyeti svayaṃ tatraivam āsthitaḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टमात्रे वटे तस्मिंश् छायाम् आक्रम्य चासकृत् ब्रह्महत्यात् प्रमुच्येत पापेष्व् अन्येषु का कथा
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭamātre vaṭe tasmiṃś chāyām ākramya cāsakṛt brahmahatyāt pramucyeta pāpeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणा कृता यैस् तु नमस्कारश् च जन्तुभिः सर्वे विधूतपाप्मानस् ते गताः केशवालयम्
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇā kṛtā yais tu namaskāraś ca jantubhiḥ sarve vidhūtapāpmānas te gatāḥ keśavālayam
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न्यग्रोधस्योत्तरे किंचिद् दक्षिणे केशवस्य तु प्रासादस् तत्र तिष्ठेत् तु पदं धर्ममयं हि तत्
verses.transliteration: nyagrodhasyottare kiṃcid dakṣiṇe keśavasya tu prāsādas tatra tiṣṭhet tu padaṃ dharmamayaṃ hi tat
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिमां तत्र वै दृष्ट्वा स्वयं देवेन निर्मिताम् अनायासेन वै यान्ति भुवनं मे ततो नराः
verses.transliteration: pratimāṃ tatra vai dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ devena nirmitām anāyāsena vai yānti bhuvanaṃ me tato narāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छमानांस् तु तान् प्रेक्ष्य एकदा धर्मराट् प्रिये मदन्तिकम् अनुप्राप्य प्रणम्य शिरसाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: gacchamānāṃs tu tān prekṣya ekadā dharmarāṭ priye madantikam anuprāpya praṇamya śirasābravīt
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमस् ते भगवन् देव लोकनाथ जगत्पते क्षीरोदवासिनं देवं शेषभोगानुशायिनम्
verses.transliteration: namas te bhagavan deva lokanātha jagatpate kṣīrodavāsinaṃ devaṃ śeṣabhogānuśāyinam
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वरं वरेण्यं वरदं कर्तारम् अकृतं प्रभुम् विश्वेश्वरम् अजं विष्णुं सर्वज्ञम् अपराजितम्
verses.transliteration: varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ kartāram akṛtaṃ prabhum viśveśvaram ajaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvajñam aparājitam
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नीलोत्पलदलश्यामं पुण्डरीकनिभेक्षणम् सर्वज्ञं निर्गुणं शान्तं जगद्धातारम् अव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇam sarvajñaṃ nirguṇaṃ śāntaṃ jagaddhātāram avyayam
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकविधातारं सर्वलोकसुखावहम् पुराणं पुरुषं वेद्यं व्यक्ताव्यक्तं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvalokavidhātāraṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ vedyaṃ vyaktāvyaktaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: परावराणां स्रष्टारं लोकनाथं जगद्गुरुम् श्रीवत्सोरस्कसंयुक्तं वनमालाविभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: parāvarāṇāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ lokanāthaṃ jagadgurum śrīvatsoraskasaṃyuktaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पीतवस्त्रं चतुर्बाहुं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् हारकेयूरसंयुक्तं मुकुटाङ्गदधारिणम्
verses.transliteration: pītavastraṃ caturbāhuṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam hārakeyūrasaṃyuktaṃ mukuṭāṅgadadhāriṇam
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलक्षणसंपूर्णं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् कूटस्थम् अचलं सूक्ष्मं ज्योतीरूपं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam kūṭastham acalaṃ sūkṣmaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भावाभावविनिर्मुक्तं व्यापिनं प्रकृतेः परम् नमस्यामि जगन्नाथम् ईश्वरं सुखदं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: bhāvābhāvavinirmuktaṃ vyāpinaṃ prakṛteḥ param namasyāmi jagannātham īśvaraṃ sukhadaṃ prabhum
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवं धर्मराजस् तु पुरा न्यग्रोधसंनिधौ स्तुत्वा नानाविधैः स्तोत्रैः प्रणामम् अकरोत् तदा
verses.transliteration: ity evaṃ dharmarājas tu purā nyagrodhasaṃnidhau stutvā nānāvidhaiḥ stotraiḥ praṇāmam akarot tadā
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा तु महाभागे प्रणतं प्राञ्जलिस्थितम् स्तोत्रस्य कारणं देवि पृष्टवान् अहम् अन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu mahābhāge praṇataṃ prāñjalisthitam stotrasya kāraṇaṃ devi pṛṣṭavān aham antakam
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वत महाबाहो सर्वदेवोत्तमो ह्य् असि किमर्थं स्तुतवान् मां त्वं संक्षेपात् तद् ब्रवीहि मे
verses.transliteration: vaivasvata mahābāho sarvadevottamo hy asi kimarthaṃ stutavān māṃ tvaṃ saṃkṣepāt tad bravīhi me
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्न् आयतने पुण्ये विख्याते पुरुषोत्तमे इन्द्रनीलमयी श्रेष्ठा प्रतिमा सार्वकामिकी
verses.transliteration: asminn āyatane puṇye vikhyāte puruṣottame indranīlamayī śreṣṭhā pratimā sārvakāmikī
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा पुण्डरीकाक्ष भावेनैकेन श्रद्धया श्वेताख्यं भवनं यान्ति निष्कामाश् चैव मानवाः
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇḍarīkākṣa bhāvenaikena śraddhayā śvetākhyaṃ bhavanaṃ yānti niṣkāmāś caiva mānavāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अतः कर्तुं न शक्नोमि व्यापारम् अरिसूदन प्रसीद सुमहादेव संहर प्रतिमां विभो
verses.transliteration: ataḥ kartuṃ na śaknomi vyāpāram arisūdana prasīda sumahādeva saṃhara pratimāṃ vibho
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा वैवस्वतस्यैतद् वाक्यम् एतद् उवाच ह यम तां गोपयिष्यामि सिकताभिः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā vaivasvatasyaitad vākyam etad uvāca ha yama tāṃ gopayiṣyāmi sikatābhiḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा प्रतिमा देवि वल्लिभिर् गोपिता मया यथा तत्र न पश्यन्ति मनुजाः स्वर्गकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā pratimā devi vallibhir gopitā mayā yathā tatra na paśyanti manujāḥ svargakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रच्छाद्य वल्लिकैर् देवि जातरूपपरिच्छदैः यमं प्रस्थापयाम् आस स्वां पुरीं दक्षिणां दिशम्
verses.transliteration: pracchādya vallikair devi jātarūpaparicchadaiḥ yamaṃ prasthāpayām āsa svāṃ purīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लुप्तायां प्रतिमायां तु इन्द्रनीलस्य भो द्विजाः तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे पुण्ये विख्याते पुरुषोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: luptāyāṃ pratimāyāṃ tu indranīlasya bho dvijāḥ tasmin kṣetravare puṇye vikhyāte puruṣottame
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो भूतस् तत्र वृत्तान्तो देवदेवो जनार्दनः तं सर्वं कथयाम् आस स तस्यै भगवान् पुरा
verses.transliteration: yo bhūtas tatra vṛttānto devadevo janārdanaḥ taṃ sarvaṃ kathayām āsa sa tasyai bhagavān purā
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रद्युम्नस्य गमनं क्षेत्रसंदर्शनं तथा क्षेत्रस्य वर्णनं चैव प्रासादकरणं तथा
verses.transliteration: indradyumnasya gamanaṃ kṣetrasaṃdarśanaṃ tathā kṣetrasya varṇanaṃ caiva prāsādakaraṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हयमेधस्य यजनं स्वप्नदर्शनम् एव च लवणस्योदधेस् तीरे काष्ठस्य दर्शनं तथा
verses.transliteration: hayamedhasya yajanaṃ svapnadarśanam eva ca lavaṇasyodadhes tīre kāṣṭhasya darśanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनं वासुदेवस्य शिल्पिराजस्य च द्विजाः निर्माणं प्रतिमायास् तु यथावर्णं विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: darśanaṃ vāsudevasya śilpirājasya ca dvijāḥ nirmāṇaṃ pratimāyās tu yathāvarṇaṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापनं चैव सर्वेषां प्रासादे भुवनोत्तमे यात्राकाले च विप्रेन्द्राः कल्पसंकीर्तनं तथा

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयस्य चरितं स्थापनं शंकरस्य च पञ्चतीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं दर्शनं शूलपाणिनः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyasya caritaṃ sthāpanaṃ śaṃkarasya ca pañcatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ darśanaṃ śūlapāṇinaḥ

verses.sanskrit: वटस्य दर्शनं चैव व्युष्टिं तस्य च भो द्विजाः दर्शनं बलदेवस्य कृष्णस्य च विशेषतः

verses.sanskrit: सुभद्रायाश् च तत्रैव माहात्म्यं चैव सर्वशः दर्शनं नरसिंहस्य व्युष्टिसंकीर्तनं तथा
verses.transliteration: subhadrāyāś ca tatraiva māhātmyaṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ darśanaṃ narasiṃhasya vyuṣṭisaṃkīrtanaṃ tathā

verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तवासुदेवस्य दर्शनं गुणकीर्तनम् श्वेतमाधवमाहात्म्यं स्वर्गद्वारस्य दर्शनम्

verses.sanskrit: उदधेर् दर्शनं चैव स्नानं तर्पणम् एव च समुद्रस्नानमाहात्म्यम् इन्द्रद्युम्नस्य च द्विजाः

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चतीर्थफलं चैव महाज्येष्ठं तथैव च स्थानं कृष्णस्य हलिनः पर्वयात्राफलं तथा
verses.transliteration: pañcatīrthaphalaṃ caiva mahājyeṣṭhaṃ tathaiva ca sthānaṃ kṛṣṇasya halinaḥ parvayātrāphalaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वर्णनं विष्णुलोकस्य क्षेत्रस्य च पुनः पुनः पूर्वं कथितवान् सर्वं तस्यै स पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: varṇanaṃ viṣṇulokasya kṣetrasya ca punaḥ punaḥ pūrvaṃ kathitavān sarvaṃ tasyai sa puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रोतुम् इच्छामहे देव कथाशेषं महीपतेः तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे गत्वा किं चकार नराधिपः
verses.transliteration: śrotum icchāmahe deva kathāśeṣaṃ mahīpateḥ tasmin kṣetravare gatvā kiṃ cakāra narādhipaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, we wish to hear the rest of the story of the king. After going to that excellent holy centre what did the lord of men do?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं मुनिशार्दूलाः प्रवक्ष्यामि समासतः क्षेत्रसंदर्शनं चैव कृत्यं तस्य च भूपतेः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ kṣetrasaṃdarśanaṃ caiva kṛtyaṃ tasya ca bhūpateḥ
verses.translation: Listen, O leading sages, I shall mention briefly the vision of the holy centre that the king had and his activities thereafter.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तत्र महीपालः क्षेत्रे त्रैलोक्यविश्रुते ददर्श रमणीयानि स्थानानि सरितस् तथा
verses.transliteration: gatvā tatra mahīpālaḥ kṣetre trailokyaviśrute dadarśa ramaṇīyāni sthānāni saritas tathā
verses.translation: O leading sages, these villages are full of well grown plants. They are very charming and thronged by delighted and well nourished people. They are finely dressed and bedecked in ornaments.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नदी तत्र महापुण्या विन्ध्यपादविनिर्गता स्वित्त्रोपलेति विख्याता सर्वपापहरा शिवा
verses.transliteration: nadī tatra mahāpuṇyā vindhyapādavinirgatā svittropaleti vikhyātā sarvapāpaharā śivā
verses.translation: The Brahmins, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras are lound there engaged in their duties. They are splendid in their traits and very peaceful.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गातुल्या महास्रोता दक्षिणार्णवगामिनी महानदीति नाम्ना सा पुण्यतोया सरिद्वरा
verses.transliteration: gaṅgātulyā mahāsrotā dakṣiṇārṇavagāminī mahānadīti nāmnā sā puṇyatoyā saridvarā
verses.translation: Mah&nadl —a river celebrated in the Puranas and flowing through the region of Utkala (Orissa).

verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇasyodadher garbhaṃ gatāvartātiśobhitā ubhayos taṭayor yasyā grāmāś ca nagarāṇi ca

verses.transliteration: striyas taddeśavāsinyo rūpayauvanagarvitāḥ saṃpūrṇalakṣaṇopetā vistīrṇaśroṇimaṇḍalāḥ

verses.transliteration: kāścit padmapalāśākṣyaḥ kāścid indīvarekṣaṇāḥ vidyudvispaṣṭadaśanās tanvaṅgyaś ca tathāparāḥ

verses.translation: Mah&nadl —a river celebrated in the Puranas and flowing through the region of Utkala (Orissa).

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुवैखानसैः सिद्धैः स्नातकैर् ब्रह्मचारिभिः मन्त्रसिद्धैस् तपःसिद्धैर् यज्ञसिद्धैर् निषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: bhikṣuvaikhānasaiḥ siddhaiḥ snātakair brahmacāribhiḥ mantrasiddhais tapaḥsiddhair yajñasiddhair niṣevitam
verses.translation: Mah&nadl —a river celebrated in the Puranas and flowing through the region of Utkala (Orissa).

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवं ददृशे राजा क्षेत्रं परमशोभनम् अत्रैवाराधयिष्यामि भगवन्तं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: ity evaṃ dadṛśe rājā kṣetraṃ paramaśobhanam atraivārādhayiṣyāmi bhagavantaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: Mah&nadl —a river celebrated in the Puranas and flowing through the region of Utkala (Orissa).

verses.sanskrit: जगद्गुरुं परं देवं परं पारं परं पदम् सर्वेश्वरेश्वरं विष्णुम् अनन्तम् अपराजितम्
verses.transliteration: jagadguruṃ paraṃ devaṃ paraṃ pāraṃ paraṃ padam sarveśvareśvaraṃ viṣṇum anantam aparājitam
verses.translation: Mah&nadl —a river celebrated in the Puranas and flowing through the region of Utkala (Orissa).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इदं तन्मानसं तीर्थं ज्ञातं मे पुरुषोत्तमम् कल्पवृक्षो महाकायो न्यग्रोधो यत्र तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: idaṃ tanmānasaṃ tīrthaṃ jñātaṃ me puruṣottamam kalpavṛkṣo mahākāyo nyagrodho yatra tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: Mah&nadl —a river celebrated in the Puranas and flowing through the region of Utkala (Orissa).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिमा चेन्द्रनीलाख्या स्वयं देवेन गोपिता न चात्र दृश्यते चान्या प्रतिमा वैष्णवी शुभा
verses.transliteration: pratimā cendranīlākhyā svayaṃ devena gopitā na cātra dṛśyate cānyā pratimā vaiṣṇavī śubhā
verses.translation: Mah&nadl —a river celebrated in the Puranas and flowing through the region of Utkala (Orissa).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा यत्नं करिष्यामि यथा देवो जगत्पतिः प्रत्यक्षं मम चाभ्येति विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: tathā yatnaṃ kariṣyāmi yathā devo jagatpatiḥ pratyakṣaṃ mama cābhyeti viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ
verses.translation: Mah&nadl —a river celebrated in the Puranas and flowing through the region of Utkala (Orissa).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञैर् दानैस् तपोभिश् च होमैर् ध्यानैस् तथार्चनैः उपवासैश् च विधिवच् चरेयं व्रतम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: yajñair dānais tapobhiś ca homair dhyānais tathārcanaiḥ upavāsaiś ca vidhivac careyaṃ vratam uttamam
verses.translation: Mah&nadl —a river celebrated in the Puranas and flowing through the region of Utkala (Orissa).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनन्यमनसा चैव तन्मना नान्यमानसः विष्ण्वायतनविन्यासे प्रारम्भं च करोम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: ananyamanasā caiva tanmanā nānyamānasaḥ viṣṇvāyatanavinyāse prārambhaṃ ca karomy aham
verses.translation: Mah&nadl —a river celebrated in the Puranas and flowing through the region of Utkala (Orissa).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं स पृथिवीपालश् चिन्तयित्वा द्विजोत्तमाः प्रासादार्थं हरेस् तत्र प्रारम्भम् अकरोत् तदा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa pṛthivīpālaś cintayitvā dvijottamāḥ prāsādārthaṃ hares tatra prārambham akarot tadā
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after thinking like this the king made the preliminary arrangements for the propitiation of Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आनाय्य गणकान् सर्वान् आचार्याञ् शास्त्रपारगान् भूमिं संशोध्य यत्नेन राजा तु परया मुदा
verses.transliteration: ānāyya gaṇakān sarvān ācāryāñ śāstrapāragān bhūmiṃ saṃśodhya yatnena rājā tu parayā mudā
verses.translation: After duly offering libation, the king Indradyumna called the heroic rulers of Kalihga, Utkala and Kosala and said:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणैर् ज्ञानसंपन्नैर् वेदशास्त्रार्थपारगैः अमात्यैर् मन्त्रिभिश् चैव वास्तुविद्याविशारदैः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇair jñānasaṃpannair vedaśāstrārthapāragaiḥ amātyair mantribhiś caiva vāstuvidyāviśāradaiḥ
verses.translation: After commanding them to proceed, Indradyumna spoke to the ministers and priests.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तैः सार्धं स समालोच्य सुमुहूर्ते शुभे दिने सुचन्द्रतारासंयोगे ग्रहानुकूल्यसंयुते
verses.transliteration: taiḥ sārdhaṃ sa samālocya sumuhūrte śubhe dine sucandratārāsaṃyoge grahānukūlyasaṃyute
verses.translation: Thus the messengers who were commanded by the noble king went to different kings and proclaimed the words of that monarch to them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जयमङ्गलशब्दैश् च नानावाद्यैर् मनोहरैः वेदाध्ययननिर्घोषैर् गीतैः सुमधुरस्वरैः
verses.transliteration: jayamaṅgalaśabdaiś ca nānāvādyair manoharaiḥ vedādhyayananirghoṣair gītaiḥ sumadhurasvaraiḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of messengers the kings came there in a hurry accompanied by their armies.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पलाजाक्षतैर् गन्धैः पूर्णकुम्भैः सदीपकैः ददाव् अर्घ्यं ततो राजा श्रद्धया सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: puṣpalājākṣatair gandhaiḥ pūrṇakumbhaiḥ sadīpakaiḥ dadāv arghyaṃ tato rājā śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: On observing that the various kings had arrived with their ministers and priests, the delighted king announced the weighty task on hand.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वैवम् अर्घ्यं विधिवद् आनाय्य स महीपतिः कलिङ्गाधिपतिं शूरम् उत्कलाधिपतिं तथा कोशलाधिपतिं चैव तान् उवाच तदा नृपः
verses.transliteration: dattvaivam arghyaṃ vidhivad ānāyya sa mahīpatiḥ kaliṅgādhipatiṃ śūram utkalādhipatiṃ tathā kośalādhipatiṃ caiva tān uvāca tadā nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Let learned brahmins who have mastered the Vedas go about and find out a place worthy of being used for success¬ fully concluding the horse-sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छध्वं सहिताः सर्वे शिलार्थे सुसमाहिताः गृहीत्वा शिल्पिमुख्यांश् च शिलाकर्मविशारदान्
verses.transliteration: gacchadhvaṃ sahitāḥ sarve śilārthe susamāhitāḥ gṛhītvā śilpimukhyāṃś ca śilākarmaviśāradān
verses.translation: (All round the sacrificial chamber) hundreds of palaces were built. They were beautiful and they resembled the abode of Indra. They were bedecked in gold and jewels. Excellent gems enhanced their beauty.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विन्ध्याचलं सुविस्तीर्णं बहुकन्दरशोभितम् निरूप्य सर्वसानूनि च्छेदयित्वा शिलाः शुभाः संवाह्यन्तां च शकटैर् नौकाभिर् मा विलम्बथ
verses.transliteration: vindhyācalaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ bahukandaraśobhitam nirūpya sarvasānūni cchedayitvā śilāḥ śubhāḥ saṃvāhyantāṃ ca śakaṭair naukābhir mā vilambatha
verses.translation: He got constructed many comfortable houses and residences for the Brahmins and VaiSyas who had come there from different lands.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं गन्तुं समादिश्य तान् नृपान् स महीपतिः पुनर् एवाब्रवीद् वाक्यं सामात्यान् सपुरोहितान्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ gantuṃ samādiśya tān nṛpān sa mahīpatiḥ punar evābravīd vākyaṃ sāmātyān sapurohitān
verses.translation: As those noble persons enjoyed themselves in their
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन्तु दूताः सर्वत्र ममाज्ञां प्रवदन्तु वै यत्र तिष्ठन्ति राजानः पृथिव्यां तान् सुशीघ्रगाः
verses.transliteration: gacchantu dūtāḥ sarvatra mamājñāṃ pravadantu vai yatra tiṣṭhanti rājānaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tān suśīghragāḥ
verses.translation: Delicious foodstuffs of various kinds prepared with rice, sugarcane, barley milk and milk products were served to guests. The excellent king himself approached them and ordered for the immediate supply of things they wanted.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हस्त्यश्वरथपादातैः सामात्यैः सपुरोहितैः गच्छत सहिताः सर्व इन्द्रद्युम्नस्य शासनात्
verses.transliteration: hastyaśvarathapādātaiḥ sāmātyaiḥ sapurohitaiḥ gacchata sahitāḥ sarva indradyumnasya śāsanāt
verses.translation: Delicious foodstuffs of various kinds prepared with rice, sugarcane, barley milk and milk products were served to guests. The excellent king himself approached them and ordered for the immediate supply of things they wanted.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं दूताः समाज्ञाता राज्ञा तेन महात्मना गत्वा तदा नृपान् ऊचुर् वचनं तस्य भूपतेः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dūtāḥ samājñātā rājñā tena mahātmanā gatvā tadā nṛpān ūcur vacanaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ
verses.translation: Delicious foodstuffs of various kinds prepared with rice, sugarcane, barley milk and milk products were served to guests. The excellent king himself approached them and ordered for the immediate supply of things they wanted.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु ते तथा सर्वे दूतानां वचनं नृपाः आजग्मुस् त्वरिताः सर्वे स्वसैन्यैः परिवारिताः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu te tathā sarve dūtānāṃ vacanaṃ nṛpāḥ ājagmus tvaritāḥ sarve svasainyaiḥ parivāritāḥ
verses.translation: Delicious foodstuffs of various kinds prepared with rice, sugarcane, barley milk and milk products were served to guests. The excellent king himself approached them and ordered for the immediate supply of things they wanted.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये नृपाः सर्वदिग्भागे ये च दक्षिणतः स्थिताः पश्चिमायां स्थिता ये च उत्तरापथसंस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: ye nṛpāḥ sarvadigbhāge ye ca dakṣiṇataḥ sthitāḥ paścimāyāṃ sthitā ye ca uttarāpathasaṃsthitāḥ
verses.translation: Delicious foodstuffs of various kinds prepared with rice, sugarcane, barley milk and milk products were served to guests. The excellent king himself approached them and ordered for the immediate supply of things they wanted.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यन्तवासिनो ये ऽपि ये च संनिधिवासिनः पार्वतीयाश् च ये केचित् तथा द्वीपनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: pratyantavāsino ye 'pi ye ca saṃnidhivāsinaḥ pārvatīyāś ca ye kecit tathā dvīpanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: Delicious foodstuffs of various kinds prepared with rice, sugarcane, barley milk and milk products were served to guests. The excellent king himself approached them and ordered for the immediate supply of things they wanted.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रथैर् नागैः पदातैश् च वाजिभिर् धनविस्तरैः संप्राप्ता बहुशो विप्राः श्रुत्वेन्द्रद्युम्नशासनम्
verses.transliteration: rathair nāgaiḥ padātaiś ca vājibhir dhanavistaraiḥ saṃprāptā bahuśo viprāḥ śrutvendradyumnaśāsanam
verses.translation: Delicious foodstuffs of various kinds prepared with rice, sugarcane, barley milk and milk products were served to guests. The excellent king himself approached them and ordered for the immediate supply of things they wanted.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तान् आगतान् नृपान् दृष्ट्वा सामात्यान् सपुरोहितान् प्रोवाच राजा हृष्टात्मा कार्यम् उद्दिश्य सादरम्
