verses.transliteration: śāntātmāno jitakrodhāḥ prāpnuvanti dvijātayaḥ prāptuṃ śakyo na caivāhaṃ narair duṣkṛtakarmabhiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लोभाभिभूतैः कृपणैर् अनार्यैर् अकृतात्मभिः तन् मां महाफलं विद्धि नराणां भावितात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: lobhābhibhūtaiḥ kṛpaṇair anāryair akṛtātmabhiḥ tan māṃ mahāphalaṃ viddhi narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुदुष्प्रापं विमूढानां मां कुयोगनिषेविणाम् यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर् भवति सत्तम
verses.transliteration: suduṣprāpaṃ vimūḍhānāṃ māṃ kuyoganiṣeviṇām yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati sattama
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अभ्युत्थानम् अधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्य् अहम् दैत्या हिंसानुरक्ताश् च अवध्याः सुरसत्तमैः
verses.transliteration: abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmy aham daityā hiṃsānuraktāś ca avadhyāḥ surasattamaiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसाश् चापि लोके ऽस्मिन् यदोत्पत्स्यन्ति दारुणाः तदाहं संप्रसूयामि गृहेषु पुण्यकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: rākṣasāś cāpi loke 'smin yadotpatsyanti dāruṇāḥ tadāhaṃ saṃprasūyāmi gṛheṣu puṇyakarmaṇām
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टो मानुषं देहं सर्वं प्रशमयाम्य् अहम् सृष्ट्वा देवमनुष्यांश् च गन्धर्वोरगराक्षसान्
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭo mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ sarvaṃ praśamayāmy aham sṛṣṭvā devamanuṣyāṃś ca gandharvoragarākṣasān
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्थावराणि च भूतानि संहराम्य् आत्ममायया कर्मकाले पुनर् देहम् अनुचिन्त्य सृजाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni saṃharāmy ātmamāyayā karmakāle punar deham anucintya sṛjāmy aham
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आविश्य मानुषं देहं मर्यादाबन्धकारणात् श्वेतः कृतयुगे धर्मः श्यामस् त्रेतायुगे मम
verses.transliteration: āviśya mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ maryādābandhakāraṇāt śvetaḥ kṛtayuge dharmaḥ śyāmas tretāyuge mama
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रक्तो द्वापरम् आसाद्य कृष्णः कलियुगे तथा त्रयो भागा ह्य् अधर्मस्य तस्मिन् काले भवन्ति च
verses.transliteration: rakto dvāparam āsādya kṛṣṇaḥ kaliyuge tathā trayo bhāgā hy adharmasya tasmin kāle bhavanti ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्तकाले च संप्राप्ते कालो भूत्वातिदारुणः त्रैलोक्यं नाशयाम्य् एकः सर्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: antakāle ca saṃprāpte kālo bhūtvātidāruṇaḥ trailokyaṃ nāśayāmy ekaḥ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहं त्रिधर्मा विश्वात्मा सर्वलोकसुखावहः अभिन्नः सर्वगो ऽनन्तो हृषीकेश उरुक्रमः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ tridharmā viśvātmā sarvalokasukhāvahaḥ abhinnaḥ sarvago 'nanto hṛṣīkeśa urukramaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कालचक्रं नयाम्य् एको ब्रह्मरूपं ममैव तत् शमनं सर्वभूतानां सर्वभूतकृतोद्यमम्
verses.transliteration: kālacakraṃ nayāmy eko brahmarūpaṃ mamaiva tat śamanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtakṛtodyamam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रणिहितः सम्यङ् ममात्मा मुनिसत्तम सर्वभूतेषु विप्रेन्द्र न च मां वेत्ति कश्चन
verses.transliteration: evaṃ praṇihitaḥ samyaṅ mamātmā munisattama sarvabhūteṣu viprendra na ca māṃ vetti kaścana
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोके च मां भक्ताः पूजयन्ति च सर्वशः यच् च किंचित् त्वया प्राप्तं मयि क्लेशात्मकं द्विज
verses.transliteration: sarvaloke ca māṃ bhaktāḥ pūjayanti ca sarvaśaḥ yac ca kiṃcit tvayā prāptaṃ mayi kleśātmakaṃ dvija
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुखोदयाय तत् सर्वं श्रेयसे च तवानघ यच् च किंचित् त्वया लोके दृष्टं स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: sukhodayāya tat sarvaṃ śreyase ca tavānagha yac ca kiṃcit tvayā loke dṛṣṭaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विहितः सर्व एवासौ मयात्मा भूतभावनः अहं नारायणो नाम शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः
verses.transliteration: vihitaḥ sarva evāsau mayātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ahaṃ nārāyaṇo nāma śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यावद् युगानां विप्रर्षे सहस्रं परिवर्तते तावत् स्वपिमि विश्वात्मा सर्वविश्वानि मोहयन्
verses.transliteration: yāvad yugānāṃ viprarṣe sahasraṃ parivartate tāvat svapimi viśvātmā sarvaviśvāni mohayan
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं सर्वम् अहं कालम् इहासे मुनिसत्तम अशिशुः शिशुरूपेण यावद् ब्रह्मा न बुध्यते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sarvam ahaṃ kālam ihāse munisattama aśiśuḥ śiśurūpeṇa yāvad brahmā na budhyate
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मया च दत्तो विप्रेन्द्र वरस् ते ब्रह्मरूपिणा असकृत् परितुष्टेन विप्रर्षिगणपूजित
verses.transliteration: mayā ca datto viprendra varas te brahmarūpiṇā asakṛt parituṣṭena viprarṣigaṇapūjita
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वम् एकार्णवं कृत्वा नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे निर्गतो ऽसि मयाज्ञातस् ततस् ते दर्शितं जगत्
verses.transliteration: sarvam ekārṇavaṃ kṛtvā naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame nirgato 'si mayājñātas tatas te darśitaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यन्तरं शरीरस्य प्रविष्टो ऽसि यदा मम दृष्ट्वा लोकं समस्तं हि विस्मितो नावबुध्यसे
verses.transliteration: abhyantaraṃ śarīrasya praviṣṭo 'si yadā mama dṛṣṭvā lokaṃ samastaṃ hi vismito nāvabudhyase
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽसि वक्त्राद् विप्रर्षे द्रुतं निःसारितो मया आख्यातस् ते मया चात्मा दुर्ज्ञेयो हि सुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration: tato 'si vaktrād viprarṣe drutaṃ niḥsārito mayā ākhyātas te mayā cātmā durjñeyo hi surāsuraiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यावत् स भगवान् ब्रह्मा न बुध्येत महातपाः तावत् त्वम् इह विप्रर्षे विश्रब्धश् चर वै सुखम्
verses.transliteration: yāvat sa bhagavān brahmā na budhyeta mahātapāḥ tāvat tvam iha viprarṣe viśrabdhaś cara vai sukham
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो विबुद्धे तस्मिंस् तु सर्वलोकपितामहे एको भूतानि स्रक्ष्यामि शरीराणि द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: tato vibuddhe tasmiṃs tu sarvalokapitāmahe eko bhūtāni srakṣyāmi śarīrāṇi dvijottama
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आकाशं पृथिवीं ज्योतिर् वायुः सलिलम् एव च लोके यच् च भवेत् किंचिद् इह स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: ākāśaṃ pṛthivīṃ jyotir vāyuḥ salilam eva ca loke yac ca bhavet kiṃcid iha sthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा तदा विप्राः पुनस् तं प्राह माधवः पूर्णे युगसहस्रे तु मेघगम्भीरनिस्वनः
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā tadā viprāḥ punas taṃ prāha mādhavaḥ pūrṇe yugasahasre tu meghagambhīranisvanaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मुने ब्रूहि यदर्थं मां स्तुतवान् परमार्थतः वरं वृणीष्व यच् छ्रेष्ठं ददामि नचिराद् अहम्
verses.transliteration: mune brūhi yadarthaṃ māṃ stutavān paramārthataḥ varaṃ vṛṇīṣva yac chreṣṭhaṃ dadāmi nacirād aham
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आयुष्मान् असि देवानां मद्भक्तो ऽसि दृढव्रतः तेन त्वम् असि विप्रेन्द्र पुनर् दीर्घायुर् आप्नुहि
verses.transliteration: āyuṣmān asi devānāṃ madbhakto 'si dṛḍhavrataḥ tena tvam asi viprendra punar dīrghāyur āpnuhi
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा वाणीं शुभां तस्य विलोक्य स तदा पुनः मूर्ध्ना निपत्य सहसा प्रणम्य पुनर् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā vāṇīṃ śubhāṃ tasya vilokya sa tadā punaḥ mūrdhnā nipatya sahasā praṇamya punar abravīt
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टं परं हि देवेश तव रूपं द्विजोत्तम मोहो ऽयं विगतः सत्यं त्वयि दृष्टे तु मे हरे
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭaṃ paraṃ hi deveśa tava rūpaṃ dvijottama moho 'yaṃ vigataḥ satyaṃ tvayi dṛṣṭe tu me hare
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् एवम् अहं नाथ इच्छेयं त्वत्प्रसादतः लोकानां च हितार्थाय नानाभावप्रशान्तये
verses.transliteration: evam evam ahaṃ nātha iccheyaṃ tvatprasādataḥ lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya nānābhāvapraśāntaye
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शैवभागवतानां च वादार्थप्रतिषेधकम् अस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे पुण्ये निर्मले पुरुषोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: śaivabhāgavatānāṃ ca vādārthapratiṣedhakam asmin kṣetravare puṇye nirmale puruṣottame
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्यायतनं देव करोमि परमं महत् प्रतिष्ठेय तथा तत्र तव स्थाने च शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: śivasyāyatanaṃ deva karomi paramaṃ mahat pratiṣṭheya tathā tatra tava sthāne ca śaṃkaram
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो ज्ञास्यन्ति लोके ऽस्मिन्न् एकमूर्ती हरीश्वरौ प्रत्युवाच जगन्नाथः स पुनस् तं महामुनिम्
verses.transliteration: tato jñāsyanti loke 'sminn ekamūrtī harīśvarau pratyuvāca jagannāthaḥ sa punas taṃ mahāmunim
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यद् एतत् परमं देवं कारणं भुवनेश्वरम् लिङ्गम् आराधनार्थाय नानाभावप्रशान्तये
verses.transliteration: yad etat paramaṃ devaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhuvaneśvaram liṅgam ārādhanārthāya nānābhāvapraśāntaye
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ममादिष्टेन विप्रेन्द्र कुरु शीघ्रं शिवालयम् तत्प्रभावाच् छिवलोके तिष्ठ त्वं च तथाक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: mamādiṣṭena viprendra kuru śīghraṃ śivālayam tatprabhāvāc chivaloke tiṣṭha tvaṃ ca tathākṣayam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिवे संस्थापिते विप्र मम संस्थापनं भवेत् नावयोर् अन्तरं किंचिद् एकभावौ द्विधा कृतौ
verses.transliteration: śive saṃsthāpite vipra mama saṃsthāpanaṃ bhavet nāvayor antaraṃ kiṃcid ekabhāvau dvidhā kṛtau
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो रुद्रः स स्वयं विष्णुर् यो विष्णुः स महेश्वरः उभयोर् अन्तरं नास्ति पवनाकाशयोर् इव
verses.transliteration: yo rudraḥ sa svayaṃ viṣṇur yo viṣṇuḥ sa maheśvaraḥ ubhayor antaraṃ nāsti pavanākāśayor iva
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मोहितो नाभिजानाति य एव गरुडध्वजः वृषध्वजः स एवेति त्रिपुरघ्नं त्रिलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: mohito nābhijānāti ya eva garuḍadhvajaḥ vṛṣadhvajaḥ sa eveti tripuraghnaṃ trilocanam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तव नामाङ्कितं तस्मात् कुरु विप्र शिवालयम् उत्तरे देवदेवस्य कुरु तीर्थं सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: tava nāmāṅkitaṃ tasmāt kuru vipra śivālayam uttare devadevasya kuru tīrthaṃ suśobhanam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयह्रदो नाम नरलोकेषु विश्रुतः भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ सर्वपापप्रणाशनः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyahrado nāma naralokeṣu viśrutaḥ bhaviṣyati dvijaśreṣṭha sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा स तदा देवस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत मार्कण्डेयं मुनिश्रेष्ठाः सर्वव्यापी जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā sa tadā devas tatraivāntaradhīyata mārkaṇḍeyaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ sarvavyāpī janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि पञ्चतीर्थविधिं द्विजाः यत् फलं स्नानदानेन देवताप्रेक्षणेन च
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pañcatīrthavidhiṃ dvijāḥ yat phalaṃ snānadānena devatāprekṣaṇena ca
verses.translation: By thus visiting and bowing to Bala, Krsna and Su- bhadra, the devotee obtains virtue, wealth, love and liberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयह्रदं गत्वा नरश् चोदङ्मुखः शुचिः निमज्जेत् तत्र वारांस् त्रीन् इमं मन्त्रम् उदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyahradaṃ gatvā naraś codaṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ nimajjet tatra vārāṃs trīn imaṃ mantram udīrayet
verses.translation: He returns to his abode where lord Visnu's idol, made of lapis lazuli, is covered up by sands. By bowing to the lord who vanished there he enters the city of Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संसारसागरे मग्नं पापग्रस्तम् अचेतनम् त्राहि मां भगनेत्रघ्न त्रिपुरारे नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: saṃsārasāgare magnaṃ pāpagrastam acetanam trāhi māṃ bhaganetraghna tripurāre namo 'stu te
verses.translation: By devoutly visiting Narasimha lord, and by bowing to him one is liberated from all sins. There is no doubt in this.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमः शिवाय शान्ताय सर्वपापहराय च स्नानं करोमि देवेश मम नश्यतु पातकम्
verses.transliteration: namaḥ śivāya śāntāya sarvapāpaharāya ca snānaṃ karomi deveśa mama naśyatu pātakam
verses.translation: Hence, by all means one shall resort to Narasimha since he bestows the benefit of virtue, wealth, love and salvation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नाभिमात्रे जले स्नात्वा विधिवद् देवता ऋषीन् तिलोदकेन मतिमान् पितॄंश् चान्यांश् च तर्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: nābhimātre jale snātvā vidhivad devatā ṛṣīn tilodakena matimān pitṝṃś cānyāṃś ca tarpayet
verses.translation: O lord of the universe, we wish to hear the power of that lord in detail. Our eagerness is very great.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा तथैव चाचम्य ततो गच्छेच् छिवालयम् प्रविश्य देवतागारं कृत्वा तं त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: snātvā tathaiva cācamya tato gacchec chivālayam praviśya devatāgāraṃ kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: O lord, obeisance be to you. For rendering help to devotees, tell us how Narasimha, the lord of great strength becomes pleased.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मूलमन्त्रेण संपूज्य मार्कण्डेयस्य चेश्वरम् अघोरेण च भो विप्राः प्रणिपत्य प्रसादयेत्
verses.transliteration: mūlamantreṇa saṃpūjya mārkaṇḍeyasya ceśvaram aghoreṇa ca bho viprāḥ praṇipatya prasādayet
verses.translation: We hear many human and divine accomplishments which are undoubtedly realized by the favour of that lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रिलोचन नमस् ते ऽस्तु नमस् ते शशिभूषण त्राहि मां त्वं विरूपाक्ष महादेव नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: trilocana namas te 'stu namas te śaśibhūṣaṇa trāhi māṃ tvaṃ virūpākṣa mahādeva namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Due to the favour of that lord, one's movement be¬ comes unimpeded in the mortal world, heaven, netherworlds, quarters, water, city as well as mountain.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयह्रदे त्व् एवं स्नात्वा दृष्ट्वा च शंकरम् दशानाम् अश्वमेधानां फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyahrade tv evaṃ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ca śaṃkaram daśānām aśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: In this world including the mobile and immobile beings O brahmins, there is nothing impossible to achieve for lord Narasimha who is always sympathetic to his devotees.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पापैः सर्वैर् विनिर्मुक्तः शिवलोकं स गच्छति तत्र भुक्त्वा वरान् भोगान् यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम्
verses.transliteration: pāpaiḥ sarvair vinirmuktaḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati tatra bhuktvā varān bhogān yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam
verses.translation: I shall mention the mode of procedure for the worship of the lord. This is helpful to his devotees. I shall mention what it is whereby the deity with half the body of a lion is propitiated.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इहलोकं समासाद्य भवेद् विप्रो बहुश्रुतः शांकरं योगम् आसाद्य ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ihalokaṃ samāsādya bhaved vipro bahuśrutaḥ śāṃkaraṃ yogam āsādya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: O leading sages, listen to the eternal Kalparaja (Royal ritual), the real principle of Narasimha which has not been understood by Devas and Asuras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कल्पवृक्षं ततो गत्वा कृत्वा तं त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम् पूजयेत् परया भक्त्या मन्त्रेणानेन तं वटम्
verses.transliteration: kalpavṛkṣaṃ tato gatvā kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam pūjayet parayā bhaktyā mantreṇānena taṃ vaṭam
verses.translation: O brahmins, the leading aspirant devotee should subsist on a diet of milk accompanied by greens, roots, barley food, fruits, fried grain powder and oil cake.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमो व्यक्तरूपाय महाप्रलयकारिणे महद्रसोपविष्टाय न्यग्रोधाय नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: oṃ namo vyaktarūpāya mahāpralayakāriṇe mahadrasopaviṣṭāya nyagrodhāya namo 'stu te
verses.translation: It should also protect from all those enemies such as Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yaksas, Vidyadharas, Nagas, goblins, demons as well as similar antagonists.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अमरस् त्वं सदा कल्पे हरेश् चायतनं वट न्यग्रोध हर मे पापं कल्पवृक्ष नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: amaras tvaṃ sadā kalpe hareś cāyatanaṃ vaṭa nyagrodha hara me pāpaṃ kalpavṛkṣa namo 'stu te
verses.translation: The learned aspirant shall unhesitatingly enter the Crevasse with the coat of mail on, as he goes ahead, his diffi¬ culty, darkness and delusion perish.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा नत्वा कल्पवटं नरः सहसा मुच्यते पापाज् जीर्णत्वच इवोरगः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā natvā kalpavaṭaṃ naraḥ sahasā mucyate pāpāj jīrṇatvaca ivoragaḥ
verses.translation: A wide royal road beautified by humming bees becomes visible. O brahmins, remembering Narasimha he enters the nether worlds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: छायां तस्य समाक्रम्य कल्पवृक्षस्य भो द्विजाः ब्रह्महत्यां नरो जह्यात् पापेष्व् अन्येषु का कथा
verses.transliteration: chāyāṃ tasya samākramya kalpavṛkṣasya bho dvijāḥ brahmahatyāṃ naro jahyāt pāpeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā
verses.translation: The amulet (inspired with Narasimha Mantra)' tied round the neck of children affords a permanent protection: It destroys tumour, pustule, boils, as well as spider poison.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा कृष्णाङ्गसंभूतं ब्रह्मतेजोमयं परम् न्यग्रोधाकृतिकं विष्णुं प्रणिपत्य च भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṅgasaṃbhūtaṃ brahmatejomayaṃ param nyagrodhākṛtikaṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇipatya ca bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: If afflicted by ailments, the devotee should perform a sacrifice with sacrificial twigs, ghee and milk, thrice a day during the junctions (i.e. dawn, midday and dusk). If this is continued for a month it will dispel all ailments.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां फलं प्राप्नोति चाधिकम् तथा स्ववंशम् उद्धृत्य विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti cādhikam tathā svavaṃśam uddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैनतेयं नमस्कृत्य कृष्णस्य पुरतः स्थितम् सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तस् ततो विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: vainateyaṃ namaskṛtya kṛṣṇasya purataḥ sthitam sarvapāpavinirmuktas tato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा वटं वैनतेयं यः पश्येत् पुरुषोत्तमम् संकर्षणं सुभद्रां च स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā vaṭaṃ vainateyaṃ yaḥ paśyet puruṣottamam saṃkarṣaṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्यायतनं विष्णोः कृत्वा तं त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम् संकर्षणं स्वमन्त्रेण भक्त्यापूज्य प्रसादयेत्
verses.transliteration: praviśyāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam saṃkarṣaṇaṃ svamantreṇa bhaktyāpūjya prasādayet
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमस् ते हलधृग् राम नमस् ते मुशलायुध नमस् ते रेवतीकान्त नमस् ते भक्तवत्सल
verses.transliteration: namas te haladhṛg rāma namas te muśalāyudha namas te revatīkānta namas te bhaktavatsala
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमस् ते बलिनां श्रेष्ठ नमस् ते धरणीधर प्रलम्बारे नमस् ते ऽस्तु त्राहि मां कृष्णपूर्वज
verses.transliteration: namas te balināṃ śreṣṭha namas te dharaṇīdhara pralambāre namas te 'stu trāhi māṃ kṛṣṇapūrvaja
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रसाद्य चानन्तम् अजेयं त्रिदशार्चितम् कैलासशिखराकारं चन्द्रात् कान्ततराननम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ prasādya cānantam ajeyaṃ tridaśārcitam kailāsaśikharākāraṃ candrāt kāntatarānanam
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नीलवस्त्रधरं देवं फणाविकटमस्तकम् महाबलं हलधरं कुण्डलैकविभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: nīlavastradharaṃ devaṃ phaṇāvikaṭamastakam mahābalaṃ haladharaṃ kuṇḍalaikavibhūṣitam
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रौहिणेयं नरो भक्त्या लभेद् अभिमतं फलम् सर्वपापैर् विनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: rauhiṇeyaṃ naro bhaktyā labhed abhimataṃ phalam sarvapāpair vinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आभूतसंप्लवं यावद् भुक्त्वा तत्र सुखं नरः पुण्यक्षयाद् इहागत्य प्रवरे योगिनां कुले
verses.transliteration: ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvad bhuktvā tatra sukhaṃ naraḥ puṇyakṣayād ihāgatya pravare yogināṃ kule
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणप्रवरो भूत्वा सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः ज्ञानं तत्र समासाद्य मुक्तिं प्राप्नोति दुर्लभाम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇapravaro bhūtvā sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ jñānaṃ tatra samāsādya muktiṃ prāpnoti durlabhām
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् अभ्यर्च्य हलिनं ततः कृष्णं विचक्षणः द्वादशाक्षरमन्त्रेण पूजयेत् सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: evam abhyarcya halinaṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa pūjayet susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्विषट्कवर्णमन्त्रेण भक्त्या ये पुरुषोत्तमम् पूजयन्ति सदा धीरास् ते मोक्षं प्राप्नुवन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: dviṣaṭkavarṇamantreṇa bhaktyā ye puruṣottamam pūjayanti sadā dhīrās te mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti vai
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न तां गतिं सुरा यान्ति योगिनो नैव सोमपाः यां गतिं यान्ति भो विप्रा द्वादशाक्षरतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: na tāṃ gatiṃ surā yānti yogino naiva somapāḥ yāṃ gatiṃ yānti bho viprā dvādaśākṣaratatparāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् तेनैव मन्त्रेण भक्त्या कृष्णं जगद्गुरुम् संपूज्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः प्रणिपत्य प्रसादयेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt tenaiva mantreṇa bhaktyā kṛṣṇaṃ jagadgurum saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ praṇipatya prasādayet
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय कृष्ण जगन्नाथ जय सर्वाघनाशन जय चाणूरकेशिघ्न जय कंसनिषूदन
verses.transliteration: jaya kṛṣṇa jagannātha jaya sarvāghanāśana jaya cāṇūrakeśighna jaya kaṃsaniṣūdana
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय पद्मपलाशाक्ष जय चक्रगदाधर जय नीलाम्बुदश्याम जय सर्वसुखप्रद
verses.transliteration: jaya padmapalāśākṣa jaya cakragadādhara jaya nīlāmbudaśyāma jaya sarvasukhaprada
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय देव जगत्पूज्य जय संसारनाशन जय लोकपते नाथ जय वाञ्छाफलप्रद
verses.transliteration: jaya deva jagatpūjya jaya saṃsāranāśana jaya lokapate nātha jaya vāñchāphalaprada
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संसारसागरे घोरे निःसारे दुःखफेनिले क्रोधग्राहाकुले रौद्रे विषयोदकसंप्लवे
verses.transliteration: saṃsārasāgare ghore niḥsāre duḥkhaphenile krodhagrāhākule raudre viṣayodakasaṃplave
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नानारोगोर्मिकलिले मोहावर्तसुदुस्तरे निमग्नो ऽहं सुरश्रेष्ठ त्राहि मां पुरुषोत्तम
verses.transliteration: nānārogormikalile mohāvartasudustare nimagno 'haṃ suraśreṣṭha trāhi māṃ puruṣottama
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रसाद्य देवेशं वरदं भक्तवत्सलम् सर्वपापहरं देवं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ prasādya deveśaṃ varadaṃ bhaktavatsalam sarvapāpaharaṃ devaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पीनांसं द्विभुजं कृष्णं पद्मपत्त्रायतेक्षणम् महोरस्कं महाबाहुं पीतवस्त्रं शुभाननम्
verses.transliteration: pīnāṃsaṃ dvibhujaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇam mahoraskaṃ mahābāhuṃ pītavastraṃ śubhānanam
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिं मुकुटाङ्गदभूषणम् सर्वलक्षणसंयुक्तं वनमालाविभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ mukuṭāṅgadabhūṣaṇam sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा नरो ऽञ्जलिं कृत्वा दण्डवत् प्रणिपत्य च अश्वमेधसहस्राणां फलं प्राप्नोति वै द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā naro 'ñjaliṃ kṛtvā daṇḍavat praṇipatya ca aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti vai dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत् फलं सर्वतीर्थेषु स्नाने दाने प्रकीर्तितम् नरस् तत् फलम् आप्नोति दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं प्रणम्य च
verses.transliteration: yat phalaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snāne dāne prakīrtitam naras tat phalam āpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत् फलं सर्वरत्नाद्यैर् इष्टे बहुसुवर्णके नरस् तत् फलम् आप्नोति दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं प्रणम्य च
verses.transliteration: yat phalaṃ sarvaratnādyair iṣṭe bahusuvarṇake naras tat phalam āpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत् फलं सर्ववेदेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु यत् फलम् तत् फलं समवाप्नोति नरः कृष्णं प्रणम्य च
verses.transliteration: yat phalaṃ sarvavedeṣu sarvayajñeṣu yat phalam tat phalaṃ samavāpnoti naraḥ kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत् फलं सर्वदानेन व्रतेन नियमेन च नरस् तत् फलम् आप्नोति दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं प्रणम्य च
verses.transliteration: yat phalaṃ sarvadānena vratena niyamena ca naras tat phalam āpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तपोभिर् विविधैर् उग्रैर् यत् फलं समुदाहृतम् नरस् तत् फलम् आप्नोति दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं प्रणम्य च
verses.transliteration: tapobhir vividhair ugrair yat phalaṃ samudāhṛtam naras tat phalam āpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत् फलं ब्रह्मचर्येण सम्यक् चीर्णेन तत्कृतम् नरस् तत् फलम् आप्नोति दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं प्रणम्य च
verses.transliteration: yat phalaṃ brahmacaryeṇa samyak cīrṇena tatkṛtam naras tat phalam āpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत् फलं च गृहस्थस्य यथोक्ताचारवर्तिनः नरस् तत् फलम् आप्नोति दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं प्रणम्य च
verses.transliteration: yat phalaṃ ca gṛhasthasya yathoktācāravartinaḥ naras tat phalam āpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत् फलं वनवासेन वानप्रस्थस्य कीर्तितम् नरस् तत् फलम् आप्नोति दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं प्रणम्य च
verses.transliteration: yat phalaṃ vanavāsena vānaprasthasya kīrtitam naras tat phalam āpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संन्यासेन यथोक्तेन यत् फलं समुदाहृतम् नरस् तत् फलम् आप्नोति दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं प्रणम्य च
verses.transliteration: saṃnyāsena yathoktena yat phalaṃ samudāhṛtam naras tat phalam āpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं चात्र बहुनोक्तेन माहात्म्ये तस्य भो द्विजाः दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं नरो भक्त्या मोक्षं प्राप्नोति दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ cātra bahunoktena māhātmye tasya bho dvijāḥ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ naro bhaktyā mokṣaṃ prāpnoti durlabham
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पापैर् विमुक्तः शुद्धात्मा कल्पकोटिसमुद्भवैः श्रिया परमया युक्तः सर्वैः समुदितो गुणैः
verses.transliteration: pāpair vimuktaḥ śuddhātmā kalpakoṭisamudbhavaiḥ śriyā paramayā yuktaḥ sarvaiḥ samudito guṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामसमृद्धेन विमानेन सुवर्चसा त्रिसप्तकुलम् उद्धृत्य नरो विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmasamṛddhena vimānena suvarcasā trisaptakulam uddhṛtya naro viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र कल्पशतं यावद् भुक्त्वा भोगान् मनोरमान् गन्धर्वाप्सरसैः सार्धं यथा विष्णुश् चतुर्भुजः
verses.transliteration: tatra kalpaśataṃ yāvad bhuktvā bhogān manoramān gandharvāpsarasaiḥ sārdhaṃ yathā viṣṇuś caturbhujaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: च्युतस् तस्माद् इहायातो विप्राणां प्रवरे कुले सर्वज्ञः सर्ववेदी च जायते गतमत्सरः
verses.transliteration: cyutas tasmād ihāyāto viprāṇāṃ pravare kule sarvajñaḥ sarvavedī ca jāyate gatamatsaraḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वधर्मनिरतः शान्तो दाता भूतहिते रतः आसाद्य वैष्णवं ज्ञानं ततो मुक्तिम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: svadharmanirataḥ śānto dātā bhūtahite rataḥ āsādya vaiṣṇavaṃ jñānaṃ tato muktim avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः संपूज्य मन्त्रेण सुभद्रां भक्तवत्सलाम् प्रसादयेत् ततो विप्राः प्रणिपत्य कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃpūjya mantreṇa subhadrāṃ bhaktavatsalām prasādayet tato viprāḥ praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमस् ते सर्वगे देवि नमस् ते शुभसौख्यदे त्राहि मां पद्मपत्त्राक्षि कात्यायनि नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: namas te sarvage devi namas te śubhasaukhyade trāhi māṃ padmapattrākṣi kātyāyani namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रसाद्य तां देवीं जगद्धात्रीं जगद्धिताम् बलदेवस्य भगिनीं सुभद्रां वरदां शिवाम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ prasādya tāṃ devīṃ jagaddhātrīṃ jagaddhitām baladevasya bhaginīṃ subhadrāṃ varadāṃ śivām
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कामगेन विमानेन नरो विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत् आभूतसंप्लवं यावत् क्रीडित्वा तत्र देववत्
verses.transliteration: kāmagena vimānena naro viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvat krīḍitvā tatra devavat
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इह मानुषतां प्राप्तो ब्राह्मणो वेदविद् भवेत् प्राप्य योगं हरेस् तत्र मोक्षं च लभते ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: iha mānuṣatāṃ prāpto brāhmaṇo vedavid bhavet prāpya yogaṃ hares tatra mokṣaṃ ca labhate dhruvam
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं दृष्ट्वा बलं कृष्णं सुभद्रां प्रणिपत्य च धर्मं चार्थं च कामं च मोक्षं च लभते ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dṛṣṭvā balaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ praṇipatya ca dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca labhate dhruvam
verses.translation: He has been propitiated by me and thereafter by Indra, Vibhlsana 1 and Rama. Who does not wish to be propitiated?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रम्य देवतागारात् कृतकृत्यो भवेन् नरः प्रणम्यायतनं पश्चाद् व्रजेत् तत्र समाहितः
verses.transliteration: niṣkramya devatāgārāt kṛtakṛtyo bhaven naraḥ praṇamyāyatanaṃ paścād vrajet tatra samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: The man who takes holy dip in the Svetaganga and visits Svetamadhava as well as Matsya Madhava (Lord Visnu in the form of a fish) goes to Svetadvlpa.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रनीलमयो विष्णुर् यत्रास्ते वालुकावृतः अन्तर्धानगतं नत्वा ततो विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: indranīlamayo viṣṇur yatrāste vālukāvṛtaḥ antardhānagataṃ natvā tato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet
verses.translation: In his kingdom, men used to live upto ten thousand years without sickness. No body perished or was despondant in that kingdom.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदेवमयो यो ऽसौ हतवान् असुरोत्तमम् स आस्ते तत्र भो विप्राः सिंहार्धकृतविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: sarvadevamayo yo 'sau hatavān asurottamam sa āste tatra bho viprāḥ siṃhārdhakṛtavigrahaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the surpassing devotion of the king, the Lord of the universe came there together with Yama and said C T am delighted and satisfied".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या दृष्ट्वा तु तं देवं प्रणम्य नरकेसरीम् मुच्यते पातकैर् मर्त्यः समस्तैर् नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā dṛṣṭvā tu taṃ devaṃ praṇamya narakesarīm mucyate pātakair martyaḥ samastair nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Sveta, lord Mahesvara be¬ came joyous. He called the God of death who is terrible to all living beings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नरसिंहस्य ये भक्ता भवन्ति भुवि मानवाः न तेषां दुष्कृतं किंचित् फलं स्याद् यद् यद् ईप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: narasiṃhasya ye bhaktā bhavanti bhuvi mānavāḥ na teṣāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcit phalaṃ syād yad yad īpsitam
verses.translation: O Brahmins, he restrained the unthwartable Kala, the
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन नरसिंहं समाश्रयेत् धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां फलं यस्मात् प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena narasiṃhaṃ samāśrayet dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ phalaṃ yasmāt prayacchati
verses.translation: O Lord of Devas, O Lord of the Universe, O unchang¬ ing source of origin of the three worlds, tell us now the greatest fact of the deity named Sveta.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: माहात्म्यं नरसिंहस्य सुखदं भुवि दुर्लभम् यथा कथयसे देव तेन नो विस्मयो महान्
verses.transliteration: māhātmyaṃ narasiṃhasya sukhadaṃ bhuvi durlabham yathā kathayase deva tena no vismayo mahān
verses.translation: Listen, O leading sages, O sinless ones, for the welfare of all living beings I shall mention factually what you ask of me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रभावं तस्य देवस्य विस्तरेण जगत्पते श्रोतुम् इच्छामहे ब्रूहि परं कौतूहलं हि नः
verses.transliteration: prabhāvaṃ tasya devasya vistareṇa jagatpate śrotum icchāmahe brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, I have heard his anecdote formerly from the sages, the divine story of the deity called Madhava. Listen to that story which dispels fear, grief and agony.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथा प्रसीदेद् देवो ऽसौ नरसिंहो महाबलः भक्तानाम् उपकाराय ब्रूहि देव नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: yathā prasīded devo 'sau narasiṃho mahābalaḥ bhaktānām upakārāya brūhi deva namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Om obeisance to Vasudeva, obeisance to Samkarsana, obeisance to Pradyumna, Aniruddha, obeisance to Narayana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादान् नरसिंहस्य या भवन्त्य् अत्र सिद्धयः ब्रूहि ताः कुरु चास्माकं प्रसादं प्रपितामह
verses.transliteration: prasādān narasiṃhasya yā bhavanty atra siddhayaḥ brūhi tāḥ kuru cāsmākaṃ prasādaṃ prapitāmaha
verses.translation: Om obeisance to the deity with the umbilical lotus, to the source of origin of the lotus-born lord; to the lotus-coloured one, to you with the lotus in hand.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं तस्य भो विप्राः प्रभावं गदतो मम अजितस्याप्रमेयस्य भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदस्य च
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ tasya bho viprāḥ prabhāvaṃ gadato mama ajitasyāprameyasya bhuktimuktipradasya ca
verses.translation: Om obeisance to the lotus-eyed bountiful lord with a thousand eyes i obeisance to the thousand-footed, thousand¬ armed and thousand-furied lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कः शक्नोति गुणान् वक्तुं समस्तांस् तस्य भो द्विजाः सिंहार्धकृतदेहस्य प्रवक्ष्यामि समासतः
verses.transliteration: kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ samastāṃs tasya bho dvijāḥ siṃhārdhakṛtadehasya pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ
verses.translation: Om obeisance to Varaha (Boar), the bestower of boons, the most excellent, the most praise-worthy deity of good intellect, Acyuta of gold complexion.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: याः काश्चित् सिद्धयश् चात्र श्रूयन्ते दैवमानुषाः प्रसादात् तस्य ताः सर्वाः सिध्यन्ति नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: yāḥ kāścit siddhayaś cātra śrūyante daivamānuṣāḥ prasādāt tasya tāḥ sarvāḥ sidhyanti nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Om obeisance to the lord in the form of a boy, obe¬ isance to the deity with the lustre of a tender lotus, obeisance to the deity with the rising sun and the moon for the eyes, obeisance to the lord with the tresses resembling Munja grass.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गे मर्त्ये च पाताले दिक्षु तोये पुरे नगे प्रसादात् तस्य देवस्य भवत्य् अव्याहता गतिः
verses.transliteration: svarge martye ca pātāle dikṣu toye pure nage prasādāt tasya devasya bhavaty avyāhatā gatiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Kesava, obeisance to Narayana. Obeisance to Madhava, obeisance to Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: असाध्यं तस्य देवस्य नास्त्य् अत्र सचराचरे नरसिंहस्य भो विप्राः सदा भक्तानुकम्पिनः
verses.transliteration: asādhyaṃ tasya devasya nāsty atra sacarācare narasiṃhasya bho viprāḥ sadā bhaktānukampinaḥ
verses.translation: Om obeisance to Visnu, obeisance to the lord endowed with wealth and strength; obeisance to the slayer of Madhu, to one who holds pure rays.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विधानं तस्य वक्ष्यामि भक्तानाम् उपकारकम् येन प्रसीदेच् चैवासौ सिंहार्धकृतविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: vidhānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi bhaktānām upakārakam yena prasīdec caivāsau siṃhārdhakṛtavigrahaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the infinite one, the subtle one, to one who bears the Srivatsa scar, obeisance to Srlvikrama and the deity who wears the divine yellow robes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं मुनिशार्दूलाः कल्पराजं सनातनम् नरसिंहस्य तत्त्वं च यन् न ज्ञातं सुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ kalparājaṃ sanātanam narasiṃhasya tattvaṃ ca yan na jñātaṃ surāsuraiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the cause of creation; obeisance to the protector and the sustainer, to one endowed with attributes, and also to one devoid of attributes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शाकयावकमूलैस् तु फलपिण्याकसक्तुकैः पयोभक्षेण विप्रेन्द्रा वर्तयेत् साधकोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: śākayāvakamūlais tu phalapiṇyākasaktukaiḥ payobhakṣeṇa viprendrā vartayet sādhakottamaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of dwarfish forms, to one of dwarfish activities, to one of small eyes, to one of dwarfish vehicle.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कोशकौपीनवासाश् च ध्यानयुक्तो जितेन्द्रियः अरण्ये विजने देशे पर्वते सिन्धुसंगमे
verses.transliteration: kośakaupīnavāsāś ca dhyānayukto jitendriyaḥ araṇye vijane deśe parvate sindhusaṃgame
verses.translation: Obeisance to the infinite deity worthy of being wor¬ shipped, to one of unmanifest forms, to one who cannot be argued about, to the pure and the dispeller of fear.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऊषरे सिद्धक्षेत्रे च नरसिंहाश्रमे तथा प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्वयं वापि पूजां कृत्वा विधानतः
verses.transliteration: ūṣare siddhakṣetre ca narasiṃhāśrame tathā pratiṣṭhāpya svayaṃ vāpi pūjāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: Om obeisance to the deity of divine forms, to the deity whose breath is constituted by the moon and fire. Obeisance to one whose tresses are constituted by solar and lunar rays. Obeisance to the deity conducive to the welfare of cows and brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्वादश्यां शुक्लपक्षस्य उपोष्य मुनिपुंगवाः जपेल् लक्षाणि वै विंशन् मनसा संयतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya upoṣya munipuṃgavāḥ japel lakṣāṇi vai viṃśan manasā saṃyatendriyaḥ
verses.translation: Om obeisance to the deity on the form of Rk; Obeisance to the deity in the forms ofPadaand Krama. Obeisance to you, who arc eulogised by the Rks; obeisance to the deity whose means is Rk.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपपातकयुक्तश् च महापातकसंयुतः मुक्तो भवेत् ततो विप्राः साधको नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: upapātakayuktaś ca mahāpātakasaṃyutaḥ mukto bhavet tato viprāḥ sādhako nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Om obeisance to the upholder of Yaju's mantras, to the deity who has assumed the form of Yajus, to one who is worthy of being worshipped through Yajus, to one who is served, to the lord of Yajus Mantras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं तत्र नरसिंहं प्रपूजयेत् पुण्यगन्धादिभिर् धूपैः प्रणम्य शिरसा प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ tatra narasiṃhaṃ prapūjayet puṇyagandhādibhir dhūpaiḥ praṇamya śirasā prabhum
verses.translation: Om obeisance to you, O lord of Sri; Obeisance to Srldhara; obeisance to the most excellent one; obeisance to the lover of Sri; obeisance to one of self-control; obeisance to the Yogin worthy of being meditated upon by the Yogins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कर्पूरचन्दनाक्तानि जातीपुष्पाणि मस्तके प्रदद्यान् नरसिंहस्य ततः सिद्धिः प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: karpūracandanāktāni jātīpuṣpāṇi mastake pradadyān narasiṃhasya tataḥ siddhiḥ prajāyate
verses.translation: Om obeisance to the deity in the form of Saman. Obeisance to the excellent tone of the Saman. Om obeisance to the gentle one of Saman. Obeisance to the deity conversant with the Samayoga.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भगवान् सर्वकार्येषु न क्वचित् प्रतिहन्यते तेजः सोढुं न शक्ताः स्युर् ब्रह्मरुद्रादयः सुराः
verses.transliteration: bhagavān sarvakāryeṣu na kvacit pratihanyate tejaḥ soḍhuṃ na śaktāḥ syur brahmarudrādayaḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the Saman. Obeisance to the deity sung about by the Saman songs. Om obeisance to the uplifter of the Saman. Obeisance to the deity conversant with the Saman. Obeisance to the composer of Saman songs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं पुनर् दानवा लोके सिद्धगन्धर्वमानुषाः विद्याधरा यक्षगणाः सकिंनरमहोरगाः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ punar dānavā loke siddhagandharvamānuṣāḥ vidyādharā yakṣagaṇāḥ sakiṃnaramahoragāḥ
verses.translation: Om obeisance to the deity with adamantine head; obeisance to the slayer of Madhu and Kaitabha; obeisance to
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रं यान् आसुरान् हन्तुं जपन्त्य् एके ऽन्यसाधकाः ते सर्वे प्रलयं यान्ति दृष्ट्वादित्याग्निवर्चसः
verses.transliteration: mantraṃ yān āsurān hantuṃ japanty eke 'nyasādhakāḥ te sarve pralayaṃ yānti dṛṣṭvādityāgnivarcasaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Hrslkesa 1 of brightly illuminated form. Obeisance to you, lord Vasudeva. Obeisance to you Narayana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सकृज्जप्तं तु कवचं रक्षेत् सर्वम् उपद्रवम् द्विर्जप्तं कवचं दिव्यं रक्षते देवदानवात्
verses.transliteration: sakṛjjaptaṃ tu kavacaṃ rakṣet sarvam upadravam dvirjaptaṃ kavacaṃ divyaṃ rakṣate devadānavāt
verses.translation: Obeisance to the deity conducive to the welfare of the. world. Om obeisance to the destroyer of delusion. Obeisance to one who breaks existence.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाः किंनरा यक्षा विद्याधरमहोरगाः भूताः पिशाचा रक्षांसि ये चान्ये परिपन्थिनः
verses.transliteration: gandharvāḥ kiṃnarā yakṣā vidyādharamahoragāḥ bhūtāḥ piśācā rakṣāṃsi ye cānye paripanthinaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who bestows salvation; obeisance to
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रिर्जप्तं कवचं दिव्यम् अभेद्यं च सुरासुरैः द्वादशाभ्यन्तरे चैव योजनानां द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: trirjaptaṃ kavacaṃ divyam abhedyaṃ ca surāsuraiḥ dvādaśābhyantare caiva yojanānāṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of Yogins; obeisance to Rama who redeems all; obeisance to happiness; obeisance to the happy-eyed; obeisance to the upholder of merits.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रक्षते भगवान् देवो नरसिंहो महाबलः ततो गत्वा बिलद्वारम् उपोष्य रजनीत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: rakṣate bhagavān devo narasiṃho mahābalaḥ tato gatvā biladvāram upoṣya rajanītrayam
verses.translation: Obeisance to Vasudeva worthy of being saluted; obeisance to Vamadeva; obeisance to one who creates bodies for the embodied souls; obeisance to the breaker of difference.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पलाशकाष्ठैः प्रज्वाल्य भगवन्तं हुताशनम् पलाशसमिधस् तत्र जुहुयात् त्रिमधुप्लुताः
verses.transliteration: palāśakāṣṭhaiḥ prajvālya bhagavantaṃ hutāśanam palāśasamidhas tatra juhuyāt trimadhuplutāḥ
verses.translation: Om obeisance to the maker of riches; obeisance to one who bestows riches and residence; obeisance to the deity of the form of sacrifice; obeisance to the lord of sacrifices; obeisance to the Yogin.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्वे शते द्विजशार्दूला वषट्कारेण साधकः ततो विवरद्वारं तु प्रकटं जायते क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: dve śate dvijaśārdūlā vaṣaṭkāreṇa sādhakaḥ tato vivaradvāraṃ tu prakaṭaṃ jāyate kṣaṇāt
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of ascetics who preach Yoga. Obeisance to one who holds a discus; obeisance to Samkarsana; obeisance to one who slew Pralamba. 2
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो विशेत् तु निःशङ्कं कवची विवरं बुधः गच्छतः संकटं तस्य तमोमोहश् च नश्यति
verses.transliteration: tato viśet tu niḥśaṅkaṃ kavacī vivaraṃ budhaḥ gacchataḥ saṃkaṭaṃ tasya tamomohaś ca naśyati
verses.translation: Obeisance to the holder of ploughshare whose velocity is great and whose sound resembles the sound of clouds. Obeisance to you a perfect knowledge of the wise, O Narayana the ultimate resort of all living beings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राजमार्गः सुविस्तीर्णो दृश्यते भ्रमराजितः नरसिंहं स्मरंस् तत्र पातालं विशते द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: rājamārgaḥ suvistīrṇo dṛśyate bhramarājitaḥ narasiṃhaṃ smaraṃs tatra pātālaṃ viśate dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O Lord excepting you, I haye no other kinsmen or guide for redeeming me from hell. Hence, O deity favourably disposed towards those who bow down, I bow to you with emotional fervour.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तत्र जपेत् तत्त्वं नरसिंहाख्यम् अव्ययम् ततः स्त्रीणां सहस्राणि वीणावादनकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: gatvā tatra japet tattvaṃ narasiṃhākhyam avyayam tataḥ strīṇāṃ sahasrāṇi vīṇāvādanakarmaṇām
verses.translation: Hr$\kefa: One who has controlled the sense-organs that is a yogin. Krsna is said to be yogesvara.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निर्गच्छन्ति पुरो विप्राः स्वागतं ता वदन्ति च प्रवेशयन्ति ता हस्ते गृहीत्वा साधकेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nirgacchanti puro viprāḥ svāgataṃ tā vadanti ca praveśayanti tā haste gṛhītvā sādhakeśvaram
verses.translation: Pralamba: an asura who attacked Srikrsna and Balarama but was killed by the latter.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो रसायनं दिव्यं पाययन्ति द्विजोत्तमाः पीतमात्रे दिव्यदेहो जायते सुमहाबलः
verses.transliteration: tato rasāyanaṃ divyaṃ pāyayanti dvijottamāḥ pītamātre divyadeho jāyate sumahābalaḥ
verses.translation: I have approached you after eschewing all sorts of contacts and unions. O Kesava, may my contact remain with you for attaining self-realization.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडते सह कन्याभिर् यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम् भिन्नदेहो वासुदेवे लीयते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: krīḍate saha kanyābhir yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam bhinnadeho vāsudeve līyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O Kesava, I know that this worldly existence is full of pain. It is impossible to cross it during adversities. I am afflicted by my threefold searching tortures. Hence, I seek refuge in you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यदा न रोचते वासस् तस्मान् निर्गच्छते पुनः पट्टं शूलं च खड्गं च रोचनां च मणिं तथा
verses.transliteration: yadā na rocate vāsas tasmān nirgacchate punaḥ paṭṭaṃ śūlaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca rocanāṃ ca maṇiṃ tathā
verses.translation: On hearing these nectar-like words of the Lord of Devas, Sveta bent down his head with devotion and said with his mind concentrating on the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रसं रसायनं चैव पादुकाञ्जनम् एव च कृष्णाजिनं मुनिश्रेष्ठा गुटिकां च मनोहराम्
verses.transliteration: rasaṃ rasāyanaṃ caiva pādukāñjanam eva ca kṛṣṇājinaṃ muniśreṣṭhā guṭikāṃ ca manoharām
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कमण्डलुं चाक्षसूत्रं यष्टिं संजीवनीं तथा सिद्धविद्यां च शास्त्राणि गृहीत्वा साधकेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kamaṇḍaluṃ cākṣasūtraṃ yaṣṭiṃ saṃjīvanīṃ tathā siddhavidyāṃ ca śāstrāṇi gṛhītvā sādhakeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलद्वह्निस्फुलिङ्गोर्मिवेष्टितं त्रिशिखं हृदि सकृन् न्यस्तं दहेत् सर्वं वृजिनं जन्मकोटिजम्
verses.transliteration: jvaladvahnisphuliṅgormiveṣṭitaṃ triśikhaṃ hṛdi sakṛn nyastaṃ dahet sarvaṃ vṛjinaṃ janmakoṭijam
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विषे न्यस्तं विषं हन्यात् कुष्ठं हन्यात् तनौ स्थितम् स्वदेहे भ्रूणहत्यादि कृत्वा दिव्येन शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: viṣe nyastaṃ viṣaṃ hanyāt kuṣṭhaṃ hanyāt tanau sthitam svadehe bhrūṇahatyādi kṛtvā divyena śudhyati
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महाग्रहगृहीतेषु ज्वलमानं विचिन्तयेत् हृदन्ते वै ततः शीघ्रं नश्येयुर् दारुणा ग्रहाः
verses.transliteration: mahāgrahagṛhīteṣu jvalamānaṃ vicintayet hṛdante vai tataḥ śīghraṃ naśyeyur dāruṇā grahāḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बालानां कण्ठके बद्धं रक्षा भवति नित्यशः गण्डपिण्डकलूतानां नाशनं कुरुते ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: bālānāṃ kaṇṭhake baddhaṃ rakṣā bhavati nityaśaḥ gaṇḍapiṇḍakalūtānāṃ nāśanaṃ kurute dhruvam
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: व्याधिजाते समिद्भिश् च घृतक्षीरेण होमयेत् त्रिसंध्यं मासम् एकं तु सर्वरोगान् विनाशयेत्
verses.transliteration: vyādhijāte samidbhiś ca ghṛtakṣīreṇa homayet trisaṃdhyaṃ māsam ekaṃ tu sarvarogān vināśayet
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: असाध्यं तु न पश्यामि त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे यां यां कामयते सिद्धिं तां तां प्राप्नोति स ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: asādhyaṃ tu na paśyāmi trailokye sacarācare yāṃ yāṃ kāmayate siddhiṃ tāṃ tāṃ prāpnoti sa dhruvam
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अष्टोत्तरशतं त्व् एके पूजयित्वा मृगाधिपम् मृत्तिकाः सप्त वल्मीके श्मशाने च चतुष्पथे
verses.transliteration: aṣṭottaraśataṃ tv eke pūjayitvā mṛgādhipam mṛttikāḥ sapta valmīke śmaśāne ca catuṣpathe
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रक्तचन्दनसंमिश्रा गवां क्षीरेण लोडयेत् सिंहस्य प्रतिमां कृत्वा प्रमाणेन षडङ्गुलाम्
verses.transliteration: raktacandanasaṃmiśrā gavāṃ kṣīreṇa loḍayet siṃhasya pratimāṃ kṛtvā pramāṇena ṣaḍaṅgulām
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लिम्पेत् तथा भूर्जपत्त्रे रोचनया समालिखेत् नरसिंहस्य कण्ठे तु बद्ध्वा चैव हि मन्त्रवित्
verses.transliteration: limpet tathā bhūrjapattre rocanayā samālikhet narasiṃhasya kaṇṭhe tu baddhvā caiva hi mantravit
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जपेत् संख्याविहीनं तु पूजयित्वा जलाशये यावत् सप्ताहमात्रं तु जपेत् संयमितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: japet saṃkhyāvihīnaṃ tu pūjayitvā jalāśaye yāvat saptāhamātraṃ tu japet saṃyamitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जलाकीर्णा मुहूर्तेन जायते सर्वमेदिनी अथवा शुष्कवृक्षाग्रे नरसिंहं तु पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: jalākīrṇā muhūrtena jāyate sarvamedinī athavā śuṣkavṛkṣāgre narasiṃhaṃ tu pūjayet
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जप्त्वा चाष्टशतं तत्त्वं वर्षन्तं विनिवारयेत् तम् एवं पिञ्जके बद्ध्वा भ्रामयेत् साधकोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: japtvā cāṣṭaśataṃ tattvaṃ varṣantaṃ vinivārayet tam evaṃ piñjake baddhvā bhrāmayet sādhakottamaḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महावातो मुहूर्तेन आगच्छेन् नात्र संशयः पुनश् च धारयेत् क्षिप्रं सप्तसप्तेन वारिणा
verses.transliteration: mahāvāto muhūrtena āgacchen nātra saṃśayaḥ punaś ca dhārayet kṣipraṃ saptasaptena vāriṇā
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अथ तां प्रतिमां द्वारि निखनेद् यस्य साधकः गोत्रोत्सादो भवेत् तस्य उद्धृते चैव शान्तिदः
verses.transliteration: atha tāṃ pratimāṃ dvāri nikhaned yasya sādhakaḥ gotrotsādo bhavet tasya uddhṛte caiva śāntidaḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् तं मुनिशार्दूला भक्त्या संपूजयेत् सदा मृगराजं महावीर्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt taṃ muniśārdūlā bhaktyā saṃpūjayet sadā mṛgarājaṃ mahāvīryaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः स्त्रियः शूद्रान्त्यजातयः
verses.transliteration: vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ striyaḥ śūdrāntyajātayaḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संपूज्य तं सुरश्रेष्ठं भक्त्या सिंहवपुर्धरम् मुच्यन्ते चाशुभैर् दुःखैर् जन्मकोटिसमुद्भवैः
verses.transliteration: saṃpūjya taṃ suraśreṣṭhaṃ bhaktyā siṃhavapurdharam mucyante cāśubhair duḥkhair janmakoṭisamudbhavaiḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संपूज्य तं सुरश्रेष्ठं प्राप्नुवन्त्य् अभिवाञ्छितम् देवत्वम् अमरेशत्वं गन्धर्वत्वं च भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: saṃpūjya taṃ suraśreṣṭhaṃ prāpnuvanty abhivāñchitam devatvam amareśatvaṃ gandharvatvaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यक्षविद्याधरत्वं च तथान्यच् चाभिवाञ्छितम् दृष्ट्वा स्तुत्वा नमस्कृत्वा संपूज्य नरकेसरीम्
verses.transliteration: yakṣavidyādharatvaṃ ca tathānyac cābhivāñchitam dṛṣṭvā stutvā namaskṛtvā saṃpūjya narakesarīm
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नुवन्ति नरा राज्यं स्वर्गं मोक्षं च दुर्लभम् नरसिंहं नरो दृष्ट्वा लभेद् अभिमतं फलम्
verses.transliteration: prāpnuvanti narā rājyaṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca durlabham narasiṃhaṃ naro dṛṣṭvā labhed abhimataṃ phalam
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निर्मुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति सकृद् दृष्ट्वा तु तं देवं भक्त्या सिंहवपुर्धरम्
verses.transliteration: nirmuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati sakṛd dṛṣṭvā tu taṃ devaṃ bhaktyā siṃhavapurdharam
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मुच्यते चाशुभैर् दुःखैर् जन्मकोटिसमुद्भवैः संग्रामे संकटे दुर्गे चोरव्याघ्रादिपीडिते
verses.transliteration: mucyate cāśubhair duḥkhair janmakoṭisamudbhavaiḥ saṃgrāme saṃkaṭe durge coravyāghrādipīḍite
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कान्तारे प्राणसंदेहे विषवह्निजलेषु च राजादिभ्यः समुद्रेभ्यो ग्रहरोगादिपीडिते
verses.transliteration: kāntāre prāṇasaṃdehe viṣavahnijaleṣu ca rājādibhyaḥ samudrebhyo graharogādipīḍite
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
