verses.sanskrit: स्मृत्वा तं पुरुषः सर्वै राजग्रामैर् विमुच्यते सूर्योदये यथा नाशं तमो ऽभ्येति महत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: smṛtvā taṃ puruṣaḥ sarvai rājagrāmair vimucyate sūryodaye yathā nāśaṃ tamo 'bhyeti mahattaram
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा संदर्शने तस्य विनाशं यान्त्य् उपद्रवाः गुटिकाञ्जनपातालपादुके च रसायनम्
verses.transliteration: tathā saṃdarśane tasya vināśaṃ yānty upadravāḥ guṭikāñjanapātālapāduke ca rasāyanam
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नरसिंहे प्रसन्ने तु प्राप्नोत्य् अन्यांश् च वाञ्छितान् यान् यान् कामान् अभिध्यायन् भजते नरकेसरीम्
verses.transliteration: narasiṃhe prasanne tu prāpnoty anyāṃś ca vāñchitān yān yān kāmān abhidhyāyan bhajate narakesarīm
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तांस् तान् कामान् अवाप्नोति नरो नास्त्य् अत्र संशयः दृष्ट्वा तं देवदेवेशं भक्त्यापूज्य प्रणम्य च
verses.transliteration: tāṃs tān kāmān avāpnoti naro nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ dṛṣṭvā taṃ devadeveśaṃ bhaktyāpūjya praṇamya ca
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दशानाम् अश्वमेधानां फलं दशगुणं लभेत् पापैः सर्वैर् विनिर्मुक्तो गुणैः सर्वैर् अलंकृतः
verses.transliteration: daśānām aśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ labhet pāpaiḥ sarvair vinirmukto guṇaiḥ sarvair alaṃkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा जरामरणवर्जितः सौवर्णेन विमानेन किङ्किणीजालमालिना
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ sauvarṇena vimānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामसमृद्धेन कामगेन सुवर्चसा तरुणादित्यवर्णेन मुक्ताहारावलम्बिना
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmasamṛddhena kāmagena suvarcasā taruṇādityavarṇena muktāhārāvalambinā
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यस्त्रीशतयुक्तेन दिव्यगन्धर्वनादिना कुलैकविंशम् उद्धृत्य देववन् मुदितः सुखी
verses.transliteration: divyastrīśatayuktena divyagandharvanādinā kulaikaviṃśam uddhṛtya devavan muditaḥ sukhī
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्तूयमानो ऽप्सरोभिश् च विष्णुलोकं व्रजेन् नरः भुक्त्वा तत्र वरान् भोगान् विष्णुलोके द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: stūyamāno 'psarobhiś ca viṣṇulokaṃ vrajen naraḥ bhuktvā tatra varān bhogān viṣṇuloke dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वैर् अप्सरैर् युक्तः कृत्वा रूपं चतुर्भुजम् मनोह्लादकरं सौख्यं यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम्
verses.transliteration: gandharvair apsarair yuktaḥ kṛtvā rūpaṃ caturbhujam manohlādakaraṃ saukhyaṃ yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यक्षयाद् इहायातः प्रवरे योगिनां कुले चतुर्वेदी भवेद् विप्रो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः वैष्णवं योगम् आस्थाय ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: puṇyakṣayād ihāyātaḥ pravare yogināṃ kule caturvedī bhaved vipro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ vaiṣṇavaṃ yogam āsthāya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनन्ताख्यं वासुदेवं दृष्ट्वा भक्त्या प्रणम्य च सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो नरो याति परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: anantākhyaṃ vāsudevaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktyā praṇamya ca sarvapāpavinirmukto naro yāti paraṃ padam
verses.translation: He goes to the greatest abode where Hari himself is present. Returning to this placc(eartli)in due course of time he shall become a king on the earth,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मया चाराधितश् चासौ शक्रेण तदनन्तरम् विभीषणेन रामेण कस् तं नाराधयेत् पुमान्
verses.transliteration: mayā cārādhitaś cāsau śakreṇa tadanantaram vibhīṣaṇena rāmeṇa kas taṃ nārādhayet pumān
verses.translation: By resorting to Matsyamadhava a man becomes un- thwartable. He shall be a donor, enjoyer of pleasures, a wor¬ shipper, a devotee of Visnu and truthful in speech.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतगङ्गां नरः स्नात्वा यः पश्येच् छ्वेतमाधवम् मत्स्याख्यं माधवं चैव श्वेतद्वीपं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: śvetagaṅgāṃ naraḥ snātvā yaḥ paśyec chvetamādhavam matsyākhyaṃ mādhavaṃ caiva śvetadvīpaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Afterwards he attains Yoga pertaining to Hari and gains salvation. O leading sages, the greatness of Matsyama¬ dhava has been recounted by me. By visiting him the devotee will obtain all cherished desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतमाधवमाहात्म्यं वक्तुम् अर्हस्य् अशेषतः विस्तरेण जगन्नाथ प्रतिमां तस्य वै हरेः
verses.transliteration: śvetamādhavamāhātmyaṃ vaktum arhasy aśeṣataḥ vistareṇa jagannātha pratimāṃ tasya vai hareḥ
verses.translation: O Lord, we wish to hear further. The rites of wiping off,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे पुण्ये विख्याते जगतीतले श्वेताख्यं माधवं देवं कस् तं स्थापितवान् पुरा
verses.transliteration: tasmin kṣetravare puṇye vikhyāte jagatītale śvetākhyaṃ mādhavaṃ devaṃ kas taṃ sthāpitavān purā
verses.translation: The Pancatlrthi (a set of five holy centres and sacred waters) is as follows:—The eddy named after Markandeya, the holy banyan tree, the shrine of Kfsna, the shrine of Bala- rama and the great Indradyumnasaras (Lake of Indra- dyumna).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अभूत् कृतयुगे विप्राः श्वेतो नाम नृपो बली मतिमान् धर्मविच् छूरः सत्यसंधो दृढव्रतः
verses.transliteration: abhūt kṛtayuge viprāḥ śveto nāma nṛpo balī matimān dharmavic chūraḥ satyasaṃdho dṛḍhavrataḥ
verses.translation: One should visit the Tlrtfiaraja (king of holy centres, the holy Banyan tree) on the full moon day in the month of Jyestha. If the constellation Jyestha coincides with it, it is especially auspicious.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्य राज्ये तु वर्षाणां सहस्रं दश मानवाः भवन्त्य् आयुष्मन्तो लोका बालस् तस्मिन् न सीदति
verses.transliteration: yasya rājye tu varṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ daśa mānavāḥ bhavanty āyuṣmanto lokā bālas tasmin na sīdati
verses.translation: O brahmins, I shall mention its names and size, in the Yugas Krta, etc, in due order.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वर्तमाने तदा राज्ये किंचित् काले गते द्विजाः कपालगौतमो नाम ऋषिः परमधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: vartamāne tadā rājye kiṃcit kāle gate dvijāḥ kapālagautamo nāma ṛṣiḥ paramadhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: The names of the banyan tree in the Kjtayuga etc are respectively.—1) Vata, (2). Vatesvara, (3) Purusa and (4) Puranapurusa, O brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुतो ऽस्याजातदन्तश् च मृतः कालवशाद् द्विजाः तम् आदाय ऋषिर् धीमान् नृपस्यान्तिकम् आनयत्
verses.transliteration: suto 'syājātadantaś ca mṛtaḥ kālavaśād dvijāḥ tam ādāya ṛṣir dhīmān nṛpasyāntikam ānayat
verses.translation: The sizes of the Kalpa tree in the four Yugas are 1) one Yojana 2) three fourths of a Yojana (3) half a Yojana and 4) onefourth of a Yojana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वैवं नृपतिः सुप्तं कुमारं गतचेतसम् प्रतिज्ञाम् अकरोद् विप्रा जीवनार्थं शिशोस् तदा
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvaivaṃ nṛpatiḥ suptaṃ kumāraṃ gatacetasam pratijñām akarod viprā jīvanārthaṃ śiśos tadā
verses.translation: After bowing to the banyan tree repeating the mantra mentioned before, the devotee shall go to the South to a distance of three hundred bow's lengths.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यावद् बालम् अहं त्व् एनं यमस्य सदने गतम् नानये सप्तरात्रेण चितां दीप्तां समारुहे
verses.transliteration: yāvad bālam ahaṃ tv enaṃ yamasya sadane gatam nānaye saptarātreṇa citāṃ dīptāṃ samāruhe
verses.translation: By bowing to him and then by worshipping him, the devotee is liberated from all ailments, sins, evils and things of other sorts.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वासितैः पद्मैः शतैर् दशशतादिकैः संपूज्य च महादेवं राजा विद्यां पुनर् जपेत्
verses.transliteration: evam uktvāsitaiḥ padmaiḥ śatair daśaśatādikaiḥ saṃpūjya ca mahādevaṃ rājā vidyāṃ punar japet
verses.translation: The waters are glorified as Naras because they are the sons ofNara (human beings). At the outset the waters had been the abode of Visnu. Hence, he is known as Narayana (having Nara (waters) for abode.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अतिभक्तिं तु संचिन्त्य नृपस्य जगदीश्वरः सांनिध्यम् अगमत् तुष्टो श्मीत्य् उवाच सहोमया
verses.transliteration: atibhaktiṃ tu saṃcintya nṛpasya jagadīśvaraḥ sāṃnidhyam agamat tuṣṭo śmīty uvāca sahomayā
verses.translation: Particularly at the time of bath the pure devotee shall worship and remember Narayana in the water. He shall meditate on him and perform the Nyasa rite in the (fingers of hand and (the limbs of) body.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वैवं गिरम् ईशस्य विलोक्य सहसा हरम् भस्मदिग्धं विरूपाक्षं शरत्कुन्देन्दुवर्चसम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvaivaṃ giram īśasya vilokya sahasā haram bhasmadigdhaṃ virūpākṣaṃ śaratkundenduvarcasam
verses.translation: I am lord Narayana who holds the conch, discus and club. After meditating on the Self he should repeat this mantra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शार्दूलचर्मवसनं शशाङ्काङ्कितमूर्धजम् महीं निपत्य सहसा प्रणम्य स तदाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: śārdūlacarmavasanaṃ śaśāṅkāṅkitamūrdhajam mahīṃ nipatya sahasā praṇamya sa tadābravīt
verses.translation: After performing the rites of ablution and cleansing by means of the Mantras with the water as their divinity, the devotee shall thereafter repeat the Aghamarsana Mantra three times (all the while) standing within water.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कारुण्यं यदि मे दृष्ट्वा प्रसन्नो ऽसि प्रभो यदि कालस्य वशम् आपन्नो बालको द्विजपुत्रकः
verses.transliteration: kāruṇyaṃ yadi me dṛṣṭvā prasanno 'si prabho yadi kālasya vaśam āpanno bālako dvijaputrakaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, just as the horse-sacrifice removes sins so also does the hymn Aghamarsana 1 remove all sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जीवत्व् एष पुनर् बाल इत्य् एवं व्रतम् आहितम् अकस्माच् च मृतं बालं नियम्य भगवन् स्वयम् यथोक्तायुष्यसंयुक्तं क्षेमं कुरु महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: jīvatv eṣa punar bāla ity evaṃ vratam āhitam akasmāc ca mṛtaṃ bālaṃ niyamya bhagavan svayam yathoktāyuṣyasaṃyuktaṃ kṣemaṃ kuru maheśvara
verses.translation: After circumambulating the sungod and bowing down to him he should sit facing the east and perform the rite of (ve ic study, then he should perform Tarpana rites to the Gods and sages.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतस्यैतद् वचः श्रुत्वा मुदं प्राप हरस् तदा कालम् आज्ञापयाम् आस सर्वभूतभयंकरम्
verses.transliteration: śvetasyaitad vacaḥ śrutvā mudaṃ prāpa haras tadā kālam ājñāpayām āsa sarvabhūtabhayaṃkaram
verses.translation: He s hould perform Tarpana rites for sages, manes and ot lers. He the knower of Mantras, should perform Tarpana
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नियम्य कालं दुर्धर्षं यमस्याज्ञाकरं द्विजाः बालं संजीवयाम् आस मृत्योर् मुखगतं पुनः
verses.transliteration: niyamya kālaṃ durdharṣaṃ yamasyājñākaraṃ dvijāḥ bālaṃ saṃjīvayām āsa mṛtyor mukhagataṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: Aghamar$apa mantra: RV.X.190.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा क्षेमं जगत् सर्वं मुनेः पुत्रं स तं द्विजाः देव्या सहोमया देवस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā kṣemaṃ jagat sarvaṃ muneḥ putraṃ sa taṃ dvijāḥ devyā sahomayā devas tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: The brahmin shall be authorized in the Tarpana rite
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं संजीवयाम् आस मुनेः पुत्रं नृपोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃjīvayām āsa muneḥ putraṃ nṛpottamaḥ
verses.translation: At the time ofSraddha, when the ball office is offered, the devotee shall offer it with a single hand. When performing the rite of Tarpana he shall use both hands. This is the pro¬ cedure to be followed always.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवदेव जगन्नाथ त्रैलोक्यप्रभवाव्यय ब्रूहि नः परमं तथ्यं श्वेताख्यस्य च सांप्रतम्
verses.transliteration: devadeva jagannātha trailokyaprabhavāvyaya brūhi naḥ paramaṃ tathyaṃ śvetākhyasya ca sāṃpratam
verses.translation: After repeating the name and Gotra (Spiritual line¬ age) he shall say 'Trpyatam' (may be pleased). Otherwise he should not utter anything. The left-hand should be joined to the right hand (and thus the libation should be offered.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं मुनिशार्दूलाः सर्वसत्त्वहितावहम् प्रवक्ष्यामि यथातथ्यं यत् पृच्छथ ममानघाः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ sarvasattvahitāvaham pravakṣyāmi yathātathyaṃ yat pṛcchatha mamānaghāḥ
verses.translation: If out of delusion the devotee performs the rite of Tar¬ pana with the gingclly seeds kept on any of his limbs, it would be as though he had performed the rites of Tarpana to the forefathers by means of skin, flesh, blood and bone.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: माधवस्य च माहात्म्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् यच् छ्रुत्वाभिमतान् कामान् ध्रुवं प्राप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: mādhavasya ca māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam yac chrutvābhimatān kāmān dhruvaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: One should notperform the rite of Tarpana to the deities and Pitrs with the gingclly seeds kept on any of the limbs. That water will turn into blood and he who offers it shall be sinful.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतवान् ऋषिभिः पूर्वं माधवाख्यस्य भो द्विजाः शृणुध्वं तां कथां दिव्यां भयशोकार्तिनाशिनीम्
verses.transliteration: śrutavān ṛṣibhiḥ pūrvaṃ mādhavākhyasya bho dvijāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ tāṃ kathāṃ divyāṃ bhayaśokārtināśinīm
verses.translation: O leading sages, if the person who offers libation stands in water and if the libation is offered on the dry ground, that offering is made futile. It does not benefit anyone.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स कृत्वा राज्यम् एकाग्र्यं वर्षाणां च सहस्रशः विचार्य लौकिकान् धर्मान् वैदिकान् नियमांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: sa kṛtvā rājyam ekāgryaṃ varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraśaḥ vicārya laukikān dharmān vaidikān niyamāṃs tathā
verses.translation: If the man stands on the ground and offers libation into the water, that water libation does not approach the manes. It turns futile.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: केशवाराधने विप्रा निश्चितं व्रतम् आस्थितः स गत्वा परमं क्षेत्रं सागरं दक्षिणाश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: keśavārādhane viprā niścitaṃ vratam āsthitaḥ sa gatvā paramaṃ kṣetraṃ sāgaraṃ dakṣiṇāśrayam
verses.translation: One should not stand in water and offer water libation to the manes. He should come out and perform water libation on a pure spot.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तटे तस्मिञ् शुभे रम्ये देशे कृष्णस्य चान्तिके श्वेतो ऽथ कारयाम् आस प्रासादं शुभलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: taṭe tasmiñ śubhe ramye deśe kṛṣṇasya cāntike śveto 'tha kārayām āsa prāsādaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: One should not stand in water and offer water libation to the manes. He should come out and perform water libation on a pure spot.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धन्वन्तरशतं चैकं देवदेवस्य दक्षिणे ततः श्वेतेन विप्रेन्द्राः श्वेतशैलमयेन च
verses.transliteration: dhanvantaraśataṃ caikaṃ devadevasya dakṣiṇe tataḥ śvetena viprendrāḥ śvetaśailamayena ca
verses.translation: One should not stand in water and offer water libation to the manes. He should come out and perform water libation on a pure spot.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गीयमानश् च मधुरं सिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितः भुनक्ति विपुलान् भोगान् यथेष्टं मामकैः सह
verses.transliteration: gīyamānaś ca madhuraṃ siddhagandharvasevitaḥ bhunakti vipulān bhogān yatheṣṭaṃ māmakaiḥ saha
verses.translation: One should not stand in water and offer water libation to the manes. He should come out and perform water libation on a pure spot.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: च्युतस् तस्माद् इहागत्य मनुष्यो ब्राह्मणो भवेत् वेदवेदाङ्गविच् छ्रीमान् भोगवांश् चिरजीवितः
verses.transliteration: cyutas tasmād ihāgatya manuṣyo brāhmaṇo bhavet vedavedāṅgavic chrīmān bhogavāṃś cirajīvitaḥ
verses.translation: One should not stand in water and offer water libation to the manes. He should come out and perform water libation on a pure spot.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गजाश्वरथयानाढ्यो धनधान्यावृतः शुचिः रूपवान् बहुभाग्यश् च पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: gajāśvarathayānāḍhyo dhanadhānyāvṛtaḥ śuciḥ rūpavān bahubhāgyaś ca putrapautrasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: One should not stand in water and offer water libation to the manes. He should come out and perform water libation on a pure spot.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषोत्तमं पुनः प्राप्य वटमूले ऽथ सागरे त्यक्त्वा देहं हरिं स्मृत्वा ततः शान्तपदं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: puruṣottamaṃ punaḥ prāpya vaṭamūle 'tha sāgare tyaktvā dehaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā tataḥ śāntapadaṃ vrajet
verses.translation: One should not stand in water and offer water libation to the manes. He should come out and perform water libation on a pure spot.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतमाधवम् आलोक्य समीपे मत्स्यमाधवम् एकार्णवजले पूर्वं रोहितं रूपम् आस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: śvetamādhavam ālokya samīpe matsyamādhavam ekārṇavajale pūrvaṃ rohitaṃ rūpam āsthitam
verses.translation: After drawing the mystic diagram O brahmins, the devotee should worship Narayana, the unborn lord by means of injunctions in regard to the eight syllabled Mantra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वेदानां हरणार्थाय रसातलतले स्थितम् चिन्तयित्वा क्षितिं सम्यक् तस्मिन् स्थाने प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: vedānāṃ haraṇārthāya rasātalatale sthitam cintayitvā kṣitiṃ samyak tasmin sthāne pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: Then he should perform the Nyasa rite with the eight- syllabled Mantra. He shall begin with the left foot and fix in due order.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आद्यावतरणं रूपं माधवं मत्स्यरूपिणम् प्रणम्य प्रणतो भूत्वा सर्वदुःखाद् विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ādyāvataraṇaṃ rūpaṃ mādhavaṃ matsyarūpiṇam praṇamya praṇato bhūtvā sarvaduḥkhād vimucyate
verses.translation: The aspirant should perform the following rites with the basic Mantra viz. the five limbs belonging to lord Visnu;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रयाति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो हरिः स्वयम् काले पुनर् इहायातो राजा स्यात् पृथिवीतले
verses.transliteration: prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo hariḥ svayam kāle punar ihāyāto rājā syāt pṛthivītale
verses.translation: Om obeisance to Visnu—thus the head. Om obeisance tojvalana (the fiery blaze)—thus the tuft. Om obeisance to Visnu—thus the coat of mail. Om obeisance to Visnu—thus the throbbing for the binding of quarters. Om Hum phat—thus the miraculous weapon. Om Vasudeva is white—in the head thus. Om Am Sarikarsana is red—in the forehead. Garuda is the fire, the luminary sun thus. Aril Pradyumna is yellow—in the neck. He is the wind and cloud. Orh ArhAniruddha is black—in the heart. He is endowed with all power. Thus protected by four arrays the devotee shall start reciting Kavaca.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वत्समाधवम् आसाद्य दुराधर्षो भवेन् नरः दाता भोक्ता भवेद् यज्वा वैष्णवः सत्यसंगरः
verses.transliteration: vatsamādhavam āsādya durādharṣo bhaven naraḥ dātā bhoktā bhaved yajvā vaiṣṇavaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ
verses.translation: He should perform the worship of eternal lord by the twelve-syllabled Mantra; thereafter he should fix it up in the pericarp, at the outside, after retaining it in the heart.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: योगं प्राप्य हरेः पश्चात् ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात् मत्स्यमाधवमाहात्म्यं मया संपरिकीर्तितम् यं दृष्ट्वा मुनिशार्दूलाः सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: yogaṃ prāpya hareḥ paścāt tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt matsyamādhavamāhātmyaṃ mayā saṃparikīrtitam yaṃ dṛṣṭvā muniśārdūlāḥ sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: He should meditate upon the eternal lord with four arms and possessed of great strength. He should think upon the lord with lustre of a crore suns. He should invoke the lord after duly thinking about him in his mind.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भगवञ् श्रोतुम् इच्छामो मार्जनं वरुणालये क्रियते स्नानदानादि तस्याशेषफलं वद
verses.transliteration: bhagavañ śrotum icchāmo mārjanaṃ varuṇālaye kriyate snānadānādi tasyāśeṣaphalaṃ vada
verses.translation: (The invocation is as follows):—
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं मुनिशार्दूला मार्जनस्य यथाविधि भक्त्या तु तन्मना भूत्वा संप्राप्य पुण्यम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlā mārjanasya yathāvidhi bhaktyā tu tanmanā bhūtvā saṃprāpya puṇyam uttamam
verses.translation: Om the water offering for washing the wet. O Eternal Padmanabha, O Lord, the water is offered at your feet. O Visnu, with eyes like the petals of a lotus, O Madhusudana, please accept it. Om namo Narayanaya (Obeisance to Narayana)—thus the Padya.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयह्रदे स्नानं पूर्वकाले प्रशस्यते चतुर्दश्यां विशेषेण सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyahrade snānaṃ pūrvakāle praśasyate caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: Madhuparka: a mixture ofhoney, curd and butter offered to the guest or the bridegroom on the wedding ceremony.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद्वत् स्नानं समुद्रस्य सर्वकालं प्रशस्यते पौर्णमास्यां विशेषेण हयमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: tadvat snānaṃ samudrasya sarvakālaṃ praśasyate paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Ornaments are offered as follows:—
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयं वटं कृष्णं रौहिणेयं महोदधिम् इन्द्रद्युम्नसरश् चैव पञ्चतीर्थीविधिः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyaṃ vaṭaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rauhiṇeyaṃ mahodadhim indradyumnasaraś caiva pañcatīrthīvidhiḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: He who observes Janardana who in accordance with this injunction is worshipped in the mystic diagram, shall enter the eternal Vi$nu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णिमा ज्येष्ठमासस्य ज्येष्ठा ऋक्षं यदा भवेत् तदा गच्छेद् विशेषेण तीर्थराजं परं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: pūrṇimā jyeṣṭhamāsasya jyeṣṭhā ṛkṣaṃ yadā bhavet tadā gacched viśeṣeṇa tīrtharājaṃ paraṃ śubham
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कायवाङ्मानसैः शुद्धस् तद्भावो नान्यमानसः सर्वद्वंद्वविनिर्मुक्तो वीतरागो विमत्सरः
verses.transliteration: kāyavāṅmānasaiḥ śuddhas tadbhāvo nānyamānasaḥ sarvadvaṃdvavinirmukto vītarāgo vimatsaraḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कल्पवृक्षवटं रम्यं तत्र स्नात्वा जनार्दनम् प्रदक्षिणं प्रकुर्वीत त्रिवारं सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: kalpavṛkṣavaṭaṃ ramyaṃ tatra snātvā janārdanam pradakṣiṇaṃ prakurvīta trivāraṃ susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यं दृष्ट्वा मुच्यते पापात् सप्तजन्मसमुद्भवात् पुण्यं चाप्नोति विपुलं गतिम् इष्टां च भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate pāpāt saptajanmasamudbhavāt puṇyaṃ cāpnoti vipulaṃ gatim iṣṭāṃ ca bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य नामानि वक्ष्यामि प्रमाणं च युगे युगे यथासंख्यं च भो विप्राः कृतादिषु यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tasya nāmāni vakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ ca yuge yuge yathāsaṃkhyaṃ ca bho viprāḥ kṛtādiṣu yathākramam
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वटं वटेश्वरं कृष्णं पुराणपुरुषं द्विजाः वटस्यैतानि नामानि कीर्तितानि कृतादिषु
verses.transliteration: vaṭaṃ vaṭeśvaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ purāṇapuruṣaṃ dvijāḥ vaṭasyaitāni nāmāni kīrtitāni kṛtādiṣu
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: योजनं पादहीनं च योजनार्धं तदर्धकम् प्रमाणं कल्पवृक्षस्य कृतादौ परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: yojanaṃ pādahīnaṃ ca yojanārdhaṃ tadardhakam pramāṇaṃ kalpavṛkṣasya kṛtādau parikīrtitam
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथोक्तेन तु मन्त्रेण नमस्कृत्वा तु तं वटम् दक्षिणाभिमुखो गच्छेद् धन्वन्तरशतत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: yathoktena tu mantreṇa namaskṛtvā tu taṃ vaṭam dakṣiṇābhimukho gacched dhanvantaraśatatrayam
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्रासौ दृश्यते विष्णुः स्वर्गद्वारं मनोरमम् सागराम्भःसमाकृष्टं काष्ठं सर्वगुणान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: yatrāsau dṛśyate viṣṇuḥ svargadvāraṃ manoramam sāgarāmbhaḥsamākṛṣṭaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रणिपत्य ततस् तं भोः परिपूज्य ततः पुनः मुच्यते सर्वरोगाद्यैस् तथा पापैर् ग्रहादिभिः
verses.transliteration: praṇipatya tatas taṃ bhoḥ paripūjya tataḥ punaḥ mucyate sarvarogādyais tathā pāpair grahādibhiḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उग्रसेनं पुरा दृष्ट्वा स्वर्गद्वारेण सागरम् गत्वाचम्य शुचिस् तत्र ध्यात्वा नारायणं परम्
verses.transliteration: ugrasenaṃ purā dṛṣṭvā svargadvāreṇa sāgaram gatvācamya śucis tatra dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ param
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न्यसेद् अष्टाक्षरं मन्त्रं पश्चाद् धस्तशरीरयोः ॐ नमो नारायणायेति यं वदन्ति मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: nyased aṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ paścād dhastaśarīrayoḥ oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti yaṃ vadanti manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं कार्यं बहुभिर् मन्त्रैर् मनोविभ्रमकारकैः ॐ नमो नारायणायेति मन्त्रः सर्वार्थसाधकः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kāryaṃ bahubhir mantrair manovibhramakārakaiḥ oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आपो नरस्य सूनुत्वान् नारा इतीह कीर्तिताः विष्णोस् तास् त्व् अयनं पूर्वं तेन नारायणः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: āpo narasya sūnutvān nārā itīha kīrtitāḥ viṣṇos tās tv ayanaṃ pūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नारायणपरा वेदा नारायणपरा द्विजाः नारायणपरा यज्ञा नारायणपराः क्रियाः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaparā vedā nārāyaṇaparā dvijāḥ nārāyaṇaparā yajñā nārāyaṇaparāḥ kriyāḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नारायणपरा पृथ्वी नारायणपरं जलम् नारायणपरो वह्निर् नारायणपरं नभः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaparā pṛthvī nārāyaṇaparaṃ jalam nārāyaṇaparo vahnir nārāyaṇaparaṃ nabhaḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नारायणपरो वायुर् नारायणपरं मनः अहंकारश् च बुद्धिश् च उभे नारायणात्मके
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaparo vāyur nārāyaṇaparaṃ manaḥ ahaṃkāraś ca buddhiś ca ubhe nārāyaṇātmake
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च यत् किंचिज् जीवसंज्ञितम् स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं परं चैव सर्वं नारायणात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca yat kiṃcij jīvasaṃjñitam sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ caiva sarvaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शब्दाद्या विषयाः सर्वे श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाणि च प्रकृतिः पुरुषश् चैव सर्वे नारायणात्मकाः
verses.transliteration: śabdādyā viṣayāḥ sarve śrotrādīnīndriyāṇi ca prakṛtiḥ puruṣaś caiva sarve nārāyaṇātmakāḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जले स्थले च पाताले स्वर्गलोके ऽम्बरे नगे अवष्टभ्य इदं सर्वम् आस्ते नारायणः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: jale sthale ca pātāle svargaloke 'mbare nage avaṣṭabhya idaṃ sarvam āste nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं चात्र बहुनोक्तेन जगद् एतच् चराचरम् ब्रह्मादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तं सर्वं नारायणात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ cātra bahunoktena jagad etac carācaram brahmādistambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नारायणात् परं किंचिन् नेह पश्यामि भो द्विजाः तेन व्याप्तम् इदं सर्वं दृश्यादृश्यं चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇāt paraṃ kiṃcin neha paśyāmi bho dvijāḥ tena vyāptam idaṃ sarvaṃ dṛśyādṛśyaṃ carācaram
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आपो ह्य् आयतनं विष्णोः स च एवाम्भसां पतिः तस्माद् अप्सु स्मरेन् नित्यं नारायणम् अघापहम्
verses.transliteration: āpo hy āyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ sa ca evāmbhasāṃ patiḥ tasmād apsu smaren nityaṃ nārāyaṇam aghāpaham
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नानकाले विशेषेण चोपस्थाय जले शुचिः स्मरेन् नारायणं ध्यायेद् धस्ते काये च विन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: snānakāle viśeṣeṇa copasthāya jale śuciḥ smaren nārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyed dhaste kāye ca vinyaset
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ॐकारं च नकारं च अङ्गुष्ठे हस्तयोर् न्यसेत् शेषैर् हस्ततलं यावत् तर्जन्यादिषु विन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: oṃkāraṃ ca nakāraṃ ca aṅguṣṭhe hastayor nyaset śeṣair hastatalaṃ yāvat tarjanyādiṣu vinyaset
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ॐकारं वामपादे तु नकारं दक्षिणे न्यसेत् मोकारं वामकट्यां तु नाकारं दक्षिणे न्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: oṃkāraṃ vāmapāde tu nakāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset mokāraṃ vāmakaṭyāṃ tu nākāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राकारं नाभिदेशे तु यकारं वामबाहुके णाकारं दक्षिणे न्यस्य यकारं मूर्ध्नि विन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: rākāraṃ nābhideśe tu yakāraṃ vāmabāhuke ṇākāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyasya yakāraṃ mūrdhni vinyaset
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अधश् चोर्ध्वं च हृदये पार्श्वतः पृष्ठतो ऽग्रतः ध्यात्वा नारायणं पश्चाद् आरभेत् कवचं बुधः
verses.transliteration: adhaś cordhvaṃ ca hṛdaye pārśvataḥ pṛṣṭhato 'grataḥ dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ paścād ārabhet kavacaṃ budhaḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वे मां पातु गोविन्दो दक्षिणे मधुसूदनः पश्चिमे श्रीधरो देवः केशवस् तु तथोत्तरे
verses.transliteration: pūrve māṃ pātu govindo dakṣiṇe madhusūdanaḥ paścime śrīdharo devaḥ keśavas tu tathottare
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पातु विष्णुस् तथाग्नेये नैरृते माधवो ऽव्ययः वायव्ये तु हृषीकेशस् तथेशाने च वामनः
verses.transliteration: pātu viṣṇus tathāgneye nairṛte mādhavo 'vyayaḥ vāyavye tu hṛṣīkeśas tatheśāne ca vāmanaḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भूतले पातु वाराहस् तथोर्ध्वं च त्रिविक्रमः कृत्वैवं कवचं पश्चाद् आत्मानं चिन्तयेत् ततः
verses.transliteration: bhūtale pātu vārāhas tathordhvaṃ ca trivikramaḥ kṛtvaivaṃ kavacaṃ paścād ātmānaṃ cintayet tataḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहं नारायणो देवः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः एवं ध्यात्वा तदात्मानम् इमं मन्त्रम् उदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ nārāyaṇo devaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ evaṃ dhyātvā tadātmānam imaṃ mantram udīrayet
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वम् अग्निर् द्विपदां नाथ रेतोधाः कामदीपनः प्रधानः सर्वभूतानां जीवानां प्रभुर् अव्ययः
verses.transliteration: tvam agnir dvipadāṃ nātha retodhāḥ kāmadīpanaḥ pradhānaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jīvānāṃ prabhur avyayaḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अमृतस्यारणिस् त्वं हि देवयोनिर् अपां पते वृजिनं हर मे सर्वं तीर्थराज नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: amṛtasyāraṇis tvaṃ hi devayonir apāṃ pate vṛjinaṃ hara me sarvaṃ tīrtharāja namo 'stu te
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उच्चार्य विधिवत् ततः स्नानं समाचरेत् अन्यथा भो द्विजश्रेष्ठाः स्नानं तत्र न शस्यते
verses.transliteration: evam uccārya vidhivat tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret anyathā bho dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ snānaṃ tatra na śasyate
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा तु वैदिकैर् मन्त्रैर् अभिषेकं च मार्जनम् अन्तर् जले जपेत् पश्चात् त्रिर् आवृत्त्याघमर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā tu vaidikair mantrair abhiṣekaṃ ca mārjanam antar jale japet paścāt trir āvṛttyāghamarṣaṇam
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हयमेधो यथा विप्राः सर्वपापहरः क्रतुः तथाघमर्षणं चात्र सूक्तं सर्वाघनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: hayamedho yathā viprāḥ sarvapāpaharaḥ kratuḥ tathāghamarṣaṇaṃ cātra sūktaṃ sarvāghanāśanam
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्तीर्य वाससी धौते निर्मले परिधाय वै प्राणान् आयम्य चाचम्य संध्यां चोपास्य भास्करम्
verses.transliteration: uttīrya vāsasī dhaute nirmale paridhāya vai prāṇān āyamya cācamya saṃdhyāṃ copāsya bhāskaram
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपतिष्ठेत् ततश् चोर्ध्वं क्षिप्त्वा पुष्पजलाञ्जलिम् उपस्थायोर्ध्वबाहुश् च तल्लिङ्गैर् भास्करं ततः
verses.transliteration: upatiṣṭhet tataś cordhvaṃ kṣiptvā puṣpajalāñjalim upasthāyordhvabāhuś ca talliṅgair bhāskaraṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रीं पावनीं देवीं जपेद् अष्टोत्तरं शतम् अन्यांश् च सौरमन्त्रांश् च जप्त्वा तिष्ठन् समाहितः
verses.transliteration: gāyatrīṃ pāvanīṃ devīṃ japed aṣṭottaraṃ śatam anyāṃś ca sauramantrāṃś ca japtvā tiṣṭhan samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं सूर्यं नमस्कृत्योपविश्य च स्वाध्यायं प्राङ्मुखः कृत्वा तर्पयेद् दैवतान्य् ऋषीन्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ sūryaṃ namaskṛtyopaviśya ca svādhyāyaṃ prāṅmukhaḥ kṛtvā tarpayed daivatāny ṛṣīn
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्यांश् च पितॄंश् चान्यान् नामगोत्रेण मन्त्रवित् तोयेन तिलमिश्रेण विधिवत् सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: manuṣyāṃś ca pitṝṃś cānyān nāmagotreṇa mantravit toyena tilamiśreṇa vidhivat susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तर्पणं देवतानां च पूर्वं कृत्वा समाहितः अधिकारी भवेत् पश्चात् पितॄणां तर्पणे द्विजः
verses.transliteration: tarpaṇaṃ devatānāṃ ca pūrvaṃ kṛtvā samāhitaḥ adhikārī bhavet paścāt pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇe dvijaḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धे हवनकाले च पाणिनैकेन निर्वपेत् तर्पणे तूभयं कुर्याद् एष एव विधिः सदा
verses.transliteration: śrāddhe havanakāle ca pāṇinaikena nirvapet tarpaṇe tūbhayaṃ kuryād eṣa eva vidhiḥ sadā
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्वारब्धेन सव्येन पाणिना दक्षिणेन तु तृप्यताम् इति सिञ्चेत् तु नामगोत्रेण वाग्यतः
verses.transliteration: anvārabdhena savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu tṛpyatām iti siñcet tu nāmagotreṇa vāgyataḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कायस्थैर् यस् तिलैर् मोहात् करोति पितृतर्पणम् तर्पितास् तेन पितरस् त्वङ्मांसरुधिरास्थिभिः
verses.transliteration: kāyasthair yas tilair mohāt karoti pitṛtarpaṇam tarpitās tena pitaras tvaṅmāṃsarudhirāsthibhiḥ
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गस्थैर् न तिलैः कुर्याद् देवतापितृतर्पणम् रुधिरं तद् भवेत् तोयं प्रदाता किल्बिषी भवेत्
verses.transliteration: aṅgasthair na tilaiḥ kuryād devatāpitṛtarpaṇam rudhiraṃ tad bhavet toyaṃ pradātā kilbiṣī bhavet
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भूम्यां यद् दीयते तोयं दाता चैव जले स्थितः वृथा तन् मुनिशार्दूला नोपतिष्ठति कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: bhūmyāṃ yad dīyate toyaṃ dātā caiva jale sthitaḥ vṛthā tan muniśārdūlā nopatiṣṭhati kasyacit
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्थले स्थित्वा जले यस् तु प्रयच्छेद् उदकं नरः पितॄणां नोपतिष्ठेत सलिलं तन् निरर्थकम्
verses.transliteration: sthale sthitvā jale yas tu prayacched udakaṃ naraḥ pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭheta salilaṃ tan nirarthakam
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उदके नोदकं कुर्यात् पितृभ्यश् च कदाचन उत्तीर्य तु शुचौ देशे कुर्याद् उदकतर्पणम्
verses.transliteration: udake nodakaṃ kuryāt pitṛbhyaś ca kadācana uttīrya tu śucau deśe kuryād udakatarpaṇam
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नोदकेषु न पात्रेषु न क्रुद्धो नैकपाणिना नोपतिष्ठति तत् तोयं यद् भूम्यां न प्रदीयते
verses.transliteration: nodakeṣu na pātreṣu na kruddho naikapāṇinā nopatiṣṭhati tat toyaṃ yad bhūmyāṃ na pradīyate
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पितॄणाम् अक्षयं स्थानं मही दत्ता मया द्विजाः तस्मात् तत्रैव दातव्यं पितॄणां प्रीतिम् इच्छता
verses.transliteration: pitṝṇām akṣayaṃ sthānaṃ mahī dattā mayā dvijāḥ tasmāt tatraiva dātavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītim icchatā
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भूमिपृष्ठे समुत्पन्ना भूम्यां चैव च संस्थिताः भूम्यां चैव लयं याता भूमौ दद्यात् ततो जलम्
verses.transliteration: bhūmipṛṣṭhe samutpannā bhūmyāṃ caiva ca saṃsthitāḥ bhūmyāṃ caiva layaṃ yātā bhūmau dadyāt tato jalam
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आस्तीर्य च कुशान् साग्रांस् तान् आवाह्य स्वमन्त्रतः प्राचीनाग्रेषु वै देवान् याम्याग्रेषु तथा पितॄन्
verses.transliteration: āstīrya ca kuśān sāgrāṃs tān āvāhya svamantrataḥ prācīnāgreṣu vai devān yāmyāgreṣu tathā pitṝn
verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवान् पितॄंस् तथा चान्यान् संतर्प्याचम्य वाग्यतः हस्तमात्रं चतुष्कोणं चतुर्द्वारं सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: devān pitṝṃs tathā cānyān saṃtarpyācamya vāgyataḥ hastamātraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ caturdvāraṃ suśobhanam
verses.translation: After duly and devoutly worshipping the lord thus, the devotee should bend his head thereafter and propitiate the ocean.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरं विलिख्य भो विप्रास् तीरे तस्य महोदधेः मध्ये तत्र लिखेत् पद्मम् अष्टपत्त्रं सकर्णिकम्
verses.transliteration: puraṃ vilikhya bho viprās tīre tasya mahodadheḥ madhye tatra likhet padmam aṣṭapattraṃ sakarṇikam
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं मण्डलम् आलिख्य पूजयेत् तत्र भो द्विजाः अष्टाक्षरविधानेन नारायणम् अजं विभुम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ maṇḍalam ālikhya pūjayet tatra bho dvijāḥ aṣṭākṣaravidhānena nārāyaṇam ajaṃ vibhum
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि कायशोधनम् उत्तमम् अकारं हृदये ध्यात्वा चक्ररेखासमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kāyaśodhanam uttamam akāraṃ hṛdaye dhyātvā cakrarekhāsamanvitam
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलन्तं त्रिशिखं चैव दहन्तं पापनाशनम् चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यस्थं राकारं मूर्ध्नि चिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: jvalantaṃ triśikhaṃ caiva dahantaṃ pāpanāśanam candramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rākāraṃ mūrdhni cintayet
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लवर्णं प्रवर्षन्तम् अमृतं प्लावयन् महीम् एवं निर्धूतपापस् तु दिव्यदेहस् ततो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: śuklavarṇaṃ pravarṣantam amṛtaṃ plāvayan mahīm evaṃ nirdhūtapāpas tu divyadehas tato bhavet
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाक्षरं ततो मन्त्रं न्यसेद् एवात्मनो बुधः वामपादं समारभ्य क्रमशश् चैव विन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭākṣaraṃ tato mantraṃ nyased evātmano budhaḥ vāmapādaṃ samārabhya kramaśaś caiva vinyaset
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाङ्गं वैष्णवं चैव चतुर्व्यूहं तथैव च करशुद्धिं प्रकुर्वीत मूलमन्त्रेण साधकः
verses.transliteration: pañcāṅgaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ caiva caturvyūhaṃ tathaiva ca karaśuddhiṃ prakurvīta mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकैकं चैव वर्णं तु अङ्गुलीषु पृथक् पृथक् ॐकारं पृथिवीं शुक्लां वामपादे तु विन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: ekaikaṃ caiva varṇaṃ tu aṅgulīṣu pṛthak pṛthak oṃkāraṃ pṛthivīṃ śuklāṃ vāmapāde tu vinyaset
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नकारः शांभवः श्यामो दक्षिणे तु व्यवस्थितः मोकारं कालम् एवाहुर् वामकट्यां निधापयेत्
verses.transliteration: nakāraḥ śāṃbhavaḥ śyāmo dakṣiṇe tu vyavasthitaḥ mokāraṃ kālam evāhur vāmakaṭyāṃ nidhāpayet
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नाकारः सर्वबीजं तु दक्षिणस्यां व्यवस्थितः राकारस् तेज इत्य् आहुर् नाभिदेशे व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: nākāraḥ sarvabījaṃ tu dakṣiṇasyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ rākāras teja ity āhur nābhideśe vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वायव्यो ऽयं यकारस् तु वामस्कन्धे समाश्रितः णाकारः सर्वगो ज्ञेयो दक्षिणांसे व्यवस्थितः यकारो ऽयं शिरस्थश् च यत्र लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: vāyavyo 'yaṃ yakāras tu vāmaskandhe samāśritaḥ ṇākāraḥ sarvago jñeyo dakṣiṇāṃse vyavasthitaḥ yakāro 'yaṃ śirasthaś ca yatra lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ॐ विष्णवे नमः शिरः ॐ ज्वलनाय नमः शिखा । ॐ विष्णवे नमः कवचम् ॐ विष्णवे नमः स्फुरणं दिशोबन्धाय । ॐ हुंफडस्त्रम् ॐ शिरसि शुक्लो वासुदेव इति । ॐ आं ललाटे रक्तः संकर्षणो गरुत्मान् वह्निस् तेज आदित्य इति । ॐ आं ग्रीवायां पीतः प्रद्युम्नो वायुमेघ इति । ॐ आं हृदये कृष्णो ऽनिरुद्धः सर्वशक्तिसमन्वित इति । एवं चतुर्व्यूहम् आत्मानं कृत्वा ततः कर्म समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ śiraḥ oṃ jvalanāya namaḥ śikhā | oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ kavacam oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ sphuraṇaṃ diśobandhāya | oṃ huṃphaḍastram oṃ śirasi śuklo vāsudeva iti | oṃ āṃ lalāṭe raktaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo garutmān vahnis teja āditya iti | oṃ āṃ grīvāyāṃ pītaḥ pradyumno vāyumegha iti | oṃ āṃ hṛdaye kṛṣṇo 'niruddhaḥ sarvaśaktisamanvita iti | evaṃ caturvyūham ātmānaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ karma samācaret
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ममाग्रे ऽवस्थितो विष्णुः पृष्ठतश् चापि केशवः गोविन्दो दक्षिणे पार्श्वे वामे तु मधुसूदनः
verses.transliteration: mamāgre 'vasthito viṣṇuḥ pṛṣṭhataś cāpi keśavaḥ govindo dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme tu madhusūdanaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपरिष्टात् तु वैकुण्ठो वाराहः पृथिवीतले अवान्तरदिशो यास् तु तासु सर्वासु माधवः
verses.transliteration: upariṣṭāt tu vaikuṇṭho vārāhaḥ pṛthivītale avāntaradiśo yās tu tāsu sarvāsu mādhavaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छतस् तिष्ठतो वापि जाग्रतः स्वपतो ऽपि वा नरसिंहकृता गुप्तिर् वासुदेवमयो ह्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: gacchatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato 'pi vā narasiṃhakṛtā guptir vāsudevamayo hy aham
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं विष्णुमयो भूत्वा ततः कर्म समारभेत् यथा देहे तथा देवे सर्वतत्त्वानि योजयेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ viṣṇumayo bhūtvā tataḥ karma samārabhet yathā dehe tathā deve sarvatattvāni yojayet
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततश् चैव प्रकुर्वीत प्रोक्षणं प्रणवेन तु फट्कारान्तं समुद्दिष्टं सर्वविघ्नहरं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: tataś caiva prakurvīta prokṣaṇaṃ praṇavena tu phaṭkārāntaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ sarvavighnaharaṃ śubham
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रार्कचन्द्रवह्नीनां मण्डलानि विचिन्तयेत् पद्ममध्ये न्यसेद् विष्णुं पवनस्याम्बरस्य च
verses.transliteration: tatrārkacandravahnīnāṃ maṇḍalāni vicintayet padmamadhye nyased viṣṇuṃ pavanasyāmbarasya ca
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो विचिन्त्य हृदय ॐकारं ज्योतीरूपिणम् कर्णिकायां समासीनं ज्योतीरूपं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: tato vicintya hṛdaya oṃkāraṃ jyotīrūpiṇam karṇikāyāṃ samāsīnaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाक्षरं ततो मन्त्रं विन्यसेच् च यथाक्रमम् तेन व्यस्तसमस्तेन पूजनं परमं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭākṣaraṃ tato mantraṃ vinyasec ca yathākramam tena vyastasamastena pūjanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशाक्षरमन्त्रेण यजेद् देवं सनातनम् ततो ऽवधार्य हृदये कर्णिकायां बहिर् न्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa yajed devaṃ sanātanam tato 'vadhārya hṛdaye karṇikāyāṃ bahir nyaset
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भुजं महासत्त्वं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् चिन्तयित्वा महायोगं ज्योतीरूपं सनातनम् ततश् चावाहयेन् मन्त्रं क्रमेणाचिन्त्य मानसे
verses.transliteration: caturbhujaṃ mahāsattvaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham cintayitvā mahāyogaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam tataś cāvāhayen mantraṃ krameṇācintya mānase
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आवाहनमन्त्रः: मीनरूपो वराहश् च नरसिंहो ऽथ वामनः । आयातु देवो वरदो मम नारायणो ऽग्रतः ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: āvāhanamantraḥ: mīnarūpo varāhaś ca narasiṃho 'tha vāmanaḥ | āyātu devo varado mama nārāyaṇo 'grataḥ oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्थापनमन्त्रः: कर्णिकायां सुपीठे ऽत्र पद्मकल्पितम् आसनम् सर्वसत्त्वहितार्थाय तिष्ठ त्वं मधुसूदन ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: sthāpanamantraḥ: karṇikāyāṃ supīṭhe 'tra padmakalpitam āsanam sarvasattvahitārthāya tiṣṭha tvaṃ madhusūdana oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अर्घमन्त्रः: ॐ त्रैलोक्यपतीनां पतये देवदेवाय हृषीकेशाय विष्णवे नमः । ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: arghamantraḥ: oṃ trailokyapatīnāṃ pataye devadevāya hṛṣīkeśāya viṣṇave namaḥ | oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पाद्यमन्त्रः: ॐ पाद्यं पादयोर् देव पद्मनाभ सनातन विष्णो कमलपत्त्राक्ष गृहाण मधुसूदन ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: pādyamantraḥ: oṃ pādyaṃ pādayor deva padmanābha sanātana viṣṇo kamalapattrākṣa gṛhāṇa madhusūdana oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मधुपर्कमन्त्रः: मधुपर्कं महादेव ब्रह्माद्यैः कल्पितं तव मया निवेदितं भक्त्या गृहाण पुरुषोत्तम ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: madhuparkamantraḥ: madhuparkaṃ mahādeva brahmādyaiḥ kalpitaṃ tava mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā gṛhāṇa puruṣottama oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मन्दाकिन्याः सितं वारि सर्वपापहरं शिवम् गृहाणाचमनीयं त्वं मया भक्त्या निवेदितम् ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: mandākinyāḥ sitaṃ vāri sarvapāpaharaṃ śivam gṛhāṇācamanīyaṃ tvaṃ mayā bhaktyā niveditam oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वम् आपः पृथिवी चैव ज्योतिस् त्वं वायुर् एव च लोकेश वृत्तिमात्रेण वारिणा स्नापयाम्य् अहम् ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: tvam āpaḥ pṛthivī caiva jyotis tvaṃ vāyur eva ca lokeśa vṛttimātreṇa vāriṇā snāpayāmy aham oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवतत्त्वसमायुक्त यज्ञवर्णसमन्वित स्वर्णवर्णप्रभे देव वाससी तव केशव ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: devatattvasamāyukta yajñavarṇasamanvita svarṇavarṇaprabhe deva vāsasī tava keśava oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शरीरं ते न जानामि चेष्टां चैव च केशव मया निवेदितो गन्धः प्रतिगृह्य विलिप्यताम् ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: śarīraṃ te na jānāmi ceṣṭāṃ caiva ca keśava mayā nivedito gandhaḥ pratigṛhya vilipyatām oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्यजुःसाममन्त्रेण त्रिवृतं पद्मयोनिना सावित्रीग्रन्थिसंयुक्तम् उपवीतं तवार्पये ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: ṛgyajuḥsāmamantreṇa trivṛtaṃ padmayoninā sāvitrīgranthisaṃyuktam upavītaṃ tavārpaye oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यरत्नसमायुक्त वह्निभानुसमप्रभ गात्राणि तव शोभन्तु सालंकाराणि माधव ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: divyaratnasamāyukta vahnibhānusamaprabha gātrāṇi tava śobhantu sālaṃkārāṇi mādhava oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नम इति प्रत्यक्षरं समस्तेन मूलमन्त्रेण वा पूजयेत् ॥ ६१।३५ वनस्पतिरसो दिव्यो गन्धाढ्यः सुरभिश् च ते मया निवेदितो भक्त्या धूपो ऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: oṃ nama iti pratyakṣaraṃ samastena mūlamantreṇa vā pūjayet || 61.35 vanaspatiraso divyo gandhāḍhyaḥ surabhiś ca te mayā nivedito bhaktyā dhūpo 'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यचन्द्रसमो ज्योतिर् विद्युदग्न्योस् तथैव च त्वम् एव ज्योतिषां देव दीपो ऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: sūryacandrasamo jyotir vidyudagnyos tathaiva ca tvam eva jyotiṣāṃ deva dīpo 'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्नं चतुर्विधं चैव रसैः षड्भिः समन्वितम् मया निवेदितं भक्त्या नैवेद्यं तव केशव ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: annaṃ caturvidhaṃ caiva rasaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ samanvitam mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā naivedyaṃ tava keśava oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वे दले वासुदेवं याम्ये संकर्षणं न्यसेत् प्रद्युम्नं पश्चिमे कुर्याद् अनिरुद्धं तथोत्तरे
verses.transliteration: pūrve dale vāsudevaṃ yāmye saṃkarṣaṇaṃ nyaset pradyumnaṃ paścime kuryād aniruddhaṃ tathottare
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वाराहं च तथाग्नेये नरसिंहं च नैरृते वायव्ये माधवं चैव तथैशाने त्रिविक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: vārāhaṃ ca tathāgneye narasiṃhaṃ ca nairṛte vāyavye mādhavaṃ caiva tathaiśāne trivikramam
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथाष्टाक्षरदेवस्य गरुडं पुरतो न्यसेत् वामपार्श्वे तथा चक्रं शङ्खं दक्षिणतो न्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: tathāṣṭākṣaradevasya garuḍaṃ purato nyaset vāmapārśve tathā cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ dakṣiṇato nyaset
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा महागदां चैव न्यसेद् देवस्य दक्षिणे ततः शार्ङ्गं धनुर् विद्वान् न्यसेद् देवस्य वामतः
verses.transliteration: tathā mahāgadāṃ caiva nyased devasya dakṣiṇe tataḥ śārṅgaṃ dhanur vidvān nyased devasya vāmataḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणेनेषुधी दिव्ये खड्गं वामे च विन्यसेत् श्रियं दक्षिणतः स्थाप्य पुष्टिम् उत्तरतो न्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇeneṣudhī divye khaḍgaṃ vāme ca vinyaset śriyaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ sthāpya puṣṭim uttarato nyaset
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वनमालां च पुरतस् ततः श्रीवत्सकौस्तुभौ विन्यसेद् धृदयादीनि पूर्वादिषु चतुर्दिशम्
verses.transliteration: vanamālāṃ ca puratas tataḥ śrīvatsakaustubhau vinyased dhṛdayādīni pūrvādiṣu caturdiśam
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽस्त्रं देवदेवस्य कोणे चैव तु विन्यसेत् इन्द्रम् अग्निं यमं चैव नैरृतं वरुणं तथा
verses.transliteration: tato 'straṃ devadevasya koṇe caiva tu vinyaset indram agniṃ yamaṃ caiva nairṛtaṃ varuṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वायुं धनदम् ईशानम् अनन्तं ब्रह्मणा सह पूजयेत् तान्त्रिकैर् मन्त्रैर् अधश् चोर्ध्वं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: vāyuṃ dhanadam īśānam anantaṃ brahmaṇā saha pūjayet tāntrikair mantrair adhaś cordhvaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं संपूज्य देवेशं मण्डलस्थं जनार्दनम् लभेद् अभिमतान् कामान् नरो नास्त्य् अत्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ maṇḍalasthaṃ janārdanam labhed abhimatān kāmān naro nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनेनैव विधानेन मण्डलस्थं जनार्दनम् पूजितं यः संपश्येत स विशेद् विष्णुम् अव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: anenaiva vidhānena maṇḍalasthaṃ janārdanam pūjitaṃ yaḥ saṃpaśyeta sa viśed viṣṇum avyayam
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सकृद् अप्य् अर्चितो येन विधिनानेन केशवः जन्ममृत्युजरां तीर्त्वा स विष्णोः पदम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: sakṛd apy arcito yena vidhinānena keśavaḥ janmamṛtyujarāṃ tīrtvā sa viṣṇoḥ padam āpnuyāt
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यः स्मरेत् सततं भक्त्या नारायणम् अतन्द्रितः अन्वहं तस्य वासाय श्वेतद्वीपः प्रकल्पितः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ smaret satataṃ bhaktyā nārāyaṇam atandritaḥ anvahaṃ tasya vāsāya śvetadvīpaḥ prakalpitaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ॐकारादिसमायुक्तं नमःकारान्तदीपितम् तन्नाम सर्वतत्त्वानां मन्त्र इत्य् अभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: oṃkārādisamāyuktaṃ namaḥkārāntadīpitam tannāma sarvatattvānāṃ mantra ity abhidhīyate
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनेनैव विधानेन गन्धपुष्पं निवेदयेत् एकैकस्य प्रकुर्वीत यथोद्दिष्टं क्रमेण तु
verses.transliteration: anenaiva vidhānena gandhapuṣpaṃ nivedayet ekaikasya prakurvīta yathoddiṣṭaṃ krameṇa tu
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मुद्रास् ततो निबध्नीयाद् यथोक्तक्रमचोदिताः जपं चैव प्रकुर्वीत मूलमन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित्
verses.transliteration: mudrās tato nibadhnīyād yathoktakramacoditāḥ japaṃ caiva prakurvīta mūlamantreṇa mantravit
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाविंशतिम् अष्टौ वा शतम् अष्टोत्तरं तथा कामेषु च यथाप्रोक्तं यथाशक्ति समाहितः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāviṃśatim aṣṭau vā śatam aṣṭottaraṃ tathā kāmeṣu ca yathāproktaṃ yathāśakti samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पद्मं शङ्खश् च श्रीवत्सो गदा गरुड एव च चक्रं खड्गश् च शार्ङ्गं च अष्टौ मुद्राः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: padmaṃ śaṅkhaś ca śrīvatso gadā garuḍa eva ca cakraṃ khaḍgaś ca śārṅgaṃ ca aṣṭau mudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ गच्छ परं स्थानं पुराणपुरुषोत्तम यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा विन्दन्ति परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: gaccha gaccha paraṃ sthānaṃ purāṇapuruṣottama yatra brahmādayo devā vindanti paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अर्चनं ये न जानन्ति हरेर् मन्त्रैर् यथोदितम् ते तत्र मूलमन्त्रेण पूजयन्त्व् अच्युतं सदा
verses.transliteration: arcanaṃ ye na jānanti harer mantrair yathoditam te tatra mūlamantreṇa pūjayantv acyutaṃ sadā
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं संपूज्य विधिवद् भक्त्या तं पुरुषोत्तमम् प्रणम्य शिरसा पश्चात् सागरं च प्रसादयेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad bhaktyā taṃ puruṣottamam praṇamya śirasā paścāt sāgaraṃ ca prasādayet
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmins, thence the devotee should go to the holy spot of sacrifices where the splendid and sacred lake Indradyumna is situated.;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्राणस् त्वं सर्वभूतानां योनिश् च सरितां पते तीर्थराज नमस् ते ऽस्तु त्राहि माम् अच्युतप्रिय
verses.transliteration: prāṇas tvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yoniś ca saritāṃ pate tīrtharāja namas te 'stu trāhi mām acyutapriya
verses.translation: The intelligent devotee should go there with pure mind and body, and meditate mentally on lord Hari, approach the sacred waters, perform the Acamana rite and repeat this Mantra:—
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वैवं सागरे सम्यक् तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे द्विजाः तीरे चाभ्यर्च्य विधिवन् नारायणम् अनामयम्
verses.transliteration: snātvaivaṃ sāgare samyak tasmin kṣetravare dvijāḥ tīre cābhyarcya vidhivan nārāyaṇam anāmayam
verses.translation: "O holy spot that is sanctified by the performance of horse sacrifice, and which destroys sins, I am taking a holy dip in you. Remove my sin. Obeisance be to you".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रामं कृष्णं सुभद्रां च प्रणिपत्य च सागरम् शतानाम् अश्वमेधानां फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca praṇipatya ca sāgaram śatānām aśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: He redeems seven former generations and seven sub¬ sequent generations of his family. Like a God he goes to the world of Visnu on an aerial chariot that can go in all directions.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
