verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वदुःखविवर्जितः वृन्दारक इव श्रीमान् रूपयौवनगर्वितः
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ vṛndāraka iva śrīmān rūpayauvanagarvitaḥ
verses.translation: He can enjoy pleasures and happiness there, as long as the moon, sun and stars last. Falling off* from that world he returns to the earth and attains salvation thereafter.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विमानेनार्कवर्णेन दिव्यगन्धर्वनादिना कुलैकविंशम् उद्धृत्य विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: vimānenārkavarṇena divyagandharvanādinā kulaikaviṃśam uddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: O lord, great-grandfather, why do you praise the month of Jyestha in preference to Magha and other months. Kindly tell us the reason thereof.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भुक्त्वा तत्र वरान् भोगान् क्रीडित्वा चाप्सरैः सह मन्वन्तरशतं साग्रं जरामृत्युविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: bhuktvā tatra varān bhogān krīḍitvā cāpsaraiḥ saha manvantaraśataṃ sāgraṃ jarāmṛtyuvivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: O leading sages, listen, I shall briefly mention why I praise the month of Jyestha. in preference to other months.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यक्षयाद् इहायातः कुले सर्वगुणान्विते रूपवान् सुभगः श्रीमान् सत्यवादी जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: puṇyakṣayād ihāyātaḥ kule sarvaguṇānvite rūpavān subhagaḥ śrīmān satyavādī jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, the tenth day in the bright half of the month of Jyestha removes ten sins. Hence it is called 'Dasahara'.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वेदशास्त्रार्थविद् विप्रो भवेद् यज्वा तु वैष्णवः योगं च वैष्णवं प्राप्य ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: vedaśāstrārthavid vipro bhaved yajvā tu vaiṣṇavaḥ yogaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ prāpya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: The man who visits Balarama, Krsna, and Subhadra meditates upon them with concentration and mental purity will get rid of all sins and go to the world of Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहोपरागे संक्रान्त्याम् अयने विषुवे तथा युगादिषु षडशीत्यां व्यतीपाते दिनक्षये
verses.transliteration: grahoparāge saṃkrāntyām ayane viṣuve tathā yugādiṣu ṣaḍaśītyāṃ vyatīpāte dinakṣaye
verses.translation: O Brahmins, by visiting Purusottama, Rama and Subhadra during the first day of the northern and southern solar transits the man goes to the world of Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आषाढ्यां चैव कार्त्तिक्यां माघ्यां वान्ये शुभे तिथौ ये तत्र दानं विप्रेभ्यः प्रयच्छन्ति सुमेधसः
verses.transliteration: āṣāḍhyāṃ caiva kārttikyāṃ māghyāṃ vānye śubhe tithau ye tatra dānaṃ viprebhyaḥ prayacchanti sumedhasaḥ
verses.translation: By visiting Govinda, the most excellent of all Gods, seated on the swing, on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna the devotee of great self-restraint shall go to the city of Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: फलं सहस्रगुणितम् अन्यतीर्थाल् लभन्ति ते पितॄणां ये प्रयच्छन्ति पिण्डं तत्र विधानतः
verses.transliteration: phalaṃ sahasraguṇitam anyatīrthāl labhanti te pitṝṇāṃ ye prayacchanti piṇḍaṃ tatra vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: By visiting Govinda, the most excellent of all Gods, seated on the swing, on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna the devotee of great self-restraint shall go to the city of Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयां पितरस् तेषां तृप्तिं संप्राप्नुवन्ति वै एवं स्नानफलं सम्यक् सागरस्य मयोदितम्
verses.transliteration: akṣayāṃ pitaras teṣāṃ tṛptiṃ saṃprāpnuvanti vai evaṃ snānaphalaṃ samyak sāgarasya mayoditam
verses.translation: By visiting Govinda, the most excellent of all Gods, seated on the swing, on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna the devotee of great self-restraint shall go to the city of Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दानस्य च फलं विप्राः पिण्डदानस्य चैव हि धर्मार्थमोक्षफलदम् आयुष्कीर्तियशस्करम्
verses.transliteration: dānasya ca phalaṃ viprāḥ piṇḍadānasya caiva hi dharmārthamokṣaphaladam āyuṣkīrtiyaśaskaram
verses.translation: By visiting Govinda, the most excellent of all Gods, seated on the swing, on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna the devotee of great self-restraint shall go to the city of Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भुक्तिमुक्तिफलं नॄणां धन्यं दुःस्वप्ननाशनम् सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: bhuktimuktiphalaṃ nṝṇāṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: By visiting Govinda, the most excellent of all Gods, seated on the swing, on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna the devotee of great self-restraint shall go to the city of Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नास्तिकाय न वक्तव्यं पुराणं च द्विजोत्तमाः तावद् गर्जन्ति तीर्थानि माहात्म्यैः स्वैः पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: nāstikāya na vaktavyaṃ purāṇaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ tāvad garjanti tīrthāni māhātmyaiḥ svaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: By visiting Govinda, the most excellent of all Gods, seated on the swing, on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna the devotee of great self-restraint shall go to the city of Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यावन् न तीर्थराजस्य माहात्म्यं वर्ण्यते द्विजाः पुष्करादीनि तीर्थानि प्रयच्छन्ति स्वकं फलम्
verses.transliteration: yāvan na tīrtharājasya māhātmyaṃ varṇyate dvijāḥ puṣkarādīni tīrthāni prayacchanti svakaṃ phalam
verses.translation: By visiting Govinda, the most excellent of all Gods, seated on the swing, on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna the devotee of great self-restraint shall go to the city of Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थराजस् तु स पुनः सर्वतीर्थफलप्रदः भूतले यानि तीर्थानि सरितश् च सरांसि च
verses.transliteration: tīrtharājas tu sa punaḥ sarvatīrthaphalapradaḥ bhūtale yāni tīrthāni saritaś ca sarāṃsi ca
verses.translation: By visiting Govinda, the most excellent of all Gods, seated on the swing, on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna the devotee of great self-restraint shall go to the city of Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विशन्ति सागरे तानि तेनासौ श्रेष्ठतां गतः राजा समस्ततीर्थानां सागरः सरितां पतिः
verses.transliteration: viśanti sāgare tāni tenāsau śreṣṭhatāṃ gataḥ rājā samastatīrthānāṃ sāgaraḥ saritāṃ patiḥ
verses.translation: By visiting Govinda, the most excellent of all Gods, seated on the swing, on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna the devotee of great self-restraint shall go to the city of Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् समस्ततीर्थेभ्यः श्रेष्ठो ऽसौ सर्वकामदः तमो नाशं यथाभ्येति भास्करे ऽभ्युदिते द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt samastatīrthebhyaḥ śreṣṭho 'sau sarvakāmadaḥ tamo nāśaṃ yathābhyeti bhāskare 'bhyudite dvijāḥ
verses.translation: By visiting Govinda, the most excellent of all Gods, seated on the swing, on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna the devotee of great self-restraint shall go to the city of Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नानेन तीर्थराजस्य तथा पापस्य संक्षयः तीर्थराजसमं तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: snānena tīrtharājasya tathā pāpasya saṃkṣayaḥ tīrtharājasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: By visiting Govinda, the most excellent of all Gods, seated on the swing, on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna the devotee of great self-restraint shall go to the city of Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अधिष्ठानं यदा यत्र प्रभोर् नारायणस्य वै कः शक्नोति गुणान् वक्तुं तीर्थराजस्य भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: adhiṣṭhānaṃ yadā yatra prabhor nārāyaṇasya vai kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ tīrtharājasya bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: By visiting Govinda, the most excellent of all Gods, seated on the swing, on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna the devotee of great self-restraint shall go to the city of Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कोट्यो नवनवत्यस् तु यत्र तीर्थानि सन्ति वै तस्मात् स्नानं च दानं च होमं जप्यं सुरार्चनम् यत् किंचित् क्रियते तत्र चाक्षयं क्रियते द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: koṭyo navanavatyas tu yatra tīrthāni santi vai tasmāt snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca homaṃ japyaṃ surārcanam yat kiṃcit kriyate tatra cākṣayaṃ kriyate dvijāḥ
verses.translation: By visiting Govinda, the most excellent of all Gods, seated on the swing, on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna the devotee of great self-restraint shall go to the city of Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेद् द्विजश्रेष्ठास् तीर्थं यज्ञाङ्गसंभवम् इन्द्रद्युम्नसरो नाम यत्रास्ते पावनं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: tato gacched dvijaśreṣṭhās tīrthaṃ yajñāṅgasaṃbhavam indradyumnasaro nāma yatrāste pāvanaṃ śubham
verses.translation: When the Mahajyesthi occurs due to the contact of a zodiac and a constellation he should go to the holy place called Purusottama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तत्र शुचिर् धीमान् आचम्य मनसा हरिम् ध्यात्वोपस्थाय च जलम् इमं मन्त्रम् उदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: gatvā tatra śucir dhīmān ācamya manasā harim dhyātvopasthāya ca jalam imaṃ mantram udīrayet
verses.translation: O brahmins, by visiting Krsna, Rama and Subhadra on the Mahajyesthi day, the visitor obtains more benefit than that of twelve pilgrimages.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधाङ्गसंभूत तीर्थ सर्वाघनाशन स्नानं त्वयि करोम्य् अद्य पापं हर नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhāṅgasaṃbhūta tīrtha sarvāghanāśana snānaṃ tvayi karomy adya pāpaṃ hara namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उच्चार्य विधिवत् स्नात्वा देवान् ऋषीन् पितॄन् तिलोदकेन चान्यांश् च संतर्प्याचम्य वाग्यतः
verses.transliteration: evam uccārya vidhivat snātvā devān ṛṣīn pitṝn tilodakena cānyāṃś ca saṃtarpyācamya vāgyataḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा पितॄणां पिण्डांश् च संपूज्य पुरुषोत्तमम् दशाश्वमेधिकं सम्यक् फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: dattvā pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍāṃś ca saṃpūjya puruṣottamam daśāśvamedhikaṃ samyak phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सप्तावरान् सप्त परान् वंशान् उद्धृत्य देववत् कामगेन विमानेन विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: saptāvarān sapta parān vaṃśān uddhṛtya devavat kāmagena vimānena viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भुक्त्वा तत्र सुखान् भोगान् यावच् चन्द्रार्कतारकम् च्युतस् तस्माद् इहायातो मोक्षं च लभते ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: bhuktvā tatra sukhān bhogān yāvac candrārkatārakam cyutas tasmād ihāyāto mokṣaṃ ca labhate dhruvam
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृत्वा पञ्चतीर्थीम् एकादश्याम् उपोषितः ज्येष्ठशुक्लपञ्चदश्यां यः पश्येत् पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛtvā pañcatīrthīm ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ jyeṣṭhaśuklapañcadaśyāṃ yaḥ paśyet puruṣottamam
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स पूर्वोक्तं फलं प्राप्य क्रीडित्वा वाच्युतालये प्रयाति परमं स्थानं यस्मान् नावर्तते पुनः
verses.transliteration: sa pūrvoktaṃ phalaṃ prāpya krīḍitvā vācyutālaye prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yasmān nāvartate punaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मासान् अन्यान् परित्यज्य माघादीन् प्रपितामह प्रशंससि कथं ज्येष्ठं ब्रूहि तत्कारणं प्रभो
verses.transliteration: māsān anyān parityajya māghādīn prapitāmaha praśaṃsasi kathaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ brūhi tatkāraṇaṃ prabho
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं मुनिशार्दूलाः प्रवक्ष्यामि समासतः ज्येष्ठं मासं यथा तेभ्यः प्रशंसामि पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ jyeṣṭhaṃ māsaṃ yathā tebhyaḥ praśaṃsāmi punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि सरितश् च सरांसि च पुष्करिण्यस् तडागानि वाप्यः कूपास् तथा ह्रदाः
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni saritaś ca sarāṃsi ca puṣkariṇyas taḍāgāni vāpyaḥ kūpās tathā hradāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नानानद्यः समुद्राश् च सप्ताहं पुरुषोत्तमे ज्येष्ठशुक्लदशम्यादि प्रत्यक्षं यान्ति सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: nānānadyaḥ samudrāś ca saptāhaṃ puruṣottame jyeṣṭhaśukladaśamyādi pratyakṣaṃ yānti sarvadā
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नानदानादिकं तस्माद् देवताप्रेक्षणं द्विजाः यत् किंचित् क्रियते तत्र तस्मिन् काले ऽक्षयं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: snānadānādikaṃ tasmād devatāprekṣaṇaṃ dvijāḥ yat kiṃcit kriyate tatra tasmin kāle 'kṣayaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लपक्षस्य दशमी ज्येष्ठे मासि द्विजोत्तमाः हरते दश पापानि तस्माद् दशहरा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: śuklapakṣasya daśamī jyeṣṭhe māsi dvijottamāḥ harate daśa pāpāni tasmād daśaharā smṛtā
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस् तस्यां हलिनं कृष्णं पश्येद् भद्रां सुसंयतः सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकं व्रजेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: yas tasyāṃ halinaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paśyed bhadrāṃ susaṃyataḥ sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ vrajen naraḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे दक्षिणे विप्रास् त्व् अयने पुरुषोत्तमम् दृष्ट्वा रामं सुभद्रां च विष्णुलोकं व्रजेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: uttare dakṣiṇe viprās tv ayane puruṣottamam dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ subhadrāṃ ca viṣṇulokaṃ vrajen naraḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नरो दोलागतं दृष्ट्वा गोविन्दं पुरुषोत्तमम् फाल्गुन्यां प्रयतो भूत्वा गोविन्दस्य पुरं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: naro dolāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā govindaṃ puruṣottamam phālgunyāṃ prayato bhūtvā govindasya puraṃ vrajet
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विषुवद्दिवसे प्राप्ते पञ्चतीर्थीं विधानतः कृत्वा संकर्षणं कृष्णं दृष्ट्वा भद्रां च भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: viṣuvaddivase prāpte pañcatīrthīṃ vidhānataḥ kṛtvā saṃkarṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhadrāṃ ca bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नरः समस्तयज्ञानां फलं प्राप्नोति दुर्लभम् विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो विष्णुलोकं च गच्छति
verses.transliteration: naraḥ samastayajñānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti durlabham vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यः पश्यति तृतीयायां कृष्णं चन्दनरूषितम् वैशाखस्यासिते पक्षे स यात्य् अच्युतमन्दिरम्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paśyati tṛtīyāyāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ candanarūṣitam vaiśākhasyāsite pakṣe sa yāty acyutamandiram
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ज्यैष्ठ्यां ज्येष्ठर्क्षयुक्तायां यः पश्येत् पुरुषोत्तमम् कुलैकविंशम् उद्धृत्य विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: jyaiṣṭhyāṃ jyeṣṭharkṣayuktāyāṃ yaḥ paśyet puruṣottamam kulaikaviṃśam uddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यदा भवेन् महाज्यैष्ठी राशिनक्षत्रयोगतः प्रयत्नेन तदा मर्त्यैर् गन्तव्यं पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: yadā bhaven mahājyaiṣṭhī rāśinakṣatrayogataḥ prayatnena tadā martyair gantavyaṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: O sages, even as I recount, listen to the rules of holy ablution (in propitiation) of Krsna, Rama and Subhadra. It is meritorious and destroyer of all sins. O brahmins if, in the month of Jyestha the constella- ation Margasiras coincides with the full moon, that is the auspicious time for the ablution of Hari.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णं दृष्ट्वा महाज्यैष्ठ्यां रामं भद्रां च भो द्विजाः नरो द्वादशयात्रायाः फलं प्राप्नोति चाधिकम्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ rāmaṃ bhadrāṃ ca bho dvijāḥ naro dvādaśayātrāyāḥ phalaṃ prāpnoti cādhikam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, all the holy sacred waters mentioned above bathe the deities separately with their waters moved with flowers. "Obeisance to you, O Lord of the chiefs of Devas, O ancient Purusottama, O lord, the cause of creation, sustenance and annihilation, O lord of the world, O lord of the Universe.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रयागे च कुरुक्षेत्रे नैमिषे पुष्करे गये गङ्गाद्वारे कुशावर्ते गङ्गासागरसंगमे
verses.transliteration: prayāge ca kurukṣetre naimiṣe puṣkare gaye gaṅgādvāre kuśāvarte gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame
verses.translation: Devoutly we bow to the lord holding the three worlds, who is favourably disposed to the brahmins, who is the cause of liberation and who bestows all desired benefits. O excellent sages, Devas eulogised Krsna, Balarama of great strength and Subhadra and remained in the sky itself.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कोकामुखे शूकरे च मथुरायां मरुस्थले शालग्रामे वायुतीर्थे मन्दरे सिन्धुसागरे
verses.transliteration: kokāmukhe śūkare ca mathurāyāṃ marusthale śālagrāme vāyutīrthe mandare sindhusāgare
verses.translation: Together with Gandharvas they sang auspicious songs while the celestial damsels danced, the divine musical instru¬ ments were played and the cool gentle winds blew. The clouds gathered in the sky, showered water and strewed flowers. The sages, Siddhas and Caranas shouted cries of victory.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डारके चित्रकूटे प्रभासे कनखले द्विजाः शङ्खोद्धारे द्वारकायां तथा बदरिकाश्रमे
verses.transliteration: piṇḍārake citrakūṭe prabhāse kanakhale dvijāḥ śaṅkhoddhāre dvārakāyāṃ tathā badarikāśrame
verses.translation: So also the aerial chariots of Devas moved about in the sky. In these divine chariots they could go wherever they were pleased to go. The cars were of different type high and low. Some of them were stationary. They were of wonderful workmanship with divin
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लोहकुण्डे चाश्वतीर्थे सर्वपापप्रमोचने कामालये कोटितीर्थे तथा चामरकण्टके
verses.transliteration: lohakuṇḍe cāśvatīrthe sarvapāpapramocane kāmālaye koṭitīrthe tathā cāmarakaṇṭake
verses.translation: They, O excellent sages; all these bathed Krsna, Bala- rama and Subhadra and eulogised them with great joy. Be victorious.be victorious.protcctor of the world. O saviour of devotees, be victorious, be victorious, one favourably disposed to one who bows down, be victorious, be victorious. O refuge of living beings, be victorious, be victorious. O primordial lord, O cause of many, be victorious, be victorious O destroyer of Asuras, be victorious, be victorious, be victorious. O most excellent * one among the gods, be victorious, be victorious. O deity lying down in the ocean, be victorious, be victorious. O foremost one among the Yogins, be victorious be victorious. O deity with the sun for the eye, be victorious, be victorious. O king of Devas be victorious, be victorious. O enemy ofKaitabha, be victorious be victorious. O excellent one (eulogized in) the Vedas, be victorious, be victorious. O deity in the form of a tortoise, be victorious, be victorious O excellent deity in the form of sacri-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लोहार्गले जम्बुमार्गे सोमतीर्थे पृथूदके उत्पलावर्तके चैव पृथुतुङ्गे सुकुब्जके
verses.transliteration: lohārgale jambumārge somatīrthe pṛthūdake utpalāvartake caiva pṛthutuṅge sukubjake
verses.translation: The aerial chariots were of wonderful workmanship with divine jewels inlaid. They were resorted by the celestial maidens. They were beautified with flags and banners while musical instruments and songs enhanced their charm. The devotees who visit Purusottarna, Balabhadra and and Subhadra on that occasion go to the eternal region (whence there is no return to the earth).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकाम्रके च केदारे काश्यां च विरजे द्विजाः कालञ्जरे च गोकर्णे श्रीशैले गन्धमादने
verses.transliteration: ekāmrake ca kedāre kāśyāṃ ca viraje dvijāḥ kālañjare ca gokarṇe śrīśaile gandhamādane
verses.translation: By seeing Purusottarna seated on the platform accom¬ panied by Subhadra and Balarama the devotees go to the abode of Visnu which is devoid of ailments. O excellent sages, the man who performs auspicious rites and visits the Lord seated on the couch accompanied by Balarama and Subhadra obtains the benefit which is equal to the benefit of charitable gift of a hundred tawny cows at the holy centre Puskara.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महेन्द्रे मलये विन्ध्ये पारियात्रे हिमालये सह्ये च शुक्तिमन्ते च गोमन्ते चार्बुदे तथा
verses.transliteration: mahendre malaye vindhye pāriyātre himālaye sahye ca śuktimante ca gomante cārbude tathā
verses.translation: By visiting Lord Kj*sna seated on the couch a man obtains the benefit which is equal to the benefit of charitable gift of a hundred virgins. By visiting lord Kr§na seated on the couch a man obtains the benefit which is equal to the benefit of charitable gift of a hundred pieces of gold coins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गायां सर्वतीर्थेषु यामुनेषु च भो द्विजाः सारस्वतेषु गोमत्यां ब्रह्मपुत्रेषु सप्तसु
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yāmuneṣu ca bho dvijāḥ sārasvateṣu gomatyāṃ brahmaputreṣu saptasu
verses.translation: By visiting lord Kr§na seated on the couch a man By visiting Lord Krsna seated on the couch a man obtains the benefit equal to the gifts of cooked rice and due hospitality to guests alongwith Arghya.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गोदावरी भीमरथी तुङ्गभद्रा च नर्मदा तापी पयोउष्णी कावेरी शिप्रा चर्मण्वती द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: godāvarī bhīmarathī tuṅgabhadrā ca narmadā tāpī payouṣṇī kāverī śiprā carmaṇvatī dvijāḥ
verses.translation: By visiting Lord Krsna seated on the couch a man By visiting lord Krsna seated on the couch a man
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वितस्ता चन्द्रभागा च शतद्रुर् बाहुदा तथा ऋषिकुल्या कुमारी च विपाशा च दृषद्वती
verses.transliteration: vitastā candrabhāgā ca śatadrur bāhudā tathā ṛṣikulyā kumārī ca vipāśā ca dṛṣadvatī
verses.translation: By visiting lord Krsna seated on the couch a man obtains the benefit which is equal to the gift of Tiladhcnu. 2 By visiting Lord Krsna seated on the couch a man obtains the benefit which is equal to the gift of elephants, horses and chariots.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शरयूर् नाकगङ्गा च गण्डकी च महानदी कौशिकी करतोया च त्रिस्रोता मधुवाहिनी
verses.transliteration: śarayūr nākagaṅgā ca gaṇḍakī ca mahānadī kauśikī karatoyā ca trisrotā madhuvāhinī
verses.translation: By visiting lord Krsna seated on the couch a man obtains the benefit which is equal to the gift of a cow with its horns plaited with gold. By visiting Lord Kp§na seated on the couch a man obtains the benefit which is equal to the charitable gift of a water and cow.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महानदी वैतरणी याश् चान्या नानुकीर्तिताः अथवा किं बहूक्तेन भाषितेन द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: mahānadī vaitaraṇī yāś cānyā nānukīrtitāḥ athavā kiṃ bahūktena bhāṣitena dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: By visiting lord Krsna seated on the couch a man obtains the benefit which is equal to the gift of ghee and a cow. By visiting lord Krsna seated on the couch a man obtains the benefit which is equal to that of performing Candrayana 3 according to sacred injunctions.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वेष्व् आयतनेषु च सागरेषु च शैलेषु नदीषु च सरःसु च
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarveṣv āyataneṣu ca sāgareṣu ca śaileṣu nadīṣu ca saraḥsu ca
verses.translation: Vifotsarga.: letting loose a bull or a bull and four heifers as a meritorious deed, especially on the occasion of a Sraddha in honour of de¬ ceased ancestors. By visiting lord Krsna seated on the couch a m obtains the benefit which is equal to that of monthly observ! ance of facts as laid down in the Sastras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत् फलं स्नानदानेन राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे तत् फलं कृष्णम् आलोक्य महाज्यैष्ठ्यां लभेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: yat phalaṃ snānadānena rāhugraste divākare tat phalaṃ kṛṣṇam ālokya mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ labhen naraḥ
verses.translation: All those sacred waters on the face of the earth Ho B y visiting K W a fiming the South, a man obtains the
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन गन्तव्यं पुरुषोत्तमे महाज्यैष्ठ्यां मुनिश्रेष्ठा सर्वकामफलेप्सुभिः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena gantavyaṃ puruṣottame mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ muniśreṣṭhā sarvakāmaphalepsubhiḥ
verses.translation: By visiting Krsna facing the south a man obtains the benefit which results from the holy dip and charitable gift at Gangadvara- and Kuruksctra. By visiting Krsna facing the south a man obtains the benefit which is equal to the benefit of (the holy dip) in Prayaga on the MahamaghI day i.c. (full moon day in the month of Magha).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा रामं महाज्येष्ठं कृष्णं सुभद्रया सह विष्णुलोकं नरो याति समुद्धृत्य समं कुलम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ mahājyeṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrayā saha viṣṇulokaṃ naro yāti samuddhṛtya samaṃ kulam
verses.translation: By visiting Krsna facing the south a man obtains the benefit which is equal to the ablution and charitable gifts in Salagrama on the Mahacaitrl day (i.c. full moon day in the month of Citra).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भुक्त्वा तत्र वरान् भोगान् यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम् पुण्यक्षयाद् इहागत्य चतुर्वेदी द्विजो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: bhuktvā tatra varān bhogān yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam puṇyakṣayād ihāgatya caturvedī dvijo bhavet
verses.translation: By visiting Krsna facing the south a man obtains that benefit which is equal to the benefit of MahakarttikI (i.e. full moon day in the month of Karttika) at Puskara. By visiting Krsna facing the south a man obtains the benefit which is derivable from the holy dip and charitable gift at the confluence of Gahga and the ocean.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वधर्मनिरतः शान्तः कृष्णभक्तो जितेन्द्रियः वैष्णवं योगम् आस्थाय ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: svadharmanirataḥ śāntaḥ kṛṣṇabhakto jitendriyaḥ vaiṣṇavaṃ yogam āsthāya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: By visiting Krsna facing the south a man obtains the benefit which is the result of holy bath accompanied by charit¬ able gifts in Kuruksetra at the time of solar eclipse.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कस्मिन् काले भवेत् स्नानं कृष्णस्य कमलोद्भव विधिना केन तद् ब्रूहि ततो विधिविदां वर
verses.transliteration: kasmin kāle bhavet snānaṃ kṛṣṇasya kamalodbhava vidhinā kena tad brūhi tato vidhividāṃ vara
verses.translation: Those who observe Kr?na, Balarama and Subhadra seated in a chariot and going in a procession to the Mandapa called Gundika go to the abode of lord Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं मुनयः स्नानं कृष्णस्य वदतो मम रामस्य च सुभद्रायाः पुण्यं सर्वाघनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ snānaṃ kṛṣṇasya vadato mama rāmasya ca subhadrāyāḥ puṇyaṃ sarvāghanāśanam
verses.translation: Those who visit Krsna, Balarama and Subhadra occu¬ pying the Mandapa for seven days, go to the world of Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मासि ज्येष्ठे च संप्राप्ते नक्षत्रे चन्द्रदैवते पौर्णमास्यां तदा स्नानं सर्वकालं हरेर् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: māsi jyeṣṭhe ca saṃprāpte nakṣatre candradaivate paurṇamāsyāṃ tadā snānaṃ sarvakālaṃ harer dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Who initiated the procession to the auspicious Gundika Mandapa? What is the benefit of witnessing this procession?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतीर्थमयः कूपस् तत्रास्ते निर्मलः शुचिः तदा भोगवती तत्र प्रत्यक्षा भवति द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sarvatīrthamayaḥ kūpas tatrāste nirmalaḥ śuciḥ tadā bhogavatī tatra pratyakṣā bhavati dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O king, there shall be a procession for seven days on the banks of your lake. It will be called Gundika. It will bestow all desired benefits.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माज् ज्यैष्ठ्यां समुद्धृत्य हैमाढ्यैः कलशैर् जलम् कृष्णरामाभिषेकार्थं सुभद्रायाश् च भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tasmāj jyaiṣṭhyāṃ samuddhṛtya haimāḍhyaiḥ kalaśair jalam kṛṣṇarāmābhiṣekārthaṃ subhadrāyāś ca bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: After saying this to him the lord vanished there itself. That glorious and excellent king was fully satisfied.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा सुशोभनं मञ्चं पताकाभिर् अलंकृतम् सुदृढं सुखसंचारं वस्त्रैः पुष्पैर् अलंकृतम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā suśobhanaṃ mañcaṃ patākābhir alaṃkṛtam sudṛḍhaṃ sukhasaṃcāraṃ vastraiḥ puṣpair alaṃkṛtam
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, one shall by all means visit lord Visnu, the bestower of all desires, at Gundika.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विस्तीर्णं धूपितं धूपैः स्नानार्थं रामकृष्णयोः सितवस्त्रपरिच्छन्नं मुक्ताहारावलम्बितम्
verses.transliteration: vistīrṇaṃ dhūpitaṃ dhūpaiḥ snānārthaṃ rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ sitavastraparicchannaṃ muktāhārāvalambitam
verses.translation: A man if he has no son, obtains sons, if poor, gets riches, if sick, is liberated from ailments. A virgin will get a good husband.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र नानाविधैर् वाद्यैः कृष्णं नीलाम्बरं द्विजाः मध्ये सुभद्रां चास्थाप्य जयमङ्गलनिस्वनैः
verses.transliteration: tatra nānāvidhair vādyaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nīlāmbaraṃ dvijāḥ madhye subhadrāṃ cāsthāpya jayamaṅgalanisvanaiḥ
verses.translation: The man derives longevity, glory, fame, intelligence, strength, learning, courage and obtains cattle, progeny and the wealth of handsome features and blooming youth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रियैर् वैश्यैः शूद्रैश् चान्यैश् च जातिभिः अनेकशतसाहस्रैर् वृतं स्त्रीपुरुषैर् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiḥ śūdraiś cānyaiś ca jātibhiḥ anekaśatasāhasrair vṛtaṃ strīpuruṣair dvijāḥ
verses.translation: By visiting lord Visnu a man or woman devotee attains whatever pleasure he or she wishes for.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गृहस्थाः स्नातकाश् चैव यतयो ब्रह्मचारिणः स्नापयन्ति तदा कृष्णं मञ्चस्थं सहलायुधम्
verses.transliteration: gṛhasthāḥ snātakāś caiva yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ snāpayanti tadā kṛṣṇaṃ mañcasthaṃ sahalāyudham
verses.translation: By visiting lord Visnu a man or woman devotee attains whatever pleasure he or she wishes for.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा समस्ततीर्थानि पूर्वोक्तानि द्विजोत्तमाः स्वोदकैः पुष्पमिश्रैश् च स्नापयन्ति पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: tathā samastatīrthāni pūrvoktāni dvijottamāḥ svodakaiḥ puṣpamiśraiś ca snāpayanti pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: By visiting lord Visnu a man or woman devotee attains whatever pleasure he or she wishes for.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पश्चात् पटहशङ्खाद्यैर् भेरीमुरजनिस्वनैः काहलैस् तालशब्दैश् च मृदङ्गैर् झर्झरैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: paścāt paṭahaśaṅkhādyair bherīmurajanisvanaiḥ kāhalais tālaśabdaiś ca mṛdaṅgair jharjharais tathā
verses.translation: By visiting lord Visnu a man or woman devotee attains whatever pleasure he or she wishes for.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्यैश् च विविधैर् वाद्यैर् घण्टास्वनविभूषितैः स्त्रीणां मङ्गलशब्दैश् च स्तुतिशब्दैर् मनोहरैः
verses.transliteration: anyaiś ca vividhair vādyair ghaṇṭāsvanavibhūṣitaiḥ strīṇāṃ maṅgalaśabdaiś ca stutiśabdair manoharaiḥ
verses.translation: By visiting lord Visnu a man or woman devotee attains whatever pleasure he or she wishes for.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जयशब्दैस् तथा स्तोत्रैर् वीणावेणुनिनादितैः श्रूयते सुमहाञ् शब्दः सागरस्येव गर्जतः
verses.transliteration: jayaśabdais tathā stotrair vīṇāveṇunināditaiḥ śrūyate sumahāñ śabdaḥ sāgarasyeva garjataḥ
verses.translation: By visiting lord Visnu a man or woman devotee attains whatever pleasure he or she wishes for.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मुनीनां वेदशब्देन मन्त्रशब्दैस् तथापरैः नानास्तोत्ररवैः पुण्यैः सामशब्दोपबृंहितैः
verses.transliteration: munīnāṃ vedaśabdena mantraśabdais tathāparaiḥ nānāstotraravaiḥ puṇyaiḥ sāmaśabdopabṛṃhitaiḥ
verses.translation: By visiting lord Visnu a man or woman devotee attains whatever pleasure he or she wishes for.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यतिभिः स्नातकैश् चैव गृहस्थैर् ब्रह्मचारिभिः स्नानकाले सुरश्रेष्ठ स्तुवन्ति परया मुदा
verses.transliteration: yatibhiḥ snātakaiś caiva gṛhasthair brahmacāribhiḥ snānakāle suraśreṣṭha stuvanti parayā mudā
verses.translation: By visiting lord Visnu a man or woman devotee attains whatever pleasure he or she wishes for.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्यामैर् वेश्याजनैश् चैव कुचभारावनामिभिः पीतरक्ताम्बराभिश् च माल्यदामावनामिभिः
verses.transliteration: śyāmair veśyājanaiś caiva kucabhārāvanāmibhiḥ pītaraktāmbarābhiś ca mālyadāmāvanāmibhiḥ
verses.translation: By visiting lord Visnu a man or woman devotee attains whatever pleasure he or she wishes for.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सरत्नकुण्डलैर् दिव्यैः सुवर्णस्तबकान्वितैः चामरै रत्नदण्डैश् च वीज्येते रामकेशवौ
verses.transliteration: saratnakuṇḍalair divyaiḥ suvarṇastabakānvitaiḥ cāmarai ratnadaṇḍaiś ca vījyete rāmakeśavau
verses.translation: By visiting lord Visnu a man or woman devotee attains whatever pleasure he or she wishes for.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यक्षविद्याधरैः सिद्धैः किंनरैश् चाप्सरोगणैः परिवार्याम्बरगतैर् देवगन्धर्वचारणैः
verses.transliteration: yakṣavidyādharaiḥ siddhaiḥ kiṃnaraiś cāpsarogaṇaiḥ parivāryāmbaragatair devagandharvacāraṇaiḥ
verses.translation: By visiting lord Visnu a man or woman devotee attains whatever pleasure he or she wishes for.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आदित्या वसवो रुद्राः साध्या विश्वे मरुद्गणाः लोकपालास् तथा चान्ये स्तुवन्ति पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā viśve marudgaṇāḥ lokapālās tathā cānye stuvanti puruṣottamam
verses.translation: By visiting lord Visnu a man or woman devotee attains whatever pleasure he or she wishes for.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा नरो लभेत् कृष्णं तत् फलं सहलायुधम् सकलं भद्रया सार्धं व्रजन्तं दक्षिणामुखम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā naro labhet kṛṣṇaṃ tat phalaṃ sahalāyudham sakalaṃ bhadrayā sārdhaṃ vrajantaṃ dakṣiṇāmukham
verses.translation: By visiting lord Visnu a man or woman devotee attains whatever pleasure he or she wishes for.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गुडिवामण्डपं यान्तं ये पश्यन्ति रथे स्थितम् कृष्णं बलं सुभद्रां च ते यान्ति भवनं हरेः
verses.transliteration: guḍivāmaṇḍapaṃ yāntaṃ ye paśyanti rathe sthitam kṛṣṇaṃ balaṃ subhadrāṃ ca te yānti bhavanaṃ hareḥ
verses.translation: Mention separately the benefit which a man or a woman with perfect self-control acquires by making holy pilgrimage.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये पश्यन्ति तदा कृष्णं सप्ताहं मण्डपे स्थितम् हलिनं च सुभद्रां च विष्णुलोकं व्रजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: ye paśyanti tadā kṛṣṇaṃ saptāhaṃ maṇḍape sthitam halinaṃ ca subhadrāṃ ca viṣṇulokaṃ vrajanti te
verses.translation: O brahmins, even as I recount, listen to the benefit of holy pilgrimage severally, that a man acquires after under¬ taking the pilgrimage to that holy centre with great restraint.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: केन सा निर्मिता यात्रा दक्षिणस्यां जगत्पते यात्राफलं च किं तत्र प्राप्यते ब्रूहि मानवैः
verses.transliteration: kena sā nirmitā yātrā dakṣiṇasyāṃ jagatpate yātrāphalaṃ ca kiṃ tatra prāpyate brūhi mānavaiḥ
verses.translation: A man undoubtedly enjoys pleasures for as many Kalpas as the number of times he undertakes pilgrimages in the month of Jyestha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं सरसस् तीरे राज्ञस् तस्य जगत्पते पवित्रे विजने देशे गत्वा तत्र च मण्डपे
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṃ sarasas tīre rājñas tasya jagatpate pavitre vijane deśe gatvā tatra ca maṇḍape
verses.translation: O Lord, we wish to hear, even as you recount, the installation and worship of the lord of the universe and the mode of these rites as well as charitable gifts and the fruits thereof. O leading sages, listen to the installation of idols urged by Brahma. By devoutly performing this, the man or the woman acquires the benefit.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णः संकर्षणश् चैव सुभद्रा च रथेन ते स्वस्थानं संपरित्यज्य सप्तरात्रं वसन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaś caiva subhadrā ca rathena te svasthānaṃ saṃparityajya saptarātraṃ vasanti vai
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, when the twelve pilgrimages are completed, the devotee should carry out the installation that destroy sin.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रद्युम्नेन भो विप्राः पुरा वै प्रार्थितो हरिः सप्ताहं सरसस् तीरे मम यात्रा भवत्व् इति
verses.transliteration: indradyumnena bho viprāḥ purā vai prārthito hariḥ saptāhaṃ sarasas tīre mama yātrā bhavatv iti
verses.translation: The rite of holy bath should be performed in accord¬ ance with the injunctions prescribed by the sages in regard to him. After taking holy bath perfectly in accordance with the injunction (the devotee) who is conversant with the names, Gotras (spiritual lines) and the procedure, should perform Tarpana rite to Devas, sages and manes as well as others.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गुडिवा नाम देवेश भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदा तस्मै किल वरं चासौ ददौ स पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: guḍivā nāma deveśa bhuktimuktiphalapradā tasmai kila varaṃ cāsau dadau sa puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: He should repeat other holy passages and Mantras pertaining to the sun with faith and concentration. After making three circumambulations he should bow down to the Sungod.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सप्ताहं सरसस् तीरे तव राजन् भविष्यति गुडिवा नाम यात्रा मे सर्वकामफलप्रदा
verses.transliteration: saptāhaṃ sarasas tīre tava rājan bhaviṣyati guḍivā nāma yātrā me sarvakāmaphalapradā
verses.translation: In regard to the people of the first three castes the rite of holy bath and the repetition of Mantras is in the manner mentioned in the Vedas. The utterance of the Vedic passage is to be avoided by women as well as Sudras. With great devotion he shall worship Lord Visnu offering lotuses and other flowers pertaining to Visnu (like jasmine etc.).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये मां तत्रार्चयिष्यन्ति श्रद्धया मण्डपे स्थितम् संकर्षणं सुभद्रां च विधिवत् सुसमाहिताः
verses.transliteration: ye māṃ tatrārcayiṣyanti śraddhayā maṇḍape sthitam saṃkarṣaṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca vidhivat susamāhitāḥ
verses.translation: After worshipping the lord the ruler of the universe, the bestower of worldly pleasures and salvation, in this manner, he shall burn incense along with agallochum in front of the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः स्त्रियः शूद्राश् च वै नृप पुष्पैर् गन्धैस् तथा धूपैर् दीपैर् नैवेद्यकैर् वरैः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ striyaḥ śūdrāś ca vai nṛpa puṣpair gandhais tathā dhūpair dīpair naivedyakair varaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, he shall burn aromatic resin too along with scents. He shall light a lamp with devotion using ghee (instead of oil) according to the means. With concentration he shall offer twelve other lamps, O excellent sages, he shall burn it with ghee or gingelly oil.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपहारैर् बहुविधैः प्रणिपातैः प्रदक्षिणैः जयशब्दैस् तथा स्तोत्रैर् गीतैर् वाद्यैर् मनोहरैः
verses.transliteration: upahārair bahuvidhaiḥ praṇipātaiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ jayaśabdais tathā stotrair gītair vādyair manoharaiḥ
verses.translation: By way of Naivedya (food offering) he shall dedicate milk pudding, sweet Saskulis, Vatakas (special kinds of baked or fried cakes) sweets, a little quantity of molasses and fruits too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न तेषां दुर्लभं किंचित् फलं यस्य यद् ईप्सितम् भविष्यति नृपश्रेष्ठ मत्प्रसादाद् असंशयम्
verses.transliteration: na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiṃcit phalaṃ yasya yad īpsitam bhaviṣyati nṛpaśreṣṭha matprasādād asaṃśayam
verses.translation: After worshipping Purusottama with five items of service (i.e. bathing, offering cloths, worshipping with flowers, showing lamps and incense and food offerings) the devotee shall repeat "Om obeisance to Purusottama" a hundred and eight times. With faith and concentration, O excellent sages, the devotee shall make a flowery bowerlike Mantfapa over the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा तु तं देवस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत स तु राजवरः श्रीमान् कृतकृत्यो ऽभवत् तदा
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā tu taṃ devas tatraivāntaradhīyata sa tu rājavaraḥ śrīmān kṛtakṛtyo 'bhavat tadā
verses.translation: Thereafter, he shall resolve to keep awake at night. For this purpose he shall arrange for the discourses on the divine story of Vasudeva or devotional songs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन गुडिवायां द्विजोत्तमाः सर्वकामप्रदं देवं पश्येत् तं पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena guḍivāyāṃ dvijottamāḥ sarvakāmapradaṃ devaṃ paśyet taṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: After taking bath perfectly in accordance with the in¬ junctions, the devotee shall control his sense organs and put on washed (and dried) clothes. Thereafter, he shall bathe lord Visnu with devotion as before. Thereafter, he should give the preceptor a cow, cloth, gold, umbrella, pair of sandals, foodgrain and bellmetal vessel with devotion.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रान् निर्धनो लभते धनम् रोगाच् च मुच्यते रोगी कन्या प्राप्नोति सत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: aputro labhate putrān nirdhano labhate dhanam rogāc ca mucyate rogī kanyā prāpnoti satpatim
verses.translation: He should feed brahmins. The food served should begin with milk pudding. There should be sweet cooked rice and various kinds of edibles prepared in jaggery and ghee.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आयुः कीर्तिं यशो मेधां बलं विद्यां धृतिं पशून् नरः संततिम् आप्नोति रूपयौवनसंपदम्
verses.transliteration: āyuḥ kīrtiṃ yaśo medhāṃ balaṃ vidyāṃ dhṛtiṃ paśūn naraḥ saṃtatim āpnoti rūpayauvanasaṃpadam
verses.translation: After the brahmins have been fed to their satisfaction and their minds are at rest, he should give them twelve water pots together with sweets. Devoid of revelry he should give them monetary gifts according to his capacity.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यान् यान् समीहते भोगान् दृष्ट्वा तं पुरुषोत्तमम् नरो वाप्य् अथवा नारी तांस् तान् प्राप्नोत्य् असंशयम्
verses.transliteration: yān yān samīhate bhogān dṛṣṭvā taṃ puruṣottamam naro vāpy athavā nārī tāṃs tān prāpnoty asaṃśayam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after worshipping those brah¬ mins, he should devotedly worship his preceptor who is the bestower of perfect knowledge and who is on a par with Visnu
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यात्रां कृत्वा गुडिवाख्यां विधिवत् सुसमाहितः आषाढस्य सिते पक्षे नरो योषिद् अथापि वा
verses.transliteration: yātrāṃ kṛtvā guḍivākhyāṃ vidhivat susamāhitaḥ āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe naro yoṣid athāpi vā
verses.translation: The learned devotee should honour him with gold cloth, cow, foodgrains and other articles. Thereafter, he should repeat this mantra. "May Lord Purusottama who has neither beginning nor end, who holds conch, discus and iron club and who is the omnipresent lord of the Universe be pleased with this.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं च रामं च सुभद्रां च द्विजोत्तमाः दशपञ्चाश्वमेधानां फलं प्राप्नोति चाधिकम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ ca rāmaṃ ca subhadrāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ daśapañcāśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti cādhikam
verses.translation: After uttering this mantra he should circumambulate brahmins thrice. He should bid farewell to the preceptor by bending his head with devotion.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सप्तावरान् सप्त परान् वंशान् उद्धृत्य चात्मनः कामगेन विमानेन सर्वरत्नैर् अलंकृतः
verses.transliteration: saptāvarān sapta parān vaṃśān uddhṛtya cātmanaḥ kāmagena vimānena sarvaratnair alaṃkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, he should follow those brahmins with devo¬ tion to the boundary of the village. Thus following them he should pay homage and bid them farewell. Accompanied by kinsmen and relatives he should take
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वैर् अप्सरोभिश् च सेव्यमानो यथोत्तरैः रूपवान् सुभगः शूरो नरो विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: gandharvair apsarobhiś ca sevyamāno yathottaraiḥ rūpavān subhagaḥ śūro naro viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet
verses.translation: By performing this rite perfectly well, the devotee whether a man or a woman should derive the benefit of thou¬ sands of horse-sacrifices and a hundred Rajasuya sacrifices.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भुक्त्वा वरान् भोगान् यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम् सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा जरामरणवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: tatra bhuktvā varān bhogān yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ
verses.translation: For a period of thirty Kalpas he enjoys excellent plea¬ sures there as he wishes. From there, O excellent brahmins he comes to the world of the moon. O excellent brahmins, after enjoying splendid pleasures there for a period of ten Kalpas he comes to the world of Gan- dharvas which is most difficult of access.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यक्षयाद् इहागत्य चतुर्वेदी द्विजो भवेत् वैष्णवं योगम् आस्थाय ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: puṇyakṣayād ihāgatya caturvedī dvijo bhavet vaiṣṇavaṃ yogam āsthāya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: After enjoying various pleasures to the fullest satisfac¬ tion for the period of a Kalpa, he comes to the earth and be¬ comes a virtuous king.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकैकस्यास् तु यात्रायाः फलं ब्रूहि पृथक् पृथक् यत् प्राप्नोति नरः कृत्वा नारी वा तत्र संयता
verses.transliteration: ekaikasyās tu yātrāyāḥ phalaṃ brūhi pṛthak pṛthak yat prāpnoti naraḥ kṛtvā nārī vā tatra saṃyatā
verses.translation: As long as the heaven stands alongwith the moon and stars, they dally with the celestial nymphs. They resemble heated gold. They are devoid of old age and death.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रतियात्राफलं विप्राः शृणुध्वं गदतो मम यत् प्राप्नोति नरः कृत्वा तस्मिन् क्षेत्रे सुसंयतः
verses.transliteration: pratiyātrāphalaṃ viprāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ gadato mama yat prāpnoti naraḥ kṛtvā tasmin kṣetre susaṃyataḥ
verses.translation: They are free from miseries. They are rid of thirst, fatigue and suffering. They assume the form of the lord:—They have four arms. They are adorned by garlands of sylvan flowers. They possess great vigour and power.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhicoditām yāṃ kṛtvā tu naro bhaktyā nārī vā labhate phalam

verses.translation: O brahmins, all those worlds which we hear as the worlds in the heavenly sphere, all those who perform meritorious rites, do not merit even a sixteenth part of the world of lord Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.translation: The devotees of Visnu who worship Vasudeva the preceptor of the universe with devotion, go to the world of Vi§nu.
