verses.sanskrit: देवर्षीणां यथा श्रेष्ठो नारदो मुनिसत्तमाः तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: devarṣīṇāṃ yathā śreṣṭho nārado munisattamāḥ tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: Divine Ordeal (divya-pariksa). Yajnavalkya prescribes ten ordeals viz tula, agni, jala, visa, kos'a, tandula, tapta-masa, phala, dharma, tulasi.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धातूनां काञ्चनं यद्वत् पवित्राणां च दक्षिणा तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: dhātūnāṃ kāñcanaṃ yadvat pavitrāṇāṃ ca dakṣiṇā tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: Divine Ordeal (divya-pariksa). Yajnavalkya prescribes ten ordeals viz tula, agni, jala, visa, kos'a, tandula, tapta-masa, phala, dharma, tulasi.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिर् यथा दक्ष ऋषीणां कश्यपो यथा तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: prajāpatir yathā dakṣa ṛṣīṇāṃ kaśyapo yathā tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: Divine Ordeal (divya-pariksa). Yajnavalkya prescribes ten ordeals viz tula, agni, jala, visa, kos'a, tandula, tapta-masa, phala, dharma, tulasi.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहाणां भास्करो यद्वन् मन्त्राणां प्रणवो यथा तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: grahāṇāṃ bhāskaro yadvan mantrāṇāṃ praṇavo yathā tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: Divine Ordeal (divya-pariksa). Yajnavalkya prescribes ten ordeals viz tula, agni, jala, visa, kos'a, tandula, tapta-masa, phala, dharma, tulasi.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधस् तु यज्ञानां यथा श्रेष्ठः प्रकीर्तितः तथा समस्ततीर्थानां क्षेत्रं च तद् द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhas tu yajñānāṃ yathā śreṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ tathā samastatīrthānāṃ kṣetraṃ ca tad dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Divine Ordeal (divya-pariksa). Yajnavalkya prescribes ten ordeals viz tula, agni, jala, visa, kos'a, tandula, tapta-masa, phala, dharma, tulasi.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ओषधीनां यथा धान्यं तृणेषु तृणराड् यथा तथा समस्ततीर्थानाम् उत्तमं पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: oṣadhīnāṃ yathā dhānyaṃ tṛṇeṣu tṛṇarāḍ yathā tathā samastatīrthānām uttamaṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: Divine Ordeal (divya-pariksa). Yajnavalkya prescribes ten ordeals viz tula, agni, jala, visa, kos'a, tandula, tapta-masa, phala, dharma, tulasi.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथा समस्ततीर्थानां धर्मः संसारतारकः तथा समस्ततीर्थानां श्रेष्ठं तत् पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: yathā samastatīrthānāṃ dharmaḥ saṃsāratārakaḥ tathā samastatīrthānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tat puruṣottamam
verses.translation: Divine Ordeal (divya-pariksa). Yajnavalkya prescribes ten ordeals viz tula, agni, jala, visa, kos'a, tandula, tapta-masa, phala, dharma, tulasi.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां चैव तीर्थानां क्षेत्राणां च द्विजोत्तमाः जपहोमव्रतानां च तपोदानफलानि च
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ japahomavratānāṃ ca tapodānaphalāni ca
verses.translation: Thus, the glory of (Infinite deity) and the holy shrine of Purusottama that yields worldly pleasures and liberation unto men has been recounted by me. It is very difficult of access.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न तत् पश्यामि भो विप्रा यत् तेन सदृशं भुवि किं चात्र बहुनोक्तेन भाषितेन पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: na tat paśyāmi bho viprā yat tena sadṛśaṃ bhuvi kiṃ cātra bahunoktena bhāṣitena punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: KtSin: a follower of Kaiiisa who at the instruction of Kamsa went to Gokula, in the form of a horse, to kill Srikrs*a. But Snkrsna killed him and got the name Kesava.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं सत्यं पुनः सत्यं क्षेत्रं तत् परमं महत् पुरुषाख्यं सकृद् दृष्ट्वा सागराम्भःसमाप्लुतम्
verses.transliteration: satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ kṣetraṃ tat paramaṃ mahat puruṣākhyaṃ sakṛd dṛṣṭvā sāgarāmbhaḥsamāplutam
verses.translation: Those who meditate upon Krsna the overlord of the three worlds', the bestower of all desired benefits, are liberated souls.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविद्यां सकृज् ज्ञात्वा गर्भवासो न विद्यते हरेः संनिहिते स्थान उत्तमे पुरुषोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: brahmavidyāṃ sakṛj jñātvā garbhavāso na vidyate hareḥ saṃnihite sthāna uttame puruṣottame
verses.translation: Those who are devoted to Krsna, those who remember Krsna at night (when they go to bed) and again when they get up enter Krsna when their bodies are consumed on death like the ghee offering consigned to fire with due repetitions of Mantras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरम् उपासीत मासमात्रम् अथापि वा तेन जप्तं हुतं तेन तेन तप्तं तपो महत्
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsaram upāsīta māsamātram athāpi vā tena japtaṃ hutaṃ tena tena taptaṃ tapo mahat
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, the lotus-eyed deity Krsna should be assiduously visited in that holy centre by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र योगेश्वरो हरिः भुक्त्वा भोगान् विचित्रांश् च देवयोषित्समन्वितः
verses.transliteration: sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra yogeśvaro hariḥ bhuktvā bhogān vicitrāṃś ca devayoṣitsamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: The lofty-minded persons who visit Krsna, (Balarama) and Subhadra at the time when the deities are laid to rest go to the world of Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कल्पान्ते पुनर् आगत्य मर्त्यलोके नरोत्तमः जायते योगिनां विप्रा ज्ञानज्ञेयोद्यतो गृहे
verses.transliteration: kalpānte punar āgatya martyaloke narottamaḥ jāyate yogināṃ viprā jñānajñeyodyato gṛhe
verses.translation: Those who devoutly visit Purusottama, Balarama and Subhadra at any time, go to the world of Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्य वैष्णवं योगं हरेः स्वच्छन्दतां व्रजेत् कल्पवृक्षस्य रामस्य कृष्णस्य भद्रया सह
verses.transliteration: saṃprāpya vaiṣṇavaṃ yogaṃ hareḥ svacchandatāṃ vrajet kalpavṛkṣasya rāmasya kṛṣṇasya bhadrayā saha
verses.translation: He who stays in the holy centres of Purusottama for the four months of rainy season derives more benefit than the benefit accruing from the holy pilgrimage to the other centres of the Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयेन्द्रद्युम्नस्य माहात्म्यं माधवस्य च स्वर्गद्वारस्य माहात्म्यं सागरस्य विधिः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyendradyumnasya māhātmyaṃ mādhavasya ca svargadvārasya māhātmyaṃ sāgarasya vidhiḥ kramāt
verses.translation: Those lofty persons who reside there itself during the seasons, after conquering sense-organs and controlling anger, derive the benefit of a penance.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मार्जनस्य यथाकाले भागीरथ्याः समागमम् सर्वम् एतन् मया ख्यातं यत् परं श्रोतुम् इच्छथ
verses.transliteration: mārjanasya yathākāle bhāgīrathyāḥ samāgamam sarvam etan mayā khyātaṃ yat paraṃ śrotum icchatha
verses.translation: Within a month a man obtains at Purusottama their benefit which others obtain after performing penance in other holy centres for ten thousand years.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रद्युम्नस्य माहात्म्यम् एतच् च कथितं मया सर्वाश्चर्यं समाख्यातं रहस्यं पुरुषोत्तमम् पुराणं परमं गुह्यं धन्यं संसारमोचनम्
verses.transliteration: indradyumnasya māhātmyam etac ca kathitaṃ mayā sarvāścaryaṃ samākhyātaṃ rahasyaṃ puruṣottamam purāṇaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ dhanyaṃ saṃsāramocanam
verses.translation: Everyday, the pure person derives that benefit which is mentioned as the result of perfectly performed pilgrimage, holy rites and observances.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नहि नस् तृप्तिर् अस्तीह शृण्वतां तीर्थविस्तरम् पुनर् एव परं गुह्यं वक्तुम् अर्हस्य् अशेषतः परं तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं सर्वतीर्थोत्तमोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nahi nas tṛptir astīha śṛṇvatāṃ tīrthavistaram punar eva paraṃ guhyaṃ vaktum arhasy aśeṣataḥ paraṃ tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ sarvatīrthottamottamam
verses.translation: A man of perfectly restrained sense-organs obtains everyday the same benefit as one obtains (on other holy centres) after performing different rites of sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इमम् एव पुरा प्रश्नं पृष्टो ऽस्मि द्विजसत्तमाः नारदेन प्रयत्नेन तदा तं प्रोक्तवान् अहम्
verses.transliteration: imam eva purā praśnaṃ pṛṣṭo 'smi dvijasattamāḥ nāradena prayatnena tadā taṃ proktavān aham
verses.translation: Those who abandon their bodies anywhere between the baniyan tree and the Ocean obtain* the greatest liberation which is very difficult to get.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तपसो यज्ञदानानां तीर्थानां पावनं स्मृतम् सर्वं श्रुतं मया त्वत्तो जगद्योने जगत्पते
verses.transliteration: tapaso yajñadānānāṃ tīrthānāṃ pāvanaṃ smṛtam sarvaṃ śrutaṃ mayā tvatto jagadyone jagatpate
verses.translation: Even the animals of low strata of species such as germs, worms, moths etc., attain the greatest salvation by abandon¬ ing their bodies there.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कियन्ति सन्ति तीर्थानि स्वर्गमर्त्यरसातले सर्वेषाम् एव तीर्थानां सर्वदा किं विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: kiyanti santi tīrthāni svargamartyarasātale sarveṣām eva tīrthānāṃ sarvadā kiṃ viśiṣyate
verses.translation: O brahmins, see the illusion of the world in regard to other holy centres. The fruits of all other holy centres are derived from the only holy centre Purusottama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विधानि तीर्थानि स्वर्गे मर्त्ये रसातले दैवानि मुनिशार्दूल आसुराण्य् आरुषाणि च
verses.transliteration: caturvidhāni tīrthāni svarge martye rasātale daivāni muniśārdūla āsurāṇy āruṣāṇi ca
verses.translation: The man who faithfully visits Purusottama for once will become the most excellent man among thousands of men.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मानुषाणि त्रिलोकेषु विख्यातानि सुरादिभिः मानुषेभ्यश् च तीर्थेभ्य आर्षं तीर्थम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: mānuṣāṇi trilokeṣu vikhyātāni surādibhiḥ mānuṣebhyaś ca tīrthebhya ārṣaṃ tīrtham anuttamam
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, one who gives up his body in this holy centre will achieve liberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आर्षेभ्यश् चैव तीर्थेभ्य आसुरं बहुपुण्यदम् आसुरेभ्यस् तथा पुण्यं दैवं तत् सार्वकामिकम्
verses.transliteration: ārṣebhyaś caiva tīrthebhya āsuraṃ bahupuṇyadam āsurebhyas tathā puṇyaṃ daivaṃ tat sārvakāmikam
verses.translation: Who can adequately mention the glory of Puru¬ sottama? Just by visiting the baniyan tree there a man dispels the sin of brahmin slaughter.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवैश् चैव निर्मितं दैवम् उच्यते त्रिभ्यो यद् एकं जायेत तस्मान् नातः परं विदुः
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇuśivaiś caiva nirmitaṃ daivam ucyate tribhyo yad ekaṃ jāyeta tasmān nātaḥ paraṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, if you seek for perpetual salvation,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानां तीर्थं मेध्यम् उदाहृतम् तत्रापि जाम्बवं द्वीपं तीर्थं बहुगुणोदयम्
verses.transliteration: trayāṇām api lokānāṃ tīrthaṃ medhyam udāhṛtam tatrāpi jāmbavaṃ dvīpaṃ tīrthaṃ bahuguṇodayam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Brahma born of the unmani¬ fest one, sages resided there and attained the highest region.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जाम्बवे भारतं वर्षं तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् कर्मभूमिर् यतः पुत्र तस्मात् तीर्थं तद् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: jāmbave bhārataṃ varṣaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam karmabhūmir yataḥ putra tasmāt tīrthaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव यानि तीर्थानि यान्य् उक्तानि मया तव हिमवद्विन्ध्ययोर् मध्ये षण्नद्यो देवसंभवाः
verses.transliteration: tatraiva yāni tīrthāni yāny uktāni mayā tava himavadvindhyayor madhye ṣaṇnadyo devasaṃbhavāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथैव देवजा ब्रह्मन् दक्षिणार्णवविन्ध्ययोः एता द्वादश नद्यस् तु प्राधान्येन प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva devajā brahman dakṣiṇārṇavavindhyayoḥ etā dvādaśa nadyas tu prādhānyena prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अभिसंपूजितं यस्माद् भारतं बहुपुण्यदम् कर्मभूमिर् अतो देवैर् वर्षं तस्मात् प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: abhisaṃpūjitaṃ yasmād bhārataṃ bahupuṇyadam karmabhūmir ato devair varṣaṃ tasmāt prakīrtitam
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आर्षाणि चैव तीर्थानि देवजानि क्वचित् क्वचित् आसुरैर् आवृतान्य् आसंस् तद् एवासुरम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: ārṣāṇi caiva tīrthāni devajāni kvacit kvacit āsurair āvṛtāny āsaṃs tad evāsuram ucyate
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दैवेष्व् एव प्रदेशेषु तपस् तप्त्वा महर्षयः दैवप्रभावात् तपस आर्षाण्य् अपि च तान्य् अपि
verses.transliteration: daiveṣv eva pradeśeṣu tapas taptvā maharṣayaḥ daivaprabhāvāt tapasa ārṣāṇy api ca tāny api
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनः श्रेयसे मुक्त्यै पूजायै भूतये ऽथवा आत्मनः फलभूत्यर्थं यशसो ऽवाप्तये पुनः
verses.transliteration: ātmanaḥ śreyase muktyai pūjāyai bhūtaye 'thavā ātmanaḥ phalabhūtyarthaṃ yaśaso 'vāptaye punaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मानुषैः कारितान्य् आहुर् मानुषाणीति नारद एवं चतुर्विधो भेदस् तीर्थानां मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: mānuṣaiḥ kāritāny āhur mānuṣāṇīti nārada evaṃ caturvidho bhedas tīrthānāṃ munisattama
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भेदं न कश्चिज् जानाति श्रोतुं युक्तो ऽसि नारद बहवः पण्डितंमन्याः शृण्वन्ति कथयन्ति च सुकृती को ऽपि जानाति वक्तुं श्रोतुं निजैर् गुणैः
verses.transliteration: bhedaṃ na kaścij jānāti śrotuṃ yukto 'si nārada bahavaḥ paṇḍitaṃmanyāḥ śṛṇvanti kathayanti ca sukṛtī ko 'pi jānāti vaktuṃ śrotuṃ nijair guṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेषां स्वरूपं भेदं च श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः यच् छ्रुत्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ svarūpaṃ bhedaṃ ca śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ yac chrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मन् कृतयुगादौ तु उपायो ऽन्यो न विद्यते तीर्थसेवां विना स्वल्पायासेनाभीष्टदायिनीम्
verses.transliteration: brahman kṛtayugādau tu upāyo 'nyo na vidyate tīrthasevāṃ vinā svalpāyāsenābhīṣṭadāyinīm
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न त्वया सदृशो धातर् वक्ता ज्ञाताथवा क्वचित् त्वं नाभिकमले विष्णोः संजातो ऽखिलपूर्वजः
verses.transliteration: na tvayā sadṛśo dhātar vaktā jñātāthavā kvacit tvaṃ nābhikamale viṣṇoḥ saṃjāto 'khilapūrvajaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गोदावरी भीमरथी तुङ्गभद्रा च वेणिका तापी पयोउष्णी विन्ध्यस्य दक्षिणे तु प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: godāvarī bhīmarathī tuṅgabhadrā ca veṇikā tāpī payouṣṇī vindhyasya dakṣiṇe tu prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भागीरथी नर्मदा तु यमुना च सरस्वती विशोका च वितस्ता च हिमवत्पर्वताश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: bhāgīrathī narmadā tu yamunā ca sarasvatī viśokā ca vitastā ca himavatparvatāśritāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एता नद्यः पुण्यतमा देवतीर्थान्य् उदाहृताः गयः कोल्लासुरो वृत्रस् त्रिपुरो ह्य् अन्धकस् तथा
verses.transliteration: etā nadyaḥ puṇyatamā devatīrthāny udāhṛtāḥ gayaḥ kollāsuro vṛtras tripuro hy andhakas tathā
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हयमूर्धा च लवणो नमुचिः शृङ्गकस् तथा यमः पातालकेतुश् च मयः पुष्कर एव च
verses.transliteration: hayamūrdhā ca lavaṇo namuciḥ śṛṅgakas tathā yamaḥ pātālaketuś ca mayaḥ puṣkara eva ca
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतैर् आवृततीर्थानि आसुराणि शुभानि च प्रभासो भार्गवो ऽगस्तिर् नरनारायणौ तथा
verses.transliteration: etair āvṛtatīrthāni āsurāṇi śubhāni ca prabhāso bhārgavo 'gastir naranārāyaṇau tathā
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठश् च भरद्वाजो गोतमः कश्यपो मनुः इत्यादिमुनिजुष्टानि ऋषितीर्थानि नारद
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhaś ca bharadvājo gotamaḥ kaśyapo manuḥ ityādimunijuṣṭāni ṛṣitīrthāni nārada
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अम्बरीषो हरिश्चन्द्रो मान्धाता मनुर् एव च कुरुः कनखलश् चैव भद्राश्वः सगरस् तथा
verses.transliteration: ambarīṣo hariścandro māndhātā manur eva ca kuruḥ kanakhalaś caiva bhadrāśvaḥ sagaras tathā
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अश्वयूपो नाचिकेता वृषाकपिर् अरिंदमः इत्यादिमानुषैर् विप्र निर्मितानि शुभानि च
verses.transliteration: aśvayūpo nāciketā vṛṣākapir ariṃdamaḥ ityādimānuṣair vipra nirmitāni śubhāni ca
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यशसः फलभूत्यर्थं निर्मितानीह नारद स्वतोउद्भूतानि दैवानि यत्र क्वापि जगत्त्रये पुण्यतीर्थानि तान्य् आहुस् तीर्थभेदो मयोदितः
verses.transliteration: yaśasaḥ phalabhūtyarthaṃ nirmitānīha nārada svatoudbhūtāni daivāni yatra kvāpi jagattraye puṇyatīrthāni tāny āhus tīrthabhedo mayoditaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रिदैवत्यं तु यत् तीर्थं सर्वेभ्यो ह्य् उक्तम् उत्तमम् तस्य स्वरूपभेदं च विस्तरेण ब्रवीतु मे
verses.transliteration: tridaivatyaṃ tu yat tīrthaṃ sarvebhyo hy uktam uttamam tasya svarūpabhedaṃ ca vistareṇa bravītu me
verses.translation: O leading sages, listen to his interesting story. I shall mention in brief the activities of that sage. During the summer he practised fivefold penance with four fires on the four sides and the sun overhead; during the rainy season he slept on the bare ground; during winter he stood in neck-deep water—thus he performed a great penance.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तावद् अन्यानि तीर्थानि तावत् ताः पुण्यभूमयः तावद् यज्ञादयो यावत् त्रिदैवत्यं न दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: tāvad anyāni tīrthāni tāvat tāḥ puṇyabhūmayaḥ tāvad yajñādayo yāvat tridaivatyaṃ na dṛśyate
verses.translation: On seeing the power of penance of that sage, Devas, Gandharvas, Siddhas and Vidyadharas were struck with wonder. O excellent sages, with the force of his strength Kandu scorched the three worlds, Earth, firmament and heaven. On seeing him engaged in penance Devas said thus:— cc Wonderful is his great courage! Wonderful is his great penance!'
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गेयं सरितां श्रेष्ठा सर्वकामप्रदायिनी त्रिदैवत्या मुनिश्रेष्ठ तदुत्पत्तिम् अतः शृणु
verses.transliteration: gaṅgeyaṃ saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvakāmapradāyinī tridaivatyā muniśreṣṭha tadutpattim ataḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Without excitement they consulted one another. Inclu¬ ding Indra they were bewildered and frightened. Hence, they wanted an obstacle to be putin the way of his penance. O Pramloca, go quickly to the place where this sage is performing penance. O splendid lady, in order to impede his penance make his mind agitated.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वर्षाणाम् अयुतात् पूर्वं देवकार्य उपस्थिते तारको बलवान् आसीन् मद्वराद् अतिगर्वितः
verses.transliteration: varṣāṇām ayutāt pūrvaṃ devakārya upasthite tārako balavān āsīn madvarād atigarvitaḥ
verses.translation: O most excellent Deva, O my lord, I always carry out your behests. But in this matter, I have some doubts. My lif e has to be risked. When he comes to know that I have approached him to create impediment in his penance, sage Kandu of excessive splendour will curse me angrily. It will be unbearable. On hearing her words the consort of SacI said again;— Let others stay by. O splendid lady, you are very clever in this affair.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवानां परमैश्वर्यं हृतं तेन बलीयसा ततस् ते शरणं जग्मुर् देवाः सेन्द्रपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ paramaiśvaryaṃ hṛtaṃ tena balīyasā tatas te śaraṇaṃ jagmur devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ
verses.translation: O lady of fine buttocks, I shall send Kama, Vasanta (Spring) and the gentle breeze to assist you. Go with them to the place where this great sage lives. On hearing the words of Indra that excellent lady of attractive eyes went with them by the aerial path.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदशायिनं देवं जगतां प्रपितामहम् कृताञ्जलिपुटा देवा विष्णुम् ऊचुर् अनन्यगाः
verses.transliteration: kṣīrodaśāyinaṃ devaṃ jagatāṃ prapitāmaham kṛtāñjalipuṭā devā viṣṇum ūcur ananyagāḥ
verses.translation: After going there she saw the excellent and charming forest. She saw the pious sage, seated in the hermitage perform¬ ing his brilliant penance. Along with them, she surveyed the beautiful forest comparable to the Nandana forest. It contained excellent flowers of all seasons. It was agitated by groups of monkeys. Standing on the banks of the river, only a very short distance from him, that excellqnt celestial damsel with the sweetness of the cuckoo in her voice began to sing songs merrily.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वं त्राता जगतां नाथ देवानां कीर्तिवर्धन सर्वेश्वर जगद्योने त्रयीमूर्ते नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ trātā jagatāṃ nātha devānāṃ kīrtivardhana sarveśvara jagadyone trayīmūrte namo 'stu te
verses.translation: An untimely but sweet and charming note of the cuckoo was heard and Vasanta exerted his full force. A gentle breeze withhis abode in the Malaya mountain blew there making the excellent flowers fall down gently into small or big heaps.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लोकस्रष्टासुरान् हन्ता त्वम् एव जगतां पतिः स्थित्युत्पत्तिविनाशानां कारणं त्वं जगन्मय
verses.transliteration: lokasraṣṭāsurān hantā tvam eva jagatāṃ patiḥ sthityutpattivināśānāṃ kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ jaganmaya
verses.translation: Holding the flowery arrows, Kama went near that sage and made his mind agitated. On hearing the sweet sound of the song the sage was surprised and his mind was afflicted by the arrows of Kama. He went to the place where the lady of beautiful eyebrows was standing. O lady of good buttocks, who are you? Whom do you belong to? O fortunate blessed lady of atrractive smiles, you have captivated my mind. O lady of fine eyebrows and slender waist, tell me the truth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्राता न कोप्य् अस्ति जगत्त्रये ऽपि शरीरिणां सर्वविपद्गतानाम् त्वया विना वारिजपत्त्रनेत्र तापत्रयाणां शरणं न चान्यत्
verses.transliteration: trātā na kopy asti jagattraye 'pi śarīriṇāṃ sarvavipadgatānām tvayā vinā vārijapattranetra tāpatrayāṇāṃ śaraṇaṃ na cānyat
verses.translation: I have come here to collect flowers. I am your servant- maid. Command me quickly? What shall I do at your bidding? On hearing her words the sage lost his courage. He
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पिता च माता जगतो ऽखिलस्य त्वम् एव सेवासुलभो ऽसि विष्णो प्रसीद पाहीश महाभयेभ्यो श्मदार्तिहन्ता वद कस् त्वदन्यः
verses.transliteration: pitā ca mātā jagato 'khilasya tvam eva sevāsulabho 'si viṣṇo prasīda pāhīśa mahābhayebhyo śmadārtihantā vada kas tvadanyaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, then Cupid, Spring, Breeze became satisfied. They returned to heaven. After going there they spoke to lndra of their activities, on hearing which lndra and Devas became delighted. Immediately after entering the hermitage sage Kandu assumed a very beautiful form like that of a Cupid.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आदिकर्ता वराहस् त्वं मत्स्यः कूर्मस् तथैव च इत्यादिरूपभेदैर् नो रक्षसे भय आगते
verses.transliteration: ādikartā varāhas tvaṃ matsyaḥ kūrmas tathaiva ca ityādirūpabhedair no rakṣase bhaya āgate
verses.translation: Suddenly, due to the power of his penance he assumed a form clad in divine garments, and beautified with divine garlands and unguents. It was lovely and capable of enjoying all pleasures. The sage Kandu engaged himself in vulgar sexual intercourse with her. Many hundreds of years he stayed with her in the valley of the Mandara mountain.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हृतस्वाम्यान् सुरगणान् हृतदारान् गतापदः कस्मान् न रक्षसे देव अनन्यशरणान् हरे
verses.transliteration: hṛtasvāmyān suragaṇān hṛtadārān gatāpadaḥ kasmān na rakṣase deva ananyaśaraṇān hare
verses.translation: Once she said to that highly blessed sage—"O brahmin, I wish to go to heaven. It behoves you to permit me with a pleasant face." Thus requested by her that sage whose mind was fondly attached to her said— cc O gentle lady, please stay for a few days more." Thus requested by him that slender-framed lady enjoyed sexual pleasures in the company of that noble sage for a further period of a hundred and odd years,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रोवाच भगवाञ् शेषशायी जगत्पतिः कस्माच् च भयम् आपन्नं तद् ब्रुवन्तु गतज्वराः ततः श्रियः पतिं प्राहुस् तं तारकवधं प्रति
verses.transliteration: tataḥ provāca bhagavāñ śeṣaśāyī jagatpatiḥ kasmāc ca bhayam āpannaṃ tad bruvantu gatajvarāḥ tataḥ śriyaḥ patiṃ prāhus taṃ tārakavadhaṃ prati
verses.translation: When requested by her thus— <c O holy sir, please When a further period of more than a hundred years elapsed, that splendid-faced lady said with a lovely smile of great endearment-"0 brahmin I am going to heaven".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तारकाद् भयम् आपन्नं भीषणं रोमहर्षणम् न युद्धैस् तपसा शापैर् हन्तुं नैव क्षमा वयम्
verses.transliteration: tārakād bhayam āpannaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ romaharṣaṇam na yuddhais tapasā śāpair hantuṃ naiva kṣamā vayam
verses.translation: When urged by her thus, the sage said to that lady of large eyes—"O lady of beautiful eyebrows, stay with me for a long time more: you will go later to heaven." Frightened of being cursed by that sage, the lady of fine buttocks stayed with him for a further period of slightly less than two hundred years. Repeatedly requested by that lady for permission to go to heaven that highly blessed sage merely said— < "Stay further".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अर्वाग्दशाहाद् यो बालस् तस्मान् मृत्युम् अवाप्स्यति तस्माद् देव न चान्येभ्यस् तत्र नीतिर् विधीयताम्
verses.transliteration: arvāgdaśāhād yo bālas tasmān mṛtyum avāpsyati tasmād deva na cānyebhyas tatra nītir vidhīyatām
verses.translation: The great sage sported and diverted himself with her, day and night, with his mind overwhelmed by cupid. The more he indulged himself the fresher became the ways of expressing his affection. Once the sage went out of his hut in a great hurry. As he rushed out the splendid lady said—"Pray, where do you go?' 5
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् नारायणः प्राह नाहं बलोत्कटः सुराः न मत्तो मदपत्याच् च न देवेभ्यो वधो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: punar nārāyaṇaḥ prāha nāhaṃ balotkaṭaḥ surāḥ na matto madapatyāc ca na devebhyo vadho bhavet
verses.translation: When asked by her thus he said— cc O auspicious lady, the day is coming to a close. I shall say my prayers for the dusk. Otherwise, it will be a great omission of my holy rites." The delighted lady then laughed and said to the sage— "is it only now; O sage conversant with all holy rites, that the day is coming to a close? Has it not passed of many times before?" "O brahmin, this is true that I came here in a morning. It is not false. But hundreds of years have passed by, since I came to you."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वराद् यदि जायेत अपत्यं बहुशक्तिकम् तस्माद् वधम् अवाप्नोति तारको लोकदारुणः
verses.transliteration: īśvarād yadi jāyeta apatyaṃ bahuśaktikam tasmād vadham avāpnoti tārako lokadāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, the brahmin asked the lady of large eyes in great perturbation—"O timid lady, even as I was engaged in dalliance with you, what period of time did pass by?" "Nine hundred, seven years, six months and three days have passed ofF till date."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् गच्छामः सुराः सर्वे यतितुम् ऋषिभिः सह भार्यार्थं प्रथमो यत्नः कर्तव्यः प्रभविष्णुभिः
verses.transliteration: tad gacchāmaḥ surāḥ sarve yatitum ṛṣibhiḥ saha bhāryārthaṃ prathamo yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ prabhaviṣṇubhiḥ
verses.translation: "O timid lady, arc you telling me the truth or are you jesting with me? I think I have stayed here with you only for a day." "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?" O excellent brahmins, on hearing her words thatsage censured himself saying—"Fie upon me who have not adhered to disciplined good conduct.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सुरगणा जग्मुस् ते च नगोत्तमम् हिमवन्तं रत्नमयं मेनां च हिमवत्प्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā suragaṇā jagmus te ca nagottamam himavantaṃ ratnamayaṃ menāṃ ca himavatpriyām
verses.translation: After censuring himself thus, that sage conversant with piety spoke these words to tlxat celestial damsel who was seated there. O sinful lady, go away as you please. The task of the king of Dcvas has been duly accomplished by you by causing perturbation in me through your amorous gestures.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इदम् ऊचुः सर्व एव सभार्यं तुहिनं गिरिम्
verses.transliteration: idam ūcuḥ sarva eva sabhāryaṃ tuhinaṃ girim
verses.translation: Wastage of my austerities has been brought about by you who seek the favour of Indra. Fie upon you the despicable one, the cause of great delusion. When that brahminical sage said this to that lady of fine waist, she trembled excessively and perspired profusely. Rebuked by him she went out of his hermitage and traversing the path of firmament she mopped off her sweat drops by the sprouts of trees.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दाक्षायणी लोकमाता या शक्तिः संस्थिता गिरौ बुद्धिः प्रज्ञा धृतिर् मेधा लज्जा पुष्टिः सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: dākṣāyaṇī lokamātā yā śaktiḥ saṃsthitā girau buddhiḥ prajñā dhṛtir medhā lajjā puṣṭiḥ sarasvatī
verses.translation: The young damsel moved from tree to tree. She wiped off her body from which perspiration flowed in profuse drops. With the pink sprouts she mopped off the sweat drops. The foetus that had been implanted in her body by
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं त्व् अनेकधा लोके या स्थिता लोकपावनी देवानां कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं युवयोर् गर्भम् आविशत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tv anekadhā loke yā sthitā lokapāvanī devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ yuvayor garbham āviśat
verses.translation: Trees took up that foetus and unified it in a body. One can befriend a person by seven steps together: She became the lovely-eyed daughter of trees, Marisa by name. O brahmins, it was she who became the wife of Prace- tas and the mother of Daksa.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: समुत्पन्ना जगन्माता शंभोः पत्नी भविष्यति अस्माकं भवतां चापि पालनी च भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: samutpannā jaganmātā śaṃbhoḥ patnī bhaviṣyati asmākaṃ bhavatāṃ cāpi pālanī ca bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: - As soon as he saw the holy centre and lord Purusot¬ tama, the excellent sage considered himself contented as one who had fulfilled his duties. There he sat with fully concentrated mind and pro¬ pitiated Hari. The excellent sage, a great Yogin stood with his arms lifted up. With a singlcminded attention he performed Japa (repetition of holy names) of Brahmapara (Brahman the great redeemer).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हिमवान् अपि तद् वाक्यं सुराणाम् अभिनन्द्य च मेना चापि महोत्साहा अस्त्व् इत्य् एवं वचो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: himavān api tad vākyaṃ surāṇām abhinandya ca menā cāpi mahotsāhā astv ity evaṃ vaco 'bravīt
verses.translation: O sage, we wish to hear about the excellent and great Brahmapara whereby lord Kesava was propitiated by Kandu who performed this Japa. O sage, mention to me the greatest task that is thought of by you in your mind. I have come to you as the bestower of boons. O sage of good holy rites, choose the boon. O Narayana, O Hari O Krsna, O lord of the universe with the Srlvatsa scar, O seed of the universe, O abode of the universe, O witness of the universe, obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदोत्पन्ना जगद्धात्री गौरी हिमवतो गृहे शिवध्यानरता नित्यं तन्निष्ठा तन्मनोगता
verses.transliteration: tadotpannā jagaddhātrī gaurī himavato gṛhe śivadhyānaratā nityaṃ tanniṣṭhā tanmanogatā
verses.translation: O unmanifest one, O victorious one, O source of origin, O chief Purusottama, O lotus-eyed one, O Govinda, O lord of the worlds, obeisance be to you. O golden-wombed one, O abode of Sri, O deity wit the umbilical lotus, O eternal one, O deity with the Earth in the womb, O steadfast one, O Isana, O Hrsikesa, obeisance be to
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तां वै प्रोचुः सुरगणा ईशार्थे तप आविश तथा हिमवतः पृष्ठे गौरी तेपे तपो महत्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ vai procuḥ suragaṇā īśārthe tapa āviśa tathā himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe gaurī tepe tapo mahat
verses.translation: O deity without beginning and end, O immortal and O deity with the Yogic Atman, O incomprehensi e O excellent one, O bestower of boons, O infinite one O source of origin of Brahma, O mine of good qualities, O lord of dissolution, origin and contact, O Vasudeva, obeisance be to
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनः संमन्त्रयाम् आसुर् ईशो ध्यायति तां शिवाम् आत्मानं वा तथान्यद् वा न जानीमः कथं भवः
verses.transliteration: punaḥ saṃmantrayām āsur īśo dhyāyati tāṃ śivām ātmānaṃ vā tathānyad vā na jānīmaḥ kathaṃ bhavaḥ
verses.translation: O Parjanya (Lord of Rain), O maker of holy rites, OBhutapa (lord of Elements), O unmanifest one, O deity not agitated by the elements and principles, O abode of living beings, O soul of living beings. O deity containing living beings in the womb, obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मेनकायाः सुतायां तु चित्तं दध्यात् सुरेश्वरः तत्र नीतिर् विधातव्या ततः श्रैष्ठ्यम् अवाप्स्यथ ततः प्राह महाबुद्धिर् वाचस्पतिर् उदारधीः
verses.transliteration: menakāyāḥ sutāyāṃ tu cittaṃ dadhyāt sureśvaraḥ tatra nītir vidhātavyā tataḥ śraiṣṭhyam avāpsyatha tataḥ prāha mahābuddhir vācaspatir udāradhīḥ
verses.translation: O performer of Yajhas, O upholder of Yajnas, O crea¬ tor ofYajnas; O bestower of fearlessness; O deity with the Yajna in the womb (?), O golden-limbcd one, O deity born of Devaki, obeisance be to you. You are the knower of Ksetra (Physical form, holy centre) you are the holder Ksetra; you possess Ksetra; you are the destroyer of Ksetra; you arc the maker of Ksetra; you have selfcontrol; O soul of Ksetra, O deity devoid of Ksetra, obei¬ sance be to you, the creator of Ksetra. O abode of good qualities, O receptacle of good quali¬ ties, O support of good qualities; O deity who are conducive to good qualities; O enjoyer of good qualities; O garden of good qualities; O deity who abandon good qualities (i.e. attributes), obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस् त्व् अयं मदनो धीमान् कन्दर्पः पुष्पचापधृक् स विध्यतु शिवं शान्तं बाणैः पुष्पमयैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: yas tv ayaṃ madano dhīmān kandarpaḥ puṣpacāpadhṛk sa vidhyatu śivaṃ śāntaṃ bāṇaiḥ puṣpamayaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: You are Visnu; you are Hari; you are the discus¬ bearing lord; you areJisnu (victorious); you are Janardana; you are the Element; and the Vasatkara; you are the future one, the lord of the present one. You are the creator of the Bhutas (living beings); you are the unmanifest one; You are Bhava (source of origin); you are the holder of Bhutas. You are lord conceiver and creator of Bhutas. They call you the unborn overlord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेन विद्धस् त्रिनेत्रो ऽपि ईशायां बुद्धिम् आदधेत् परिणेष्यत्य् असौ नूनं तदा तां गिरिजां हरः
verses.transliteration: tena viddhas trinetro 'pi īśāyāṃ buddhim ādadhet pariṇeṣyaty asau nūnaṃ tadā tāṃ girijāṃ haraḥ
verses.translation: You arc the sun; you are the Omkara, you are the vital breath; you are the dispeller of darkness; you are Parjanya (god of Rain); you are well reputed; you arc Brahma; you are Indra, lord of Devas. You are Rk. Yajus and Saman; you are Atman; you arc the honoured and approved one, you are fire and wind; you are Kubera; you arc Havis (ghee offering). You are the creator; you are the enjoyer; you are the Hotf (one who performs Homa offerings), you are Havis (obla¬ tion) Kratu (sacrifice); you are the poet, you are Hari; you are the most excellent lord of worlds; you are Acyuta.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जयिनः पञ्चबाणस्य न बाणाः क्वापि कुण्ठिताः तथोढायां जगद्धात्र्यां शंभोः पुत्रो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: jayinaḥ pañcabāṇasya na bāṇāḥ kvāpi kuṇṭhitāḥ tathoḍhāyāṃ jagaddhātryāṃ śaṃbhoḥ putro bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: You are the glorious deity with the vision of every¬ thing; you are the destroyer of enemies suppressing everyone; you are the day; similarly, you are the night; learned men call you Vatsara (year). You are the units of time such as Kala; Kastha, Muhurta, Ksana and Lava; you are a boy; you are an old man; you are man, woman and eunuch.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जातः पुत्रस् त्रिनेत्रस्य तारकं स हनिष्यति वसन्तं च सहायार्थं शोभिष्ठं कुसुमाकरम्
verses.transliteration: jātaḥ putras trinetrasya tārakaṃ sa haniṣyati vasantaṃ ca sahāyārthaṃ śobhiṣṭhaṃ kusumākaram
verses.translation: You arc Atman the support of all (?) You are not per¬ ceptible to sense-organs. You are Agranl (leader); you are Gramani (leader of groups); you are Suparna (Garuda); you are one without a beginning, you are the collection; you are very great, you are one who held the Atman; you are Acyuta (unswerving). You are Yama; (Restraint); you are Niyama (observ¬ ance of regulations); you are lofty; you are four-armed; you alone are the cooked rice and the immanent soul; you are men¬ tioned as the greatest Atman.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आह्लादनं च मनसा कामायैनं प्रयच्छथ
verses.transliteration: āhlādanaṃ ca manasā kāmāyainaṃ prayacchatha
verses.translation: You are the preceptor and the weighty one; you are the weightier being; you are the left one (adverse one); you are the right one (the favourable one, clever one); you are Pippala (a variety of medicinal plant), you are one who do not go, you are the manifest one; you are the Prajapati (patriarch). You arc one with golden umbilicus; you are the lord; you are the moon; you are one whose physical form cannot be specifically pointed out; you are Yama; you are the destroyer of the enemies ofDcvas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सुरगणा मदनं कुसुमाकरम् प्रेषयाम् आसुर् अव्यग्राः शिवान्तिकम् अरिंदमाः
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā suragaṇā madanaṃ kusumākaram preṣayām āsur avyagrāḥ śivāntikam ariṃdamāḥ
verses.translation: You are lord Samkarsana; you are the eternal maker; you are Vasudeva of unmeasurable soul; you alone are one devoid of attributes. You are the eldest; you are the most excellent; you are one who endure; you are Madhava; you are thousand-headed lord; you are unmanifcst one with thousand Visions. You are the thousand-footed lord, you are Virat (Immense Being); you are the lord ofDevas; O lord of Dcvas; you alone stand ten Angulas beyond all.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स जगाम त्वरा कामो धृतचापो समाधवः रत्या च सहितः कामः कर्तुं कर्म सुदुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: sa jagāma tvarā kāmo dhṛtacāpo samādhavaḥ ratyā ca sahitaḥ kāmaḥ kartuṃ karma suduṣkaram
verses.translation: A fourth part of yours constitutes the Universe; your nine parts are immortal in heaven; nine parts are stationed in the firmament; this part is the eternal manly being. Two of your parts are stationed on the Earth; four parts were also here. (?) Yajnas originate from you, the cause of rain in the world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वा सशरं चापम् इदं तस्य मनो ऽभवत् मया वेध्यस् त्व् अवेध्यो वै शंभुर् लोकगुरुः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: gṛhītvā saśaraṃ cāpam idaṃ tasya mano 'bhavat mayā vedhyas tv avedhyo vai śaṃbhur lokaguruḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: The Virat (Immense Being) originated from you; it is the Man who is in the heart of the universe; he excelled the elements by splendour, fam e and glory. You are devoted to what should be meditated upon and the meditation; you created the medicinal herbs. O lord of Dcvas, having seven faces you are named Kala; you have an illuminated physical form. O lord, the most excellent one among Devas, the greatest refuge of the worlds you are Aniruddha, you are Madhava, you arc Pradyumna the destroyer of the enemies of
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यजयिनो बाणाः शंभौ मे किं दृढा न वा तेनासौ चाग्निनेत्रेण भस्मशेषस् तदा कृतः
verses.transliteration: trailokyajayino bāṇāḥ śaṃbhau me kiṃ dṛḍhā na vā tenāsau cāgninetreṇa bhasmaśeṣas tadā kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O lotus-eyed deity, save me 0 Narayana, obeisance to you. O Puru?ottama, obeisance to you. Obeisance to you, O lord of worlds, obeisance to you the abode of LaksmI; obeisance to you, O abode of attributes; obeisance be to you; O mine of good qualities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् एव कर्म सुदृढम् ईक्षितुं सुरसत्तमाः आजग्मुस् तत्र यद् वृत्तं शृणु विस्मयकारकम्
verses.transliteration: tad eva karma sudṛḍham īkṣituṃ surasattamāḥ ājagmus tatra yad vṛttaṃ śṛṇu vismayakārakam
verses.translation: O Vasudeva, obeisance be to you. O most excellent Deva, obeisance be to you. O Janardana, obeisance be to you; O eternal one, obeisance be to you. Obeisance to you O deity comprehensible to the Yogins; O abode of Yoga, obeisance be to you. O lord of LaksmI; O lord of universe, obeisance be to you. O lord of the universe, O source of origin of the uni¬
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शंभुं दृष्ट्वा सुरगणा यावत् पश्यन्ति मन्मथम् तावच् च भस्मसाद्भूतं कामं दृष्ट्वा भयातुराः तुष्टुवुस् त्रिदशेशानं कृताञ्जलिपुटाः सुराः
verses.transliteration: śaṃbhuṃ dṛṣṭvā suragaṇā yāvat paśyanti manmatham tāvac ca bhasmasādbhūtaṃ kāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayāturāḥ tuṣṭuvus tridaśeśānaṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, to the slayer of Madhu; O lotus¬ eyed one, obeisance to you; O destroyer ofKaitabha, obeisance be to you; O Subrahmanya (Excessively favourable to the brahmins). Obeisance be to you. O great Fish, obeisance be to you. O Acyuta, holding
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तारकाद् भयम् आपन्नं कुरु पत्नीं गिरेः सुताम्
verses.transliteration: tārakād bhayam āpannaṃ kuru patnīṃ gireḥ sutām
verses.translation: O Horse-headed deity of great snout, O deity, having the great manly frame, O Horse-faced deity, obeisance to you the annihilator of Madhu and Kaitabha. Obeisance to you, to the great tortoise, to the deity with the great body of a tortoise, to the deity who lifted up e Earth, to that form that held the mountain aloft. Obeisance to the great Varaha (Boar), to (the deity)
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विद्धचित्तो हरो ऽप्य् आशु मेने वाक्यं सुरोदितम् अरुन्धतीं वसिष्ठं च मां तु चक्रधरं तथा
verses.transliteration: viddhacitto haro 'py āśu mene vākyaṃ suroditam arundhatīṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca māṃ tu cakradharaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Obeisance to the infinite one, to the subtle one, chief one, to the most excellent one. Obeisance to you of the form of the atom, to one comprehensible to the yogins. Obeisance to the greatest cause of causes; to the abode of the circle of leading Yogins; to the being very difficult to be known. Obeisance to you who lie down on the couch of the great serpent stationed in the milky ocean; obeisance to the deity with fine ear rings made of gold and studded with jewels.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रेषयाम् आसुर् अमरा विवाहाय परस्परम् संबन्धो ऽपि तथाप्य् आसीद् धिमवल्लोकनाथयोः
verses.transliteration: preṣayām āsur amarā vivāhāya parasparam saṃbandho 'pi tathāpy āsīd dhimavallokanāthayoḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, after saying thus to him, Visnu the lord After he had gone, O excellent sages, Kandu eschew¬ ed all lustful desires. He became delighted in his mind and he attained a proper mental quietude. He who reads or listens to the story of the noble Kandu shall be liberated from sins. He goes to the heavenly world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हिमवत्पर्वते श्रेष्ठे नानारत्नविचित्रिते नानावृक्षलताकीर्णे नानाद्विजनिषेविते
verses.transliteration: himavatparvate śreṣṭhe nānāratnavicitrite nānāvṛkṣalatākīrṇe nānādvijaniṣevite
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Vyasa, the sages of restrained sense-organs became satisfied, delighted and struck with wonder again and again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नदीनदसरःकूपतडागादिभिर् आवृते देवगन्धर्वयक्षादिसिद्धचारणसेविते
verses.transliteration: nadīnadasaraḥkūpataḍāgādibhir āvṛte devagandharvayakṣādisiddhacāraṇasevite
verses.translation: Wonderful indeed are the attributes of the sub continent Bharata mentioned by you. So also of the shrine named Sri- purusa in the holy centre Purusottama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शुभमारुतसंपन्ने हर्षोत्कर्षैककारणे मेरुमन्दरकैलासमैनाकादिनगैर् वृते
verses.transliteration: śubhamārutasaṃpanne harṣotkarṣaikakāraṇe merumandarakailāsamainākādinagair vṛte
verses.translation: ' O sage, the most excellent among eloquent ones, who will not be delighted and surprised on hearing about the excellent greatness of the shrine named Purusa?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठागस्त्यपौलस्त्यलोमशादिभिर् आवृते महोत्सवे वर्तमाने विवाहः समजायत
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhāgastyapaulastyalomaśādibhir āvṛte mahotsave vartamāne vivāhaḥ samajāyata
verses.translation: Why were the heroic Krsna and Sankarsana (Balarama) born in the house of Vasudeva? Why was she too born in that house there, O sage?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र वेदी रत्नमयी शोभिता स्वर्णभूषिता वज्रमाणिक्यवैदूर्यतन्मयस्तम्भशोभिता
verses.transliteration: tatra vedī ratnamayī śobhitā svarṇabhūṣitā vajramāṇikyavaidūryatanmayastambhaśobhitā
verses.translation: O sage, the most excellent among the eloquent ones, recount to us in detail the activities that they pursued on being born on the Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जयालक्ष्मीशुभाक्षान्तिकीर्तिपुष्ट्यादिसंवृता मेरुमन्दरकैलासरैवतैः परिशोभितैः
verses.transliteration: jayālakṣmīśubhākṣāntikīrtipuṣṭyādisaṃvṛtā merumandarakailāsaraivataiḥ pariśobhitaiḥ
verses.translation: Tarakamaya: a war which arose in consequence of Soma (Moon) havin carried ofFTara, the wife of Brhaspati.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूजितो लोकनाथेन विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना मैनाकः पर्वतश्रेष्ठो रेजे ऽतीव हिरण्मयः
verses.transliteration: pūjito lokanāthena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā mainākaḥ parvataśreṣṭho reje 'tīva hiraṇmayaḥ
verses.translation: Tarakamaya: a war which arose in consequence of Soma (Moon) havin carried ofFTara, the wife of Brhaspati.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयो लोकपालाश् च आदित्याः समरुद्गणाः विवाहे वेदिकां चक्रुर् देवदेवस्य शूलिनः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayo lokapālāś ca ādityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ vivāhe vedikāṃ cakrur devadevasya śūlinaḥ
verses.translation: Tarakamaya: a war which arose in consequence of Soma (Moon) havin carried ofFTara, the wife of Brhaspati.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वकर्मा स्वयं त्वष्टा वेदीं चक्रे सतोरणाम् सुरभी नन्दिनी नन्दा सुनन्दा कामदोहिनी
verses.transliteration: viśvakarmā svayaṃ tvaṣṭā vedīṃ cakre satoraṇām surabhī nandinī nandā sunandā kāmadohinī
verses.translation: Tarakamaya: a war which arose in consequence of Soma (Moon) havin carried ofFTara, the wife of Brhaspati.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आभिस् तु शोभितेशान्या विवाहः समजायत समुद्राः सरितो नागा ओषध्यो लोकमातरः
verses.transliteration: ābhis tu śobhiteśānyā vivāhaḥ samajāyata samudrāḥ sarito nāgā oṣadhyo lokamātaraḥ
verses.translation: Tarakamaya: a war which arose in consequence of Soma (Moon) havin carried ofFTara, the wife of Brhaspati.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सवनस्पतिबीजाश् च सर्वे तत्र समाययुः भुवः कर्म इला चक्रे ओषध्यस् त्व् अन्नकर्म च
verses.transliteration: savanaspatibījāś ca sarve tatra samāyayuḥ bhuvaḥ karma ilā cakre oṣadhyas tv annakarma ca
verses.translation: Tarakamaya: a war which arose in consequence of Soma (Moon) havin carried ofFTara, the wife of Brhaspati.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वरुणः पानकर्माणि दानकर्म धनाधिपः अग्निश् चकार तत्रान्नं यच् चेष्टं लोकनाथयोः
verses.transliteration: varuṇaḥ pānakarmāṇi dānakarma dhanādhipaḥ agniś cakāra tatrānnaṃ yac ceṣṭaṃ lokanāthayoḥ
verses.translation: Tarakamaya: a war which arose in consequence of Soma (Moon) havin carried ofFTara, the wife of Brhaspati.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: lajjayā kaluṣībhūtaḥ skannaṃ vīryam acūrṇayam madvīryāc cūrṇitāt sūkṣmād vālakhilyās tu jajñire

verses.transliteration: etad evāmṛtaṃ loke naitasmāt pāvanaṃ param mayābhimantritaṃ brahman gṛhāṇemaṃ kamaṇḍalum

verses.sanskrit: अत्रत्यं वारि यः कश्चित् स्मरेद् अपि पठेद् अपि स सर्वकामान् आप्नोति गृहाणेमं कमण्डलुम्
verses.transliteration: atratyaṃ vāri yaḥ kaścit smared api paṭhed api sa sarvakāmān āpnoti gṛhāṇemaṃ kamaṇḍalum

verses.sanskrit: भूतेभ्यश् चापि पञ्चभ्य आपो भूतं महोदितम् तासाम् उत्कृष्टम् एतस्माद् गृहाणेमं कमण्डलुम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtebhyaś cāpi pañcabhya āpo bhūtaṃ mahoditam tāsām utkṛṣṭam etasmād gṛhāṇemaṃ kamaṇḍalum

verses.sanskrit: अत्र यद् वारि शोभिष्ठं पुण्यं पावनम् एव च स्पृष्ट्वा स्मृत्वा च दृष्ट्वा च ब्रह्मन् पापाद् विमोक्ष्यसे
verses.transliteration: atra yad vāri śobhiṣṭhaṃ puṇyaṃ pāvanam eva ca spṛṣṭvā smṛtvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca brahman pāpād vimokṣyase

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा महादेवः प्रादान् मम कमण्डलुम् ततः सुरगणाः सर्वे भक्त्या प्रोचुः सुरेश्वरम् आह्लादश् च महांस् तत्र जयशब्दो व्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā mahādevaḥ prādān mama kamaṇḍalum tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve bhaktyā procuḥ sureśvaram āhlādaś ca mahāṃs tatra jayaśabdo vyavartata
verses.translation: Tarakamaya: a war which arose in consequence of Soma (Moon) havin carried ofFTara, the wife of Brhaspati.

verses.sanskrit: देवोत्सवे मातुर् अजः पदाग्रं समीक्ष्य पापात् पतितत्वम् आप प्रादात् कृपालुः स्मरणात् पवित्रां गङ्गां पिता पुण्यकमण्डलुस्थाम्
verses.transliteration: devotsave mātur ajaḥ padāgraṃ samīkṣya pāpāt patitatvam āpa prādāt kṛpāluḥ smaraṇāt pavitrāṃ gaṅgāṃ pitā puṇyakamaṇḍalusthām
verses.translation: Tarakamaya: a war which arose in consequence of Soma (Moon) havin carried ofFTara, the wife of Brhaspati.

verses.sanskrit: कमण्डलुस्थिता देवी तव पुण्यविवर्धिनी यथा मर्त्यं गता नाथ तन् मे विस्तरतो वद
verses.transliteration: kamaṇḍalusthitā devī tava puṇyavivardhinī yathā martyaṃ gatā nātha tan me vistarato vada
verses.translation: Immediately after entering the hermitage sage Kandu assumed a very beautiful form like that of a Cupid.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बलिर् नाम महादैत्यो देवारिर् अपराजितः धर्मेण यशसा चैव प्रजासंरक्षणेन च
verses.transliteration: balir nāma mahādaityo devārir aparājitaḥ dharmeṇa yaśasā caiva prajāsaṃrakṣaṇena ca
verses.translation: Suddenly, due to the power of his penance he assumed a form clad in divine garments, and beautified with divine garlands and unguents. It was lovely and capable of enjoying all pleasures.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गुरुभक्त्या च सत्येन वीर्येण च बलेन च त्यागेन क्षमया चैव त्रैलोक्ये नोपमीयते
verses.transliteration: gurubhaktyā ca satyena vīryeṇa ca balena ca tyāgena kṣamayā caiva trailokye nopamīyate
verses.translation: The sage Kandu engaged himself in vulgar sexual intercourse with her. Many hundreds of years he stayed with her in the valley of the Mandara mountain.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यर्द्धिम् उन्नतां दृष्ट्वा देवाश् चिन्तापरायणाः मिथः समूचुर् अमरा जेष्यामो वै कथं बलिम्
verses.transliteration: tasyarddhim unnatāṃ dṛṣṭvā devāś cintāparāyaṇāḥ mithaḥ samūcur amarā jeṣyāmo vai kathaṃ balim
verses.translation: Once she said to that highly blessed sage—"O brahmin, I wish to go to heaven. It behoves you to permit me with a pleasant face."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिञ् शासति राज्यं तु त्रैलोक्यं हतकण्टकम् नारयो व्याधयो वापि नाधयो वा कथंचन
verses.transliteration: tasmiñ śāsati rājyaṃ tu trailokyaṃ hatakaṇṭakam nārayo vyādhayo vāpi nādhayo vā kathaṃcana
verses.translation: Thus requested by her that sage whose mind was fondly attached to her said— cc O gentle lady, please stay for a few days more."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनावृष्टिर् अधर्मो वा नास्तिशब्दो न दुर्जनः स्वप्ने ऽपि नैव दृश्येत बलौ राज्यं प्रशासति
verses.transliteration: anāvṛṣṭir adharmo vā nāstiśabdo na durjanaḥ svapne 'pi naiva dṛśyeta balau rājyaṃ praśāsati
verses.translation: Thus requested by him that slender-framed lady enjoyed sexual pleasures in the company of that noble sage for a further period of a hundred and odd years,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्योन्नतिशरैर् भग्नाः कीर्तिखड्गद्विधाकृताः तस्याज्ञाशक्तिभिन्नाङ्गा देवाः शर्म न लेभिरे
verses.transliteration: tasyonnatiśarair bhagnāḥ kīrtikhaḍgadvidhākṛtāḥ tasyājñāśaktibhinnāṅgā devāḥ śarma na lebhire
verses.translation: When requested by her thus— <c O holy sir, please
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः संमन्त्रयाम् आसुः कृत्वा मात्सर्यम् अग्रतः तद्यशोग्निप्रदीप्ताङ्गा विष्णुं जग्मुः सुविह्वलाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃmantrayām āsuḥ kṛtvā mātsaryam agrataḥ tadyaśognipradīptāṅgā viṣṇuṃ jagmuḥ suvihvalāḥ
verses.translation: When a further period of more than a hundred years elapsed, that splendid-faced lady said with a lovely smile of great endearment-"0 brahmin I am going to heaven".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आर्ताः स्म गतसत्त्वाः स्म शङ्खचक्रगदाधर अस्मदर्थे भवान् नित्यम् आयुधानि बिभर्ति च
verses.transliteration: ārtāḥ sma gatasattvāḥ sma śaṅkhacakragadādhara asmadarthe bhavān nityam āyudhāni bibharti ca
verses.translation: When urged by her thus, the sage said to that lady of large eyes—"O lady of beautiful eyebrows, stay with me for a long time more: you will go later to heaven."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वयि नाथे जगन्नाथ अस्माकं दुःखम् ईदृशम् त्वां तु प्रणमती वाणी कथं दैत्यं नमस्यति
verses.transliteration: tvayi nāthe jagannātha asmākaṃ duḥkham īdṛśam tvāṃ tu praṇamatī vāṇī kathaṃ daityaṃ namasyati
verses.translation: Frightened of being cursed by that sage, the lady of fine buttocks stayed with him for a further period of slightly less than two hundred years.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा त्वाम् एव शरणं गताः त्वदङ्घ्रिशरणाः सन्तः कथं दैत्यं नमेमहि
verses.transliteration: manasā karmaṇā vācā tvām eva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ tvadaṅghriśaraṇāḥ santaḥ kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi
verses.translation: Repeatedly requested by that lady for permission to go to heaven that highly blessed sage merely said— < "Stay further".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यजामस् त्वां महायज्ञैर् वदामो वाग्भिर् अच्युत त्वदेकशरणाः सन्तः कथं दैत्यं नमेमहि
verses.transliteration: yajāmas tvāṃ mahāyajñair vadāmo vāgbhir acyuta tvadekaśaraṇāḥ santaḥ kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi
verses.translation: The great sage sported and diverted himself with her, day and night, with his mind overwhelmed by cupid. The more he indulged himself the fresher became the ways of expressing his affection.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्वीर्यम् आश्रिता नित्यं देवाः सेन्द्रपुरोगमाः त्वया दत्तं पदं प्राप्य कथं दैत्यं नमेमहि
verses.transliteration: tvadvīryam āśritā nityaṃ devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ tvayā dattaṃ padaṃ prāpya kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi
verses.translation: Once the sage went out of his hut in a great hurry. As he rushed out the splendid lady said—"Pray, where do you go?' 5
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्रष्टा त्वं ब्रह्ममूर्त्या तु विष्णुर् भूत्वा तु रक्षसि संहर्ता रुद्रशक्त्या त्वं कथं दैत्यं नमेमहि
verses.transliteration: sraṣṭā tvaṃ brahmamūrtyā tu viṣṇur bhūtvā tu rakṣasi saṃhartā rudraśaktyā tvaṃ kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi
verses.translation: When asked by her thus he said— cc O auspicious lady, the day is coming to a close. I shall say my prayers for the dusk. Otherwise, it will be a great omission of my holy rites."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऐश्वर्यं कारणं लोके विनैश्वर्यं तु किं फलम् हतैश्वर्याः सुरेशान कथं दैत्यं नमेमहि
verses.transliteration: aiśvaryaṃ kāraṇaṃ loke vinaiśvaryaṃ tu kiṃ phalam hataiśvaryāḥ sureśāna kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi
verses.translation: The delighted lady then laughed and said to the sage— "is it only now; O sage conversant with all holy rites, that the day is coming to a close? Has it not passed of many times before?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनादिस् त्वं जगद्धातर् अनन्तस् त्वं जगद्गुरुः अन्तवन्तम् अमुं शत्रुं कथं दैत्यं नमेमहि
verses.transliteration: anādis tvaṃ jagaddhātar anantas tvaṃ jagadguruḥ antavantam amuṃ śatruṃ kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi
verses.translation: "O brahmin, this is true that I came here in a morning. It is not false. But hundreds of years have passed by, since I came to you."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तवैश्वर्येण पुष्टाङ्गा जित्वा त्रैलोक्यम् ओजसा स्थिराः स्यामः सुरेशान कथं दैत्यं नमेमहि
verses.transliteration: tavaiśvaryeṇa puṣṭāṅgā jitvā trailokyam ojasā sthirāḥ syāmaḥ sureśāna kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi
verses.translation: Thereupon, the brahmin asked the lady of large eyes in great perturbation—"O timid lady, even as I was engaged in dalliance with you, what period of time did pass by?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एतद् एव वचनं श्रुत्वा दैतेयसूदनः उवाच सर्वान् अमरान् देवानां कार्यसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: ity etad eva vacanaṃ śrutvā daiteyasūdanaḥ uvāca sarvān amarān devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye
verses.translation: "Nine hundred, seven years, six months and three days have passed ofF till date."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मद्भक्तो ऽसौ बलिर् दैत्यो ह्य् अवध्यो ऽसौ सुरासुरैः यथा भवन्तो मत्पोष्यास् तथा पोष्यो बलिर् मम
verses.transliteration: madbhakto 'sau balir daityo hy avadhyo 'sau surāsuraiḥ yathā bhavanto matpoṣyās tathā poṣyo balir mama
verses.translation: "O timid lady, arc you telling me the truth or are you jesting with me? I think I have stayed here with you only for a day."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विना तु संगरं देवा हत्वा राज्यं त्रिविष्टपे बलिं निबध्य मन्त्रोक्त्या राज्यं वः प्रददाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: vinā tu saṃgaraṃ devā hatvā rājyaṃ triviṣṭape baliṃ nibadhya mantroktyā rājyaṃ vaḥ pradadāmy aham
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सुरगणाः संजग्मुर् दिवम् एव हि भगवान् अपि देवेशो ह्य् अदित्या गर्भम् आविशत्
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā suragaṇāḥ saṃjagmur divam eva hi bhagavān api deveśo hy adityā garbham āviśat
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्न् उत्पद्यमाने तु उत्सवाश् च बभूविरे जातो ऽसौ वामनो ब्रह्मन् यज्ञेशो यज्ञपूरुषः
verses.transliteration: tasminn utpadyamāne tu utsavāś ca babhūvire jāto 'sau vāmano brahman yajñeśo yajñapūruṣaḥ
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे ब्रह्मन् हयमेधाय दीक्षितः बलिर् बलवतां श्रेष्ठ ऋषिमुख्यैः समाहितः
verses.transliteration: etasminn antare brahman hayamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ balir balavatāṃ śreṣṭha ṛṣimukhyaiḥ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरोधसा च शुक्रेण वेदवेदाङ्गवेदिना मखे तस्मिन् वर्तमाने यजमाने बलौ तथा
verses.transliteration: purodhasā ca śukreṇa vedavedāṅgavedinā makhe tasmin vartamāne yajamāne balau tathā
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आर्त्विज्य ऋषिमुख्ये तु शुक्रे तत्र पुरोधसि हविर्भागार्थम् आसन्नदेवगन्धर्वपन्नगे
verses.transliteration: ārtvijya ṛṣimukhye tu śukre tatra purodhasi havirbhāgārtham āsannadevagandharvapannage
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दीयतां भुज्यतां पूजा क्रियतां च पृथक् पृथक् परिपूर्णं पुनः पूर्णम् एवं वाक्ये प्रवर्तति
verses.transliteration: dīyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ pūjā kriyatāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak paripūrṇaṃ punaḥ pūrṇam evaṃ vākye pravartati
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शनैस् तद्देशम् अभ्यागाद् वामनः सामगायनः यज्ञवाटम् अनुप्राप्तो वामनश् चित्रकुण्डलः
verses.transliteration: śanais taddeśam abhyāgād vāmanaḥ sāmagāyanaḥ yajñavāṭam anuprāpto vāmanaś citrakuṇḍalaḥ
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रशंसमानस् तं यज्ञं वामनं प्रेक्ष्य भार्गवः ब्रह्मरूपधरं देवं वामनं दैत्यसूदनम्
verses.transliteration: praśaṃsamānas taṃ yajñaṃ vāmanaṃ prekṣya bhārgavaḥ brahmarūpadharaṃ devaṃ vāmanaṃ daityasūdanam
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दातारं यज्ञतपसां फलं हन्तारं रक्षसाम् ज्ञात्वा त्वरन्न् अथोवाच राजानं भूरितेजसम्
verses.transliteration: dātāraṃ yajñatapasāṃ phalaṃ hantāraṃ rakṣasām jñātvā tvarann athovāca rājānaṃ bhūritejasam
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"

verses.sanskrit: जेतारं क्षत्रधर्मेण दातारं भक्तितो धनम् बलिं बलवतां श्रेष्ठं सभार्यं दीक्षितं मखे
verses.transliteration: jetāraṃ kṣatradharmeṇa dātāraṃ bhaktito dhanam baliṃ balavatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sabhāryaṃ dīkṣitaṃ makhe
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायन्तं यज्ञपुरुषम् उत्सृजन्तं हविः पृथक् तम् आह भृगुशार्दूलः शुक्रः परमबुद्धिमान्
