verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शुभं च शुभदं नित्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम् मातृस्वरूपं लोकानाम् अमृतं भेषजं शुचि
verses.transliteration: śubhaṃ ca śubhadaṃ nityaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam mātṛsvarūpaṃ lokānām amṛtaṃ bheṣajaṃ śuci
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पवित्रं पावनं पूज्यं ज्येष्ठं श्रेष्ठं गुणान्वितम् स्मरणाद् एव लोकानां पावनं किं नु दर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: pavitraṃ pāvanaṃ pūjyaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ guṇānvitam smaraṇād eva lokānāṃ pāvanaṃ kiṃ nu darśanāt
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तादृग् वारि शुचिर् भूत्वा कल्पये ऽर्घाय मे पितुः इति संचिन्त्य तद् वारि गृहीत्वार्घाय कल्पितम्
verses.transliteration: tādṛg vāri śucir bhūtvā kalpaye 'rghāya me pituḥ iti saṃcintya tad vāri gṛhītvārghāya kalpitam
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोः पादे तु पतितम् अर्घवारि सुमन्त्रितम् तद् वारि पतितं मेरौ चतुर्धा व्यगमद् भुवम्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇoḥ pāde tu patitam arghavāri sumantritam tad vāri patitaṃ merau caturdhā vyagamad bhuvam
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वे तु दक्षिणे चैव पश्चिमे चोत्तरे तथा दक्षिणे यत् तु पतितं जटाभिः शंकरो मुने
verses.transliteration: pūrve tu dakṣiṇe caiva paścime cottare tathā dakṣiṇe yat tu patitaṃ jaṭābhiḥ śaṃkaro mune
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जग्राह पश्चिमे यत् तु पुनः प्रायात् कमण्डलुम् उत्तरे पतितं यत् तु विष्णुर् जग्राह तज् जलम्
verses.transliteration: jagrāha paścime yat tu punaḥ prāyāt kamaṇḍalum uttare patitaṃ yat tu viṣṇur jagrāha taj jalam
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वस्मिन्न् ऋषयो देवा पितरो लोकपालकाः जगृहुः शुभदं वारि तस्माच् छ्रेष्ठं तद् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: pūrvasminn ṛṣayo devā pitaro lokapālakāḥ jagṛhuḥ śubhadaṃ vāri tasmāc chreṣṭhaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: या दक्षिणां दिशं प्राप्ता आपो वै लोकमातरः विष्णुपादप्रसूतास् ता ब्रह्मण्या लोकमातरः
verses.transliteration: yā dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ prāptā āpo vai lokamātaraḥ viṣṇupādaprasūtās tā brahmaṇyā lokamātaraḥ
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरजटासंस्थाः पर्वजातशुभोदयाः तासां प्रभावस्मरणात् सर्वकामान् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: maheśvarajaṭāsaṃsthāḥ parvajātaśubhodayāḥ tāsāṃ prabhāvasmaraṇāt sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कमण्डलुस्थिता देवी महेश्वरजटागता श्रुता देव यथा मर्त्यम् आगता तद् ब्रवीतु मे
verses.transliteration: kamaṇḍalusthitā devī maheśvarajaṭāgatā śrutā deva yathā martyam āgatā tad bravītu me
verses.translation: Listen, O leading sages, I shall recount to you briefly the incarnations which Hari took up in order to remove the burden of the Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरजटास्था या आपो देव्यो महामते तासां च द्विविधो भेद आहर्तुर् द्वयकारणात्
verses.transliteration: maheśvarajaṭāsthā yā āpo devyo mahāmate tāsāṃ ca dvividho bheda āhartur dvayakāraṇāt
verses.translation: Now, Daityas, the followers of Kalanemi have come to the mortal world. Day and night they harass the subjects.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकांशो ब्राह्मणेनात्र व्रतदानसमाधिना गोतमेन शिवं पूज्य आहृतो लोकविश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: ekāṃśo brāhmaṇenātra vratadānasamādhinā gotamena śivaṃ pūjya āhṛto lokaviśrutaḥ
verses.translation: • That Asura Kalancmi who was slain by all powerful Visnu is now born as Karhsa the great Asura and a son of Ugrasena.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अपरस् तु महाप्राज्ञ क्षत्रियेण बलीयसा आराध्य शंकरं देवं तपोभिर् नियमैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: aparas tu mahāprājña kṣatriyeṇa balīyasā ārādhya śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ tapobhir niyamais tathā
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the Earth Brahma was requested by Devas to remove the burden of the Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भगीरथेन भूपेन आहृतो ऽंशो ऽपरस् तथा एवं द्वैरूप्यम् अभवद् गङ्गाया मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: bhagīrathena bhūpena āhṛto 'ṃśo 'paras tathā evaṃ dvairūpyam abhavad gaṅgāyā munisattama
verses.translation: After saying thus Brahma went along with Devas. With full concentration, he eulogised the Garua-emblemed deity.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरजटास्था या हेतुना केन गौतमः आहर्ता क्षत्रियेणापि आहृता केन तद् वद
verses.transliteration: maheśvarajaṭāsthā yā hetunā kena gautamaḥ āhartā kṣatriyeṇāpi āhṛtā kena tad vada
verses.translation: O lord with thousand forms, obeisance, obeisance be to you; O thousand-armed one, O many-armed and many- footcd one, obeisance, obeisance to you, O lord engaged in creation, maintenance and destruction of the universe, O incomprehensible one.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथानीता पुरा वत्स ब्राह्मणेनेतरेण वा तत् सर्वं विस्तरेणाहं वदिष्ये प्रीतये तव
verses.transliteration: yathānītā purā vatsa brāhmaṇenetareṇa vā tat sarvaṃ vistareṇāhaṃ vadiṣye prītaye tava
verses.translation: You are the subtlest of all subtle beings; you have a great magnitude, O lord, you are weightier than the weightiest. O lord, possessed of Pradhana, cosmic intellect and sense- organs, O lord identical with the chief worlds, be pleased.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् काले सुरेशस्य उमा पत्न्य् अभवत् प्रिया तस्मिन्न् एवाभवद् गङ्गा प्रिया शंभोर् महामते
verses.transliteration: yasmin kāle sureśasya umā patny abhavat priyā tasminn evābhavad gaṅgā priyā śaṃbhor mahāmate
verses.translation: On account of the mighty Asuras born on the Earth, O lord, this Earth is extremely afflicted. She is pained under the heavy weight of suffering. In order to get the burden re¬ moved she has approached you the ultimate resort of worlds, the redeemer without any other greater being.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मम दोषापनोदाय चिन्तयानः शिवस् तदा उमया सहितः श्रीमान् देवीं प्रेक्ष्य विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: mama doṣāpanodāya cintayānaḥ śivas tadā umayā sahitaḥ śrīmān devīṃ prekṣya viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: May all Devas incarnate on the Earth. Let them fight with the mighty proud Asuras who are already born before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रसवृत्तौ स्थितो यस्मान् निर्ममे रसम् उत्तमम् रसिकत्वात् प्रियत्वाच् च स्त्रैणत्वात् पावनत्वतः
verses.transliteration: rasavṛttau sthito yasmān nirmame rasam uttamam rasikatvāt priyatvāc ca straiṇatvāt pāvanatvataḥ
verses.translation: O immortal ones, this hair of mine will be born as the eighth child in the womb of DevakI, the wife of Vasudeva who is comparable to a goddess.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाभ्यो ह्य् अधिकप्रीतिर् गङ्गाभूद् द्विजसत्तम सैवोद्भूता जटामार्गात् कस्मिंश्चित् कारणान्तरे स तु संगोपयाम् आस गङ्गां शंभुर् जटागताम्
verses.transliteration: sarvābhyo hy adhikaprītir gaṅgābhūd dvijasattama saivodbhūtā jaṭāmārgāt kasmiṃścit kāraṇāntare sa tu saṃgopayām āsa gaṅgāṃ śaṃbhur jaṭāgatām
verses.translation: After birth on the Earth it will kill Kamsa bom of Kalancmi. AJter saying this, Hari vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिरसा च धृतां ज्ञात्वा न शशाक उमा तदा सोढुं ब्रह्मञ् जटाजूटे स्थितां दृष्ट्वा पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: śirasā ca dhṛtāṃ jñātvā na śaśāka umā tadā soḍhuṃ brahmañ jaṭājūṭe sthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Those Devas then bowed down to the noble lord who became invisible, went to the top of Meru and then descended on the Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अमर्षेण भवं गोरी प्रेरयस्वेत्य् अभाषत नैवासौ प्रैरयच् छंभू रसिको रसम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: amarṣeṇa bhavaṃ gorī prerayasvety abhāṣata naivāsau prairayac chaṃbhū rasiko rasam uttamam
verses.translation: The holy sage Narada said thus to Kamsa—"The eighth child in the womb of DevakI born in the Earth will kill you".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जटास्व् एव तदा देवीं गोपायन्तं विमृश्य सा विनायकं जयां स्कन्दं रहो वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: jaṭāsv eva tadā devīṃ gopāyantaṃ vimṛśya sā vināyakaṃ jayāṃ skandaṃ raho vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: On hearing it from Narada, Kamsa became infuriated. He kept DevakI and Vasudeva as prisoners in their own house and guarded them well.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नैवायं त्रिदशेशानो गङ्गां त्यजति कामुकः सापि प्रिया शिवस्याद्य कथं त्यजति तां प्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: naivāyaṃ tridaśeśāno gaṅgāṃ tyajati kāmukaḥ sāpi priyā śivasyādya kathaṃ tyajati tāṃ priyām
verses.translation: The sons of Hiranyakasipu became well known as these six children in the womb. Urged by Visnu, his (Yogic) slumber joined them gradually to the womb of DevakI.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं विमृश्य बहुशो गौरी चाह विनायकम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vimṛśya bahuśo gaurī cāha vināyakam
verses.translation: O slumber, go hence. One by one take these children (of Hiranyakasipu) who are in the nether worlds now to the belly of DevakI at my behest.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न देवैर् नासुरैर् यक्षैर् न सिद्धैर् भवतापि च न राजभिर् अथान्यैर् वा न गङ्गां त्यजति प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: na devair nāsurair yakṣair na siddhair bhavatāpi ca na rājabhir athānyair vā na gaṅgāṃ tyajati prabhuḥ
verses.translation: When they have been killed by Kamsa, my sinless part named Sesa will become the seventh child in the womb of DevakI by means of a small part.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनस् तप्स्यामि वा गत्वा हिमवन्तं नगोत्तमम् अथवा ब्राह्मणैः पुण्यैस् तपोभिर् हतकल्मषैः
verses.transliteration: punas tapsyāmi vā gatvā himavantaṃ nagottamam athavā brāhmaṇaiḥ puṇyais tapobhir hatakalmaṣaiḥ
verses.translation: Since the child in the womb has been dragged away, the heroic boy comparable to the peak of Meru, Sankarsana will be born in the world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तैर् वा जटास्थिता गङ्गा प्रार्थिता भुवम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tair vā jaṭāsthitā gaṅgā prārthitā bhuvam āpnuyāt
verses.translation: Then, I shall be born in the auspicious womb of DevakI. You should also go to the womb of Yasoda without delay.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा मातृवाक्यं मातरं प्राह विघ्नराट् भ्रात्रा स्कन्देन जयया संमन्त्र्येह च युज्यते
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā mātṛvākyaṃ mātaraṃ prāha vighnarāṭ bhrātrā skandena jayayā saṃmantryeha ca yujyate
verses.translation: I shall be born at night on the eighth day in the dark half of the mouth of Sravana during the rainy season. You will be born on the ninth day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत् कुर्मो मस्तकाद् गङ्गां यथा त्यजति मे पिता एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे ब्रह्मन्न् अनावृष्टिर् अजायत
verses.transliteration: tat kurmo mastakād gaṅgāṃ yathā tyajati me pitā etasminn antare brahmann anāvṛṣṭir ajāyata
verses.translation: O uncensured lady, urged by my Sakti, Vasudeva will take me to the bed ofYasoda and you to that of Devaki.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्विर् द्वादश समा मर्त्ये सर्वप्राणिभयावहा ततो विनष्टम् अभवज् जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: dvir dvādaśa samā martye sarvaprāṇibhayāvahā tato vinaṣṭam abhavaj jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: O gentle lady, Kamsa will seize you and hurl you against a rocky slab. Thereafter, you will attain an abode in the firmament.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विना तु गौतमं पुण्यम् आश्रमं सर्वकामदम् स्रष्टुकामः पुरा पुत्र स्थावरं जङ्गमं तथा
verses.transliteration: vinā tu gautamaṃ puṇyam āśramaṃ sarvakāmadam sraṣṭukāmaḥ purā putra sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā
verses.translation: With due deference to me, Indra will bow down to you a hundred times; with his head bent down in obeisance he will accept you as his sister.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृतो यज्ञो मया पूर्वं स देवयजनो गिरिः मन्नामा तत्र विख्यातस् ततो ब्रह्मगिरिः सदा
verses.transliteration: kṛto yajño mayā pūrvaṃ sa devayajano giriḥ mannāmā tatra vikhyātas tato brahmagiriḥ sadā
verses.translation: Thereafter, you will kill thousands of Daityas. With various abodes (i.e. shrines) you will adorn the entire Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तम् आश्रित्य नगश्रेष्ठं सर्वदास्ते स गौतमः तस्याश्रमे महापुण्ये श्रेष्ठे ब्रह्मगिरौ शुभे
verses.transliteration: tam āśritya nagaśreṣṭhaṃ sarvadāste sa gautamaḥ tasyāśrame mahāpuṇye śreṣṭhe brahmagirau śubhe
verses.translation: You are identical with the following deities:—Bhuti (Existence), Sannati (Obeisance), Klrti (Renown), Kanti (Splendour), PrthivI (Earth), Dhrti (Courage), Lajja (Bashfulness), Pu?ti (Nourishment), Uma and other goddesses whoever they may be.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आधयो व्याधयो वापि दुर्भिक्षं वाप्य् अवर्षणम् भयशोकौ च दारिद्र्यं न श्रूयन्ते कदाचन
verses.transliteration: ādhayo vyādhayo vāpi durbhikṣaṃ vāpy avarṣaṇam bhayaśokau ca dāridryaṃ na śrūyante kadācana
verses.translation: Worshipped by means of wine, meat and other pre¬ sents and various items of foodstuffs you will become de¬ lighted and fulfil all desires of men.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदाश्रमं विनान्यत्र हव्यं वा कव्यम् एव च नास्ति पुत्र तथा दाता होता यष्टा तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tadāśramaṃ vinānyatra havyaṃ vā kavyam eva ca nāsti putra tathā dātā hotā yaṣṭā tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यदैव गौतमो विप्रो ददाति च जुहोति च तदैवाप्य् अयनं स्वर्गे सुराणाम् अपि नान्यतः
verses.transliteration: yadaiva gautamo vipro dadāti ca juhoti ca tadaivāpy ayanaṃ svarge surāṇām api nānyataḥ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवलोके ऽपि मर्त्ये वा श्रूयते गौतमो मुनिः होता दाता च भोक्ता च स एवेति जना विदुः
verses.transliteration: devaloke 'pi martye vā śrūyate gautamo muniḥ hotā dātā ca bhoktā ca sa eveti janā viduḥ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा मुनयः सर्वे नानाश्रमनिवासिनः गौतमाश्रमम् आपृच्छन्न् आगच्छन्तस् तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā munayaḥ sarve nānāśramanivāsinaḥ gautamāśramam āpṛcchann āgacchantas tapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मुनीनां सर्वेषाम् आगतानां स गौतमः शिष्यवत् पुत्रवद् भक्त्या पितृवत् पोषको ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ munīnāṃ sarveṣām āgatānāṃ sa gautamaḥ śiṣyavat putravad bhaktyā pitṛvat poṣako 'bhavat
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्य यथेप्सितं कामं यथायोग्यं यथाक्रमम् यथानुरूपं सर्वेषां शुश्रूषाम् अकरोन् मुनिः
verses.transliteration: yasya yathepsitaṃ kāmaṃ yathāyogyaṃ yathākramam yathānurūpaṃ sarveṣāṃ śuśrūṣām akaron muniḥ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञया गौतमस्यासन्न् ओषध्यो लोकमातरः आराधिताः पुनस् तेन ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: ājñayā gautamasyāsann oṣadhyo lokamātaraḥ ārādhitāḥ punas tena brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जायन्ते च तदौषध्यो लूयन्ते च तदैव हि संपत्स्यन्ते तदोप्यन्ते गौतमस्य तपोबलात्
verses.transliteration: jāyante ca tadauṣadhyo lūyante ca tadaiva hi saṃpatsyante tadopyante gautamasya tapobalāt
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाः समृद्धयस् तस्य संसिध्यन्ते मनोगताः प्रत्यहं वक्ति विनयाद् गौतमस् त्व् आगतान् मुनीन्
verses.transliteration: sarvāḥ samṛddhayas tasya saṃsidhyante manogatāḥ pratyahaṃ vakti vinayād gautamas tv āgatān munīn
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रवच् छिष्यवच् चैव प्रेष्यवत् करवाणि किम् पितृवत् पोषयाम् आस संवत्सरगणान् बहून्
verses.transliteration: putravac chiṣyavac caiva preṣyavat karavāṇi kim pitṛvat poṣayām āsa saṃvatsaragaṇān bahūn
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं वसत्सु मुनिषु त्रैलोक्ये ख्यातिर् आश्रयात् ततो विनायकः प्राह मातरं भ्रातरं जयाम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vasatsu muniṣu trailokye khyātir āśrayāt tato vināyakaḥ prāha mātaraṃ bhrātaraṃ jayām
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवानां सदने मातर् गीयते गौतमो द्विजः यन् न साध्यं सुरगणैर् गौतमः कृतवान् इति
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ sadane mātar gīyate gautamo dvijaḥ yan na sādhyaṃ suragaṇair gautamaḥ kṛtavān iti
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं श्रुतं मया देवि ब्राह्मणस्य तपोबलम् स विप्रश् चालयेद् एनां मातर् गङ्गां जटागताम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ śrutaṃ mayā devi brāhmaṇasya tapobalam sa vipraś cālayed enāṃ mātar gaṅgāṃ jaṭāgatām
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तपसा वान्यतो वापि पूजयित्वा त्रिलोचनम् स एव च्यावयेद् एनां जटास्थां मे पितृप्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: tapasā vānyato vāpi pūjayitvā trilocanam sa eva cyāvayed enāṃ jaṭāsthāṃ me pitṛpriyām
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र नीतिर् विधातव्या तां विप्रो याचयेद् यथा तत्प्रभावात् सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा शिरसो ऽवतरत्य् अपि
verses.transliteration: tatra nītir vidhātavyā tāṃ vipro yācayed yathā tatprabhāvāt saricchreṣṭhā śiraso 'vataraty api
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा मातरं भ्रात्रा जयया सह विघ्नराट् जगाम गौतमो यत्र ब्रह्मसूत्रधरः कृशः
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā mātaraṃ bhrātrā jayayā saha vighnarāṭ jagāma gautamo yatra brahmasūtradharaḥ kṛśaḥ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वसन् कतिपयाहःसु गौतमाश्रममण्डले उवाच ब्राह्मणान् सर्वांस् तत्र तत्र च विघ्नराट्
verses.transliteration: vasan katipayāhaḥsu gautamāśramamaṇḍale uvāca brāhmaṇān sarvāṃs tatra tatra ca vighnarāṭ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छामः स्वम् अधिष्ठानम् आश्रमाणि शुचीनि च पुष्टाः स्म गौतमान्नेन पृच्छामो गौतमं मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: gacchāmaḥ svam adhiṣṭhānam āśramāṇi śucīni ca puṣṭāḥ sma gautamānnena pṛcchāmo gautamaṃ munim
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति संमन्त्र्य पृच्छन्ति मुनयो मुनिसत्तमाः स तान् निवारयाम् आस स्नेहबुद्ध्या मुनीन् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: iti saṃmantrya pṛcchanti munayo munisattamāḥ sa tān nivārayām āsa snehabuddhyā munīn pṛthak
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिः सविनयम् आसध्वम् इह चैव हि युष्मच्चरणशुश्रूषां करोमि मुनिपुंगवाः
verses.transliteration: kṛtāñjaliḥ savinayam āsadhvam iha caiva hi yuṣmaccaraṇaśuśrūṣāṃ karomi munipuṃgavāḥ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शुश्रूषौ पुत्रवन् नित्यं मयि तिष्ठति नोचितम् भवतां भूमिदेवानाम् आश्रमान्तरसेवनम्
verses.transliteration: śuśrūṣau putravan nityaṃ mayi tiṣṭhati nocitam bhavatāṃ bhūmidevānām āśramāntarasevanam
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनुमान्य द्विजान् सर्वान् पुनः पुनर् उदारधीः स्वयं च ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा प्रणम्य ब्राह्मणान् पुनः मातुर् मते स्थितो विद्वाञ् जयां प्राह गणेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: anumānya dvijān sarvān punaḥ punar udāradhīḥ svayaṃ ca brāhmaṇo bhūtvā praṇamya brāhmaṇān punaḥ mātur mate sthito vidvāñ jayāṃ prāha gaṇeśvaraḥ

verses.sanskrit: यथा नान्यो विजानीते तथा कुरु शुभानने गोरूपधारिणी गच्छ गौतमो यत्र तिष्ठति

verses.sanskrit: शालीन् खाद विनाश्याथ विकारं कुरु भामिनि कृते प्रहारे हुंकारे प्रेक्षिते चापि किंचन पत दीनं स्वनं कृत्वा न म्रियस्व न जीव च

verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् आनयस्व तरसा तपसा नियमेन च तेनाभिषिञ्च गाम् एतां भगवन् भुवम् आश्रिताम् ततो वत्स्यामहे सर्वे पूर्ववत् तव वेश्मनि
verses.transliteration: tad ānayasva tarasā tapasā niyamena ca tenābhiṣiñca gām etāṃ bhagavan bhuvam āśritām tato vatsyāmahe sarve pūrvavat tava veśmani
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्तवति विप्रेन्द्रे ब्राह्मणानां च संसदि तत्रापतत् पुष्पवृष्टिर् जयशब्दो व्यवर्धत ततः कृताञ्जलिर् नम्रो गौतमो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: ity uktavati viprendre brāhmaṇānāṃ ca saṃsadi tatrāpatat puṣpavṛṣṭir jayaśabdo vyavardhata tataḥ kṛtāñjalir namro gautamo vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तपसाग्निप्रसादेन देवब्रह्मप्रसादतः भवतां च प्रसादेन मत्संकल्पो ऽनुसिध्यताम्
verses.transliteration: tapasāgniprasādena devabrahmaprasādataḥ bhavatāṃ ca prasādena matsaṃkalpo 'nusidhyatām
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् अस्त्व् इति तं विप्रा आपृच्छन् मुनिपुंगवम् स्वानि स्थानानि ते जग्मुः समृद्धान्य् अन्नवारिभिः
verses.transliteration: evam astv iti taṃ viprā āpṛcchan munipuṃgavam svāni sthānāni te jagmuḥ samṛddhāny annavāribhiḥ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यातेषु तेषु विप्रेषु भ्रात्रा सह गणेश्वरः जयया सह सुप्रीतः कृतकृत्यो न्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration: yāteṣu teṣu vipreṣu bhrātrā saha gaṇeśvaraḥ jayayā saha suprītaḥ kṛtakṛtyo nyavartata
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गतेषु ब्रह्मवृन्देषु गणेशे च गते तथा गौतमो ऽपि मुनिश्रेष्ठस् तपसा हतकल्मषः
verses.transliteration: gateṣu brahmavṛndeṣu gaṇeśe ca gate tathā gautamo 'pi muniśreṣṭhas tapasā hatakalmaṣaḥ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायंस् तदर्थं स मुनिः किम् इदं मम संस्थितम् इत्य् एवं बहुशो ध्यायञ् ज्ञानेन ज्ञातवान् द्विज
verses.transliteration: dhyāyaṃs tadarthaṃ sa muniḥ kim idaṃ mama saṃsthitam ity evaṃ bahuśo dhyāyañ jñānena jñātavān dvija
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निश्चित्य देवकार्यार्थम् आत्मनः किल्बिषां गतिम् लोकानाम् उपकारं च शंभोः प्रीणनम् एव च
verses.transliteration: niścitya devakāryārtham ātmanaḥ kilbiṣāṃ gatim lokānām upakāraṃ ca śaṃbhoḥ prīṇanam eva ca
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उमायाः प्रीणनं चापि गङ्गानयनम् एव च सर्वं श्रेयस्करं मन्ये मयि नैव च किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: umāyāḥ prīṇanaṃ cāpi gaṅgānayanam eva ca sarvaṃ śreyaskaraṃ manye mayi naiva ca kilbiṣam
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवं मनसा ध्यायन् सुप्रीतो ऽभूद् द्विजोत्तमः आराध्य जगताम् ईशं त्रिनेत्रं वृषभध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: ity evaṃ manasā dhyāyan suprīto 'bhūd dvijottamaḥ ārādhya jagatām īśaṃ trinetraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आनयिष्ये सरिच्छ्रेष्ठां प्रीता ऽस्तु गिरिजा मम सपत्नी जगदम्बाया महेश्वरजटास्थिता
verses.transliteration: ānayiṣye saricchreṣṭhāṃ prītā 'stu girijā mama sapatnī jagadambāyā maheśvarajaṭāsthitā
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं हि संकल्प्य मुनिप्रवीरः स गौतमो ब्रह्मगिरेर् जगाम कैलासम् आधिष्ठितम् उग्रधन्वना सुरार्चितं प्रियया ब्रह्मवृन्दैः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ hi saṃkalpya munipravīraḥ sa gautamo brahmagirer jagāma kailāsam ādhiṣṭhitam ugradhanvanā surārcitaṃ priyayā brahmavṛndaiḥ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कैलासशिखरं गत्वा गौतमो भगवान् ऋषिः किं चकार तपो वापि कां चक्रे स्तुतिम् उत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: kailāsaśikharaṃ gatvā gautamo bhagavān ṛṣiḥ kiṃ cakāra tapo vāpi kāṃ cakre stutim uttamām
verses.translation: On the same day the Yogic slumber took birth in the belly of Yasoda in accordance with what was mentioned by Brahma.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गिरिं गत्वा ततो वत्स वाचं संयम्य गौतमः आस्तीर्य स कुशान् प्राज्ञः कैलासे पर्वतोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: giriṃ gatvā tato vatsa vācaṃ saṃyamya gautamaḥ āstīrya sa kuśān prājñaḥ kailāse parvatottame
verses.translation: O brahmins, when the part of Visnu entered the Earth the seasons became auspicious. The planets in the sky moved perfectly (and favourably).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपविश्य शुचिर् भूत्वा स्तोत्रं चेदं ततो जगौ अपतत् पुष्पवृष्टिश् च स्तूयमाने महेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: upaviśya śucir bhūtvā stotraṃ cedaṃ tato jagau apatat puṣpavṛṣṭiś ca stūyamāne maheśvare
verses.translation: No one dared to look at Devaki due to her excessive refulgence. On seeing her blazing splendidly, the minds of onlookers became excited.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भोगार्थिनां भोगम् अभीप्सितं च दातुं महान्त्य् अष्टवपूंषि धत्ते सोमो जनानां गुणवन्ति नित्यं देवं महादेवम् इति स्तुवन्ति
verses.transliteration: bhogārthināṃ bhogam abhīpsitaṃ ca dātuṃ mahānty aṣṭavapūṃṣi dhatte somo janānāṃ guṇavanti nityaṃ devaṃ mahādevam iti stuvanti
verses.translation: Day and night the deities eulogised Devaki who held Visnu in her womb.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कर्तुं स्वकीयैर् विषयैः सुखानि भर्तुं समस्तं सचराचरं च संपत्तये ह्य् अस्य विवृद्धये च महीमयं रूपम् इतीश्वरस्य
verses.transliteration: kartuṃ svakīyair viṣayaiḥ sukhāni bhartuṃ samastaṃ sacarācaraṃ ca saṃpattaye hy asya vivṛddhaye ca mahīmayaṃ rūpam itīśvarasya
verses.translation: You are Svaha, you are Svadha, you are Vidya, you are Sudha (Nectar), you are splendour. For the protection of worlds, you have incarnated on the Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टेः स्थितेः संहरणाय भूमेर् आधारम् आधातुम् अपां स्वरूपम् भेजे शिवः शान्ततनुर् जनानां सुखाय धर्माय जगत् प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭeḥ sthiteḥ saṃharaṇāya bhūmer ādhāram ādhātum apāṃ svarūpam bheje śivaḥ śāntatanur janānāṃ sukhāya dharmāya jagat pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: Thus eulogised by Devas, she conceived the lord in her womb, the lotus-eyed lord, the cause of safety and security of the world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कालव्यवस्थाम् अमृतस्रवं च जीवस्थितिं सृष्टिम् अथो विनाशनम् मुदं प्रजानां सुखम् उन्नतिं च चक्रे ऽर्कचन्द्राग्निमयं शरीरम्
verses.transliteration: kālavyavasthām amṛtasravaṃ ca jīvasthitiṃ sṛṣṭim atho vināśanam mudaṃ prajānāṃ sukham unnatiṃ ca cakre 'rkacandrāgnimayaṃ śarīram
verses.translation: When at midnight, Janardana the support of all, was
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धिं गतिं शक्तिम् अथाक्षराणि जीवव्यवस्थां मुदम् अप्य् अनेकाम् स्रष्टुं कृतं वायुर् इतीशरूपं त्वं वेत्सि नूनं भगवन् भवन्तम्
verses.transliteration: vṛddhiṃ gatiṃ śaktim athākṣarāṇi jīvavyavasthāṃ mudam apy anekām sraṣṭuṃ kṛtaṃ vāyur itīśarūpaṃ tvaṃ vetsi nūnaṃ bhagavan bhavantam
verses.translation: May that lord ofDevas be pleased, the lord of Devas who has now revealed an infant's form by means of his own Maya, whose form is endless, whose form is this entire universe and who bears the world in his womb.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भेदैर् विना नैव कृतिर् न धर्मो नात्मीयम् अन्यन् न दिशो ऽन्तरिक्षम् द्यावापृथिव्यौ न च भुक्तिमुक्ती तस्माद् इदं व्योमवपुस् तवेश
verses.transliteration: bhedair vinā naiva kṛtir na dharmo nātmīyam anyan na diśo 'ntarikṣam dyāvāpṛthivyau na ca bhuktimuktī tasmād idaṃ vyomavapus taveśa
verses.translation: O lord, the Atman of ail, withdraw this four-armed form. O destroyer of Asuras, sons of Diti, let not Karhsa know about your incarnation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धर्मं व्यवस्थापयितुं व्यवस्य ऋक्सामशास्त्राणि यजुश् च शाखाः लोके च गाथाः स्मृतयः पुराणम् इत्यादिशब्दात्मकताम् उपैति
verses.transliteration: dharmaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ vyavasya ṛksāmaśāstrāṇi yajuś ca śākhāḥ loke ca gāthāḥ smṛtayaḥ purāṇam ityādiśabdātmakatām upaiti
verses.translation: Formerly, O gentle lady, I had been eulogised by you, desirous of a son. Since I am now born of your womb, your prayer has become fruitful.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यष्टा क्रतुर् यान्य् अपि साधनानि ऋत्विक्प्रदेशं फलदेशकालाः त्वम् एव शंभो परमार्थतत्त्वं वदन्ति यज्ञाङ्गमयं वपुस् ते
verses.transliteration: yaṣṭā kratur yāny api sādhanāni ṛtvikpradeśaṃ phaladeśakālāḥ tvam eva śaṃbho paramārthatattvaṃ vadanti yajñāṅgamayaṃ vapus te
verses.translation: O excellent sages, after saying thus, the lord became silent. During the night itself Vasudeva took him and went out.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कर्ता प्रदाता प्रतिभूः प्रदानं सर्वज्ञसाक्षी पुरुषः परश् च प्रत्यात्मभूतः परमार्थरूपस् त्वम् एव सर्वं किम् उ वाग्विलासैः
verses.transliteration: kartā pradātā pratibhūḥ pradānaṃ sarvajñasākṣī puruṣaḥ paraś ca pratyātmabhūtaḥ paramārtharūpas tvam eva sarvaṃ kim u vāgvilāsaiḥ
verses.translation: When Vasudeva set out, the watchmen became deluded. The porters and watchmen of the city of Mathura were enchanted and deluded by the Yogic slumber.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न वेदशास्त्रैर् गुरुभिः प्रदिष्टो न नासि बुद्ध्यादिभिर् अप्रधृष्यः अजो ऽप्रमेयः शिवशब्दवाच्यस् त्वम् अस्ति सत्यं भगवन् नमस् ते
verses.transliteration: na vedaśāstrair gurubhiḥ pradiṣṭo na nāsi buddhyādibhir apradhṛṣyaḥ ajo 'prameyaḥ śivaśabdavācyas tvam asti satyaṃ bhagavan namas te
verses.translation: When the clouds discharged a heavy and fierce down¬ pour during that night, Sesa shielded Vasudeva by means of
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आत्मैकतां स्वप्रकृतिं कदाचिद् ऐक्षच् छिवः संपद् इयं ममेति पृथक् तदैवाभवद् अप्रतर्क्य अचिन्त्यप्रभावो बहुविश्वमूर्तिः
verses.transliteration: ātmaikatāṃ svaprakṛtiṃ kadācid aikṣac chivaḥ saṃpad iyaṃ mameti pṛthak tadaivābhavad apratarkya acintyaprabhāvo bahuviśvamūrtiḥ
verses.translation: Bearing Visnu, Vasudeva waded through Yamuna with
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भावे ऽभिवृद्धा च भवे भवे च स्वकारणं कारणम् आस्थिता च नित्या शिवा सर्वसुलक्षणा वा विलक्षणा विश्वकरस्य शक्तिः
verses.transliteration: bhāve 'bhivṛddhā ca bhave bhave ca svakāraṇaṃ kāraṇam āsthitā ca nityā śivā sarvasulakṣaṇā vā vilakṣaṇā viśvakarasya śaktiḥ
verses.translation: On the bank of Yamuna he saw Nanda and other elderly cowherds who carried revenue to be paid to Karhsa.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्पादनं संस्थितिर् अन्नवृद्धि लयाः सतां यत्र सनातनास् ते एकैव मूर्तिर् न समस्ति किंचिद् असाध्यम् अस्या दयिता हरस्य
verses.transliteration: utpādanaṃ saṃsthitir annavṛddhi layāḥ satāṃ yatra sanātanās te ekaiva mūrtir na samasti kiṃcid asādhyam asyā dayitā harasya
verses.translation: On waking up, Yasoda saw her new-born son, dark in complexion like the petals of a blue lotus. Thereat she re¬ joiced very much.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यदर्थम् अन्नानि धनानि जीवा यच्छन्ति कुर्वन्ति तपांसि धर्मान् सापीयम् अम्बा जगतो जनित्री प्रिया तु सोमस्य महासुकीर्तिः
verses.transliteration: yadartham annāni dhanāni jīvā yacchanti kurvanti tapāṃsi dharmān sāpīyam ambā jagato janitrī priyā tu somasya mahāsukīrtiḥ
verses.translation: Taking the baby girl back to his abode, Vasudeva placed her on the bed of Devakl.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यद् ईक्षितं काङ्क्षति वासवो ऽपि यन्नामतो मङ्गलम् आप्नुयाच् च या व्याप्य विश्वं विमलीकरोति सोमा सदा सोमसमानरूपा
verses.transliteration: yad īkṣitaṃ kāṅkṣati vāsavo 'pi yannāmato maṅgalam āpnuyāc ca yā vyāpya viśvaṃ vimalīkaroti somā sadā somasamānarūpā
verses.translation: O brahmins, thereafter the watchmen heard the crying sound of the infant and got up suddenly. They intimated to Kamsa about the birth of a child to Devakl.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादिजीवस्य चराचरस्य बुद्ध्यक्षिचैतन्यमनःसुखानि यस्याः प्रसादात् फलवन्ति नित्यं वागीश्वरी लोकगुरोः सुरम्या
verses.transliteration: brahmādijīvasya carācarasya buddhyakṣicaitanyamanaḥsukhāni yasyāḥ prasādāt phalavanti nityaṃ vāgīśvarī lokaguroḥ suramyā
verses.translation: Kamsa rushed to Devakl and seized the baby girl from her even as Devakl tried to prevent him crying aloud "Leave off, leave off" till her throat ached.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्मुखस्यापि मनो मलीनं किम् अन्यजन्तोर् इति चिन्त्य माता गङ्गावतारं विविधैर् उपायैः सर्वं जगत् पावयितुं चकार
verses.transliteration: caturmukhasyāpi mano malīnaṃ kim anyajantor iti cintya mātā gaṅgāvatāraṃ vividhair upāyaiḥ sarvaṃ jagat pāvayituṃ cakāra
verses.translation: He hurled her on the top of a rocky slab. On being hurled thus she flew up and took up a position in the sky. She assumed a formidable form with eight large hands armed with weapons. She laughed aloud (in derision) and furiously spoke to Kamsa thus:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतीः समालक्ष्य हरप्रभुत्वं विश्वस्य लोकः सकलैः प्रमाणैः कृत्वा च धर्मान् बुभुजे च भोगान् विभूतिर् एषा तु सदाशिवस्य
verses.transliteration: śrutīḥ samālakṣya haraprabhutvaṃ viśvasya lokaḥ sakalaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ kṛtvā ca dharmān bubhuje ca bhogān vibhūtir eṣā tu sadāśivasya
verses.translation: He hurled her on the top of a rocky slab. On being hurled thus she flew up and took up a position in the sky. She assumed a formidable form with eight large hands armed with weapons. She laughed aloud (in derision) and furiously spoke to Kamsa thus:

verses.transliteration: kāryakriyākārakasādhanānāṃ vedoditānām atha laukikānām yat sādhyam utkṛṣṭatamaṃ priyaṃ ca proktā ca sā siddhir anādikartuḥ

verses.sanskrit: ध्यात्वा वरं ब्रह्म परं प्रधानं यत् सारभूतं यद् उपासितव्यम् यत् प्राप्य मुक्ता न पुनर् भवन्ति सद्योगिनो मुक्तिर् उमापतिः सः
verses.transliteration: dhyātvā varaṃ brahma paraṃ pradhānaṃ yat sārabhūtaṃ yad upāsitavyam yat prāpya muktā na punar bhavanti sadyogino muktir umāpatiḥ saḥ

verses.sanskrit: श्लाघ्यं कृते तपः प्रोक्तं त्रेतायां यज्ञकर्म च द्वापरे यज्ञदाने च दानम् एव कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: ślāghyaṃ kṛte tapaḥ proktaṃ tretāyāṃ yajñakarma ca dvāpare yajñadāne ca dānam eva kalau yuge

verses.sanskrit: युगधर्माश् च ये सर्वे देशधर्मास् तथैव च देशकालादिसंयोगे यो धर्मो यत्र शस्यते
verses.transliteration: yugadharmāś ca ye sarve deśadharmās tathaiva ca deśakālādisaṃyoge yo dharmo yatra śasyate

verses.sanskrit: यद् अन्यत्र कृतं पुण्यं स्नानदानादिसंयमैः अस्यास् तु स्मरणाद् एव तत् पुण्यं जायतां हर
verses.transliteration: yad anyatra kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ snānadānādisaṃyamaiḥ asyās tu smaraṇād eva tat puṇyaṃ jāyatāṃ hara

verses.sanskrit: यत्र यत्र त्व् इयं याति यावत् सागरगामिनी तत्र तत्र त्वया भाव्यम् एष चास्तु वरो वरः
verses.transliteration: yatra yatra tv iyaṃ yāti yāvat sāgaragāminī tatra tatra tvayā bhāvyam eṣa cāstu varo varaḥ

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां तूपरि तु दश यावच् च संख्यया तदन्तरप्रविष्टानां महापातकिनाम् अपि
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ tūpari tu daśa yāvac ca saṃkhyayā tadantarapraviṣṭānāṃ mahāpātakinām api

verses.sanskrit: तत् पितॄणां च तेषां च स्नानायागच्छतां शिव स्नाने चाप्य् अन्तरे मृत्योर् मुक्तिभाजो भवन्तु वै
verses.transliteration: tat pitṝṇāṃ ca teṣāṃ ca snānāyāgacchatāṃ śiva snāne cāpy antare mṛtyor muktibhājo bhavantu vai
