verses.sanskrit: एकतः सर्वतीर्थानि स्वर्गमर्त्यरसातले एषा तेभ्यो विशिष्टा तु अलं शंभो नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: ekataḥ sarvatīrthāni svargamartyarasātale eṣā tebhyo viśiṣṭā tu alaṃ śaṃbho namo 'stu te
verses.translation: He hurled her on the top of a rocky slab. On being hurled thus she flew up and took up a position in the sky. She assumed a formidable form with eight large hands armed with weapons. She laughed aloud (in derision) and furiously spoke to Kamsa thus:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् गौतमवचः श्रुत्वा तथास्त्व् इत्य् अब्रवीच् छिवः अस्याः परतरं तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tad gautamavacaḥ śrutvā tathāstv ity abravīc chivaḥ asyāḥ parataraṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: He hurled her on the top of a rocky slab. On being hurled thus she flew up and took up a position in the sky. She assumed a formidable form with eight large hands armed with weapons. She laughed aloud (in derision) and furiously spoke to Kamsa thus:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं सत्यं पुनः सत्यं वेदे च परिनिष्ठितम् सर्वेषां गौतमी पुण्या इत्य् उक्त्वान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ vede ca pariniṣṭhitam sarveṣāṃ gautamī puṇyā ity uktvāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: He hurled her on the top of a rocky slab. On being hurled thus she flew up and took up a position in the sky. She assumed a formidable form with eight large hands armed with weapons. She laughed aloud (in derision) and furiously spoke to Kamsa thus:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो गते भगवति लोकपूजिते तदाज्ञया पूर्णबलः स गौतमः जटां समादाय सरिद्वरां तां सुरैर् वृतो ब्रह्मगिरिं विवेश
verses.transliteration: tato gate bhagavati lokapūjite tadājñayā pūrṇabalaḥ sa gautamaḥ jaṭāṃ samādāya saridvarāṃ tāṃ surair vṛto brahmagiriṃ viveśa
verses.translation: He hurled her on the top of a rocky slab. On being hurled thus she flew up and took up a position in the sky. She assumed a formidable form with eight large hands armed with weapons. She laughed aloud (in derision) and furiously spoke to Kamsa thus:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तु गौतमे प्राप्ते जटाम् आदाय नारद पुष्पवृष्टिर् अभूत् तत्र समाजग्मुः सुरेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: tatas tu gautame prāpte jaṭām ādāya nārada puṣpavṛṣṭir abhūt tatra samājagmuḥ sureśvarāḥ
verses.translation: He hurled her on the top of a rocky slab. On being hurled thus she flew up and took up a position in the sky. She assumed a formidable form with eight large hands armed with weapons. She laughed aloud (in derision) and furiously spoke to Kamsa thus:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयश् च महाभागा ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रियास् तथा जयशब्देन तं विप्रं पूजयन्तो मुदान्विताः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayaś ca mahābhāgā brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyās tathā jayaśabdena taṃ vipraṃ pūjayanto mudānvitāḥ
verses.translation: He hurled her on the top of a rocky slab. On being hurled thus she flew up and took up a position in the sky. She assumed a formidable form with eight large hands armed with weapons. She laughed aloud (in derision) and furiously spoke to Kamsa thus:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरजटाजुटाद् गङ्गाम् आदाय गौतमः आगत्य ब्रह्मणः पुण्ये ततः किम् अकरोद् गिरौ
verses.transliteration: maheśvarajaṭājuṭād gaṅgām ādāya gautamaḥ āgatya brahmaṇaḥ puṇye tataḥ kim akarod girau
verses.translation: Distressed in mind (due to this) Kamsa called all Asuras, Pralamba, Kesin and others and spoke to them thus:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आदाय गौतमो गङ्गां शुचिः प्रयतमानसः पूजितो देवगन्धर्वैस् तथा गिरिनिवासिभिः
verses.transliteration: ādāya gautamo gaṅgāṃ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ pūjito devagandharvais tathā girinivāsibhiḥ
verses.translation: O Pralamba of great arms, O Kesin, O Dhenuka, O Putana, may my words be heard by Arista and others.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गिरेर् मूर्ध्नि जटां स्थाप्य स्मरन् देवं त्रिलोचनम् उवाच प्राञ्जलिर् भूत्वा गङ्गां स द्विजसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: girer mūrdhni jaṭāṃ sthāpya smaran devaṃ trilocanam uvāca prāñjalir bhūtvā gaṅgāṃ sa dvijasattamaḥ
verses.translation: Still O leading Asuras I have to exert myself to harm those wicked ones, more than what those evil ones may do.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रिलोचनजटोद्भूते सर्वकामप्रदायिनि क्षमस्व मातः शान्तासि सुखं याहि हितं कुरु
verses.transliteration: trilocanajaṭodbhūte sarvakāmapradāyini kṣamasva mātaḥ śāntāsi sukhaṃ yāhi hitaṃ kuru
verses.translation: "The lord of the past, present and future is born to bring about my death", So says the girl born of the womb of Devakl.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता गौतमेन गङ्गा प्रोवाच गौतमम् दिव्यरूपधरा देवी दिव्यस्रगनुलेपना
verses.transliteration: evam uktā gautamena gaṅgā provāca gautamam divyarūpadharā devī divyasraganulepanā
verses.translation: Hence, we have to endeavour very much in regard to boys on the Earth. If any extraordinary strength is visible in
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छेयं देवसदनम् अथवापि कमण्डलुम् रसातलं वा गच्छेयं जातस् त्वं सत्यवाग् असि
verses.transliteration: gaccheyaṃ devasadanam athavāpi kamaṇḍalum rasātalaṃ vā gaccheyaṃ jātas tvaṃ satyavāg asi
verses.translation: Hence grieve not for what has happened. Who is not
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रयाणाम् उपकारार्थं लोकानां याचिता मया शंभुना च तथा दत्ता देवि तन् नान्यथा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: trayāṇām upakārārthaṃ lokānāṃ yācitā mayā śaṃbhunā ca tathā dattā devi tan nānyathā bhavet
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् गौतमवचः श्रुत्वा गङ्गा मेने द्विजेरितम् त्रेधात्मानं विभज्याथ स्वर्गमर्त्यरसातले
verses.transliteration: tad gautamavacaḥ śrutvā gaṅgā mene dvijeritam tredhātmānaṃ vibhajyātha svargamartyarasātale
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गे चतुर्धा व्यगमत् सप्तधा मर्त्यमण्डले रसातले चतुर्धैव सैवं पञ्चदशाकृतिः
verses.transliteration: svarge caturdhā vyagamat saptadhā martyamaṇḍale rasātale caturdhaiva saivaṃ pañcadaśākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र सर्वभूतैव सर्वपापविनाशिनी सर्वकामप्रदा नित्यं सैव वेदे प्रगीयते
verses.transliteration: sarvatra sarvabhūtaiva sarvapāpavināśinī sarvakāmapradā nityaṃ saiva vede pragīyate
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मर्त्या मर्त्यगताम् एव पश्यन्ति न तलं गताम् नैव स्वर्गगतां मर्त्याः पश्यन्त्य् अज्ञानबुद्धयः
verses.transliteration: martyā martyagatām eva paśyanti na talaṃ gatām naiva svargagatāṃ martyāḥ paśyanty ajñānabuddhayaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यावत् सागरगा देवी तावद् देवमयी स्मृता उत्सृष्टा गौतमेनैव प्रायात् पूर्वार्णवं प्रति
verses.transliteration: yāvat sāgaragā devī tāvad devamayī smṛtā utsṛṣṭā gautamenaiva prāyāt pūrvārṇavaṃ prati
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवर्षिभिर् जुष्टां मातरं जगतः शुभाम् गौतमो मुनिशार्दूलः प्रदक्षिणम् अथाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: tato devarṣibhir juṣṭāṃ mātaraṃ jagataḥ śubhām gautamo muniśārdūlaḥ pradakṣiṇam athākarot
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रिलोचनं सुरेशानं प्रथमं पूज्य गौतमः उभयोस् तीरयोः स्नानं करोमीति दधे मतिम्
verses.transliteration: trilocanaṃ sureśānaṃ prathamaṃ pūjya gautamaḥ ubhayos tīrayoḥ snānaṃ karomīti dadhe matim
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्मृतमात्रस् तदा तत्राविरासीत् करुणार्णवः तत्र स्नानं कथं सिध्येद् इत्य् एवं शर्वम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: smṛtamātras tadā tatrāvirāsīt karuṇārṇavaḥ tatra snānaṃ kathaṃ sidhyed ity evaṃ śarvam abravīt
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा भक्तिनम्रस् त्रिलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā bhaktinamras trilocanam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवदेव महेशान तीर्थस्नानविधिं मम ब्रूहि सम्यङ् महेशान लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: devadeva maheśāna tīrthasnānavidhiṃ mama brūhi samyaṅ maheśāna lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महर्षे शृणु सर्वं च विधिं गोदावरीभवम् पूर्वं नान्दीमुखं कृत्वा देहशुद्धिं विधाय च
verses.transliteration: maharṣe śṛṇu sarvaṃ ca vidhiṃ godāvarībhavam pūrvaṃ nāndīmukhaṃ kṛtvā dehaśuddhiṃ vidhāya ca
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च तेषाम् आज्ञां प्रगृह्य च ब्रह्मचर्येण गच्छन्ति पतितालापवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca teṣām ājñāṃ pragṛhya ca brahmacaryeṇa gacchanti patitālāpavarjitāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्य हस्तौ च पादौ च मनश् चैव सुसंयतम् विद्या तपश् च कीर्तिश् च स तीर्थफलम् अश्नुते
verses.transliteration: yasya hastau ca pādau ca manaś caiva susaṃyatam vidyā tapaś ca kīrtiś ca sa tīrthaphalam aśnute
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भावदुष्टिं परित्यज्य स्वधर्मपरिनिष्ठितः श्रान्तसंवाहनं कुर्वन् दद्याद् अन्नं यथोचितम्
verses.transliteration: bhāvaduṣṭiṃ parityajya svadharmapariniṣṭhitaḥ śrāntasaṃvāhanaṃ kurvan dadyād annaṃ yathocitam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अकिंचनेभ्यः साधुभ्यो दद्याद् वस्त्राणि कम्बलान् शृण्वन् हरिकथां दिव्यां तथा गङ्गासमुद्भवाम् अनेन विधिना गच्छन् सम्यक् तीर्थफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: akiṃcanebhyaḥ sādhubhyo dadyād vastrāṇi kambalān śṛṇvan harikathāṃ divyāṃ tathā gaṅgāsamudbhavām anena vidhinā gacchan samyak tīrthaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यम्बकश् च इति प्राह गौतमं मुनिभिर् वृतम्
verses.transliteration: tryambakaś ca iti prāha gautamaṃ munibhir vṛtam
verses.translation: Vasudeva then said to him with great respect:_
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्विहस्तमात्रे तीर्थानि संभविष्यन्ति गौतम सर्वत्राहं संनिहितः सर्वकामप्रदस् तथा
verses.transliteration: dvihastamātre tīrthāni saṃbhaviṣyanti gautama sarvatrāhaṃ saṃnihitaḥ sarvakāmapradas tathā
verses.translation: The yearly revenue to the king has been paid: The purpose for which you all came here has been served. Hence, my noble friends should not stay here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदा तु सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा पर्वते ऽमरकण्टके यमुना संगता तत्र प्रभासे तु सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: narmadā tu saricchreṣṭhā parvate 'marakaṇṭake yamunā saṃgatā tatra prabhāse tu sarasvatī
verses.translation: That son of mine born of Rohinl should be looked after by you in the same manner as your own son.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णा भीमरथी चैव तुङ्गभद्रा तु नारद तिसृणां संगमो यत्र तत् तीर्थं मुक्तिदं नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇā bhīmarathī caiva tuṅgabhadrā tu nārada tisṛṇāṃ saṃgamo yatra tat tīrthaṃ muktidaṃ nṛṇām
verses.translation: Thus urged, the powerful cowherds led by Nanda paid the revenue and went back after loading their carts with vessels and articles of trade.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पयोउष्णी संगता यत्र तत्रत्या तच् च मुक्तिदम् इयं तु गौतमी वत्स यत्र क्वापि ममाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: payouṣṇī saṃgatā yatra tatratyā tac ca muktidam iyaṃ tu gautamī vatsa yatra kvāpi mamājñayā
verses.translation: Whde they were staying in the cowherds' colony a certain (ogress) named Putana who had been going about i mg chddrcntookup Rrsna whowas asleep at night and fed at her breasts.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां सर्वदा नॄणां स्नानान् मुक्तिं प्रदास्यति किंचित्काले पुण्यतमं किंचित्तीर्थं सुरागमे
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ sarvadā nṝṇāṃ snānān muktiṃ pradāsyati kiṃcitkāle puṇyatamaṃ kiṃcittīrthaṃ surāgame
verses.translation: All the childern whom Putana the night used to die instantaneously.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां सर्वदा तीर्थं गौतमी नात्र संशयः तिस्रः कोट्यो ऽर्धकोटी च योजनानां शतद्वये
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ sarvadā tīrthaṃ gautamī nātra saṃśayaḥ tisraḥ koṭyo 'rdhakoṭī ca yojanānāṃ śatadvaye
verses.translation: Krsna seized her breasts and pressed them forcibly with both of his hands. He sucked the breast furiously and drank up even her vital breath.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानि मुनिशार्दूल संभविष्यन्ति गौतम इयं माहेश्वरी गङ्गा गौतमी वैष्णवीति च
verses.transliteration: tīrthāni muniśārdūla saṃbhaviṣyanti gautama iyaṃ māheśvarī gaṅgā gautamī vaiṣṇavīti ca
verses.translation: The terrible Putana groaned loudly as she died with the nervous cards snapping one by one. She fell on the ground.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मी गोदावरी नन्दा सुनन्दा कामदायिनी ब्रह्मतेजःसमानीता सर्वपापप्रणाशनी
verses.transliteration: brāhmī godāvarī nandā sunandā kāmadāyinī brahmatejaḥsamānītā sarvapāpapraṇāśanī
verses.translation: Frightened on hearing her loud cry the residents of the cowherds' colony woke up and saw Putana lying dead and Krsna was in her lap.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्मरणाद् एव पापौघहन्त्री मम सदा प्रिया पञ्चानाम् अपि भूतानाम् आपः श्रेष्ठत्वम् आगताः
verses.transliteration: smaraṇād eva pāpaughahantrī mama sadā priyā pañcānām api bhūtānām āpaḥ śreṣṭhatvam āgatāḥ
verses.translation: Nanda the cowherd took some cow-dung and smeared Krsna's forehead with it, according him protection thereby. Even as he did so he uttered these Mantras:—
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि तीर्थभूतास् तु तस्माद् आपः पराः स्मृताः तासां भागीरथी श्रेष्ठा ताभ्यो ऽपि गौतमी तथा
verses.transliteration: tatrāpi tīrthabhūtās tu tasmād āpaḥ parāḥ smṛtāḥ tāsāṃ bhāgīrathī śreṣṭhā tābhyo 'pi gautamī tathā
verses.translation: The boy for whom the benedictory rites were performed
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आनीता सजटा गङ्गा अस्या नान्यच् छुभावहम् स्वर्गे भुवि तले वापि तीर्थं सर्वार्थदं मुने
verses.transliteration: ānītā sajaṭā gaṅgā asyā nānyac chubhāvaham svarge bhuvi tale vāpi tīrthaṃ sarvārthadaṃ mune
verses.translation: On seeing the huge body of the dead ogress Putana, the cowherds were frightened and surprised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एतत् कथितं पुत्र गौतमाय महात्मने साक्षाद् धरेण तुष्टेन मया तव निवेदितम्
verses.transliteration: ity etat kathitaṃ putra gautamāya mahātmane sākṣād dhareṇa tuṣṭena mayā tava niveditam
verses.translation: On seeing the huge body of the dead ogress Putana, the cowherds were frightened and surprised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं सा गौतमी गङ्गा सर्वेभ्यो ऽप्य् अधिका मता तत्स्वरूपं च कथितं कुतो ऽन्या श्रवणस्पृहा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sā gautamī gaṅgā sarvebhyo 'py adhikā matā tatsvarūpaṃ ca kathitaṃ kuto 'nyā śravaṇaspṛhā
verses.translation: On seeing the huge body of the dead ogress Putana, the cowherds were frightened and surprised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्विविधा सैव गदिता एकापि सुरसत्तम एको भेदस् तु कथितो ब्राह्मणेनाहृतो यतः
verses.transliteration: dvividhā saiva gaditā ekāpi surasattama eko bhedas tu kathito brāhmaṇenāhṛto yataḥ
verses.translation: Thus urged by Vjisudeva, Garga went to the Cowherds' colony disguised and unknown to the cowherds. He performed the postnatal ceremonies and rites for the two boys,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियेणापरो ऽप्य् अंशो जटास्व् एव व्यवस्थितः भवस्य देवदेवस्य आहृतस् तद् वदस्व मे
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyeṇāparo 'py aṃśo jaṭāsv eva vyavasthitaḥ bhavasya devadevasya āhṛtas tad vadasva me
verses.translation: O brahmins, in a short while the two boys became well known as very powerful. They began to crawl on their knees.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतान्वये जात इक्ष्वाकुकुलसंभवः पुरा वै सगरो नाम राजासीद् अतिधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: vaivasvatānvaye jāta ikṣvākukulasaṃbhavaḥ purā vai sagaro nāma rājāsīd atidhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: With their bodies smeared with the ashes of cowdung cakes they roamed about here and there. Neither Yasoda nor Rohini was inclined to stop them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यज्वा दानपरो नित्यं धर्माचारविचारवान् तस्य भार्याद्वयं चासीत् पतिभक्तिपरायणम्
verses.transliteration: yajvā dānaparo nityaṃ dharmācāravicāravān tasya bhāryādvayaṃ cāsīt patibhaktiparāyaṇam
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वै संततिर् नाभूद् इति चिन्तापरो ऽभवत् वसिष्ठं गृहम् आहूय संपूज्य विधिवत् ततः
verses.transliteration: tasya vai saṃtatir nābhūd iti cintāparo 'bhavat vasiṣṭhaṃ gṛham āhūya saṃpūjya vidhivat tataḥ
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उवाच वचनं राजा संततेः कारणं प्रति इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ध्यात्वा राजानम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: uvāca vacanaṃ rājā saṃtateḥ kāraṇaṃ prati iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhyātvā rājānam abravīt
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सपत्नीकः सदा राजन्न् ऋषिपूजापरो भव
verses.transliteration: sapatnīkaḥ sadā rājann ṛṣipūjāparo bhava
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा स मुनिर् विप्र यथास्थानं जगाम ह एकदा तस्य राजर्षेर् गृहम् आगात् तपोनिधिः
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā sa munir vipra yathāsthānaṃ jagāma ha ekadā tasya rājarṣer gṛham āgāt taponidhiḥ
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यर्षेः पूजनं चक्रे स संतुष्टो ऽब्रवीद् वचम् वरं ब्रूहि महाभागेत्य् उक्ते पुत्रान् स चावृणोत्
verses.transliteration: tasyarṣeḥ pūjanaṃ cakre sa saṃtuṣṭo 'bravīd vacam varaṃ brūhi mahābhāgety ukte putrān sa cāvṛṇot
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स मुनिः प्राह राजानम् एकस्यां वंशधारकः पुत्रो भूयात् तथान्यस्यां षष्टिसाहस्रकं सुताः
verses.transliteration: sa muniḥ prāha rājānam ekasyāṃ vaṃśadhārakaḥ putro bhūyāt tathānyasyāṃ ṣaṣṭisāhasrakaṃ sutāḥ
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वरं दत्त्वा मुनौ याते पुत्रा जाताः सहस्रशः स यज्ञान् सुबहूंश् चक्रे हयमेधान् सुदक्षिणान्
verses.transliteration: varaṃ dattvā munau yāte putrā jātāḥ sahasraśaḥ sa yajñān subahūṃś cakre hayamedhān sudakṣiṇān
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन् हयमेधे वै दीक्षितो विधिवन् नृपः पुत्रान् न्ययोजयद् राजा ससैन्यान् हयरक्षणे
verses.transliteration: ekasmin hayamedhe vai dīkṣito vidhivan nṛpaḥ putrān nyayojayad rājā sasainyān hayarakṣaṇe
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिद् अन्तरम् आसाद्य हयं जह्रे शतक्रतुः मार्गमाणाश् च ते पुत्रा नैवापश्यन् हयं तदा
verses.transliteration: kvacid antaram āsādya hayaṃ jahre śatakratuḥ mārgamāṇāś ca te putrā naivāpaśyan hayaṃ tadā
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राणां तथा षष्टिर् नानायुद्धविशारदाः तेषु पश्यत्सु रक्षांसि पुत्रेषु सगरस्य हि
verses.transliteration: sahasrāṇāṃ tathā ṣaṣṭir nānāyuddhaviśāradāḥ teṣu paśyatsu rakṣāṃsi putreṣu sagarasya hi
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रोक्षितं तद् धयं नीत्वा ते रसातलम् आगमन् राक्षसान् मायया युक्तान् नैवापश्यन्त सागराः
verses.transliteration: prokṣitaṃ tad dhayaṃ nītvā te rasātalam āgaman rākṣasān māyayā yuktān naivāpaśyanta sāgarāḥ
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न दृष्ट्वा ते हयं पुत्राः सगरस्य बलीयसः इतश् चेतश् चरन्तस् ते नैवापश्यन् हयं तदा
verses.transliteration: na dṛṣṭvā te hayaṃ putrāḥ sagarasya balīyasaḥ itaś cetaś carantas te naivāpaśyan hayaṃ tadā
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवलोकं तदा जग्मुः पर्वतांश् च सरांसि च वनानि च विचिन्वन्तो नैवापश्यन् हयं तदा
verses.transliteration: devalokaṃ tadā jagmuḥ parvatāṃś ca sarāṃsi ca vanāni ca vicinvanto naivāpaśyan hayaṃ tadā
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृतस्वस्त्ययनो राजा ऋत्विग्भिः कृतमङ्गलः अदृष्ट्वा तु पशुं रम्यं राजा चिन्ताम् उपेयिवान्
verses.transliteration: kṛtasvastyayano rājā ṛtvigbhiḥ kṛtamaṅgalaḥ adṛṣṭvā tu paśuṃ ramyaṃ rājā cintām upeyivān
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अटन्तः सागराः सर्वे देवलोकम् उपागमन् हयं तम् अनुचिन्वन्तस् तत्रापि न हयो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: aṭantaḥ sāgarāḥ sarve devalokam upāgaman hayaṃ tam anucinvantas tatrāpi na hayo 'bhavat
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो महीं समाजग्मुः पर्वतांश् च वनानि च तत्रापि च हयं नैव दृष्टवन्तो नृपात्मजाः
verses.transliteration: tato mahīṃ samājagmuḥ parvatāṃś ca vanāni ca tatrāpi ca hayaṃ naiva dṛṣṭavanto nṛpātmajāḥ
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तत्र दैवी वाग् अभवत् तदा रसातले हयो बद्ध आस्ते नान्यत्र सागराः
verses.transliteration: etasminn antare tatra daivī vāg abhavat tadā rasātale hayo baddha āste nānyatra sāgarāḥ
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा ततो वाक्यं गन्तुकामा रसातलम् अखनन् पृथिवीं सर्वां परितः सागरास् ततः
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā tato vākyaṃ gantukāmā rasātalam akhanan pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ paritaḥ sāgarās tataḥ
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ते क्षुधार्ता मृदं शुष्कां भक्षयन्तस् त्व् अहर्निशम् न्यखनंश् चापि जग्मुश् च सत्वरास् ते रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: te kṣudhārtā mṛdaṃ śuṣkāṃ bhakṣayantas tv aharniśam nyakhanaṃś cāpi jagmuś ca satvarās te rasātalam
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तान् आगतान् भूपसुतान् सागरान् बलिनः कृतीन् श्रुत्वा रक्षांसि संत्रस्ता व्यगमन् कपिलान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: tān āgatān bhūpasutān sāgarān balinaḥ kṛtīn śrutvā rakṣāṃsi saṃtrastā vyagaman kapilāntikam
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कपिलो ऽपि महाप्राज्ञस् तत्र शेते रसातले पुरा च साधितं तेन देवानां कार्यम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kapilo 'pi mahāprājñas tatra śete rasātale purā ca sādhitaṃ tena devānāṃ kāryam uttamam
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विनिद्रेण ततः श्रान्तः सिद्धे कार्ये सुरान् प्रति अब्रवीत् कपिलः श्रीमान् निद्रास्थानं प्रयच्छथ
verses.transliteration: vinidreṇa tataḥ śrāntaḥ siddhe kārye surān prati abravīt kapilaḥ śrīmān nidrāsthānaṃ prayacchatha
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रसातलं ददुस् तस्मै पुनर् आह सुरान् मुनिः यो माम् उत्थापयेन् मन्दो भस्मी भूयाच् च सत्वरम्
verses.transliteration: rasātalaṃ dadus tasmai punar āha surān muniḥ yo mām utthāpayen mando bhasmī bhūyāc ca satvaram
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः शये तलगतो नो चेन् न स्वप्न एव हि तथेत्य् उक्तः सुरगणैस् तत्र शेते रसातले
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śaye talagato no cen na svapna eva hi tathety uktaḥ suragaṇais tatra śete rasātale
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य प्रभावं ते ज्ञात्वा राक्षसा मायया युताः सागराणां च सर्वेषां वधोपायं प्रचक्रिरे
verses.transliteration: tasya prabhāvaṃ te jñātvā rākṣasā māyayā yutāḥ sāgarāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vadhopāyaṃ pracakrire
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विना युद्धेन ते भीता राक्षसाः सत्वरास् तदा आगत्य यत्र स मुनिः कपिलः कोपनो महान्
verses.transliteration: vinā yuddhena te bhītā rākṣasāḥ satvarās tadā āgatya yatra sa muniḥ kapilaḥ kopano mahān
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिरोदेशे हयं ते वै बद्ध्वाथ त्वरयान्विताः दूरे स्थित्वा मौनिनश् च प्रेक्षन्तः किं भवेद् इति
verses.transliteration: śirodeśe hayaṃ te vai baddhvātha tvarayānvitāḥ dūre sthitvā mauninaś ca prekṣantaḥ kiṃ bhaved iti
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तु सागराः सर्वे निर्विशन्तो रसातलम् ददृशुस् ते हयं बद्धं शयानं पुरुषं तथा
verses.transliteration: tatas tu sāgarāḥ sarve nirviśanto rasātalam dadṛśus te hayaṃ baddhaṃ śayānaṃ puruṣaṃ tathā
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तं मेनिरे च हर्तारं क्रतुहन्तारम् एव च एनं हत्वा महापापं नयामो ऽश्वं नृपान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ menire ca hartāraṃ kratuhantāram eva ca enaṃ hatvā mahāpāpaṃ nayāmo 'śvaṃ nṛpāntikam
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: केचिद् ऊचुः पशुं बद्धं नयामो ऽनेन किं फलम् तदाहुर् अपरे शूरा राजानः शासका वयम्
verses.transliteration: kecid ūcuḥ paśuṃ baddhaṃ nayāmo 'nena kiṃ phalam tadāhur apare śūrā rājānaḥ śāsakā vayam
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्थाप्यैनं महापापं हन्मः क्षात्रेण वर्चसा ते तं जघ्नुर् मुनिं पादैर् ब्रुवन्तो निष्ठुराणि च
verses.transliteration: utthāpyainaṃ mahāpāpaṃ hanmaḥ kṣātreṇa varcasā te taṃ jaghnur muniṃ pādair bruvanto niṣṭhurāṇi ca
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः कोपेन महता कपिलो मुनिसत्तमः सागरान् ईक्षयाम् आस तान् कोपाद् भस्मसात् करोत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kopena mahatā kapilo munisattamaḥ sāgarān īkṣayām āsa tān kopād bhasmasāt karot

verses.sanskrit: अंशुमान् इति विख्यातः पुत्रस् तस्यासमञ्जसः आनाय्य बालकं राजा कार्यं तस्मै न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: aṃśumān iti vikhyātaḥ putras tasyāsamañjasaḥ ānāyya bālakaṃ rājā kāryaṃ tasmai nyavedayat

verses.sanskrit: तद् देववचनं श्रुत्वा तदर्थं तु तपो महत् स्तुतिं चकार गङ्गाया भक्त्या प्रयतमानसः
verses.transliteration: tad devavacanaṃ śrutvā tadarthaṃ tu tapo mahat stutiṃ cakāra gaṅgāyā bhaktyā prayatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्या अपि प्रसादं च प्राप्य बालो ऽप्य् अबालवत् गङ्गां महेश्वरात् प्राप्ताम् आदायागाद् रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: tasyā api prasādaṃ ca prāpya bālo 'py abālavat gaṅgāṃ maheśvarāt prāptām ādāyāgād rasātalam
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न्यवेदयत् स मुनये कपिलाय महात्मने यथोदितप्रकारेण गङ्गां संस्थाप्य यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: nyavedayat sa munaye kapilāya mahātmane yathoditaprakāreṇa gaṅgāṃ saṃsthāpya yatnataḥ
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणम् अथावर्त्य कृताञ्जलिपुटो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇam athāvartya kṛtāñjalipuṭo 'bravīt
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवि मे पितरः शापात् कपिलस्य महामुनेः प्राप्तास् ते विगतिं मातस् तस्मात् तान् पातुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: devi me pitaraḥ śāpāt kapilasya mahāmuneḥ prāptās te vigatiṃ mātas tasmāt tān pātum arhasi
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सुरनदी सर्वेषाम् उपकारिका लोकानाम् उपकारार्थं पितॄणां पावनाय च
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā suranadī sarveṣām upakārikā lokānām upakārārthaṃ pitṝṇāṃ pāvanāya ca
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यपीतस्याम्भोधेः पूरणाय विशेषतः स्मरणाद् एव पापानां नाशाय सुरनिम्नगा
verses.transliteration: agastyapītasyāmbhodheḥ pūraṇāya viśeṣataḥ smaraṇād eva pāpānāṃ nāśāya suranimnagā
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भगीरथोदितं चक्रे रसातलतले स्थितान् भस्मीभूतान् नृपसुतान् सागरांश् च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: bhagīrathoditaṃ cakre rasātalatale sthitān bhasmībhūtān nṛpasutān sāgarāṃś ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विनिर्दग्धान् अथाप्लाव्य खातपूरम् अथाकरोत् ततो मेरुं समाप्लाव्य स्थितां बालो ऽब्रवीन् नृपः
verses.transliteration: vinirdagdhān athāplāvya khātapūram athākarot tato meruṃ samāplāvya sthitāṃ bālo 'bravīn nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कर्मभूमौ त्वया भाव्यं तथेत्य् आगाद् धिमालयम् हिमवत्पर्वतात् पुण्याद् भारतं वर्षम् अभ्यगात्
verses.transliteration: karmabhūmau tvayā bhāvyaṃ tathety āgād dhimālayam himavatparvatāt puṇyād bhārataṃ varṣam abhyagāt
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तन्मध्यतः पुण्यनदी प्रायात् पूर्वार्णवं प्रति एवम् एषापि ते प्रोक्ता गङ्गा क्षात्रा महामुने
verses.transliteration: tanmadhyataḥ puṇyanadī prāyāt pūrvārṇavaṃ prati evam eṣāpi te proktā gaṅgā kṣātrā mahāmune
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: माहेश्वरी वैष्णवी च सैव ब्राह्मी च पावनी भागीरथी देवनदी हिमवच्छिखराश्रया
verses.transliteration: māheśvarī vaiṣṇavī ca saiva brāhmī ca pāvanī bhāgīrathī devanadī himavacchikharāśrayā
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरजटावारि एवं द्वैविध्यम् आगतम् विन्ध्यस्य दक्षिणे गङ्गा गौतमी सा निगद्यते उत्तरे सापि विन्ध्यस्य भागीरथ्य् अभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: maheśvarajaṭāvāri evaṃ dvaividhyam āgatam vindhyasya dakṣiṇe gaṅgā gautamī sā nigadyate uttare sāpi vindhyasya bhāgīrathy abhidhīyate
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न मनस् तृप्तिम् आधत्ते कथाः शृण्वत् त्वयेरिताः पृथक् तीर्थफलं श्रोतुं प्रवृत्तं मम मानसम्
verses.transliteration: na manas tṛptim ādhatte kathāḥ śṛṇvat tvayeritāḥ pṛthak tīrthaphalaṃ śrotuṃ pravṛttaṃ mama mānasam
verses.translation: He went to the river Kalindl that had gently moving ripples and waves and that appeared to be smiling all round by the clusters of foams sticking to the banks.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्रमशो ब्राह्मणानीतां गङ्गां मे प्रथमं वद पृथक् तीर्थफलं पुण्यं सेतिहासं यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: kramaśo brāhmaṇānītāṃ gaṅgāṃ me prathamaṃ vada pṛthak tīrthaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ setihāsaṃ yathākramam
verses.translation: There he saw a hideous and extremely terrible whirl¬ pool of serpent Kaliya, which had been defiled by sparks of poisonous fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानां च पृथग् भावं फलं माहात्म्यम् एव च सर्वं वक्तुं न शक्नोमि न च त्वं श्रवणे क्षमः
verses.transliteration: tīrthānāṃ ca pṛthag bhāvaṃ phalaṃ māhātmyam eva ca sarvaṃ vaktuṃ na śaknomi na ca tvaṃ śravaṇe kṣamaḥ
verses.translation: As the fire of poison spread, the great trees that grew on its banks were burnt. Even the birds (that flew over it) had been burnt when they came into contact with its watery spray as the wind wafted it up.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथापि किंचिद् वक्ष्यामि शृणु नारद यत्नतः यान्य् उक्तानि च तीर्थानि श्रुतिवाक्यानि यानि च
verses.transliteration: tathāpi kiṃcid vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ yāny uktāni ca tīrthāni śrutivākyāni yāni ca
verses.translation: On seeing that highly terrible serpent which was like another jaw of Death lord Krsna thought thus:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तानि वक्ष्यामि संक्षेपान् नमस्कृत्वा त्रिलोचनम् यत्रासौ भगवान् आसीत् प्रत्यक्षस् त्र्यम्बको मुने
verses.transliteration: tāni vakṣyāmi saṃkṣepān namaskṛtvā trilocanam yatrāsau bhagavān āsīt pratyakṣas tryambako mune
verses.translation: Therefore, I shall climb this great tree of Kadamba which is not very far off from it, I shall jump into the eddy of the serpent that causes destruction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यम्बकं नाम तत् तीर्थं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम् वाराहम् अपरं तीर्थं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: tryambakaṃ nāma tat tīrthaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam vārāham aparaṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
verses.translation: Those trees that were sprinkled with the hot water heated by the flames of the defiled person of the serpent blazed suddenly. The flames then spread over all the quarters.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य रूपं प्रवक्ष्यामि नाम विष्णोर् यथाभवत् पुरा देवान् पराभूय यज्ञम् आदाय राक्षसः
verses.transliteration: tasya rūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi nāma viṣṇor yathābhavat purā devān parābhūya yajñam ādāya rākṣasaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Krsna clapped and dashed against the whirlpool with his arms. On hearing that sound the king of serpents approached him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रसातलम् अनुप्राप्तः सिन्धुसेन इति श्रुतः यज्ञे तलम् अनुप्राप्ते निर्यज्ञा ह्य् अभवन् मही
verses.transliteration: rasātalam anuprāptaḥ sindhusena iti śrutaḥ yajñe talam anuprāpte niryajñā hy abhavan mahī
verses.translation: His eyes turned red due to wrath; his hoods became agitated through poisonous flames. He was surrounded by pink-coloured serpents of great poison.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नायं लोको ऽस्ति न परो यज्ञे नष्ट इतीत्वराः सुरास् तम् एव विविशू रसातलम् अनुद्विषम्
verses.transliteration: nāyaṃ loko 'sti na paro yajñe naṣṭa itītvarāḥ surās tam eva viviśū rasātalam anudviṣam
verses.translation: There were hundreds of wives of the serpent. They appeared splendid by their attractive necklaces. Their earrings sparkled as they moved along with their jerking trembling bodies.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नाशक्नुवंस् तु तं जेतुं देवा इन्द्रपुरोगमाः विष्णुं पुराणपुरुषं गत्वा तस्मै न्यवेदयन्
verses.transliteration: nāśaknuvaṃs tu taṃ jetuṃ devā indrapurogamāḥ viṣṇuṃ purāṇapuruṣaṃ gatvā tasmai nyavedayan
verses.translation: On seeing him fallen there afflicted by the bodies of serpents, the cowherd lads went back to Vraja (the colony of cowherds) and lamented in their excessive grief.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसस्य तु तत् कर्म यज्ञभ्रंशम् अशेषतः ततः प्रोवाच भगवान् वाराहं वपुर् आस्थितः
verses.transliteration: rākṣasasya tu tat karma yajñabhraṃśam aśeṣataḥ tataḥ provāca bhagavān vārāhaṃ vapur āsthitaḥ
verses.translation: In his. delusion Krsna went into the eddy of Kaliya. He has sunk into it. He is being bitten by the king of serpents. Hence, all of you come. Do not delay.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिर् गत्वा चैव रसातलम् आनयिष्ये मखं पुण्यं हत्वा राक्षसपुंगवान्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇir gatvā caiva rasātalam ānayiṣye makhaṃ puṇyaṃ hatvā rākṣasapuṃgavān
verses.translation: On hearing these words comparable to the stunning blow of the thunderbolt, the cowherds and the cowherdesses, Yosoda and others, hastened to the eddy.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वः प्रयान्तु सुराः सर्वे व्येतु वो मानसो ज्वरः येन गङ्गा तलं प्राप्ता पथा तेनैव चक्रधृक्
verses.transliteration: svaḥ prayāntu surāḥ sarve vyetu vo mānaso jvaraḥ yena gaṅgā talaṃ prāptā pathā tenaiva cakradhṛk
verses.translation: Rama of wonderful exploits, Nandagopa and other cowherds hastened to Yamuna, desirous of seeing Krsna.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जगाम तरसा पुत्र भुवं भित्त्वा रसातलम् स वराहवपुः श्रीमान् रसातलनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: jagāma tarasā putra bhuvaṃ bhittvā rasātalam sa varāhavapuḥ śrīmān rasātalanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, staring anxiously at the face of his son, Nandagopa stood motionless. The highly blessed Yosoda was also like that.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसान् दानवान् हत्वा मुखे धृत्वा महाध्वरम् वाराहरूपी भगवान् मखम् आदाय यज्ञभुक्
verses.transliteration: rākṣasān dānavān hatvā mukhe dhṛtvā mahādhvaram vārāharūpī bhagavān makham ādāya yajñabhuk
verses.translation: The cowherdesses and others looked on helplessly. In their extreme distress and grief they wept continuously owing to their love for Kcs'ava. Those ladies said in the frightened timidity of their minds: Ail of us shall now enter this great eddy of the king of serpents alongwith Yasoda. It is not proper on our part to go back to our colony.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: येन प्राप तलं विष्णुः पथा तेनैव शत्रुजित् मुखे न्यस्य महायज्ञं निश्चक्राम रसातलात्
verses.transliteration: yena prāpa talaṃ viṣṇuḥ pathā tenaiva śatrujit mukhe nyasya mahāyajñaṃ niścakrāma rasātalāt
verses.translation: Vyasa said:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ब्रह्मगिरौ देवाः प्रतीक्षां चक्रिरे हरेः पथस् तस्माद् विनिःसृत्य गङ्गास्रवणम् अभ्यगात्
verses.transliteration: tatra brahmagirau devāḥ pratīkṣāṃ cakrire hareḥ pathas tasmād viniḥsṛtya gaṅgāsravaṇam abhyagāt
verses.translation: He saw Nanda extremely distressed with his eyes fixed to his face. He saw Yasoda perturbed and faintingwithout being fully aware of his greatness. With both of his hands he made the middle hood bend down. As the head of the serpent king became bent he rode and danced on it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्राक्षालयच् च स्वाङ्गानि असृग्लिप्तानि नारद गङ्गाम्भसा तत्र कुण्डं वाराहम् अभवत् ततः
verses.transliteration: prākṣālayac ca svāṅgāni asṛgliptāni nārada gaṅgāmbhasā tatra kuṇḍaṃ vārāham abhavat tataḥ
verses.translation: The hood of the serpent became wounded due to the kicks from the feet of Kr§na whenever the hood was raised. After the kick his head bent low.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मुखे न्यस्तं महायज्ञं देवानां पुरतो हरिः दत्तवांस् त्रिदशश्रेष्ठो मुखाद् यज्ञो ऽभ्यजायत
verses.transliteration: mukhe nyastaṃ mahāyajñaṃ devānāṃ purato hariḥ dattavāṃs tridaśaśreṣṭho mukhād yajño 'bhyajāyata
verses.translation: By frequent hits and blows from Krsna the serpent became unconscious and deluded. Due to the fierce kickings he vomited blood. On seeing that serpent had been compelled to bend his head and neck to shed blood from his mouth the wives of the serpent lord sought shelter in Krsna.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति यज्ञाङ्गं प्रधानं स्रुव उच्यते वाराहरूपम् अभवद् एवं वै कारणान्तरात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti yajñāṅgaṃ pradhānaṃ sruva ucyate vārāharūpam abhavad evaṃ vai kāraṇāntarāt
verses.translation: O serpent, you must not stay any longer in the waters of Yamuna, go to the waters of the ocean along with your sons and attendants.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् पुण्यतमं तीर्थं वाराहं सर्वकामदम् तत्र स्नानं च दानं च सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt puṇyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ vārāhaṃ sarvakāmadam tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam
verses.translation: O serpent, when he sees the imprints of my feet on your head during your stay in the ocean, Garuqla the enemy of serpents will not strike you. After saying this lordHari released the king of serpents. The serpent lord bowed down to Krsna and went to the ocean.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्थितो ऽपि यः कश्चित् पितॄन् स्मरति पुण्यकृत् विमुक्ताः सर्वपापेभ्यः पितरः स्वर्गम् आप्नुयुः
verses.transliteration: tatra sthito 'pi yaḥ kaścit pitṝn smarati puṇyakṛt vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ pitaraḥ svargam āpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: Even as all the living beings stood watching, the serpent king abandoned his white eddy and went away along with servants, children and kinsmen accompanied by all his wives.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुशावर्तस्य माहात्म्यम् अहं वक्तुं न ते क्षमः तस्य स्मरणमात्रेण कृतकृत्यो भवेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: kuśāvartasya māhātmyam ahaṃ vaktuṃ na te kṣamaḥ tasya smaraṇamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyo bhaven naraḥ
verses.translation: Once again, Bala and Keava started tending the cows together. Wandering along the forest they came to the beautiful grove of palmyre trees.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुशावर्तम् इति ख्यातं नराणां सर्वकामदम् कुशेनावर्तितं यत्र गौतमेन महात्मना
verses.transliteration: kuśāvartam iti khyātaṃ narāṇāṃ sarvakāmadam kuśenāvartitaṃ yatra gautamena mahātmanā
verses.translation: The Asura Dhenuka occupied that palmyra grove after assuming the form of a donkey. Human flesh and beef consti¬ tuted his diet.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुशेनावर्तयित्वा तु आनयाम् आस तां मुनिः तत्र स्नानं च दानं च पितॄणां तृप्तिदायकम्
verses.transliteration: kuśenāvartayitvā tu ānayām āsa tāṃ muniḥ tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidāyakam
verses.translation: On seeing the beautiful palm grove richlyendowed with plenty of fruits, the cowherds became desirous of plucking those fruits. They said thus:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नीलगङ्गा सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा निःसृता नीलपर्वतात् तत्र स्नानादि यत् किंचित् करोति प्रयतो नरः
verses.transliteration: nīlagaṅgā saricchreṣṭhā niḥsṛtā nīlaparvatāt tatra snānādi yat kiṃcit karoti prayato naraḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the cowherd lads, Sariikar- sana and Krsna knocked clown the palm fruits to the ground.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं तद् अक्षयं विद्यात् पितॄणां तृप्तिदायकम् विश्रुतं त्रिषु लोकेषु कपोतं तीर्थम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ vidyāt pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidāyakam viśrutaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kapotaṃ tīrtham uttamam
verses.translation: On hearing the sound of the falling palmyra fruits the evil-minded king of Asuras, a son of Diti who had assumed the form of a donkey came there in great fury.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य रूपं च वक्ष्यामि मुने शृणु महाफलम् तत्र ब्रह्मगिरौ कश्चिद् व्याधः परमदारुणः
verses.transliteration: tasya rūpaṃ ca vakṣyāmi mune śṛṇu mahāphalam tatra brahmagirau kaścid vyādhaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: As he fell down from the top of the palm tree the dead donkey brought with him many fruits on the Earth like a gust of wind bringing down clouds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हिनस्ति ब्राह्मणान् साधून् यतीन् गोपक्षिणो मृगान् एवंभूतः स पापात्मा क्रोधनो ऽनृतभाषणः
verses.transliteration: hinasti brāhmaṇān sādhūn yatīn gopakṣiṇo mṛgān evaṃbhūtaḥ sa pāpātmā krodhano 'nṛtabhāṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Krsna and Balabhadra playfully seized other asuras too in the form of donkeys—this asura's kinsmen came there
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भीषणाकृतिर् अत्युग्रो नीलाक्षो ह्रस्वबाहुकः दन्तुरो नष्टनासाक्षो ह्रस्वपात् पृथुकुक्षिकः
verses.transliteration: bhīṣaṇākṛtir atyugro nīlākṣo hrasvabāhukaḥ danturo naṣṭanāsākṣo hrasvapāt pṛthukukṣikaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, thereafter without any obstruction the cows comfortably grazed fresh shoots of grass inthatpalmgrove where they had not been grazing before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ह्रस्वोदरो ह्रस्वभुजो विकृतो गर्दभस्वनः पाशहस्तः पापचित्तः पापिष्ठः सधनुः सदा
verses.transliteration: hrasvodaro hrasvabhujo vikṛto gardabhasvanaḥ pāśahastaḥ pāpacittaḥ pāpiṣṭhaḥ sadhanuḥ sadā
verses.translation: Then those two sons of Vasudeva much delighted after killing asura Dhenuka, went to the Bhandlra forest.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्या तथाभूता अपत्यान्य् अपि नारद तया तु प्रेर्यमाणो ऽसौ विवेश गहनं वनम्
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā tathābhūtā apatyāny api nārada tayā tu preryamāṇo 'sau viveśa gahanaṃ vanam
verses.translation: Jesting and shouting, singing and collecting the fruits of the trees those two noble boys shone splendidly like two bulls with tiny horns.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स जघान मृगान् पापः पक्षिणो बहुरूपिणः पञ्जरे प्राक्षिपत् कांश्चिज् जीवमानांस् तथेतरान्
verses.transliteration: sa jaghāna mṛgān pāpaḥ pakṣiṇo bahurūpiṇaḥ pañjare prākṣipat kāṃścij jīvamānāṃs tathetarān
verses.translation: An Asura named Pralamba, desirous of catching them, came there, even as both of them were sporting about thus. He was disguised as an ordinary cowherd.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्षुधया परितप्ताङ्गो विह्वलस् तृषया तथा भ्रान्तदेशो बहुतरं न्यवर्तत गृहं प्रति
verses.transliteration: kṣudhayā paritaptāṅgo vihvalas tṛṣayā tathā bhrāntadeśo bahutaraṃ nyavartata gṛhaṃ prati
verses.translation: He considered ways and means to find about a vulnerable point in them very quickly. He desired to kill Krsna and Balarama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽपराह्णे संप्राप्ते निवृत्ते मधुमाधवे क्षणात् तडिद् गर्जितं च साभ्रं चैवाभवत् तदा
verses.transliteration: tato 'parāhṇe saṃprāpte nivṛtte madhumādhave kṣaṇāt taḍid garjitaṃ ca sābhraṃ caivābhavat tadā
verses.translation: The Danava carried Samkarsana on his shoulders and walked quickly. He did not stop (at the stipulated plaee). He appeared like the cloud carrying the moon.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ववौ वायुः साश्मवर्षो वारिधारातिभीषणः स गच्छंल् लुब्धकः श्रान्तः पन्थानं नावबुध्यत
verses.transliteration: vavau vāyuḥ sāśmavarṣo vāridhārātibhīṣaṇaḥ sa gacchaṃl lubdhakaḥ śrāntaḥ panthānaṃ nāvabudhyata
verses.translation: Unable to bear the weight of Rauhneya the excellent asura increased in size with his body like a cloud in the rainy season.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जलं स्थलं गर्तम् अथो पन्थानम् अथवा दिशः न बुबोध तदा पापः श्रान्तः शरणम् अप्य् अथ
verses.transliteration: jalaṃ sthalaṃ gartam atho panthānam athavā diśaḥ na bubodha tadā pāpaḥ śrāntaḥ śaraṇam apy atha
verses.translation: Unable to bear the weight of Rauhneya the excellent asura increased in size with his body like a cloud in the rainy season.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्व गच्छामि क्व तिष्ठेयं किं करोमीत्य् अचिन्तयत् सर्वेषां प्राणिनां प्राणान् आहर्ताहं यथान्तकः
verses.transliteration: kva gacchāmi kva tiṣṭheyaṃ kiṃ karomīty acintayat sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇān āhartāhaṃ yathāntakaḥ
verses.translation: Unable to bear the weight of Rauhneya the excellent asura increased in size with his body like a cloud in the rainy season.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ममाप्य् अन्तकरं भूतं संप्राप्तं चाश्मवर्षणम् त्रातारं नैव पश्यामि शिलां वा वृक्षम् अन्तिके
verses.transliteration: mamāpy antakaraṃ bhūtaṃ saṃprāptaṃ cāśmavarṣaṇam trātāraṃ naiva paśyāmi śilāṃ vā vṛkṣam antike
verses.translation: Unable to bear the weight of Rauhneya the excellent asura increased in size with his body like a cloud in the rainy season.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं बहुविधं व्याधो विचिन्त्यापश्यद् अन्तिके वने वनस्पतिम् इव नक्षत्राणां यथात्रिजम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ vyādho vicintyāpaśyad antike vane vanaspatim iva nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathātrijam
verses.translation: Unable to bear the weight of Rauhneya the excellent asura increased in size with his body like a cloud in the rainy season.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृगाणां च यथा सिंहम् आश्रमाणां गृहाधिपम् इन्द्रियाणां मन इव त्रातारं प्राणिनां नगम्
verses.transliteration: mṛgāṇāṃ ca yathā siṃham āśramāṇāṃ gṛhādhipam indriyāṇāṃ mana iva trātāraṃ prāṇināṃ nagam
verses.translation: Unable to bear the weight of Rauhneya the excellent asura increased in size with his body like a cloud in the rainy season.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रेष्ठं विटपिनं शुभ्रं शाखापल्लवमण्डितम् तम् आश्रित्योपविष्टो ऽभूत् क्लिन्नवासा स लुब्धकः
verses.transliteration: śreṣṭhaṃ viṭapinaṃ śubhraṃ śākhāpallavamaṇḍitam tam āśrityopaviṣṭo 'bhūt klinnavāsā sa lubdhakaḥ
verses.translation: Unable to bear the weight of Rauhneya the excellent asura increased in size with his body like a cloud in the rainy season.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्मरन् भार्याम् अपत्यानि जीवेयुर् अथवा न वा एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तत्र चास्तं प्राप्तो दिवाकरः

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरः पूज्यमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः कपोतश् च कपोती च तृतीयो लुब्धकस् तथा गङ्गायाश् च प्रभावेण सर्वे वै दिवम् आक्रमन्

verses.translation: Unable to bear the weight of Rauhneya the excellent asura increased in size with his body like a cloud in the rainy season.

verses.sanskrit: कार्त्तिकेयं परं तीर्थं कौमारम् इति विश्रुतम् यन्नामश्रवणाद् एव कुलवान् रूपवान् भवेत्

verses.translation: Even as Rama and Kesava sported about thus, the rainy season passed off and the season of Autumn set in when lotuses blossomed forth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निहते तारके दैत्ये स्वस्थे जाते त्रिविष्टपे कार्त्तिकेयं सुतं ज्येष्ठं प्रीत्या प्रोवाच पार्वती
verses.transliteration: nihate tārake daitye svasthe jāte triviṣṭape kārttikeyaṃ sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ prītyā provāca pārvatī
verses.translation: On seeing the cowherds enthusiastic and desirous of celebrating the festival the highly intelligent Krsna spoke to the elders out of curiosity.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथासुखं भुङ्क्ष्व भोगांस् त्रैलोक्ये मनसः प्रियान् ममाज्ञया प्रीतमनाः पितुश् चैव प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: yathāsukhaṃ bhuṅkṣva bhogāṃs trailokye manasaḥ priyān mamājñayā prītamanāḥ pituś caiva prasādataḥ
verses.translation: "What is this festival of Indra wherein you are so very delighted?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः स वै मात्रा विशाखो देवतास्त्रियः यथासुखं बलाद् रेमे देवपत्न्यो ऽपि रेमिरे
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ sa vai mātrā viśākho devatāstriyaḥ yathāsukhaṃ balād reme devapatnyo 'pi remire
verses.translation: Plants and foodgrains are produced by that rain. We and other embodied beings sustain ourselves by eating them. So we propitiate the Deities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः संभुज्यमानासु देवपत्नीषु नारद नाशक्नुवन् वारयितुं कार्त्तिकेयं दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃbhujyamānāsu devapatnīṣu nārada nāśaknuvan vārayituṃ kārttikeyaṃ divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: The land without plants and grass and people afflicted by hunger are not seen in the places where rain-bearing clouds are seen.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो निवेदयाम् आसुः पार्वत्यै पुत्रकर्म तत् असकृद् वार्यमाणो ऽपि मात्रा देवैः स शक्तिधृक्
verses.transliteration: tato nivedayām āsuḥ pārvatyai putrakarma tat asakṛd vāryamāṇo 'pi mātrā devaiḥ sa śaktidhṛk
verses.translation: The cloud squeezes the terrestrial water through the rays of the sun. Parjanya, lord of the cloud, showers it on the Earth for Existence and growth of the world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नैवासाव् अकरोद् वाक्यं स्त्रीष्व् आसक्तस् तु षण्मुखः अभिशापभयाद् भीता पार्वती पर्यचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: naivāsāv akarod vākyaṃ strīṣv āsaktas tu ṣaṇmukhaḥ abhiśāpabhayād bhītā pārvatī paryacintayat
verses.translation: Hence, during the rainy season, the joyous kings, we and other embodied beings, worship Indra the lord of Devas in the festival.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रस्नेहात् तथैवेशा देवानां कार्यसिद्धये देवपत्न्यश् चिरं रक्ष्या इति मत्वा पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: putrasnehāt tathaiveśā devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye devapatnyaś ciraṃ rakṣyā iti matvā punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Nandagopa in regard to the worship of Indra, Kfsna spoke thus, in order to rouse the anger of the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्यां तु रमते स्कन्दः पार्वती त्व् अपि तादृशी तद्रूपम् आत्मनः कृत्वा वर्तयाम् आस पार्वती
verses.transliteration: yasyāṃ tu ramate skandaḥ pārvatī tv api tādṛśī tadrūpam ātmanaḥ kṛtvā vartayām āsa pārvatī
verses.translation: The four lores are Anvlksiki (Metaphysics), Tray!
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य वरुणस्यापि भार्याम् आहूय षण्मुखः यावत् पश्यति तस्यां तु मातृरूपम् अपश्यत
verses.transliteration: indrasya varuṇasyāpi bhāryām āhūya ṣaṇmukhaḥ yāvat paśyati tasyāṃ tu mātṛrūpam apaśyata
verses.translation: O highly blessed one, the lore Varta consists of three breeding 3310113  Agriculture > trading activity and cattle
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताम् अपास्य नमस्याथ पुनर् अन्याम् अथाह्वयत् तस्यां तु मातृरूपं स प्रेक्ष्य लज्जाम् उपेयिवान्
verses.transliteration: tām apāsya namasyātha punar anyām athāhvayat tasyāṃ tu mātṛrūpaṃ sa prekṣya lajjām upeyivān
verses.translation: Whatever be the calling one has adopted, it should be considered as his great deity. It should be honoured and wor¬ shipped. Only that calling renders him true help.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं बह्वीषु तद् रूपं दृष्ट्वा मातृमयं जगत् इति संचिन्त्य गाङ्गेयो वैराग्यम् अगमत् तदा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bahvīṣu tad rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā mātṛmayaṃ jagat iti saṃcintya gāṅgeyo vairāgyam agamat tadā
verses.translation: If after reaping the fruits of one profession a man honours another, O dear father, he does not derive any thing splendid both here and hereafter.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स तु मातृकृतं ज्ञात्वा प्रवृत्तस्य निवर्तनम् निवार्यश् चेद् अहं भोगात् किंतु पूर्वं प्रवर्तितः
verses.transliteration: sa tu mātṛkṛtaṃ jñātvā pravṛttasya nivartanam nivāryaś ced ahaṃ bhogāt kiṃtu pūrvaṃ pravartitaḥ
verses.translation: Let our borderlands and outskirts be worshipped; our forest extends to them, the mountains mark the boundary of the forests; and the mountain is our ultimate goal.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान् मातृकृतं सर्वं मम हास्यास्पदं त्व् इति लज्जया परया युक्तो गौतमीम् अगमत् तदा
verses.transliteration: tasmān mātṛkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mama hāsyāspadaṃ tv iti lajjayā parayā yukto gautamīm agamat tadā
verses.translation: Let a sacrifice unto the mountain or a sacrifice unto the cows be performed. What have we to do with Mahendra? The cows and the mountains are our deities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इयं च मातृरूपा मे शृणोतु मम भाषितम् इतः स्त्रीनामधेयं यन् मम मातृसमं मतम्
verses.transliteration: iyaṃ ca mātṛrūpā me śṛṇotu mama bhāṣitam itaḥ strīnāmadheyaṃ yan mama mātṛsamaṃ matam
verses.translation: The brahmins are devoted to Yajfias with the chanting of Mantras; the farmers are devoted to Yajnas with their plough¬ shares. We who depend upon the mountains and forests shall practise Yajnas of the mountains and cows.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं ज्ञात्वा लोकनाथः पार्वत्या सह शंकरः पुत्रं निवारयाम् आस वृत्तम् इत्य् अब्रवीद् गुरुः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ jñātvā lokanāthaḥ pārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ putraṃ nivārayām āsa vṛttam ity abravīd guruḥ
verses.translation: Hence, let the mountain Govardhana be honoured and worshipped with all due offerings after killing the sacrificial animal in accordance with injunctions.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरपतिः प्रीतः किं ददामीति चिन्तयन् कृताञ्जलिपुटः स्कन्दः पितरं पुनर् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ surapatiḥ prītaḥ kiṃ dadāmīti cintayan kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ skandaḥ pitaraṃ punar abravīt
verses.translation: Let the whole quantity (of milk and milk products) of the entire colony of the cowherds be taken. Do not be anxious and worried over anything. Let the brahmins and other persons who desire be fed thereby.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सेनापतिः सुरपतिस् तव पुत्रो ऽहम् इत्य् अपि अलम् एतेन देवेश किं वरैः सुरपूजित
verses.transliteration: senāpatiḥ surapatis tava putro 'ham ity api alam etena deveśa kiṃ varaiḥ surapūjita
verses.translation: O brahmins, on hearing these words of his, Nanda and other residents of the colony became delighted with their faces beaming with pleasure. They said "Well said, well said, my boy."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अथवा दातुकामो ऽसि लोकानां हितकाम्यया याचे ऽहं नात्मना देव तद् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: athavā dātukāmo 'si lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā yāce 'haṃ nātmanā deva tad anujñātum arhasi
verses.translation: "O dear one, your suggestion is very splendid. All of us
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महापातकिनः केचिद् गुरुदाराभिगामिनः अत्राप्लवनमात्रेण धौतपापा भवन्तु ते
verses.transliteration: mahāpātakinaḥ kecid gurudārābhigāminaḥ atrāplavanamātreṇa dhautapāpā bhavantu te
verses.translation: Accordingly the residents of colony performed Yajna unto the mountain. They offered oblations unto the mountain by curds, milk puddings, meat etc.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आप्नुवन्तूत्तमां जातिं तिर्यञ्चो ऽपि सुरेश्वर कुरूपो रूपसंपत्तिम् अत्र स्नानाद् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: āpnuvantūttamāṃ jātiṃ tiryañco 'pi sureśvara kurūpo rūpasaṃpattim atra snānād avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Accordingly the residents of colony performed Yajna unto the mountain. They offered oblations unto the mountain by curds, milk puddings, meat etc.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् अस्त्व् इति तं शंभुः प्रत्यनन्दत् सुतेरितम् ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं कार्त्तिकेयम् इति श्रुतम् तत्र स्नानं च दानं च सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: evam astv iti taṃ śaṃbhuḥ pratyanandat suteritam tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ kārttikeyam iti śrutam tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam
verses.translation: Accordingly the residents of colony performed Yajna unto the mountain. They offered oblations unto the mountain by curds, milk puddings, meat etc.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत् ख्यातं कृत्तिकातीर्थं कार्त्तिकेयाद् अनन्तरम् तस्य श्रवणमात्रेण सोमपानफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: yat khyātaṃ kṛttikātīrthaṃ kārttikeyād anantaram tasya śravaṇamātreṇa somapānaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: O brahmins, on being commended thus by the lord of Devas, those clouds let down a terrible gust of wind and downpour for the annihilation of cows. Then, O brahmins, Ear.h, sky and quarters became one as it were, due to the great showers that filled them all.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरा तारकनाशाय भवरेतो ऽपिबत् कविः रेतोगर्भं कविं दृष्ट्वा ऋषिपत्न्यो ऽस्पृहन् मुने
verses.transliteration: purā tārakanāśāya bhavareto 'pibat kaviḥ retogarbhaṃ kaviṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṣipatnyo 'spṛhan mune
verses.translation: The cows began to tremble as the winds blew and the showers fell. They gave, up their lives and fell down with their heads and faces directed sideways.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सप्तर्षीणाम् ऋतुस्नातां वर्जयित्वा त्व् अरुन्धतीम् तासु गर्भः समभवत् षट्सु स्त्रीषु तदाग्नितः
verses.transliteration: saptarṣīṇām ṛtusnātāṃ varjayitvā tv arundhatīm tāsu garbhaḥ samabhavat ṣaṭsu strīṣu tadāgnitaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, other cows stood over their calves covering them with their laps. Still other cows were deprived of their calves by the heavy downpour of water. The distressed calves exhibited their wretched faces. The chill wind made their necks shiver. They seemed to tell Krsna cf O save us, O save us" by uttering few feeble words.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तप्यमानास् तु शोभिष्ठा ऋतुस्नातास् तु ता मुने किं कुर्मः क्व नु गच्छामः किं कृत्वा सुकृतं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tapyamānās tu śobhiṣṭhā ṛtusnātās tu tā mune kiṃ kurmaḥ kva nu gacchāmaḥ kiṃ kṛtvā sukṛtaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: On seeing the entire cowherds' colony bewildered with the cows, cowherds and cowherdesses in utter confusion, Hari thought of the means of saving them. He said.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा ता मिथो गङ्गां व्यग्रा गत्वा व्यपीडयन् ताभ्यस् ते निःसृता गर्भाः फेनरूपास् तदाम्भसि
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā tā mitho gaṅgāṃ vyagrā gatvā vyapīḍayan tābhyas te niḥsṛtā garbhāḥ phenarūpās tadāmbhasi
verses.translation: After thinking thus, Kr?na uprooted the Govardhana mountain and playfully held it aloft with a single hand. On being advised thus by him the cowherds and the cowherdesscs who had been afflicted by the heavy downpour, entered the sheltered spot along with their cattle wealth. They kept their utensils and belongings loaded in carts.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अम्भसा त्व् एकतां प्राप्ता वायुना सर्व एव हि एकरूपस् तदा ताभ्यः षण्मुखः समजायत
verses.transliteration: ambhasā tv ekatāṃ prāptā vāyunā sarva eva hi ekarūpas tadā tābhyaḥ ṣaṇmukhaḥ samajāyata
verses.translation: Krsna then released the great mountain Govardhana and replaced it in its spot, closely watched by the residents of Vraja with wonderment evident in their faces.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्रावयित्वा तु तान् गर्भान् ऋषिपत्न्यो गृहान् ययुः तासां विकृतरूपाणि दृष्ट्वा ते ऋषयो ऽब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: srāvayitvā tu tān garbhān ṛṣipatnyo gṛhān yayuḥ tāsāṃ vikṛtarūpāṇi dṛṣṭvā te ṛṣayo 'bruvan
verses.translation: The lord of Devas, the conqueror of enemies rode on O Kfsna, O Krsna of mighty great arms, listen, why I have come near you. This should not be misunderstood (and thought otherwise) by you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गम्यतां गम्यतां शीघ्रं स्वैरी वृत्तिर् न युज्यते स्त्रीणाम् इति ततो वत्स निरस्ताः पतिभिस् तु ताः
verses.transliteration: gamyatāṃ gamyatāṃ śīghraṃ svairī vṛttir na yujyate strīṇām iti tato vatsa nirastāḥ patibhis tu tāḥ
verses.translation: You are indeed the great lord, the support of every¬ thing. You have incarnated on the surface of the Earth in order to remove the burden of the Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो दुःखं समाविष्टास् त्यक्ताः स्वपतिभिश् च षट् ता दृष्ट्वा नारदः प्राह कार्त्तिकेयो हरोद्भवः
verses.transliteration: tato duḥkhaṃ samāviṣṭās tyaktāḥ svapatibhiś ca ṣaṭ tā dṛṣṭvā nāradaḥ prāha kārttikeyo harodbhavaḥ
verses.translation: The cows were saved by you by uprooting the great mountain. O heroic one, I am delighted by this extremely wonderful feat of yours. Q Krsna, I think, the purpose of Devas has been served today. This excellent mountain has been held aloft with a single hand by you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गाङ्गेयो ऽग्निभवश् चेति विख्यातस् तारकान्तकः तं यान्तु न चिराद् एव प्रीतो भोगं प्रदास्यति
verses.transliteration: gāṅgeyo 'gnibhavaś ceti vikhyātas tārakāntakaḥ taṃ yāntu na cirād eva prīto bhogaṃ pradāsyati
verses.translation: Moreover, O Krsna, I have come near you, after being prompted by the cows saved by you. It is very much for your sake also, you are the cause of causes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षेर् वचनाद् एव समभ्येत्य च षण्मुखम् कृत्तिकाः स्वयम् एवैतद् यथावृत्तं न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: devarṣer vacanād eva samabhyetya ca ṣaṇmukham kṛttikāḥ svayam evaitad yathāvṛttaṃ nyavedayat
verses.translation: Urged by the words of cows, I shall crown you as Upendra (younger brother of Indra). You shall become Govinda, the lord of cows. Then he brought the bell from his vehicle, Airavata. Filling it with sacred waters he performed the rite of coro¬ nation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यो वाक्यं कृत्तिकाभ्यः कार्त्तिकेयो ऽनुमन्य च गौतमीं यान्तु सर्वाश् च स्नात्वापूज्य महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tābhyo vākyaṃ kṛttikābhyaḥ kārttikeyo 'numanya ca gautamīṃ yāntu sarvāś ca snātvāpūjya maheśvaram
