verses.translation: After crowning Sri Krsna at the instance of cows, the husband of SacI, Devendra spoke to Krsna again humbly and lovingly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एष्यामि चाहं तत्रैव यास्यामि सुरमन्दिरम् तथेत्य् उक्त्वा कृत्तिकाश् च स्नात्वा गङ्गां च गौतमीम्
verses.transliteration: eṣyāmi cāhaṃ tatraiva yāsyāmi suramandiram tathety uktvā kṛttikāś ca snātvā gaṅgāṃ ca gautamīm
verses.translation: I know Partha born into the Bharata family from a part of yours. As long as I continue to live on the surface of the Earth, I shall protect him. O Indra, lordofDevas, O suppressor of foes, as long as I stay on the Earth, no one will conquer Arjuna, in battle.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवेश्वरं च संपूज्य कार्त्तिकेयानुशासनात् देवेश्वरप्रसादेन प्रययुः सुरमन्दिरम्
verses.transliteration: deveśvaraṃ ca saṃpūjya kārttikeyānuśāsanāt deveśvaraprasādena prayayuḥ suramandiram
verses.translation: • Go, it does not behove you to be sad and anxious for the sake of your son. No enemy of Arjuna, howsoever great, will be too powerful in my presence.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं कृत्तिकातीर्थम् उच्यते कार्त्तिक्यां कृत्तिकायोगे तत्र यः स्नानम् आचरेत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ kṛttikātīrtham ucyate kārttikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge tatra yaḥ snānam ācaret
verses.translation: For the sake of Arjuna I shall protect Yudhisthira and others also. When the Bharata battle is concluded I shall hand over toKunti all these persons led by Yudhisthira, (safe and) unwounded. On being assured thus the king of Devas embraced Kfsna and mounted on his elephant Airavata went back to heaven once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वक्रतुफलं प्राप्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः तत्तीर्थस्मरणं वापि यः करोति शृणोति च सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो दीर्घम् आयुर् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: sarvakratuphalaṃ prāpya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ tattīrthasmaraṇaṃ vāpi yaḥ karoti śṛṇoti ca sarvapāpavinirmukto dīrgham āyur avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Accompanied by* cowherds and cows Krsna returned to the Vraja along the path sanctified by the loving glances of cowherd lasses.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दशाश्वमेधिकं तीर्थं तच् छृणुष्व महामुने यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण हयमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva mahāmune yasya śravaṇamātreṇa hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: When Iridra went away, the cowherds who had wit¬ nessed Krsna of unimpaired activities holding aloft the moun¬ tain Govardhana said to him lovingly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वकर्मसुतः श्रीमान् विश्वरूपो महाबलः तस्यापि प्रथमः पुत्रस् तत्पुत्रो भौवनो विभुः
verses.transliteration: viśvakarmasutaḥ śrīmān viśvarūpo mahābalaḥ tasyāpi prathamaḥ putras tatputro bhauvano vibhuḥ
verses.translation: O highly blessed one, from this great danger all of us and the cows have been protected by you through this activity of holding up the mountain.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरोधाः कश्यपस् तस्य सर्वज्ञानविशारदः तम् अपृच्छन् महाबाहुर् भौवनः सार्वभौवनः
verses.transliteration: purodhāḥ kaśyapas tasya sarvajñānaviśāradaḥ tam apṛcchan mahābāhur bhauvanaḥ sārvabhauvanaḥ
verses.translation: (If this is only)a childish play, it is (really) unrivalled. O dear one, tending of the cows is a profession viewed at with abhorrence. But your activities are divine. How is this? May it be explained to us.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यक्ष्ये ऽहं हयमेधैश् च युगपद् दशभिर् मुने इत्य् अपृच्छद् गुरुं विप्रं क्व यक्ष्यामि सुरान् इति
verses.transliteration: yakṣye 'haṃ hayamedhaiś ca yugapad daśabhir mune ity apṛcchad guruṃ vipraṃ kva yakṣyāmi surān iti
verses.translation: Whether you are a Deva or a Danava, whether you are a Yaksa or a Gandharva—You are our kinsman in our consideration. Obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽवदद् देवयजनं तत्र तत्र नृपोत्तम यत्र यत्र द्विजश्रेष्ठाः प्रावर्तन्त महाक्रतून्
verses.transliteration: so 'vadad devayajanaṃ tatra tatra nṛpottama yatra yatra dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prāvartanta mahākratūn
verses.translation: O Kesava, the love of the entire cowherds' colony in¬ cluding women and children is heaped on you. This feat is impossible to Devas too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्राभवन्न् ऋषिगणा आर्त्विज्ये मखमण्डले युगपद् दशमेधानि प्रवृत्तानि पुरोधसा
verses.transliteration: tatrābhavann ṛṣigaṇā ārtvijye makhamaṇḍale yugapad daśamedhāni pravṛttāni purodhasā
verses.translation: Your boyhood and this excessive valour, your birth amidst us, not very splendid in itself—all this, on being considered, O Krsna of immeasurable Soul, produces suspicion in us.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णतां नाययुस् तानि दृष्ट्वा चिन्तापरो नृपः विहाय देवयजनं पुनर् अन्यत्र तान् क्रतून्
verses.transliteration: pūrṇatāṃ nāyayus tāni dṛṣṭvā cintāparo nṛpaḥ vihāya devayajanaṃ punar anyatra tān kratūn
verses.translation: On being addressed thus by the cowherds, O excellent brahmins, Krsna remained silent for a while with feigned anger (in spite of his) love and said.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपाक्रामत् तथा तत्र विघ्नदोषास् तम् आययुः दृष्ट्वापूर्णांस् ततो यज्ञान् राजा गुरुम् अभाषत
verses.transliteration: upākrāmat tathā tatra vighnadoṣās tam āyayuḥ dṛṣṭvāpūrṇāṃs tato yajñān rājā gurum abhāṣata
verses.translation: o cowherds, if due to your relationship with me you
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देशदोषात् कालदोषान् मम दोषात् तवापि वा पूर्णतां नाप्नुवन्ति स्म दशमेधानि वाजिनः
verses.transliteration: deśadoṣāt kāladoṣān mama doṣāt tavāpi vā pūrṇatāṃ nāpnuvanti sma daśamedhāni vājinaḥ
verses.translation: I am neither a Deva nor a Gandharva, neither a Yaksa nor a Danava. I have become your kinsman. Hence, nothing other than this should be thought of me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततश् च दुःखितो राजा कश्यपेन पुरोधसा गीष्पतेर् भ्रातरं ज्येष्ठं गत्वा संवर्तम् ऊचतुः
verses.transliteration: tataś ca duḥkhito rājā kaśyapena purodhasā gīṣpater bhrātaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ gatvā saṃvartam ūcatuḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Hari and realizing that he had feigned anger due to love, the highly blessed cowherds kept quiet. They gained in strength thereby.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् युगपत् कार्याण्य् अश्वमेधानि मानद दश संपूर्णतां यान्ति तं देशं तं गुरुं वद
verses.transliteration: bhagavan yugapat kāryāṇy aśvamedhāni mānada daśa saṃpūrṇatāṃ yānti taṃ deśaṃ taṃ guruṃ vada
verses.translation: The lotus-footed lord sang sweet songs in the company of Rama, pleasing to the womenfolk. He feigned that he was observing holy rites there.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो ध्यात्वा ऋषिश्रेष्ठः संवर्तो भौवनं तदा अब्रवीद् गच्छ ब्रह्माणं गुरुं देशं वदिष्यति
verses.transliteration: tato dhyātvā ṛṣiśreṣṭhaḥ saṃvarto bhauvanaṃ tadā abravīd gaccha brahmāṇaṃ guruṃ deśaṃ vadiṣyati
verses.translation: On hearing the sweet and charming sound of the songs, the cowherd lasses left ofT their abodes and hurriedly came to the place where Krsna stood.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भौवनो ऽपि महाप्राज्ञः कश्यपेन महात्मना आगत्य माम् अब्रवीच् च गुरुं देशादिकं च यत्
verses.transliteration: bhauvano 'pi mahāprājñaḥ kaśyapena mahātmanā āgatya mām abravīc ca guruṃ deśādikaṃ ca yat
verses.translation: A certain cowherd lass followed his footsteps and sang slowly. Another one listened to it attentively and mentally remembered him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽहम् अब्रवं पुत्र भौवनं कश्यपं तथा गौतमीं गच्छ राजेन्द्र स देशः क्रतुपुण्यवान्
verses.transliteration: tato 'ham abravaṃ putra bhauvanaṃ kaśyapaṃ tathā gautamīṃ gaccha rājendra sa deśaḥ kratupuṇyavān
verses.translation: A certain lass uttered "O Krsna O Krsna 5 ' and be¬ came bashful. A certain lass who was blindly in love with him went near him without shame.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अयम् एव गुरुः श्रेष्ठः कश्यपो वेदपारगः गुरोर् अस्य प्रसादेन गौतम्याश् च प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: ayam eva guruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kaśyapo vedapāragaḥ guror asya prasādena gautamyāś ca prasādataḥ
verses.translation: Surrounded by the cowherd lasses and eager to begin the charming dance of Rasa, Govinda approved of the night, charming with the autumnal moon.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकेन हयमेधेन तत्र स्नानेन वा पुनः सेत्स्यन्ति तत्र यज्ञाश् च दशमेधानि वाजिनः
verses.transliteration: ekena hayamedhena tatra snānena vā punaḥ setsyanti tatra yajñāś ca daśamedhāni vājinaḥ
verses.translation: The cowherdesses were fully engrossed in the activities of Krsna. When Krsna went to a different spot those lasses walked about in the forests of Vrndavana in groups.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा भौवनो राजा गौतमीतीरम् अभ्यगात् कश्यपेन सहायेन हयमेधाय दीक्षितः
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā bhauvano rājā gautamītīram abhyagāt kaśyapena sahāyena hayamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Eager to see Krsna, the cowherdesses wandered here and there, O brahmins, on seeing the footprint of Krsna during that night.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रवृत्ते यज्ञेशे हयमेधे महाक्रतौ संपूर्णे तु तदा राजा पृथिवीं दातुम् उद्यतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pravṛtte yajñeśe hayamedhe mahākratau saṃpūrṇe tu tadā rājā pṛthivīṃ dātum udyataḥ
verses.translation: Thus in the course of different types of activities and sports of Krsna, the cowherd lasses became agitated simultane¬ ously and roamed about in the beautiful forest of Vrndavana. From there the cowherd lasses losing their hopes of seeing Krsna, came back to the banks of Yamuna and sang about his conduct.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽन्तरिक्षे वाग् उच्चैर् उवाच नृपसत्तमम् पूजयित्वा स्थितं विप्रान् ऋत्विजो ऽथ सदस्पतीन्
verses.transliteration: tato 'ntarikṣe vāg uccair uvāca nṛpasattamam pūjayitvā sthitaṃ viprān ṛtvijo 'tha sadaspatīn
verses.translation: Thereupon, the cowherdesses saw Krsna of unimpaired activities, the saviour of the three worlds coming to them with his face beaming like a full-blown lotus.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरोधसे कश्यपाय सशैलवनकाननाम् पृथिवीं दातुकामेन दत्तं सर्वं त्वया नृप
verses.transliteration: purodhase kaśyapāya saśailavanakānanām pṛthivīṃ dātukāmena dattaṃ sarvaṃ tvayā nṛpa
verses.translation: A certain lass became extremely delighted on seeing Krsna coming. With wide open eyes she shouted "Krsna, Krsna, Krsna". A certain lass looked at Hari with knit eyebrows over her broad forehead. She seemed to squeeze honey from his lotus face through her bee-like eyes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भूमिदानस्पृहां त्यक्त्वा अन्नं देहि महाफलम् नान्नदानसमं पुण्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते
verses.transliteration: bhūmidānaspṛhāṃ tyaktvā annaṃ dehi mahāphalam nānnadānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate
verses.translation: A certain lass closed her eyes after seeing Govinda. Meditating on his own form she appeared to be in Yogic slumber.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विशेषतस् तु गङ्गायाः श्रद्धया पुलिने मुने त्वया तु हयमेधो ऽयं कृतः सबहुदक्षिणः कृतकृत्यो ऽसि भद्रं ते नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: viśeṣatas tu gaṅgāyāḥ śraddhayā puline mune tvayā tu hayamedho 'yaṃ kṛtaḥ sabahudakṣiṇaḥ kṛtakṛtyo 'si bhadraṃ te nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Then Krsna humoured, delighted and consoled some ladies with pleasing conversations, some by glances with knit eyebrows and some by gently touching them with hands. Hari of elegant conduct sported about and diverted himself with those cowherd lasses who were delighted in their minds by means of Rasa dances enthusiastically pursued.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथापि दातुकामं तं मही प्रोवाच भौवनम्
verses.transliteration: tathāpi dātukāmaṃ taṃ mahī provāca bhauvanam
verses.translation: Then began to function a series of music with songs of autumn along with the sounds of the moving bangles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वकर्मज सार्वभौम मा मां देहि पुनः पुनः निमज्जे ऽहं सलिलस्य मध्ये तस्मान् न दीयताम्
verses.transliteration: viśvakarmaja sārvabhauma mā māṃ dehi punaḥ punaḥ nimajje 'haṃ salilasya madhye tasmān na dīyatām
verses.translation: Krsna sang about the autumnal moon, the moonlight and the lily pond, but the womenfolk of the cowherds uttered the name of Krsna alone again and again. One (of those ladies) after dancing round and round became fatigued. The heat warmed up her moving bangles. That cowherd lass put her creeper-like arms on his shoulders.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततश् च भौवनो भीतः किं देयम् इति चाब्रवीत् पुनश् चोवाच सा पृथ्वी भौवनं ब्राह्मणैर् वृतम्
verses.transliteration: tataś ca bhauvano bhītaḥ kiṃ deyam iti cābravīt punaś covāca sā pṛthvī bhauvanaṃ brāhmaṇair vṛtam
verses.translation: A certain cowherd lass whose arms moved about gracefully and who was an expert in singing, eulogising found pretexts, embraced and kissed him emotionally.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तिला गावो धनं धान्यं यत् किंचिद् गौतमीतटे सर्वं तद् अक्षयं दानं किं मां भौवन दास्यसि
verses.transliteration: tilā gāvo dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ yat kiṃcid gautamītaṭe sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ dānaṃ kiṃ māṃ bhauvana dāsyasi
verses.translation: Hari's arms came into contact with the cheeks of cow¬ herd lasses and acted like the clouds. The downpour from these clouds was the series of sweat drops and the plants issuing therefrom were the hairs standing on end. When Krsna sang the usual songs of Rasa in highly shrill notes, the ladies shouted "Well done, Krsna, O Krsna" with notes twice as shrill.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गातीरं समाश्रित्य ग्रासम् एकं ददाति यः तेनाहं सकला दत्ता किं मां भौवन दास्यसि
verses.transliteration: gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritya grāsam ekaṃ dadāti yaḥ tenāhaṃ sakalā dattā kiṃ māṃ bhauvana dāsyasi
verses.translation: When he went anywhere they followed him; when he moved in a circle they stood in front of him. The womenfolk of the cowherds' colony resorted to Hari both directly and inversely.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् भुवो वचनं श्रुत्वा भौवनः सार्वभौवनः तथेति मत्वा विप्रेभ्यो ह्य् अन्नं प्रादात् सुविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tad bhuvo vacanaṃ śrutvā bhauvanaḥ sārvabhauvanaḥ tatheti matvā viprebhyo hy annaṃ prādāt suvistaram
verses.translation: At that time Krsna sported himself together with the cowherd lasses. Even when he was away from them for a moment they felt that period of time equal to a crore of years. Though prevented by their fathers, husbands and brothers the cowherdesses who were fond of sexual intercourse delighted Krsna during the nights.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं दशाश्वमेधिकं विदुः दशानाम् अश्वमेधानां फलं स्नानाद् अवाप्यते
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ daśāśvamedhikaṃ viduḥ daśānām aśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ snānād avāpyate
verses.translation: Just as Ether, Earth, fire, water, wind and Atman are present in all living beings so also he stood pervading every¬ thing.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पैशाचं तीर्थम् अपरं पूजितं ब्रह्मवादिभिः तस्य स्वरूपं वक्ष्यामि गौतम्या दक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: paiśācaṃ tīrtham aparaṃ pūjitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi gautamyā dakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: Due to his excessive wrath he taunted everyone in the assembly of Yadavas. He rebuked Yadavas and thought of what should be done next. "Bala and Krsna are small boys (now). Before they grow stronger they should be killed by me. Once they attain youth they cannot be checked from their evil activities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गिरिर् ब्रह्मगिरेः पार्श्वे अञ्जनो नाम नारद तस्मिञ् शैले मुनिवर शापभ्रष्टा वराप्सरा
verses.transliteration: girir brahmagireḥ pārśve añjano nāma nārada tasmiñ śaile munivara śāpabhraṣṭā varāpsarā
verses.translation: Here I have Canura of great prowess and Mustika of great strength. I shall get those two haughty boys killed through these two in a wrestling bout. After thinking like this, the wicked Kamsa decided to
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अञ्जना नाम तत्रासीद् उत्तमाङ्गेन वानरी केसरी नाम तद्भर्ता अद्रिकेति तथापरा
verses.transliteration: añjanā nāma tatrāsīd uttamāṅgena vānarī kesarī nāma tadbhartā adriketi tathāparā
verses.translation: Refers to the Rgvcdic legend (Rv 1.80) of Vrtra and Indra. Vrtra was more powerful than Indra but the latter killed him deceitfully. My wrestlers Canura and Mustika are experts in duels. Let the people see duel between the two combatants.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सापि केसरिणो भार्या शापभ्रष्टा वराप्सरा उत्तमाङ्गेन मार्जारी साप्य् आस्ते ऽञ्जनपर्वते
verses.transliteration: sāpi kesariṇo bhāryā śāpabhraṣṭā varāpsarā uttamāṅgena mārjārī sāpy āste 'ñjanaparvate
verses.translation: After killing them I shall kill the wicked Vasudeva and Nanda too. I shall kill my father Ugrasena as well. Thereafter, I shall seize the cattle-wealth of the cow¬ herds. I shall confiscate the wealth of all those wicked ones who are desirous of killing me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणार्णवम् अभ्यागात् केसरी लोकविश्रुतः एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे ऽगस्त्यो ऽञ्जनं पर्वतम् अभ्यगात्
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇārṇavam abhyāgāt kesarī lokaviśrutaḥ etasminn antare 'gastyo 'ñjanaṃ parvatam abhyagāt
verses.translation: O lord of charitable gifts, excepting you all these Yada- vas are wicked in my opinion. I shall endeavour to kill them also one by one. Thereafter, I shall make this kingdom devoid of Yada- vas. As it is rid of ail thorns I shall rule it through you. Hence, O heroic one, go for my love.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अञ्जना चाद्रिका चैव अगस्त्यम् ऋषिसत्तमम् पूजयाम् आसतुर् उभे यथान्यायं यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: añjanā cādrikā caiva agastyam ṛṣisattamam pūjayām āsatur ubhe yathānyāyaṃ yathāsukham
verses.translation: You should speak to them in such a manner as to make the cowherds bring as present unto me ghee and curds the pro¬ ducts of buffalo's milk. He came to the colony of cowherds. With his hoofs he dug up pits on the ground. When he waved his manes he shook and scattered the clouds. He traversed through the aerial path of the moon and the sun.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान् आहोभे व्रियतां वरः ते आहतुर् उभे ऽगस्त्यं पुत्रौ देहि मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno bhagavān āhobhe vriyatāṃ varaḥ te āhatur ubhe 'gastyaṃ putrau dehi munīśvara
verses.translation: Frightened by the neighing sound of the asura in the form of a horse the cowherds and cowherdesscs sought refuge in Krsna. On hearing their words—"Save us, O save us", Krsna spoke in a loud tone like the rumbling sound of the rain-bearing cloud.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेभ्यो बलिनौ श्रेष्ठौ सर्वलोकोपकारकौ तथेत्य् उक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठो जगामाशां स दक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: sarvebhyo balinau śreṣṭhau sarvalokopakārakau tathety uktvā muniśreṣṭho jagāmāśāṃ sa dakṣiṇām
verses.translation: O cowherds, do not be afraid. You belong to the clan of cowherds, why are you so afraid of Kesin? Why are you losing courage and prowess befitting the heroes?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः कदाचित् ते काले अञ्जना चाद्रिका तथा गीतं नृत्यं च हास्यं च कुर्वत्यौ गिरिमूर्धनि
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kadācit te kāle añjanā cādrikā tathā gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca hāsyaṃ ca kurvatyau girimūrdhani
verses.translation: This wicked horse has only very little strength. He is making a proud display of the loud neighing sound. He is only an ordinary messenger in the army of asuras. He is vaunting and galloping—Of what avail is this? O wicked one, come. come. I am Krsna. Just as the Pinaka-bearing lord knocked off the teeth of Pusan, so also I shall knock off thc_tceth from your mouth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वायुश् च निरृतिश् चापि ते दृष्ट्वा सस्मितौ सुरौ कामाक्रान्तधियौ चोभौ तदा सत्वरम् ईयतुः
verses.transliteration: vāyuś ca nirṛtiś cāpi te dṛṣṭvā sasmitau surau kāmākrāntadhiyau cobhau tadā satvaram īyatuḥ
verses.translation: After saying thus, Krsna stood face to face with Kesin. The asura too rushed at him with a wide open mouth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भार्ये भवेताम् उभयोर् आवां देवौ वरप्रदौ ते अप्य् ऊचतुर् अस्त्व् एतद् रेमाते गिरिमूर्धनि
verses.transliteration: bhārye bhavetām ubhayor āvāṃ devau varapradau te apy ūcatur astv etad remāte girimūrdhani
verses.translation: Then Krsna enlarged his arm and thrust it into the mouth of the wicked horse, Kesin. His teeth were knocked off by the arm of Krsna that was thrust into the mouth of Kesin. They looked like the bits of white clouds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अञ्जनायां तथा वायोर् हनुमान् समजायत अद्रिकायां च निरृतेर् अद्रिर् नाम पिशाचराट्
verses.transliteration: añjanāyāṃ tathā vāyor hanumān samajāyata adrikāyāṃ ca nirṛter adrir nāma piśācarāṭ
verses.translation: O brahmins, Krsna's arm that went into the body of Kesin became the cause of his destruction like the ailment that is neglected m the early stages by trustworthy persons (atten¬ dants, relatives or oneself;.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनस् ते आहतुर् उभे पुत्रौ जातौ मुनेर् वरात् आवयोर् विकृतं रूपम् उत्तमाङ्गेन दूषितम्
verses.transliteration: punas te āhatur ubhe putrau jātau muner varāt āvayor vikṛtaṃ rūpam uttamāṅgena dūṣitam
verses.translation: His lips were torn off. The corners of the mouth were made gapingly wide. He vomited frothful blood. The tendons were loosened and untied. Stretching his legs he fell on the ground and discharged dung and urine in plenty. His body was drenched in sweat. He became exhausted and ultimately ceased to struggle for life.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शापाच् छचीपतेस् तत्र युवाम् आज्ञातुम् अर्हथः ततः प्रोवाच भगवान् वायुश् च निरृतिस् तथा
verses.transliteration: śāpāc chacīpates tatra yuvām ājñātum arhathaḥ tataḥ provāca bhagavān vāyuś ca nirṛtis tathā
verses.translation: With his mouth torn apart by the arm of Krsna, that extremely terrible Asura fell down like a tree that is severed into two by the lightning stroke.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतम्यां स्नानदानाभ्यां शापमोक्षो भविष्यति इत्य् उक्त्वा ताव् उभौ प्रीतौ तत्रैवान्तरधीयताम्
verses.transliteration: gautamyāṃ snānadānābhyāṃ śāpamokṣo bhaviṣyati ity uktvā tāv ubhau prītau tatraivāntaradhīyatām
verses.translation: The two halves of the dead horse Kesin, each having two legs, one ear, one eye, one nostril and a moiety of the back and the tail shone remarkably. The sage Narada hurriedly came there seated on a cloud. On seeing Kesin killed his mind was extremely delighted.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽञ्जनां समादाय अद्रिः पैशाचमूर्तिमान् भ्रातुर् हनुमतः प्रीत्यै स्नापयाम् आस मातरम्
verses.transliteration: tato 'ñjanāṃ samādāya adriḥ paiśācamūrtimān bhrātur hanumataḥ prītyai snāpayām āsa mātaram
verses.translation: Well done. Well done, O lord of the universe, O Acyuta! Kesin, the tormentor of heaven-dwellers, has been killed by you playfully.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथैव हनुमान् गङ्गाम् आदायाद्रिम् अतित्वरन् मार्जाररूपिणीं नीत्वा गौतम्यास् तीरम् आप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva hanumān gaṅgām ādāyādrim atitvaran mārjārarūpiṇīṃ nītvā gautamyās tīram āptavān
verses.translation: (?) You were eager to bring about his death in this battle between a man and a horse. Killed by you here that wicked asura has gone to heaven. O slayer of Madhu, good rites have been performed by you in this incarnation that caused surprise in me (?) But by virtue of this action, my mind is delighted and satisfied.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं पैशाचं चाञ्जनं तथा ब्रह्मणो गिरिम् आसाद्य सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ paiśācaṃ cāñjanaṃ tathā brahmaṇo girim āsādya sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham
verses.translation: O Krsna, Devas and Indra had been afraid of this horse that used to shake ofT his manes, neigh (loudly) and seethe clouds high up in the sky.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां त्रिपञ्चाशन् मार्जारं पूर्वतो भवेत् मार्जारसंज्ञितात् तस्माद् धनूमन्तं वृषाकपिम्
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ tripañcāśan mārjāraṃ pūrvato bhavet mārjārasaṃjñitāt tasmād dhanūmantaṃ vṛṣākapim
verses.translation: Hail to you. I shall go now. O slayer of Kesin, day O Krsna, I shall be there witnessing matches, old duels as told by you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: फेनासंगमम् आख्यातं सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम् तस्य स्वरूपं व्युष्टिश् च तत्रैव प्रोच्यते शुभा
verses.transliteration: phenāsaṃgamam ākhyātaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham tasya svarūpaṃ vyuṣṭiś ca tatraiva procyate śubhā
verses.translation: I shall now go, O Krsna, great task of Devas has been accomplished by you. I have been honoured by you. Hail to you. I shall go now.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्षुधातीर्थम् इति ख्यातं शृणु नारद तन्मनाः कथ्यमानं महापुण्यं सर्वकामप्रदं नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: kṣudhātīrtham iti khyātaṃ śṛṇu nārada tanmanāḥ kathyamānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām
verses.translation: I shall be seeing that face of Visnu which has lotus-like eyes and which dispels the sin of men even if it is fancied.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिर् आसीत् पुरा कण्वस् तपस्वी वेदवित्तमः परिभ्रमन्न् आश्रमाणि क्षुधया परिपीडितः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣir āsīt purā kaṇvas tapasvī vedavittamaḥ paribhramann āśramāṇi kṣudhayā paripīḍitaḥ
verses.translation: I shall be seeing the face of the lord from which the Vedas and Vcdangas have come up and which is the greatest abode of Devas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतमस्याश्रमं पुण्यं समृद्धं चान्नवारिणा आत्मानं च क्षुधायुक्तं समृद्धं चापि गौतमम्
verses.transliteration: gautamasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ samṛddhaṃ cānnavāriṇā ātmānaṃ ca kṣudhāyuktaṃ samṛddhaṃ cāpi gautamam
verses.translation: I shall be seeing that Kcsava who has neither a beginn¬ ing nor an end and by worshipping whom with a hundred sacri¬ fices, Indra attained the overlordship of immortal beings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वीक्ष्य कण्वो ऽथ वैषम्यं वैराग्यम् अगमत् तदा गौतमो ऽपि द्विजश्रेष्ठो ह्य् अहं तपसि निष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: vīkṣya kaṇvo 'tha vaiṣamyaṃ vairāgyam agamat tadā gautamo 'pi dvijaśreṣṭho hy ahaṃ tapasi niṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: The lord of the Universe has attained a human form and is stationed in the cowherds' colony for certain (specific) tasks. He is the unchanging lord who can take up any formas he wishes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: समेन याच्ञायुक्ता स्यात् तस्माद् गौतमवेश्मनि न भोक्ष्ये ऽहं क्षुधार्तो ऽपि पीडिते ऽपि कलेवरे
verses.transliteration: samena yācñāyuktā syāt tasmād gautamaveśmani na bhokṣye 'haṃ kṣudhārto 'pi pīḍite 'pi kalevare
verses.translation: That infinite lord who holds the Earth stationed on the top of the peak and who has incarnated himself for removing the burden of the Earth will call me—'O Akrura'.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छेयं गौतमीं गङ्गाम् अर्जयेयं च संपदम् इति निश्चित्य मेधावी गत्वा गङ्गां च पावनीम्
verses.transliteration: gaccheyaṃ gautamīṃ gaṅgām arjayeyaṃ ca saṃpadam iti niścitya medhāvī gatvā gaṅgāṃ ca pāvanīm
verses.translation: Obeisance, obeisance to the lord whose Maya the uni¬ verse is incompetent to dispel, the Maya that consists of kinship with father, kinsman, friend, brother, mother and other kindred relations.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा शुचिर् यतमना उपविश्य कुशासने तुष्टाव गौतमीं गङ्गां क्षुधां च परमापदम्
verses.transliteration: snātvā śucir yatamanā upaviśya kuśāsane tuṣṭāva gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ kṣudhāṃ ca paramāpadam
verses.translation: Obeisance to that soul of learning by keeping whom in the heart, the mortal beings surmount ignorance, the Yogic illusion.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु गङ्गे परमार्तिहारिणि नमः क्षुधे सर्वजनार्तिकारिणि नमो महेशानजटोद्भवे शुभे नमो महामृत्युमुखाद् विनिसृते
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu gaṅge paramārtihāriṇi namaḥ kṣudhe sarvajanārtikāriṇi namo maheśānajaṭodbhave śubhe namo mahāmṛtyumukhād vinisṛte
verses.translation: Continuously do I seek refuge in Hari the most excell-, ent of Purusas; On remembering him one becomes the recipient of all auspicious things.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यात्मनां शान्तरूपे क्रोधरूपे दुरात्मनाम् सरिद्रूपेण सर्वेषां तापपापापहारिणि
verses.transliteration: puṇyātmanāṃ śāntarūpe krodharūpe durātmanām saridrūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ tāpapāpāpahāriṇi
verses.translation: Thinking about Visnu thus, humbly and devoutly in his- mind, Akrura reached the cowherds' colony when there was still some sunlight (a little before sunset).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्षुधारूपेण सर्वेषां तापपापप्रदे नमः नमः श्रेयस्करि देवि नमः पापप्रतर्दिनि नमः शान्तिकरि देवि नमो दारिद्र्यनाशिनि
verses.transliteration: kṣudhārūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ tāpapāpaprade namaḥ namaḥ śreyaskari devi namaḥ pāpapratardini namaḥ śāntikari devi namo dāridryanāśini
verses.translation: O brahmins, near him he saw Balabhadra, a scion of the family of Yadus. He was white in complexion like the swan, moon and Kunda flower. He was clad in blue robes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवं स्तुवतस् तस्य पुरस्ताद् अभवद् द्वयम् एकं गाङ्गं मनोहारि ह्य् अपरं भीषणाकृति पुनः कृताञ्जलिर् भूत्वा नमस्कृत्वा द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: ity evaṃ stuvatas tasya purastād abhavad dvayam ekaṃ gāṅgaṃ manohāri hy aparaṃ bhīṣaṇākṛti punaḥ kṛtāñjalir bhūtvā namaskṛtvā dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing them, O brahmins, that highly intelligent Akrura experienced horripilation all over the body. His face beamed like a blowing lotus flower.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये ब्राह्मि माहेश्वरि शुभे वैष्णवि त्र्यम्बके देवि गोदावरि नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalye brāhmi māheśvari śubhe vaiṣṇavi tryambake devi godāvari namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Akrura then thought within himself thus Here is the p-eatest of splendours. Here is the greatest of regions. Vasudeva is stationed here in two forms.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यम्बकस्य जटोद्भूते गौतमस्याघनाशिनि सप्तधा सागरं यान्ति गोदावरि नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: tryambakasya jaṭodbhūte gautamasyāghanāśini saptadhā sāgaraṃ yānti godāvari namo 'stu te
verses.translation: May both of my eyes simultaneously attain fruit¬ fulness when the creator of the universe in the form of Kr?na is seen. ill this limb (of mine) on coming into contact with
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापकृतां पापे धर्मकामार्थनाशिनि दुःखलोभमयि देवि क्षुधे तुभ्यं नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpakṛtāṃ pāpe dharmakāmārthanāśini duḥkhalobhamayi devi kṣudhe tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ
verses.translation: Touching my lotus-like hand today itself the lord of • le,r WiIlmake * Serious. Excellent achievement is
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत् कण्ववचनं श्रुत्वा सुप्रीते आहतुर् द्विजम्
verses.transliteration: tat kaṇvavacanaṃ śrutvā suprīte āhatur dvijam
verses.translation: But the devotees consider Krsna Purna avatara (complete incar¬ nation) and not the partial incarnation (amsavatara).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अभीष्टं वद कल्याण वरान् वरय सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: abhīṣṭaṃ vada kalyāṇa varān varaya suvrata
verses.translation: But the devotees consider Krsna Purna avatara (complete incar¬ nation) and not the partial incarnation (amsavatara).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रोवाच प्रणतो गङ्गां कण्वः क्षुधां यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: provāca praṇato gaṅgāṃ kaṇvaḥ kṣudhāṃ yathākramam
verses.translation: But the devotees consider Krsna Purna avatara (complete incar¬ nation) and not the partial incarnation (amsavatara).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देहि देवि मनोज्ञानि कामानि विभवं मम आयुर् वित्तं च भुक्तिं च मुक्तिं गङ्गे प्रयच्छ मे
verses.transliteration: dehi devi manojñāni kāmāni vibhavaṃ mama āyur vittaṃ ca bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ gaṅge prayaccha me
verses.translation: But the devotees consider Krsna Purna avatara (complete incar¬ nation) and not the partial incarnation (amsavatara).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा गौतमीं गङ्गां क्षुधां चाह द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ kṣudhāṃ cāha dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: But the devotees consider Krsna Purna avatara (complete incar¬ nation) and not the partial incarnation (amsavatara).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मयि मद्वंशजे चापि क्षुधे तृष्णे दरिद्रिणि याहि पापतरे रूक्षे न भूयास् त्वं कदाचन
verses.transliteration: mayi madvaṃśaje cāpi kṣudhe tṛṣṇe daridriṇi yāhi pāpatare rūkṣe na bhūyās tvaṃ kadācana
verses.translation: But the devotees consider Krsna Purna avatara (complete incar¬ nation) and not the partial incarnation (amsavatara).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनेन स्तवेन ये वै त्वां स्तुवन्ति क्षुधातुराः तेषां दारिद्र्यदुःखानि न भवेयुर् वरो ऽपरः
verses.transliteration: anena stavena ye vai tvāṃ stuvanti kṣudhāturāḥ teṣāṃ dāridryaduḥkhāni na bhaveyur varo 'paraḥ
verses.translation: But the devotees consider Krsna Purna avatara (complete incar¬ nation) and not the partial incarnation (amsavatara).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिंस् तीर्थे महापुण्ये स्नानदानजपादिकम् ये कुर्वन्ति नरा भक्त्या लक्ष्मीभाजो भवन्तु ते
verses.transliteration: asmiṃs tīrthe mahāpuṇye snānadānajapādikam ye kurvanti narā bhaktyā lakṣmībhājo bhavantu te
verses.translation: But the devotees consider Krsna Purna avatara (complete incar¬ nation) and not the partial incarnation (amsavatara).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस् त्व् इदं पठते स्तोत्रं तीर्थे वा यदि वा गृहे तस्य दारिद्र्यदुःखेभ्यो न भयं स्याद् वरो ऽपरः
verses.transliteration: yas tv idaṃ paṭhate stotraṃ tīrthe vā yadi vā gṛhe tasya dāridryaduḥkhebhyo na bhayaṃ syād varo 'paraḥ
verses.translation: But the devotees consider Krsna Purna avatara (complete incar¬ nation) and not the partial incarnation (amsavatara).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् अस्त्व् इति चोक्त्वा ते कण्वं याते स्वम् आलयम् ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं काण्वं गाङ्गं क्षुधाभिधम् सर्वपापहरं वत्स पितॄणां प्रीतिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: evam astv iti coktvā te kaṇvaṃ yāte svam ālayam tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ kāṇvaṃ gāṅgaṃ kṣudhābhidham sarvapāpaharaṃ vatsa pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam
verses.translation: But the devotees consider Krsna Purna avatara (complete incar¬ nation) and not the partial incarnation (amsavatara).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति ब्रह्मन् महातीर्थं चक्रतीर्थम् इति श्रुतम् तत्र स्नानान् नरो भक्त्या हरेर् लोकम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: asti brahman mahātīrthaṃ cakratīrtham iti śrutam tatra snānān naro bhaktyā harer lokam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Thinking thus on his way and approaching Krsna, that scion of the family of Yadavas bowed his head to the feet of Hari saying - T am Akrura'.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकादश्यां तु शुक्लायाम् उपोष्य पृथिवीपते गणिकासंगमे स्नात्वा प्राप्नुयाद् अक्षयं पदम्
verses.transliteration: ekādaśyāṃ tu śuklāyām upoṣya pṛthivīpate gaṇikāsaṃgame snātvā prāpnuyād akṣayaṃ padam
verses.translation: The lord too stroked him with his hand marked by the lines of flag, thunderbolt and lotus. He dragged him with love towards himself and closely embraced him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरा तत्र यथा वृत्तं तन् मे निगदतः शृणु आसीद् विश्वधरो नाम वैश्यो बहुधनान्वितः
verses.transliteration: purā tatra yathā vṛttaṃ tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu āsīd viśvadharo nāma vaiśyo bahudhanānvitaḥ
verses.translation: Balarama and Kr?na were duly greeted and honoured by* him. The two who were delighted took him with them and entered their chamber.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे वयसि श्रेष्ठस् तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद् ऋषे गुणवान् रूपसंपन्नो विलासी शुभदर्शनः
verses.transliteration: uttare vayasi śreṣṭhas tasya putro 'bhavad ṛṣe guṇavān rūpasaṃpanno vilāsī śubhadarśanaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing everything in detail the lord, the slayer of Kesin said—"O lord of charitable gifts, all this has been understood by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्राणेभ्यो ऽपि प्रियः पुत्रः काले पञ्चत्वम् आगतः तथा दृष्ट्वा तु तं पुत्रं दंपती दुःखपीडितौ
verses.transliteration: prāṇebhyo 'pi priyaḥ putraḥ kāle pañcatvam āgataḥ tathā dṛṣṭvā tu taṃ putraṃ daṃpatī duḥkhapīḍitau
verses.translation: O highly blessed one, I shall undertake what is the most proper expedient in this matter. It should not be considered otherwise. Know that Kamsa is already killed by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वाते स्म तदा तेन सहैव मरणे मतिम् हा पुत्र हन्त कालेन पापेन सुदुरात्मना
verses.transliteration: kurvāte sma tadā tena sahaiva maraṇe matim hā putra hanta kālena pāpena sudurātmanā
verses.translation: Rama and I shall go to Mathura along with you, tomorrow. The elderly cowherds will accompany us taking many presents with them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यौवने वर्तमानो ऽपि नीतो ऽसि गुणसागर आवयोश् च तथैव त्वं प्राणेभ्यो ऽपि सुदुर्लभः
verses.transliteration: yauvane vartamāno 'pi nīto 'si guṇasāgara āvayoś ca tathaiva tvaṃ prāṇebhyo 'pi sudurlabhaḥ
verses.translation: O heroic one, let this night be passed off. It does not behove you to worry over anything. Within three nights I shall kill Kamsa alongwith his followers."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं तु रुदितं श्रुत्वा दंपत्योः करुणं यमः त्यक्त्वा निजपुरं तूर्णं कृपयाविष्टमानसः
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ tu ruditaṃ śrutvā daṃpatyoḥ karuṇaṃ yamaḥ tyaktvā nijapuraṃ tūrṇaṃ kṛpayāviṣṭamānasaḥ
verses.translation: After directing cowherds in regard to Akrura, Kesava and Balabhadra went to the abode ofNandagopa and slept
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गोदावर्याः शुभे तीरे स्थितो ध्यायञ् जनार्दनम् अपि स्वल्पेन कालेन प्रजा वृद्धाः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: godāvaryāḥ śubhe tīre sthito dhyāyañ janārdanam api svalpena kālena prajā vṛddhāḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: When the day dawned with pure atmosphere, the extremely powerful Balarama and Krsna began their prepar¬ ations to go to Mathura in the company of Akrura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इयत इति मे पृथ्वी कथ्यतां केन पूरिता न कश्चिन् म्रियते जन्तुर् भाराक्रान्ता वसुंधरा
verses.transliteration: iyata iti me pṛthvī kathyatāṃ kena pūritā na kaścin mriyate jantur bhārākrāntā vasuṃdharā
verses.translation: On seeing this, the cowherd folk were full of tears. The bangles in their hands got loose. They heaved sighs in their misery and spoke to one another thus:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवी गता तूर्णं वसुधा मुनिसत्तम यत्रास्ति सुरसंयुक्तः शक्रः परपुरंजयः दृष्ट्वा वसुंधराम् इन्द्रः प्रणिपत्येदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tato devī gatā tūrṇaṃ vasudhā munisattama yatrāsti surasaṃyuktaḥ śakraḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ dṛṣṭvā vasuṃdharām indraḥ praṇipatyedam abravīt
verses.translation: "After reaching Mathura how will Krsna return to the cowherds' colony? He will imbibe honey of the sweet tale of the city-lasses by his cars.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किम् आगमनकार्यं त इति मे पृथ्वि कथ्यताम्
verses.transliteration: kim āgamanakāryaṃ ta iti me pṛthvi kathyatām
verses.translation: After getting involved in the net of elegant speech of the city lasses how will his mind revert to the cowherd boys and cowherd lasses of vulgar nature?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भारेण गुरुणा शक्र पीडिताहं विना वधम् कारणं प्रष्टुम् आयाता किम् इदं कथ्यतां मम
verses.transliteration: bhāreṇa guruṇā śakra pīḍitāhaṃ vinā vadham kāraṇaṃ praṣṭum āyātā kim idaṃ kathyatāṃ mama
verses.translation: The ruthless wicked Fate has struck at the cowherd damsels since it removes Krsna who is the essence of our colony.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा महीवाक्यम् इन्द्रो वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā mahīvākyam indro vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: The following attributes of the city lasses are extraor¬ dinary—their words are uttered with smiles couched in emotional fervour; their movement is graceful and elegant; their side- glances are very attractive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कारणं यदि नाम स्यात् तदानीं ज्ञायते मया सुराणां हि पतिर् यस्माद् अहं सर्वासु मेदिनि
verses.transliteration: kāraṇaṃ yadi nāma syāt tadānīṃ jñāyate mayā surāṇāṃ hi patir yasmād ahaṃ sarvāsu medini
verses.translation: This Kesava goes to Mathura driving in a chariot. He has been duped by Akrura who is really Krura (cruel) and who is one who has dashed our hopes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अथ पृथ्वी तदा वाक्यं श्रुत्वा चाह शचीपतिम् यम आदिश्यतां तर्हि यथा संहरते प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: atha pṛthvī tadā vākyaṃ śrutvā cāha śacīpatim yama ādiśyatāṃ tarhi yathā saṃharate prajāḥ
verses.translation: Does not this wicked Akrura know us earnestly in love with him? Wherefore does he take our lord elsewhere, lord who provides us with imperishable delight?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा वचो मह्या आदिष्टाः सिद्धकिंनराः यमस्यानयने शीघ्रं महेन्द्रेण महामुने
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā vaco mahyā ādiṣṭāḥ siddhakiṃnarāḥ yamasyānayane śīghraṃ mahendreṇa mahāmune
verses.translation: All these cowherds, led by Nandagopa, are ready to accompany him. No one attempts to make Govinda return.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् ते सत्वरं याताः सर्वे वैवस्वतं पुरम् नैवापश्यन् यमं तत्र ते सिद्धाः सह किंनरैः तथागत्य पुनर् वेगाद् वार्त्ता शक्रे निवेदिता
verses.transliteration: tatas te satvaraṃ yātāḥ sarve vaivasvataṃ puram naivāpaśyan yamaṃ tatra te siddhāḥ saha kiṃnaraiḥ tathāgatya punar vegād vārttā śakre niveditā
verses.translation: In regard to the womenfolk residing in Mathura the night has turned into a bright morning. The lotus-like face of Acyuta can now be enjoyed by their eyes which resemble the bees.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यमो यमपुरे नाथ अस्माभिर् नावलोकितः महतापि सुयत्नेन वीक्ष्यमाणः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: yamo yamapure nātha asmābhir nāvalokitaḥ mahatāpi suyatnena vīkṣyamāṇaḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: It will be a festive occasion to the eyes of the residents of Mathura, after seeing the face of Krsna.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा वचस् तेषां पृष्टः शक्रेण वै तदा सविता स पिता तस्य यमः कुत्रास्त इत्य् अथ
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā vacas teṣāṃ pṛṣṭaḥ śakreṇa vai tadā savitā sa pitā tasya yamaḥ kutrāsta ity atha
verses.translation: May this column of dust raised up by the wheels of
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शक्र गोदावरीतीरे कृतान्तो वर्तते ऽधुना चरंस् तत्र तपस् तीव्रं न जाने किं नु कारणम्
verses.transliteration: śakra godāvarītīre kṛtānto vartate 'dhunā caraṃs tatra tapas tīvraṃ na jāne kiṃ nu kāraṇam
verses.translation: So lamented the cowherd lasses. Even as they were watching him with great sincerity and affection, Kesava left that land of cowherds' colony (far behind) in the company of Rama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा वचो भानोः शक्रः शङ्काम् उपाविशत्
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā vaco bhānoḥ śakraḥ śaṅkām upāviśat
verses.translation: Then Akrura said to Krsna:—"Both of you be waiting here, until I complete rites in the waters of Yamuna."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहो कष्टं महाकष्टं नष्टा मे सुरनाथता गोदावर्यां तपः कुर्याद् यमो वै दुष्टचेष्टितः जिघृक्षुर् मत्पदं नूनं देवा इति मतिर् मम
verses.transliteration: aho kaṣṭaṃ mahākaṣṭaṃ naṣṭā me suranāthatā godāvaryāṃ tapaḥ kuryād yamo vai duṣṭaceṣṭitaḥ jighṛkṣur matpadaṃ nūnaṃ devā iti matir mama
verses.translation: Thereupon, he understood the real nature of the lord as existence. The lord of charitable gifts then eulogised lord Acyuta full of all perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा सहसेन्द्रेण आहूतश् चाप्सरोगणः
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā sahasendreṇa āhūtaś cāpsarogaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance, obeisance to the great Atman of the form of Cit (Consciousness) alone; to the all-pervading lord of unima¬ ginable greatness, to one of single form, to one of many forms.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: का भवतीषु कालस्य स्थितस्य तपसि द्विषः तपःप्रणाशने शक्ता इति मे शीघ्रम् उच्यताम्
verses.transliteration: kā bhavatīṣu kālasya sthitasya tapasi dviṣaḥ tapaḥpraṇāśane śaktā iti me śīghram ucyatām
verses.translation: O unimaginable one, obeisance to you, of the form of sound; obeisance to you who have become identical with the sacrificial offering of ghee, obeisance to the lord of the form of perfect knowledge, O lord, greater than Prakrti.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति शक्रवचः श्रुत्वा नोचे कापि महामुने अथ शक्रः प्रकोपेण प्रत्युवाचाप्सरोगणम्
verses.transliteration: iti śakravacaḥ śrutvā noce kāpi mahāmune atha śakraḥ prakopeṇa pratyuvācāpsarogaṇam
verses.translation: Sanandana: belonged to the Sanakadi group and was the mental son of Brahma, having taken incarnation long before Brahma started his work of creation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरं नाब्रवीत् किंचिद् यामस् तर्हि वयं स्वयम् सज्जा भवन्तु विबुधाः सैन्यैर् आयान्तु मा चिरम् घातयामो वयं शत्रुं तपसा स्वर्गकामुकम्
verses.transliteration: uttaraṃ nābravīt kiṃcid yāmas tarhi vayaṃ svayam sajjā bhavantu vibudhāḥ sainyair āyāntu mā ciram ghātayāmo vayaṃ śatruṃ tapasā svargakāmukam
verses.translation: Be pleased, O lord identical with all virtuous rites, O Mahesvara, O imperishable being amongst the perishable ones. You are praised with the conception of Brahma, Vi?nu and Siva.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्ते सति देवानां सेना प्रादुर्बभूव ह इतीन्द्रहृदयं ज्ञात्वा हरिणा लोकधारिणा
verses.transliteration: ity ukte sati devānāṃ senā prādurbabhūva ha itīndrahṛdayaṃ jñātvā hariṇā lokadhāriṇā
verses.translation: O deity whose form, nature, purpose and aim can¬ not be adequately expressed; O deity whose name cannot be specifically mentioned, I bow to you, the greatest lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रेषितं चक्रिणा चक्रं रक्षणाय यमस्य हि चक्रं यत्राभवत् तत्र चक्रतीर्थम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: preṣitaṃ cakriṇā cakraṃ rakṣaṇāya yamasya hi cakraṃ yatrābhavat tatra cakratīrtham anuttamam
verses.translation: O lord, you are the unborn one. You are the greatest eternal Brahman without aberrations wherein there are no im¬ posed ideas of name, caste and the like.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अथेन्द्रं मेनका प्राह शङ्कितेति वचस् तदा
verses.transliteration: athendraṃ menakā prāha śaṅkiteti vacas tadā
verses.translation: Since, without some sort of conception, no matter can be comprehended, you are being worshipped under the names: Krsna, Acyuta, Ananta and Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कालावलोकने नालं काचिद् अस्ति सुरेश्वर मरणं च वरं देव भवतो न यमात् पुनः
verses.transliteration: kālāvalokane nālaṃ kācid asti sureśvara maraṇaṃ ca varaṃ deva bhavato na yamāt punaḥ
verses.translation: O unborn lord, O soul of all, by means of these diffe¬ rent conceptions, you arc identical with Devas and the Uni¬ verse. O soul of the universe, you are devoid of differences and aberrations. In every object of the world there is nothing which is different from you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रूपयौवनमत्तेयं गणिकायाचनं प्रभो प्रेषणं तत् प्रयच्छैषा स्वामित्वं मन्यते त्वया
verses.transliteration: rūpayauvanamatteyaṃ gaṇikāyācanaṃ prabho preṣaṇaṃ tat prayacchaiṣā svāmitvaṃ manyate tvayā
verses.translation: After eulogising Krsna thus under the water that scion of the family ofYadavas worshipped the lord of all by means of incense and flowers mentally conceived.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा वचस् तस्याः शक्रः सुरवरेश्वरः आदिदेशाबलां क्षामां सत्कृत्य गणिकां तथा
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā vacas tasyāḥ śakraḥ suravareśvaraḥ ādideśābalāṃ kṣāmāṃ satkṛtya gaṇikāṃ tathā
verses.translation: After eschewing other objects, fixing the mind therein
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गणिके गच्छ मे कार्यं कुरु सुन्दरि मा चिरम् कृतकृत्यागता भूयो वल्लभा मे यथा शची
verses.transliteration: gaṇike gaccha me kāryaṃ kuru sundari mā ciram kṛtakṛtyāgatā bhūyo vallabhā me yathā śacī
verses.translation: Considering himself contented and blessed, O excellent brahmins, he came out of the waters of Yurauna and approached the chariot once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् आकर्ण्य वचः शक्राद् उत्पत्य गणिका दिशः क्षणेन यमसांनिध्यम् आयाता चारुरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: ity ākarṇya vacaḥ śakrād utpatya gaṇikā diśaḥ kṣaṇena yamasāṃnidhyam āyātā cārurūpiṇī
verses.translation: There he saw Rama and Krsna seated as before. Krsna spoke thus to Akrura who was evidently surprised as was indicated by his eyes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यमान्तिकम् अनुप्राप्ता द्योतयन्ती दिशो दश सलीलं ललितं बाला जगौ हिन्दोलकङ्कलम्
verses.transliteration: yamāntikam anuprāptā dyotayantī diśo daśa salīlaṃ lalitaṃ bālā jagau hindolakaṅkalam
verses.translation: O Acyuta, here itself standing in front of me in its embodied form I see the same miracle as was seen by me in¬ side the water.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततश् चचाल कालस्य मनो लोलं चलाचलम् अथोन्मील्य यमो नेत्रे कामपावकपूरिते
verses.transliteration: tataś cacāla kālasya mano lolaṃ calācalam athonmīlya yamo netre kāmapāvakapūrite
verses.translation: After saying this, the scion of the family of Yadu drove those horses as swift as the wind. In the evening Akrura reached the city of Mathura. Observing the city of Mathura and looking at Krsna and Balarama he spoke this.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां व्यापारयाम् आस श्रेयःशत्रौ महामुने ततो विलीय सा सद्यः सरित्त्वम् अगमत् तदा
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ vyāpārayām āsa śreyaḥśatrau mahāmune tato vilīya sā sadyaḥ sarittvam agamat tadā
verses.translation: You two of great vigour and prowess will go on foot.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतम्यां तु समागम्य गणिकागणकिंकरैः गीयमाना गता स्वर्गे तस्य तीर्थप्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: gautamyāṃ tu samāgamya gaṇikāgaṇakiṃkaraiḥ gīyamānā gatā svarge tasya tīrthaprabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: After saying this Akrura entered Mathura. Balarama
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन्तीं गणिकां दृष्ट्वा विमानस्थां दिवं प्रति विस्मयं परमं प्राप्तः कालस् तरललोचनः अथादित्येन चागत्य एवम् उक्तो यमस् तदा
verses.transliteration: gacchantīṃ gaṇikāṃ dṛṣṭvā vimānasthāṃ divaṃ prati vismayaṃ paramaṃ prāptaḥ kālas taralalocanaḥ athādityena cāgatya evam ukto yamas tadā
verses.translation: They were glanced at with delighted eyes by the citizens men and women. The two heroic boys went ahead sportingly like two elephant cubs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुरु पुत्र निजं कर्म प्रजानां त्वं परिक्षयम् पश्य वातं सदा वान्तं सृजन्तं वेधसं प्रजाः पर्यटन्तं त्रिलोकीं मां वहन्तीं वसुधां प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: kuru putra nijaṃ karma prajānāṃ tvaṃ parikṣayam paśya vātaṃ sadā vāntaṃ sṛjantaṃ vedhasaṃ prajāḥ paryaṭantaṃ trilokīṃ māṃ vahantīṃ vasudhāṃ prajāḥ
verses.translation: As they wandered here and there they saw a washer¬ man and dyer. They requested him for beautiful clothes of good colour.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा यमो वाक्यं पितुर् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā yamo vākyaṃ pitur vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: With a blow of his palm in anger, Krsna struck down the head of that wicked washerman and let it fail on the ground.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतन् न गर्हितं कर्म कुर्याम् अहम् इदं ध्रुवम् कर्मण्य् अस्मिन् महाक्रूरे समादेष्टुं न वार्हसि
verses.transliteration: etan na garhitaṃ karma kuryām aham idaṃ dhruvam karmaṇy asmin mahākrūre samādeṣṭuṃ na vārhasi
verses.translation: After killing him and taking clothes from his house Krsna and Balarama, clad themselves in yellow and blue robes, joyously and went to the gardener's abode.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा च तद् वाक्यं भानुर् वचनम् अब्रवीत् किं नाम गर्हितं कर्म तव कर्तुम् अलं यम
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā ca tad vākyaṃ bhānur vacanam abravīt kiṃ nāma garhitaṃ karma tava kartum alaṃ yama
verses.translation: Seeing them with a wide gaping eyes, the gardener was struck with wonder and he thought mentally —"In which family are these two bom?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं न दृष्टा त्वया यान्ती गणिका गणकिंकरैः गीयमाना दिवं सद्यो गौतमीतोयम् आप्लुता
verses.transliteration: kiṃ na dṛṣṭā tvayā yāntī gaṇikā gaṇakiṃkaraiḥ gīyamānā divaṃ sadyo gautamītoyam āplutā
verses.translation: On seeing those two charming boys clad in yellow and blue robes he resolved that they were two Devas who had come to the Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वया चात्र तपस् तीव्रं कृतं पुत्र सुदुष्करम् नैवान्तं तस्य पश्यामि तस्माद् गच्छ निजं पुरम्
verses.transliteration: tvayā cātra tapas tīvraṃ kṛtaṃ putra suduṣkaram naivāntaṃ tasya paśyāmi tasmād gaccha nijaṃ puram
verses.translation: That gardener who maintained himself by selling gar¬ lands spoke to them "O my lords, you two have come to my house with delighted gentle faces. I am blessed. I shall worship
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा भगवान् भानुस् तत्र स्नात्वा गतो दिवम् यमो ऽपि संगमे स्नात्वा ततो निजपुरं ययौ
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā bhagavān bhānus tatra snātvā gato divam yamo 'pi saṃgame snātvā tato nijapuraṃ yayau
verses.translation: Then with his face beaming with delight he gave them
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भूतहापि ततः शङ्कां तत्याज च महामुने तथा दृष्ट्वा यमं यान्तं चक्रे चक्रं प्रयाणकम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtahāpi tataḥ śaṅkāṃ tatyāja ca mahāmune tathā dṛṣṭvā yamaṃ yāntaṃ cakre cakraṃ prayāṇakam
verses.translation: After saying this, O excellent sages, Krsna came out of that house in the company of Balarama. He was duly wor¬ shipped by the gardener.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भगवान् यत्र गोविन्दो वनमालाविभूषितः इति यः शृणुयान् मर्त्यः पठेद् वापि समाहितः
verses.transliteration: bhagavān yatra govindo vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ iti yaḥ śṛṇuyān martyaḥ paṭhed vāpi samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, O excellent sages, Krsna came out of that house in the company of Balarama. He was duly wor¬ shipped by the gardener.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आपदस् तस्य नश्यन्ति दीर्घम् आयुर् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: āpadas tasya naśyanti dīrgham āyur avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: After saying this, O excellent sages, Krsna came out of that house in the company of Balarama. He was duly wor¬ shipped by the gardener.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहल्यासंगमं चेह तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यपावनम् शृणु सम्यङ् मुनिश्रेष्ठ तत्र वृत्तम् इदं यथा
verses.transliteration: ahalyāsaṃgamaṃ ceha tīrthaṃ trailokyapāvanam śṛṇu samyaṅ muniśreṣṭha tatra vṛttam idaṃ yathā
verses.translation: Thereafter, Krsna saw a hump-backed lady in the prime of her youth, coming along the royal high-way with the vessel of unguent in her hand.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कौतुकेनातिमहता मया पूर्वं मुनीश्वर सृष्टा कन्या बहुविधा रूपवत्यो गुणान्विताः
verses.transliteration: kautukenātimahatā mayā pūrvaṃ munīśvara sṛṣṭā kanyā bahuvidhā rūpavatyo guṇānvitāḥ
verses.translation: Krsna gracefully said to her:—"O lady with the eyes like the blue lotus, to whom is this unguent being taken by you? Speak the truth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तासाम् एकां श्रेष्ठतमां निर्ममे शुभलक्षणाम् तां बालां चारुसर्वाङ्गीं दृष्ट्वा रूपगुणान्विताम्
verses.transliteration: tāsām ekāṃ śreṣṭhatamāṃ nirmame śubhalakṣaṇām tāṃ bālāṃ cārusarvāṅgīṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpaguṇānvitām
verses.translation: O loving one, why don't you know me? I have been employed by Kamsa in the task of preparing unguents. I am well known as Naikavakra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: को वास्याः पोषणे शक्त इति मे बुद्धिर् आविशत् न दैत्यानां सुराणां च न मुनीनां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: ko vāsyāḥ poṣaṇe śakta iti me buddhir āviśat na daityānāṃ surāṇāṃ ca na munīnāṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: The unguent ground and pasted by anyone else is not conducive to the delight of Kamsa. I am highly favoured by him and I am given much wealth too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नास्त्य् अस्याः पोषणे शक्तिर् इति मे बुद्धिर् अन्वभूत् गुणज्येष्ठाय विप्राय तपोयुक्ताय धीमते
verses.transliteration: nāsty asyāḥ poṣaṇe śaktir iti me buddhir anvabhūt guṇajyeṣṭhāya viprāya tapoyuktāya dhīmate
verses.translation: May this fragrant unguent beautiful and befitting kings, be given to us at least as much as will suffice our bodies.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलक्षणयुक्ताय वेदवेदाङ्गवेदिने गौतमाय महाप्राज्ञाम् अददां पोषणाय ताम्
verses.transliteration: sarvalakṣaṇayuktāya vedavedāṅgavedine gautamāya mahāprājñām adadāṃ poṣaṇāya tām
verses.translation: On hearing that, she spoke to Kr?na with respect and eagerness "May it be taken." She gave them unguent enough for their bodies.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पालयस्व मुनिश्रेष्ठ यावद् आप्स्यति यौवनम् यौवनस्थां पुनः साध्वीम् आनयेथा ममान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: pālayasva muniśreṣṭha yāvad āpsyati yauvanam yauvanasthāṃ punaḥ sādhvīm ānayethā mamāntikam
verses.translation: Embellished and smeared with the unguents, the two leading mainly ones shone like a white and a black cloud adorned with the rain-bow.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा गौतमाय प्रादां कन्यां सुमध्यमाम् ताम् आदाय मुनिश्रेष्ठ तपसा हतकल्मषः
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā gautamāya prādāṃ kanyāṃ sumadhyamām tām ādāya muniśreṣṭha tapasā hatakalmaṣaḥ
verses.translation: Krsna then pulled both of her legs and made her straight. With the body straightened she became the most excellent one among women.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तां पोषयित्वा विधिवद् अलंकृत्य ममान्तिकम् निर्विकारो मुनिश्रेष्ठो ह्य् अहल्याम् आनयत् तदा
verses.transliteration: tāṃ poṣayitvā vidhivad alaṃkṛtya mamāntikam nirvikāro muniśreṣṭho hy ahalyām ānayat tadā
verses.translation: In a charming ajnd graceful manner she caught hold of Krsna by his robes and said in lingering words couched in love
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा विबुधाः सर्वे शक्राग्निवरुणादयः मम देया सुरेशान इत्य् ऊचुस् ते पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vibudhāḥ sarve śakrāgnivaruṇādayaḥ mama deyā sureśāna ity ūcus te pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: "I will come to your house", said Krsna to her and bade her farewell. Looking at Rama's face he laughed aloud.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथैव मुनयः साध्या दानवा यक्षराक्षसाः तान् सर्वान् आगतान् दृष्ट्वा कन्यार्थम् अथ संगतान्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva munayaḥ sādhyā dānavā yakṣarākṣasāḥ tān sarvān āgatān dṛṣṭvā kanyārtham atha saṃgatān
verses.translation: With their bodies embellished and smeared with un¬ guents, clad in blue and yellow garments and with their hand¬ some features enhanced by garlands of flowers of various colours—the two went towards the chamber of bows.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य तु विशेषेण महांश् चाभूत् तदा ग्रहः गौतमस्य तु माहात्म्यं गाम्भीर्यं धैर्यम् एव च
verses.transliteration: indrasya tu viśeṣeṇa mahāṃś cābhūt tadā grahaḥ gautamasya tu māhātmyaṃ gāmbhīryaṃ dhairyam eva ca
verses.translation: The two cowherd boys have come. They are the destroyers of my life. Just in my presence they should be killed by you iii a wrestling bout.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्मृत्वा सुविस्मितो भूत्वा ममैवम् अभवत् सुधीः देयेयं गौतमायैव नान्ययोग्या शुभानना
verses.transliteration: smṛtvā suvismito bhūtvā mamaivam abhavat sudhīḥ deyeyaṃ gautamāyaiva nānyayogyā śubhānanā
verses.translation: If they are destroyed in a mutual combat by you, I will be satisfied and will give you all desired benefits. This cannot be otherwise, O strong ones.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माऐ एव तु तां दास्ये तथाप्य् एवम् अचिन्तयम् सर्वेषां च मतिर् धैर्यं मथितं बालयानया
verses.transliteration: tasmāai eva tu tāṃ dāsye tathāpy evam acintayam sarveṣāṃ ca matir dhairyaṃ mathitaṃ bālayānayā
verses.translation: Whether by just or unjust means, these enemies of mine should be killed by you. By their death the kingdom will be common to you both."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहल्येति सुरैः प्रोक्तं मया च ऋषिभिस् तदा देवान् ऋषींस् तदा वीक्ष्य मया तत्रोक्तम् उच्चकैः
verses.transliteration: ahalyeti suraiḥ proktaṃ mayā ca ṛṣibhis tadā devān ṛṣīṃs tadā vīkṣya mayā tatroktam uccakaiḥ
verses.translation: Then all the citizens occupied the common couches and seats and the kings occupied the royal couches and sofas along with their attendants.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै सा दीयते सुभ्रूर् यः पृथिव्याः प्रदक्षिणाम् कृत्वोपतिष्ठते पूर्वं न चान्यस्मै पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tasmai sā dīyate subhrūr yaḥ pṛthivyāḥ pradakṣiṇām kṛtvopatiṣṭhate pūrvaṃ na cānyasmai punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: The wrestlers, umpires and judges were kept in the middle of the stage by Kamsa, very near him. Kamsa himself occupied a raised sofa.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः सर्वे सुरगणाः श्रुत्वा वाक्यं मयेरितम् अहल्यार्थं सुरा जग्मुः पृथिव्याश् च प्रदक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sarve suragaṇāḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ mayeritam ahalyārthaṃ surā jagmuḥ pṛthivyāś ca pradakṣiṇe
verses.translation: Separate couches, seats and platforms were assigned to the residents of the royal harem, the chief courtesans and the ordinary ladies of the city.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गतेषु सुरसंघेषु गौतमो ऽपि मुनीश्वर प्रयत्नम् अकरोत् किंचिद् अहल्यार्थम् इमं तथा
verses.transliteration: gateṣu surasaṃgheṣu gautamo 'pi munīśvara prayatnam akarot kiṃcid ahalyārtham imaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Nandagopa and other cowherds were seated in their (specially reserved) couches. Akrura and Vasudeva occupied extremities of the platform.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे ब्रह्मन् सुरभिः सर्वकामधुक् अर्धप्रसूता ह्य् अभवत् तां ददर्श स गौतमः
verses.transliteration: etasminn antare brahman surabhiḥ sarvakāmadhuk ardhaprasūtā hy abhavat tāṃ dadarśa sa gautamaḥ
verses.translation: In the middle of the common ladies of the city was seated Devaki who was very fond of her son. Though it be the time of death, I shall see the face of my son.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः प्रदक्षिणं चक्रे इयम् उर्वीति संस्मरन् लिङ्गस्य च सुरेशस्य प्रदक्षिणम् अथाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ cakre iyam urvīti saṃsmaran liṅgasya ca sureśasya pradakṣiṇam athākarot
verses.translation: "This is the boy by whom the terrible ogress Putana had been killed; he by whom the cart had been upset and the pair of Arjuna trees were broken."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तयोः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा गौतमो मुनिसत्तमः सर्वेषां चैव देवानाम् एकं चापि प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā gautamo munisattamaḥ sarveṣāṃ caiva devānām ekaṃ cāpi pradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: "This is the boy who mounted the serpent Kaliya and danced; this is he by whom the great mountain Govardhana was lifted up and held for seven nights."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नैवाभवद् भुवो गन्तुः संजातं द्वितयं मम एवं निश्चित्य स मुनिर् ममान्तिकम् अथाभ्यगात्
verses.transliteration: naivābhavad bhuvo gantuḥ saṃjātaṃ dvitayaṃ mama evaṃ niścitya sa munir mamāntikam athābhyagāt
verses.translation: "Here is seen that Krsna the noble lord, by whom the wicked asuras Arista, Dhenuka and Kesin were playfully slain."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कृत्वाब्रवीद् वाक्यं गौतमो मां महामतिः कमलासन विश्वात्मन् नमस् ते ऽस्तु पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: namaskṛtvābravīd vākyaṃ gautamo māṃ mahāmatiḥ kamalāsana viśvātman namas te 'stu punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: "This lad of great arms is Balarama, his elder brother. He sportingly goes ahead delighting the minds and eyes of the womenfolk."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणीकृता ब्रह्मन् मयेयं वसुधाखिला यद् अत्र युक्तं देवेश जानीते तद् भवान् स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇīkṛtā brahman mayeyaṃ vasudhākhilā yad atra yuktaṃ deveśa jānīte tad bhavān svayam
verses.translation: "It is he who is mentioned by wisemen who survey the topics in the Puranas as follows "Gopala will redeem the entire Yadava family".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मया तु ध्यानयोगेन ज्ञात्वा गौतमम् अब्रवम् तवैव दीयते सुभ्रूः प्रदक्षिणम् इदं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: mayā tu dhyānayogena jñātvā gautamam abravam tavaiva dīyate subhrūḥ pradakṣiṇam idaṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: "He is that part of Visnu which has incarnated on the Earth; of Visnu who is identical with everyone; of Visnu who is the source of origin of everything. Indeed he is the dispeller of burden of the Earth".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धर्मं जानीहि विप्रर्षे दुर्ज्ञेयं निगमैर् अपि अर्धप्रसूता सुरभिः सप्तद्वीपवती मही
verses.transliteration: dharmaṃ jānīhi viprarṣe durjñeyaṃ nigamair api ardhaprasūtā surabhiḥ saptadvīpavatī mahī
verses.translation: When Rama and Krsna were described thus, the breasts of DevakI instantaneously exuded milk due to affection.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृता प्रदक्षिणा तस्याः पृथिव्याः सा कृता भवेत् लिङ्गं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य तद् एव फलम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: kṛtā pradakṣiṇā tasyāḥ pṛthivyāḥ sā kṛtā bhavet liṅgaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tad eva phalam āpnuyāt
verses.translation: On seeing his sons, Vasudeva felt as if he was witnessing a great festival. Due to delight he dispelled the old age that had descended on him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन मुने गौतम सुव्रत तुष्टो ऽहं तव धैर्येण ज्ञानेन तपसा तथा
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena mune gautama suvrata tuṣṭo 'haṃ tava dhairyeṇa jñānena tapasā tathā
verses.translation: The ladies of the royal harem and the ordinary ladies
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दत्तेयम् ऋषिशार्दूल कन्या लोकवरा मया इत्य् उक्त्वाहं गौतमाय अहल्याम् अददां मुने
verses.transliteration: datteyam ṛṣiśārdūla kanyā lokavarā mayā ity uktvāhaṃ gautamāya ahalyām adadāṃ mune
verses.translation: Krsna of unmeasured valour fought with Canura. Mustika the asura who was an expert in wrestling, fought with Balarama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जाते विवाहे ते देवाः कृत्वेलायाः प्रदक्षिणम् शनैः शनैर् अथागत्य ददृशुः सर्व एव ते
verses.transliteration: jāte vivāhe te devāḥ kṛtvelāyāḥ pradakṣiṇam śanaiḥ śanair athāgatya dadṛśuḥ sarva eva te
verses.translation: They dragged other cowherds of the same age to them¬ selves in their delight. With his eyes turned red Kamsa spoke to his men who had gathered in large.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तं गौतमम् अहल्यां च दांपत्यं प्रीतिवर्धनम् ते चागत्याथ पश्यन्तो विस्मिताश् चाभवन् सुराः
verses.transliteration: taṃ gautamam ahalyāṃ ca dāṃpatyaṃ prītivardhanam te cāgatyātha paśyanto vismitāś cābhavan surāḥ
verses.translation: - Let these two cowherds be forcibly removed from the the assembled group. Let the sinful Nanda be seized and bound with fetters.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अतिक्रान्ते विवाहे तु सुराः सर्वे दिवं ययुः समत्सरः शचीभर्ता ताम् ईक्ष्य च दिवं ययौ
verses.transliteration: atikrānte vivāhe tu surāḥ sarve divaṃ yayuḥ samatsaraḥ śacībhartā tām īkṣya ca divaṃ yayau
verses.translation: Let Vasudeva also be punished in the same manner as one not old. Let all these cowherds too who vaunt and swagger along with Krsna, be punished suitably.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रीतमनास् तस्मै गौतमाय महात्मने प्रादां ब्रह्मगिरिं पुण्यं सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prītamanās tasmai gautamāya mahātmane prādāṃ brahmagiriṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Be pleased, O lord of Devas, O most excellent one, O lord, O Kesava, favouring us you have lifted us up.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहल्यायां मुनिश्रेष्ठो रेमे तत्र स गौतमः गौतमस्य कथां पुण्यां श्रुत्वा शक्रस् त्रिविष्टपे
verses.transliteration: ahalyāyāṃ muniśreṣṭho reme tatra sa gautamaḥ gautamasya kathāṃ puṇyāṃ śrutvā śakras triviṣṭape
verses.translation: Since after being propitiated by me the lord has incar¬ nated in my house for destroying the wicked ones, thereby our race is sanctified.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तम् आश्रमं तं च मुनिं तस्य भार्याम् अनिन्दिताम् भूत्वा ब्राह्मणवेषेण द्रष्टुम् आगाच् छतक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: tam āśramaṃ taṃ ca muniṃ tasya bhāryām aninditām bhūtvā brāhmaṇaveṣeṇa draṣṭum āgāc chatakratuḥ
verses.translation: You remain within living beings. You are stationed within living beings, O soul of everyone, it is from you that the past and future function, invariably.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा भवनं तस्य भार्यां च विभवं तथा पापीयसीं मतिं कृत्वा अहल्यां समुदैक्षत
verses.transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā bhavanaṃ tasya bhāryāṃ ca vibhavaṃ tathā pāpīyasīṃ matiṃ kṛtvā ahalyāṃ samudaikṣata
verses.translation: O Acyuta, identical with Devas, O incomprehensible and unimaginable one, you are worshipped in the course of a Yajna. O lord of Yajnas, you are the Yajna and the performer of Yajna.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नात्मानं न परं देशं कालं शापाद् ऋषेर् भयम् न बुबोध तदा वत्स कामाकृष्टः शतक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: nātmānaṃ na paraṃ deśaṃ kālaṃ śāpād ṛṣer bhayam na bubodha tadā vatsa kāmākṛṣṭaḥ śatakratuḥ
verses.translation: O son ofDevakl, the fact that out of affection, my mind is full of vague notions in respect of you is great decep¬ tion.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद्ध्यानपरमो नित्यं सुरराज्येन गर्वितः संतप्ताङ्गः कथं कुर्यां प्रवेशो मे कथं भवेत्
