verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गालवं च नमस्याथ ततो याति स्वमन्दिरम् गङ्गायाः सेवनात् पूर्वं सनाज्जातस्य यद् वपुः
verses.transliteration: gālavaṃ ca namasyātha tato yāti svamandiram gaṅgāyāḥ sevanāt pūrvaṃ sanājjātasya yad vapuḥ
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा सविस्मयो मेने किंचिद् अस्त्य् अत्र कारणम् एवं सविस्मयो भूत्वा गालवः प्राह तं द्विजम्

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन्तं तु नमस्याथ सनाज्जातं गुरुर् गृहम् आहूय यत्नतो धीमान् कृपया विस्मयेन च

verses.sanskrit: को भवान् क्व च गन्तासि किं करोषि क्व भोक्ष्यसि किंनामा त्वं क्व शय्या ते का ते भार्या वदस्व मे
verses.transliteration: ko bhavān kva ca gantāsi kiṃ karoṣi kva bhokṣyasi kiṃnāmā tvaṃ kva śayyā te kā te bhāryā vadasva me
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.sanskrit: गालवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा ब्राह्मणो ऽप्य् आह तं मुनिम्

verses.sanskrit: श्वः कथ्यते मया सर्वं ज्ञात्वा कार्यविनिर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: śvaḥ kathyate mayā sarvaṃ jñātvā kāryavinirṇayam
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा गालवं तं सनाज्जातो गृहं ययौ भुक्त्वा रात्रौ तया सम्यक् शय्याम् आसाद्य बन्धकीम् उवाच चकितः स्मृत्वा गालवस्य तु यद् वचः
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā gālavaṃ taṃ sanājjāto gṛhaṃ yayau bhuktvā rātrau tayā samyak śayyām āsādya bandhakīm uvāca cakitaḥ smṛtvā gālavasya tu yad vacaḥ
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं तु सर्वगुणोपेता बन्धक्य् अपि पतिव्रता आवयोः सदृशी प्रीतिर् यावज्जीवं प्रवर्तताम्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ tu sarvaguṇopetā bandhaky api pativratā āvayoḥ sadṛśī prītir yāvajjīvaṃ pravartatām
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथापि किंचित् पृच्छामि किंनाम्नी त्वं क्व वा कुलम् किं नु स्थानं क्व वा बन्धुर् मम सर्वं निवेद्यताम्
verses.transliteration: tathāpi kiṃcit pṛcchāmi kiṃnāmnī tvaṃ kva vā kulam kiṃ nu sthānaṃ kva vā bandhur mama sarvaṃ nivedyatām
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धृतव्रत इति ख्यातो ब्राह्मणो दीक्षितः शुचिः तस्य भार्या मही चाहं मत्पुत्रो गालवाश्रमे
verses.transliteration: dhṛtavrata iti khyāto brāhmaṇo dīkṣitaḥ śuciḥ tasya bhāryā mahī cāhaṃ matputro gālavāśrame
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्सृष्टो मतिमान् बालः सनाज्जात इति श्रुतः अहं तु पूर्वदोषेण त्यक्त्वा धर्मं कुलागतम् स्वैरिणी त्व् इह वर्ते ऽहं विद्धि मां ब्राह्मणीं द्विज
verses.transliteration: utsṛṣṭo matimān bālaḥ sanājjāta iti śrutaḥ ahaṃ tu pūrvadoṣeṇa tyaktvā dharmaṃ kulāgatam svairiṇī tv iha varte 'haṃ viddhi māṃ brāhmaṇīṃ dvija
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास् तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा मर्मविद्ध इवाभवत् पपात सहसा भूमौ वेश्या तं वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā marmaviddha ivābhavat papāta sahasā bhūmau veśyā taṃ vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं तु जातं द्विजश्रेष्ठ क्व च प्रीतिर् गता तव किं तु वाक्यं मया चोक्तं तव चित्तविरोधकृत्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ tu jātaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha kva ca prītir gatā tava kiṃ tu vākyaṃ mayā coktaṃ tava cittavirodhakṛt
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानम् आत्मनाश्वास्य ब्राह्मणो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: ātmānam ātmanāśvāsya brāhmaṇo vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.sanskrit: धृतव्रतः पिता विप्रस् तत्पुत्रो ऽहं सनाद्यतः माता मही मम इयं मम दैवाद् उपागता
verses.transliteration: dhṛtavrataḥ pitā vipras tatputro 'haṃ sanādyataḥ mātā mahī mama iyaṃ mama daivād upāgatā
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा तस्य वाक्यं साप्य् अभूद् अतिदुःखिता तयोस् तु शोचतोः पश्चात् प्रभाते विमले रवौ गालवं मुनिशार्दूलं गत्वा विप्रो न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā tasya vākyaṃ sāpy abhūd atiduḥkhitā tayos tu śocatoḥ paścāt prabhāte vimale ravau gālavaṃ muniśārdūlaṃ gatvā vipro nyavedayat
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.sanskrit: धृतव्रतसुतो ब्रह्मंस् त्वया पूर्वं तु पालितः उपनीतस् त्वया चैव मही माता मम प्रभो
verses.transliteration: dhṛtavratasuto brahmaṃs tvayā pūrvaṃ tu pālitaḥ upanītas tvayā caiva mahī mātā mama prabho

verses.sanskrit: किं करोमि च किं कृत्वा निष्कृतिर् मम वै भवेत्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ karomi ca kiṃ kṛtvā niṣkṛtir mama vai bhavet

verses.transliteration: tad vipravacanaṃ śrutvā gālavaḥ prāha mā śucaḥ tavedaṃ dvividhaṃ rūpaṃ nityaṃ paśyāmy apūrvavat
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पृष्टो ऽसि वृत्तान्तं श्रुतं ज्ञातं मया यथा यत् कृत्यं तव तत् सर्वं गङ्गायां प्रत्यगात् क्षयम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pṛṣṭo 'si vṛttāntaṃ śrutaṃ jñātaṃ mayā yathā yat kṛtyaṃ tava tat sarvaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ pratyagāt kṣayam

verses.sanskrit: अस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्याद् अस्या देव्याः प्रसादतः पूतो ऽसि प्रत्यहं वत्स नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: asya tīrthasya māhātmyād asyā devyāḥ prasādataḥ pūto 'si pratyahaṃ vatsa nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभाते तव रूपाणि सपापानि त्व् अहर्निशम् पश्ये ऽहं पुनर् अप्य् एव रूपं तव गुणोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: prabhāte tava rūpāṇi sapāpāni tv aharniśam paśye 'haṃ punar apy eva rūpaṃ tava guṇottamam
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.sanskrit: आगच्छन्तं त्व् आगोयुक्तं गच्छन्तं त्वाम् अनागसम् पश्यामि नित्यं तस्मात् त्वं पूतो देव्या कृतो ऽधुना
verses.transliteration: āgacchantaṃ tv āgoyuktaṃ gacchantaṃ tvām anāgasam paśyāmi nityaṃ tasmāt tvaṃ pūto devyā kṛto 'dhunā
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान् न कार्यं ते किंचिद् अवशिष्टं भविष्यति इयं च माता ते विप्र ज्ञाता या चैव बन्धकी
verses.transliteration: tasmān na kāryaṃ te kiṃcid avaśiṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati iyaṃ ca mātā te vipra jñātā yā caiva bandhakī
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चात्तापं गतात्यन्तं निवृत्ता त्व् अथ पातकात् भूतानां विषये प्रीतिर् वत्स स्वाभाविकी यतः
verses.transliteration: paścāttāpaṃ gatātyantaṃ nivṛttā tv atha pātakāt bhūtānāṃ viṣaye prītir vatsa svābhāvikī yataḥ
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.sanskrit: सत्सङ्गतो महापुण्यान् निवृत्तिर् दैवतो भवेत् अत्यर्थम् अनुतप्तेयं प्रागाचरितपुण्यतः
verses.transliteration: satsaṅgato mahāpuṇyān nivṛttir daivato bhavet atyartham anutapteyaṃ prāgācaritapuṇyataḥ
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.transliteration: snānaṃ kṛtvā cātra tīrthe tataḥ pūtā bhaviṣyati tathā tau cakratur ubhau mātāputrau ca nārada
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.

verses.transliteration: snānād babhūvatur ubhau gatapāpāv asaṃśayam tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ dhautapāpaṃ pracakṣate
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पापप्रणाशनं नाम गालवं चेति विश्रुतम् महापातकम् अल्पं वा तथा यच् चोपपातकम् तत् सर्वं नाशयेद् एतद् धौतपापं सुपुण्यदम्
verses.transliteration: pāpapraṇāśanaṃ nāma gālavaṃ ceti viśrutam mahāpātakam alpaṃ vā tathā yac copapātakam tat sarvaṃ nāśayed etad dhautapāpaṃ supuṇyadam
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र दाशरथी रामः सीतया सहितो द्विज पितॄन् संतर्पयाम् आस पितृतीर्थं ततो विदुः
verses.transliteration: yatra dāśarathī rāmaḥ sītayā sahito dvija pitṝn saṃtarpayām āsa pitṛtīrthaṃ tato viduḥ
verses.translation: Krsna loved Rukmini and the lady of beautiful smiles loved him in return. Due to hatred, Rukmin did not give her to the discus-bearing lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नानं च दानं च पितॄणां तर्पणं तथा सर्वम् अक्षयताम् एति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā sarvam akṣayatām eti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Urged by Jarasandha and Rukmin together, Bhismaka of great exploit gave Rukmini to Sisupala.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र दाशरथी रामो विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम् पूजयाम् आस राजेन्द्रो मुनिभिस् तत्त्वदर्शिभिः
verses.transliteration: yatra dāśarathī rāmo viśvāmitraṃ mahāmunim pūjayām āsa rājendro munibhis tattvadarśibhiḥ
verses.translation: Then for the purpose of marriage the kings led by Jarasandha, and Sisupala went to Kundina the city of Bhismaka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रं तु तत् तीर्थम् ऋषिजुष्टं सुपुण्यदम् तत्स्वरूपं च वक्ष्यामि पठितं वेदवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitraṃ tu tat tīrtham ṛṣijuṣṭaṃ supuṇyadam tatsvarūpaṃ ca vakṣyāmi paṭhitaṃ vedavādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Surrounded by Balarama and other scions of the Yadu, Krsna went to Kundina to witness the marriage of Sisupala, the king of Cedi.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनावृष्टिर् अभूत् पूर्वं प्रजानाम् अतिभीषणा विश्वामित्रो महाप्राज्ञः सशिष्यो गौतमीम् अगात्
verses.transliteration: anāvṛṣṭir abhūt pūrvaṃ prajānām atibhīṣaṇā viśvāmitro mahāprājñaḥ saśiṣyo gautamīm agāt
verses.translation: On the sixth day after his birth, O brahmins, Kala- sambara kidnapped Pradyumna from the lying-in-chamber thinking—"O this one will be my killer".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यान् पुत्रांश् च जायां च कृशान् दृष्ट्वा क्षुधातुरान् व्यथितः कौशिकः श्रीमाञ् शिष्यान् इदम् उवाच ह
verses.transliteration: śiṣyān putrāṃś ca jāyāṃ ca kṛśān dṛṣṭvā kṣudhāturān vyathitaḥ kauśikaḥ śrīmāñ śiṣyān idam uvāca ha
verses.translation: Taking the boy with him he hurled him into the briny sea, infested with crocodiles, the awful abode of sparks that abounded in eddies and whirlpools generated by billows.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथा कथंचिद् यत् किंचिद् यत्र क्वापि यथा तथा आनीयतां किंतु भक्ष्यं भोज्यं वा मा विलम्ब्यताम् इदानीम् एव गन्तव्यम् आनेतव्यं क्षणेन तु
verses.transliteration: yathā kathaṃcid yat kiṃcid yatra kvāpi yathā tathā ānīyatāṃ kiṃtu bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ vā mā vilambyatām idānīm eva gantavyam ānetavyaṃ kṣaṇena tu
verses.translation: As the boy fell down there a fish caught hold of him. Though burned by its gastric fire the boy did not die.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋषेस् तद् वचनाच् छिष्याः क्षुधितास् त्वरया ययुः अटमाना इतश् चेतो मृतं ददृशिरे शुनम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣes tad vacanāc chiṣyāḥ kṣudhitās tvarayā yayuḥ aṭamānā itaś ceto mṛtaṃ dadṛśire śunam
verses.translation: O brahmins, this fish alongwith other fishes was caught by fishermen and offered to Sambara the most excellent one among the Asuras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तम् आदाय त्वरायुक्ता आचार्याय न्यवेदयन् सो ऽपि तं भद्रम् इत्य् उक्त्वा प्रतिजग्राह पाणिना
verses.transliteration: tam ādāya tvarāyuktā ācāryāya nyavedayan so 'pi taṃ bhadram ity uktvā pratijagrāha pāṇinā
verses.translation: His wife named Mayavati, the uncensured queen of his household, supervised over the work of cooks.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विशसध्वं श्वमांसं च क्षालयध्वं च वारिणा पचध्वं मन्त्रवच् चापि हुत्वाग्नौ तु यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: viśasadhvaṃ śvamāṃsaṃ ca kṣālayadhvaṃ ca vāriṇā pacadhvaṃ mantravac cāpi hutvāgnau tu yathāvidhi
verses.translation: "Who is this? How did he happen to come into the
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवान् ऋषीन् पितॄन् अन्यांस् तर्पयित्वातिथीन् गुरून् सर्वे भोक्ष्यामहे शेषम् इत्य् उवाच स कौशिकः
verses.transliteration: devān ṛṣīn pitṝn anyāṃs tarpayitvātithīn gurūn sarve bhokṣyāmahe śeṣam ity uvāca sa kauśikaḥ
verses.translation: Mavavati taught all the Mayas (illusory tricks) to the noble Pradyumna who was befitting her and in whom she had fixed her heart and the eyes. The lotus-eyed son of Krsna told her who was attached to him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रवचः श्रुत्वा शिष्याश् चक्रुस् तथैव तत् पच्यमाने श्वमांसे तु देवदूतो ऽग्निर् अभ्यगात् देवानां सदने सर्वं देवेभ्यस् तन् न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitravacaḥ śrutvā śiṣyāś cakrus tathaiva tat pacyamāne śvamāṃse tu devadūto 'gnir abhyagāt devānāṃ sadane sarvaṃ devebhyas tan nyavedayat
verses.translation: On seeing him present in the harem accompanied by Mayavatl, Krsna's wives had delightful ideas. The uncensured lady Rukrainl said with her eyes fixed on him with affection.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवैः श्वमांसं भोक्तव्यम् आपन्नम् ऋषिकल्पितम्
verses.transliteration: devaiḥ śvamāṃsaṃ bhoktavyam āpannam ṛṣikalpitam
verses.translation: In the meantime, Narada came there along with Krsna. Delighted he said to the gentle lady RukminI who was moving about in the harem:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेस् तद्वचनाद् इन्द्रः श्येनो भूत्वा विहायसि स्थालीम् अथाहरत् पूर्णां मांसेन पिहितां तदा
verses.transliteration: agnes tadvacanād indraḥ śyeno bhūtvā vihāyasi sthālīm athāharat pūrṇāṃ māṃsena pihitāṃ tadā
verses.translation: In the course of enjoyment of conjugal and other pleasures, this lady of charming eyes showed only the splendid illusory form to the asura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत् कर्म दृष्ट्वा शिष्यास् ते ऋषेः श्येनं न्यवेदयन् हृता स्थाली मुनिश्रेष्ठ श्येनेनाकृतबुद्धिना
verses.transliteration: tat karma dṛṣṭvā śiṣyās te ṛṣeḥ śyenaṃ nyavedayan hṛtā sthālī muniśreṣṭha śyenenākṛtabuddhinā
verses.translation: In the course of enjoyment of conjugal and other pleasures, this lady of charming eyes showed only the splendid illusory form to the asura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततश् चुकोप भगवाञ् शप्तुकामस् तदा हरिम् ततो ज्ञात्वा सुरपतिः स्थालीं चक्रे मधुप्लुताम्
verses.transliteration: tataś cukopa bhagavāñ śaptukāmas tadā harim tato jñātvā surapatiḥ sthālīṃ cakre madhuplutām
verses.translation: In the course of enjoyment of conjugal and other pleasures, this lady of charming eyes showed only the splendid illusory form to the asura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् निवेशयाम् आस उल्कास्व् एव खगो हरिः मधुना तु समायुक्तां विश्वामित्रश् चुकोप ह स्थालीं वीक्ष्य ततः कोपाद् इदम् आह स कौशिकः
verses.transliteration: punar niveśayām āsa ulkāsv eva khago hariḥ madhunā tu samāyuktāṃ viśvāmitraś cukopa ha sthālīṃ vīkṣya tataḥ kopād idam āha sa kauśikaḥ
verses.translation: In the course of enjoyment of conjugal and other pleasures, this lady of charming eyes showed only the splendid illusory form to the asura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्वमांसम् एव नो देहि त्वं हरामृतम् उत्तमम् नो चेत् त्वां भस्मसात् कुर्याम् इन्द्रो भीतस् तदाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: śvamāṃsam eva no dehi tvaṃ harāmṛtam uttamam no cet tvāṃ bhasmasāt kuryām indro bhītas tadābravīt
verses.translation: In the course of enjoyment of conjugal and other pleasures, this lady of charming eyes showed only the splendid illusory form to the asura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मधु हुत्वा यथान्यायं पिब पुत्रैः समन्वितः किम् अनेन श्वमांसेन अमेध्येन महामुने
verses.transliteration: madhu hutvā yathānyāyaṃ piba putraiḥ samanvitaḥ kim anena śvamāṃsena amedhyena mahāmune
verses.translation: In the course of enjoyment of conjugal and other pleasures, this lady of charming eyes showed only the splendid illusory form to the asura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रो ऽपि नेत्य् आह भुक्तेनैकेन किं फलम् प्रजाः सर्वाश् च सीदन्ति किं तेन मधुना हरे
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitro 'pi nety āha bhuktenaikena kiṃ phalam prajāḥ sarvāś ca sīdanti kiṃ tena madhunā hare
verses.translation: In the course of enjoyment of conjugal and other pleasures, this lady of charming eyes showed only the splendid illusory form to the asura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषाम् अमृतं चेत् स्याद् भोक्ष्ये ऽहम् अमृतं शुचि अथवा देवपितरो भोक्ष्यन्तीदं श्वमांसकम्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣām amṛtaṃ cet syād bhokṣye 'ham amṛtaṃ śuci athavā devapitaro bhokṣyantīdaṃ śvamāṃsakam
verses.translation: In the course of enjoyment of conjugal and other pleasures, this lady of charming eyes showed only the splendid illusory form to the asura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पश्चाद् अहं तच् च मांसं भोक्ष्ये नानृतम् अस्ति मे ततो भीतः सहस्राक्षो मेघान् आहूय तत्क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: paścād ahaṃ tac ca māṃsaṃ bhokṣye nānṛtam asti me tato bhītaḥ sahasrākṣo meghān āhūya tatkṣaṇāt
verses.translation: In the course of enjoyment of conjugal and other pleasures, this lady of charming eyes showed only the splendid illusory form to the asura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ववर्ष चामृतं वारि ह्य् अमृतेनार्पिताः प्रजाः पश्चात् तद् अमृतं पुण्यं हरिदत्तं यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: vavarṣa cāmṛtaṃ vāri hy amṛtenārpitāḥ prajāḥ paścāt tad amṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ haridattaṃ yathāvidhi
verses.translation: In the course of enjoyment of conjugal and other pleasures, this lady of charming eyes showed only the splendid illusory form to the asura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तर्पयित्वा सुरान् आदौ तर्पयित्वा जगत्त्रयम् विप्रः संभुक्तवाञ् शिष्यैर् विश्वामित्रः स्वभार्यया
verses.transliteration: tarpayitvā surān ādau tarpayitvā jagattrayam vipraḥ saṃbhuktavāñ śiṣyair viśvāmitraḥ svabhāryayā
verses.translation: In the course of enjoyment of conjugal and other pleasures, this lady of charming eyes showed only the splendid illusory form to the asura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थम् आख्यातं चातिपुण्यदम् यत्रागतः सुरपतिर् लोकानाम् अमृतार्पणम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham ākhyātaṃ cātipuṇyadam yatrāgataḥ surapatir lokānām amṛtārpaṇam
verses.translation: In the course of enjoyment of conjugal and other pleasures, this lady of charming eyes showed only the splendid illusory form to the asura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संजातं मांसवर्जं तु तत् तीर्थं पुण्यदं नृणाम् तत्र स्नानं च दानं च सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: saṃjātaṃ māṃsavarjaṃ tu tat tīrthaṃ puṇyadaṃ nṛṇām tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam
verses.translation: In the course of enjoyment of conjugal and other pleasures, this lady of charming eyes showed only the splendid illusory form to the asura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं विश्वामित्रम् इति स्मृतम् मधुतीर्थम् अथैन्द्रं च श्येनं पर्जन्यम् एव च
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ viśvāmitram iti smṛtam madhutīrtham athaindraṃ ca śyenaṃ parjanyam eva ca
verses.translation: In the course of enjoyment of conjugal and other pleasures, this lady of charming eyes showed only the splendid illusory form to the asura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्वेततीर्थम् इति ख्यातं त्रैलोक्ये विश्रुतं शुभम् तस्य श्रवणमात्रेण सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: śvetatīrtham iti khyātaṃ trailokye viśrutaṃ śubham tasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Krsna chose the granddaughter of Rukmin as wife unto his grandson. Although Rukmin vied and contended with Krsna he gave her to his daughter's son (i. e. Aniruddha)
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतो नाम पुरा विप्रो गौतमस्य प्रियः सखा आतिथ्यपूजानिरतो गौतमीतीरम् आश्रितः
verses.transliteration: śveto nāma purā vipro gautamasya priyaḥ sakhā ātithyapūjānirato gautamītīram āśritaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, to attend her marriage Rama and other descendants of Yadu went to Rukmin's city named Bhojakata, along, with Lord Krsna.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा शिवभक्तिपरायणः ध्यायन्तं तं द्विजश्रेष्ठं पूजयन्तं सदा शिवम्
verses.transliteration: manasā karmaṇā vācā śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ dhyāyantaṃ taṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ pūjayantaṃ sadā śivam
verses.translation: After the marriage of noble son of Pradyumna was concluded, Kalinga king and others spoke these words to Rukmin.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णायुषं द्विजवरं शिवभक्तिपरायणम् नेतुं दूताः समाजग्मुर् दक्षिणाशापतेस् तदा
verses.transliteration: pūrṇāyuṣaṃ dvijavaraṃ śivabhaktiparāyaṇam netuṃ dūtāḥ samājagmur dakṣiṇāśāpates tadā
verses.translation: So be it ' said Rukmin who possessed great strength, to those kings. He played the game of dice with Rama, in the
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नाशक्नुवन् गृहं तस्य प्रवेष्टुम् अपि नारद तदा काले व्यतिक्रान्ते चित्रको मृत्युम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: nāśaknuvan gṛhaṃ tasya praveṣṭum api nārada tadā kāle vyatikrānte citrako mṛtyum abravīt
verses.translation: Then Rukmin the most excellent
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं नायाति क्षीणजीवो मृत्यो श्वेतः कथं त्व् इति नाद्याप्य् आयान्ति दूतास् ते मृत्योर् नैवोचितं तु ते
verses.transliteration: kiṃ nāyāti kṣīṇajīvo mṛtyo śvetaḥ kathaṃ tv iti nādyāpy āyānti dūtās te mṛtyor naivocitaṃ tu te
verses.translation: Then, O brahmins, exhibiting all his teeth, the foolish overlord of Kalinga laughed at Bala. The haughty Rukmin spoke then:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततश् च कुपितो मृत्युः प्रायाच् छ्वेतगृहं स्वयम् बहिःस्थितांस् तदा पश्यन् मृत्युर् दूतान् भयार्दितान् प्रोवाच किम् इदं दूता मृत्युम् ऊचुश् च दूतकाः
verses.transliteration: tataś ca kupito mṛtyuḥ prāyāc chvetagṛhaṃ svayam bahiḥsthitāṃs tadā paśyan mṛtyur dūtān bhayārditān provāca kim idaṃ dūtā mṛtyum ūcuś ca dūtakāḥ
verses.translation: O members of the assembly, this Balarama devoid of learning has been defeated by me in the game of dice. He is not conversant with either the manner of fighting or the lore of the game.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिवेन रक्षितं श्वेतं वयं नो वीक्षितुं क्षमाः येषां प्रसन्नो गिरिशस् तेषां का नाम भीतयः
verses.transliteration: śivena rakṣitaṃ śvetaṃ vayaṃ no vīkṣituṃ kṣamāḥ yeṣāṃ prasanno giriśas teṣāṃ kā nāma bhītayaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the king of Kalinga with the teeth in his mouth fully exhibited, and Rukmin indulging in harsh words, Balarama became infuriated.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पाशपाणिस् तदा मृत्युः प्राविशद् यत्र स द्विजः नासौ विप्रो विजानाति मृत्युं वा यमकिंकरान्
verses.transliteration: pāśapāṇis tadā mṛtyuḥ prāviśad yatra sa dvijaḥ nāsau vipro vijānāti mṛtyuṃ vā yamakiṃkarān
verses.translation: With his mind full of fury Balarama put up the stake at a crore of gold coins. Rukmin too accepted it: He threw the dice for that purpose.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिवं पूजयते भक्त्या श्वेतस्य तु समीपतः मृत्युं पाशधरं दृष्ट्वा दण्डी प्रोवाच विस्मितः
verses.transliteration: śivaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā śvetasya tu samīpataḥ mṛtyuṃ pāśadharaṃ dṛṣṭvā daṇḍī provāca vismitaḥ
verses.translation: Baladevawon the stake. He said to him loudly "This is won by me".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किम् अत्र वीक्षसे मृत्यो दण्डिनं मृत्युर् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: kim atra vīkṣase mṛtyo daṇḍinaṃ mṛtyur abravīt
verses.translation: "It is true that this stake was announced by you. But it had not been accepted or approved of by me. That being the case if (you say) you have won how (can't I say that) I have won?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतं नेतुम् इहायातस् तस्माद् वीक्षे द्विजोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: śvetaṃ netum ihāyātas tasmād vīkṣe dvijottamam
verses.translation: Then loud resonant words rose up in the sky aggravat¬ ing the fury of noble Baladeva.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वं गच्छेत्य् अब्रवीद् दण्डी मृत्युः पाशान् अथाक्षिपत् श्वेताय मुनिशार्दूल ततो दण्डी चुकोप ह
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ gacchety abravīd daṇḍī mṛtyuḥ pāśān athākṣipat śvetāya muniśārdūla tato daṇḍī cukopa ha
verses.translation: The speech in the firmament said: "The stake is won by Baladeva. What is uttered by Rukmin is false. Certain things are accepted through actions even without mentioning words."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिवदत्तेन दण्डेन दण्डी मृत्युम् अताडयत् ततः पाशधरो मृत्युः पपात धरणीतले
verses.transliteration: śivadattena daṇḍena daṇḍī mṛtyum atāḍayat tataḥ pāśadharo mṛtyuḥ papāta dharaṇītale
verses.translation: Then Bala of great strength got up with his eyes turned red due to fury. With the dice board itself he hit and killed Rukmin.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् ते सत्वरं दूता हतं मृत्युम् अवेक्ष्य च यमाय सर्वम् अवदन् वधं मृत्योस् तु दण्डिना
verses.transliteration: tatas te satvaraṃ dūtā hataṃ mṛtyum avekṣya ca yamāya sarvam avadan vadhaṃ mṛtyos tu daṇḍinā
verses.translation: With great force he held the king of Kalinga who was throbbing and trembling. In his fury he broke his teeth with which he had openly laughed at him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततश् च कुपितो धर्मो यमो महिषवाहनः चित्रगुप्तं बहुबलं यमदण्डं च रक्षकम्
verses.transliteration: tataś ca kupito dharmo yamo mahiṣavāhanaḥ citraguptaṃ bahubalaṃ yamadaṇḍaṃ ca rakṣakam
verses.translation: The infuriated Bala seized a great column of gold and killed those kings who belonged to his side.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महिषं भूतवेतालान् आधिव्याधींस् तथैव च अक्षिरोगान् कुक्षिरोगान् कर्णशूलं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: mahiṣaṃ bhūtavetālān ādhivyādhīṃs tathaiva ca akṣirogān kukṣirogān karṇaśūlaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ज्वरं च त्रिविधं पापं नरकाणि पृथक् पृथक् त्वरन्ताम् इति तान् उक्त्वा जगाम त्वरितो यमः
verses.transliteration: jvaraṃ ca trividhaṃ pāpaṃ narakāṇi pṛthak pṛthak tvarantām iti tān uktvā jagāma tvarito yamaḥ
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतैर् अन्यैः परिवृतो यत्र श्वेतो द्विजोत्तमः तम् आयान्तं यमं दृष्ट्वा नन्दी प्रोवाच सायुधः
verses.transliteration: etair anyaiḥ parivṛto yatra śveto dvijottamaḥ tam āyāntaṃ yamaṃ dṛṣṭvā nandī provāca sāyudhaḥ
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विनायकं तथा स्कन्दं भूतनाथं तु दण्डिनम् तत्र तद् युद्धम् अभवत् सर्वलोकभयावहम्
verses.transliteration: vināyakaṃ tathā skandaṃ bhūtanāthaṃ tu daṇḍinam tatra tad yuddham abhavat sarvalokabhayāvaham
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कार्त्तिकेयः स्वयं शक्त्या बिभेद यमकिंकरान् दक्षिणाशापतिं चापि निजघान बलान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: kārttikeyaḥ svayaṃ śaktyā bibheda yamakiṃkarān dakṣiṇāśāpatiṃ cāpi nijaghāna balānvitam
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हतावशिष्टा याम्यास् ते आदित्याय न्यवेदयन् आदित्यो ऽपि सुरैः सार्धं श्रुत्वा तन् महद् अद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: hatāvaśiṣṭā yāmyās te ādityāya nyavedayan ādityo 'pi suraiḥ sārdhaṃ śrutvā tan mahad adbhutam
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लोकपालैर् अनुवृतो ममान्तिकम् उपागमत् अहं विष्णुश् च भगवान् इन्द्रो ऽग्निर् वरुणस् तथा
verses.transliteration: lokapālair anuvṛto mamāntikam upāgamat ahaṃ viṣṇuś ca bhagavān indro 'gnir varuṇas tathā
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रादित्याव् अश्विनौ च लोकपाला मरुद्गणाः एते चान्ये च बहवो वयं याता यमान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: candrādityāv aśvinau ca lokapālā marudgaṇāḥ ete cānye ca bahavo vayaṃ yātā yamāntikam
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृत आस्ते दक्षिणेशो गङ्गातीरे बलान्वितः समुद्राश् च नदा नागा नानाभूतान्य् अनेकशः
verses.transliteration: mṛta āste dakṣiṇeśo gaṅgātīre balānvitaḥ samudrāś ca nadā nāgā nānābhūtāny anekaśaḥ
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्राजग्मुः सुरेशानं द्रष्टुं वैवस्वतं यमम् तं दृष्ट्वा हतसैन्यं च यमं देवा भयार्दिताः कृताञ्जलिपुटाः शंभुम् ऊचुः सर्वे पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tatrājagmuḥ sureśānaṃ draṣṭuṃ vaivasvataṃ yamam taṃ dṛṣṭvā hatasainyaṃ ca yamaṃ devā bhayārditāḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ śaṃbhum ūcuḥ sarve punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भक्तिप्रियत्वं ते नित्यं दुष्टहन्तृत्वम् एव च आदिकर्तर् नमस् तुभ्यं नीलकण्ठ नमो ऽस्तु ते ब्रह्मप्रिय नमस् ते ऽस्तु देवप्रिय नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: bhaktipriyatvaṃ te nityaṃ duṣṭahantṛtvam eva ca ādikartar namas tubhyaṃ nīlakaṇṭha namo 'stu te brahmapriya namas te 'stu devapriya namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतं द्विजं भक्तम् अनायुषं ते नेतुं यमादिः सकलो ऽसमर्थः संतोषम् आप्ताः परमं समीक्ष्य भक्तप्रियत्वं त्वयि नाथ सत्यम्
verses.transliteration: śvetaṃ dvijaṃ bhaktam anāyuṣaṃ te netuṃ yamādiḥ sakalo 'samarthaḥ saṃtoṣam āptāḥ paramaṃ samīkṣya bhaktapriyatvaṃ tvayi nātha satyam
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये त्वां प्रपन्नाः शरणं कृपालुं नालं कृतान्तो ऽप्य् अनुवीक्षितुं तान् एवं विदित्वा शिव एव सर्वे त्वाम् एव भक्त्या परया भजन्ते
verses.transliteration: ye tvāṃ prapannāḥ śaraṇaṃ kṛpāluṃ nālaṃ kṛtānto 'py anuvīkṣituṃ tān evaṃ viditvā śiva eva sarve tvām eva bhaktyā parayā bhajante
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वम् एव जगतां नाथ किं न स्मरसि शंकर त्वां विना कः समर्थो ऽत्र व्यवस्थां कर्तुम् ईश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tvam eva jagatāṃ nātha kiṃ na smarasi śaṃkara tvāṃ vinā kaḥ samartho 'tra vyavasthāṃ kartum īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं तु स्तुवतां तेषां पुरस्ताद् अभवच् छिवः किं ददामीति तान् आह इदम् ऊचुः सुरा अपि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tu stuvatāṃ teṣāṃ purastād abhavac chivaḥ kiṃ dadāmīti tān āha idam ūcuḥ surā api
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अयं वैवस्वतो धर्मो नियन्ता सर्वदेहिनाम् धर्माधर्मव्यवस्थायां स्थापितो लोकपालकः
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ vaivasvato dharmo niyantā sarvadehinām dharmādharmavyavasthāyāṃ sthāpito lokapālakaḥ
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नायं वधम् अवाप्नोति नापराधी न पापकृत् विना तेन जगद्धातुर् नैव किंचिद् भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: nāyaṃ vadham avāpnoti nāparādhī na pāpakṛt vinā tena jagaddhātur naiva kiṃcid bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माज् जीवय देवेश यमं सबलवाहनम् प्रार्थना सफला नाथ महत्सु न वृथा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmāj jīvaya deveśa yamaṃ sabalavāhanam prārthanā saphalā nātha mahatsu na vṛthā bhavet
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रोवाच भगवाञ् जीवयेयम् असंशयम् यमं यदि वचो मे ऽद्य अनुमन्यन्ति देवताः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ provāca bhagavāñ jīvayeyam asaṃśayam yamaṃ yadi vaco me 'dya anumanyanti devatāḥ
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रोचुः सुराः सर्वे कुर्मो वाक्यं त्वयोदितम् हरिब्रह्मादिसहितं वशे यस्याखिलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ procuḥ surāḥ sarve kurmo vākyaṃ tvayoditam haribrahmādisahitaṃ vaśe yasyākhilaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रोवाच भगवान् अमरान् समुपागतान् मद्भक्तो न मृतिं यातु नेत्य् ऊचुर् अमराः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ provāca bhagavān amarān samupāgatān madbhakto na mṛtiṃ yātu nety ūcur amarāḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अमराः स्युस् ततो देव सर्वलोकाश् चराचराः अमर्त्यमर्त्यभेदो ऽयं न स्याद् देव जगन्मय
verses.transliteration: amarāḥ syus tato deva sarvalokāś carācarāḥ amartyamartyabhedo 'yaṃ na syād deva jaganmaya
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् अप्य् आह ताञ् शंभुः शृण्वन्तु मम भाषितम् मद्भक्तानां वैष्णवानां गौतमीम् अनुसेवताम्
verses.transliteration: punar apy āha tāñ śaṃbhuḥ śṛṇvantu mama bhāṣitam madbhaktānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ gautamīm anusevatām
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वयं तु स्वामिनो नित्यं न मृत्युः स्वाम्यम् अर्हति वार्त्ताप्य् एषां न कर्तव्या यमेन तु कदाचन
verses.transliteration: vayaṃ tu svāmino nityaṃ na mṛtyuḥ svāmyam arhati vārttāpy eṣāṃ na kartavyā yamena tu kadācana
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आधिव्याध्यादिभिर् जातु कार्यो नाभिभवः क्वचित् ये शिवं शरणं यातास् ते मुक्तास् तत्क्षणाद् अपि
verses.transliteration: ādhivyādhyādibhir jātu kāryo nābhibhavaḥ kvacit ye śivaṃ śaraṇaṃ yātās te muktās tatkṣaṇād api
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सानुगस्य यमस्यातो नमस्याः सर्व एव ते तथेत्य् ऊचुः सुरगणा देवदेवं शिवं प्रति
verses.transliteration: sānugasya yamasyāto namasyāḥ sarva eva te tathety ūcuḥ suragaṇā devadevaṃ śivaṃ prati
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततश् च भगवान् नाथो नन्दिनं प्राह वाहनम्
verses.transliteration: tataś ca bhagavān nātho nandinaṃ prāha vāhanam
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतम्या उदकेन त्वम् अभिषिञ्च मृतं यमम्
verses.transliteration: gautamyā udakena tvam abhiṣiñca mṛtaṃ yamam
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो यमादयः सर्वे अभिषिक्तास् तु नन्दिना उत्थिताश् च सजीवास् ते दक्षिणाशां ततो गताः
verses.transliteration: tato yamādayaḥ sarve abhiṣiktās tu nandinā utthitāś ca sajīvās te dakṣiṇāśāṃ tato gatāḥ
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे गौतमीतीरे विष्ण्वाद्याः सर्वदैवताः स्थिता आसन् पूजयन्तो देवदेवं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: uttare gautamītīre viṣṇvādyāḥ sarvadaivatāḥ sthitā āsan pūjayanto devadevaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रासन्न् अयुतान्य् अष्ट सहस्राणि चतुर्दश तथा षट् च सहस्राणि पुनः षट् च तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tatrāsann ayutāny aṣṭa sahasrāṇi caturdaśa tathā ṣaṭ ca sahasrāṇi punaḥ ṣaṭ ca tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: षड् दक्षिणे तथा तीरे तीर्थानाम् अयुतत्रयम् पुण्यम् आख्यानम् एतद् धि श्वेततीर्थस्य नारद
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍ dakṣiṇe tathā tīre tīrthānām ayutatrayam puṇyam ākhyānam etad dhi śvetatīrthasya nārada
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्रासौ पतितो मृत्युर् मृत्युतीर्थं तद् उच्यते तस्य श्रवणमात्रेण सहस्रं जीवते समाः
verses.transliteration: yatrāsau patito mṛtyur mṛtyutīrthaṃ tad ucyate tasya śravaṇamātreṇa sahasraṃ jīvate samāḥ
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नानं च दानं च सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् श्रवणं पठनं चापि स्मरणं च मलक्षयम् करोति सर्वलोकानां भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvapāpapraṇāśanam śravaṇaṃ paṭhanaṃ cāpi smaraṇaṃ ca malakṣayam karoti sarvalokānāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam
verses.translation: Then, O excellent brahmins, the descendants of Yadu, accompanied by Krsna returned to Dvaraka taking Aniruddha with them after his marriage rites were concluded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वसिद्धिकरं नृणाम् सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: śukratīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam
verses.translation: O lord, all miseries have been subdued by you, the lord of Devas, though stationed in the form of a human being.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गिराश् च भृगुश् चैव ऋषी परमधार्मिकौ तयोः पुत्रौ महाप्राज्ञौ रूपबुद्धिविलासिनौ
verses.transliteration: aṅgirāś ca bhṛguś caiva ṛṣī paramadhārmikau tayoḥ putrau mahāprājñau rūpabuddhivilāsinau
verses.translation: When the three worlds have been saved by your excellent intellect as well as brawny baton-like arms, the
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जीवः कविर् इति ख्यातौ मातापित्रोर् वशे रतौ उपनीतौ सुतौ दृष्ट्वा पितराव् ऊचतुर् मिथः
verses.transliteration: jīvaḥ kavir iti khyātau mātāpitror vaśe ratau upanītau sutau dṛṣṭvā pitarāv ūcatur mithaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, it behoves you to pursue efforts and counter¬ measures after listening to the reason for which I have come now.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आवयोर् एक एवास्तु शास्ता नित्यं च पुत्रयोः तस्माद् एकः शासिता स्यात् तिष्ठत्व् एको यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: āvayor eka evāstu śāstā nityaṃ ca putrayoḥ tasmād ekaḥ śāsitā syāt tiṣṭhatv eko yathāsukham
verses.translation: O suppressor of enemies, this son of Bhumi named Naraka
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा ततः शीघ्रम् अङ्गिराः प्राह भार्गवम् अध्यापयिष्ये सदृशं सुखं तिष्ठतु भार्गवः
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā tataḥ śīghram aṅgirāḥ prāha bhārgavam adhyāpayiṣye sadṛśaṃ sukhaṃ tiṣṭhatu bhārgavaḥ
verses.translation: After killing Devas, Siddhas, kings, and others that Asura imprisoned their daughters in his own palace.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा चाङ्गिरसो वाक्यं भृगुकुलोद्वहः तथेति मत्वाङ्गिरसे शुक्रं तस्मै न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā cāṅgiraso vākyaṃ bhṛgukulodvahaḥ tatheti matvāṅgirase śukraṃ tasmai nyavedayat
verses.translation: He has taken away the umbrella of Pracetas that exudes water. He has removed the Maniparvata, peak of the Mandara.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उभाव् अपि सुतौ नित्यम् अध्यापयति वै पृथक् वैषम्यबुद्ध्या तौ बालौ चिराच् छुक्रो ऽब्रवीद् इदम्
verses.transliteration: ubhāv api sutau nityam adhyāpayati vai pṛthak vaiṣamyabuddhyā tau bālau cirāc chukro 'bravīd idam
verses.translation: That Asura has taken away the illustrious ear-rings of my mother Aditi, the ear-rings that exude nectar. He now desires to take possession of my elephant Airavata.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैषम्येण गुरो मां त्वम् अध्यापयसि नित्यशः गुरूणां नेदम् उचितं वैषम्यं पुत्रशिष्ययोः
verses.transliteration: vaiṣamyeṇa guro māṃ tvam adhyāpayasi nityaśaḥ gurūṇāṃ nedam ucitaṃ vaiṣamyaṃ putraśiṣyayoḥ
verses.translation: O lord, I have told you about his evil activities. What steps should be taken by way of remedy may be pondered over by yourself.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैषम्येण च वर्तन्ते मूढाः शिष्येषु देशिकाः नैषा विषमबुद्धीनां संख्या पापस्य विद्यते
verses.transliteration: vaiṣamyeṇa ca vartante mūḍhāḥ śiṣyeṣu deśikāḥ naiṣā viṣamabuddhīnāṃ saṃkhyā pāpasya vidyate
verses.translation: On hearing this, lord Krsna, son of DevakI, smiled and caught hold of the hand of Indra. He then got up from the excellent seat.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आचार्य सम्यग् ज्ञातो ऽसि नमस्ये ऽहं पुनः पुनः गच्छेयं गुरुम् अन्यं वै माम् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: ācārya samyag jñāto 'si namasye 'haṃ punaḥ punaḥ gaccheyaṃ gurum anyaṃ vai mām anujñātum arhasi
verses.translation: He then rode on Garuda who traversed through the sky. He kept Satyabhama also on its back and went to the city of Pragjyotisa.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छेयं पितरं ब्रह्मन् यद्य् असौ विषमो भवेत् ततो वान्यत्र गच्छामि स्वामिन् पृष्टो ऽसि गम्यते
verses.transliteration: gaccheyaṃ pitaraṃ brahman yady asau viṣamo bhavet tato vānyatra gacchāmi svāmin pṛṣṭo 'si gamyate
verses.translation: Even as the residents of Dvaraka watched him, the delighted Indra mounted his elephant Airavata and went to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गुरुं बृहस्पतिं दृष्ट्वा अनुज्ञातस् त्व् अगात् ततः अवाप्तविद्यः पितरं गच्छेयं चेत्य् अचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: guruṃ bṛhaspatiṃ dṛṣṭvā anujñātas tv agāt tataḥ avāptavidyaḥ pitaraṃ gaccheyaṃ cety acintayat
verses.translation: For a hundred Yojanas all round the city of Pragjyo¬ tisa, the entire place was covered with terrible nooses in order to ward off the army of enemies.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् कम् अनुपृच्छेयम् उत्कृष्टः को गुरुर् भवेत् इति स्मरन् महाप्राज्ञम् अपृच्छद् वृद्धगौतमम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt kam anupṛccheyam utkṛṣṭaḥ ko gurur bhavet iti smaran mahāprājñam apṛcchad vṛddhagautamam
verses.translation: Lord Krsna hurled his discus Sudarsana and cut off those nooses. Then the asura Mura got up. Kesava killed him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: को गुरुः स्यान् मुनिश्रेष्ठ मम ब्रूहि गुरुर् भवेत् त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानां यो गुरुस् तं व्रजाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: ko guruḥ syān muniśreṣṭha mama brūhi gurur bhavet trayāṇām api lokānāṃ yo gurus taṃ vrajāmy aham
verses.translation: By the fire from the sharp edges of his discus Hari burned seven thousand sons of Mura as though they were mere moths,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स प्राह जगताम् ईशं शंभुं देवं जगद्गुरुम् क्वाराधयामि गिरिशम् इत्य् उक्तः प्राह गौतमः
verses.transliteration: sa prāha jagatām īśaṃ śaṃbhuṃ devaṃ jagadgurum kvārādhayāmi giriśam ity uktaḥ prāha gautamaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, after killing Mura, Hayagrlva and Pancajana the intelligent lord hastened to Pragjyotisa.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतम्यां तु शुचिर् भूत्वा स्तोत्रैस् तोषय शंकरम् ततस् तुष्टो जगन्नाथः स ते विद्यां प्रदास्यति
verses.transliteration: gautamyāṃ tu śucir bhūtvā stotrais toṣaya śaṃkaram tatas tuṣṭo jagannāthaḥ sa te vidyāṃ pradāsyati
verses.translation: By hurling his discus the discus-bearing lord, the power¬ ful destroyer of asuras, split Naraka into two, Naraka, son of the Earth, who was hurling weapons and missiles on him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतमस्य तु तद्वाक्यात् प्रागाद् गङ्गां स भार्गवः स्नात्वा भूत्वा शुचिः सम्यक् स्तुतिं चक्रे स बालकः
verses.transliteration: gautamasya tu tadvākyāt prāgād gaṅgāṃ sa bhārgavaḥ snātvā bhūtvā śuciḥ samyak stutiṃ cakre sa bālakaḥ
verses.translation: He had been given to me by you and now has been struck down by you. Take back these two ear-rings and protect his children.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बालो ऽहं बालबुद्धिश् च बालचन्द्रधर प्रभो नाहं जानामि ते किंचित् स्तुतिं कर्तुं नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: bālo 'haṃ bālabuddhiś ca bālacandradhara prabho nāhaṃ jānāmi te kiṃcit stutiṃ kartuṃ namo 'stu te
verses.translation: You are the creator, re-creator, annihilator, eternal source of origin and one whose form is identical with that of the universe. O Acyuta, how ami to eulogise you?.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: परित्यक्तस्य गुरुणा न ममास्ति सुहृत् सखा त्वं प्रभुः सर्वभावेन जगन्नाथ नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: parityaktasya guruṇā na mamāsti suhṛt sakhā tvaṃ prabhuḥ sarvabhāvena jagannātha namo 'stu te
verses.translation: You are the one all-pervading and the pervaded; deed, the doer and the thing done. You are the Atman, the inner soul of all living beings. O Acyuta, how can I eulogise you?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गुरुर् गुरुमतां देव महतां च महान् असि अहम् अल्पतरो बालो जगन्मय नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: gurur gurumatāṃ deva mahatāṃ ca mahān asi aham alpataro bālo jaganmaya namo 'stu te
verses.translation: You are the Supreme Atman, the innermost soul, the soul of living beings, the eternal lord. These are not your praises. They are the statements of facts. How shall anyone go about (this act of eulogy)?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विद्यार्थं हि सुरेशान नाहं वेद्मि भवद्गतिम् मां त्वं च कृपया पश्य लोकसाक्षिन् नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: vidyārthaṃ hi sureśāna nāhaṃ vedmi bhavadgatim māṃ tvaṃ ca kṛpayā paśya lokasākṣin namo 'stu te
verses.translation: O lord, the soul of all-living beings, be pleased. May what is done by Naraka be excused for making him free from defects. My son has already been struck down.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं तु स्तुवतस् तस्य प्रसन्नो ऽभूत् सुरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tu stuvatas tasya prasanno 'bhūt sureśvaraḥ
verses.translation: "So be it", the lord said to the Earth. O excellent sages, the conceiver and creator of the living beings took up jewels from the residence of Naraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कामं वरय भद्रं ते यच् चापि सुरदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: kāmaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yac cāpi suradurlabham
verses.translation: The lord of unequalled exploits saw sixteen thousand one hundred virgins in the harem, O excellent brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कविर् अप्य् आह देवेशं कृताञ्जलिर् उदारधीः
verses.transliteration: kavir apy āha deveśaṃ kṛtāñjalir udāradhīḥ
verses.translation: The lord of unequalled exploits saw sixteen thousand one hundred virgins in the harem, O excellent brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादिभिश् च ऋषिभिर् या विद्या नैव गोचरा तां विद्यां नाथ याचिष्ये त्वं गुरुर् मम दैवतम्
verses.transliteration: brahmādibhiś ca ṛṣibhir yā vidyā naiva gocarā tāṃ vidyāṃ nātha yāciṣye tvaṃ gurur mama daivatam
verses.translation: The lord of unequalled exploits saw sixteen thousand one hundred virgins in the harem, O excellent brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृतसंजीविनीं विद्याम् अज्ञातां त्रिदशैर् अपि तां दत्तवान् सुरश्रेष्ठस् तस्मै शुक्राय याचते
verses.transliteration: mṛtasaṃjīvinīṃ vidyām ajñātāṃ tridaśair api tāṃ dattavān suraśreṣṭhas tasmai śukrāya yācate
verses.translation: The lord of unequalled exploits saw sixteen thousand one hundred virgins in the harem, O excellent brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इतरा लौकिकी विद्या वैदिकी चान्यगोचरा किं पुनः शंकरे तुष्टे विचार्यम् अवशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: itarā laukikī vidyā vaidikī cānyagocarā kiṃ punaḥ śaṃkare tuṣṭe vicāryam avaśiṣyate
verses.translation: The lord of unequalled exploits saw sixteen thousand one hundred virgins in the harem, O excellent brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स तु लब्ध्वा महाविद्यां प्रायात् स्वपितरं गुरुम् दैत्यानां च गुरुश् चासीद् विद्यया पूजितः कविः
verses.transliteration: sa tu labdhvā mahāvidyāṃ prāyāt svapitaraṃ gurum daityānāṃ ca guruś cāsīd vidyayā pūjitaḥ kaviḥ
verses.translation: The lord of unequalled exploits saw sixteen thousand one hundred virgins in the harem, O excellent brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः कदाचित् तां विद्यां कस्मिंश्चित् कारणान्तरे कचो बृहस्पतिसुतो विद्यां प्राप्तः कवेस् तु ताम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kadācit tāṃ vidyāṃ kasmiṃścit kāraṇāntare kaco bṛhaspatisuto vidyāṃ prāptaḥ kaves tu tām
verses.translation: The lord of unequalled exploits saw sixteen thousand one hundred virgins in the harem, O excellent brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कचाद् बृहस्पतिश् चापि ततो देवाः पृथक् पृथक् अवापुर् महतीं विद्यां याम् आहुर् मृतजीविनीम्
verses.transliteration: kacād bṛhaspatiś cāpi tato devāḥ pṛthak pṛthak avāpur mahatīṃ vidyāṃ yām āhur mṛtajīvinīm
verses.translation: The lord of unequalled exploits saw sixteen thousand one hundred virgins in the harem, O excellent brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र सा कविना प्राप्ता विद्यापूज्य महेश्वरम् गौतम्या उत्तरे पारे शुक्रतीर्थं तद् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: yatra sā kavinā prāptā vidyāpūjya maheśvaram gautamyā uttare pāre śukratīrthaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: The lord of unequalled exploits saw sixteen thousand one hundred virgins in the harem, O excellent brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृतसंजीविनीतीर्थम् आयुरारोग्यवर्धनम् स्नानं दानं च यत् किंचित् सर्वम् अक्षयपुण्यदम्
verses.transliteration: mṛtasaṃjīvinītīrtham āyurārogyavardhanam snānaṃ dānaṃ ca yat kiṃcit sarvam akṣayapuṇyadam
verses.translation: The lord of unequalled exploits saw sixteen thousand one hundred virgins in the harem, O excellent brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं ब्रह्महत्याविनाशनम् स्मरणाद् अपि पापौघक्लेशसंघविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: indratīrtham iti khyātaṃ brahmahatyāvināśanam smaraṇād api pāpaughakleśasaṃghavināśanam
verses.translation: Playfully carrying the umbrella of Varuna, the jewel mountain and bearing lord Krsna on his back accompanied by his wife, Garuda went ahead.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरा वृत्रवधे वृत्ते ब्रह्महत्या तु नारद शचीपतिं चानुगता तां दृष्ट्वा भीतवद् धरिः
verses.transliteration: purā vṛtravadhe vṛtte brahmahatyā tu nārada śacīpatiṃ cānugatā tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītavad dhariḥ
verses.translation: Lord Krsna reached the gateway of heaven and blew the conch. Then Devas approached the lord along with the vessels full of materials of worship.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस् ततो वृत्रहन्ता इतश् चेतश् च धावति यत्र यत्र त्व् असौ याति हत्या सापीन्द्रगामिनी
verses.transliteration: indras tato vṛtrahantā itaś cetaś ca dhāvati yatra yatra tv asau yāti hatyā sāpīndragāminī
verses.translation: After being worshipped by Devas, Krsna entered the abode of the mother of Devas that had the shape of the peak of white mountain. After entering it he saw Aditi.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स महत् सर आविश्य पद्मनालम् उपागमत् तत्रासौ तन्तुवद् भूत्वा वासं चक्रे शचीपतिः
verses.transliteration: sa mahat sara āviśya padmanālam upāgamat tatrāsau tantuvad bhūtvā vāsaṃ cakre śacīpatiḥ
verses.translation: Accompanied by Indra he bowed to her. The lord gave her the excellent earrings and intimated to her the death of Naraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सरस्तीरे ऽपि हत्यासीद् दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रकम् एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे देवा निरिन्द्रा ह्य् अभवन् मुने
verses.transliteration: sarastīre 'pi hatyāsīd divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam etasminn antare devā nirindrā hy abhavan mune
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, O lotus-eyed one, O lord causing fearlessness to devotees, O lord, the eternal Atman, O Atman of living beings, O Atman of everything,© creator of living beings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रयाम् आसुर् अव्यग्राः कथम् इन्द्रो भवेद् इति तत्राहम् अवदं देवान् हत्यास्थानं प्रकल्प्य च
verses.transliteration: mantrayām āsur avyagrāḥ katham indro bhaved iti tatrāham avadaṃ devān hatyāsthānaṃ prakalpya ca
verses.translation: O lord, if one takes the non-Atman to be the Atman, this misconception is your Maya. It is from this that the ideas of T, 'Mine* etc. emerge.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य पावनार्थाय गौतम्याम् अभिषिच्यताम् यत्राभिषिक्तः पूतात्मा पुनर् इन्द्रो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: indrasya pāvanārthāya gautamyām abhiṣicyatām yatrābhiṣiktaḥ pūtātmā punar indro bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: O lady of fine eye-brows, due to my favour you will never have old age or deformity. O lady of blameless limbs, you will enjoy all worldly pleasures.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा ते निश्चयं कृत्वा गौतमीं शीघ्रम् आगमन् तत्र स्नातं सुरपतिं देवाश् च ऋषयस् तथा
verses.transliteration: tathā te niścayaṃ kṛtvā gautamīṃ śīghram āgaman tatra snātaṃ surapatiṃ devāś ca ṛṣayas tathā
verses.translation: Permitted by Aditi, the king of Devas duly worshipped the lord with adequate reverence.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अभिषेक्तुकामास् ते सर्वे शचीकान्तं च तस्थिरे अभिषिच्यमानम् इन्द्रं तं प्रकोपाद् गौतमो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: abhiṣektukāmās te sarve śacīkāntaṃ ca tasthire abhiṣicyamānam indraṃ taṃ prakopād gautamo 'bravīt
verses.translation: Then, O excellent ones, Kfsna accompanied by Satya- bhama visited the divine gardens and parks such as Nandana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अभिषेक्ष्यन्ति पापिष्ठं महेन्द्रं गुरुतल्पगम् तान् सर्वान् भस्मसात् कुर्यां शीघ्रं यान्त्व् असुरारयः
verses.transliteration: abhiṣekṣyanti pāpiṣṭhaṃ mahendraṃ gurutalpagam tān sarvān bhasmasāt kuryāṃ śīghraṃ yāntv asurārayaḥ
verses.translation: You seek for this Parijata out of foolishness. Who will go out safe and secure if he takes this with him? O Krsna, the lord of Devas will indeed be furious over this.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् ऋषेर् वचनं श्रुत्वा परिहृत्य च गौतमीम् नर्मदाम् अगमन् सर्व इन्द्रम् आदाय सत्वराः
verses.transliteration: tad ṛṣer vacanaṃ śrutvā parihṛtya ca gautamīm narmadām agaman sarva indram ādāya satvarāḥ
verses.translation: The immortal ones will follow Indra with the thunder¬ bolt raised up in his hand. Hence, O Acyuta, enough of your attempts to quarrel with Devas. Scholars do not praise that action which is very bitter in its result.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे नर्मदातीरे अभिषेकाय तस्थिरे अभिषेक्ष्यमाणम् इन्द्रं तं माण्डव्यो भगवान् ऋषिः
verses.transliteration: uttare narmadātīre abhiṣekāya tasthire abhiṣekṣyamāṇam indraṃ taṃ māṇḍavyo bhagavān ṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: The guards of the park who were addressed thus, went to §aci and told her what they were told. Saci then encouraged her husband the over-lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अब्रवीद् भस्मसात् कुर्यां यदि स्याद् अभिषेचनम् पूजयाम् आसुर् अमरा माण्डव्यं युक्तिभिः स्तवैः
verses.transliteration: abravīd bhasmasāt kuryāṃ yadi syād abhiṣecanam pūjayām āsur amarā māṇḍavyaṃ yuktibhiḥ stavaiḥ
verses.translation: Then Indra stood ready with the thunderbolt in his hand. Devas also stood in readiness holding their weapons such as iron clubs, sword and tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अयम् इन्द्रः सहस्राक्षो यस्मिन् देशे ऽभिषिच्यते तत्रातिदारुणं विघ्नं मुने समुपजायते
verses.transliteration: ayam indraḥ sahasrākṣo yasmin deśe 'bhiṣicyate tatrātidāruṇaṃ vighnaṃ mune samupajāyate
verses.translation: Then lord of the worlds playfully split each of the missiles and weapons discharged by Devas, into a thousand bits.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच्छान्तिं कुरु कल्याण प्रसीद वरदो भव मलनिर्यातनं यस्मिन् कुर्मस् तस्मिन् वरान् बहून्
verses.transliteration: tacchāntiṃ kuru kalyāṇa prasīda varado bhava malaniryātanaṃ yasmin kurmas tasmin varān bahūn
verses.translation: Garuda snatched the noose of the king of waters (i.e. Varuna), split it into bits like the body of a young serpent and moved about.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देशे दास्यामहे सर्वे तद् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्हसि यस्मिन् देशे सुरेन्द्रस्य अभिषेको भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: deśe dāsyāmahe sarve tad anujñātum arhasi yasmin deśe surendrasya abhiṣeko bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: The lord, the son of Devaki, struck down on to the ground the staff discharged by Yama. It was broken when he hurled his iron club at it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स सर्वकामदः पुंसां धान्यवृक्षफलैर् युतः नानावृष्टिर् न दुर्भिक्षं भवेद् अत्र कदाचन
verses.transliteration: sa sarvakāmadaḥ puṃsāṃ dhānyavṛkṣaphalair yutaḥ nānāvṛṣṭir na durbhikṣaṃ bhaved atra kadācana
verses.translation: The lord Krsna smashed the palanquin of the god of wealth into minute bits like gingelly seeds. The sun' and the moon lost their prowess.as it was destroyed by a single glance of the lord..
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मेने ततो मुनिश्रेष्ठो माण्डव्यो लोकपूजितः अभिषेकः कृतस् तत्र मलनिर्यातनं तथा
verses.transliteration: mene tato muniśreṣṭho māṇḍavyo lokapūjitaḥ abhiṣekaḥ kṛtas tatra malaniryātanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The Sadhyas, Visvedevas, Maruts and Gandharvas were sent up into the sky like the cotton bits from a Salmali tree by the Sarhga-bearing lord through his arrows.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवैस् तदोक्तो मुनिभिः स देशो मालवस् ततः अभिषिक्ते सुरपतौ जाते च विमले तदा
verses.transliteration: devais tadokto munibhiḥ sa deśo mālavas tataḥ abhiṣikte surapatau jāte ca vimale tadā
verses.translation: Garuda killed and ate Devas and Upadevas by means of his beak, wings and claws.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आनीय गौतमीं गङ्गां तं पुण्यायाभिषेचिरे सुराश् च ऋषयश् चैव अहं विष्णुस् तथैव च
verses.transliteration: ānīya gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ taṃ puṇyāyābhiṣecire surāś ca ṛṣayaś caiva ahaṃ viṣṇus tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Then Indra, the lord of Devas, and lord Krsna, the slayer of Madhu showered each other with a thousand arrows like two clouds by heavy downpours.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठो गौतमश् चापि अगस्त्यो ऽत्रिश् च कश्यपः एते चान्ये च ऋषयो देवा यक्षाः सपन्नगाः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭho gautamaś cāpi agastyo 'triś ca kaśyapaḥ ete cānye ca ṛṣayo devā yakṣāḥ sapannagāḥ
verses.translation: In the utter confusion obtaining there, Garuqla fought with Airavata and lord.Krsna with Devas accompanied by Indra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं तत्पुण्यतोयेन अकुर्वन्न् अभिषेचनम् मया पुनः शचीभर्ता कमण्डलुभवेन च
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ tatpuṇyatoyena akurvann abhiṣecanam mayā punaḥ śacībhartā kamaṇḍalubhavena ca
verses.translation: When weapons and missiles were split and scattered, Indra hastily seized the thunderbolt and Krsna took up his discus Sudarsana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वारिणाप्य् अभिषिक्तश् च तत्र पुण्याभवन् नदी सिक्ता चेति च तत्रासीत् ते गङ्गायां च संगते
verses.transliteration: vāriṇāpy abhiṣiktaś ca tatra puṇyābhavan nadī siktā ceti ca tatrāsīt te gaṅgāyāṃ ca saṃgate
verses.translation: On seeing the king of Devas and Sri Krsna holding up their thunderbolt and discus respectively the whole of the uni¬ verse consisting of mobile and immobile beings raised a hue and cry.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संगमौ तत्र विख्यातौ सर्वदा मुनिसेवितौ ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं पुण्यासंगमम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: saṃgamau tatra vikhyātau sarvadā munisevitau tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ puṇyāsaṃgamam ucyate
verses.translation: Lord Krsna caught hold of thunderbolt hurled by Indra. Without releasing his discus he told him c stay, stay'.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सिक्तायाः संगमे पुण्यम् ऐन्द्रं तद् अभिधीयते तत्र सप्त सहस्राणि तीर्थान्य् आसञ् शुभानि च
verses.transliteration: siktāyāḥ saṃgame puṇyam aindraṃ tad abhidhīyate tatra sapta sahasrāṇi tīrthāny āsañ śubhāni ca
verses.translation: As the king of Devas lost his thunderbolt, as his vehicle was wounded by Garuda, he became inclined to run away then. Satyabhama spoke to him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेषु स्नानं च दानं च विशेषेण तु संगमे सर्वं तद् अक्षयं विद्यान् नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa tu saṃgame sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ vidyān nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: O Indra, enough of your endeavour. It does not behove you to be ashamed. Let this Parijata tree be taken away. Let Devas be rid of pain. On account of her excessive pride and arrogance SacI did not view me with reverence as I went to her house. Nor did she honour me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यद् एतत् पुण्यम् आख्यानं यः पठेच् च शृणोति वा सर्वपापैः स मुच्येत मनोवाक्कायकर्मजैः
verses.transliteration: yad etat puṇyam ākhyānaṃ yaḥ paṭhec ca śṛṇoti vā sarvapāpaiḥ sa mucyeta manovākkāyakarmajaiḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, when addressed thus the king of Devas re¬ turned and said to her:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पौलस्त्यं तीर्थम् आख्यातं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदं नृणाम् प्रभावं तस्य वक्ष्यामि भ्रष्टराज्यप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: paulastyaṃ tīrtham ākhyātaṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇām prabhāvaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi bhraṣṭarājyapradāyakam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, eulogised thus by the king of Devas, lord Krsna laughed and spoke in an emotionally majes- tic manner.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्तराशापतिः पूर्वम् ऋद्धिसिद्धिसमन्वितः पुरा लङ्कापतिश् चासीज् ज्येष्ठो विश्रवसः सुतः
verses.transliteration: uttarāśāpatiḥ pūrvam ṛddhisiddhisamanvitaḥ purā laṅkāpatiś cāsīj jyeṣṭho viśravasaḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: You are Indra, the king of Devas. O lord of the universe, we are mortals. The crime committed by me should be excused by you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैते भ्रातरश् चासन् बलवन्तो ऽमितप्रभाः सापत्ना रावणश् चैव कुम्भकर्णो विभीषणः
verses.transliteration: tasyaite bhrātaraś cāsan balavanto 'mitaprabhāḥ sāpatnā rāvaṇaś caiva kumbhakarṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: May this Parijata tree be taken to its proper site. O Indra, it was at the instance of Satya that it was taken by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ते ऽपि विश्रवसः पुत्रा राक्षस्यां राक्षसास् तु ते मद्दत्तेन विमानेन धनदो भ्रातृभिः सह
verses.transliteration: te 'pi viśravasaḥ putrā rākṣasyāṃ rākṣasās tu te maddattena vimānena dhanado bhrātṛbhiḥ saha
verses.translation: Take back this thunderbolt which had been hurled at me by you. O Indra, it is your own weapon that pierces enemies.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ममान्तिकं भक्तियुक्तो नित्यम् एति तु याति च रावणस्य तु या माता कुपिता साब्रवीत् सुतान्
verses.transliteration: mamāntikaṃ bhaktiyukto nityam eti tu yāti ca rāvaṇasya tu yā mātā kupitā sābravīt sutān
verses.translation: O Lord, why do you try to delude me by saying "I am a mortal". We know you; we are conversant with the infinite happiness.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मरिष्ये न च जीविष्ये पुत्रा वैरूप्यकारणात् देवाश् च दानवाश् चासन् सापत्ना भ्रातरो मिथः
verses.transliteration: mariṣye na ca jīviṣye putrā vairūpyakāraṇāt devāś ca dānavāś cāsan sāpatnā bhrātaro mithaḥ
verses.translation: As you are, so you are, O lord of the universe. O lord, you are firmly fixed in your work. O slayer of Asuras, you re¬ move thorns of the universe.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यवधम् ईप्सन्ते जयैश्वर्यवशानुगाः तद्भवन्तो न पुरुषा न शक्ता न जयैषिणः सापत्न्यं यो ऽनुमन्यते तस्य जीवो निरर्थकः
verses.transliteration: anyonyavadham īpsante jayaiśvaryavaśānugāḥ tadbhavanto na puruṣā na śaktā na jayaiṣiṇaḥ sāpatnyaṃ yo 'numanyate tasya jīvo nirarthakaḥ
verses.translation: O Krsna, may this Parijata tree be taken to Dvaravatl. Except with you this will not remain anywhere else in the mortal world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तन् मातृवचनं श्रुत्वा भ्रातरस् ते त्रयो मुने जग्मुस् ते तपसे ऽरण्यं कृतवन्तस् तपो महत्
verses.transliteration: tan mātṛvacanaṃ śrutvā bhrātaras te trayo mune jagmus te tapase 'raṇyaṃ kṛtavantas tapo mahat
verses.translation: After saying "So be it" to the lord of Devas Sri K r sna came to the Earth, eulogised by the liberated Siddhas, Gan- dharvas and sages.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मत्तो वरान् अवापुश् च त्रय एते च राक्षसाः मातुलेन मरीचेन तथा मातामहेन तु
verses.transliteration: matto varān avāpuś ca traya ete ca rākṣasāḥ mātulena marīcena tathā mātāmahena tu
verses.translation: Taking the excellent tree with him, Krsna hastened.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तन्मातृवचनाच् चापि ततो लङ्काम् अयाचत रक्षोभावान् मातृदोषाद् भ्रात्रोर् वैरम् अभून् महत्
verses.transliteration: tanmātṛvacanāc cāpi tato laṅkām ayācata rakṣobhāvān mātṛdoṣād bhrātror vairam abhūn mahat
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तद् अभवद् युद्धं देवदानवयोर् इव युद्धे जित्वाग्रजं शान्तं धनदं भ्रातरं तथा
verses.transliteration: tatas tad abhavad yuddhaṃ devadānavayor iva yuddhe jitvāgrajaṃ śāntaṃ dhanadaṃ bhrātaraṃ tathā
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पकं च पुरीं लङ्कां सर्वं चैव व्यपाहरत् रावणो घोषयाम् आस त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे
verses.transliteration: puṣpakaṃ ca purīṃ laṅkāṃ sarvaṃ caiva vyapāharat rāvaṇo ghoṣayām āsa trailokye sacarācare
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो दद्याद् आश्रयं भ्रातुः स च वध्यो भवेन् मम भ्रात्रा निरस्तो वैश्रवणो नैव प्रापाश्रयं क्वचित् पितामहं पुलस्त्यं तं गत्वा नत्वाब्रवीद् वचः
verses.transliteration: yo dadyād āśrayaṃ bhrātuḥ sa ca vadhyo bhaven mama bhrātrā nirasto vaiśravaṇo naiva prāpāśrayaṃ kvacit pitāmahaṃ pulastyaṃ taṃ gatvā natvābravīd vacaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भ्रात्रा निरस्तो दुष्टेन किं करोमि वदस्व मे आश्रयः शरणं यत् स्याद् दैवं वा तीर्थम् एव च
verses.transliteration: bhrātrā nirasto duṣṭena kiṃ karomi vadasva me āśrayaḥ śaraṇaṃ yat syād daivaṃ vā tīrtham eva ca
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
