verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत् पौत्रवचनं श्रुत्वा पुलस्त्यो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tat pautravacanaṃ śrutvā pulastyo vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतमीं गच्छ पुत्र त्वं स्तुहि देवं महेश्वरम् तत्र नास्य प्रवेशः स्याद् गङ्गाया जलमध्यतः
verses.transliteration: gautamīṃ gaccha putra tvaṃ stuhi devaṃ maheśvaram tatra nāsya praveśaḥ syād gaṅgāyā jalamadhyataḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धिं प्राप्स्यसि कल्याणीं तथा कुरु मया सह
verses.transliteration: siddhiṃ prāpsyasi kalyāṇīṃ tathā kuru mayā saha
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा जगामासौ सभार्यो धनदस् तथा पित्रा मात्रा च वृद्धेन पुलस्त्येन धनेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā jagāmāsau sabhāryo dhanadas tathā pitrā mātrā ca vṛddhena pulastyena dhaneśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तु गौतमीं गङ्गां शुचिः स्नात्वा यतव्रतः तुष्टाव देवदेवेशं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: gatvā tu gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ śuciḥ snātvā yatavrataḥ tuṣṭāva devadeveśaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ śivam
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वामी त्वम् एवास्य चराचरस्य विश्वस्य शंभो न परो ऽस्ति कश्चित् त्वाम् अप्य् अवज्ञाय यदीह मोहात् प्रगल्भते कोपि स शोच्य एव
verses.transliteration: svāmī tvam evāsya carācarasya viśvasya śaṃbho na paro 'sti kaścit tvām apy avajñāya yadīha mohāt pragalbhate kopi sa śocya eva
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वम् अष्टमूर्त्या सकलं बिभर्षि त्वदाज्ञया वर्तत एव सर्वम् तथापि वेदेति बुधो भवन्तं न जात्व् अविद्वान् महिमा पुरातनम्
verses.transliteration: tvam aṣṭamūrtyā sakalaṃ bibharṣi tvadājñayā vartata eva sarvam tathāpi vedeti budho bhavantaṃ na jātv avidvān mahimā purātanam
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मलप्रसूतं यद् अवोचद् अम्बा हास्यात् सुतो ऽयं तव देव शूरः त्वत्प्रेक्षिताद् यः स च विघ्नराजो जज्ञे त्व् अहो चेष्टितम् ईशदृष्टेः
verses.transliteration: malaprasūtaṃ yad avocad ambā hāsyāt suto 'yaṃ tava deva śūraḥ tvatprekṣitād yaḥ sa ca vighnarājo jajñe tv aho ceṣṭitam īśadṛṣṭeḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अश्रुप्लुताङ्गी गिरिजा समीक्ष्य वियुक्तदांपत्यम् इतीशम् ऊचे मनोभवो ऽभून् मदनो रतिश् च सौभाग्यपूर्वत्वम् अवाप सोमात्
verses.transliteration: aśruplutāṅgī girijā samīkṣya viyuktadāṃpatyam itīśam ūce manobhavo 'bhūn madano ratiś ca saubhāgyapūrvatvam avāpa somāt
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्यादि स्तुवतस् तस्य पुरतो ऽभूत् त्रिलोचनः वरेण च्छन्दयाम् आस हर्षान् नोवाच किंचन
verses.transliteration: ityādi stuvatas tasya purato 'bhūt trilocanaḥ vareṇa cchandayām āsa harṣān novāca kiṃcana
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तूष्णींभूते तु धनदे पुलस्त्ये च महेश्वरे पुनः पुनर् वरस्वेति शिवे वादिनि हर्षिते
verses.transliteration: tūṣṇīṃbhūte tu dhanade pulastye ca maheśvare punaḥ punar varasveti śive vādini harṣite
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तत्र वाग् उवाचाशरीरिणी प्राप्तव्यं धनपालत्वं वदन्तीदं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: etasminn antare tatra vāg uvācāśarīriṇī prāptavyaṃ dhanapālatvaṃ vadantīdaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्यस्य तु यच् चित्तं पितुर् वैश्रवणस्य तु विदित्वेव तदा वाणी शुभम् अर्थम् उदीरयत्
verses.transliteration: pulastyasya tu yac cittaṃ pitur vaiśravaṇasya tu viditveva tadā vāṇī śubham artham udīrayat
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भूतवद् भवितव्यं स्याद् दास्यमानं तु दत्तवत् प्राप्तव्यं प्राप्तवत् तत्र दैवी वाग् अभवच् छुभा
verses.transliteration: bhūtavad bhavitavyaṃ syād dāsyamānaṃ tu dattavat prāptavyaṃ prāptavat tatra daivī vāg abhavac chubhā
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रभूतशत्रुः परिभूतदुःखः संपूज्य सोमेश्वरम् आप लिङ्गम् दिगीश्वरत्वं द्रविणप्रभुत्वम् अपारदातृत्वकलत्रपुत्रान्
verses.transliteration: prabhūtaśatruḥ paribhūtaduḥkhaḥ saṃpūjya someśvaram āpa liṅgam digīśvaratvaṃ draviṇaprabhutvam apāradātṛtvakalatraputrān
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तां वाचं धनदः श्रुत्वा देवदेवं त्रिशूलिनम् एवं भवतु नामेति धनदो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ vācaṃ dhanadaḥ śrutvā devadevaṃ triśūlinam evaṃ bhavatu nāmeti dhanado vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथैवास्त्व् इति देवेशो दैवीं वाचम् अमन्यत पुलस्त्यं च वरैः पुण्यैस् तथा विश्रवसं मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: tathaivāstv iti deveśo daivīṃ vācam amanyata pulastyaṃ ca varaiḥ puṇyais tathā viśravasaṃ munim
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धनपालं च देवेशो ह्य् अभिनन्द्य ययौ शिवः ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं पौलस्त्यं धनदं विदुः
verses.transliteration: dhanapālaṃ ca deveśo hy abhinandya yayau śivaḥ tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ paulastyaṃ dhanadaṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा वैश्रवसं पुण्यं सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम् तेषु स्नानादि यत् किंचित् तत् सर्वं बहुपुण्यदम्
verses.transliteration: tathā vaiśravasaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham teṣu snānādi yat kiṃcit tat sarvaṃ bahupuṇyadam
verses.translation: O brahmins, getting down from Garuda in the com- pany of Satyabhama he delighted the residents of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्नितीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम् सर्वविघ्नोपशमनं तत्तीर्थस्य फलं शृणु
verses.transliteration: agnitīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvakratuphalapradam sarvavighnopaśamanaṃ tattīrthasya phalaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Pradyumna and other sons of Krsna born of RukminI, have already been mentioned. O brahmins, Satyabhama gave birth to Bhanu and other sons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जातवेदा इति ख्यातो अग्नेर् भ्राता स हव्यवाट् हव्यं वहन्तं देवानां गौतम्यास् तीर एव तु
verses.transliteration: jātavedā iti khyāto agner bhrātā sa havyavāṭ havyaṃ vahantaṃ devānāṃ gautamyās tīra eva tu
verses.translation: Prapaksa and others were the brilliant sons of RohinI and Krsna. Samba and others of mighty arms were bom to
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां सत्त्रसदने अग्नेर् भ्रातरम् उत्तमम् भ्रातुः प्रियं तथा दक्षं मधुर् दितिसुतो बली
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ sattrasadane agner bhrātaram uttamam bhrātuḥ priyaṃ tathā dakṣaṃ madhur ditisuto balī
verses.translation: Bhadravinda and other powerful sons were born to Nagnajiti. The sons the chief of whom was Sangramajit were
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जघान ऋषिमुख्येषु पश्यत्सु च सुरेष्व् अपि हव्यं देवा नैव चापुर् मृते वै जातवेदसि
verses.transliteration: jaghāna ṛṣimukhyeṣu paśyatsu ca sureṣv api havyaṃ devā naiva cāpur mṛte vai jātavedasi
verses.translation: Madri's sons were VVka and others. Laksmana had sons the chief of whom was Gotravan. Sruta and others were the sons of KalindT.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृते भ्रातरि स त्व् अग्निः प्रिये वै जातवेदसि कोपेन महताविष्टो गाङ्गम् अम्भः समाविशत्
verses.transliteration: mṛte bhrātari sa tv agniḥ priye vai jātavedasi kopena mahatāviṣṭo gāṅgam ambhaḥ samāviśat
verses.translation: The discus-bearing lord had sons in other wives too. On the whole, he had eightyeight thousand and one hundred
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाम्भसि समाविष्टे ह्य् अग्नौ देवाश् च मानुषाः जीवम् उत्सर्जयाम् आसुर् अग्निजीवा यतो मताः
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāmbhasi samāviṣṭe hy agnau devāś ca mānuṣāḥ jīvam utsarjayām āsur agnijīvā yato matāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, Aniruddha of great strength who had been held as a prisoner of war, married Usa, the Daughter of Bana and the grand-daughter of Bali.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्राग्निर् जलम् आविष्टस् तं देशं सर्व एव ते आजग्मुर् विबुधाः सर्व ऋषयः पितरस् तथा
verses.transliteration: yatrāgnir jalam āviṣṭas taṃ deśaṃ sarva eva te ājagmur vibudhāḥ sarva ṛṣayaḥ pitaras tathā
verses.translation: In the course of events, Krsna and Sankara fought with each other during which the thousand arms of Bana were cut off by the discus-bearing lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विनाग्निना न जीवामः स्तुवन्तो ऽग्निं विशेषतः अग्निं जलगतं दृष्ट्वा प्रियं चोचुर् दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: vināgninā na jīvāmaḥ stuvanto 'gniṃ viśeṣataḥ agniṃ jalagataṃ dṛṣṭvā priyaṃ cocur divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: Thus consoled by Parvati, she thought within herself— "When? Who will be my husband?" Parvati then said to her again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवाञ् जीवय हव्येन कव्येन च पितॄंस् तथा मानुषान् अन्नपाकेन बीजानां क्लेदनेन च
verses.transliteration: devāñ jīvaya havyena kavyena ca pitṝṃs tathā mānuṣān annapākena bījānāṃ kledanena ca
verses.translation: "O princess, that person will be your husband, the person who will molest you in your dream on the twelfth day in the bright half of the month ofVaisakha".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर् अप्य् आह तान् देवाञ् शक्तो यो मे गतो ऽनुजः क्रियमाणे भवत्कार्ये या गतिर् जातवेदसः
verses.transliteration: agnir apy āha tān devāñ śakto yo me gato 'nujaḥ kriyamāṇe bhavatkārye yā gatir jātavedasaḥ
verses.translation: On that day, in the manner mentioned by the goddess a man molested her in the course of her dream. She too loved
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सा वापि स्यान् मम सुरा नोत्सहे कार्यसाधने कार्यं तु सर्वतस् तस्य भवतां जातवेदसः
verses.transliteration: sā vāpi syān mama surā notsahe kāryasādhane kāryaṃ tu sarvatas tasya bhavatāṃ jātavedasaḥ
verses.translation: On that day, in the manner mentioned by the goddess a man molested her in the course of her dream. She too loved
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इमां स्थितिम् अनुप्राप्तो न जाने मे कथं भवेत् इह चामुत्र च व्याप्तौ शक्तिर् अप्य् अत्र नो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: imāṃ sthitim anuprāpto na jāne me kathaṃ bhavet iha cāmutra ca vyāptau śaktir apy atra no bhavet
verses.translation: On that day, in the manner mentioned by the goddess a man molested her in the course of her dream. She too loved
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अथापि क्रियमाणे वै कार्ये सैव गतिर् मम देवास् तम् ऊचुर् भावेन सर्वेण ऋषयस् तथा
verses.transliteration: athāpi kriyamāṇe vai kārye saiva gatir mama devās tam ūcur bhāvena sarveṇa ṛṣayas tathā
verses.translation: On that day, in the manner mentioned by the goddess a man molested her in the course of her dream. She too loved
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आयुः कर्मणि च प्रीतिर् व्याप्तौ शक्तिश् च दीयते प्रयाजान् अनुयाजांश् च दास्यामो हव्यवाहन
verses.transliteration: āyuḥ karmaṇi ca prītir vyāptau śaktiś ca dīyate prayājān anuyājāṃś ca dāsyāmo havyavāhana
verses.translation: On that day, in the manner mentioned by the goddess a man molested her in the course of her dream. She too loved
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवानां त्वं मुखं श्रेष्ठम् आहुत्यः प्रथमास् तव त्वया दत्तं तु यद् द्रव्यं भोक्ष्यामः सुरसत्तम
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ tvaṃ mukhaṃ śreṣṭham āhutyaḥ prathamās tava tvayā dattaṃ tu yad dravyaṃ bhokṣyāmaḥ surasattama
verses.translation: On that day, in the manner mentioned by the goddess a man molested her in the course of her dream. She too loved
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तुष्टो ऽभवद् वह्निर् देववाक्याद् यथाक्रमम् इह चामुत्र च व्याप्तौ हव्ये वा लौकिके तथा
verses.transliteration: tatas tuṣṭo 'bhavad vahnir devavākyād yathākramam iha cāmutra ca vyāptau havye vā laukike tathā
verses.translation: On that day, in the manner mentioned by the goddess a man molested her in the course of her dream. She too loved
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र वह्निर् अभयः समर्थो ऽभूत् सुराज्ञया जातवेदा बृहद्भानुः सप्तार्चिर् नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: sarvatra vahnir abhayaḥ samartho 'bhūt surājñayā jātavedā bṛhadbhānuḥ saptārcir nīlalohitaḥ
verses.translation: On that day, in the manner mentioned by the goddess a man molested her in the course of her dream. She too loved
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जलगर्भः शमीगर्भो यज्ञगर्भः स उच्यते जलाद् आकृष्य विबुधा अभिषिच्य विभावसुम्
verses.transliteration: jalagarbhaḥ śamīgarbho yajñagarbhaḥ sa ucyate jalād ākṛṣya vibudhā abhiṣicya vibhāvasum
verses.translation: On that day, in the manner mentioned by the goddess a man molested her in the course of her dream. She too loved
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उभयत्र पदे वासः सर्वगो ऽग्निस् ततो ऽभवत् यथागतं सुरा जग्मुर् वह्नितीर्थं तद् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: ubhayatra pade vāsaḥ sarvago 'gnis tato 'bhavat yathāgataṃ surā jagmur vahnitīrthaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: On that day, in the manner mentioned by the goddess a man molested her in the course of her dream. She too loved
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सप्त शतान्य् आसंस् तीर्थानि गुणवन्ति च तेषु स्नानं च दानं च यः करोति जितात्मवान्
verses.transliteration: tatra sapta śatāny āsaṃs tīrthāni guṇavanti ca teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca yaḥ karoti jitātmavān
verses.translation: On that day, in the manner mentioned by the goddess a man molested her in the course of her dream. She too loved
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधफलं साग्रं प्राप्नोत्य् अविकलं शुभम् देवतीर्थं च तत्रैव आग्नेयं जातवेदसम्
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhaphalaṃ sāgraṃ prāpnoty avikalaṃ śubham devatīrthaṃ ca tatraiva āgneyaṃ jātavedasam
verses.translation: On that day, in the manner mentioned by the goddess a man molested her in the course of her dream. She too loved
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्निप्रतिष्ठितं लिङ्गं तत्रास्ते ऽनेकवर्णवत् तद्देवदर्शनाद् एव सर्वक्रतुफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: agnipratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgaṃ tatrāste 'nekavarṇavat taddevadarśanād eva sarvakratuphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: On that day, in the manner mentioned by the goddess a man molested her in the course of her dream. She too loved
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋणप्रमोचनं नाम तीर्थं वेदविदो विदुः तस्य स्वरूपं वक्ष्यामि शृणु नारद तन्मनाः
verses.transliteration: ṛṇapramocanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ vedavido viduḥ tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada tanmanāḥ
verses.translation: Joyously he bowed down to Sarabhu and returned to his mansion. On seeing breakage in his flagstaff he was very muc delighted.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आसीत् पृथुश्रवा नाम प्रियः कक्षीवतः सुतः न दारसंग्रहं लेभे वैराग्यान् नाग्निपूजनम्
verses.transliteration: āsīt pṛthuśravā nāma priyaḥ kakṣīvataḥ sutaḥ na dārasaṃgrahaṃ lebhe vairāgyān nāgnipūjanam
verses.translation: Aniruddha the destroyer of heroic enemies seized a great
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कनीयांस् तु समर्थो ऽपि परिवित्तिभयान् मुने नाकरोद् दारकर्मादि नैवाग्नीनाम् उपासनम्
verses.transliteration: kanīyāṃs tu samartho 'pi parivittibhayān mune nākarod dārakarmādi naivāgnīnām upāsanam
verses.translation: Lord Krsna said thus to Mahesvara Jvara—"Those who remember our fight between us shall be free from fever. After saying this lord Krsna went away. Then the lord defeated and destroyed the five fires. Visnu playfully smashed the army of Asuras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रोचुः पितृगणाः पुत्रं कक्षीवतः शुभम् ज्येष्ठं चैव कनिष्ठं च पृथक् पृथग् इदं वचः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ procuḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ putraṃ kakṣīvataḥ śubham jyeṣṭhaṃ caiva kaniṣṭhaṃ ca pṛthak pṛthag idaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: Then the son of Bali, Sankara and Karttikeya assisted by the entire army of asuras fought with Krsna.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋणत्रयापनोदाय क्रियतां दारसंग्रहः
verses.transliteration: ṛṇatrayāpanodāya kriyatāṃ dārasaṃgrahaḥ
verses.translation: The battle raged furiously. Then Devas thought:— "Certainly the dissolution of the universe has arrived". Krsna made Sankara burst open Jrmbhana missile. Thereby the Pramathas and Daityas perished all round.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नेत्य् उवाच ततो ज्येष्ठः किम् ऋणं केन युज्यते कनीयांस् तु पितॄन् प्राह न योग्यो दारसंग्रहः
verses.transliteration: nety uvāca tato jyeṣṭhaḥ kim ṛṇaṃ kena yujyate kanīyāṃs tu pitṝn prāha na yogyo dārasaṃgrahaḥ
verses.translation: Balarama of great prowess hit the army of Bana by means of many arrows. Pradyumna did not go astray from virtue. He abided by the rules of war as laid down m the
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठे सति महाप्राज्ञः परिवित्तिभयाद् इति ताव् उभौ पुनर् अप्य् एवम् ऊचुस् ते वै पितामहाः
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhe sati mahāprājñaḥ parivittibhayād iti tāv ubhau punar apy evam ūcus te vai pitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: Bana saw his army crushed and suppressed.by Bala by means of his iron club after being dragged by the tip of his Then, O brahmins, Bana and Krsna were eager to conquer each other. They hurled missiles and iron clubs at each other.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: याताम् उभौ गौतमीं तु पुण्यां कक्षीवतः सुतौ कुरुतां गौतमीस्नानं सर्वाभीष्टप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: yātām ubhau gautamīṃ tu puṇyāṃ kakṣīvataḥ sutau kurutāṃ gautamīsnānaṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakam
verses.translation: On seeing her in front Kr?na closed his eyes and discharged Sudarsana against Bana in order to cut off the thousand arms of his enemy.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छतां गौतमीं गङ्गां लोकत्रितयपावनीम् स्नानं च तर्पणं तस्यां कुरुतां श्रद्धयान्वितौ
verses.transliteration: gacchatāṃ gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ lokatritayapāvanīm snānaṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ tasyāṃ kurutāṃ śraddhayānvitau
verses.translation: O Krsna, O Krsna, O lord of the universe, I know (hat you are Purusottama the great lord, the great Atman the greatest being without beginning or without end. Be pleased, O lord, fearlessness (freedom from fear) has been offered to Bana by me. The words uttered by me should not be falsified by you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टावनामिता ध्याता गौतमी सर्वकामदा न देशकालजात्यादिनियमो ऽत्रावगाहने ज्येष्ठो ऽनृणस् ततो भूयात् परिवित्तिर् न चेतरः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭāvanāmitā dhyātā gautamī sarvakāmadā na deśakālajātyādiniyamo 'trāvagāhane jyeṣṭho 'nṛṇas tato bhūyāt parivittir na cetaraḥ
verses.translation: He has grown old in serving me and having my support. O unchanging one, it is not your fault. (?) Boons have been granted to this Daitya by me. Hence, I request fo. your forbearance.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः पृथुश्रवा ज्येष्ठः कृत्वा स्नानं सतर्पणम् त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानां काक्षीवतो ऽनृणो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pṛthuśravā jyeṣṭhaḥ kṛtvā snānaṃ satarpaṇam trayāṇām api lokānāṃ kākṣīvato 'nṛṇo 'bhavat
verses.translation: Thus requested, Krsna became delighted as evidenced by his bright face. His anger towards the Asura disappeared. He spoke to the Trident-bearing lord of Uma. O Sankara, may Bana live (since) he has been grant¬ ed boons by you. The discus has been withdrawn by me out of ' deference for your words.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थम् ऋणमोचनम् उच्यते श्रौतस्मार्त-ऋणेभ्यश् च इतरेभ्यश् च नारद तत्र स्नानेन दानेन ऋणी मुक्तः सुखी भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham ṛṇamocanam ucyate śrautasmārta-ṛṇebhyaś ca itarebhyaś ca nārada tatra snānena dānena ṛṇī muktaḥ sukhī bhavet
verses.translation: After saying this Krsna went to that place where the son of Pradyumna had been imprisoned. When dried up by the winds of Garuda the serpents that fettered him perished.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्णासंगमं नाम काद्रवासंगमं तथा महेश्वरो यत्र देवो गङ्गापुलिनम् आश्रितः
verses.transliteration: suparṇāsaṃgamaṃ nāma kādravāsaṃgamaṃ tathā maheśvaro yatra devo gaṅgāpulinam āśritaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, even as I narrate, let this be listened to with great attention how Varanasi was burned by Krsna during his incarnation as a human being.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्निकुण्डं च तत्रैव रौद्रं वैष्णवम् एव च सौरं सौम्यं तथा ब्राह्मं कौमारं वारुणं तथा
verses.transliteration: agnikuṇḍaṃ ca tatraiva raudraṃ vaiṣṇavam eva ca sauraṃ saumyaṃ tathā brāhmaṃ kaumāraṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: (Defective) Paundraka, king of Varanasi was told by the people deluded by ignorance—"Vasudeva has taken in¬ carnation on the Earth. You are that incarnation."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरा च नदी यत्र संगता गङ्गया तथा तत्तीर्थस्मरणाद् एव कृतकृत्यो भवेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: apsarā ca nadī yatra saṃgatā gaṅgayā tathā tattīrthasmaraṇād eva kṛtakṛtyo bhaven naraḥ
verses.translation: When the messenger who had been instructed thus,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापप्रशमनं शृणु यत्नेन नारद इन्द्रेण हिंसिताः पूर्वं वालखिल्या महर्षयः दत्तार्धतपसः सर्वे प्रोचुस् ते काश्यपं मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ śṛṇu yatnena nārada indreṇa hiṃsitāḥ pūrvaṃ vālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ dattārdhatapasaḥ sarve procus te kāśyapaṃ munim
verses.translation: On hearing about the endeavour of Krsna and that of his (Paundraka's), the lord of Kasi came as his supporting ally, with all his armies surrounding him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रम् उत्पादयानेन इन्द्रदर्पहरं शुभम् तपसो ऽर्धं तु दास्यामस् तथेत्य् आह मुनिस् तु तान्
verses.transliteration: putram utpādayānena indradarpaharaṃ śubham tapaso 'rdhaṃ tu dāsyāmas tathety āha munis tu tān
verses.translation: With a great army (of his own) and that of the king of Kasi, Paundraka Vasudeva marched against Krsna.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्णायां ततो गर्भम् आदधे स प्रजापतिः कद्र्वां चैव शनैर् ब्रह्मन् सर्पाणां सर्पमातरि
verses.transliteration: suparṇāyāṃ tato garbham ādadhe sa prajāpatiḥ kadrvāṃ caiva śanair brahman sarpāṇāṃ sarpamātari
verses.translation: Instantaneously he slew the army by means of arrows discharged from his bow and blazing like fires, and by means of hits and blows with the iron clubs and discus.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ते गर्भिण्याव् उभे आह गन्तुकामः प्रजापतिः अपराधो न च क्वापि कार्यो गमनम् एव च
verses.transliteration: te garbhiṇyāv ubhe āha gantukāmaḥ prajāpatiḥ aparādho na ca kvāpi kāryo gamanam eva ca
verses.translation: After destroying the army of the king of Kasi also, Krsna spoke to Paundraka who was deluded and who bore his own characteristic marks.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्यत्र गमनाच् छापो भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: anyatra gamanāc chāpo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O Paundraka, through the messenger you had told me <f Leave the symbols." I shall now accomplish it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा स ययौ पत्न्यौ गते भर्तरि ते उभे तदैव जग्मतुः सत्त्रम् ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā sa yayau patnyau gate bhartari te ubhe tadaiva jagmatuḥ sattram ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām
verses.translation: After saying this, he discharged his discus by which Paundraka was torn asunder. He was then threshed with his iron club. Garuda of Paundraka was smashed by his own Garuda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मवृन्दसमाकीर्णं गङ्गातीरसमाश्रितम् उन्मत्ते ते उभे नित्यं वयःसंपत्तिगर्विते
verses.transliteration: brahmavṛndasamākīrṇaṃ gaṅgātīrasamāśritam unmatte te ubhe nityaṃ vayaḥsaṃpattigarvite
verses.translation: On seeing the head of the king of Kasi fallen in his city the wonder-struck people said—'"What is this? By whom is this heinous crime committed?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निवार्यमाणे बहुशो मुनिभिस् तत्त्वदर्शिभिः विकुर्वत्यौ तत्र सत्त्रे समानि च हवींषि च
verses.transliteration: nivāryamāṇe bahuśo munibhis tattvadarśibhiḥ vikurvatyau tatra sattre samāni ca havīṃṣi ca
verses.translation: He chose thus—"O lord, O Mahcsvara, by your favour, may a Krtya (female deity of destruction) rise up for destroying Krsna who slew my lather."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: योषितां दुर्विलसितं कः संवरितुम् ईश्वरः ते दृष्ट्वा चुक्षुभुर् विप्रा अपमार्गरते उभे
verses.transliteration: yoṣitāṃ durvilasitaṃ kaḥ saṃvaritum īśvaraḥ te dṛṣṭvā cukṣubhur viprā apamārgarate ubhe
verses.translation: It had an awful face blazing terrible with flames of fire. The tresses were dishevelled and blazing. Angrily shouting 'Krsna Krsna' it went to Dvaravatl.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अपमार्गस्थिते यस्माद् आपगे हि भविष्यथः सुपर्णा चैव कद्रूश् च नद्यौ ते संबभूवतुः
verses.transliteration: apamārgasthite yasmād āpage hi bhaviṣyathaḥ suparṇā caiva kadrūś ca nadyau te saṃbabhūvatuḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the terrible Krtya with hideous eyes, the people of Dvaraka sought refuge in Sri Krsna who is worthy of being the refuge to the worlds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स कदाचिद् गृहं प्रायात् कश्यपो ऽथ प्रजापतिः ऋषिभ्यस् तत्र वृत्तान्तं शापं ताभ्यां सविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: sa kadācid gṛhaṃ prāyāt kaśyapo 'tha prajāpatiḥ ṛṣibhyas tatra vṛttāntaṃ śāpaṃ tābhyāṃ savistaram
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु विस्मयाविष्टः किं करोमीत्य् अचिन्तयत् ऋषिभ्यः कथयाम् आस वालखिल्या इति श्रुताः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu vismayāviṣṭaḥ kiṃ karomīty acintayat ṛṣibhyaḥ kathayām āsa vālakhilyā iti śrutāḥ
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त ऊचुः कश्यपं विप्रं गत्वा गङ्गां तु गौतमीम् तत्र स्तुहि महेशानं पुनर् भार्ये भविष्यतः
verses.transliteration: ta ūcuḥ kaśyapaṃ vipraṃ gatvā gaṅgāṃ tu gautamīm tatra stuhi maheśānaṃ punar bhārye bhaviṣyataḥ
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्याभयाद् एव यत्र देवो महेश्वरः गङ्गामध्ये सदा ह्य् आस्ते मध्यमेश्वरसंज्ञया
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyābhayād eva yatra devo maheśvaraḥ gaṅgāmadhye sadā hy āste madhyameśvarasaṃjñayā
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा कश्यपो ऽपि स्नात्वा गङ्गां जितव्रतः तुष्टाव स्तवनैः पुण्यैर् देवदेवं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā kaśyapo 'pi snātvā gaṅgāṃ jitavrataḥ tuṣṭāva stavanaiḥ puṇyair devadevaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लोकत्रयैकाधिपतेर् न यस्य कुत्रापि वस्तुन्य् अभिमानलेशः स सिद्धनाथो ऽखिलविश्वकर्ता भर्ता शिवाया भवतु प्रसन्नः
verses.transliteration: lokatrayaikādhipater na yasya kutrāpi vastuny abhimānaleśaḥ sa siddhanātho 'khilaviśvakartā bhartā śivāyā bhavatu prasannaḥ
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तापत्रयोष्णद्युतितापितानाम् इतस् ततो वै परिधावतां च शरीरिणां स्थावरजङ्गमानां त्वम् एव दुःखव्यपनोददक्षः
verses.transliteration: tāpatrayoṣṇadyutitāpitānām itas tato vai paridhāvatāṃ ca śarīriṇāṃ sthāvarajaṅgamānāṃ tvam eva duḥkhavyapanodadakṣaḥ
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वादियोगस् त्रिविधो ऽपि यस्य शक्रादिभिर् वक्तुम् अशक्य एव विचित्रवृत्तिं परिचिन्त्य सोमं सुखी सदा दानपरो वरेण्यः
verses.transliteration: sattvādiyogas trividho 'pi yasya śakrādibhir vaktum aśakya eva vicitravṛttiṃ paricintya somaṃ sukhī sadā dānaparo vareṇyaḥ
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्यादिस्तुतिभिर् देवः स्तुतो गौरीपतिः शिवः प्रसन्नो ह्य् अददाच् छंभुः कश्यपाय वरान् बहून्
verses.transliteration: ityādistutibhir devaḥ stuto gaurīpatiḥ śivaḥ prasanno hy adadāc chaṃbhuḥ kaśyapāya varān bahūn
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भार्यार्थिनं तु तं प्राह स्यातां भार्ये उभे तु ते नदीस्वरूपे पत्न्यौ ये गङ्गां प्राप्य सरिद्वराम्
verses.transliteration: bhāryārthinaṃ tu taṃ prāha syātāṃ bhārye ubhe tu te nadīsvarūpe patnyau ye gaṅgāṃ prāpya saridvarām
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्संगमनमात्रेण ताभ्यां भूयात् स्वकं वपुः ते गर्भिण्यौ पुनर् जाते गङ्गायाश् च प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: tatsaṃgamanamātreṇa tābhyāṃ bhūyāt svakaṃ vapuḥ te garbhiṇyau punar jāte gaṅgāyāś ca prasādataḥ
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रजापतिः प्रीतो भार्ये प्राप्य महामनाः आह्वयाम् आस तान् विप्रान् गौतमीतीरम् आश्रितान्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prajāpatiḥ prīto bhārye prāpya mahāmanāḥ āhvayām āsa tān viprān gautamītīram āśritān
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सीमन्तोन्नयनं चक्रे ताभ्यां प्रीतः प्रजापतिः ब्राह्मणान् पूजयाम् आस विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: sīmantonnayanaṃ cakre tābhyāṃ prītaḥ prajāpatiḥ brāhmaṇān pūjayām āsa vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भुक्तवत्स्व् अथ विप्रेषु कश्यपस्याथ मन्दिरे भर्तृसमीपोपविष्टा कद्रूर् विप्रान् निरीक्ष्य च
verses.transliteration: bhuktavatsv atha vipreṣu kaśyapasyātha mandire bhartṛsamīpopaviṣṭā kadrūr viprān nirīkṣya ca
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः कद्रूर् ऋषीन् अक्ष्णा प्राहसत् ते च चुक्षुभुः येनाक्ष्णा हसिता पापे भज्यतां ते ऽक्षि पापवत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kadrūr ṛṣīn akṣṇā prāhasat te ca cukṣubhuḥ yenākṣṇā hasitā pāpe bhajyatāṃ te 'kṣi pāpavat
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: काणाभवत् ततः कद्रूः सर्पमातेति योच्यते ततः प्रसादयाम् आस कश्यपो भगवान् ऋषीन्
verses.transliteration: kāṇābhavat tataḥ kadrūḥ sarpamāteti yocyate tataḥ prasādayām āsa kaśyapo bhagavān ṛṣīn
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नास् ते प्रोचुर् गौतमी सरितां वरा अपराधसहस्रेभ्यो रक्षिष्यति च सेवनात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasannās te procur gautamī saritāṃ varā aparādhasahasrebhyo rakṣiṣyati ca sevanāt
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भार्यान्वितस् तथा चक्रे कश्यपो मुनिसत्तमः ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थम् उभयोः संगमं विदुः सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: bhāryānvitas tathā cakre kaśyapo munisattamaḥ tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham ubhayoḥ saṃgamaṃ viduḥ sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvakratuphalapradam
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरूरवसम् आख्यातं तीर्थं वेदविदो विदुः स्मरणाद् एव पापानां नाशनं किं तु दर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: purūravasam ākhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ vedavido viduḥ smaraṇād eva pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ kiṃ tu darśanāt
verses.translation: O sage, we wish to hear again about the exploits of the intelligent Balarama. It behoves you to recount his heroism unto us.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरूरवा ब्रह्मसदः प्राप्य तत्र सरस्वतीम् यदृच्छया देवनदीं हसन्तीं ब्रह्मणो ऽन्तिके तां दृष्ट्वा रूपसंपन्नाम् उर्वशीं प्राह भूपतिः
verses.transliteration: purūravā brahmasadaḥ prāpya tatra sarasvatīm yadṛcchayā devanadīṃ hasantīṃ brahmaṇo 'ntike tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpasaṃpannām urvaśīṃ prāha bhūpatiḥ
verses.translation: His exploits, such as dragging Yamuna have already been heard by us here. Hence, O blessed one, kindly recount anything else which Bala performed.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: केयं रूपवती साध्वी स्थितेयं ब्रह्मणो ऽन्तिके सर्वासाम् उत्तमा योषिद् दीपयन्ती सभाम् इमाम्
verses.transliteration: keyaṃ rūpavatī sādhvī sthiteyaṃ brahmaṇo 'ntike sarvāsām uttamā yoṣid dīpayantī sabhām imām
verses.translation: O sages, listen to the activities carried out by Rama the infinite one, the unmeasurable one, the incarnation ofSesa, the holder of the Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उर्वशी प्राह राजानम् इयं देवनदी शुभा सरस्वती ब्रह्मसुता नित्यम् एति च याति च तच् छ्रुत्वा विस्मितो राजा आनयेमां ममान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: urvaśī prāha rājānam iyaṃ devanadī śubhā sarasvatī brahmasutā nityam eti ca yāti ca tac chrutvā vismito rājā ānayemāṃ mamāntikam
verses.translation: Samba the heroic son of Jambavatl forcefully abducted Duryodhana's daughter whose Svayamvara was awaited.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उर्वशी पुनर् अप्य् आह राजानं भूरिदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: urvaśī punar apy āha rājānaṃ bhūridakṣiṇam
verses.translation: Then the infuriated Karna, Duryodhana and others including Bhlsma and Drona of great prowess bound him after conquering him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आनीयते महाराज तस्याः सर्वं निवेद्य च
verses.transliteration: ānīyate mahārāja tasyāḥ sarvaṃ nivedya ca
verses.translation: On hearing about it, O sages, the Yadavas became
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तां प्राहिणोत् तत्र राजा प्रीत्या तदोर्वशीम् सा गत्वा राजवचनं न्यवेदयद् अथोर्वशी
verses.transliteration: tatas tāṃ prāhiṇot tatra rājā prītyā tadorvaśīm sā gatvā rājavacanaṃ nyavedayad athorvaśī
verses.translation: Bala stopped them and spoke to them although his words were indistinct through inebriation:—
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वत्य् अपि तन् मेने उर्वश्या यन् निवेदितम् सा तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय प्रायाद् यत्र पुरूरवाः
verses.transliteration: sarasvaty api tan mene urvaśyā yan niveditam sā tatheti pratijñāya prāyād yatra purūravāḥ
verses.translation: Then Balarama went to Hastinapura. He camped in the middle of a park at the outskirts of the city. He did not enter it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वत्यास् ततस् तीरे स रेमे बहुलाः समाः सरस्वान् अभवत् पुत्रो यस्य पुत्रो बृहद्रथः
verses.transliteration: sarasvatyās tatas tīre sa reme bahulāḥ samāḥ sarasvān abhavat putro yasya putro bṛhadrathaḥ
verses.translation: On coming to know that Balarama had arrived, Duryodhana and others brought unto him by way of presents, greetings, along with Arghya and water for drinking.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तां गच्छन्तीं नृपगृहं नित्यम् एव सरस्वतीम् सरस्वन्तं ततो लक्ष्म ज्ञात्वान्येषु तथा कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ gacchantīṃ nṛpagṛhaṃ nityam eva sarasvatīm sarasvantaṃ tato lakṣma jñātvānyeṣu tathā kṛtam
verses.translation: After duly accepting those things he said to the Kauravas—"It is Ugrasena's order—Release Samba quickly".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यै ददाव् अहं शापं भूया इति महानदी मच्छापभीता वागीशा प्रागाद् देवीं च गौतमीम्
verses.transliteration: tasyai dadāv ahaṃ śāpaṃ bhūyā iti mahānadī macchāpabhītā vāgīśā prāgād devīṃ ca gautamīm
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on hearing his words, Bhlsma, Drona, Karna, Duryodhana and others became angry.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कमण्डलुभवां पूतां मातरं लोकपावनीम् तापत्रयोपशमनीम् ऐहिकामुष्मिकप्रदाम्
verses.transliteration: kamaṇḍalubhavāṃ pūtāṃ mātaraṃ lokapāvanīm tāpatrayopaśamanīm aihikāmuṣmikapradām
verses.translation: Bahllka and all other kings too, were angry on seeing Balarama who had the threshing rod for his weapon and realizing that the race of Yadu did not deserve a kingdom, they said:—
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सा गत्वा गौतमीं देवीं प्राह मच्छापम् आदितः गङ्गापि माम् उवाचेदं विशापां कर्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: sā gatvā gautamīṃ devīṃ prāha macchāpam āditaḥ gaṅgāpi mām uvācedaṃ viśāpāṃ kartum arhasi
verses.translation: If even Ugrasena can pass orders on Kauravas, enough of the white umbrellas and ornaments befitting kings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न युक्तं यत् सरस्वत्याः शापं त्वं दत्तवान् असि स्त्रीणाम् एष स्वभावो वै पुंस्कामा योषितो यतः
verses.transliteration: na yuktaṃ yat sarasvatyāḥ śāpaṃ tvaṃ dattavān asi strīṇām eṣa svabhāvo vai puṃskāmā yoṣito yataḥ
verses.translation: Hence, go back, O Balarama. Neither at your bidding will we release Samba whose activities are unjust.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावचपला ब्रह्मन् योषितः सकला अपि त्वं कथं तु न जानीषे जगत्स्रष्टाम्बुजासन
verses.transliteration: svabhāvacapalā brahman yoṣitaḥ sakalā api tvaṃ kathaṃ tu na jānīṣe jagatsraṣṭāmbujāsana
verses.translation: Formerly, Kukuras and Andhakas used to bow unto us, for we are worthy of that honour. Now-a-days that usual obeisance is not made. What is this commanding attitude of a servant towards a master?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विडम्बयति कं वा न कामो वापि स्वभावतः ततो विशापम् अवदं दृश्यापि स्यात् सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: viḍambayati kaṃ vā na kāmo vāpi svabhāvataḥ tato viśāpam avadaṃ dṛśyāpi syāt sarasvatī
verses.translation: After saying this the Kauravas remained adamant. They did not release Krsna's son. After making this unanimous decision they entered Hastinapura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच् छापान् नदी मर्त्ये दृश्यादृश्या सरस्वती यत्रैषा संगता देवी गङ्गायां शापविह्वला
verses.transliteration: tasmāc chāpān nadī martye dṛśyādṛśyā sarasvatī yatraiṣā saṃgatā devī gaṅgāyāṃ śāpavihvalā
verses.translation: Maddened by the anger originating from the insult, Balarama lifted up his rugged ploughshare and rolled it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र प्रायान् नृपवरो धार्मिकः स पुरूरवाः तपस् तप्त्वा समाराध्य देवं सिद्धेश्वरं हरम्
verses.transliteration: tatra prāyān nṛpavaro dhārmikaḥ sa purūravāḥ tapas taptvā samārādhya devaṃ siddheśvaraṃ haram
verses.translation: Alas, the insignificant wicked haughty Kauravas wish to rule over us. It is brought abput by adverse time.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान् कामान् अथावाप गङ्गायाश् च प्रसादतः ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं पुरूरवसम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: sarvān kāmān athāvāpa gaṅgāyāś ca prasādataḥ tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ purūravasam ucyate
verses.translation: The womenfolk of the servants of Ugrasena wear bun¬ ches of flower, of Parijata tree, still he is not a king for these people.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वतीसंगमं च ब्रह्मतीर्थं तद् उच्यते सिद्धेश्वरो यत्र देवः सर्वकामप्रदं तु तत्
verses.transliteration: sarasvatīsaṃgamaṃ ca brahmatīrthaṃ tad ucyate siddheśvaro yatra devaḥ sarvakāmapradaṃ tu tat
verses.translation: Let Ugrasena, the lord of kings stay by. I shall go to that city after making the Earth devoid of Kauravas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सावित्री चैव गायत्री श्रद्धा मेधा सरस्वती एतानि पञ्च तीर्थानि पुण्यानि मुनयो विदुः
verses.transliteration: sāvitrī caiva gāyatrī śraddhā medhā sarasvatī etāni pañca tīrthāni puṇyāni munayo viduḥ
verses.translation: O holy sage, explain the number of Parardha as it has been mentioned before, and by doubling which the natural re¬ absorption has to be realized. Fifteen Kalas make a Nadika. In the calculation of time by means of the measurement of water it is equivalent to half of thirteen Palas (6£ Palas of water trickling down through a hole may take a Nadika of time i.e. 24 minutes to flow out completely).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा तु पीत्वा तु मुच्यते सर्वकल्मषात् सावित्री चैव गायत्री श्रद्धा मेधा सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā tu pītvā tu mucyate sarvakalmaṣāt sāvitrī caiva gāyatrī śraddhā medhā sarasvatī
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, two Nadikas make one Muhurta (48 minutes). A day of twentyfour hours consists of thirty Muhurtas and thirty days make a month. Twelve months make a year and this constitutes a peiiod of a day and a night in the heaven. Three hundred and sixty human years make one divine year.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एता मम सुता ज्येष्ठा धर्मसंस्थानहेतवः सर्वासाम् उत्तमां कांचिन् निर्ममे लोकसुन्दरीम्
verses.transliteration: etā mama sutā jyeṣṭhā dharmasaṃsthānahetavaḥ sarvāsām uttamāṃ kāṃcin nirmame lokasundarīm
verses.translation: Twelve thousand divine years make a set of four Yugas. A thousand sets of four Yugas are considered to be one day of Brahma. Then, O excellent sages, almost all of those earthly
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा विकृता बुद्धिर् ममासीन् मुनिसत्तम गृह्यमाणा मया बाला सा मां दृष्ट्वा पलायिता
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtā buddhir mamāsīn munisattama gṛhyamāṇā mayā bālā sā māṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyitā
verses.translation: Then the imperishable lord Krsna assumes the form of Rudra and endeavours to keep the subjects within himself for the purpose of annihilation. After drinking up the water present in the elements and living beings, O brahmins, he makes the entire surface of the Earth dried up and withered.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृगीभूता तु सा बाला मृगो ऽहम् अभवं तदा मृगव्याधो ऽभवच् छंभुर् धर्मसंरक्षणाय च
verses.transliteration: mṛgībhūtā tu sā bālā mṛgo 'ham abhavaṃ tadā mṛgavyādho 'bhavac chaṃbhur dharmasaṃrakṣaṇāya ca
verses.translation: He dries up oceans, rivers, mountains and mountain springs. He sucks up the water that is present in the nether worlds too. As every particle of water vanishes there will be seven suns, each of a thousand rays and they become increased in size due to their watery diet.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ता मद्भीताः पञ्च सुता गङ्गाम् ईयुर् महानदीम् ततो महेश्वरः प्रायाद् धर्मसंरक्षणाय सः
verses.transliteration: tā madbhītāḥ pañca sutā gaṅgām īyur mahānadīm tato maheśvaraḥ prāyād dharmasaṃrakṣaṇāya saḥ
verses.translation: Blazing from beneath and above, O brahmins, those seven suns burn up the three worlds along with the nether worlds. On being burnt by those blazing suns, the three worlds, along with the extensive area of mountains, trees and oceans, become devoid of viscidity.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धनुर् गृहीत्वा सशरम् ईशो ऽपि मृगरूपिणम् माम् उवाच वधिष्ये त्वां मृगव्याधस् तदा हरः
verses.transliteration: dhanur gṛhītvā saśaram īśo 'pi mṛgarūpiṇam mām uvāca vadhiṣye tvāṃ mṛgavyādhas tadā haraḥ
verses.translation: Then the entire area of the three worlds, O brahmins, has all the trees and watery parts dried up. The Earth attains the shape of the back of a tortoise. Thereafter lord Hara, the annihilator of all created be¬ ings, terrible like black fire, burns the nether worlds from below by means of the hot breath of the serpent Sesa.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्कर्मणो निवृत्तो ऽहं प्रादां कन्यां विवस्वते सावित्र्याद्याः पञ्च सुता नदीरूपेण संगताः
verses.transliteration: tatkarmaṇo nivṛtto 'haṃ prādāṃ kanyāṃ vivasvate sāvitryādyāḥ pañca sutā nadīrūpeṇa saṃgatāḥ
verses.translation: From there also people proceed ahead to Janaloka on being scorched by the great sunshine ten times more power¬ ful. They are desirous of a supreme abode. After burning the entire universe, O excellent sages, the lord in the guise of Rudra, produces clouds by means* of breath expelled from his mouth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ता आगताः पुनश् चापि स्वर्गं लोकं ममान्तिकम् यत्र ताः संगता देव्या पञ्च तीर्थानि नारद
verses.transliteration: tā āgatāḥ punaś cāpi svargaṃ lokaṃ mamāntikam yatra tāḥ saṃgatā devyā pañca tīrthāni nārada
verses.translation: Thereafter, rise up in the sky the Samvartaka clouds Some of these clouds are like a collyrium mountain; some are like the elephant Kumuda. Some are smoky in colour! Some are yellow.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संगतानि च पुण्यानि पञ्च नद्यः सरस्वती तेषु स्नानं तथा दानं यत् किंचित् कुरुते नरः
verses.transliteration: saṃgatāni ca puṇyāni pañca nadyaḥ sarasvatī teṣu snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ yat kiṃcit kurute naraḥ
verses.translation: Some are turmeric; some resemble the exudation of lac juice; some appear like lapis lazuli; and some are like sapphire. Some resemble a conch shell and others the turner's lathe; some are like Jati flower (white jasmine) and some are like Kunda. Some are scarlet coloured like the tiny insect Indragopa (glow-worm) and some are like Manahs'ita (?)
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामप्रदं तत् स्यान् नैष्कर्म्यान् मुक्तिदं स्मृतम् तत्राभवन् मृगव्याधं तीर्थं सर्वार्थदं नृणाम् स्वर्गमोक्षफलं चान्यद् ब्रह्मतीर्थफलं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmapradaṃ tat syān naiṣkarmyān muktidaṃ smṛtam tatrābhavan mṛgavyādhaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvārthadaṃ nṛṇām svargamokṣaphalaṃ cānyad brahmatīrthaphalaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: Some of the terrible clouds rise up like the petals of a Others resemble the apartments on the tops of houses; some are like the dry tracts of ground. They are huge in body and loud In their sound; they cover the sky completely.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शमीतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वपापोपशान्तिदम् तस्याख्यानं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु यत्नेन नारद
verses.transliteration: śamītīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvapāpopaśāntidam tasyākhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu yatnena nārada
verses.translation: How did Krsna exterminate his family under the pre¬ text of the curse of brahmins? How did he give up his human form? O messenger, I know fully well what you say. But the destruction of Yadavas is only just started by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आसीत् प्रियव्रतो नाम क्षत्रियो जयतां वरः गौतम्या दक्षिणे तीरे दीक्षां चक्रे पुरोधसा
verses.transliteration: āsīt priyavrato nāma kṣatriyo jayatāṃ varaḥ gautamyā dakṣiṇe tīre dīkṣāṃ cakre purodhasā
verses.translation: If they remain uncxlerminated, they will constitute a great burden unto the Earth. Hence I shall hurriedly bring that down within seven nights. In the same manner as it had been taken from the ocean I shall replace Dvaraka in the ocean, exterminate Yada¬ vas and then return to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हयमेध उपक्रान्ते ऋत्विग्भिर् ऋषिभिर् वृते तस्य राज्ञो महाबाहोर् वसिष्ठस् तु पुरोहितः
verses.transliteration: hayamedha upakrānte ṛtvigbhir ṛṣibhir vṛte tasya rājño mahābāhor vasiṣṭhas tu purohitaḥ
verses.translation: I shall cast off my human body too, assisted by Sam- karsana. It should be considered by the leader of Devas that I have come there. Thus informed by Vasudcva O sages, the divine messenger bowed to him and went to heaven near the king of Devas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद्यज्ञवाटम् अगमद् दानवो ऽथ हिरण्यकः तं दानवम् अभिप्रेक्ष्य देवास् त्व् इन्द्रपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: tadyajñavāṭam agamad dānavo 'tha hiraṇyakaḥ taṃ dānavam abhiprekṣya devās tv indrapurogamāḥ
verses.translation: Day and night the lord witnessed evil omens in hea¬ ven, on Earth and in the sky as well, indicating the destruction of Dvaraka. On seeing them he said to Yadavas—"See the extre¬ mely terrible evil omens. In order to subdue these, we shall go to Prabhasa. Do not delay".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भीताः केचिद् दिवं जग्मुर् हव्यवाट् शमिम् आविशत् अश्वत्थं विष्णुर् अगमद् भानुर् अर्कं वटं शिवः
verses.transliteration: bhītāḥ kecid divaṃ jagmur havyavāṭ śamim āviśat aśvatthaṃ viṣṇur agamad bhānur arkaṃ vaṭaṃ śivaḥ
verses.translation: After finishing this family I shall go to Heaven. T e sea will engulf Dvaraka in its flood when it has been abandon¬ ed by me. Thus advised and urged by Krsna, Uddhava bowed to liim and went to the abode of Nara and Narayana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमः पलाशम् अगमद् गङ्गाम्भो हव्यवाहनः अश्विनौ तु हयं गृह्य वायसो ऽभूद् यमः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: somaḥ palāśam agamad gaṅgāmbho havyavāhanaḥ aśvinau tu hayaṃ gṛhya vāyaso 'bhūd yamaḥ svayam
verses.translation: Then Yadavas, O brahmins, got into fast moving chariots and went to Prabhasa alongwith Krsna, Balarama and
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तत्र वसिष्ठो भगवान् ऋषिः यष्टिम् आदाय दैतेयान् न्यवारयद् अथाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: etasminn antare tatra vasiṣṭho bhagavān ṛṣiḥ yaṣṭim ādāya daiteyān nyavārayad athājñayā
verses.translation: Krsna restrained them. They thought that he was one who had come to assist them. They bit and struck one another. The infuriated Krsna seized a fistful of Eraka from them. Thus the iron club became the fistful of iron for their destruction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रवृत्तः पुनर् एव यज्ञो दैत्यो गतः स्वेन बलेन युक्तः इमानि तीर्थानि ततः शुभानि दशाश्वमेधस्य फलानि दद्युः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pravṛttaḥ punar eva yajño daityo gataḥ svena balena yuktaḥ imāni tīrthāni tataḥ śubhāni daśāśvamedhasya phalāni dadyuḥ
verses.translation: As an Assailant he killed all Yadavas. Suddenly they too approached him and hit one another. Others also did like¬ wise.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं तु शमीतीर्थं द्वितीयं वैष्णवं विदुः आर्कं शैवं च सौम्यं च वासिष्ठं सर्वकामदम्
verses.transliteration: prathamaṃ tu śamītīrthaṃ dvitīyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ viduḥ ārkaṃ śaivaṃ ca saumyaṃ ca vāsiṣṭhaṃ sarvakāmadam
verses.translation: Then O excellent brahmins, even as Daruka went on watching, observing, Jaitra, the chariot of the discus-bearing lord was dragged by the horses through the middle of the ocean. The discus Sarnga, quivers, conch and the sword circumambulated him and went away along the solar path.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवाश् च ऋषयः सर्वे निवृत्ते मखविस्तरे तुष्टाः प्रोचुर् वसिष्ठं तं यजमानं प्रियव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: devāś ca ṛṣayaḥ sarve nivṛtte makhavistare tuṣṭāḥ procur vasiṣṭhaṃ taṃ yajamānaṃ priyavratam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, within a moment Yadavas were destroyed except the mighty-armed Krsna and Daruka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तांश् च वृक्षांस् तां च गङ्गां मुदा युक्ताः पुनः पुनः हयमेधस्य निष्पत्त्यै एते याता इतस् ततः
verses.transliteration: tāṃś ca vṛkṣāṃs tāṃ ca gaṅgāṃ mudā yuktāḥ punaḥ punaḥ hayamedhasya niṣpattyai ete yātā itas tataḥ
verses.translation: While taking their rounds both of them saw Balarama seated at the root of a tree. A great serpent was coming out of his mouth. After wriggling out of his mouth that serpent of huge dimension went towards the ocean. It was worshipped by Siddhas as well as Nagas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हयमेधफलं दद्युस् तीर्थानीत्य् अवदन् सुराः तस्मात् स्नानेन दानेन तेषु तीर्थेषु नारद हयमेधफलं पुण्यं प्राप्नोति न मृषा वचः
verses.transliteration: hayamedhaphalaṃ dadyus tīrthānīty avadan surāḥ tasmāt snānena dānena teṣu tīrtheṣu nārada hayamedhaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnoti na mṛṣā vacaḥ
verses.translation: Taking Arghya with him the ocean came face to face with Balarama. Worshipped by the excellent Nagas he entered
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रं हरिश्चन्द्रं शुनःशेपं च रोहितम् वारुणं ब्राह्मम् आग्नेयम् ऐन्द्रम् ऐन्दवम् ऐश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitraṃ hariścandraṃ śunaḥśepaṃ ca rohitam vāruṇaṃ brāhmam āgneyam aindram aindavam aiśvaram
verses.translation: Thus directed, Daruka bowed to and circumambulated Krsna and went away as instructed.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मैत्रं च वैष्णवं चैव याम्यम् आश्विनम् औशनम् एतेषां पुण्यतीर्थानां नामधेयं शृणुष्व मे
verses.transliteration: maitraṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ caiva yāmyam āśvinam auśanam eteṣāṃ puṇyatīrthānāṃ nāmadheyaṃ śṛṇuṣva me
verses.translation: Lord Krsna reinstated the greatest Brahman of the nature ofVasudcva into the Atman and held it in all living
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्चन्द्र इति त्व् आसीद् इक्ष्वाकुप्रभवो नृपः तस्य गृहे मुनी प्राप्तौ नारदः पर्वतस् तथा कृत्वातिथ्यं तयोः सम्यग् घरिश्चन्द्रो ऽब्रवीद् ऋषी
verses.transliteration: hariścandra iti tv āsīd ikṣvākuprabhavo nṛpaḥ tasya gṛhe munī prāptau nāradaḥ parvatas tathā kṛtvātithyaṃ tayoḥ samyag ghariścandro 'bravīd ṛṣī
verses.translation: O excellent ones, honouring the words of brahmins and Durvasas, the lord remained in the yogic posture keeping one of his feet over the other knee.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रार्थं क्लिश्यते लोकः किं पुत्रेण भविष्यति ज्ञानी वाप्य् अथवाज्ञानी उत्तमो मध्यमो ऽथवा एतं मे संशयं नित्यं ब्रूताम् ऋषिवराव् उभौ
verses.transliteration: putrārthaṃ kliśyate lokaḥ kiṃ putreṇa bhaviṣyati jñānī vāpy athavājñānī uttamo madhyamo 'thavā etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ nityaṃ brūtām ṛṣivarāv ubhau
verses.translation: The hunter Jara came there, holding a great arrow fitted with the last remnant bit of the iron club.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताव् ऊचतुर् हरिश्चन्द्रं पर्वतो नारदस् तथा
verses.transliteration: tāv ūcatur hariścandraṃ parvato nāradas tathā
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकधा दशधा राजञ् शतधा च सहस्रधा उत्तरं विद्यते सम्यक् तथाप्य् एतद् उदीर्यते
verses.transliteration: ekadhā daśadhā rājañ śatadhā ca sahasradhā uttaraṃ vidyate samyak tathāpy etad udīryate
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नापुत्रस्य परो लोको विद्यते नृपसत्तम जाते पुत्रे पिता स्नानं यः करोति जनाधिप
verses.transliteration: nāputrasya paro loko vidyate nṛpasattama jāte putre pitā snānaṃ yaḥ karoti janādhipa
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दशानाम् अश्वमेधानाम् अभिषेकफलं लभेत् आत्मप्रतिष्ठा पुत्रात् स्याज् जायते चामरोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: daśānām aśvamedhānām abhiṣekaphalaṃ labhet ātmapratiṣṭhā putrāt syāj jāyate cāmarottamaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अमृतेनामरा देवाः पुत्रेण ब्राह्मणादयः त्रिऋणान् मोचयेत् पुत्रः पितरं च पितामहान्
verses.transliteration: amṛtenāmarā devāḥ putreṇa brāhmaṇādayaḥ triṛṇān mocayet putraḥ pitaraṃ ca pitāmahān
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं तु मूलं किम् उ जलं किं तु श्मश्रूणि किं तपः विना पुत्रेण राजेन्द्र स्वर्गो मुक्तिः सुतात् स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ tu mūlaṃ kim u jalaṃ kiṃ tu śmaśrūṇi kiṃ tapaḥ vinā putreṇa rājendra svargo muktiḥ sutāt smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र एव परो लोको धर्मः कामो ऽर्थ एव च पुत्रो मुक्तिः परं ज्योतिस् तारकः सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: putra eva paro loko dharmaḥ kāmo 'rtha eva ca putro muktiḥ paraṃ jyotis tārakaḥ sarvadehinām
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विना पुत्रेण राजेन्द्र स्वर्गमोक्षौ सुदुर्लभौ पुत्र एव परो लोके धर्मकामार्थसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: vinā putreṇa rājendra svargamokṣau sudurlabhau putra eva paro loke dharmakāmārthasiddhaye
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विना पुत्रेण यद् दत्तं विना पुत्रेण यद् धुतम् विना पुत्रेण यज् जन्म व्यर्थं तद् अवभाति मे
verses.transliteration: vinā putreṇa yad dattaṃ vinā putreṇa yad dhutam vinā putreṇa yaj janma vyarthaṃ tad avabhāti me
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् पुत्रसमं किंचित् काम्यं नास्ति जगत्त्रये तच् छ्रुत्वा विस्मयवांस् ताव् उवाच नृपः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt putrasamaṃ kiṃcit kāmyaṃ nāsti jagattraye tac chrutvā vismayavāṃs tāv uvāca nṛpaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कथं मे स्यात् सुतो ब्रूतां यत्र क्वापि यथातथम् येन केनाप्य् उपायेन कृत्वा किंचित् तु पौरुषम् मन्त्रेण यागदानाभ्याम् उत्पाद्यो ऽसौ सुतो मया
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ me syāt suto brūtāṃ yatra kvāpi yathātatham yena kenāpy upāyena kṛtvā kiṃcit tu pauruṣam mantreṇa yāgadānābhyām utpādyo 'sau suto mayā
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताव् ऊचतुर् नृपश्रेष्ठं हरिश्चन्द्रं सुतार्थिनम् ध्यात्वा क्षणं तथा सम्यग् गौतमीं याहि मानद
verses.transliteration: tāv ūcatur nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ hariścandraṃ sutārthinam dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ tathā samyag gautamīṃ yāhi mānada
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापांपतिर् उत्कृष्टं ददाति मनसीप्सितम् वरुणः सर्वदाता वै मुनिभिः परिकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: tatrāpāṃpatir utkṛṣṭaṃ dadāti manasīpsitam varuṇaḥ sarvadātā vai munibhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स तु प्रीतः शनैः काले तव पुत्रं प्रदास्यति एतच् छ्रुत्वा नृपश्रेष्ठो मुनिवाक्यं तथाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: sa tu prītaḥ śanaiḥ kāle tava putraṃ pradāsyati etac chrutvā nṛpaśreṣṭho munivākyaṃ tathākarot
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तोषयाम् आस वरुणं गौतमीतीरम् आश्रितः ततश् च तुष्टो वरुणो हरिश्चन्द्रम् उवाच ह
verses.transliteration: toṣayām āsa varuṇaṃ gautamītīram āśritaḥ tataś ca tuṣṭo varuṇo hariścandram uvāca ha
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रं दास्यामि ते राजंल् लोकत्रयविभूषणम् यदि यक्ष्यसि तेनैव तव पुत्रो भवेद् ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: putraṃ dāsyāmi te rājaṃl lokatrayavibhūṣaṇam yadi yakṣyasi tenaiva tava putro bhaved dhruvam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्चन्द्रो ऽपि वरुणं यक्ष्ये तेनेत्य् अवोचत ततो गत्वा हरिश्चन्द्रश् चरुं कृत्वा तु वारुणम्
verses.transliteration: hariścandro 'pi varuṇaṃ yakṣye tenety avocata tato gatvā hariścandraś caruṃ kṛtvā tu vāruṇam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भार्यायै नृपतिः प्रादात् ततो जातः सुतो नृपात् जाते पुत्रे अपाम् ईशः प्रोवाच वदतां वरः
verses.transliteration: bhāryāyai nṛpatiḥ prādāt tato jātaḥ suto nṛpāt jāte putre apām īśaḥ provāca vadatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अद्यैव पुत्रो यष्टव्यः स्मरसे वचनं पुरा
verses.transliteration: adyaiva putro yaṣṭavyaḥ smarase vacanaṃ purā
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्चन्द्रो ऽपि वरुणं प्रोवाचेदं क्रमागतम्
verses.transliteration: hariścandro 'pi varuṇaṃ provācedaṃ kramāgatam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निर्दशो मेध्यतां याति पशुर् यक्ष्ये ततो ह्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: nirdaśo medhyatāṃ yāti paśur yakṣye tato hy aham
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा वचनं राज्ञो वरुणो ऽगात् स्वम् आलयम् निर्दशे पुनर् अभ्येत्य यजस्वेत्य् आह तं नृपम्
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā vacanaṃ rājño varuṇo 'gāt svam ālayam nirdaśe punar abhyetya yajasvety āha taṃ nṛpam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राजापि वरुणं प्राह निर्दन्तो निष्फलः पशुः पशोर् दन्तेषु जातेषु एहि गच्छाधुनाप्पते
verses.transliteration: rājāpi varuṇaṃ prāha nirdanto niṣphalaḥ paśuḥ paśor danteṣu jāteṣu ehi gacchādhunāppate
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा राजवचनं पुनः प्रायाद् अपांपतिः जातेषु चैव दन्तेषु सप्तवर्षेषु नारद
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā rājavacanaṃ punaḥ prāyād apāṃpatiḥ jāteṣu caiva danteṣu saptavarṣeṣu nārada
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् अप्य् आह राजानं यजस्वेति ततो ऽब्रवीत् राजापि वरुणं प्राह पत्स्यन्तीमे अपांपते
verses.transliteration: punar apy āha rājānaṃ yajasveti tato 'bravīt rājāpi varuṇaṃ prāha patsyantīme apāṃpate
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संपत्स्यन्ति तथा चान्ये ततो यक्ष्ये व्रजाधुना पुनः प्रायात् स वरुणः पुनर्दन्तेषु नारद यजस्वेति नृपं प्राह राजा प्राह त्व् अपांपतिम्
verses.transliteration: saṃpatsyanti tathā cānye tato yakṣye vrajādhunā punaḥ prāyāt sa varuṇaḥ punardanteṣu nārada yajasveti nṛpaṃ prāha rājā prāha tv apāṃpatim
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यदा तु क्षत्रियो यज्ञे पशुर् भवति वारिप धनुर्वेदं यदा वेत्ति तदा स्यात् पशुर् उत्तमः
verses.transliteration: yadā tu kṣatriyo yajñe paśur bhavati vāripa dhanurvedaṃ yadā vetti tadā syāt paśur uttamaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा राजवचनं वरुणो ऽगात् स्वम् आलयम् यदास्त्रेषु च शस्त्रेषु समर्थो ऽभूत् स रोहितः
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā rājavacanaṃ varuṇo 'gāt svam ālayam yadāstreṣu ca śastreṣu samartho 'bhūt sa rohitaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्ववेदेषु शास्त्रेषु वेत्ताभूत् स त्व् अरिंदमः युवराज्यम् अनुप्राप्ते रोहिते षोडशाब्दिके
verses.transliteration: sarvavedeṣu śāstreṣu vettābhūt sa tv ariṃdamaḥ yuvarājyam anuprāpte rohite ṣoḍaśābdike
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतिमान् अगमत् तत्र यत्र राजा सरोहितः आगत्य वरुणः प्राह यजस्वाद्य सुतं स्वकम्
verses.transliteration: prītimān agamat tatra yatra rājā sarohitaḥ āgatya varuṇaḥ prāha yajasvādya sutaṃ svakam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ओम् इत्य् उक्त्वा नृपवर ऋत्विजः प्राह भूपतिः रोहितं च सुतं ज्येष्ठं शृण्वतो वरुणस्य च
