verses.transliteration: om ity uktvā nṛpavara ṛtvijaḥ prāha bhūpatiḥ rohitaṃ ca sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ śṛṇvato varuṇasya ca
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एहि पुत्र महावीर यक्ष्ये त्वां वरुणाय हि
verses.transliteration: ehi putra mahāvīra yakṣye tvāṃ varuṇāya hi
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किम् एतद् इत्य् अथोवाच रोहितः पितरं प्रति पितापि तद् यथावृत्तम् आचचक्षे सविस्तरम् रोहितः पितरं प्राह शृण्वतो वरुणस्य च
verses.transliteration: kim etad ity athovāca rohitaḥ pitaraṃ prati pitāpi tad yathāvṛttam ācacakṣe savistaram rohitaḥ pitaraṃ prāha śṛṇvato varuṇasya ca
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहं पूर्वं महाराज ऋत्विग्भिः सपुरोहितः विष्णवे लोकनाथाय यक्ष्ये ऽहं त्वरितं शुचिः पशुना वरुणेनाथ तद् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ pūrvaṃ mahārāja ṛtvigbhiḥ sapurohitaḥ viṣṇave lokanāthāya yakṣye 'haṃ tvaritaṃ śuciḥ paśunā varuṇenātha tad anujñātum arhasi
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रोहितस्य तु तद् वाक्यं श्रुत्वा वारीश्वरस् तदा कोपेन महताविष्टो जलोदरम् अथाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: rohitasya tu tad vākyaṃ śrutvā vārīśvaras tadā kopena mahatāviṣṭo jalodaram athākarot
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्चन्द्रस्य नृपते रोहितः स वनं ययौ गृहीत्वा स धनुर् दिव्यं रथारूढो गतव्यथः
verses.transliteration: hariścandrasya nṛpate rohitaḥ sa vanaṃ yayau gṛhītvā sa dhanur divyaṃ rathārūḍho gatavyathaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र चाराध्य वरुणं हरिश्चन्द्रो जनेश्वरः गङ्गायां प्राप्तवान् पुत्रं तत्रागात् सो ऽपि रोहितः
verses.transliteration: yatra cārādhya varuṇaṃ hariścandro janeśvaraḥ gaṅgāyāṃ prāptavān putraṃ tatrāgāt so 'pi rohitaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: व्यतीतान्य् अथ वर्षाणि पञ्च षष्ठे प्रवर्तति तत्र स्थित्वा नृपसुतः शुश्राव नृपते रुजम्
verses.transliteration: vyatītāny atha varṣāṇi pañca ṣaṣṭhe pravartati tatra sthitvā nṛpasutaḥ śuśrāva nṛpate rujam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मया पुत्रेण जातेन पितुर् वै क्लेशकारिणा किं फलं किं नु कृत्यं स्याद् इत्य् एवं पर्यचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: mayā putreṇa jātena pitur vai kleśakāriṇā kiṃ phalaṃ kiṃ nu kṛtyaṃ syād ity evaṃ paryacintayat
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास् तीरे ऋषीन् पुण्यान् अपश्यन् नृपतेः सुतः गङ्गातीरे वर्तमानम् अपश्यद् ऋषिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasyās tīre ṛṣīn puṇyān apaśyan nṛpateḥ sutaḥ gaṅgātīre vartamānam apaśyad ṛṣisattamam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अजीगर्तम् इति ख्यातम् ऋषेस् तु वयसः सुतम् त्रिभिः पुत्रैर् अनुवृतं भार्यया क्षीणवृत्तिकम् तं दृष्ट्वा नृपतेः पुत्रो नमस्येदं वचो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: ajīgartam iti khyātam ṛṣes tu vayasaḥ sutam tribhiḥ putrair anuvṛtaṃ bhāryayā kṣīṇavṛttikam taṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpateḥ putro namasyedaṃ vaco 'bravīt
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्षीणवृत्तिः कृशः कस्माद् दुर्मना इव लक्ष्यसे
verses.transliteration: kṣīṇavṛttiḥ kṛśaḥ kasmād durmanā iva lakṣyase
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अजीगर्तो ऽपि चोवाच रोहितं नृपतेः सुतम्
verses.transliteration: ajīgarto 'pi covāca rohitaṃ nṛpateḥ sutam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वर्तनं नास्ति देहस्य भोक्तारो बहवश् च मे विनान्नेन मरिष्यामो ब्रूहि किं करवामहे
verses.transliteration: vartanaṃ nāsti dehasya bhoktāro bahavaś ca me vinānnena mariṣyāmo brūhi kiṃ karavāmahe
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा पुनर् अप्य् आह नृपपुत्र ऋषिं तदा
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā punar apy āha nṛpaputra ṛṣiṃ tadā
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तव किं वर्तते चित्ते तद् ब्रूहि वदतां वर
verses.transliteration: tava kiṃ vartate citte tad brūhi vadatāṃ vara
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यं रजतं गावो धान्यं वस्त्रादिकं न मे विद्यते नृपशार्दूल वर्तनं नास्ति मे ततः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ gāvo dhānyaṃ vastrādikaṃ na me vidyate nṛpaśārdūla vartanaṃ nāsti me tataḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुता मे सन्ति भार्या च अहं वै पञ्चमस् तथा नैतेषां कतमस्यापि क्रेतान्नेन नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: sutā me santi bhāryā ca ahaṃ vai pañcamas tathā naiteṣāṃ katamasyāpi kretānnena nṛpottama
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं क्रीणासि महाबुद्धे ऽजीगर्त सत्यम् एव मे वद नान्यच् च वक्तव्यं विप्रा वै सत्यवादिनः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ krīṇāsi mahābuddhe 'jīgarta satyam eva me vada nānyac ca vaktavyaṃ viprā vai satyavādinaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रयाणाम् अपि पुत्राणाम् एकं वा मां तथैव च भार्यां वापि गृहाणेमां क्रीत्वा जीवामहे वयम्
verses.transliteration: trayāṇām api putrāṇām ekaṃ vā māṃ tathaiva ca bhāryāṃ vāpi gṛhāṇemāṃ krītvā jīvāmahe vayam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं भार्यया महाबुद्धे किं त्वया वृद्धरूपिणा युवानं देहि पुत्रं मे पुत्राणां यं त्वम् इच्छसि
verses.transliteration: kiṃ bhāryayā mahābuddhe kiṃ tvayā vṛddharūpiṇā yuvānaṃ dehi putraṃ me putrāṇāṃ yaṃ tvam icchasi
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठपुत्रं शुनःपुच्छं नाहं क्रीणामि रोहित माता कनीयसं चापि न क्रीणाति ततो ऽनयोः मध्यमं तु शुनःशेपं क्रीणामि वद तद्धनम्
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhaputraṃ śunaḥpucchaṃ nāhaṃ krīṇāmi rohita mātā kanīyasaṃ cāpi na krīṇāti tato 'nayoḥ madhyamaṃ tu śunaḥśepaṃ krīṇāmi vada taddhanam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वरुणाय पशुः कल्प्यः पुरुषो गुणवत्तरः यदि क्रीणासि मूल्यं त्वं वद सत्यं महामुने
verses.transliteration: varuṇāya paśuḥ kalpyaḥ puruṣo guṇavattaraḥ yadi krīṇāsi mūlyaṃ tvaṃ vada satyaṃ mahāmune
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा त्व् अजीगर्तः पुत्रमूल्यम् अकल्पयत् गवां सहस्रं धान्यानां निष्कानां चापि वाससाम् राजपुत्र वरं देहि दास्यामि स्वसुतं तव
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā tv ajīgartaḥ putramūlyam akalpayat gavāṃ sahasraṃ dhānyānāṃ niṣkānāṃ cāpi vāsasām rājaputra varaṃ dehi dāsyāmi svasutaṃ tava
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा रोहितो ऽपि प्रादात् सवसनं धनम् दत्त्वा जगाम पितरम् ऋषिपुत्रेण रोहितः पित्रे निवेदयाम् आस क्रयक्रीतम् ऋषेः सुतम्
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā rohito 'pi prādāt savasanaṃ dhanam dattvā jagāma pitaram ṛṣiputreṇa rohitaḥ pitre nivedayām āsa krayakrītam ṛṣeḥ sutam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वरुणाय यजस्व त्वं पशुना त्वम् अरुग् भव
verses.transliteration: varuṇāya yajasva tvaṃ paśunā tvam arug bhava
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.

verses.sanskrit: तथोवाच हरिश्चन्द्रः पुत्रवाक्याद् अनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tathovāca hariścandraḥ putravākyād anantaram
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्या राज्ञा पाल्या इति श्रुतिः विशेषतस् तु वर्णानां गुरवो हि द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā rājñā pālyā iti śrutiḥ viśeṣatas tu varṇānāṃ guravo hi dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोर् अपि हि ये पूज्या मादृशाः कुत एव हि अवज्ञयापि येषां स्यान् नृपाणां स्वकुलक्षयः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇor api hi ye pūjyā mādṛśāḥ kuta eva hi avajñayāpi yeṣāṃ syān nṛpāṇāṃ svakulakṣayaḥ

verses.sanskrit: तान् पशून् कृत्वा कृपणं कथं रक्षितुम् उत्सहे अहं च ब्राह्मणं कुर्यां पशुं नैतद् धि युज्यते
verses.transliteration: tān paśūn kṛtvā kṛpaṇaṃ kathaṃ rakṣitum utsahe ahaṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ kuryāṃ paśuṃ naitad dhi yujyate

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तत्र वाग् उवाचाशरीरिणी
verses.transliteration: etasminn antare tatra vāg uvācāśarīriṇī

verses.sanskrit: गौतमीं गच्छ राजेन्द्र ऋत्विग्भिः सपुरोहितः पशुना विप्रपुत्रेण रोहितेन सुतेन च
verses.transliteration: gautamīṃ gaccha rājendra ṛtvigbhiḥ sapurohitaḥ paśunā vipraputreṇa rohitena sutena ca

verses.sanskrit: त्वया कार्यः क्रतुश् चैव शुनःशेपवधं विना क्रतुः पूर्णो भवेत् तत्र तस्माद् याहि महामते
verses.transliteration: tvayā kāryaḥ kratuś caiva śunaḥśepavadhaṃ vinā kratuḥ pūrṇo bhavet tatra tasmād yāhi mahāmate

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवेन ऋषिणा तथान्यैर् मुनिभिः सह प्राप्य गङ्गां गौतमीं तां नरमेधाय दीक्षितः
verses.transliteration: vāmadevena ṛṣiṇā tathānyair munibhiḥ saha prāpya gaṅgāṃ gautamīṃ tāṃ naramedhāya dīkṣitaḥ

verses.transliteration: śunaḥśepaṃ paśuṃ yūpe nibadhyātha samantrakam vāribhiḥ prokṣitaṃ dṛṣṭvā viśvāmitro 'bravīd idam

verses.transliteration: devān ṛṣīn hariścandraṃ rohitaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ anujānantv imaṃ sarve śunaḥśepaṃ dvijottamam

verses.transliteration: yebhyas tv ayaṃ havir deyo devebhyo 'yaṃ pṛthak pṛthak anujānantu te sarve śunaḥśepaṃ viśeṣataḥ

verses.transliteration: vasābhir lomabhis tvagbhir māṃsaiḥ sanmantritair makhe agnau hoṣyaḥ paśuś cāyaṃ śunaḥśepo dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपासिताः स्युर् विप्रेन्द्रास् ते सर्वे त्व् अनुमन्य माम् गौतमीं यान्तु विप्रेन्द्राः स्नात्वा देवान् पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: upāsitāḥ syur viprendrās te sarve tv anumanya mām gautamīṃ yāntu viprendrāḥ snātvā devān pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रैः स्तोत्रैः स्तुवन्तस् ते मुदं यान्तु शिवे रताः एनं रक्षन्तु मुनयो देवाश् च हविषो भुजः
verses.transliteration: mantraiḥ stotraiḥ stuvantas te mudaṃ yāntu śive ratāḥ enaṃ rakṣantu munayo devāś ca haviṣo bhujaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् ऊचुश् च मुनयो मेने च नृपसत्तमः ततो गत्वा शुनःशेपो गङ्गां त्रैलोक्यपावनीम्
verses.transliteration: tathety ūcuś ca munayo mene ca nṛpasattamaḥ tato gatvā śunaḥśepo gaṅgāṃ trailokyapāvanīm
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा तुष्टाव तान् देवान् ये तत्र हविषो भुजः ततस् तुष्टाः सुरगणाः शुनःशेपं च ते मुने अवदन्त सुराः सर्वे विश्वामित्रस्य शृण्वतः
verses.transliteration: snātvā tuṣṭāva tān devān ye tatra haviṣo bhujaḥ tatas tuṣṭāḥ suragaṇāḥ śunaḥśepaṃ ca te mune avadanta surāḥ sarve viśvāmitrasya śṛṇvataḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्रतुः पूर्णो भवत्व् एष शुनःशेपवधं विना
verses.transliteration: kratuḥ pūrṇo bhavatv eṣa śunaḥśepavadhaṃ vinā
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विशेषेणाथ वरुणश् चावदन् नृपसत्तमम् ततः पूर्णो ऽभवद् राज्ञो नृमेधो लोकविश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: viśeṣeṇātha varuṇaś cāvadan nṛpasattamam tataḥ pūrṇo 'bhavad rājño nṛmedho lokaviśrutaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवानां च प्रसादेन मुनीनां च प्रसादतः तीर्थस्य तु प्रसादेन राज्ञः पूर्णो ऽभवत् क्रतुः
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ ca prasādena munīnāṃ ca prasādataḥ tīrthasya tu prasādena rājñaḥ pūrṇo 'bhavat kratuḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रः शुनःशेपं पूजयाम् आस संसदि अकरोद् आत्मनः पुत्रं पूजयित्वा सुरान्तिके
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitraḥ śunaḥśepaṃ pūjayām āsa saṃsadi akarod ātmanaḥ putraṃ pūjayitvā surāntike
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठं चकार पुत्राणाम् आत्मनः स तु कौशिकः न मेनिरे ये च पुत्रा विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhaṃ cakāra putrāṇām ātmanaḥ sa tu kauśikaḥ na menire ye ca putrā viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शुनःशेपस्य च ज्यैष्ठ्यं ताञ् शशाप स कौशिकः ज्यैष्ठ्यं ये मेनिरे पुत्राः पूजयाम् आस तान् सुतान्
verses.transliteration: śunaḥśepasya ca jyaiṣṭhyaṃ tāñ śaśāpa sa kauśikaḥ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ ye menire putrāḥ pūjayām āsa tān sutān
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वरेण मुनिशार्दूलस् तद् एतत् कथितं मया एतत् सर्वं यत्र जातं गौतम्या दक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: vareṇa muniśārdūlas tad etat kathitaṃ mayā etat sarvaṃ yatra jātaṃ gautamyā dakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थानि पुण्यानि विख्यातानि सुरादिभिः बहूनि तेषां नामानि मत्तः शृणु महामते
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthāni puṇyāni vikhyātāni surādibhiḥ bahūni teṣāṃ nāmāni mattaḥ śṛṇu mahāmate
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्चन्द्रं शुनःशेपं विश्वामित्रं सरोहितम् इत्याद्य् अष्ट सहस्राणि तीर्थान्य् अथ चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: hariścandraṃ śunaḥśepaṃ viśvāmitraṃ sarohitam ityādy aṣṭa sahasrāṇi tīrthāny atha caturdaśa
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेषु स्नानं च दानं च नरमेधफलप्रदम् आख्यातं चास्य माहात्म्यं तीर्थस्य मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca naramedhaphalapradam ākhyātaṃ cāsya māhātmyaṃ tīrthasya munisattama
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यः पठेत् पाठयेद् वापि शृणुयाद् वापि भक्तितः अपुत्रः पुत्रम् आप्नोति यच् चान्यन् मनसः प्रियम्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhet pāṭhayed vāpi śṛṇuyād vāpi bhaktitaḥ aputraḥ putram āpnoti yac cānyan manasaḥ priyam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं पितॄणां प्रीतिवर्धनम् तत्र वृत्तं महापुण्यं शृणु यत्नेन नारद
verses.transliteration: somatīrtham iti khyātaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam tatra vṛttaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ śṛṇu yatnena nārada
verses.translation: Arjuna found out the cast off physical bodies of Krsna and Balarama and performed the requisite consecratory rites. He did the same for others too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमो राजामृतमयो गन्धर्वाणां पुराभवत् न देवानां तदा देवा माम् अभ्येत्येदम् अब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: somo rājāmṛtamayo gandharvāṇāṃ purābhavat na devānāṃ tadā devā mām abhyetyedam abruvan
verses.translation: The eight crowned queens of Krsna, RukminI and others, took the dead body of Krsna and entered fire*
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वैर् आहृतः सोमो देवानां प्राणदः पुरा तम् अध्यायन् सुरगणा ऋषयस् त्व् अतिदुःखिताः यथा स्यात् सोमो ह्य् अस्माकं तथा नीतिर् विधीयताम्
verses.transliteration: gandharvair āhṛtaḥ somo devānāṃ prāṇadaḥ purā tam adhyāyan suragaṇā ṛṣayas tv atiduḥkhitāḥ yathā syāt somo hy asmākaṃ tathā nītir vidhīyatām
verses.translation: Revati the excellent lady, embraced the body of Bala¬ rama and entered the blazing fire which cooled and delighted her by the mere touch of her body.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र वाग् विबुधान् आह गन्धर्वाः स्त्रीषु कामुकाः तेभ्यो दत्त्वाथ मां देवाः सोमम् आहर्तुम् अर्हथ
verses.transliteration: tatra vāg vibudhān āha gandharvāḥ strīṣu kāmukāḥ tebhyo dattvātha māṃ devāḥ somam āhartum arhatha
verses.translation: On hearing about this, Ugrasena, Anakadundubhi, DevakI and RohinI entered fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वाचं प्रत्यूचुर् अमरास् त्वां दातुं न क्षमा वयम् विना तेनापि न स्थातुं शक्यं नैव त्वया विना
verses.transliteration: vācaṃ pratyūcur amarās tvāṃ dātuṃ na kṣamā vayam vinā tenāpi na sthātuṃ śakyaṃ naiva tvayā vinā
verses.translation: Arjuna performed their funeral rites in accordance with the injunctions. Taking all the people and Vajra with him he left Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् वाग् अब्रवीद् देवान् पुनर् एष्याम्य् अहं त्व् इह अत्र बुद्धिर् विधातव्या क्रियतां क्रतुर् उत्तमः
verses.transliteration: punar vāg abravīd devān punar eṣyāmy ahaṃ tv iha atra buddhir vidhātavyā kriyatāṃ kratur uttamaḥ
verses.translation: Thousands of wives of Krsna went out of Dvaravatl. Looking after Vajra and the people, the son of Kunti went ahead slowly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतम्या दक्षिणे तीरे भवेद् देवागमो यदि मखं तु विषयं कृत्वा आयान्तु सुरसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: gautamyā dakṣiṇe tīre bhaved devāgamo yadi makhaṃ tu viṣayaṃ kṛtvā āyāntu surasattamāḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, the assembly chamber Sudharma, that had been brought to the mortal world by Kisnawent back to heaven. So also the Parijata tree..
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाः स्त्रीप्रिया नित्यं पणध्वं तं मया सह तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सुरगणाः सरस्वत्या वचःस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: gandharvāḥ strīpriyā nityaṃ paṇadhvaṃ taṃ mayā saha tathety uktvā suragaṇāḥ sarasvatyā vacaḥsthitāḥ
verses.translation: The great ocean flooded Dvaraka. The sea did not engulf the house of the most excellent one among the descendants of Yadu. This was the only thing it did not envelop in its waters.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवदूतैः पृथग् देवान् यक्षान् गन्धर्वपन्नगान् आह्वानं चक्रिरे तत्र पुण्ये देवगिरौ तदा
verses.transliteration: devadūtaiḥ pṛthag devān yakṣān gandharvapannagān āhvānaṃ cakrire tatra puṇye devagirau tadā
verses.translation: O excellent sages, in the land ofPancanada (watered by five rivers), equipped with much of wealth and foodgrains, Arjuna made arrangements for the residence of all the people.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवगिरिर् नाम पर्वतस्याभवन् मुने तत्रागमन् सुरगणा गन्धर्वा यक्षकिंनराः
verses.transliteration: tato devagirir nāma parvatasyābhavan mune tatrāgaman suragaṇā gandharvā yakṣakiṃnarāḥ
verses.translation: Tnereafter Dasyus who hurled lumps of clay and who struck with their staffs rushed at those womenfolk whose hus¬ bands had been killed. They attacked them in their thousands. Turning back, the son of Kunti spoke to the Abhiras laughingly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवाः सिद्धाश् च ऋषयस् तथाष्टौ देवयोनयः ऋषिभिर् गौतमीतीरे क्रियमाणे महाध्वरे
verses.transliteration: devāḥ siddhāś ca ṛṣayas tathāṣṭau devayonayaḥ ṛṣibhir gautamītīre kriyamāṇe mahādhvare
verses.translation: When the arrows were exhausted Arjuna struck them with the tip of his bow. O brahmins, at the blow the Dasyus laughed derisively.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवैः परिवृतः सहस्राक्षो ऽभ्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: tatra devaiḥ parivṛtaḥ sahasrākṣo 'bhyabhāṣata
verses.translation: Arjuna became dejected saying—"Alas; Alas, I have been abandoned by that lord." He lamented.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वान् अथ संपूज्य सरस्वत्याः समीपतः सरस्वत्या पणध्वं नो युष्माकम् अमृतात्मना
verses.transliteration: gandharvān atha saṃpūjya sarasvatyāḥ samīpataḥ sarasvatyā paṇadhvaṃ no yuṣmākam amṛtātmanā
verses.translation: That bow, those miraculous missiles, that chariot and those horses—all these are destroyed at one'stroke like the chari¬ table gift to one who is not learned in the Vedas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच् छक्रवचनात् ते वै गन्धर्वाः स्त्रीषु कामुकाः सोमं दत्त्वा सुरेभ्यस् तु जगृहुस् तां सरस्वतीम्
verses.transliteration: tac chakravacanāt te vai gandharvāḥ strīṣu kāmukāḥ somaṃ dattvā surebhyas tu jagṛhus tāṃ sarasvatīm
verses.translation: My superior powers and those of Bhimawere certainly effected by Lord Kjrsna. Without him, I have been conquered by the cowherds. How can it happen otherwise?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमो ऽभवच् चामराणां गन्धर्वाणां सरस्वती अवसत् तत्र वागीशा तथापि च सुरान्तिके
verses.transliteration: somo 'bhavac cāmarāṇāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ sarasvatī avasat tatra vāgīśā tathāpi ca surāntike
verses.translation: Saying thus, Arjuna went to Indraprastha. There he crowned as king, the Yadava scion Vajra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आयाति च रहो नित्यम् उपांशु क्रियताम् इति अत एव हि सोमस्य क्रयो भवति नारद
verses.transliteration: āyāti ca raho nityam upāṃśu kriyatām iti ata eva hi somasya krayo bhavati nārada
verses.translation: Arjuna saw there the highly blessed sage Vyasa with his abode in the forest. He approached him humbly and saluted the sage.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपांशुना वर्तितव्यं सोमक्रयण एव हि ततो ऽभवद् देवतानां सोमश् चापि सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: upāṃśunā vartitavyaṃ somakrayaṇa eva hi tato 'bhavad devatānāṃ somaś cāpi sarasvatī
verses.translation: He who had been our strength, our splendour, our prowess, our exploit, our glory, our lustre—lord Kna—has left us.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाणां नैव सोमो नैवासीच् च सरस्वती तत्रागमन् सर्व एव सोमार्थं गौतमीतटम्
verses.transliteration: gandharvāṇāṃ naiva somo naivāsīc ca sarasvatī tatrāgaman sarva eva somārthaṃ gautamītaṭam
verses.translation: To me the Earth appears like a lady who has lost her blooming youth, whose splendour is destroyed and whose lustre has vanished. O dear one, I am not the only one to suffer from the bereavement of the discus-bearing lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गावो देवाः पर्वता यक्षरक्षाः सिद्धाः साध्या मुनयो गुह्यकाश् गन्धर्वास् ते मरुतः पन्नगाश् सर्वौषध्यो मातरो लोकपालाः
verses.transliteration: gāvo devāḥ parvatā yakṣarakṣāḥ siddhāḥ sādhyā munayo guhyakāś gandharvās te marutaḥ pannagāś sarvauṣadhyo mātaro lokapālāḥ
verses.translation: Due to the power and magnificence of Krsna I was able to kill Bhlsma and others. I was like fire and they were like moths. But today, without lord Krsna, I have been defeated by cowherds. O great sage, thousands of helpless ladies have been carried off, in spite of my endeavour, by the Dasyus who had batons for their weapons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चविंशतिनद्यस् तु गङ्गायां संगता मुने पूर्णाहुतिर् यत्र दत्ता पूर्णाख्यानं तद् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: pañcaviṃśatinadyas tu gaṅgāyāṃ saṃgatā mune pūrṇāhutir yatra dattā pūrṇākhyānaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: All the womenfolk of Krsna, while being brought over here by me, have been carried away by the cowherds who carried sticks as their weapons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतम्यां संगता यास् तु सर्वाश् चापि यथोदिताः तन्नामधेयतीर्थानि संक्षेपाच् छृणु नारद
verses.transliteration: gautamyāṃ saṃgatā yās tu sarvāś cāpi yathoditāḥ tannāmadheyatīrthāni saṃkṣepāc chṛṇu nārada
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the noble-minded Arjuna, who Enough of your being ashamed, O Arjuna, it does not behove you to bewail. Understand that the working of time in all living beings is like this.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमतीर्थं च गान्धर्वं देवतीर्थम् अतः परम् पूर्णातीर्थं ततः शालं श्रीपर्णासंगमं तथा
verses.transliteration: somatīrthaṃ ca gāndharvaṃ devatīrtham ataḥ param pūrṇātīrthaṃ tataḥ śālaṃ śrīparṇāsaṃgamaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Formerly, the Earth that had been afflicted by burden had gone to Devas. It was for that purpose that Visnu who could assume any form that he desired had taken up incarnation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वागतासंगमं पुण्यं कुसुमायाश् च संगमम् पुष्टिसंगमम् आख्यातं कर्णिकासंगमं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: svāgatāsaṃgamaṃ puṇyaṃ kusumāyāś ca saṃgamam puṣṭisaṃgamam ākhyātaṃ karṇikāsaṃgamaṃ śubham
verses.translation: That task has been achieved, the kings have been killed. The family of Vrsnis and Andhakas has been duly finished. This lord of Devas performs creation at the beginning and sustains during its maintenance. He is competent to annihi¬ late as well, as has been done now.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैणवीसंगमश् चैव कृशरासंगमस् तथा वासवीसंगमश् चैव शिवशर्या तथा शिखी
verses.transliteration: vaiṇavīsaṃgamaś caiva kṛśarāsaṃgamas tathā vāsavīsaṃgamaś caiva śivaśaryā tathā śikhī
verses.translation: Hence, O Arjuna, you must not feel aggrieved due to this discomfiture. At the moment of creative activity men will have exploits.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुसुम्भिका उपारथ्या शान्तिजा देवजा तदा अजो वृद्धः सुरो भद्रो गौतम्या सह संगताः
verses.transliteration: kusumbhikā upārathyā śāntijā devajā tadā ajo vṛddhaḥ suro bhadro gautamyā saha saṃgatāḥ
verses.translation: That lord, the lord of the universe, permeates other bodies and performs the task of dissolving all living beings in the end. During the origin of this creative process the lord was your ally, O son of Kuntl. At the close of created beings those who are viewed with sympathy by the lord had been your adversaries.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च बहवो नदीनदसहायगाः पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि ह्य् अगमन् देवपर्वते
verses.transliteration: ete cānye ca bahavo nadīnadasahāyagāḥ pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni hy agaman devaparvate
verses.translation: Who could have believed at the beginning that you could kill Kauravas including Bhisma? Who could have believ¬ ed your discomfiture at the hands of cowherds?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमार्थं वै तथा चान्ये ऽप्य् आगमन् मखमण्डपम् तानि तीर्थानि गङ्गायां संगतानि यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: somārthaṃ vai tathā cānye 'py āgaman makhamaṇḍapam tāni tīrthāni gaṅgāyāṃ saṃgatāni yathākramam
verses.translation: O Arjuna, Rambha, Tilottama and hundreds and thou¬ sands of other ladies eulogised and praised that great soul. They praised the sage who wore weighty matted hair and who was standing immersed in water up to his neck. With humility they bent down their heads. They were eager in repeating the hymns.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नदीरूपेण कान्य् एव नदरूपेण कानिचित् सरोरूपेण कान्य् अत्र स्तवरूपेण कानिचित्
verses.transliteration: nadīrūpeṇa kāny eva nadarūpeṇa kānicit sarorūpeṇa kāny atra stavarūpeṇa kānicit
verses.translation: They eulogised him so much that he became pleased with them. O most excellent among the descendants of Kuru, they eulogised that most excellent brahmin.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तान्य् एव सर्वतीर्थानि विख्यातानि पृथक् पृथक् तेषु स्नानं जपो होमः पितृतर्पणम् एव च
verses.transliteration: tāny eva sarvatīrthāni vikhyātāni pṛthak pṛthak teṣu snānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam eva ca
verses.translation: O highly blessed ladies, I am delighted. Whatever is wished for by you, may be requested for from me. I shall grant it even if it.is very difficult to grant. Hence, O Arjuna, even the least bit of sorrow need not be felt by you. Everything has already been ordained by the lord of all.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामप्रदं पुंसां भुक्तिदं मुक्तिभाजनम् एतेषां पठनं चापि स्मरणं वा करोति यः सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो याति विष्णुपुरं जनः
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmapradaṃ puṃsāṃ bhuktidaṃ muktibhājanam eteṣāṃ paṭhanaṃ cāpi smaraṇaṃ vā karoti yaḥ sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti viṣṇupuraṃ janaḥ
verses.translation: Your strength, splendour, prowess and greatness have been condensed by the lord desirous of annihilating you all.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रवरासंगमो नाम श्रेष्ठा चैव महानदी यत्र सिद्धेश्वरो देवः सर्वलोकोपकारकृत्
verses.transliteration: pravarāsaṃgamo nāma śreṣṭhā caiva mahānadī yatra siddheśvaro devaḥ sarvalokopakārakṛt
verses.translation: O excellent sage, the rare manifestation and the diverse activities of lord Krsna as well as Balarama in the world have been mentioned by you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवानां दानवानां च संगमो ऽभूत् सुदारुणः तेषां परस्परं वापि प्रीतिश् चाभून् महामुने
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca saṃgamo 'bhūt sudāruṇaḥ teṣāṃ parasparaṃ vāpi prītiś cābhūn mahāmune
verses.translation: Listening to the story of the lord we are not contented. We wish to hear about the other manifestations of the lord of the universe.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ते ऽप्य् एवं मन्त्रयाम् आसुर् देवा वै दानवा मिथः मेरुपर्वतम् आसाद्य परस्परहितैषिणः
verses.transliteration: te 'py evaṃ mantrayām āsur devā vai dānavā mithaḥ meruparvatam āsādya parasparahitaiṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: We do not know his full conduct nor the details of the process whereby the incarnation took place. We do not know the extent of the existence of Gunas and Karmans in him. We do not know the extent of his will in the causation thereof.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अमृतेनामरत्वं स्याद् उत्पाद्यामृतम् उत्तमम् पिबामः सर्व एवैते भवामश् चामरा वयम्
verses.transliteration: amṛtenāmaratvaṃ syād utpādyāmṛtam uttamam pibāmaḥ sarva evaite bhavāmaś cāmarā vayam
verses.translation: I shall mention the greatness of Vasudeva, the con¬ duct of life of the highly intelligent one, for the welfare of Devas and mortal beings as well as the origin of the worlds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकीभूत्वा वयं लोकान् पालयामः सुखानि च प्राप्स्यामः संगरं हित्वा संगरो दुःखकारणम्
verses.transliteration: ekībhūtvā vayaṃ lokān pālayāmaḥ sukhāni ca prāpsyāmaḥ saṃgaraṃ hitvā saṃgaro duḥkhakāraṇam
verses.translation: The supreme Atman manifests himself on many occa¬ sions. I shall recount the manifestations that are divine, sacred and endowed with good qualities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रीत्या चैवार्जितान् अर्थान् भोक्ष्यामो गतमत्सराः यतः स्नेहेन वृत्तिर् या सास्माकं सुखदा सदा
verses.transliteration: prītyā caivārjitān arthān bhokṣyāmo gatamatsarāḥ yataḥ snehena vṛttir yā sāsmākaṃ sukhadā sadā
verses.translation: The lord of Devas, the lord of universe, who sleeps for the period of a thousand sets of four Yugas, manifests himself against some (specific) task after the thousand sets of four Yugas are completed.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैपरीत्यं तु यद् वृत्तं न स्मर्तव्यं कदाचन न च त्रैलोक्यराज्ये ऽपि कैवल्ये वा सुखं मनाक् तद् ऊर्ध्वम् अपि वा यत् तु निर्वैरत्वाद् अवाप्यते
verses.transliteration: vaiparītyaṃ tu yad vṛttaṃ na smartavyaṃ kadācana na ca trailokyarājye 'pi kaivalye vā sukhaṃ manāk tad ūrdhvam api vā yat tu nirvairatvād avāpyate
verses.translation: O you of good holy rites, I am pleased wtih your penance. Welfare unto you. Choose a boon. Obtain your cherished desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं परस्परं प्रीताः सन्तो देवाश् च दानवाः एकीभूताश् च सुप्रीता विमथ्य वरुणालयम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ parasparaṃ prītāḥ santo devāś ca dānavāḥ ekībhūtāś ca suprītā vimathya varuṇālayam
verses.translation: O dear one, all these divine and wonderful boons have been granted to you by me. O dear one, you will attain all these desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मन्थानं मन्दरं कृत्वा रज्जुं कृत्वा तु वासुकिम् देवाश् च दानवाः सर्वे ममन्थुर् वरुणालयम्
verses.transliteration: manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā rajjuṃ kṛtvā tu vāsukim devāś ca dānavāḥ sarve mamanthur varuṇālayam
verses.translation: After saying this, lord Brahma immediately went to his abode frequented by the brahminical sage.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नं च ततः पुण्यम् अमृतं सुरवल्लभम् निष्पन्ने चामृते पुण्ये ते च प्रोचुः परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: utpannaṃ ca tataḥ puṇyam amṛtaṃ suravallabham niṣpanne cāmṛte puṇye te ca procuḥ parasparam
verses.translation: On hearing about the granting of boon, Devas, Nagas, Gandharvas and sages approached him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यामः स्वं स्वम् अधिष्ठानं कृतकार्याः श्रमं गताः सर्वे समं च सर्वेभ्यो यथायोग्यं विभज्यताम्
verses.transliteration: yāmaḥ svaṃ svam adhiṣṭhānaṃ kṛtakāryāḥ śramaṃ gatāḥ sarve samaṃ ca sarvebhyo yathāyogyaṃ vibhajyatām
verses.translation: O lord, with this boon, that Asura will harass us. Hence, O lord, be pleased, let the manner of his destruction be also thought of.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यदा सर्वागमो यत्र यस्मिंल् लग्ने शुभावहे विभज्यताम् इदं पुण्यम् अमृतं सुरसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: yadā sarvāgamo yatra yasmiṃl lagne śubhāvahe vibhajyatām idaṃ puṇyam amṛtaṃ surasattamāḥ
verses.translation: O lord, you are the self-born lord, you are the cause of all living beings, you are the creator of Havyas and Kavyas. You Are the unmanifest being. You are certainly Prakrti.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा ते ययुः सर्वे दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः गतेषु दैत्यसंघेषु देवाः सर्वे ऽन्वमन्त्रयन्
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā te yayuḥ sarve daityadānavarākṣasāḥ gateṣu daityasaṃgheṣu devāḥ sarve 'nvamantrayan
verses.translation: O Devas, the fruit of penance must of course be obtain- ed by him. But as the benefits of penance are exhausted lord Visnu will slay him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गतास् ते रिपवो ऽस्माकं दैवयोगाद् अरिंदमाः रिपूणाम् अमृतं नैव देयं भवति सर्वथा
verses.transliteration: gatās te ripavo 'smākaṃ daivayogād ariṃdamāḥ ripūṇām amṛtaṃ naiva deyaṃ bhavati sarvathā
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the lotus-born Brahma Devas felt joyous. They returned to their divine abodes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिस् तथेत्य् आह पुनर् आह सुरान् इदम्
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatis tathety āha punar āha surān idam
verses.translation: Immediately after he had obtained the boon, the asura Hiranyakasipu became haughty and he harassed his subjects.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न जानन्ति यथा पापा पिबध्वं च तथामृतम् अयम् एवोचितो मन्त्रो यच् छत्रूणां पराभवः
verses.transliteration: na jānanti yathā pāpā pibadhvaṃ ca tathāmṛtam ayam evocito mantro yac chatrūṇāṃ parābhavaḥ
verses.translation: He overpowered and insulted the highly blessed sages of holy rites, interested in truthfulness and piety and of subdued sense-organs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्वेष्याः सर्वात्मना द्वेष्या इति नीतिविदो विदुः न विश्वास्या न चाख्येया नैव मन्त्र्याश् च शत्रवः
verses.transliteration: dveṣyāḥ sarvātmanā dveṣyā iti nītivido viduḥ na viśvāsyā na cākhyeyā naiva mantryāś ca śatravaḥ
verses.translation: That great Asura defeated Devas stationed in heaven. He kept the three worlds under his control and lived in heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यो न देयम् अमृतं भवेयुर् अमरास् ततः अमरेषु च जातेषु तेषु दैत्येषु शत्रुषु ताञ् जेतुं नैव शक्ष्यामो न देयम् अमृतं ततः
verses.transliteration: tebhyo na deyam amṛtaṃ bhaveyur amarās tataḥ amareṣu ca jāteṣu teṣu daityeṣu śatruṣu tāñ jetuṃ naiva śakṣyāmo na deyam amṛtaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: Whenever that asura became haughty due to his obtaining the boon he roamed over the Earth. He made asuras worthy of shares in the Yajnas and Devas, unworthy of shares in the same.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति संमन्त्र्य ते देवा वाचस्पतिम् अथाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: iti saṃmantrya te devā vācaspatim athābruvan
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, save us today from the fear of Hiran- yakasipu. Indeed you are our greatest lord. You are our greatest preceptor.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्व यामः कुत्र मन्त्रः स्यात् क्व पिबामः क्व संस्थितिः कुर्मस् तद् एव प्रथमं वद वाचस्पते तथा
verses.transliteration: kva yāmaḥ kutra mantraḥ syāt kva pibāmaḥ kva saṃsthitiḥ kurmas tad eva prathamaṃ vada vācaspate tathā
verses.translation: O most excellent one among Devas, you are indeed the supreme creator of all of us, Brahma and others. O lord, with the eyes resembling thepetals of a full blown lotus devoid of impurities, O lord, the destroyer of the enemy hosts, be our refuge for the destruction of the race of Diti.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यान्तु ब्रह्माणम् अमराः पृच्छन्त्व् अत्र गतिं पराम् स तु ज्ञाता च वक्ता च दाता चैव पितामहः
verses.transliteration: yāntu brahmāṇam amarāḥ pṛcchantv atra gatiṃ parām sa tu jñātā ca vaktā ca dātā caiva pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: O immortal ones, cast off your fear. I grant you all, fearlessness. O Devas, you will regain heaven as before without delay.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतेर् वचः श्रुत्वा मदन्तिकम् अथागमन् नमस्य मां सुराः सर्वे यद् वृत्तं तन् न्यवेदयन्
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspater vacaḥ śrutvā madantikam athāgaman namasya māṃ surāḥ sarve yad vṛttaṃ tan nyavedayan
verses.translation: I shall kill this asura along with his attendants. I shall kill this leading Danava haughty on account of his acquiring the boon that he cannot be killed by the leading immortal
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् देववचनात् पुत्र तैः सुरैर् अगमं हरिम् विष्णवे कथितं सर्वं शंभवे विषहारिणे
verses.transliteration: tad devavacanāt putra taiḥ surair agamaṃ harim viṣṇave kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śaṃbhave viṣahāriṇe
verses.translation: After saying this to the chiefs of Devas and bidding
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहं विष्णुश् च शंभुश् च देवगन्धर्वकिंनरैः मेरुकन्दरम् आगत्य न जानन्ति यथासुराः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ viṣṇuś ca śaṃbhuś ca devagandharvakiṃnaraiḥ merukandaram āgatya na jānanti yathāsurāḥ
verses.translation: A further manifestation of Visnu the great Atman, in the nature of a living being, is well known as Dattatreya. He was equipped with great forbearance.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रक्षकं च हरिं कृत्वा सोमपानाय तस्थिरे आदित्यस् तत्र विज्ञाता सोमभोज्यान् अथेतरान्
verses.transliteration: rakṣakaṃ ca hariṃ kṛtvā somapānāya tasthire ādityas tatra vijñātā somabhojyān athetarān
verses.translation: O lord of the Earth, you will protect the entire Earth. Engaged in battle you become so dazzling that you will not be stared at by the enemy.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमो दातामृतं भागं चक्रधृग् रक्षकस् तथा नैव जानन्ति तद् दैत्या दनुजा राक्षसास् तथा
verses.transliteration: somo dātāmṛtaṃ bhāgaṃ cakradhṛg rakṣakas tathā naiva jānanti tad daityā danujā rākṣasās tathā
verses.translation: This glorious and auspicious manifestation of Visnu has been recounted to you. There is another manifestation of the great Atman namely Jamadagnya Parasurama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विना राहुं महाप्राज्ञं सैंहिकेयं च सोमपम् कामरूपधरो राहुर् मरुतां मध्यम् आविशत्
verses.transliteration: vinā rāhuṃ mahāprājñaṃ saiṃhikeyaṃ ca somapam kāmarūpadharo rāhur marutāṃ madhyam āviśat
verses.translation: In the course of this manifestation the lord Parasurama killed king Sahasrarjuna in battle. Previously he had been invincible to the enemies in battle by the prowess of his thousand arms.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मरुद्रूपं समास्थाय पानपात्रधरस् तथा ज्ञात्वा दिवाकरो दैत्यं तं सोमाय न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: marudrūpaṃ samāsthāya pānapātradharas tathā jñātvā divākaro daityaṃ taṃ somāya nyavedayat
verses.translation: The Earth where crores of Ksatriyas remained scatte¬ red about, the Earth that is adorned by the mountains Meru and Mandara was rid of Ksatriyas twentyone* times by the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदा तद् अमृतं तस्मै दैत्यायादैत्यरूपिणे दत्त्वा सोमं तदा सोमो विष्णवे तन् न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: tadā tad amṛtaṃ tasmai daityāyādaityarūpiṇe dattvā somaṃ tadā somo viṣṇave tan nyavedayat
verses.translation: After making the Earth devoid of Ksatriyas, Para¬ surama of great fame performed a horse sacrifice in order to dispel his sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुः पीतामृतं दैत्यं चक्रेणोद्यम्य तच्छिरः चिच्छेद तरसा वत्स तच्छिरस् त्व् अमरं त्व् अभूत्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuḥ pītāmṛtaṃ daityaṃ cakreṇodyamya tacchiraḥ ciccheda tarasā vatsa tacchiras tv amaraṃ tv abhūt
verses.translation: Rama the lord of the living beings killed Ravana who had a huge body, who was very powerful and who resembled a mass of clouds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिरोमात्रविहीनं यद् देहं तद् अपतद् भुवि देहं तद् अमृतस्पृष्टं पतितं दक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: śiromātravihīnaṃ yad dehaṃ tad apatad bhuvi dehaṃ tad amṛtaspṛṣṭaṃ patitaṃ dakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: For the sake of Sugrlva, Bali the powerful lord of monkeys was killed in battle and Sugrlva was crowned in his place.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतम्या मुनिशार्दूल कम्पयद् वसुधातलम् देहं चाप्य् अमरं पुत्र तद् अद्भुतम् इवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: gautamyā muniśārdūla kampayad vasudhātalam dehaṃ cāpy amaraṃ putra tad adbhutam ivābhavat
verses.translation: Janasthana: A part of DaijiJaka forest which lies in the basin of Godavari. Rama had lived in this forest with Sita and Laksmana for a long time during the period of his exile.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देहं च शिरसो ऽपेक्षि शिरो देहम् अपेक्षते उभयं चामरं जातं दैत्यश् चायं महाबलः
verses.transliteration: dehaṃ ca śiraso 'pekṣi śiro deham apekṣate ubhayaṃ cāmaraṃ jātaṃ daityaś cāyaṃ mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: The great Asura, the haughty son of Madhu, the Danava named Lavana, the heroic demon, proud of his boons was killed in the forest (named) Madhuvana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिरः काये समाविष्टं सर्वान् भक्षयते सुरान् तस्माद् देहम् इदं पूर्वं नाशयामो महीगतम् ततस् ते शंकरं प्राहुर् देवाः सर्वे ससंभ्रमाः
verses.transliteration: śiraḥ kāye samāviṣṭaṃ sarvān bhakṣayate surān tasmād deham idaṃ pūrvaṃ nāśayāmo mahīgatam tatas te śaṃkaraṃ prāhur devāḥ sarve sasaṃbhramāḥ
verses.translation: The tiger among men killed Viradha and Kabandha, the Raksasas of terrible exploits who had been formerly two Gandharvas deluded by imprecation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महीगतं दैत्यदेहं नाशयस्व सुरोत्तम त्वं देव करुणासिन्धुः शरणागतरक्षकः
verses.transliteration: mahīgataṃ daityadehaṃ nāśayasva surottama tvaṃ deva karuṇāsindhuḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣakaḥ
verses.translation: In the battle Rama killed his enemies by means of arrows, that had the lustre of fire, sun-rays and lightning streaks, that had the tail ends fitted with feathers of various kinds made of molten gold and the strength of which was like that of the thunderbolt of Mahendra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिरसा नैव युज्येत दैत्यदेहं तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: śirasā naiva yujyeta daityadehaṃ tathā kuru
verses.translation: Weapons were given to him by Visvaraitra the intelli¬ gent sage for slaying the enemies who could not be assailed even by Devas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रेषयाम् आस चेशो ऽपि श्रेष्ठां शक्तिं तदात्मनः मातृभिः सहितां देवीं मातरं लोकपालिनीम्
verses.transliteration: preṣayām āsa ceśo 'pi śreṣṭhāṃ śaktiṃ tadātmanaḥ mātṛbhiḥ sahitāṃ devīṃ mātaraṃ lokapālinīm
verses.translation: Formerly, when a certain sacrifice yvas performed by Janaka the great Atman, the great bow belonging to Mahesvara was broken by him even as he playfully and sportingly touched it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ईशायुधधरा देवी ईशशक्तिसमन्विता महीगतं यत्र देहं तत्रागाद् भक्ष्यकाङ्क्षिणी
verses.transliteration: īśāyudhadharā devī īśaśaktisamanvitā mahīgataṃ yatra dehaṃ tatrāgād bhakṣyakāṅkṣiṇī
verses.translation: After performing these tasks Rama the most excellent among the virtuous performed ten horse-sacrifices where flesh was offered to the deities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिरोमात्रं सुराः सर्वे मेरौ तत्रैव सान्त्वयन् देहो देव्या पुनस् तत्र युयुधे बहवः समाः
verses.transliteration: śiromātraṃ surāḥ sarve merau tatraiva sāntvayan deho devyā punas tatra yuyudhe bahavaḥ samāḥ
verses.translation: No widow lamented. There were no calamities. Every¬ thing was auspicious when Rama was ruling over the earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राहुस् तत्र सुरान् आह भित्त्वा देहं पुरा मम अत्रास्ते रसम् उत्कृष्टं तद् आकृष्य शरीरतः
verses.transliteration: rāhus tatra surān āha bhittvā dehaṃ purā mama atrāste rasam utkṛṣṭaṃ tad ākṛṣya śarīrataḥ
verses.translation: No living being had any fear from water, fire, wind or blows (of any sort). Old men never performed the funeral rites of boys (i.e. boys never died before old men).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पृथक्भूते रसे देहं प्रवरे ऽमृतम् उत्तमम् भस्मीभूयात् क्षणेनैव तस्मात् कुर्वन्तु तत् पुरा
verses.transliteration: pṛthakbhūte rase dehaṃ pravare 'mṛtam uttamam bhasmībhūyāt kṣaṇenaiva tasmāt kurvantu tat purā
verses.translation: The Ksatriyas were devoted to the Brahmins. The Vaisyas were devoted to the Ksatriyas. The Sudras served the three castes without any pride or egotism.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतद् राहुवचः श्रुत्वा प्रीताः सर्वे ऽसुरारयः अभ्यषिञ्चन् ग्रहाणां त्वं ग्रहो भूया मुदान्वितः
verses.transliteration: etad rāhuvacaḥ śrutvā prītāḥ sarve 'surārayaḥ abhyaṣiñcan grahāṇāṃ tvaṃ graho bhūyā mudānvitaḥ
verses.translation: Women did not stray from their husbands; the hus¬ band did not stray from his wife. The entire universe was restrained and subdued. The earth was rid of robbers.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद्देववचनाच् छक्तिर् ईश्वरी या निगद्यते देहं भित्त्वा दैत्यपतेः सुरशक्तिसमन्विता
verses.transliteration: taddevavacanāc chaktir īśvarī yā nigadyate dehaṃ bhittvā daityapateḥ suraśaktisamanvitā
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आकृष्य शीघ्रम् उत्कृष्टं प्रवरं चामृतं बहिः स्थापयित्वा तु तद् देहं भक्षयाम् आस चाम्बिका
verses.transliteration: ākṛṣya śīghram utkṛṣṭaṃ pravaraṃ cāmṛtaṃ bahiḥ sthāpayitvā tu tad dehaṃ bhakṣayām āsa cāmbikā
verses.translation: All the jewels of the kings were taken away by him
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कालरात्रिर् भद्रकाली प्रोच्यते या महाबला स्थापितं रसम् उत्कृष्टं रसानां प्रवरं रसम्
verses.transliteration: kālarātrir bhadrakālī procyate yā mahābalā sthāpitaṃ rasam utkṛṣṭaṃ rasānāṃ pravaraṃ rasam
verses.translation: The following manifestation of the great Atman is conducive to the welfare of the world. It is the manifestation of Kalki named Visnuyasas also. It will occur in the village of Sambhala.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: व्यस्रवत् स्थापितं तत् तु प्रवरा साभवन् नदी आकृष्टम् अमृतं चैव स्थापितं साप्य् अभक्षयत्
verses.transliteration: vyasravat sthāpitaṃ tat tu pravarā sābhavan nadī ākṛṣṭam amṛtaṃ caiva sthāpitaṃ sāpy abhakṣayat
verses.translation: The Puranais on a par with the Vedas and Srutis (?) The enumeration of manifestation is but indicatory, not exhaus¬ tive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः श्रेष्ठा नदी जाता प्रवरा चामृता शुभा राहुदेहसमुद्भूता रुद्रशक्तिसमन्विता
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śreṣṭhā nadī jātā pravarā cāmṛtā śubhā rāhudehasamudbhūtā rudraśaktisamanvitā
verses.translation: The Puranais on a par with the Vedas and Srutis (?) The enumeration of manifestation is but indicatory, not exhaus¬ tive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नदीनां प्रवरा रम्या चामृता प्रेरिता तहा तत्र पञ्च सहस्राणि तीर्थानि गुणवन्ति च
verses.transliteration: nadīnāṃ pravarā ramyā cāmṛtā preritā tahā tatra pañca sahasrāṇi tīrthāni guṇavanti ca
verses.translation: The Puranais on a par with the Vedas and Srutis (?) The enumeration of manifestation is but indicatory, not exhaus¬ tive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र शंभुः स्वयं तस्थौ सर्वदा सुरपूजितः तस्यै तुष्टाः सुराः सर्वे देव्यै नद्यै पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: tatra śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ tasthau sarvadā surapūjitaḥ tasyai tuṣṭāḥ surāḥ sarve devyai nadyai pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: The Puranais on a par with the Vedas and Srutis (?) The enumeration of manifestation is but indicatory, not exhaus¬ tive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वरान् ददुर् मुदा युक्ता यथा पूजाम् अवाप्स्यति शंभुः सुरपतिर् लोके तथा पूजाम् अवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: varān dadur mudā yuktā yathā pūjām avāpsyati śaṃbhuḥ surapatir loke tathā pūjām avāpsyasi
verses.translation: The Puranais on a par with the Vedas and Srutis (?) The enumeration of manifestation is but indicatory, not exhaus¬ tive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निवासं कुरु देवि त्वं लोकानां हितकाम्यया सदा तिष्ठ रसेशानि सर्वेषां सर्वसिद्धिदा
verses.transliteration: nivāsaṃ kuru devi tvaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā sadā tiṣṭha raseśāni sarveṣāṃ sarvasiddhidā
verses.translation: The Puranais on a par with the Vedas and Srutis (?) The enumeration of manifestation is but indicatory, not exhaus¬ tive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्तवनात् कीर्तनाद् ध्यानात् सर्वकामप्रदायिनी त्वां नमस्यन्ति ये भक्त्या किंचिद् आपेक्ष्य सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: stavanāt kīrtanād dhyānāt sarvakāmapradāyinī tvāṃ namasyanti ye bhaktyā kiṃcid āpekṣya sarvadā
verses.translation: The Puranais on a par with the Vedas and Srutis (?) The enumeration of manifestation is but indicatory, not exhaus¬ tive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेषां सर्वाणि कार्याणि भवेयुर् देवताज्ञया शिवशक्त्योर् यतस् तस्मिन् निवासो ऽभूत् सनातनः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi bhaveyur devatājñayā śivaśaktyor yatas tasmin nivāso 'bhūt sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: The Puranais on a par with the Vedas and Srutis (?) The enumeration of manifestation is but indicatory, not exhaus¬ tive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अतो वदन्ति मुनयो निवासपुरम् इत्य् अदः प्रवरायाः पुरा देवाः सुप्रीतास् ते वरान् ददुः
verses.transliteration: ato vadanti munayo nivāsapuram ity adaḥ pravarāyāḥ purā devāḥ suprītās te varān daduḥ
verses.translation: The Puranais on a par with the Vedas and Srutis (?) The enumeration of manifestation is but indicatory, not exhaus¬ tive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गायाः संगमो यस् ते विख्यातः सुरवल्लभः तत्राप्लुतानां सर्वेषां भुक्तिर् वा मुक्तिर् एव च
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāyāḥ saṃgamo yas te vikhyātaḥ suravallabhaḥ tatrāplutānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhuktir vā muktir eva ca
verses.translation: The Puranais on a par with the Vedas and Srutis (?) The enumeration of manifestation is but indicatory, not exhaus¬ tive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यद् वापि मनसः काम्यं देवानाम् अपि दुर्लभम् स्यात् तेषां सर्वम् एवेह एवं दत्त्वा सुरा ययुः
verses.transliteration: yad vāpi manasaḥ kāmyaṃ devānām api durlabham syāt teṣāṃ sarvam eveha evaṃ dattvā surā yayuḥ
verses.translation: The Puranais on a par with the Vedas and Srutis (?) The enumeration of manifestation is but indicatory, not exhaus¬ tive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं प्रवरासंगमं विदुः प्रेरिता देवदेवेन शक्तिर् या प्रेरिता तु सा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ pravarāsaṃgamaṃ viduḥ preritā devadevena śaktir yā preritā tu sā
verses.translation: The Puranais on a par with the Vedas and Srutis (?) The enumeration of manifestation is but indicatory, not exhaus¬ tive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अमृता सैव विख्याता प्रवरैवं महानदी
verses.transliteration: amṛtā saiva vikhyātā pravaraivaṃ mahānadī
verses.translation: The Puranais on a par with the Vedas and Srutis (?) The enumeration of manifestation is but indicatory, not exhaus¬ tive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धासंगमम् आख्यातं यत्र वृद्धेश्वरः शिवः तस्याख्यानं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु पापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: vṛddhāsaṃgamam ākhyātaṃ yatra vṛddheśvaraḥ śivaḥ tasyākhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu pāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: O sage, we are not satiated by hearing about holy meritorious rites. Greatly sung by you they are like nectar. Our enthusiasm is further increased.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतमो वृद्ध इत्य् उक्तो मुनिर् आसीन् महातपाः यदा पुराभवद् बालो गौतमस्य सुतो द्विजः
verses.transliteration: gautamo vṛddha ity ukto munir āsīn mahātapāḥ yadā purābhavad bālo gautamasya suto dvijaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, you know everything, origin and dissolution of living beings and the goal reached through actions. Hence, we ask you, O great sage.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनासः स पुरोत्पन्नस् तस्माद् विकृतरूपधृक् स वैराग्याज् जगामाथ देशं तीर्थम् इतस् ततः
verses.transliteration: anāsaḥ sa purotpannas tasmād vikṛtarūpadhṛk sa vairāgyāj jagāmātha deśaṃ tīrtham itas tataḥ
verses.translation: How do men go to the abode of Yama through that path? O foremost among eloquent persons, tell us the magni¬ tude and extent of the path.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपाध्यायेन नैवासील् लज्जितस्य समागमः शिष्यैर् अन्यैः सहाध्यायो लज्जितस्य च नाभवत्
verses.transliteration: upādhyāyena naivāsīl lajjitasya samāgamaḥ śiṣyair anyaiḥ sahādhyāyo lajjitasya ca nābhavat
verses.translation: O omniscient sage, we earnesdy ask you to tell us entirely. O sage, how do men avert the miseries of hell?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपनीतः कथंचिच् च पित्रा वै गौतमेन सः एतावता गौतमो ऽपि व्यगमच् चरितुं बहिः
verses.transliteration: upanītaḥ kathaṃcic ca pitrā vai gautamena saḥ etāvatā gautamo 'pi vyagamac carituṃ bahiḥ
verses.translation: By what means do they prevent the hellish tortures? By charitable gifts, holy rites and observances?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं बहुतिथे काले ब्रह्ममात्रा धृते द्विजे नैव चाध्ययनं तस्य संजातं गौतमस्य हि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bahutithe kāle brahmamātrā dhṛte dvije naiva cādhyayanaṃ tasya saṃjātaṃ gautamasya hi
verses.translation: How do people attain the heavenly goal? By what deeds do they go to hell? How many are the abodes in heaven? How many are the hellish abodes?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नैव शास्त्रस्य चाभ्यासो गौतमस्याभवत् तदा अग्निकार्यं ततश् चक्रे नित्यम् एव यतव्रतः
verses.transliteration: naiva śāstrasya cābhyāso gautamasyābhavat tadā agnikāryaṃ tataś cakre nityam eva yatavrataḥ
verses.translation: How do men of good deeds go? How do men of evil deeds go? What is the form and what is the magnitude? What is the caste of the two? Even as an individual soul is being led to Yama's abode what is its form, shape and extent?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गायत्र्यभ्यासमात्रेण ब्राह्मणो नामधारकः अग्न्युपासनमात्रं च गायत्र्यभ्यसनं तथा
verses.transliteration: gāyatryabhyāsamātreṇa brāhmaṇo nāmadhārakaḥ agnyupāsanamātraṃ ca gāyatryabhyasanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: O leading sages, listen, even as I recount. O sages of good holy rites, the cycle of worldly existence is unageing. It has no permanent existence.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतावता ब्राह्मणत्वं गौतमस्याभवन् मुने उपासतो ऽग्निं विधिवद् गायत्रीं च महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: etāvatā brāhmaṇatvaṃ gautamasyābhavan mune upāsato 'gniṃ vidhivad gāyatrīṃ ca mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: I shall decisively mention the path of Yama entirely. I shall recount everything in detail beginning from the time of departure. I shall recount it in a manner that no one else will be able to recount.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यायुर् ववृधे पुत्र गौतमस्य चिरायुषः न दारसंग्रहं लेभे नैव दातास्ति कन्यकाम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāyur vavṛdhe putra gautamasya cirāyuṣaḥ na dārasaṃgrahaṃ lebhe naiva dātāsti kanyakām
verses.translation: O excellent ones, I shall mention the form and nature of the path about which you have asked me and also the dis¬ tance between the world of Yama and the mortal world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा चरंस् तीर्थदेशे वनेषु विविधेषु च आश्रमेषु च पुण्येषु अटन्न् आस्ते स गौतमः
verses.transliteration: tathā caraṃs tīrthadeśe vaneṣu vividheṣu ca āśrameṣu ca puṇyeṣu aṭann āste sa gautamaḥ
verses.translation: That pathway should of necessity be traversed by all living beings called individual souls. Meritorious men go to the meritorious sections and the sinful go to the sinful.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं भ्रमञ् शीतगिरिम् आश्रित्यास्ते स गौतमः तत्रापश्यद् गुहां रम्यां वल्लीविटपमालिनीम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bhramañ śītagirim āśrityāste sa gautamaḥ tatrāpaśyad guhāṃ ramyāṃ vallīviṭapamālinīm
verses.translation: Those who make charitable gifts of water and cooked rice do not undergo any forture there along with their wives, sons and kins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रोपविश्य विप्रेन्द्रो वस्तुं समकरोन् मतिम् चिन्तयंस् तु प्रविष्टो ऽसाव् अपश्यत् स्त्रियम् उत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: tatropaviśya viprendro vastuṃ samakaron matim cintayaṃs tu praviṣṭo 'sāv apaśyat striyam uttamām
verses.translation: He who makes a charitable gift of cooked rice with the mind sanctified by faith derives satisfaction there even without (the presence of) cooked rice then.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिथिलाङ्गीम् अथ कृशां वृद्धां च तपसि स्थिताम् ब्रह्मचर्येण वर्तन्तीं विरागां रहसि स्थिताम्
verses.transliteration: śithilāṅgīm atha kṛśāṃ vṛddhāṃ ca tapasi sthitām brahmacaryeṇa vartantīṃ virāgāṃ rahasi sthitām
verses.translation: The tlieist who lias faith in God or holy scriptures, utters no falsehood and by whom severance of affection has not been effected, attains a happy death.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स तां दृष्ट्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठो नमस्काराय तस्थिवान् नमस्यन्तं मुनिश्रेष्ठं तं गौतमम् अवारयत्
verses.transliteration: sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā muniśreṣṭho namaskārāya tasthivān namasyantaṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ taṃ gautamam avārayat
verses.translation: These men face a happy death:—those who are devot¬ ed to the worship of Devas and brahmins, those who are not jealous, those who have spotless character, those who are liberal in gifts and those who possess the attribute of modesty.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गुरुस् त्वं भविता मह्यं न मां वन्दितुम् अर्हसि आयुर् विद्या धनं कीर्तिर् धर्मः स्वर्गादिकं च यत् तस्य नश्यति वै सर्वं यं नमस्यति वै गुरुः
verses.transliteration: gurus tvaṃ bhavitā mahyaṃ na māṃ vanditum arhasi āyur vidyā dhanaṃ kīrtir dharmaḥ svargādikaṃ ca yat tasya naśyati vai sarvaṃ yaṃ namasyati vai guruḥ
verses.translation: He who does not eschew virtue either due to lust or due to fury or out of hatred; he who carries out what is men¬ tioned by elders and he who is gentle meets with a comfortable death.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिपुटस् तां वै गौतमः प्राह विस्मितः
verses.transliteration: kṛtāñjalipuṭas tāṃ vai gautamaḥ prāha vismitaḥ
verses.translation: Those who offer water to the thirsty, give food to the hungry, meet with timely death with ease and happiness.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तपस्विनी त्वं वृद्धा च गुणज्येष्ठा च भामिनी अल्पविद्यस् त्व् अल्पवया अहं तव गुरुः कथम्
verses.transliteration: tapasvinī tvaṃ vṛddhā ca guṇajyeṣṭhā ca bhāminī alpavidyas tv alpavayā ahaṃ tava guruḥ katham
verses.translation: He attains another body having the same shape as the previous one. It is for experiencing the tortures caused by his bad Karman. This body does not originate from the parents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आर्ष्टिषेणप्रियपुत्र ऋतध्वज इति श्रुतः गुणवान् मतिमाञ् शूरः क्षत्रधर्मपरायणः
verses.transliteration: ārṣṭiṣeṇapriyaputra ṛtadhvaja iti śrutaḥ guṇavān matimāñ śūraḥ kṣatradharmaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Watched by those people in distress, with their eyes full of tears he casts off his body, attains a gaseous form and goes ahead.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स कदाचिद् वनं प्रायान् मृगयाकृष्टचेतनः विश्रामम् अकरोद् अस्यां गुहायां स ऋतध्वजः
verses.transliteration: sa kadācid vanaṃ prāyān mṛgayākṛṣṭacetanaḥ viśrāmam akarod asyāṃ guhāyāṃ sa ṛtadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the living creature with the span of life extinct, the terrible emissaries of Yama come there desirous of taking him aw&y.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: युवा स मतिमान् दक्षो बलेन महता वृतः तं विश्रान्तं नृपवरम् अप्सरा ददृशे ततः
verses.transliteration: yuvā sa matimān dakṣo balena mahatā vṛtaḥ taṃ viśrāntaṃ nṛpavaram apsarā dadṛśe tataḥ
verses.translation: The emissaries of Yama are excessively terrible and competent to frighten all living beings. They assume different forms and their faces resembl.e those of bears, buffaloes, vampires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वराजस्य सुता सुश्यामा इति विश्रुता तां दृष्ट्वा चकमे राजा राजानं चकमे च सा
verses.transliteration: gandharvarājasya sutā suśyāmā iti viśrutā tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cakame rājā rājānaṃ cakame ca sā
verses.translation: Some have long faces; some are hideous-faced; some have crooked nooses; some have three eyes. They have massive jaw bones, cheeks and faces. Some have hanging lips.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति क्रीडा समभवत् तया राज्ञो महामते निवृत्तकामो राजेन्द्रस् ताम् आपृच्छ्यागमद् गृहम्
verses.transliteration: iti krīḍā samabhavat tayā rājño mahāmate nivṛttakāmo rājendras tām āpṛcchyāgamad gṛham
verses.translation: The limbs of some are smeared with blood and flesh. Their teeth come out of their mouths resembling spouts of shooting plants. They arc very hideous in their shape. Their curved fangs are very fierce.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नाहं ततस् तस्यां सुश्यामायां महामते गच्छन्ती मां तदा माता इदम् आह तपोधन
verses.transliteration: utpannāhaṃ tatas tasyāṃ suśyāmāyāṃ mahāmate gacchantī māṃ tadā mātā idam āha tapodhana
verses.translation: Their mouths resemble the nether worlds with blazing terrible tongues. The eyes are awful in their shape and size. They are shining, roving and tawny-coloured.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस् त्व् अस्यां प्रविशेद् भद्रे स ते भर्ता भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: yas tv asyāṃ praviśed bhadre sa te bhartā bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: The eyes of some resemble fire or the eyes of the cat or owl. Some eyes are protruded like the eyes of the beetle. Some resemble the glowworm. Their hair are dishevelled and stand erect.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा सा जगमाथ माता मम महामते तस्माद् अत्र प्रविष्टस् त्वं पुमान् नान्यः कदाचन
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā sā jagamātha mātā mama mahāmate tasmād atra praviṣṭas tvaṃ pumān nānyaḥ kadācana
verses.translation: They are bedecked in garlands and skulls. Their limbs drip with blood (?). Their ornaments resemble terrible ser¬ pents tied up round their heads.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राणि तथाशीतिं कृत्वा राज्यं पिता मम अत्रैव च तपस् तप्त्वा ततः स्वर्गम् उपेयिवान्
verses.transliteration: sahasrāṇi tathāśītiṃ kṛtvā rājyaṃ pitā mama atraiva ca tapas taptvā tataḥ svargam upeyivān
verses.translation: There are black serpents round their necks. They are very terrible due to their kissing sounds. Their tresses are coarse and stiff. They arc terrible and they resemble fiery flames.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गं याते ऽपि पितरि सहस्राणि तथा दश वर्षाणि मुनिशार्दूल राज्यं कृत्वा तथा परः
verses.transliteration: svargaṃ yāte 'pi pitari sahasrāṇi tathā daśa varṣāṇi muniśārdūla rājyaṃ kṛtvā tathā paraḥ
verses.translation: Some of them have only two arms; others have four arms, still others have ten, sixteen or twenty arms. •
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गे यातो मम भ्राता अहम् अत्रैव संस्थिता अहं ब्रह्मन् नान्यवृत्ता न माता न पिता मम
verses.transliteration: svarge yāto mama bhrātā aham atraiva saṃsthitā ahaṃ brahman nānyavṛttā na mātā na pitā mama
verses.translation: There are still others with innumrable hands. Some of them have thousand arms. Terrible weapons of various forms shine in their hands.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहम् आत्मेश्वरी ब्रह्मन् निविष्टा क्षत्रकन्यका तस्माद् भजस्व मां ब्रह्मन् व्रतस्थां पुरुषार्थिनीम्
verses.transliteration: aham ātmeśvarī brahman niviṣṭā kṣatrakanyakā tasmād bhajasva māṃ brahman vratasthāṃ puruṣārthinīm
verses.translation: These emissaries of great strength threaten the aying men with different brilliant weapons such as javelin, iron club, discus etc. or nooses, fetters and batons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रायुर् अहं भद्रे मत्तस् त्वं वयसाधिका अहं बालस् त्वं तु वृद्धा नैवायं घटते मिथः
verses.transliteration: sahasrāyur ahaṃ bhadre mattas tvaṃ vayasādhikā ahaṃ bālas tvaṃ tu vṛddhā naivāyaṃ ghaṭate mithaḥ
verses.translation: When the span of life of the men comes to an end these extremely terrible emissaries come to take away the creatures. All of them carry out the orders of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वं भर्ता मे पुरा दिष्टो नान्यो भर्ता मतो मम धात्रा दत्तस् ततस् त्वं मां न निराकर्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ bhartā me purā diṣṭo nānyo bhartā mato mama dhātrā dattas tatas tvaṃ māṃ na nirākartum arhasi
verses.translation: The creature assumes a physical body befitting tortures in the hell and originating from its own actions. It is this body of the creature that is taken away towards the abode of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
