verses.sanskrit: अथवा नेच्छसि मां त्वम् अप्रदुष्टाम् अनुव्रताम् ततस् त्यक्ष्यामि जीवं मे इदानीं तव पश्यतः
verses.transliteration: athavā necchasi māṃ tvam apraduṣṭām anuvratām tatas tyakṣyāmi jīvaṃ me idānīṃ tava paśyataḥ
verses.translation: With the nooses, adamantine fetters andiron chains, the creature is bound by the infuriated servants of Yama. He is beaten and taken over to the abode of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अपेक्षिताप्राप्तितो हि देहिनां मरणं वरम् अनुरक्तजनत्यागे पातकान्तो न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: apekṣitāprāptito hi dehināṃ maraṇaṃ varam anuraktajanatyāge pātakānto na vidyate
verses.translation: That great path has to be traversed by these sinful per¬ sons frightened in some places, terrified in some places and faltering here and there. They are shouting and lamenting due to misery.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धायास् तद् वचः श्रुत्वा गौतमो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vṛddhāyās tad vacaḥ śrutvā gautamo vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: The living beings have to traverse the path even as they are rebuked and burnt in their bodies, They are agitated due to terror. They run about in great dejection and agitation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहं तपोविरहितो विद्याहीनो ह्य् अकिंचनः नाहं वरो हि योग्यस् ते कुरूपो भोगवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ tapovirahito vidyāhīno hy akiṃcanaḥ nāhaṃ varo hi yogyas te kurūpo bhogavarjitaḥ
verses.translation: Men who are devoid of charitable gifts are scorched and burnt by the heated sand. They have to go along the path strewn with thorns.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनासो ऽहं किं करोमि अतपोविद्य एव च तस्मात् सुरूपं सुविद्याम् आपाद्य प्रथमं शुभे पश्चात् ते वचनं कार्यं ततो वृद्धाब्रवीद् द्विजम्
verses.transliteration: anāso 'haṃ kiṃ karomi atapovidya eva ca tasmāt surūpaṃ suvidyām āpādya prathamaṃ śubhe paścāt te vacanaṃ kāryaṃ tato vṛddhābravīd dvijam
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings have to traverse the path with their bodies emitting putrescent odour of
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मया सरस्वती देवी तोषिता तपसा द्विज तथैवापो रूपवत्यो रूपदाताग्निर् एव च
verses.transliteration: mayā sarasvatī devī toṣitā tapasā dvija tathaivāpo rūpavatyo rūpadātāgnir eva ca
verses.translation: The destroyers of living beings must of necessity go along the path shouting and lamenting, cooing and chirping out of tune. They shall be in agony due to their pain.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् वागीश्वरी देवी सा ते विद्यां प्रदास्यति अग्निश् च रूपवान् देवस् तव रूपं प्रदास्यति
verses.transliteration: tasmād vāgīśvarī devī sā te vidyāṃ pradāsyati agniś ca rūpavān devas tava rūpaṃ pradāsyati
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा गौतमं तं वृद्धोवाच विभावसुम् प्रार्थयित्वा सुविद्यं तं सुरूपं चाकरोन् मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā gautamaṃ taṃ vṛddhovāca vibhāvasum prārthayitvā suvidyaṃ taṃ surūpaṃ cākaron munim
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुविद्यः सुभगः सुकान्तो वृद्धां स पत्नीम् अकरोत् प्रीतियुक्तः तया स रेमे बहुला मनोज्ञया समाः सुखं प्रीतमना गुहायाम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ suvidyaḥ subhagaḥ sukānto vṛddhāṃ sa patnīm akarot prītiyuktaḥ tayā sa reme bahulā manojñayā samāḥ sukhaṃ prītamanā guhāyām
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित् तत्र वसतोर् दंपत्योर् मुदतोर् गिरौ गुहायां मुनिशार्दूल आजग्मुर् मुनयो ऽमलाः
verses.transliteration: kadācit tatra vasator daṃpatyor mudator girau guhāyāṃ muniśārdūla ājagmur munayo 'malāḥ
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठवामदेवाद्या ये चान्ये च महर्षयः भ्रमन्तः पुण्यतीर्थानि प्राप्नुवंस् तस्य तां गुहाम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhavāmadevādyā ye cānye ca maharṣayaḥ bhramantaḥ puṇyatīrthāni prāpnuvaṃs tasya tāṃ guhām
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आगतांस् तान् ऋषीञ् ज्ञात्वा गौतमः सह भार्यया सत्कारम् अकरोत् तेषां जहसुस् तं च केचन
verses.transliteration: āgatāṃs tān ṛṣīñ jñātvā gautamaḥ saha bhāryayā satkāram akarot teṣāṃ jahasus taṃ ca kecana
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये बाला यौवनोन्मत्ता वयसा ये च मध्यमाः वृद्धां च गौतमं प्रेक्ष्य जहसुस् तत्र केचन
verses.transliteration: ye bālā yauvanonmattā vayasā ye ca madhyamāḥ vṛddhāṃ ca gautamaṃ prekṣya jahasus tatra kecana
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रो ऽयं तव पौत्रो वा वृद्धे को गौतमो ऽभवत् सत्यं वदस्व कल्याणि इत्य् एवं जहसुर् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: putro 'yaṃ tava pautro vā vṛddhe ko gautamo 'bhavat satyaṃ vadasva kalyāṇi ity evaṃ jahasur dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विषं वृद्धस्य युवती वृद्धाया अमृतं युवा इष्टानिष्टसमायोगो दृष्टो ऽस्माभिर् अहो चिरात्
verses.transliteration: viṣaṃ vṛddhasya yuvatī vṛddhāyā amṛtaṃ yuvā iṣṭāniṣṭasamāyogo dṛṣṭo 'smābhir aho cirāt
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवम् ऊचिरे केचिद् दंपत्योः शृण्वतोस् तदा एवम् उक्त्वा कृतातिथ्या ययुः सर्वे महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: ity evam ūcire kecid daṃpatyoḥ śṛṇvatos tadā evam uktvā kṛtātithyā yayuḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां वचनं श्रुत्वा उभाव् अपि सुदुःखितौ लज्जितौ च महाप्राज्ञौ गौतमो भार्यया सह पप्रच्छ मुनिशार्दूलम् अगस्त्यम् ऋषिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā ubhāv api suduḥkhitau lajjitau ca mahāprājñau gautamo bhāryayā saha papraccha muniśārdūlam agastyam ṛṣisattamam
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: को देशः किम् उ तीर्थं वा यत्र श्रेयः समाप्यते शीघ्रम् एव महाप्राज्ञ भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: ko deśaḥ kim u tīrthaṃ vā yatra śreyaḥ samāpyate śīghram eva mahāprājña bhuktimuktipradāyakam
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वदद्भिर् मुनिभिर् ब्रह्मन् मया श्रुतम् इदं वचः सर्वे कामास् तत्र पूर्णा गौतम्यां नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: vadadbhir munibhir brahman mayā śrutam idaṃ vacaḥ sarve kāmās tatra pūrṇā gautamyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् गच्छ महाबुद्धे गौतमीं पापनाशिनीम् अहं त्वाम् अनुयास्यामि यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: tasmād gaccha mahābuddhe gautamīṃ pāpanāśinīm ahaṃ tvām anuyāsyāmi yathecchasi tathā kuru
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वागस्त्यवाक्यं वृद्धया गौतमो ऽभ्यगात् तत्र तेपे तपस् तीव्रं पत्न्या स भगवान् ऋषिः
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvāgastyavākyaṃ vṛddhayā gautamo 'bhyagāt tatra tepe tapas tīvraṃ patnyā sa bhagavān ṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्तुतिं चकार देवस्य शंभोर् विष्णोस् तथैव च गङ्गां च तोषयाम् आस भार्यार्थं भगवान् ऋषिः
verses.transliteration: stutiṃ cakāra devasya śaṃbhor viṣṇos tathaiva ca gaṅgāṃ ca toṣayām āsa bhāryārthaṃ bhagavān ṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: खिन्नात्मनाम् अत्र भवे त्वम् एव शरणं शिवः मरुभूमाव् अध्वगानां विटपीव प्रियायुतः
verses.transliteration: khinnātmanām atra bhave tvam eva śaraṇaṃ śivaḥ marubhūmāv adhvagānāṃ viṭapīva priyāyutaḥ
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उच्चावचानां भूतानां सर्वथा पापनोदनः सस्यानां घनवत् कृष्ण त्वम् अवग्रहशोषिणाम्
verses.transliteration: uccāvacānāṃ bhūtānāṃ sarvathā pāpanodanaḥ sasyānāṃ ghanavat kṛṣṇa tvam avagrahaśoṣiṇām
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैकुण्ठदुर्गनिःश्रेणिस् त्वं पीयूषतरंगिणी अधोगतानां तप्तानां शरणं भव गौतमि
verses.transliteration: vaikuṇṭhadurganiḥśreṇis tvaṃ pīyūṣataraṃgiṇī adhogatānāṃ taptānāṃ śaraṇaṃ bhava gautami
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तुष्टावदद् वाक्यं गौतमं वृद्धया युतम् शरणागतदीनार्तं शरण्या गौतमी मुदा
verses.transliteration: tatas tuṣṭāvadad vākyaṃ gautamaṃ vṛddhayā yutam śaraṇāgatadīnārtaṃ śaraṇyā gautamī mudā
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अभिषिञ्चस्व भार्यां त्वं मज्जलैर् मन्त्रसंयुतैः कलशैर् उपचारैश् च ततः पत्नी तव प्रिया
verses.transliteration: abhiṣiñcasva bhāryāṃ tvaṃ majjalair mantrasaṃyutaiḥ kalaśair upacāraiś ca tataḥ patnī tava priyā
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुरूपा चारुसर्वाङ्गी सुभगा चारुलोचना सर्वलक्षणसंपूर्णा रम्यरूपम् अवाप्स्यति
verses.transliteration: surūpā cārusarvāṅgī subhagā cārulocanā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇā ramyarūpam avāpsyati
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रूपवत्या पुनस् त्वं वै भार्यया चाभिषेचितः सर्वलक्षणसंपूर्णः कान्तं रूपम् अवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: rūpavatyā punas tvaṃ vai bhāryayā cābhiṣecitaḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaḥ kāntaṃ rūpam avāpsyasi
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेति गाङ्गवचनाद् यथोक्तं तौ च चक्रतुः सुरूपताम् उभौ प्राप्तौ गौतम्याश् च प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: tatheti gāṅgavacanād yathoktaṃ tau ca cakratuḥ surūpatām ubhau prāptau gautamyāś ca prasādataḥ
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अभिषेकोदकं यच् च सा नदी समजायत तस्या नाम्ना तु विख्याता वृद्धाया मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: abhiṣekodakaṃ yac ca sā nadī samajāyata tasyā nāmnā tu vikhyātā vṛddhāyā munisattama
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धा नदीति विख्याता गौतमो ऽपि तथोच्यते वृद्धगौतम इत्य् उक्त ऋषिभिः समवासिभिः वृद्धा तु गौतमीं प्राह गङ्गां प्रत्यक्षरूपिणीम्
verses.transliteration: vṛddhā nadīti vikhyātā gautamo 'pi tathocyate vṛddhagautama ity ukta ṛṣibhiḥ samavāsibhiḥ vṛddhā tu gautamīṃ prāha gaṅgāṃ pratyakṣarūpiṇīm
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मन्नाम्नीयं नदी देवि वृद्धा चेत्य् अभिधीयताम् त्वया च संगमस् तस्यास् तस्यास् तीर्थम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: mannāmnīyaṃ nadī devi vṛddhā cety abhidhīyatām tvayā ca saṃgamas tasyās tasyās tīrtham anuttamam
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रूपसौभाग्यसंपत्तिपुत्रपौत्रप्रवर्धनम् आयुरारोग्यकल्याणं जयप्रीतिविवर्धनम् स्नानदानादिहोमैश् च पितॄणां पावनं परम्
verses.transliteration: rūpasaubhāgyasaṃpattiputrapautrapravardhanam āyurārogyakalyāṇaṃ jayaprītivivardhanam snānadānādihomaiś ca pitṝṇāṃ pāvanaṃ param
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्व् इत्य् आह च तां गङ्गा सुवृद्धां गौतमप्रियाम् गौतमस्थापितं लिङ्गं वृद्धानाम्नैव कीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: astv ity āha ca tāṃ gaṅgā suvṛddhāṃ gautamapriyām gautamasthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ vṛddhānāmnaiva kīrtitam
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव च मुदं प्राप्तो वृद्धया मुनिसत्तमः तत्र स्नानं च दानं च सर्वाभीष्टप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: tatraiva ca mudaṃ prāpto vṛddhayā munisattamaḥ tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakam
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं वृद्धासंगमम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ vṛddhāsaṃgamam ucyate
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इलातीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वसिद्धिकरं नृणाम् ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानां पावनं सर्वकामदम्
verses.transliteration: ilātīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ pāvanaṃ sarvakāmadam
verses.translation: O ascetic, how do the sinners go to that city by the southern path? We wish to hear. Recount it in detail.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतान्वये जात इलो नाम जनेश्वरः महत्या सेनया सार्धं जगाम मृगयावनम्
verses.transliteration: vaivasvatānvaye jāta ilo nāma janeśvaraḥ mahatyā senayā sārdhaṃ jagāma mṛgayāvanam
verses.translation: On seeing such a terrible doorway, those who have committed sins faint and lose consciousness suddenly. They begin to babble and prattle due to fear.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: परिबभ्राम गहनं बहुव्यालसमाकुलम् नानाकारद्विजयुतं विटपैः परिशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: paribabhrāma gahanaṃ bahuvyālasamākulam nānākāradvijayutaṃ viṭapaiḥ pariśobhitam
verses.translation: Then the servants of Yama bind them with chains and nooses and drag them ruthlessly. They beat them with sticks and threaten them again and again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वनेचरं नृपश्रेष्ठो मृगयागतमानसः तत्रैव मतिम् आधत्त इलो ऽमात्यान् अथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vanecaraṃ nṛpaśreṣṭho mṛgayāgatamānasaḥ tatraiva matim ādhatta ilo 'mātyān athābravīt
verses.translation: After regaining consciousness they go towards the southern door faltering at every step. They are smeared with blood.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन्तु नगरं सर्वे मम पुत्रेण पालितम् देशं कोशं बलं राज्यं पालयन्तु पुनश् च तम्
verses.transliteration: gacchantu nagaraṃ sarve mama putreṇa pālitam deśaṃ kośaṃ balaṃ rājyaṃ pālayantu punaś ca tam
verses.translation: When the extremely rough, coarse and chill wind blows against them they shrink, shrivel and become frozen.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठो ऽपि तथा यातु आदायाग्नीन् पितेव नः पत्नीभिः सहितो धीमान् अरण्ये ऽहं वसाम्य् अथ
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭho 'pi tathā yātu ādāyāgnīn piteva naḥ patnībhiḥ sahito dhīmān araṇye 'haṃ vasāmy atha
verses.translation: On hearing the words ofYama's servants they lose their taste therein. They are afflicted by hunger and thirst (all the more). Thereafter they are tortured by the servants of Yama with terrible weapons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अरण्यभोगभुग्भिश् च वाजिवारणमानुषैः मृगयाशीलिभिः कैश्चिद् यान्तु सर्व इतः पुरीम्
verses.transliteration: araṇyabhogabhugbhiś ca vājivāraṇamānuṣaiḥ mṛgayāśīlibhiḥ kaiścid yāntu sarva itaḥ purīm
verses.translation: They do not get the opportunity of either getting in or coming out. They are in a highly wretched state. Those sinners are overwhelmed by their own actions. They lament piteously.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा ययुस् ते ऽपि स्वयं प्रायाच् छनैर् गिरिम् हिमवन्तं रत्नमयं वसंस् तत्र इलो नृपः
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā yayus te 'pi svayaṃ prāyāc chanair girim himavantaṃ ratnamayaṃ vasaṃs tatra ilo nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: After restraining and afflicting them much the sinners are taken by the servants of Yama to that place where Yama himself is present.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ददर्श कन्दरं तत्र नानारत्नविचित्रितम् तत्र यक्षेश्वरः कश्चित् समन्युर् इति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: dadarśa kandaraṃ tatra nānāratnavicitritam tatra yakṣeśvaraḥ kaścit samanyur iti viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: Now, when you are being afflicted by your own ac¬ tions, why do you repent and bewail? Experience your own miseries. It is not the fault of anyone else.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्या समानाम्नी भर्तृव्रतपरायणा तस्मिन् वसत्य् असौ यक्षो रमणीये नगोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā samānāmnī bhartṛvrataparāyaṇā tasmin vasaty asau yakṣo ramaṇīye nagottame
verses.translation: Due to your greed for the kingdom, due to delusion
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृगरूपेण व्यचरद् भार्यया स महामतिः स्वेच्छया स्ववने यक्षः क्रीडते नृत्यगीतकैः
verses.transliteration: mṛgarūpeṇa vyacarad bhāryayā sa mahāmatiḥ svecchayā svavane yakṣaḥ krīḍate nṛtyagītakaiḥ
verses.translation: We do not see all that strength of yours whereby the subjects have been destroyed. You are being hit and pierced by the emissaries of Yama now. Now see, what have you gained?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं स यक्षो जानाति मृगरूपधरो ऽपि च इलस् तु तं न जानाति कन्दरं यक्षपालितम्
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ sa yakṣo jānāti mṛgarūpadharo 'pi ca ilas tu taṃ na jānāti kandaraṃ yakṣapālitam
verses.translation: Touched by the wind he slowly regains life. Then they throw the man into the ocean of hellish life.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यक्षस्य गेहं विपुलं नानारत्नविचित्रितम् तत्रोपविष्टो नृपतिर् महत्या सेनया वृतः
verses.transliteration: yakṣasya gehaṃ vipulaṃ nānāratnavicitritam tatropaviṣṭo nṛpatir mahatyā senayā vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, the emissaries intimate to Yama about the people engaged in sinful activities who are now extremely miserable.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वासं चक्रे स तत्रैव गेहे यक्षस्य धीमतः स यक्षो ऽधर्मकोपेन भार्यया मृगरूपधृक्
verses.transliteration: vāsaṃ cakre sa tatraiva gehe yakṣasya dhīmataḥ sa yakṣo 'dharmakopena bhāryayā mṛgarūpadhṛk
verses.translation: This man has had sexual intercourse with forbidden women. He is a wicked man. He is a person who stole away other men's wealth. He has sold his daughter. He is a perjuror. He is ungrateful. He has deceived friends.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इलं जेतुं न शक्नोमि याचितो न ददाति च हृतं गेहं ममानेन किं करोमीत्य् अचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: ilaṃ jetuṃ na śaknomi yācito na dadāti ca hṛtaṃ gehaṃ mamānena kiṃ karomīty acintayat
verses.translation: Virtue and piety has always been censured by this pioud follow. A sinful deed has been committed by this wicked man in the mortal world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: युधि मत्तं कथं हन्यां चेति स्थित्वा स यक्षराट् आत्मीयान् प्रेषयाम् आस यक्षाञ् शूरान् धनुर्धरान्
verses.transliteration: yudhi mattaṃ kathaṃ hanyāṃ ceti sthitvā sa yakṣarāṭ ātmīyān preṣayām āsa yakṣāñ śūrān dhanurdharān
verses.translation: Now, O lord of Devas, mention the modes of restrain¬ ing or blessing this fellow. Our lord must be competent to lay down action against him. We will be only hindering if we do anything ourselves.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: युद्धे जित्वा च राजानम् इलम् उद्धतदन्तिनम् गृहाद् यथान्यतो याति मम तत् कर्तुम् अर्हथ
verses.transliteration: yuddhe jitvā ca rājānam ilam uddhatadantinam gṛhād yathānyato yāti mama tat kartum arhatha
verses.translation: The tongues of those who take false pledges and speak words that wound the sensitive spots in others are plucked by the servants of Yama, who are the members of the assembly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यक्षेश्वरस्य तद् वाक्याद् यक्षास् ते युद्धदुर्मदाः इलं गत्वाब्रुवन् सर्वे निर्गच्छास्माद् गुहालयात्
verses.transliteration: yakṣeśvarasya tad vākyād yakṣās te yuddhadurmadāḥ ilaṃ gatvābruvan sarve nirgacchāsmād guhālayāt
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न चेद् युद्धात् परिभ्रष्टः पलाय्य क्व गमिष्यसि तद् यक्षवचनात् कोपाद् युद्धं चक्रे स राजराट्
verses.transliteration: na ced yuddhāt paribhraṣṭaḥ palāyya kva gamiṣyasi tad yakṣavacanāt kopād yuddhaṃ cakre sa rājarāṭ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जित्वा यक्षान् बहुविधान् उवास दश शर्वरीः यक्षेश्वरो मृगो भूत्वा भार्ययापि वने वसन्
verses.transliteration: jitvā yakṣān bahuvidhān uvāsa daśa śarvarīḥ yakṣeśvaro mṛgo bhūtvā bhāryayāpi vane vasan
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हृतगेहो वनं प्राप्तो हृतभृत्यः स यक्षिणीम् प्राह चिन्तापरो भूत्वा मृगीरूपधरां प्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: hṛtageho vanaṃ prāpto hṛtabhṛtyaḥ sa yakṣiṇīm prāha cintāparo bhūtvā mṛgīrūpadharāṃ priyām
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राजा ऽयं दुर्मनाः कान्ते व्यसनासक्तमानसः कथम् आयाति विपदं तत्रोपायो विचिन्त्यताम्
verses.transliteration: rājā 'yaṃ durmanāḥ kānte vyasanāsaktamānasaḥ katham āyāti vipadaṃ tatropāyo vicintyatām
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पापर्द्धिव्यसनान्तानि राज्यान्य् अखिलभूभुजाम् प्रापयोमावनं सुभ्रूर् मृगी भूत्वा मनोहरा
verses.transliteration: pāparddhivyasanāntāni rājyāny akhilabhūbhujām prāpayomāvanaṃ subhrūr mṛgī bhūtvā manoharā
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रविशेत् तत्र राजायं स्त्री भविष्यत्य् असंशयम् करणीयं त्वया भद्रे न चैतद् युज्यते मम अहं तु पुरुषो येन त्वं पुनः स्त्री च यक्षिणी
verses.transliteration: praviśet tatra rājāyaṃ strī bhaviṣyaty asaṃśayam karaṇīyaṃ tvayā bhadre na caitad yujyate mama ahaṃ tu puruṣo yena tvaṃ punaḥ strī ca yakṣiṇī
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कथं त्वया न गन्तव्यम् उमावनम् अनुत्तमम् गते ऽपि त्वयि को दोषस् तन् मे कथय तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ tvayā na gantavyam umāvanam anuttamam gate 'pi tvayi ko doṣas tan me kathaya tattvataḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हिमवत्पर्वतश्रेष्ठ उमया सहितः शिवः देवैर् गणैर् अनुवृतो विचचार यथासुखम् पार्वती शंकरं प्राह कदाचिद् रहसि स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: himavatparvataśreṣṭha umayā sahitaḥ śivaḥ devair gaṇair anuvṛto vicacāra yathāsukham pārvatī śaṃkaraṃ prāha kadācid rahasi sthitam
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीणाम् एष स्वभावो ऽस्ति रतं गोपायितं भवेत् तस्मान् मे नियतं देशम् आज्ञया रक्षितं तव
verses.transliteration: strīṇām eṣa svabhāvo 'sti rataṃ gopāyitaṃ bhavet tasmān me niyataṃ deśam ājñayā rakṣitaṃ tava
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देहि मे त्रिदशेशान उमावनम् इति श्रुतम् विना त्वया गणेशेन कार्त्तिकेयेन नन्दिना
verses.transliteration: dehi me tridaśeśāna umāvanam iti śrutam vinā tvayā gaṇeśena kārttikeyena nandinā
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस् त्व् अत्र प्रविशेन् नाथ स्त्रीत्वं तस्य भवेद् इति
verses.transliteration: yas tv atra praviśen nātha strītvaṃ tasya bhaved iti
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् आज्ञोमावने दत्ता प्रसन्नेनेन्दुमौलिना किं करोमि पुमान् कान्ते त्वया प्रणयनार्दितः तस्मान् मया न गन्तव्यम् उमाया वनम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ity ājñomāvane dattā prasannenendumaulinā kiṃ karomi pumān kānte tvayā praṇayanārditaḥ tasmān mayā na gantavyam umāyā vanam uttamam
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् भर्तृवचनं श्रुत्वा यक्षिणी कामरूपिणी मृगी भूत्वा विशालाक्षी इलस्य पुरतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: tad bhartṛvacanaṃ śrutvā yakṣiṇī kāmarūpiṇī mṛgī bhūtvā viśālākṣī ilasya purato 'bhavat
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यक्षस् तु संस्थितस् तत्र ददर्शेलो मृगीं तदा मृगयासक्तचित्तो वै मृगीं दृष्ट्वा विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: yakṣas tu saṃsthitas tatra dadarśelo mṛgīṃ tadā mṛgayāsaktacitto vai mṛgīṃ dṛṣṭvā viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एक एव हयारूढो निर्ययौ तां मृगीम् अनु साकर्षत शनैस् तं तु राजानं मृगयाकुलम्
verses.transliteration: eka eva hayārūḍho niryayau tāṃ mṛgīm anu sākarṣata śanais taṃ tu rājānaṃ mṛgayākulam
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शनैर् जगाम सा तत्र यद् उमावनम् उच्यते अदृश्या तु मृगी तस्मै दर्शयन्ती क्वचित् क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: śanair jagāma sā tatra yad umāvanam ucyate adṛśyā tu mṛgī tasmai darśayantī kvacit kvacit
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठन्ती चैव गच्छन्ती धावन्ती च विभीतवत् हरिणी चपलाक्षी सा तम् आकर्षद् उमावनम्
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭhantī caiva gacchantī dhāvantī ca vibhītavat hariṇī capalākṣī sā tam ākarṣad umāvanam
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनुप्राप्तो हयारूढस् तत् प्राप स उमावनम् उमावनं प्रविष्टं तं ज्ञात्वा सा यक्षिणी तदा
verses.transliteration: anuprāpto hayārūḍhas tat prāpa sa umāvanam umāvanaṃ praviṣṭaṃ taṃ jñātvā sā yakṣiṇī tadā
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृगीरूपं परित्यज्य यक्षिणी कामरूपिणी दिव्यरूपं समास्थाय चाशोकतरुसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration: mṛgīrūpaṃ parityajya yakṣiṇī kāmarūpiṇī divyarūpaṃ samāsthāya cāśokatarusaṃnidhau
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच्छाखालम्बितकरा दिव्यगन्धानुलेपना दिव्यरूपधरा तन्वी कृतकार्या समा तदा
verses.transliteration: tacchākhālambitakarā divyagandhānulepanā divyarūpadharā tanvī kṛtakāryā samā tadā
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हसन्ती नृपतिं प्रेक्ष्य श्रान्तं हयगतं तदा मृगीम् आलोकयन्तं तं चपलाक्षम् इलं तदा
verses.transliteration: hasantī nṛpatiṃ prekṣya śrāntaṃ hayagataṃ tadā mṛgīm ālokayantaṃ taṃ capalākṣam ilaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भर्तृवाक्यम् अशेषेण स्मरन्ती प्राह भूमिपम्
verses.transliteration: bhartṛvākyam aśeṣeṇa smarantī prāha bhūmipam
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हयारूढाबला तन्वि क्व एकैव तु गच्छसि पुरुषस्य च वेषेण इले कम् अनुयास्यसि
verses.transliteration: hayārūḍhābalā tanvi kva ekaiva tu gacchasi puruṣasya ca veṣeṇa ile kam anuyāsyasi
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इलेति वचनं श्रुत्वा राजासौ क्रोधमूर्छितः यक्षिणीं भर्त्सयित्वासौ ताम् अपृच्छन् मृगीं पुनः
verses.transliteration: ileti vacanaṃ śrutvā rājāsau krodhamūrchitaḥ yakṣiṇīṃ bhartsayitvāsau tām apṛcchan mṛgīṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथापि यक्षिणी प्राह इले किम् अनुवीक्षसे इलेति वचनं श्रुत्वा धृतचापो हयस्थितः
verses.transliteration: tathāpi yakṣiṇī prāha ile kim anuvīkṣase ileti vacanaṃ śrutvā dhṛtacāpo hayasthitaḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुपितो दर्शयाम् आस त्रैलोक्यविजयी धनुः पुनः सा प्राह नृपतिं महात्मानम् इले स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: kupito darśayām āsa trailokyavijayī dhanuḥ punaḥ sā prāha nṛpatiṃ mahātmānam ile svayam
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रेक्षस्व पश्चान् मां ब्रूहि असत्यां सत्यवादिनीम् तदा चालोकयद् राजा स्तनौ तुङ्गौ भुजान्तरे
verses.transliteration: prekṣasva paścān māṃ brūhi asatyāṃ satyavādinīm tadā cālokayad rājā stanau tuṅgau bhujāntare
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किम् इदं मम संजातम् इत्य् एवं चकितो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: kim idaṃ mama saṃjātam ity evaṃ cakito 'bhavat
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किम् इदं मम संजातं जानीते भवती स्फुटम् वद सर्वं यथातथ्यं त्वं का वा वद सुव्रते
verses.transliteration: kim idaṃ mama saṃjātaṃ jānīte bhavatī sphuṭam vada sarvaṃ yathātathyaṃ tvaṃ kā vā vada suvrate
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हिमवत्कन्दरश्रेष्ठे समन्युर् वसते पतिः यक्षाणाम् अधिपः श्रीमांस् तद्भार्याहं तु यक्षिणी
verses.transliteration: himavatkandaraśreṣṭhe samanyur vasate patiḥ yakṣāṇām adhipaḥ śrīmāṃs tadbhāryāhaṃ tu yakṣiṇī
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्कन्दरे भवान् राजा तूपविष्टः सुशीतले यस्य यक्षा हता मोहात् त्वया हि संगरं विना
verses.transliteration: yatkandare bhavān rājā tūpaviṣṭaḥ suśītale yasya yakṣā hatā mohāt tvayā hi saṃgaraṃ vinā
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽहं निर्गमार्थं ते मृगी भूत्वा उमावनम् प्रविष्टा त्वं प्रविष्टो ऽसि पुरा प्राह महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tato 'haṃ nirgamārthaṃ te mṛgī bhūtvā umāvanam praviṣṭā tvaṃ praviṣṭo 'si purā prāha maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस् त्व् अत्र प्रविशेन् मन्दः पुमान् स्त्रीत्वम् अवाप्स्यति तस्मात् स्त्रीत्वम् अवाप्तो ऽसि न त्वं दुःखितुम् अर्हसि प्रौढो ऽपि को ऽत्र जानाति विचित्रभवितव्यताम्
verses.transliteration: yas tv atra praviśen mandaḥ pumān strītvam avāpsyati tasmāt strītvam avāpto 'si na tvaṃ duḥkhitum arhasi prauḍho 'pi ko 'tra jānāti vicitrabhavitavyatām
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यक्षिणीवचनं श्रुत्वा हयारूढस् तदापतत् तम् आश्वास्य पुनः सैव यक्षिणी वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: yakṣiṇīvacanaṃ śrutvā hayārūḍhas tadāpatat tam āśvāsya punaḥ saiva yakṣiṇī vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीत्वं जातं जातम् एव न पुंस्त्वं कर्तुम् अर्हसि गृहाण विद्यां स्त्रीयोग्यां नृत्यं गीतम् अलंकृतिम् स्त्रीलालित्यं स्त्रीविलासं स्त्रीकृत्यं सर्वम् एव तत्
verses.transliteration: strītvaṃ jātaṃ jātam eva na puṃstvaṃ kartum arhasi gṛhāṇa vidyāṃ strīyogyāṃ nṛtyaṃ gītam alaṃkṛtim strīlālityaṃ strīvilāsaṃ strīkṛtyaṃ sarvam eva tat
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इला सर्वम् अथावाप्य यक्षिणीं वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: ilā sarvam athāvāpya yakṣiṇīṃ vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: को वा भर्ता किं तु कृत्यं पुनः पुंस्त्वं कथं भवेत् एतद् वदस्व कल्याणी दुःखार्ताया विशेषतः आर्तानाम् आर्तिशमनाच् छ्रेयो नाभ्यधिकं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: ko vā bhartā kiṃ tu kṛtyaṃ punaḥ puṃstvaṃ kathaṃ bhavet etad vadasva kalyāṇī duḥkhārtāyā viśeṣataḥ ārtānām ārtiśamanāc chreyo nābhyadhikaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बुधः सोमसुतो नाम वनाद् अस्माच् च पूर्वतः आश्रमस् तस्य सुभगे पितरं नित्यम् एष्यति
verses.transliteration: budhaḥ somasuto nāma vanād asmāc ca pūrvataḥ āśramas tasya subhage pitaraṃ nityam eṣyati
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनेनैव पथा सोमं पितरं स बुधो ग्रहः द्रष्टुं याति ततो नित्यं नमस्कर्तुं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: anenaiva pathā somaṃ pitaraṃ sa budho grahaḥ draṣṭuṃ yāti tato nityaṃ namaskartuṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यदा याति बुधः शान्तस् तदात्मानं च दर्शय तं दृष्ट्वा त्वं तु सुभगे सर्वकामान् अवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: yadā yāti budhaḥ śāntas tadātmānaṃ ca darśaya taṃ dṛṣṭvā tvaṃ tu subhage sarvakāmān avāpsyasi
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताम् आश्वास्य ततः सुभ्रूर् यक्षिण्य् अन्तरधीयत यक्षिणी सा तम् आचष्ट यक्षो ऽपि सुखम् आप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: tām āśvāsya tataḥ subhrūr yakṣiṇy antaradhīyata yakṣiṇī sā tam ācaṣṭa yakṣo 'pi sukham āptavān
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इलसैन्यं च तत्रासीत् तद् गतं च यथासुखम् उमावनस्थिता चेला गायन्ती नृत्यती पुनः
verses.transliteration: ilasainyaṃ ca tatrāsīt tad gataṃ ca yathāsukham umāvanasthitā celā gāyantī nṛtyatī punaḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीभावम् अनुचेष्टन्ती स्मरन्ती कर्मणो गतिम् कदाचित् क्रियमाणे तु इलया नृत्यकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: strībhāvam anuceṣṭantī smarantī karmaṇo gatim kadācit kriyamāṇe tu ilayā nṛtyakarmaṇi
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताम् अपश्यद् बुधो धीमान् पितरं गन्तुम् उद्यतः इलां दृष्ट्वा गतिं त्यक्त्वा ताम् आगत्याब्रवीद् बुधः
verses.transliteration: tām apaśyad budho dhīmān pitaraṃ gantum udyataḥ ilāṃ dṛṣṭvā gatiṃ tyaktvā tām āgatyābravīd budhaḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भार्या भव मम स्वस्था सर्वाभ्यस् त्वं प्रिया भव
verses.transliteration: bhāryā bhava mama svasthā sarvābhyas tvaṃ priyā bhava
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बुधवाक्यम् इला भक्त्या त्व् अभिनन्द्य तथाकरोत् स्मृत्वा च यक्षिणीवाक्यं ततस् तुष्टाभवन् मुने
verses.transliteration: budhavākyam ilā bhaktyā tv abhinandya tathākarot smṛtvā ca yakṣiṇīvākyaṃ tatas tuṣṭābhavan mune
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बुधो रेमे तया प्रीत्या नीत्वा स्वस्थानम् उत्तमम् सा चापि सर्वभावेन तोषयाम् आस तं पतिम् ततो बहुतिथे काले बुधस् तुष्टो ऽवदत् प्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: budho reme tayā prītyā nītvā svasthānam uttamam sā cāpi sarvabhāvena toṣayām āsa taṃ patim tato bahutithe kāle budhas tuṣṭo 'vadat priyām
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं ते देयं मया भद्रे प्रियं यन् मनसि स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ te deyaṃ mayā bhadre priyaṃ yan manasi sthitam
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद्वाक्यसमकालं तु पुत्रं देहीत्य् अभाषत इला बुधं सोमसुतं प्रीतिमन्तं प्रियं तथा
verses.transliteration: tadvākyasamakālaṃ tu putraṃ dehīty abhāṣata ilā budhaṃ somasutaṃ prītimantaṃ priyaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अमोघम् एतन् मद्वीर्यं तथा प्रीतिसमुद्भवम् पुत्रस् ते भविता तस्मात् क्षत्रियो लोकविश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: amogham etan madvīryaṃ tathā prītisamudbhavam putras te bhavitā tasmāt kṣatriyo lokaviśrutaḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमवंशकरः श्रीमान् आदित्य इव तेजसा बुद्ध्या बृहस्पतिसमः क्षमया पृथिवीसमः
verses.transliteration: somavaṃśakaraḥ śrīmān āditya iva tejasā buddhyā bṛhaspatisamaḥ kṣamayā pṛthivīsamaḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वीर्येणाजौ हरिर् इव कोपेन हुतभुग् यथा
verses.transliteration: vīryeṇājau harir iva kopena hutabhug yathā
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्न् उत्पद्यमाने तु बुधपुत्रे महात्मनि जयशब्दश् च सर्वत्र त्व् आसीच् च सुरवेश्मनि
verses.transliteration: tasminn utpadyamāne tu budhaputre mahātmani jayaśabdaś ca sarvatra tv āsīc ca suraveśmani
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बुधपुत्रे समुत्पन्ने तत्राजग्मुः सुरेश्वराः अहम् अप्य् आगमं तत्र मुदा युक्तो महामते
verses.transliteration: budhaputre samutpanne tatrājagmuḥ sureśvarāḥ aham apy āgamaṃ tatra mudā yukto mahāmate
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जातमात्रः सुतो रावम् अकरोत् स पृथुस्वरम् तेन सर्वे ऽप्य् अवोचन् वै संगता ऋषयः सुराः
verses.transliteration: jātamātraḥ suto rāvam akarot sa pṛthusvaram tena sarve 'py avocan vai saṃgatā ṛṣayaḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात् पुरू रवो ऽस्येति तस्माद् एष पुरूरवाः स्याद् इत्य् एवं नाम चक्रुः सर्वे संतुष्टमानसाः
verses.transliteration: yasmāt purū ravo 'syeti tasmād eṣa purūravāḥ syād ity evaṃ nāma cakruḥ sarve saṃtuṣṭamānasāḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बुधो ऽप्य् अध्यापयाम् आस क्षात्रविद्यां सुतं शुभाम् धनुर्वेदं सप्रयोगं बुधः प्रादात् तदात्मजे
verses.transliteration: budho 'py adhyāpayām āsa kṣātravidyāṃ sutaṃ śubhām dhanurvedaṃ saprayogaṃ budhaḥ prādāt tadātmaje
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स शीघ्रं वृद्धिम् अगमच् छुक्लपक्षे यथा शशी स मातरं दुःखयुतां समीक्ष्येलां महामतिः नमस्याथ विनीतात्मा इलाम् ऐलो ऽब्रवीद् इदम्
verses.transliteration: sa śīghraṃ vṛddhim agamac chuklapakṣe yathā śaśī sa mātaraṃ duḥkhayutāṃ samīkṣyelāṃ mahāmatiḥ namasyātha vinītātmā ilām ailo 'bravīd idam
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बुधो मातर् मम पिता तव भर्ता प्रियस् तथा अहं च पुत्रः कर्मण्यः कस्मात् ते मानसो ज्वरः
verses.transliteration: budho mātar mama pitā tava bhartā priyas tathā ahaṃ ca putraḥ karmaṇyaḥ kasmāt te mānaso jvaraḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं पुत्र बुधो भर्ता त्वं च पुत्रो गुणाकरः भर्तृपुत्रकृता चिन्ता न ममास्ति कदाचन
verses.transliteration: satyaṃ putra budho bhartā tvaṃ ca putro guṇākaraḥ bhartṛputrakṛtā cintā na mamāsti kadācana
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथापि पूर्वजं किंचिद् दुःखं स्मृत्वा पुनः पुनः चिन्तयेयं महाबुद्धे ततो मातरम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tathāpi pūrvajaṃ kiṃcid duḥkhaṃ smṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ cintayeyaṃ mahābuddhe tato mātaram abravīt
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निवेदयस्व मे मातस् तद् एव प्रथमं मम
verses.transliteration: nivedayasva me mātas tad eva prathamaṃ mama
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इला चैनम् उवाचेदं रहोवाचं कथं वदे तथापि पुत्र ते वच्मि पित्रोः पुत्रो यतो गतिः मग्नानां दुःखपाथोब्धौ पुत्रः प्रवहणं परम्
verses.transliteration: ilā cainam uvācedaṃ rahovācaṃ kathaṃ vade tathāpi putra te vacmi pitroḥ putro yato gatiḥ magnānāṃ duḥkhapāthobdhau putraḥ pravahaṇaṃ param
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तन् मातृवचनं श्रुत्वा विनीतः प्राह मातरम् पादयोः पतितश् चापि वद मातर् यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: tan mātṛvacanaṃ śrutvā vinītaḥ prāha mātaram pādayoḥ patitaś cāpi vada mātar yathā tathā
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सा पुरूरवसं प्राह इक्ष्वाकूणां तथा कुलम् तत्रोत्पत्तिं स्वस्य नाम राज्यप्राप्तिं प्रियान् सुतान्
verses.transliteration: sā purūravasaṃ prāha ikṣvākūṇāṃ tathā kulam tatrotpattiṃ svasya nāma rājyaprāptiṃ priyān sutān
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरोधसं वसिष्ठं च प्रियां भार्यां स्वकं पदम् वननिर्याणम् एवाथ अमात्यानां पुरोधसः
verses.transliteration: purodhasaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca priyāṃ bhāryāṃ svakaṃ padam vananiryāṇam evātha amātyānāṃ purodhasaḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रेषणं च नगर्यां तां मृगयासक्तिम् एव च हिमवत्कन्दरगतिं यक्षेश्वरगृहे गतिम्
verses.transliteration: preṣaṇaṃ ca nagaryāṃ tāṃ mṛgayāsaktim eva ca himavatkandaragatiṃ yakṣeśvaragṛhe gatim
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उमावनप्रवेशं च स्त्रीत्वप्राप्तिम् अशेषतः महेश्वराज्ञया तत्र चाप्रवेशं नरस्य तु
verses.transliteration: umāvanapraveśaṃ ca strītvaprāptim aśeṣataḥ maheśvarājñayā tatra cāpraveśaṃ narasya tu
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यक्षिणीवाक्यम् अप्य् अस्य वरदानं तथैव च बुधप्राप्तिं तथा प्रीतिं पुत्रोत्पत्त्याद्य् अशेषतः
verses.transliteration: yakṣiṇīvākyam apy asya varadānaṃ tathaiva ca budhaprāptiṃ tathā prītiṃ putrotpattyādy aśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कथयाम् आस तत् सर्वं श्रुत्वा मातरम् अब्रवीत् पुरूरवाः किं करोमि किं कृत्वा सुकृतं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: kathayām āsa tat sarvaṃ śrutvā mātaram abravīt purūravāḥ kiṃ karomi kiṃ kṛtvā sukṛtaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतावता ते तृप्तिश् चेद् अलम् एतेन चाम्बिके यद् अप्य् अन्यन् मनोवर्ति तद् अप्य् आज्ञापयस्व मे
verses.transliteration: etāvatā te tṛptiś ced alam etena cāmbike yad apy anyan manovarti tad apy ājñāpayasva me
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इच्छेयं पुंस्त्वम् उत्कृष्टम् इच्छेयं राज्यम् उत्तमम् अभिषेकं च पुत्राणां तव चापि विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: iccheyaṃ puṃstvam utkṛṣṭam iccheyaṃ rājyam uttamam abhiṣekaṃ ca putrāṇāṃ tava cāpi viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दानं दातुं च यष्टुं च मुक्तिमार्गस्य वीक्षणम् सर्वं च कर्तुम् इच्छामि तव पुत्र प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: dānaṃ dātuṃ ca yaṣṭuṃ ca muktimārgasya vīkṣaṇam sarvaṃ ca kartum icchāmi tava putra prasādataḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपायं त्वा तु पृच्छामि येन पुंस्त्वम् अवाप्स्यसि तपसो वान्यतो वापि वदस्व मम तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: upāyaṃ tvā tu pṛcchāmi yena puṃstvam avāpsyasi tapaso vānyato vāpi vadasva mama tattvataḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बुधं त्वं पितरं पृच्छ गत्वा पुत्र यथार्थवत् स तु सर्वं तु जानाति उपदेक्ष्यति ते हितम्
verses.transliteration: budhaṃ tvaṃ pitaraṃ pṛccha gatvā putra yathārthavat sa tu sarvaṃ tu jānāti upadekṣyati te hitam
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तन्मातृवचनाद् ऐलो गत्वा पितरम् अञ्जसा उवाच प्रणतो भूत्वा मातुः कृत्यं तथात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tanmātṛvacanād ailo gatvā pitaram añjasā uvāca praṇato bhūtvā mātuḥ kṛtyaṃ tathātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इलं जाने महाप्राज्ञ इलां जातां पुनस् तथा उमावनप्रवेशं च शंभोर् आज्ञां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: ilaṃ jāne mahāprājña ilāṃ jātāṃ punas tathā umāvanapraveśaṃ ca śaṃbhor ājñāṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच् छंभुप्रसादेन उमायाश् च प्रसादतः विशापो भविता पुत्र ताव् आराध्य न चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: tasmāc chaṃbhuprasādena umāyāś ca prasādataḥ viśāpo bhavitā putra tāv ārādhya na cānyathā
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पश्येयं तं कथं देवं कथं वा मातरं शिवाम् तीर्थाद् वा तपसो वापि तत् पितः प्रथमं वद
verses.transliteration: paśyeyaṃ taṃ kathaṃ devaṃ kathaṃ vā mātaraṃ śivām tīrthād vā tapaso vāpi tat pitaḥ prathamaṃ vada
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतमीं गच्छ पुत्र त्वं तत्रास्ते सर्वदा शिवः उमया सहितः श्रीमाञ् शापहन्ता वरप्रदः
verses.transliteration: gautamīṃ gaccha putra tvaṃ tatrāste sarvadā śivaḥ umayā sahitaḥ śrīmāñ śāpahantā varapradaḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरूरवाः पितुर् वाक्यं श्रुत्वा तु मुदितो ऽभवत् गौतमीं तपसे धीमान् गङ्गां त्रैलोक्यपावनीम्
verses.transliteration: purūravāḥ pitur vākyaṃ śrutvā tu mudito 'bhavat gautamīṃ tapase dhīmān gaṅgāṃ trailokyapāvanīm
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुंस्त्वम् इच्छंस् तथा मातुर् जगाम तपसे त्वरन् हिमवन्तं गिरिं नत्वा मातरं पितरं गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: puṃstvam icchaṃs tathā mātur jagāma tapase tvaran himavantaṃ giriṃ natvā mātaraṃ pitaraṃ gurum
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन्तम् अन्वगात् पुत्रम् इला सोमसुतस् तथा ते सर्वे गौतमीं प्राप्ता हिमवत्पर्वतोत्तमात्
verses.transliteration: gacchantam anvagāt putram ilā somasutas tathā te sarve gautamīṃ prāptā himavatparvatottamāt
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा तपः किंचित् कृत्वा चक्रुः स्तुतिं पराम् भवस्य देवदेवस्य स्तुतिक्रमम् इमं शृणु
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā tapaḥ kiṃcit kṛtvā cakruḥ stutiṃ parām bhavasya devadevasya stutikramam imaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बुधस् तुष्टाव प्रथमम् इला च तदनन्तरम् ततः पुरूरवाः पुत्रो गौरीं देवीं च शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: budhas tuṣṭāva prathamam ilā ca tadanantaram tataḥ purūravāḥ putro gaurīṃ devīṃ ca śaṃkaram
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यौ कुङ्कुमेन स्वशरीरजेन स्वभावहेमप्रतिमौ सरूपौ याव् अर्चितौ स्कन्दगणेश्वराभ्यां तौ मे शरण्यौ शरणं भवेताम्
verses.transliteration: yau kuṅkumena svaśarīrajena svabhāvahemapratimau sarūpau yāv arcitau skandagaṇeśvarābhyāṃ tau me śaraṇyau śaraṇaṃ bhavetām
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संसारतापत्रयदावदग्धाः शरीरिणो यौ परिचिन्तयन्तः सद्यः परां निर्वृतिम् आप्नुवन्ति तौ शंकरौ मे शरणं भवेताम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsāratāpatrayadāvadagdhāḥ śarīriṇo yau paricintayantaḥ sadyaḥ parāṃ nirvṛtim āpnuvanti tau śaṃkarau me śaraṇaṃ bhavetām
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आर्ता ह्य् अहं पीडितमानसा ते क्लेशादिगोप्ता न परो ऽस्ति कश्चित् देव त्वदीयौ चरणौ सुपुण्यौ तौ मे शरण्यौ शरणं भवेताम्
verses.transliteration: ārtā hy ahaṃ pīḍitamānasā te kleśādigoptā na paro 'sti kaścit deva tvadīyau caraṇau supuṇyau tau me śaraṇyau śaraṇaṃ bhavetām
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ययोः सकाशाद् इदम् अभ्युदैति प्रयाति चान्ते लयम् एव सर्वम् जगच्छरण्यौ जगदात्मकौ तु गौरीहरौ मे शरणं भवेताम्
verses.transliteration: yayoḥ sakāśād idam abhyudaiti prayāti cānte layam eva sarvam jagaccharaṇyau jagadātmakau tu gaurīharau me śaraṇaṃ bhavetām
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यौ देववृन्देषु महोत्सवे तु पादौ गृहाणेश गिरीशपुत्र्याः प्रोक्तं धृतौ प्रीतिवशाच् छिवेन तौ मे शरण्यौ शरणं भवेताम्
verses.transliteration: yau devavṛndeṣu mahotsave tu pādau gṛhāṇeśa girīśaputryāḥ proktaṃ dhṛtau prītivaśāc chivena tau me śaraṇyau śaraṇaṃ bhavetām
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किम् अभीष्टं प्रदास्यामि युष्मभ्यं तद् वदन्तु मे कृतकृत्याः स्थ भद्रं वो देवानाम् अपि दुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: kim abhīṣṭaṃ pradāsyāmi yuṣmabhyaṃ tad vadantu me kṛtakṛtyāḥ stha bhadraṃ vo devānām api duṣkaram
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इलो राजा तवाज्ञात्वा वनं प्राविशद् अम्बिके तत् क्षमस्व सुरेशानि पुंस्त्वं दातुं त्वम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: ilo rājā tavājñātvā vanaṃ prāviśad ambike tat kṣamasva sureśāni puṃstvaṃ dātuṃ tvam arhasi
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उवाच तान् सर्वान् भवस्य तु मते स्थिता ततः स भगवान् आह देवीवाक्यरतः सदा
verses.transliteration: tathety uvāca tān sarvān bhavasya tu mate sthitā tataḥ sa bhagavān āha devīvākyarataḥ sadā
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अत्राभिषेकमात्रेण पुंस्त्वं प्राप्नोत्व् अयं नृपः
verses.transliteration: atrābhiṣekamātreṇa puṃstvaṃ prāpnotv ayaṃ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नाताया बुधभार्यायाः शरीराद् वारि सुस्रुवे नृत्यं गीतं च लावण्यं यक्षिण्या यद् उपार्जितम्
verses.transliteration: snātāyā budhabhāryāyāḥ śarīrād vāri susruve nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca lāvaṇyaṃ yakṣiṇyā yad upārjitam
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत् सर्वं वारिधाराभिर् गङ्गाम्भसि समाविशत् नृत्या गीता च सौभाग्या इमा नद्यो बभूविरे
verses.transliteration: tat sarvaṃ vāridhārābhir gaṅgāmbhasi samāviśat nṛtyā gītā ca saubhāgyā imā nadyo babhūvire
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताश् चापि संगता गङ्गां ते पुण्याः संगमास् त्रयः तेषु स्नानं च दानं च सुरराज्यफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tāś cāpi saṃgatā gaṅgāṃ te puṇyāḥ saṃgamās trayaḥ teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca surarājyaphalapradam
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इला पुंस्त्वम् अवाप्याथ गौरीशंभोः प्रसादतः महाभ्युदयसिद्ध्यर्थं वाजिमेधम् अथाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: ilā puṃstvam avāpyātha gaurīśaṃbhoḥ prasādataḥ mahābhyudayasiddhyarthaṃ vājimedham athākarot
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरोधसं वसिष्ठं च भार्यां पुत्रांस् तथैव च अमात्यांश् च बलं कोशम् आनीय स नृपोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: purodhasaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca bhāryāṃ putrāṃs tathaiva ca amātyāṃś ca balaṃ kośam ānīya sa nṛpottamaḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चतुरङ्गं बलं राज्यं दण्डके ऽस्थापयत् तदा इलस्य नाम्ना विख्यातं तत्र तत् पुरम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: caturaṅgaṃ balaṃ rājyaṃ daṇḍake 'sthāpayat tadā ilasya nāmnā vikhyātaṃ tatra tat puram ucyate
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वजातान् अथो पुत्रान् सूर्यवंशक्रमागते राज्ये ऽभिषिच्य पश्चात् तम् ऐलं स्नेहाद् असिञ्चयत्
verses.transliteration: pūrvajātān atho putrān sūryavaṃśakramāgate rājye 'bhiṣicya paścāt tam ailaṃ snehād asiñcayat
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमवंशकरः श्रीमान् अयं राजा भवेद् इति सर्वेभ्यो मतिमानेभ्यो ज्येष्ठः श्रेष्ठो ऽभवन् मुने
verses.transliteration: somavaṃśakaraḥ śrīmān ayaṃ rājā bhaved iti sarvebhyo matimānebhyo jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭho 'bhavan mune
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र च क्रतवो वृत्ता इलस्य नृपतेः शुभाः यत्र पुंस्त्वम् अवाप्याथ यत्र पुत्राः समागताः
verses.transliteration: yatra ca kratavo vṛttā ilasya nṛpateḥ śubhāḥ yatra puṃstvam avāpyātha yatra putrāḥ samāgatāḥ
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यक्षिणीदत्तनृत्यादिगीतसौभाग्यमङ्गलाः नद्यो भूत्वा यत्र गङ्गां संगतास् तानि नारद
verses.transliteration: yakṣiṇīdattanṛtyādigītasaubhāgyamaṅgalāḥ nadyo bhūtvā yatra gaṅgāṃ saṃgatās tāni nārada
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानि शुभदान्य् आसन् सहस्राण्य् अथ षोडश उभयोस् तीरयोस् तात तत्र शंभुर् इलेश्वरः तेषु स्नानं च दानं च सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tīrthāni śubhadāny āsan sahasrāṇy atha ṣoḍaśa ubhayos tīrayos tāta tatra śaṃbhur ileśvaraḥ teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam
verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चक्रतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं ब्रह्महत्यादिनाशनम् यत्र चक्रेश्वरो देवश् चक्रम् आप यतो हरिः
verses.transliteration: cakratīrtham iti khyātaṃ brahmahatyādināśanam yatra cakreśvaro devaś cakram āpa yato hariḥ
verses.translation: Served by heavenly damsels they go the city of Dhamia- raja travelling by different divine aerial chariots rendered splendid by diamonds and gold.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र विष्णुः स्वयं स्थित्वा चक्रार्थं शंकरं प्रभुः पूजयाम् आस तत् तीर्थं चक्रतीर्थम् उदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: yatra viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ sthitvā cakrārthaṃ śaṃkaraṃ prabhuḥ pūjayām āsa tat tīrthaṃ cakratīrtham udāhṛtam
verses.translation: Those who devoutly give the brahmins gifts of various forms go comfortably along that great path.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते दक्षक्रतौ प्रवृत्ते तु देवानां च समागमे
verses.transliteration: yasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate dakṣakratau pravṛtte tu devānāṃ ca samāgame
verses.translation: Those who speak truth, those who are devoid of impuri¬ ties inwardly and outwardly, go to the abode of Yama by serial chariots. They resemble the immortal beings in lustre.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दक्षेण दूषिते देवे शिवे शर्वे महेश्वरे अनाह्वाने सुरेशस्य दक्षचित्ते मलीमसे
verses.transliteration: dakṣeṇa dūṣite deve śive śarve maheśvare anāhvāne sureśasya dakṣacitte malīmase
verses.translation: Those who make gifts of gold, silver, corals or pearls, travel in aerial chariots shining like furnished gold.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दाक्षायण्या श्रुते वाक्ये अनाह्वानस्य कारणे अहल्यायां चोक्तवत्यां कुपिताभूत् सुरेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: dākṣāyaṇyā śrute vākye anāhvānasya kāraṇe ahalyāyāṃ coktavatyāṃ kupitābhūt sureśvarī
verses.translation: Those who make gifts of houses and residences go to the abode of Dharmaraja (making use of) rest houses embel¬ lished in gold and resembling the rising sun.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पितरं नाशये पापं क्षमेयं न कथंचन शृण्वती दोषवाक्यानि पित्रा चोक्तानि भर्तरि
verses.transliteration: pitaraṃ nāśaye pāpaṃ kṣameyaṃ na kathaṃcana śṛṇvatī doṣavākyāni pitrā coktāni bhartari
verses.translation: Those who make gifts of water pots, different types of vessels such as Kundika, Karaka etc. go (along the path) by means of lordly elephants. They are honoured by celestial damsels too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पत्युः शृण्वन्ति या निन्दां तासां पापावधिः कुतः यादृशस् तादृशो वापि पतिः स्त्रीणां परा गतिः
verses.transliteration: patyuḥ śṛṇvanti yā nindāṃ tāsāṃ pāpāvadhiḥ kutaḥ yādṛśas tādṛśo vāpi patiḥ strīṇāṃ parā gatiḥ
verses.translation: Those who give to brahmins oil for applying over the feet or on the head, those who give water for bath and drink unto the brahmins, go to the abode of Yama by riding on horses.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं पुनः सकलाधीशो महादेवो जगद्गुरुः श्रुतं तन्निन्दनं तर्हि धारयामि न देहकम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ punaḥ sakalādhīśo mahādevo jagadguruḥ śrutaṃ tannindanaṃ tarhi dhārayāmi na dehakam
