verses.sanskrit: ऋषिणाभ्यर्थिता कृत्या त्वच्चक्षुर्वह्निनिर्गता सा जिघांसति लोकांस् त्रींस् त्वं नस् त्राता न चेतरः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣiṇābhyarthitā kṛtyā tvaccakṣurvahninirgatā sā jighāṃsati lokāṃs trīṃs tvaṃ nas trātā na cetaraḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तान् अब्रवीज् जगन्नाथो योजनान्तर्निवासिनः न बाधते त्व् असौ कृत्या तस्माद् यूयम् अहर्निशम् इहैवासध्वम् अमरास् तस्या वो न भयं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tān abravīj jagannātho yojanāntarnivāsinaḥ na bādhate tv asau kṛtyā tasmād yūyam aharniśam ihaivāsadhvam amarās tasyā vo na bhayaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् ऊचुः सुरेशानं त्वया दत्तं त्रिविष्टपम् तत् त्यक्त्वात्र कथं नाथ वत्स्यामस् त्रिदशार्चित
verses.transliteration: punar ūcuḥ sureśānaṃ tvayā dattaṃ triviṣṭapam tat tyaktvātra kathaṃ nātha vatsyāmas tridaśārcita
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवानां वचनं श्रुत्वा शिवो वाक्यम् अथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā śivo vākyam athābravīt
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवो ऽसौ विश्वतश्चक्षुर् यो देवो विश्वतोमुखः यो रश्मिभिस् तु धमते नित्यं यो जनको मतः
verses.transliteration: devo 'sau viśvataścakṣur yo devo viśvatomukhaḥ yo raśmibhis tu dhamate nityaṃ yo janako mataḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स सूर्य एक एवात्र साक्षाद् रूपेण सर्वदा स्थितिं करोतु तन्मूर्तौ भविष्यन्त्य् अखिलाः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: sa sūrya eka evātra sākṣād rūpeṇa sarvadā sthitiṃ karotu tanmūrtau bhaviṣyanty akhilāḥ sthitāḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेति शंभुवचनात् पारिजाततरोस् तदा देवा दिवाकरं चक्रुस् त्वष्टा भास्करम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tatheti śaṃbhuvacanāt pārijātataros tadā devā divākaraṃ cakrus tvaṣṭā bhāskaram abravīt
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इहैवास्स्व जगत्स्वामिन् रक्षेमान् विबुधान् स्वयम् स्वांशैश् च वयम् अप्य् अत्र तिष्ठामः शंभुसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration: ihaivāssva jagatsvāmin rakṣemān vibudhān svayam svāṃśaiś ca vayam apy atra tiṣṭhāmaḥ śaṃbhusaṃnidhau
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चक्रेश्वरस्य परितो यावद् योजनसंख्यया गङ्गाया उभयं तीरम् आसाद्यासन् सुरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: cakreśvarasya parito yāvad yojanasaṃkhyayā gaṅgāyā ubhayaṃ tīram āsādyāsan surottamāḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुल्यर्धार्धमात्रं तु गङ्गातीरं समाश्रिताः तिस्रः कोट्यस् तथा पञ्च शतानि मुनिसत्तम तीर्थानां तत्र व्युष्टिं च कः शृणोति ब्रवीति वा
verses.transliteration: aṅgulyardhārdhamātraṃ tu gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritāḥ tisraḥ koṭyas tathā pañca śatāni munisattama tīrthānāṃ tatra vyuṣṭiṃ ca kaḥ śṛṇoti bravīti vā
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरगणाः सर्वे विनीताः शिवम् अब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve vinītāḥ śivam abruvan
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पिप्पलादं सुरेशान शमं नय जगन्मय
verses.transliteration: pippalādaṃ sureśāna śamaṃ naya jaganmaya
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ओम् इत्य् उक्त्वा जगन्नाथः पिप्पलादम् अवोचत
verses.transliteration: om ity uktvā jagannāthaḥ pippalādam avocata
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नाशितेष्व् अपि देवेषु पिता ते नागमिष्यति दत्ताः पित्रा तव प्राणा देवानां कार्यसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: nāśiteṣv api deveṣu pitā te nāgamiṣyati dattāḥ pitrā tava prāṇā devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दीनार्तकरुणाबन्धुः को हि तादृग्भवे भवेत् तथा याता दिवं तात तव माता पतिव्रता
verses.transliteration: dīnārtakaruṇābandhuḥ ko hi tādṛgbhave bhavet tathā yātā divaṃ tāta tava mātā pativratā
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: समा काप्य् अत्र मतया लोपामुद्राप्य् अरुन्धती यद् अस्थिभिः सुराः सर्वे जयिनः सुखिनः सदा
verses.transliteration: samā kāpy atra matayā lopāmudrāpy arundhatī yad asthibhiḥ surāḥ sarve jayinaḥ sukhinaḥ sadā
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेनावाप्तं यशः स्फीतं तव मात्राक्षयं कृतम् त्वया पुत्रेण सर्वत्र नातः परतरं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tenāvāptaṃ yaśaḥ sphītaṃ tava mātrākṣayaṃ kṛtam tvayā putreṇa sarvatra nātaḥ parataraṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्प्रतापभयात् स्वर्गाच् च्युतांस् त्वं पातुम् अर्हसि कांदिशीकांस् तव भयाद् अमरांस् त्रातुम् अर्हसि नार्तत्राणाद् अभ्यधिकं सुकृतं क्वापि विद्यते
verses.transliteration: tvatpratāpabhayāt svargāc cyutāṃs tvaṃ pātum arhasi kāṃdiśīkāṃs tava bhayād amarāṃs trātum arhasi nārtatrāṇād abhyadhikaṃ sukṛtaṃ kvāpi vidyate
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यावद् यशः स्फुरति चारु मनुष्यलोके अहानि तावन्ति दिवं गतस्य दिने दिने वर्षसंख्या परस्मिंल् लोके वासो जायते निर्विकारः
verses.transliteration: yāvad yaśaḥ sphurati cāru manuṣyaloke ahāni tāvanti divaṃ gatasya dine dine varṣasaṃkhyā parasmiṃl loke vāso jāyate nirvikāraḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृतास् त एवात्र यशो न येषाम् अन्धास् त एव श्रुतवर्जिता ये ये दानशीला न नपुंसकास् ते ये धर्मशीला न त एव शोच्याः
verses.transliteration: mṛtās ta evātra yaśo na yeṣām andhās ta eva śrutavarjitā ye ye dānaśīlā na napuṃsakās te ye dharmaśīlā na ta eva śocyāḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भाषितं देवदेवस्य श्रुत्वा शान्तो ऽभवन् मुनिः कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा नत्वा नाथम् अथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: bhāṣitaṃ devadevasya śrutvā śānto 'bhavan muniḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā natvā nātham athābravīt
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वाग्भिर् मनोभिः कृतिभिः कदाचिन् ममोपकुर्वन्ति हिते रता ये तेभ्यो हितार्थं त्व् इह चापरेषां सोमं नमस्यामि सुरादिपूज्यम्
verses.transliteration: vāgbhir manobhiḥ kṛtibhiḥ kadācin mamopakurvanti hite ratā ye tebhyo hitārthaṃ tv iha cāpareṣāṃ somaṃ namasyāmi surādipūjyam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संरक्षितो यैर् अभिवर्धितश् च समानगोत्रश् च समानधर्मा तेषाम् अभीष्टानि शिवः करोतु बालेन्दुमौलिं प्रणतो ऽस्मि नित्यम्
verses.transliteration: saṃrakṣito yair abhivardhitaś ca samānagotraś ca samānadharmā teṣām abhīṣṭāni śivaḥ karotu bālendumauliṃ praṇato 'smi nityam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यैर् अहं वर्धितो नित्यं मातृवत् पितृवत् प्रभो तन्नाम्ना जायतां तीर्थं देवदेव जगत्त्रये
verses.transliteration: yair ahaṃ vardhito nityaṃ mātṛvat pitṛvat prabho tannāmnā jāyatāṃ tīrthaṃ devadeva jagattraye
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यशस् तु तेषां भविता तेभ्यो ऽहम् अनृणस् ततः यानि क्षेत्राणि देवानां यानि तीर्थानि भूतले
verses.transliteration: yaśas tu teṣāṃ bhavitā tebhyo 'ham anṛṇas tataḥ yāni kṣetrāṇi devānāṃ yāni tīrthāni bhūtale
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यो यद् इदम् अधिकम् अनुमन्यन्तु देवताः ततः क्षमे ऽहं देवानाम् अपराधं निरञ्जनः
verses.transliteration: tebhyo yad idam adhikam anumanyantu devatāḥ tataḥ kṣame 'haṃ devānām aparādhaṃ nirañjanaḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः समक्षं सुरसाक्षरां गिरं सहस्रचक्षुःप्रमुखांस् तथाग्रतः उवाच देवा अपि मेनिरे वचो दधीचिपुत्रोदितम् आदरेण
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samakṣaṃ surasākṣarāṃ giraṃ sahasracakṣuḥpramukhāṃs tathāgrataḥ uvāca devā api menire vaco dadhīciputroditam ādareṇa
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बालस्य बुद्धिं विनयं च विद्यां शौर्यं बलं साहसं सत्यवाचम् पित्रोर् भक्तिं भावशुद्धिं विदित्वा तदावादीच् छंकरः पिप्पलादम्
verses.transliteration: bālasya buddhiṃ vinayaṃ ca vidyāṃ śauryaṃ balaṃ sāhasaṃ satyavācam pitror bhaktiṃ bhāvaśuddhiṃ viditvā tadāvādīc chaṃkaraḥ pippalādam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वत्स यद् वै प्रियं कामं यच् चापि सुरवल्लभम् प्राप्स्यसे वद कल्याणं नान्यथा त्वं मनः कृथाः
verses.transliteration: vatsa yad vai priyaṃ kāmaṃ yac cāpi suravallabham prāpsyase vada kalyāṇaṃ nānyathā tvaṃ manaḥ kṛthāḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये गङ्गायाम् आप्लुता धर्मनिष्ठाः संपश्यन्ति त्वत्पदाब्जं महेश सर्वान् कामान् आप्नुवन्तु प्रसह्य देहान्ते ते पदम् आयान्तु शैवम्
verses.transliteration: ye gaṅgāyām āplutā dharmaniṣṭhāḥ saṃpaśyanti tvatpadābjaṃ maheśa sarvān kāmān āpnuvantu prasahya dehānte te padam āyāntu śaivam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तातः प्राप्तस् त्वत्पदं चाम्बिका मे नाथ प्राप्ता पिप्पलश् चामराश् च सुखं प्राप्ता नाथनाथं विलोक्य त्वां पश्येयुस् त्वत्पदं ते प्रयान्तु
verses.transliteration: tātaḥ prāptas tvatpadaṃ cāmbikā me nātha prāptā pippalaś cāmarāś ca sukhaṃ prāptā nāthanāthaṃ vilokya tvāṃ paśyeyus tvatpadaṃ te prayāntu
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा पिप्पलादं देवदेवो महेश्वरः अभिनन्द्य च तं देवैः सार्धं वाक्यम् अथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā pippalādaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ abhinandya ca taṃ devaiḥ sārdhaṃ vākyam athābravīt
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवा अपि मुदा युक्ता निर्भयास् तत्कृताद् भयात् इदम् ऊचुः सर्व एव दाधीचं शिवसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration: devā api mudā yuktā nirbhayās tatkṛtād bhayāt idam ūcuḥ sarva eva dādhīcaṃ śivasaṃnidhau
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुराणां यद् अभीष्टं च त्वया कृतम् असंशयम् पालिता देवदेवस्य आज्ञा त्रैलोक्यमण्डनी
verses.transliteration: surāṇāṃ yad abhīṣṭaṃ ca tvayā kṛtam asaṃśayam pālitā devadevasya ājñā trailokyamaṇḍanī
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: याचितं च त्वया पूर्वं परार्थं नात्मने द्विज तस्माद् अन्यतमं ब्रूहि किंचिद् दास्यामहे वयम्
verses.transliteration: yācitaṃ ca tvayā pūrvaṃ parārthaṃ nātmane dvija tasmād anyatamaṃ brūhi kiṃcid dāsyāmahe vayam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनः पुनस् तद् एवोचुः सुरसंघा द्विजोत्तमम् कृताञ्जलिपुटः पूर्वं नत्वा शंभुसुरान् इदम् उवाच पिप्पलादश् च उमां नत्वा च पिप्पलान्
verses.transliteration: punaḥ punas tad evocuḥ surasaṃghā dvijottamam kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ pūrvaṃ natvā śaṃbhusurān idam uvāca pippalādaś ca umāṃ natvā ca pippalān
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पितरौ द्रष्टुकामो ऽस्मि सदा मे शब्दगोचरौ ते धन्याः प्राणिनो लोके मातापित्रोर् वशे स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: pitarau draṣṭukāmo 'smi sadā me śabdagocarau te dhanyāḥ prāṇino loke mātāpitror vaśe sthitāḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शुश्रूषणपरा नित्यं तत्पादाज्ञाप्रतीक्षकाः इन्द्रियाणि शरीरं च कुलं शक्तिं धियं वपुः
verses.transliteration: śuśrūṣaṇaparā nityaṃ tatpādājñāpratīkṣakāḥ indriyāṇi śarīraṃ ca kulaṃ śaktiṃ dhiyaṃ vapuḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: परिलभ्य तयोः कृत्ये कृतकृत्यो भवेत् स्वयम् पशूनां पक्षिणां चापि सुलभं मातृदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: parilabhya tayoḥ kṛtye kṛtakṛtyo bhavet svayam paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ cāpi sulabhaṃ mātṛdarśanam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दुर्लभं मम तच् चापि पृच्छे पापफलं नु किम् दुर्लभं च तथा चेत् स्यात् सर्वेषां यस्य कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: durlabhaṃ mama tac cāpi pṛcche pāpaphalaṃ nu kim durlabhaṃ ca tathā cet syāt sarveṣāṃ yasya kasyacit
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नोपपद्येत सुलभं मत्तो नान्यो ऽस्ति पापकृत् तयोर् दर्शनमात्रं च यदि प्राप्स्ये सुरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: nopapadyeta sulabhaṃ matto nānyo 'sti pāpakṛt tayor darśanamātraṃ ca yadi prāpsye surottamāḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मनोवाक्कायकर्मभ्यः फलं प्राप्तं भविष्यति पितरौ ये न पश्यन्ति समुत्पन्ना न संसृतौ तेषां महापातकानां कः संख्यां कर्तुम् ईश्वरः
verses.transliteration: manovākkāyakarmabhyaḥ phalaṃ prāptaṃ bhaviṣyati pitarau ye na paśyanti samutpannā na saṃsṛtau teṣāṃ mahāpātakānāṃ kaḥ saṃkhyāṃ kartum īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् ऋषेर् वचनं श्रुत्वा मिथः संमन्त्र्य ते सुराः विमानवरम् आरूढौ पितरौ दंपती शुभौ
verses.transliteration: tad ṛṣer vacanaṃ śrutvā mithaḥ saṃmantrya te surāḥ vimānavaram ārūḍhau pitarau daṃpatī śubhau
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तव संदर्शनाकाङ्क्षौ द्रक्ष्यसे वाद्य निश्चितम् विषादं लोभमोहौ च त्यक्त्वा चित्तं शमं नय
verses.transliteration: tava saṃdarśanākāṅkṣau drakṣyase vādya niścitam viṣādaṃ lobhamohau ca tyaktvā cittaṃ śamaṃ naya
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पश्य पश्येति तं प्राहुर् दाधीचं सुरसत्तमाः विमानवरम् आरूढौ स्वर्गिणौ स्वर्णभूषणौ
verses.transliteration: paśya paśyeti taṃ prāhur dādhīcaṃ surasattamāḥ vimānavaram ārūḍhau svargiṇau svarṇabhūṣaṇau
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तव संदर्शनाकाङ्क्षौ पितरौ दंपती शुभौ वीज्यमानौ सुरस्त्रीभिः स्तूयमानौ च किंनरैः
verses.transliteration: tava saṃdarśanākāṅkṣau pitarau daṃpatī śubhau vījyamānau surastrībhiḥ stūyamānau ca kiṃnaraiḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा स मातापितरौ ननाम शिवसंनिधौ हर्षबाष्पाश्रुनयनौ स कथंचिद् उवाच तौ
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā sa mātāpitarau nanāma śivasaṃnidhau harṣabāṣpāśrunayanau sa kathaṃcid uvāca tau
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तारयन्त्य् एव पितराव् अन्ये पुत्राः कुलोद्वहाः अहं तु मातुर् उदरे केवलं भेदकारणम् एवंभूतो ऽपि तौ मोहात् पश्येयम् अतिदुर्मतिः
verses.transliteration: tārayanty eva pitarāv anye putrāḥ kulodvahāḥ ahaṃ tu mātur udare kevalaṃ bhedakāraṇam evaṃbhūto 'pi tau mohāt paśyeyam atidurmatiḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताव् आलोक्य ततो दुःखाद् वक्तुं नैव शशाक सः देवाश् च मातापितरौ पिप्पलादम् अथाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: tāv ālokya tato duḥkhād vaktuṃ naiva śaśāka saḥ devāś ca mātāpitarau pippalādam athābruvan
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धन्यस् त्वं पुत्र लोकेषु यस्य कीर्तिर् गता दिवम् साक्षात्कृतस् त्वया त्र्यक्षो देवाश् चाश्वासितास् त्वया त्वया पुत्रेण सल्लोका न क्षीयन्ते कदाचन
verses.transliteration: dhanyas tvaṃ putra lokeṣu yasya kīrtir gatā divam sākṣātkṛtas tvayā tryakṣo devāś cāśvāsitās tvayā tvayā putreṇa sallokā na kṣīyante kadācana
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पवृष्टिस् तदा स्वर्गात् पपात तस्य मूर्धनि जयशब्दः सुरैर् उक्तः प्रादुर्भूतो महामुने
verses.transliteration: puṣpavṛṣṭis tadā svargāt papāta tasya mūrdhani jayaśabdaḥ surair uktaḥ prādurbhūto mahāmune
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आशिषं तु सुते दत्त्वा दधीचिः सह भार्यया शंभुं गङ्गां सुरान् नत्वा पुत्रं वाक्यम् अथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: āśiṣaṃ tu sute dattvā dadhīciḥ saha bhāryayā śaṃbhuṃ gaṅgāṃ surān natvā putraṃ vākyam athābravīt
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्य भार्यां शिवे भक्तिं कुरु गङ्गां च सेवय पुत्रान् उत्पाद्य विधिवद् यज्ञान् इष्ट्वा सदक्षिणान् कृतकृत्यस् ततो वत्स आक्रमस्व चिरं दिवम्
verses.transliteration: prāpya bhāryāṃ śive bhaktiṃ kuru gaṅgāṃ ca sevaya putrān utpādya vidhivad yajñān iṣṭvā sadakṣiṇān kṛtakṛtyas tato vatsa ākramasva ciraṃ divam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: करोम्य् एवम् इति प्राह दधीचिं पिप्पलाशनः दधीचिः पुत्रम् आश्वास्य भार्यया च पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: karomy evam iti prāha dadhīciṃ pippalāśanaḥ dadhīciḥ putram āśvāsya bhāryayā ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनुज्ञातः सुरगणैः पुनः स दिवम् आक्रमत् देवा अप्य् ऊचिरे सर्वे पिप्पलादं ससंभ्रमाः
verses.transliteration: anujñātaḥ suragaṇaiḥ punaḥ sa divam ākramat devā apy ūcire sarve pippalādaṃ sasaṃbhramāḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृत्यां शमय भद्रं ते तद् उत्पन्नं महानलम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtyāṃ śamaya bhadraṃ te tad utpannaṃ mahānalam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पिप्पलादस् तु तान् आह न शक्तो ऽहं निवारणे असत्यं नैव वक्ताहं यूयं कृत्यां तु ब्रूत ताम्
verses.transliteration: pippalādas tu tān āha na śakto 'haṃ nivāraṇe asatyaṃ naiva vaktāhaṃ yūyaṃ kṛtyāṃ tu brūta tām
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मां दृष्ट्वा सा महारौद्रा विपरीतं करिष्यति ताम् एव गत्वा विबुधाः प्रोचुस् ते शान्तिकारणम्
verses.transliteration: māṃ dṛṣṭvā sā mahāraudrā viparītaṃ kariṣyati tām eva gatvā vibudhāḥ procus te śāntikāraṇam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनलं च यथाप्रीति ते उभे नेत्य् अवोचताम् सर्वेषां भक्षणायैव सृष्टा चाहं द्विजन्मना
verses.transliteration: analaṃ ca yathāprīti te ubhe nety avocatām sarveṣāṃ bhakṣaṇāyaiva sṛṣṭā cāhaṃ dvijanmanā
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा च मत्प्रसूतो ऽग्निर् अन्यथा तत् कथं भवेत् महाभूतानि पञ्चापि स्थावरं जङ्गमं तथा
verses.transliteration: tathā ca matprasūto 'gnir anyathā tat kathaṃ bhavet mahābhūtāni pañcāpi sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वम् अस्मन्मुखे विद्याद् वक्तव्यं नावशिष्यते मया संमन्त्र्य ते देवाः पुनर् ऊचुर् उभाव् अपि
verses.transliteration: sarvam asmanmukhe vidyād vaktavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate mayā saṃmantrya te devāḥ punar ūcur ubhāv api
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भक्षयेताम् उभौ सर्वं यथानुक्रमतस् तथा वडवापि सुरान् एवम् उवाच शृणु नारद
verses.transliteration: bhakṣayetām ubhau sarvaṃ yathānukramatas tathā vaḍavāpi surān evam uvāca śṛṇu nārada
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भवताम् इच्छया सर्वं भक्ष्यं मे सुरसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: bhavatām icchayā sarvaṃ bhakṣyaṃ me surasattamāḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वडवा सा नदी जाता गङ्गया संगता मुने तद्भवस् तु महान् अग्निर् य आसीद् अतिभीषणः तम् आहुर् अमरा वह्निं भूतानाम् आदितो विदुः
verses.transliteration: vaḍavā sā nadī jātā gaṅgayā saṃgatā mune tadbhavas tu mahān agnir ya āsīd atibhīṣaṇaḥ tam āhur amarā vahniṃ bhūtānām ādito viduḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आपो ज्येष्ठतमा ज्ञेयास् तथैव प्रथमं भवान् तत्राप्य् अपांपतिं ज्येष्ठं समुद्रम् अशनं कुरु यथैव तु वयं ब्रूमो गच्छ भुङ्क्ष्व यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: āpo jyeṣṭhatamā jñeyās tathaiva prathamaṃ bhavān tatrāpy apāṃpatiṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ samudram aśanaṃ kuru yathaiva tu vayaṃ brūmo gaccha bhuṅkṣva yathāsukham
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनलस् त्व् अमरान् आह आपस् तत्र कथं त्व् अहम् व्रजेयं यदि मां तत्र प्रापयन्त्य् उदकं महत्
verses.transliteration: analas tv amarān āha āpas tatra kathaṃ tv aham vrajeyaṃ yadi māṃ tatra prāpayanty udakaṃ mahat
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भवन्त एव ते ऽप्य् आहुः कथं ते ऽग्ने गतिर् भवेत् अग्निर् अप्य् आह तान् देवान् कन्या मां गुणशालिनी
verses.transliteration: bhavanta eva te 'py āhuḥ kathaṃ te 'gne gatir bhavet agnir apy āha tān devān kanyā māṃ guṇaśālinī
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकलशे स्थाप्य नयेद् यत्र गतिर् मम तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा कन्याम् ऊचुः सरस्वतीम्
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyakalaśe sthāpya nayed yatra gatir mama tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā kanyām ūcuḥ sarasvatīm
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नयैनम् अनलं शीघ्रं शिरसा वरुणालयम्
verses.transliteration: nayainam analaṃ śīghraṃ śirasā varuṇālayam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वती सुरान् आह नैका शक्ता च धारणे युक्ता चतसृभिः शीघ्रं वहेयं वरुणालयम्
verses.transliteration: sarasvatī surān āha naikā śaktā ca dhāraṇe yuktā catasṛbhiḥ śīghraṃ vaheyaṃ varuṇālayam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वत्या वचः श्रुत्वा गङ्गां च यमुनां तथा नर्मदां तपतीं चैव सुराः प्रोचुः पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: sarasvatyā vacaḥ śrutvā gaṅgāṃ ca yamunāṃ tathā narmadāṃ tapatīṃ caiva surāḥ procuḥ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताभिः समन्वितोवाह हिरण्यकलशे ऽनलम् संस्थाप्य शिरसाधार्य ता जग्मुर् वरुणालयम्
verses.transliteration: tābhiḥ samanvitovāha hiraṇyakalaśe 'nalam saṃsthāpya śirasādhārya tā jagmur varuṇālayam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संस्थाप्य यत्र देवेशः सोमनाथो जगत्पतिः अध्यास्ते विबुधैः सार्धं प्रभासे शशिभूषणः
verses.transliteration: saṃsthāpya yatra deveśaḥ somanātho jagatpatiḥ adhyāste vibudhaiḥ sārdhaṃ prabhāse śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रापयाम् आसुर् अनलं पञ्चनद्यः सरस्वती अध्यास्ते च महान् अग्निः पिबन् वारि शनैः शनैः
verses.transliteration: prāpayām āsur analaṃ pañcanadyaḥ sarasvatī adhyāste ca mahān agniḥ piban vāri śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरगणाः सर्वे शिवम् ऊचुः सुरोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve śivam ūcuḥ surottamam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अस्थ्नां च पावनं ब्रूहि अस्माकं च गवां तथा
verses.transliteration: asthnāṃ ca pāvanaṃ brūhi asmākaṃ ca gavāṃ tathā
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिवः प्राह तदा सर्वान् गङ्गाम् आप्लुत्य यत्नतः देवाश् च गावस् तत्पापान् मुच्यन्ते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ prāha tadā sarvān gaṅgām āplutya yatnataḥ devāś ca gāvas tatpāpān mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षालितानि चास्थीनि ऋषिदेहभवान्य् अथ तानि प्रक्षालनाद् एव तत्र प्राप्तानि पूतताम्
verses.transliteration: prakṣālitāni cāsthīni ṛṣidehabhavāny atha tāni prakṣālanād eva tatra prāptāni pūtatām
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र देवा मुक्तपापास् तत् तीर्थं पापनाशनम् तत्र स्नानं च दानं च ब्रह्महत्याविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: yatra devā muktapāpās tat tīrthaṃ pāpanāśanam tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca brahmahatyāvināśanam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गवां च पावनं यत्र गोतीर्थं तद् उदाहृतम् तत्र स्नानान् महाबुद्धिर् गोमेधफलम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: gavāṃ ca pāvanaṃ yatra gotīrthaṃ tad udāhṛtam tatra snānān mahābuddhir gomedhaphalam āpnuyāt
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र तद्ब्राह्मणास्थीनि आसन् पुण्यानि नारद पितृतीर्थं तु वै ज्ञेयं पितॄणां प्रीतिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: yatra tadbrāhmaṇāsthīni āsan puṇyāni nārada pitṛtīrthaṃ tu vai jñeyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भस्मास्थिनखरोमाणि प्राणिनो यस्य कस्यचित् तत्र तीर्थे संक्रमेरन् यावच् चन्द्रार्कतारकम्
verses.transliteration: bhasmāsthinakharomāṇi prāṇino yasya kasyacit tatra tīrthe saṃkrameran yāvac candrārkatārakam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गे वासो भवेत् तस्य अपि दुष्कृतकर्मणः तथा चक्रेश्वरात् तीर्थात् त्रीणि तीर्थानि नारद ततः पूताः सुरगणा गावः शंभुम् अथाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: svarge vāso bhavet tasya api duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ tathā cakreśvarāt tīrthāt trīṇi tīrthāni nārada tataḥ pūtāḥ suragaṇā gāvaḥ śaṃbhum athābruvan
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यामः स्वं स्वम् अधिष्ठानम् अत्र सूर्यः प्रतिष्ठितः अस्मिन् स्थिते दिनकरे सुराः सर्वे प्रतिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: yāmaḥ svaṃ svam adhiṣṭhānam atra sūryaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ asmin sthite dinakare surāḥ sarve pratiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भवेयुर् जगताम् ईश तद् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्हसि सूर्यो ह्य् आत्मास्य जगतस् तस्थुषश् च सनातनः
verses.transliteration: bhaveyur jagatām īśa tad anujñātum arhasi sūryo hy ātmāsya jagatas tasthuṣaś ca sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दिवाकरो देवमयस् तत्रास्माभिः प्रतिष्ठितः यत्र गङ्गा जगद्धात्री यत्र वै त्र्यम्बकः स्वयम् सुरवासं प्रतिष्ठानं भवेद् यत्र च त्र्यम्बकम्
verses.transliteration: divākaro devamayas tatrāsmābhiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ yatra gaṅgā jagaddhātrī yatra vai tryambakaḥ svayam suravāsaṃ pratiṣṭhānaṃ bhaved yatra ca tryambakam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आपृच्छ्य पिप्पलादं तं सुराः स्वं सदनं ययुः पिप्पलाः कालपर्याये स्वर्गं जग्मुर् अथाक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: āpṛcchya pippalādaṃ taṃ surāḥ svaṃ sadanaṃ yayuḥ pippalāḥ kālaparyāye svargaṃ jagmur athākṣayam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पादपानां पदं विप्रः पिप्पलादः प्रतापवान् क्षेत्राधिपत्ये संस्थाप्य पूजयाम् आस शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: pādapānāṃ padaṃ vipraḥ pippalādaḥ pratāpavān kṣetrādhipatye saṃsthāpya pūjayām āsa śaṃkaram
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दधीचिसूनुर् मुनिर् उग्रतेजा अवाप्य भार्यां गौतमस्यात्मजां च पुत्रान् अथावाप्य श्रियं यशश् च सुहृज्जनैः स्वर्गम् अवाप धीरः
verses.transliteration: dadhīcisūnur munir ugratejā avāpya bhāryāṃ gautamasyātmajāṃ ca putrān athāvāpya śriyaṃ yaśaś ca suhṛjjanaiḥ svargam avāpa dhīraḥ
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं पिप्पलेश्वरम् उच्यते सर्वक्रतुफलं पुण्यं स्मरणाद् अघनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ pippaleśvaram ucyate sarvakratuphalaṃ puṇyaṃ smaraṇād aghanāśanam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं पुनः स्नानदानाभ्याम् आदित्यस्य तु दर्शनात् चक्रेश्वरः पिप्पलेशो देवदेवस्य नामनी
verses.transliteration: kiṃ punaḥ snānadānābhyām ādityasya tu darśanāt cakreśvaraḥ pippaleśo devadevasya nāmanī
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सरहस्यं विदित्वा तु सर्वकामान् अवाप्नुयात् सूर्यस्य च प्रतिष्ठानात् सुरवासे प्रतिष्ठिते प्रतिष्ठानं तु तत् क्षेत्रं सुराणाम् अपि वल्लभम्
verses.transliteration: sarahasyaṃ viditvā tu sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt sūryasya ca pratiṣṭhānāt suravāse pratiṣṭhite pratiṣṭhānaṃ tu tat kṣetraṃ surāṇām api vallabham
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इतीदम् आख्यानम् अतीव पुण्यं पठेत वा यः शृणुयात् स्मरेद् वा स दीर्घजीवी धनवान् धर्मयुक्तश् चान्ते स्मरञ् शंभुम् उपैति नित्यम्
verses.transliteration: itīdam ākhyānam atīva puṇyaṃ paṭheta vā yaḥ śṛṇuyāt smared vā sa dīrghajīvī dhanavān dharmayuktaś cānte smarañ śaṃbhum upaiti nityam
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नागतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम् यत्र नागेश्वरो देवः शृणु तस्यापि विस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: nāgatīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham yatra nāgeśvaro devaḥ śṛṇu tasyāpi vistaram
verses.translation: O lord, you have addressed us on the course of adharma. now let us know about the course of dharma too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठानपुरे राजा शूरसेन इति श्रुतः सोमवंशभवः श्रीमान् मतिमान् गुणसागरः
verses.transliteration: pratiṣṭhānapure rājā śūrasena iti śrutaḥ somavaṃśabhavaḥ śrīmān matimān guṇasāgaraḥ
verses.translation: Having done sinful deeds, how do people meet with disaster? By what righteous activities do the people attain prosperity?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रार्थं स महायत्नम् अकरोत् प्रियया सह तस्य पुत्रश् चिराद् आसीत् सर्पो वै भीषणाकृतिः
verses.transliteration: putrārthaṃ sa mahāyatnam akarot priyayā saha tasya putraś cirād āsīt sarpo vai bhīṣaṇākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Having performed evil actions, having come under the control of adharma, with his mind averse to dharma, man goes
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रं तं गोपयाम् आस शूरसेनो महीपतिः राज्ञः पुत्रः सर्प इति न कश्चिद् विन्दते जनः
verses.transliteration: putraṃ taṃ gopayām āsa śūraseno mahīpatiḥ rājñaḥ putraḥ sarpa iti na kaścid vindate janaḥ
verses.translation: He who out of ignorance performs acts of impiety but repents afterwards with his mind concentrated on his self never comes to grief.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्वर्ती परो वापि मातरं पितरं विना धात्रेय्य् अपि न जानाति नामात्यो न पुरोहितः
verses.transliteration: antarvartī paro vāpi mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vinā dhātreyy api na jānāti nāmātyo na purohitaḥ
verses.translation: Inasmuch as his mind dislikes performing evil deeds, in the same proportion is his body released from the control o adharma.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा भीषणं सर्पं सभार्यो नृपसत्तमः संतापं नित्यम् आप्नोति सर्पाद् वरम् अपुत्रता
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīṣaṇaṃ sarpaṃ sabhāryo nṛpasattamaḥ saṃtāpaṃ nityam āpnoti sarpād varam aputratā
verses.translation: Thus the food not attained by unlawful activities should be gifted. He should, first of all, pour offerings of food into the fire with the formula Pranaya Svaha and then eat food.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतद् अस्ति महासर्पो वक्ति नित्यं मनुष्यवत् स सर्पः पितरं प्राह कुरु चूडाम् अपि क्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: etad asti mahāsarpo vakti nityaṃ manuṣyavat sa sarpaḥ pitaraṃ prāha kuru cūḍām api kriyām
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथोपनयनं चापि वेदाध्ययनम् एव च यावद् वेदं न चाधीते तावच् छूद्रसमो द्विजः
verses.transliteration: tathopanayanaṃ cāpi vedādhyayanam eva ca yāvad vedaṃ na cādhīte tāvac chūdrasamo dvijaḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा पुत्रवचः शूरसेनो ऽतिदुःखितः ब्राह्मणं कंचनानीय संस्कारादि तदाकरोत् अधीतवेदः सर्पो ऽपि पितरं चाब्रवीद् इदम्
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā putravacaḥ śūraseno 'tiduḥkhitaḥ brāhmaṇaṃ kaṃcanānīya saṃskārādi tadākarot adhītavedaḥ sarpo 'pi pitaraṃ cābravīd idam
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विवाहं कुरु मे राजन् स्त्रीकामो ऽहं नृपोत्तम अन्यथापि च कृत्यं ते न सिध्येद् इति मे मतिः
verses.transliteration: vivāhaṃ kuru me rājan strīkāmo 'haṃ nṛpottama anyathāpi ca kṛtyaṃ te na sidhyed iti me matiḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जनयित्वात्मजान् वेदविधिनाखिलसंस्कृतीः न कुर्याद् यः पिता तस्य नरकान् नास्ति निष्कृतिः
verses.transliteration: janayitvātmajān vedavidhinākhilasaṃskṛtīḥ na kuryād yaḥ pitā tasya narakān nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विस्मितः स पिता प्राह सुतं तम् उरगाकृतिम्
verses.transliteration: vismitaḥ sa pitā prāha sutaṃ tam uragākṛtim
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्य शब्दाद् अपि त्रासं यान्ति शूराश् च पूरुषाः तस्मै कन्यां तु को दद्याद् वद पुत्र करोमि किम्
verses.transliteration: yasya śabdād api trāsaṃ yānti śūrāś ca pūruṣāḥ tasmai kanyāṃ tu ko dadyād vada putra karomi kim
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत् पितुर् वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्पः प्राह विचक्षणः
verses.transliteration: tat pitur vacanaṃ śrutvā sarpaḥ prāha vicakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विवाहा बहवो राजन् राज्ञां सन्ति जनेश्वर प्रसह्याहरणं चापि शस्त्रैर् वैवाह एव च
verses.transliteration: vivāhā bahavo rājan rājñāṃ santi janeśvara prasahyāharaṇaṃ cāpi śastrair vaivāha eva ca
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जाते विवाहे पुत्रस्य पितासौ कृतकृद् भवेत् नो चेद् अत्रैव गङ्गायां मरिष्ये नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: jāte vivāhe putrasya pitāsau kṛtakṛd bhavet no ced atraiva gaṅgāyāṃ mariṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत् पुत्रनिश्चयं ज्ञात्वा अपुत्रो नृपसत्तमः विवाहार्थम् अमात्यांस् तान् आहूयेदं वचो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tat putraniścayaṃ jñātvā aputro nṛpasattamaḥ vivāhārtham amātyāṃs tān āhūyedaṃ vaco 'bravīt
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नागेश्वरो मम सुतो युवराजो गुणाकरः गुणवान् मतिमाञ् शूरो दुर्जयः शत्रुतापनः
verses.transliteration: nāgeśvaro mama suto yuvarājo guṇākaraḥ guṇavān matimāñ śūro durjayaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रथे नागे स धनुषि पृथिव्यां नोपमीयते विवाहस् तस्य कर्तव्यो ह्य् अहं वृद्धस् तथैव च
verses.transliteration: rathe nāge sa dhanuṣi pṛthivyāṃ nopamīyate vivāhas tasya kartavyo hy ahaṃ vṛddhas tathaiva ca
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राज्यभारं सुते न्यस्य निश्चिन्तो ऽहं भवाम्य् अतः न दारसंग्रहो यावत् तावत् पुत्रो मम प्रियः
verses.transliteration: rājyabhāraṃ sute nyasya niścinto 'haṃ bhavāmy ataḥ na dārasaṃgraho yāvat tāvat putro mama priyaḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बालभावं नो जहाति तस्मात् सर्वे ऽनुमन्य च विवाहायाथ कुर्वन्तु यत्नं मम हिते रताः
verses.transliteration: bālabhāvaṃ no jahāti tasmāt sarve 'numanya ca vivāhāyātha kurvantu yatnaṃ mama hite ratāḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न मे काचित् तदा चिन्ता कृतोद्वाहो यदात्मजः सुते न्यस्तभरा यान्ति कृतिनस् तपसे वनम्
verses.transliteration: na me kācit tadā cintā kṛtodvāho yadātmajaḥ sute nyastabharā yānti kṛtinas tapase vanam
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अमात्या राजवचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वे विनीतवत् ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयो हर्षाद् राजानं भूरितेजसम्
verses.transliteration: amātyā rājavacanaṃ śrutvā sarve vinītavat ūcuḥ prāñjalayo harṣād rājānaṃ bhūritejasam
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तव पुत्रो गुणज्येष्ठस् त्वं च सर्वत्र विश्रुतः विवाहे तव पुत्रस्य किं मन्त्र्यं किं तु चिन्त्यते
verses.transliteration: tava putro guṇajyeṣṭhas tvaṃ ca sarvatra viśrutaḥ vivāhe tava putrasya kiṃ mantryaṃ kiṃ tu cintyate
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अमात्येषु तथोक्तेषु गम्भीरो नृपसत्तमः पुत्रं सर्पं त्व् अमात्यानां न चाख्याति न ते विदुः
verses.transliteration: amātyeṣu tathokteṣu gambhīro nṛpasattamaḥ putraṃ sarpaṃ tv amātyānāṃ na cākhyāti na te viduḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राजा पुनस् तान् उवाच का स्यात् कन्या गुणाधिका महावंशभवः श्रीमान् को राजा स्याद् गुणाश्रयः
verses.transliteration: rājā punas tān uvāca kā syāt kanyā guṇādhikā mahāvaṃśabhavaḥ śrīmān ko rājā syād guṇāśrayaḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संबन्धयोग्यः शूरश् च यत्संबन्धः प्रशस्यते तद् राजवचनं श्रुत्वा अमात्यानां महामतिः
verses.transliteration: saṃbandhayogyaḥ śūraś ca yatsaṃbandhaḥ praśasyate tad rājavacanaṃ śrutvā amātyānāṃ mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुलीनः साधुर् अत्यन्तं राजकार्यहिते रतः राज्ञो मतिं विदित्वा तु इङ्गितज्ञो ऽब्रवीद् इदम्
verses.transliteration: kulīnaḥ sādhur atyantaṃ rājakāryahite rataḥ rājño matiṃ viditvā tu iṅgitajño 'bravīd idam
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वदेशे महाराज विजयो नाम भूपतिः वाजिवारणरत्नानां यस्य संख्या न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: pūrvadeśe mahārāja vijayo nāma bhūpatiḥ vājivāraṇaratnānāṃ yasya saṃkhyā na vidyate
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ पुत्रा महेष्वासा महाराजस्य धीमतः तेषां स्वसा भोगवती साक्षाल् लक्ष्मीर् इवापरा तव पुत्रस्य योग्या सा भार्या राजन् मयोदिता
verses.transliteration: aṣṭau putrā maheṣvāsā mahārājasya dhīmataḥ teṣāṃ svasā bhogavatī sākṣāl lakṣmīr ivāparā tava putrasya yogyā sā bhāryā rājan mayoditā
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धामात्यवचः श्रुत्वा राजा तं प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: vṛddhāmātyavacaḥ śrutvā rājā taṃ pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुता तस्य कथं मे ऽस्य सुतस्य स्याद् वदस्व तत्
verses.transliteration: sutā tasya kathaṃ me 'sya sutasya syād vadasva tat
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लक्षितो ऽसि महाराज यत् ते मनसि वर्तते यच् छूरसेन कृत्यं स्याद् अनुजानीहि मां ततः
verses.transliteration: lakṣito 'si mahārāja yat te manasi vartate yac chūrasena kṛtyaṃ syād anujānīhi māṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धामात्यवचः श्रुत्वा भूषणाच्छादनोक्तिभिः संपूज्य प्रेषयाम् आस महत्या सेनया सह
verses.transliteration: vṛddhāmātyavacaḥ śrutvā bhūṣaṇācchādanoktibhiḥ saṃpūjya preṣayām āsa mahatyā senayā saha
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स पूर्वदेशम् आगत्य महाराजं समेत्य च संपूज्य विविधैर् वाक्यैर् उपायैर् नीतिसंभवैः
verses.transliteration: sa pūrvadeśam āgatya mahārājaṃ sametya ca saṃpūjya vividhair vākyair upāyair nītisaṃbhavaiḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महाराजसुतायाश् च भोगवत्या महामतिः शूरसेनस्य नृपतेः सूनोर् नागस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: mahārājasutāyāś ca bhogavatyā mahāmatiḥ śūrasenasya nṛpateḥ sūnor nāgasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विवाहायाकरोत् संधिं मिथ्यामिथ्यावचोउक्तिभिः पूजयाम् आस नृपतिं भूषणाच्छादनादिभिः
verses.transliteration: vivāhāyākarot saṃdhiṃ mithyāmithyāvacouktibhiḥ pūjayām āsa nṛpatiṃ bhūṣaṇācchādanādibhiḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अवाप्य पूजां नृपतिर् ददामीत्य् अवदत् तदा तत आगत्य राज्ञे ऽसौ वृद्धामात्यो महामतिः
verses.transliteration: avāpya pūjāṃ nṛpatir dadāmīty avadat tadā tata āgatya rājñe 'sau vṛddhāmātyo mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शूरसेनाय तद् वृत्तं वैवाहिकम् अवेदयत् ततो बहुतिथे काले वृद्धामात्यो महामतिः
verses.transliteration: śūrasenāya tad vṛttaṃ vaivāhikam avedayat tato bahutithe kāle vṛddhāmātyo mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् बलेन महता वस्त्रालंकारभूषितः जगाम तरसा सर्वैर् अन्यैश् च सचिवैर् वृतः
verses.transliteration: punar balena mahatā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ jagāma tarasā sarvair anyaiś ca sacivair vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विवाहाय महामात्यो महाराजाय बुद्धिमान् सर्वं प्रोवाच वृद्धो ऽसाव् अमात्यः सचिवैर् वृतः
verses.transliteration: vivāhāya mahāmātyo mahārājāya buddhimān sarvaṃ provāca vṛddho 'sāv amātyaḥ sacivair vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अत्रागन्तुं न चायाति शूरसेनस्य भूपतेः पुत्रो नाग इति ख्यातो बुद्धिमान् गुणसागरः
verses.transliteration: atrāgantuṃ na cāyāti śūrasenasya bhūpateḥ putro nāga iti khyāto buddhimān guṇasāgaraḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियाणां विवाहाश् च भवेयुर् बहुधा नृप तस्माच् छस्त्रैर् अलंकारैर् विवाहः स्यान् महामते
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyāṇāṃ vivāhāś ca bhaveyur bahudhā nṛpa tasmāc chastrair alaṃkārair vivāhaḥ syān mahāmate
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रिया ब्राह्मणाश् चैव सत्यां वाचं वदन्ति हि तस्माच् छस्त्रैर् अलंकारैर् विवाहस् त्व् अनुमन्यताम्
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyā brāhmaṇāś caiva satyāṃ vācaṃ vadanti hi tasmāc chastrair alaṃkārair vivāhas tv anumanyatām
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धामात्यवचः श्रुत्वा विजयो राजसत्तमः मेने वाक्यं तथा सत्यम् अमात्यं भूपतिं तदा
verses.transliteration: vṛddhāmātyavacaḥ śrutvā vijayo rājasattamaḥ mene vākyaṃ tathā satyam amātyaṃ bhūpatiṃ tadā
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विवाहम् अकरोद् राजा भोगवत्याः सविस्तरम् शस्त्रेण च यथाशास्त्रं प्रेषयाम् आस तां पुनः
verses.transliteration: vivāham akarod rājā bhogavatyāḥ savistaram śastreṇa ca yathāśāstraṃ preṣayām āsa tāṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वान् अमात्यांस् तथा गाश् च हिरण्यतुरगादिकम् बहु दत्त्वाथ विजयो हर्षेण महता युतः
verses.transliteration: svān amātyāṃs tathā gāś ca hiraṇyaturagādikam bahu dattvātha vijayo harṣeṇa mahatā yutaḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताम् आदायाथ सचिवा वृद्धामात्यपुरोगमाः प्रतिष्ठानम् अथाभ्येत्य शूरसेनाय तां स्नुषाम्
verses.transliteration: tām ādāyātha sacivā vṛddhāmātyapurogamāḥ pratiṣṭhānam athābhyetya śūrasenāya tāṃ snuṣām
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न्यवेदयंस् तथोचुस् ते विजयस्य वचो बहु भूषणानि विचित्राणि दास्यो वस्त्रादिकं च यत्
verses.transliteration: nyavedayaṃs tathocus te vijayasya vaco bahu bhūṣaṇāni vicitrāṇi dāsyo vastrādikaṃ ca yat
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निवेद्य शूरसेनाय कृतकृत्या बभूविरे विजयस्य तु ये ऽमात्या भोगवत्या सहागताः
verses.transliteration: nivedya śūrasenāya kṛtakṛtyā babhūvire vijayasya tu ye 'mātyā bhogavatyā sahāgatāḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तान् पूजयित्वा राजासौ बहुमानपुरःसरम् विजयाय यथा प्रीतिस् तथा कृत्वा व्यसर्जयत्
verses.transliteration: tān pūjayitvā rājāsau bahumānapuraḥsaram vijayāya yathā prītis tathā kṛtvā vyasarjayat
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विजयस्य सुता बाला रूपयौवनशालिनी श्वश्रूश्वशुरयोर् नित्यं शुश्रूषन्ती सुमध्यमा
verses.transliteration: vijayasya sutā bālā rūpayauvanaśālinī śvaśrūśvaśurayor nityaṃ śuśrūṣantī sumadhyamā
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भोगवत्याश् च यो भर्ता महासर्पो ऽतिभीषणः एकान्तदेशे विजने गृहे रत्नसुशोभिते
verses.transliteration: bhogavatyāś ca yo bhartā mahāsarpo 'tibhīṣaṇaḥ ekāntadeśe vijane gṛhe ratnasuśobhite
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुगन्धकुसुमाकीर्णे तत्रास्ते सुखशीतले स सर्पो मातरं प्राह पितरं च पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: sugandhakusumākīrṇe tatrāste sukhaśītale sa sarpo mātaraṃ prāha pitaraṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मम भार्या राजपुत्री किं मां नैवोपसर्पति तत् पुत्रवचनं श्रुत्वा सर्पमातेदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: mama bhāryā rājaputrī kiṃ māṃ naivopasarpati tat putravacanaṃ śrutvā sarpamātedam abravīt
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धात्रिके गच्छ सुभगे शीघ्रं भोगवतीं वद तव भर्ता सर्प इति ततः सा किं वदिष्यति
verses.transliteration: dhātrike gaccha subhage śīghraṃ bhogavatīṃ vada tava bhartā sarpa iti tataḥ sā kiṃ vadiṣyati
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धात्रिका च तथेत्य् उक्त्वा गत्वा भोगवतीं तदा रहोगता उवाचेदं विनीतवद् अपूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: dhātrikā ca tathety uktvā gatvā bhogavatīṃ tadā rahogatā uvācedaṃ vinītavad apūrvavat
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जाने ऽहं सुभगे भद्रे भर्तारं तव दैवतम् न चाख्येयं त्वया क्वापि सर्पो न पुरुषो ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: jāne 'haṃ subhage bhadre bhartāraṃ tava daivatam na cākhyeyaṃ tvayā kvāpi sarpo na puruṣo dhruvam
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास् तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा भोगवत्य् अब्रवीद् इदम्
verses.transliteration: tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā bhogavaty abravīd idam
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मानुषीणां मनुष्यो हि भर्ता सामान्यतो भवेत् किं पुनर् देवजातिस् तु भर्ता पुण्येन लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: mānuṣīṇāṃ manuṣyo hi bhartā sāmānyato bhavet kiṃ punar devajātis tu bhartā puṇyena labhyate
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भोगवत्यास् तु तद् वाक्यं सा च सर्वं न्यवेदयत् सर्पाय सर्पमात्रे च राज्ञे चैव यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: bhogavatyās tu tad vākyaṃ sā ca sarvaṃ nyavedayat sarpāya sarpamātre ca rājñe caiva yathākramam
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रुरोद राजा तद्वाक्यात् स्मृत्वा तां कर्मणो गतिम् भोगवत्य् अपि तां प्राह उक्तपूर्वां पुनः सखीम्
verses.transliteration: ruroda rājā tadvākyāt smṛtvā tāṃ karmaṇo gatim bhogavaty api tāṃ prāha uktapūrvāṃ punaḥ sakhīm
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कान्तं दर्शय भद्रं ते वृथा याति वयो मम
verses.transliteration: kāntaṃ darśaya bhadraṃ te vṛthā yāti vayo mama
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा दर्शयाम् आस सर्पं तम् अतिभीषणम् सुगन्धकुसुमाकीर्णे शयने सा रहोगता
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā darśayām āsa sarpaṃ tam atibhīṣaṇam sugandhakusumākīrṇe śayane sā rahogatā
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा भीषणं सर्पं भर्तारं रत्नभूषितम् कृताञ्जलिपुटा वाक्यम् अवदत् कान्तम् अञ्जसा
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīṣaṇaṃ sarpaṃ bhartāraṃ ratnabhūṣitam kṛtāñjalipuṭā vākyam avadat kāntam añjasā
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धन्यास्म्य् अनुगृहीतास्मि यस्या मे दैवतं पतिः
verses.transliteration: dhanyāsmy anugṛhītāsmi yasyā me daivataṃ patiḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा शयने स्थित्वा तं सर्पं सर्पभावनैः खेलयाम् आस तन्वङ्गी गीतैश् चैवाङ्गसंगमैः
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā śayane sthitvā taṃ sarpaṃ sarpabhāvanaiḥ khelayām āsa tanvaṅgī gītaiś caivāṅgasaṃgamaiḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुगन्धकुसुमैः पानैस् तोषयाम् आस तं पतिम् तस्याश् चैव प्रसादेन सर्पस्याभूत् स्मृतिर् मुने स्मृत्वा सर्वं दैवकृतं रात्रौ सर्पो ऽब्रवीत् प्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: sugandhakusumaiḥ pānais toṣayām āsa taṃ patim tasyāś caiva prasādena sarpasyābhūt smṛtir mune smṛtvā sarvaṃ daivakṛtaṃ rātrau sarpo 'bravīt priyām
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राजकन्यापि मां दृष्ट्वा न भीतासि कथं प्रिये सोवाच दैवविहितं को ऽतिक्रमितुम् ईश्वरः पतिर् एव गतिः स्त्रीणां सर्वदैव विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: rājakanyāpi māṃ dṛṣṭvā na bhītāsi kathaṃ priye sovāca daivavihitaṃ ko 'tikramitum īśvaraḥ patir eva gatiḥ strīṇāṃ sarvadaiva viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वेति हृष्टस् ताम् आह नागः प्रहसिताननः
verses.transliteration: śrutveti hṛṣṭas tām āha nāgaḥ prahasitānanaḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टो ऽस्मि तव भक्त्याहं किं ददामि तवेप्सितम् तव प्रसादाच् चार्वङ्गि सर्वस्मृतिर् अभूद् इयम्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭo 'smi tava bhaktyāhaṃ kiṃ dadāmi tavepsitam tava prasādāc cārvaṅgi sarvasmṛtir abhūd iyam
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शप्तो ऽहं देवदेवेन कुपितेन पिनाकिना महेश्वरकरे नागः शेषपुत्रो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: śapto 'haṃ devadevena kupitena pinākinā maheśvarakare nāgaḥ śeṣaputro mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहं पतिस् त्वं च भार्या नाम्ना भोगवती पुरा उमावाक्याज् जहासोच्चैः शंभुः प्रीतो रहोगतः
verses.transliteration: so 'haṃ patis tvaṃ ca bhāryā nāmnā bhogavatī purā umāvākyāj jahāsoccaiḥ śaṃbhuḥ prīto rahogataḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ममापि चागतं भद्रे हास्यं तद्देवसंनिधौ ततस् तु कुपितः शंभुः प्रादाच् छापं ममेदृशम्
verses.transliteration: mamāpi cāgataṃ bhadre hāsyaṃ taddevasaṃnidhau tatas tu kupitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ prādāc chāpaṃ mamedṛśam
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्ययोनौ त्वं सर्पो भविता ज्ञानवान् इति
verses.transliteration: manuṣyayonau tvaṃ sarpo bhavitā jñānavān iti
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसादितः शंभुस् त्वया भद्रे मया सह ततश् चोक्तं तेन भद्रे गौतम्यां मम पूजनम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasāditaḥ śaṃbhus tvayā bhadre mayā saha tataś coktaṃ tena bhadre gautamyāṃ mama pūjanam
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वतो ज्ञानम् आधास्ये यदा सर्पाकृतेस् तव तदा विशापो भविता भोगवत्याः प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: kurvato jñānam ādhāsye yadā sarpākṛtes tava tadā viśāpo bhavitā bhogavatyāḥ prasādataḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् इदं ममापन्नं तव चापि शुभानने तस्मान् नीत्वा गौतमीं मां पूजां कुरु मया सह
verses.transliteration: tasmād idaṃ mamāpannaṃ tava cāpi śubhānane tasmān nītvā gautamīṃ māṃ pūjāṃ kuru mayā saha
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो विशापो भविता आवां यावः शिवं पुनः सर्वेषां सर्वदार्तानां शिव एव परा गतिः
verses.transliteration: tato viśāpo bhavitā āvāṃ yāvaḥ śivaṃ punaḥ sarveṣāṃ sarvadārtānāṃ śiva eva parā gatiḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा भर्तृवचनं सा भर्त्रा गौतमीं ययौ ततः स्नात्वा तु गौतम्यां पूजां चक्रे शिवस्य तु
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā bhartṛvacanaṃ sā bhartrā gautamīṃ yayau tataḥ snātvā tu gautamyāṃ pūjāṃ cakre śivasya tu
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान् दिव्यरूपं ददौ मुने आपृच्छ्य पितरौ सर्पो भार्यया गन्तुम् उद्यतः शिवलोकं ततो ज्ञात्वा पिता प्राह महामतिः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno bhagavān divyarūpaṃ dadau mune āpṛcchya pitarau sarpo bhāryayā gantum udyataḥ śivalokaṃ tato jñātvā pitā prāha mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: युवराज्यधरो ज्येष्ठः पुत्र एको भवान् इति तस्माद् राज्यम् अशेषेण कृत्वोत्पाद्य सुतान् बहून् याते मयि परं धाम ततो याहि शिवं पुरम्
verses.transliteration: yuvarājyadharo jyeṣṭhaḥ putra eko bhavān iti tasmād rājyam aśeṣeṇa kṛtvotpādya sutān bahūn yāte mayi paraṃ dhāma tato yāhi śivaṃ puram
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा पितृवचस् तथेत्य् आह स नागराट् कामरूपम् अवाप्याथ भार्यया सह सुव्रतः
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā pitṛvacas tathety āha sa nāgarāṭ kāmarūpam avāpyātha bhāryayā saha suvrataḥ
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पित्रा मात्रा तथा पुत्रै राज्यं कृत्वा सुविस्तरम् याते पितरि स्वर्लोकं पुत्रान् स्थाप्य स्वके पदे
verses.transliteration: pitrā mātrā tathā putrai rājyaṃ kṛtvā suvistaram yāte pitari svarlokaṃ putrān sthāpya svake pade
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भार्यामात्यादिसहितस् ततः शिवपुरं ययौ ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं नागतीर्थम् इति श्रुतम्
