verses.transliteration: bhāryāmātyādisahitas tataḥ śivapuraṃ yayau tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ nāgatīrtham iti śrutam
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र नागेश्वरो देवो भोगवत्या प्रतिष्ठितः तत्र स्नानं च दानं च सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: yatra nāgeśvaro devo bhogavatyā pratiṣṭhitaḥ tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मातृतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वसिद्धिकरं नृणाम् आधिभिर् मुच्यते जन्तुस् तत्तीर्थस्मरणाद् अपि
verses.transliteration: mātṛtīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām ādhibhir mucyate jantus tattīrthasmaraṇād api
verses.translation: How should sons and relatives perform Sraddha for the manes who have departed to the other world and who are abiding in the region assigned to them according to their actions? I bow to Varaha, lord of the universe, creator of the people. Listen, I shall tell you all about Sraddha, as was recorded afore.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवानाम् असुराणां च संगरो ऽभूत् सुदारुणः नाशक्नुवंस् तदा जेतुं देवा दानवसंगरम्
verses.transliteration: devānām asurāṇāṃ ca saṃgaro 'bhūt sudāruṇaḥ nāśaknuvaṃs tadā jetuṃ devā dānavasaṃgaram
verses.translation: In days of yore, the lord uplifted the manes who were drowned in the waters of Koka river, by performing Sraddha for their sake, O best ofBrahmanas. In the intervening period of Treta and Dvapara Yugas, the diverse human beings—the manes, stood in the company of Visvedevas at the top of Meru mountain.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदाहम् अगमं देवैस् तिष्ठन्तं शूलपाणिनम् अस्तवं विविधैर् वाक्यैः कृताञ्जलिपुटः शनैः
verses.transliteration: tadāham agamaṃ devais tiṣṭhantaṃ śūlapāṇinam astavaṃ vividhair vākyaiḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ śanaiḥ
verses.translation: Once, they were sitting (as usual) there (at the top of Meru). A beautiful divine girl born of Soma appeared before them with hands joined in reverence. Among the manes who had assembled there, those shining with refulgence spoke to her. She said to the refulgent manes. I am Kala, born of the Moon, You are my lords whom I can choose, if you so desire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संमन्त्र्य देवैर् असुरैश् च सर्वैर् यदाहृतं संमथितुं समुद्रम् यत् कालकूटं समभून् महेश तत् त्वां विना को ग्रसितुं समर्थः
verses.transliteration: saṃmantrya devair asuraiś ca sarvair yadāhṛtaṃ saṃmathituṃ samudram yat kālakūṭaṃ samabhūn maheśa tat tvāṃ vinā ko grasituṃ samarthaḥ
verses.translation: When Visvcdevas saw that they were gazing at the face of the girl and had fallen off Yoga, they left their company and went to heaven. When the holy god Moon did not see his daughter Urja, he was upset. Where she may have gone? He thought to himself.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पप्रहारेण जगत्त्रयं यः स्वाधीनम् आपादयितुं समर्थः मारो हरे ऽप्य् अन्यसुरादिवन्द्यो वितायमानो विलयं प्रयातः
verses.transliteration: puṣpaprahāreṇa jagattrayaṃ yaḥ svādhīnam āpādayituṃ samarthaḥ māro hare 'py anyasurādivandyo vitāyamāno vilayaṃ prayātaḥ
verses.translation: Thus cursed by the Moon, the manes, the divine men were deprived of yoga and fell off at Mount Himavat. O best of sages, the manes living on that sustenance passed ten thousand years as it were a single day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विमथ्य वारीशम् अनङ्गशत्रो यद् उत्तमं तत् तु दिवौकसेभ्यः दत्त्वा विषं संहरन् नीलकण्ठ को वा धर्तुं त्वाम् ऋते वै समर्थः
verses.transliteration: vimathya vārīśam anaṅgaśatro yad uttamaṃ tat tu divaukasebhyaḥ dattvā viṣaṃ saṃharan nīlakaṇṭha ko vā dhartuṃ tvām ṛte vai samarthaḥ
verses.translation: Then the asuras, yatudhanas and raksasas found that the manes were estranged from Devas anci they fell upon them. The Brahmins stationed on the bank of Koka (who were formerly manes) saw asuras and yatudhanas pouncing upon them. The infuriated brahmins caught hold of a lofty slab.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततश् च तुष्टो भगवान् आदिकर्ता त्रिलोचनः
verses.transliteration: tataś ca tuṣṭo bhagavān ādikartā trilocanaḥ
verses.translation: The fast-flowing Koka saw them holding the slab. She concealed the manes in her waters which overflowed Himalaya. Victory to Govinda: O the abode of the universe, O Kesava, be pleased to favour us with Victory. O Janardana of pure and spotless impression, uplift us from the cavity of waters.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दास्ये ऽहं यद् अभीष्टं वो ब्रुवन्तु सुरसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: dāsye 'haṃ yad abhīṣṭaṃ vo bruvantu surasattamāḥ
verses.translation: O lord, Visnu, O Boar, Vaikuntha, Narayana, lord of lords, lotus-navelled, worthy of praise, we are afraid of asuras, of dreadful sight; protect us, O lord, and grant us victory. O Visnu, the younger brother of lord Indra, O Yogin, the slayer of Madhu and Kaitabha demons, O Endless, of steady disposition, Vasudeva, holding bow, discus, lotus and conch in your hands, O lord of Devas, protect us from raksasas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दानवेभ्यो भयं घोरं तत्रैहि वृषभध्वज जहि शत्रून् सुरान् पाहि नाथवन्तस् त्वया प्रभो
verses.transliteration: dānavebhyo bhayaṃ ghoraṃ tatraihi vṛṣabhadhvaja jahi śatrūn surān pāhi nāthavantas tvayā prabho
verses.translation: O Sambhu, you are the father of universe, the dreadful asuras are unable to assail you. Hence, we come to your shel¬ ter. Thus praised by the manes, the lord in the divine form of a boar, the sustainer of this Earth saw the manes, merged in the waters of Koka carrying slabs over their head.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निष्कारणः सुहृच् छंभो नाभविष्यद् भवान् यदि तदाकरिष्यन् किम् इव दुःखार्ताः सर्वदेहिनः
verses.transliteration: niṣkāraṇaḥ suhṛc chaṃbho nābhaviṣyad bhavān yadi tadākariṣyan kim iva duḥkhārtāḥ sarvadehinaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Visnu, in the form of a boar, saw the manes hid¬ den in the waters of Koka out of fear from the asuras and thou¬ ght of uplifting them to the Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्तस् तत्क्षणात् प्रायाद् यत्र ते देवशत्रवः तत्र तद् युद्धम् अभवच् छंकरेण सुरद्विषाम्
verses.transliteration: ity uktas tatkṣaṇāt prāyād yatra te devaśatravaḥ tatra tad yuddham abhavac chaṃkareṇa suradviṣām
verses.translation: The boar cast away the slab with the tip of his tusks and brought up the manes to the Earth. They said: "You may" The Lord then invoked all <mds and on their arrival gave them seats.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् त्रिलोचनः श्रान्तस् तमोरूपधरः शिवः ललाटाद् व्यपतंस् तस्य युध्यतः स्वेदबिन्दवः
verses.transliteration: tatas trilocanaḥ śrāntas tamorūpadharaḥ śivaḥ lalāṭād vyapataṃs tasya yudhyataḥ svedabindavaḥ
verses.translation: Adorned with discus and mace, he planned out their protection with the unbroken rice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स संहरन् दैत्यगणांस् तामसीं मूर्तिम् आश्रितः तां मूर्तिम् असुरा दृष्ट्वा मेरुपृष्ठाद् भुवं ययुः
verses.transliteration: sa saṃharan daityagaṇāṃs tāmasīṃ mūrtim āśritaḥ tāṃ mūrtim asurā dṛṣṭvā merupṛṣṭhād bhuvaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: The unbroken rice and the barley seeds are born of parts of all-gods. These ward off calamities from all sites- they are produced for the sake of protection. "I invoke the manes, both divine and mortals." When they agreed to be invoked, he invoked them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स संहरन् सर्वदैत्यांस् तदागच्छद् भुवं हरः इतश् चेतश् च भीतास् ते ऽधावन् सर्वां महीम् इमाम्
verses.transliteration: sa saṃharan sarvadaityāṃs tadāgacchad bhuvaṃ haraḥ itaś cetaś ca bhītās te 'dhāvan sarvāṃ mahīm imām
verses.translation: He held a handful of sacred grass together with the
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथैव कोपाद् रुद्रो ऽपि शत्रूंस् तान् अनुधावति तथैव युध्यतः शंभोः पतिताः स्वेदबिन्दवः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva kopād rudro 'pi śatrūṃs tān anudhāvati tathaiva yudhyataḥ śaṃbhoḥ patitāḥ svedabindavaḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, he put his right hand on the right knee and the sacred thread on the right side and invited them with the mantra 'ayantu nah\ Varaha recited the mantra 'apahata' and warded off the asuras from the site. He then transferred his saci ed thi cad to the right. Uttering the names and gotras he invoked the pitrs by the personal and gotra names.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र यत्र भुवं प्राप्तो बिन्दुर् माहेश्वरो मुने तत्र तत्र शिवाकारा मातरो जज्ञिरे ततः
verses.transliteration: yatra yatra bhuvaṃ prāpto bindur māheśvaro mune tatra tatra śivākārā mātaro jajñire tataḥ
verses.translation: Varaha then uttered the mantras 'apyayayantu' and 'samvatsaraih* and poured arghya to the Pitrs who as a result of the curse had assumed the form of Brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रोचुर् महेश्वरं सर्वाः खादामस् त्व् असुरान् इति ततः प्रोवाच भगवान् सर्वैः सुरगणैर् वृतः
verses.transliteration: procur maheśvaraṃ sarvāḥ khādāmas tv asurān iti tataḥ provāca bhagavān sarvaiḥ suragaṇair vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Varaha (incarnate of Visnu) repeated the same proce¬ dure for the maternal grandfather. He propitiated them again with incense etc. and offered them perfume with devotion. The residue of the sacrificial material he offered thrice to each of the Pitrs, by their personal and gotra names.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गाद् भुवम् अनुप्राप्ता राक्षसास् ते रसातलम् अनुप्राप्तास् ततः सर्वाः शृण्वन्तु मम भाषितम्
verses.transliteration: svargād bhuvam anuprāptā rākṣasās te rasātalam anuprāptās tataḥ sarvāḥ śṛṇvantu mama bhāṣitam
verses.translation: The residue of the material such as "food" he put into the vessel wherein the rice-ball was kept. Then, he gave the tasty food together with the rice boiled in milk.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र यत्र द्विषो यान्ति तत्र गच्छन्तु मातरः रसातलम् अनुप्राप्ता इदानीं मद्भयाद् द्विषः भवत्यो ऽप्य् अनुगच्छन्तु रसातलम् अनु द्विषः
verses.transliteration: yatra yatra dviṣo yānti tatra gacchantu mātaraḥ rasātalam anuprāptā idānīṃ madbhayād dviṣaḥ bhavatyo 'py anugacchantu rasātalam anu dviṣaḥ
verses.translation: On their reply, "we are satiated", he gave them water for breaking silence. He gave the rice-ball vessel to Chaya. He divided food into two parts. Then each into three parts. Varaha scratched the Earth and covered the same with
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताश् च जग्मुर् भुवं भित्त्वा यत्र ते दैत्यदानवाः तान् हत्वा मातरः सर्वान् देवारीन् अतिभीषणान्
verses.transliteration: tāś ca jagmur bhuvaṃ bhittvā yatra te daityadānavāḥ tān hatvā mātaraḥ sarvān devārīn atibhīṣaṇān
verses.translation: Having pleased them thus, he should move aside, repeat aghamarsana thrice. Withdrawing himself, he should repeat 'yanme'.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् देवान् उपाजग्मुः पथा तेनैव मातरः गताश् च मातरो यावद् यावच् च पुनर् आगताः
verses.transliteration: punar devān upājagmuḥ pathā tenaiva mātaraḥ gatāś ca mātaro yāvad yāvac ca punar āgatāḥ
verses.translation: Then sprinkling the massive heap of hair with the collected waters of holy rivers he begged blessings of Brahmanas. O lord Boar, by your favour, we shall go to heaven. Let Soma (the Moon-god), the observer of Yoga be our guar¬ dian.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तावद् देवाः स्थिता आसन् गौतमीतीरम् आश्रिताः प्रस्थानात् तत्र मातॄणां सुराणां च प्रतिष्ठितेः
verses.transliteration: tāvad devāḥ sthitā āsan gautamītīram āśritāḥ prasthānāt tatra mātṝṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca pratiṣṭhiteḥ
verses.translation: Let Yama be your deity; Moon the preceptor; Fire the priest.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठानं तु तत् क्षेत्रं पुण्यं विजयवर्धनम् मातॄणां यत्र चोत्पत्तिर् मातृतीर्थं पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: pratiṣṭhānaṃ tu tat kṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ vijayavardhanam mātṝṇāṃ yatra cotpattir mātṛtīrthaṃ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: Let Fire, wind and Sun be your abodes; Brahma, \ isnu and Rudra be your guardians. Let Aditiyas, Vasus and Rudras be your forms. Let \ ogis, embodying \ oga make yoga as your basis and observe
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तत्र बिलान्य् आसन् रसातलगतानि च सुरास् ताभ्यो वरान् प्रोचुर् लोके पूजां यथा शिवः
verses.transliteration: tatra tatra bilāny āsan rasātalagatāni ca surās tābhyo varān procur loke pūjāṃ yathā śivaḥ
verses.translation: Known as Koka, she will resort to Himalaya. She will be as efficacious as the crores of holy places all together.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नोति तद्वन् मातृभ्यः पूजा भवतु सर्वदा इत्य् उक्त्वान्तर्दधुर् देवा आसंस् तत्रैव मातरः
verses.transliteration: prāpnoti tadvan mātṛbhyaḥ pūjā bhavatu sarvadā ity uktvāntardadhur devā āsaṃs tatraiva mātaraḥ
verses.translation: I shall stay in Koka from this very day, smashing sins of all mankind. The sight of lord Boar is holy. His worship grants worldly pleasures and salvation. Drinking the water of Koka destroys sins. The plunge yields merit. The fast leads to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र यत्र स्थिता देव्यो मातृतीर्थं ततो विदुः सुराणाम् अपि सेव्यानि किं पुनर् मानुषादिभिः
verses.transliteration: yatra yatra sthitā devyo mātṛtīrthaṃ tato viduḥ surāṇām api sevyāni kiṃ punar mānuṣādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Charity gives imperishable fruit; it destroys sins of birth, death and old age.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेषु स्नानम् अथो दानं पितॄणां चैव तर्पणम् सर्वं तद् अक्षयं ज्ञेयं शिवस्य वचनं यथा
verses.transliteration: teṣu snānam atho dānaṃ pitṝṇāṃ caiva tarpaṇam sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ jñeyaṃ śivasya vacanaṃ yathā
verses.translation: He who fasts here reaps the fruit thereof as mentioned previously. O blessed ones, you are now free to go to your places at your will. "I too shall rest here", saying this lord Boar disappear¬ ed. When lord Boar had gone, the pitrs took leave of Koka and went away.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस् त्व् इदं शृणुयान् नित्यं स्मरेद् अपि पठेत् तथा आख्यानं मातृतीर्थानाम् आयुष्मान् स सुखी भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yas tv idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ smared api paṭhet tathā ākhyānaṃ mātṛtīrthānām āyuṣmān sa sukhī bhavet
verses.translation: Thus have I described at Kokamukha the Boar incar¬ nate ofVisnu who confers boons to the people. On hearing this description, a man is purified from dirt, becomes devoid of sins, and obtains the merit of performing Asvamedha Sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इदम् अप्य् अपरं तीर्थं देवानाम् अपि दुर्लभम् ब्रह्मतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: idam apy aparaṃ tīrthaṃ devānām api durlabham brahmatīrtham iti khyātaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām
verses.translation: Women and Sudras too should perform the same under the direction of Brahmanas. But there should be no recitation of mantras or ritual of sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्थितेषु देवसैन्येषु प्रविष्टेषु रसातलम् दैत्येषु च मुनिश्रेष्ठ तथा मातृषु तान् अनु
verses.transliteration: sthiteṣu devasainyeṣu praviṣṭeṣu rasātalam daityeṣu ca muniśreṣṭha tathā mātṛṣu tān anu
verses.translation: When the sun enters zodiac Kanya, there are fifteen days exclusively meant for Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मदीयं पञ्चमं वक्त्रं गर्दभाकृति भीषणम् तद् वक्त्रं देवसैन्येषु मयि तिष्ठत्य् उवाच ह
verses.transliteration: madīyaṃ pañcamaṃ vaktraṃ gardabhākṛti bhīṣaṇam tad vaktraṃ devasainyeṣu mayi tiṣṭhaty uvāca ha
verses.translation: When the sun has entered the Kanya Zodiac, the per¬ former of Sraddha in that period obtains whatever desire lie • has in his mind. Nandlmukha should be performed during the same period. It should be done in Purnima as stated in Varaha Purana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हे दैत्याः किं पलायन्ते न भयं वो ऽस्तु सत्वरम् आगच्छन्तु सुरान् सर्वान् भक्षयिष्ये क्षणाद् इति
verses.transliteration: he daityāḥ kiṃ palāyante na bhayaṃ vo 'stu satvaram āgacchantu surān sarvān bhakṣayiṣye kṣaṇād iti
verses.translation: When a Brahmin versed in the Vedas and the firc- lituals comes to the house, he alone should be considered as worthy of Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निवारयन्तं माम् एवं भक्षणायोद्यतं तथा तं दृष्ट्वा विबुधाः सर्वे वित्रस्ता विष्णुम् अब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: nivārayantaṃ mām evaṃ bhakṣaṇāyodyataṃ tathā taṃ dṛṣṭvā vibudhāḥ sarve vitrastā viṣṇum abruvan
verses.translation: When the material for Sraddha approved by the experts is available, he should perform Parvana Sraddha with the help of Brahmins well versed in the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्राहि विष्णो जगन्नाथ ब्रह्मणो ऽस्य मुखं लुन चक्रधृग् विबुधान् आह च्छेद्मि चक्रेण वै शिरः
verses.transliteration: trāhi viṣṇo jagannātha brahmaṇo 'sya mukhaṃ luna cakradhṛg vibudhān āha cchedmi cakreṇa vai śiraḥ
verses.translation: One should celebrate the anniversary of one's departed parents, also of the uncle and elder brother if they died sonless.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं तु तच् छिन्नम् एवेदं संहरेत् सचराचरम् मन्त्रं ब्रूमो ऽत्र विबुधाः श्रूयतां सर्वम् एव हि
verses.transliteration: kiṃ tu tac chinnam evedaṃ saṃharet sacarācaram mantraṃ brūmo 'tra vibudhāḥ śrūyatāṃ sarvam eva hi
verses.translation: After purification, they enjoin Ekoddista, on the twelfth day, or after the expiry of a month or at the end of three fort¬ nights.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रिनेत्रः कशिरश् छेत्ता स च धत्ते न संशयः मया च शंभुः सर्वैश् च स्तुतः प्रोक्तस् तथैव च
verses.transliteration: trinetraḥ kaśiraś chettā sa ca dhatte na saṃśayaḥ mayā ca śaṃbhuḥ sarvaiś ca stutaḥ proktas tathaiva ca
verses.translation: O Brahmins, Sraddha should be performed every month, for a year. Then he should perform sapindlkarana rite after a year. When that is done, he should perform Parvana. The de¬ ceased then change their states as Preta to thatofPitrs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यागः क्षणी दृष्टफले ऽसमर्थः स नैव कर्तुः फलतीति मत्वा फलस्य दाने प्रतिभूर् जटीति निश्चित्य लोकः प्रतिकर्म यातः
verses.transliteration: yāgaḥ kṣaṇī dṛṣṭaphale 'samarthaḥ sa naiva kartuḥ phalatīti matvā phalasya dāne pratibhūr jaṭīti niścitya lokaḥ pratikarma yātaḥ
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरेशः संतुष्टो देवानां कार्यसिद्धये लोकानाम् उपकारार्थं तथेत्य् आह सुरान् प्रति
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sureśaḥ saṃtuṣṭo devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye lokānām upakārārthaṃ tathety āha surān prati
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद्वक्त्रं पापरूपं यद् भीषणं लोमहर्षणम् निकृत्य नखशस्त्रैश् च क्व स्थाप्यं चेत्य् अथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tadvaktraṃ pāparūpaṃ yad bhīṣaṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam nikṛtya nakhaśastraiś ca kva sthāpyaṃ cety athābravīt
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रेला विबुधान् आह नाहं वोढुं शिरः क्षमा रसातलम् अथो यास्ये उदधिश् चाप्य् अथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tatrelā vibudhān āha nāhaṃ voḍhuṃ śiraḥ kṣamā rasātalam atho yāsye udadhiś cāpy athābravīt
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शोषं यास्ये क्षणाद् एव पुनश् चोचुः शिवं सुराः त्वयैवैतद् ब्रह्मशिरो धार्यं लोकानुकम्पया
verses.transliteration: śoṣaṃ yāsye kṣaṇād eva punaś cocuḥ śivaṃ surāḥ tvayaivaitad brahmaśiro dhāryaṃ lokānukampayā
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अच्छेदे जगतां नाशश् छेदे दोषश् च तादृशः एवं विमृश्य सोमेशो दधार कशिरस् तदा
verses.transliteration: acchede jagatāṃ nāśaś chede doṣaś ca tādṛśaḥ evaṃ vimṛśya someśo dadhāra kaśiras tadā
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् दृष्ट्वा दुष्करं कर्म गौतमीं प्राप्य पावनीम् अस्तुवञ् जगताम् ईशं प्रणयाद् भक्तितः सुराः
verses.transliteration: tad dṛṣṭvā duṣkaraṃ karma gautamīṃ prāpya pāvanīm astuvañ jagatām īśaṃ praṇayād bhaktitaḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवेष्व् अमित्रं कशिरो ऽतिभीमं तान् भक्षणायोपगतं निकृत्य नखाग्रसूच्या शकलेन्दुमौलिस् त्यागे ऽपि दोषात् कृपयानुधत्ते
verses.transliteration: deveṣv amitraṃ kaśiro 'tibhīmaṃ tān bhakṣaṇāyopagataṃ nikṛtya nakhāgrasūcyā śakalendumaulis tyāge 'pi doṣāt kṛpayānudhatte
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ते विबुधाः सर्वे स्थिता ये ब्रह्मणो ऽन्तिके तुष्टुवुर् विबुधेशानं कर्म दृष्ट्वातिदैवतम्
verses.transliteration: tatra te vibudhāḥ sarve sthitā ye brahmaṇo 'ntike tuṣṭuvur vibudheśānaṃ karma dṛṣṭvātidaivatam
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं ब्रह्मतीर्थम् इति श्रुतम् अद्यापि ब्रह्मणो रूपं चतुर्मुखम् अवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ brahmatīrtham iti śrutam adyāpi brahmaṇo rūpaṃ caturmukham avasthitam
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिरोमात्रं तु यः पश्येत् स गच्छेद् ब्रह्मणः पदम् यत्र स्थित्वा स्वयं रुद्रो लूनवान् ब्रह्मणः शिरः
verses.transliteration: śiromātraṃ tu yaḥ paśyet sa gacched brahmaṇaḥ padam yatra sthitvā svayaṃ rudro lūnavān brahmaṇaḥ śiraḥ
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रतीर्थं तद् एव स्यात् तत्र साक्षाद् दिवाकरः देवानां च स्वरूपेण स्थितो यस्मात् तद् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: rudratīrthaṃ tad eva syāt tatra sākṣād divākaraḥ devānāṃ ca svarūpeṇa sthito yasmāt tad uttamam
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सौर्यं तीर्थं तद् आख्यातं सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम् तत्र स्नात्वा रविं दृष्ट्वा पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: sauryaṃ tīrthaṃ tad ākhyātaṃ sarvakratuphalapradam tatra snātvā raviṃ dṛṣṭvā punarjanma na vidyate
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महादेवेन यच् छिन्नं ब्रह्मणः पञ्चमं शिरः क्षेत्रे ऽविमुक्ते संस्थाप्य देवतानां हितं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: mahādevena yac chinnaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ kṣetre 'vimukte saṃsthāpya devatānāṃ hitaṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मतीर्थे शिरोमात्रं यो दृष्ट्वा गौतमीतटे क्षेत्रे ऽविमुक्ते तस्यैव स्थापितं यो ऽनुपश्यति कपालं ब्रह्मणः पुण्यं ब्रह्महा पूततां व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmatīrthe śiromātraṃ yo dṛṣṭvā gautamītaṭe kṣetre 'vimukte tasyaiva sthāpitaṃ yo 'nupaśyati kapālaṃ brahmaṇaḥ puṇyaṃ brahmahā pūtatāṃ vrajet
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अविघ्नं तीर्थम् आख्यातं सर्वविघ्नविनाशनम् तत्रापि वृत्तम् आख्यास्ये शृणु नारद भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: avighnaṃ tīrtham ākhyātaṃ sarvavighnavināśanam tatrāpi vṛttam ākhyāsye śṛṇu nārada bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: There should be four vessels, three for the Pitrs, mixed with sesamum seeds, incense and water and one for the Preta.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवसत्त्रे प्रवृत्ते तु गौतम्याश् चोत्तरे तटे समाप्तिर् नैव सत्त्रस्य संजाता विघ्नदोषतः
verses.transliteration: devasattre pravṛtte tu gautamyāś cottare taṭe samāptir naiva sattrasya saṃjātā vighnadoṣataḥ
verses.translation: In each of the three vessels some water from the Preta patra should be poured. In each case, he should recite the mantra "Ye samana".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरगणाः सर्वे माम् अवोचन् हरिं तदा ततो ध्यानगतो ऽहं तान् अवोचं वीक्ष्य कारणम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve mām avocan hariṃ tadā tato dhyānagato 'haṃ tān avocaṃ vīkṣya kāraṇam
verses.translation: In regard to women also, the same procedure should be adopted. But sapindikarana need not be performed if the deceas¬ ed woman had no sons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विनायककृतैर् विघ्नैर् नैतत् सत्त्रं समाप्यते तस्मात् स्तुवन्तु ते सर्वे आदिदेवं विनायकम्
verses.transliteration: vināyakakṛtair vighnair naitat sattraṃ samāpyate tasmāt stuvantu te sarve ādidevaṃ vināyakam
verses.translation: In case of women sapindikarana should be done every year by men. The rite should be performed on their death anni¬ versary, as enjoined by the sastras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सुरगणाः स्नात्वा ते गौतमीतटे अस्तुवन् भक्तितो देवा आदिदेवं गणेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā suragaṇāḥ snātvā te gautamītaṭe astuvan bhaktito devā ādidevaṃ gaṇeśvaram
verses.translation: If there be no son, this should be performed by the rela¬ tives connected by the offering of rice balls. If there be no such relatives, brothers should do the same. If there be no brothers, grandsons or great-grandsons should perform the sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यः सर्वकार्येषु सदा सुराणाम् अपीशविष्ण्वम्बुजसंभवानाम् पूज्यो नमस्यः परिचिन्तनीयस् तं विघ्नराजं शरणं व्रजामः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sarvakāryeṣu sadā surāṇām apīśaviṣṇvambujasaṃbhavānām pūjyo namasyaḥ paricintanīyas taṃ vighnarājaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmaḥ
verses.translation: The daughter's son should perform the rite for hfa maternal groud-fa,her. They are named dvyamusyayana (fo
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न विघ्नराजेन समो ऽस्ति कश्चिद् देवो मनोवाञ्छितसंप्रदाता निश्चित्य चैतत् त्रिपुरान्तको ऽपि तं पूजयाम् आस वधे पुराणाम्
verses.transliteration: na vighnarājena samo 'sti kaścid devo manovāñchitasaṃpradātā niścitya caitat tripurāntako 'pi taṃ pūjayām āsa vadhe purāṇām
verses.translation: The list of Brahmins as mentioned above should be invited a day before Sraddha. Whether the rite pertains to gods or manes, he should appoint them accordingly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: करोतु सो ऽस्माकम् अविघ्नम् अस्मिन् महाक्रतौ सत्वरम् आम्बिकेयः ध्यातेन येनाखिलदेहभाजां पूर्णा भविष्यन्ति मनोभिलाषाः
verses.transliteration: karotu so 'smākam avighnam asmin mahākratau satvaram āmbikeyaḥ dhyātena yenākhiladehabhājāṃ pūrṇā bhaviṣyanti manobhilāṣāḥ
verses.translation: He who gives fresh garments, made of silk or cotton, obtains the fulfilment of his desire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महोत्सवो ऽभूद् अखिलस्य देव्या जातः सुतश् चिन्तितमात्र एव अतो ऽवदन् सुरसंघाः कृतार्थाः सद्योजातं विघ्नराजं नमन्तः
verses.transliteration: mahotsavo 'bhūd akhilasya devyā jātaḥ sutaś cintitamātra eva ato 'vadan surasaṃghāḥ kṛtārthāḥ sadyojātaṃ vighnarājaṃ namantaḥ
verses.translation: The Pitrs receive food offered to the brahmins who utter the Pitr's name, gotra and mantras. Although they are not present in physical forms they get satiated thereby.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो मातुर् उत्सङ्गगतो ऽथ मात्रा निवार्यमाणो ऽपि बलाच् च चन्द्रम् संगोपयाम् आस पितुर् जटासु गणाधिनाथस्य विनोद एषः
verses.transliteration: yo mātur utsaṅgagato 'tha mātrā nivāryamāṇo 'pi balāc ca candram saṃgopayām āsa pitur jaṭāsu gaṇādhināthasya vinoda eṣaḥ
verses.translation: Homage to Deities, Pitrs and Yogins. Homage to Svaha, Svadha for ever and for ever.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पपौ स्तनं मातुर् अथापि तृप्तो यो भ्रातृमात्सर्यकषायबुद्धिः लम्बोदरस् त्वं भव विघ्नराजो लम्बोदरं नाम चकार शंभुः
verses.transliteration: papau stanaṃ mātur athāpi tṛpto yo bhrātṛmātsaryakaṣāyabuddhiḥ lambodaras tvaṃ bhava vighnarājo lambodaraṃ nāma cakāra śaṃbhuḥ
verses.translation: At the beginning and the end of Sraddha, he should repeat the same thrice. At the offering of the rice-ball as well, he should recite this attentively.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संवेष्टितो देवगणैर् महेशः प्रवर्ततां नृत्यम् इतीत्य् उवाच संतोषितो नूपुररावमात्राद् गणेश्वरत्वे ऽभिषिषेच पुत्रम्
verses.transliteration: saṃveṣṭito devagaṇair maheśaḥ pravartatāṃ nṛtyam itīty uvāca saṃtoṣito nūpurarāvamātrād gaṇeśvaratve 'bhiṣiṣeca putram
verses.translation: Pitrs come very soon. Raksasas fly away. They get propitiated in the three worlds. This mantra, indeed uplifts them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो विघ्नपाशं च करेण बिभ्रत् स्कन्धे कुठारं च तथा परेण अपूजितो विघ्नम् अथो ऽपि मातुः करोति को विघ्नपतेः समो ऽन्यः
verses.transliteration: yo vighnapāśaṃ ca kareṇa bibhrat skandhe kuṭhāraṃ ca tathā pareṇa apūjito vighnam atho 'pi mātuḥ karoti ko vighnapateḥ samo 'nyaḥ
verses.translation: He should gift a fresh thread, silken, hempen, cotton, one made of patrorna, patka or kauseya. Variety should be avoided.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थकामादिषु पूर्वपूज्यो देवासुरैः पूज्यत एव नित्यम् यस्यार्चनं नैव विनाशम् अस्ति तं पूर्वपूज्यं प्रथमं नमामि
verses.transliteration: dharmārthakāmādiṣu pūrvapūjyo devāsuraiḥ pūjyata eva nityam yasyārcanaṃ naiva vināśam asti taṃ pūrvapūjyaṃ prathamaṃ namāmi
verses.translation: The wise man should avoid that piece of cloth which in spite of its being full has no fringe. The aforesaid variety docs not propitiate the Pitrs and the donor too comes to grief.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्यार्चनात् प्रार्थनयानुरूपां दृष्ट्वा तु सर्वस्य फलस्य सिद्धिम् स्वतन्त्रसामर्थ्यकृतातिगर्वं भ्रातृप्रियं त्व् आखुरथं तम् ईडे
verses.transliteration: yasyārcanāt prārthanayānurūpāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu sarvasya phalasya siddhim svatantrasāmarthyakṛtātigarvaṃ bhrātṛpriyaṃ tv ākhurathaṃ tam īḍe
verses.translation: With faith and devotion he should offer ball into the fire. If he is in need of progeny, he should give it to his wife, reciting the mantras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो मातरं सरसैर् नृत्यगीतैस् तथाभिलाषैर् अखिलैर् विनोदैः संतोषयाम् आस तदातितुष्टं तं श्रीगणेशं शरणं प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: yo mātaraṃ sarasair nṛtyagītais tathābhilāṣair akhilair vinodaiḥ saṃtoṣayām āsa tadātituṣṭaṃ taṃ śrīgaṇeśaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
verses.translation: If he wishes for brilliant splendour, he should offer it to the cows. If he wishes for wisdom, fame and renown he should offer the same into waters.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुरोपकारैर् असुरैश् च युद्धैः स्तोत्रैर् नमस्कारपरैश् च मन्त्रैः पितृप्रसादेन सदा समृद्धं तं श्रीगणेशं शरणं प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: suropakārair asuraiś ca yuddhaiḥ stotrair namaskāraparaiś ca mantraiḥ pitṛprasādena sadā samṛddhaṃ taṃ śrīgaṇeśaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
verses.translation: If he wishes for longevity he should give it to the
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जये पुराणाम् अकरोत् प्रतीपं पित्रापि हर्षात् प्रतिपूजितो यः निर्विघ्नतां चापि पुनश् चकार तस्मै गणेशाय नमस्करोमि
verses.transliteration: jaye purāṇām akarot pratīpaṃ pitrāpi harṣāt pratipūjito yaḥ nirvighnatāṃ cāpi punaś cakāra tasmai gaṇeśāya namaskaromi
verses.translation: Again, some brahmins opine that Pinda should be lifted by the front. He should do so when the Brahmins have said: "Now, lift it up please".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति स्तुतः सुरगणैर् विघ्नेशः प्राह तान् पुनः
verses.transliteration: iti stutaḥ suragaṇair vighneśaḥ prāha tān punaḥ
verses.translation: Therefore, Sraddha should be performed as the sages of yore have stated. Otherwise, he incurs sin, and the Pitrs do not receive the essence thereof.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इतो निर्विघ्नता सत्त्रे मत्तः स्याद् असुरारिणः
verses.transliteration: ito nirvighnatā sattre mattaḥ syād asurāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Guggulu, sandal paste, Srivasa, Aguru, and such other instances as are available.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवसत्त्रे निवृत्ते तु गणेशः प्राह तान् सुरान्
verses.transliteration: devasattre nivṛtte tu gaṇeśaḥ prāha tān surān
verses.translation: Beans, Canakas, Masuras, Koradusakas, Viprusas, Markatas, Kodravas should be avoided.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रेणानेन ये भक्त्या मां स्तोष्यन्ति यतव्रताः तेषां दारिद्र्यदुःखानि न भवेयुः कदाचन
verses.transliteration: stotreṇānena ye bhaktyā māṃ stoṣyanti yatavratāḥ teṣāṃ dāridryaduḥkhāni na bhaveyuḥ kadācana
verses.translation: He should avoid milk, curd, ghee produced from Ma-. C amara > Mrga, Avika, Ekasapha (an animal whose hoof is not cloven) (as ahorse, ass etc.), the breasts of women, camel.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अत्र ये भक्तितः स्नानं दानं कुर्युर् अतन्द्रिताः तेषां सर्वाणि कार्याणि भवेयुर् इति मन्यताम्
verses.transliteration: atra ye bhaktitaḥ snānaṃ dānaṃ kuryur atandritāḥ teṣāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi bhaveyur iti manyatām
verses.translation: Tala, Varuna, Kakola, Bahupatra, Arjuniphala, Ja- mblra, red Bilva, and the fruit of Sala should be avoided.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद्वाक्यसमकालं तु तथेत्य् ऊचुः सुरा अपि निवृत्ते तु मखे तस्मिन् सुरा जग्मुः स्वम् आलयम्
verses.transliteration: tadvākyasamakālaṃ tu tathety ūcuḥ surā api nivṛtte tu makhe tasmin surā jagmuḥ svam ālayam
verses.translation: He who recites this section on Pitrmedha at the time of Sraddha, O Brahmins, his Pitrs feed upon his food for a number of years lasting for three yugas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थम् अविघ्नम् इति गद्यते सर्वकामप्रदं पुंसां सर्वविघ्नविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham avighnam iti gadyate sarvakāmapradaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvavighnavināśanam
verses.translation: Thus I have told you the section on Pitrmedha which destroys sins and increases merit. Men with controlled mind should hear it attentively and recite the same during the period when the Sraddha is being performed.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शेषतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वकामप्रदायकम् तस्य रूपं प्रवक्ष्यामि यन् मया परिभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: śeṣatīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam tasya rūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi yan mayā paribhāṣitam
verses.translation: Thus the Deities and Manes are to be duly worshipped by the householder by means of the Havya and Xavya offer¬ ings. The guests and kinsmen should be honoured with cooked rice. The living beings, the servants, animals, birds and even ants; the mendicants who beg for alms and all other travellers who come to the house are to be received hospitably. Brahmins observing the disciplined conduct of life of the good should be honoured by the good householder.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शेषो नाम महानागो रसातलपतिः प्रभुः सर्वनागैः परिवृतो रसातलम् अथाभ्यगात्
verses.transliteration: śeṣo nāma mahānāgo rasātalapatiḥ prabhuḥ sarvanāgaiḥ parivṛto rasātalam athābhyagāt
verses.translation: Good conduct should always be preserved by a house¬ holder. There is no welfare here or hereafter to one who is devoid of good conduct. Sacrifices, charitable gifts and austerities are not condu- • cive to the prosperity of the person who transgresses the rules A person who maintains good conduct attains the longe¬ vity of Brahma (?) Virtue and good conduct should always be maintained. Virtue is the symbol of good conduct.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसा दैत्यदनुजाः प्रविष्टा ये रसातलम् तैर् निरस्तो भोगिपतिर् माम् उवाचाथ विह्वलः
verses.transliteration: rākṣasā daityadanujāḥ praviṣṭā ye rasātalam tair nirasto bhogipatir mām uvācātha vihvalaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, one shall avoid evil utterances, falsehoods and harsh words. He shall eschew ignoble scriptures, evil argu¬ ments and service of ignoble persons. One shall perform Homa both in the evening and in the morning, with perfect restraint over the self. He shall not see sunrise and sunset directly. The following activities should be performed in the forenoon Washing the teeth, applying collyrium, embellish¬ ing the hair, looking into the mirror and the Tarpana rite to the deities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रसातलं त्वया दत्तं राक्षसानां ममापि च ते मे स्थानं न दास्यन्ति तस्मात् त्वां शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: rasātalaṃ tvayā dattaṃ rākṣasānāṃ mamāpi ca te me sthānaṃ na dāsyanti tasmāt tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Faeces should not be discharged on the path leading to the ruial residences, holy centres and fields, nor in a ploughed field, nor in a cowpen. One shall not look at the naked wife of another man; one shall not look at one's own ordure. (One shall avoid) see- ing, touching and talking to a women in her menses. One shall not discharge urine or faeces into the waters (of a tank etc.). Nor should one indulge in sexual intercourse under water. One shall not stand on faeces and urine nor on hairs or ashes. One shall not stand over the sharp edge of any cutting instrument.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽहम् अब्रवं नागं गौतमीं याहि पन्नग तत्र स्तुत्वा महादेवं लप्स्यसे त्वं मनोरथम्
verses.transliteration: tato 'ham abravaṃ nāgaṃ gautamīṃ yāhi pannaga tatra stutvā mahādevaṃ lapsyase tvaṃ manoratham
verses.translation: An intelligent man shall not stand on scattered husk, burning coal, bits of ropes, clothes etc. on the road or in a ground. After performing the rite of worship of the Pitfs, Devas, human beings and other living beings, the householder deserves to take food in accordance with his affluence. After performing the Acamana rite, after restricting unnecessary talk, the man shall remain pure. He shall sit fac¬ ing the East or the North and take food with the mind therein. He shall keep the hands between the knees.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नान्यो ऽस्ति लोकत्रितये मनोरथसमर्पकः मद्वाक्यप्रेरितो नागो गङ्गाम् आप्लुत्य यत्नतः कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा तुष्टाव त्रिदशेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nānyo 'sti lokatritaye manorathasamarpakaḥ madvākyaprerito nāgo gaṅgām āplutya yatnataḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā tuṣṭāva tridaśeśvaram
verses.translation: Except in the case of utter destruction of food, the wise man shall not complain about the defects of food at the time of taking it. One shall avoid taking salt directly (i.e. salt should be mixed with food and then taken in). He shall avoid the leavings of food also. An intelligent man shall talk in a way favourable to them (i.e. elderly persons). He shall follow them. He shall not act against them. One shall avoid studying the Vedas during the holi¬ days. One shall never disregard or insult brahmins, fires, cows and the sun.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमस् त्रैलोक्यनाथाय दक्षयज्ञविभेदिने आदिकर्त्रे नमस् तुभ्यं नमस् त्रैलोक्यरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: namas trailokyanāthāya dakṣayajñavibhedine ādikartre namas tubhyaṃ namas trailokyarūpiṇe
verses.translation: One shall discharge faeces and urine facing the north during the day and facing the south during the night. During distress he shall discharge them as he pleases. One shall not speak out the misdeeds of the precep¬ tor. If he is angry, one shall propitiate him. One shall not listen to others who slander him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमः सहस्रशिरसे नमः संहारकारिणे सोमसूर्याग्निरूपाय जलरूपाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: namaḥ sahasraśirase namaḥ saṃhārakāriṇe somasūryāgnirūpāya jalarūpāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: One shall avoid taking oil bath or indulging j„ scxua, intercourse with women on the eighth, fourteenth and Bftecnth lunations as well as on Parvan days. No wise man shall ever stand with arms and upper leg A wise man should not drag a seat with his leg and sit thereon. One shall not prepare a cake of wheat flour or a dish of rice and peas mixed together or meat solely for oneself.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदा सर्वरूपाय कालरूपाय ते नमः पाहि शंकर सर्वेश पाहि सोमेश सर्वग जगन्नाथ नमस् तुभ्यं देहि मे मनसेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: sarvadā sarvarūpāya kālarūpāya te namaḥ pāhi śaṃkara sarveśa pāhi someśa sarvaga jagannātha namas tubhyaṃ dehi me manasepsitam
verses.translation: One shall never wear a red, or a black cloth nor one of variegated colour. No one shall exchange clothes or orna¬ ments (with others). A man shall never take in salt directly. O brahmins, a foodstuff that has been left over for a long time, that has be¬ come dry or that has become stale should be eschewed.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो महेश्वरः प्रीतः प्रादान् नागेप्सितान् वरान् विनाशाय सुरारीणां दैत्यदानवरक्षसाम्
verses.transliteration: tato maheśvaraḥ prītaḥ prādān nāgepsitān varān vināśāya surārīṇāṃ daityadānavarakṣasām
verses.translation: One shall not grind one's teeth, nor beat one's own body. While sleeping, meditating or taking food, one shall eschew the self-study of the Vedas. One shall protect one's wife. One shall avoid jealousy as well as sleeping and indulgence in sexual intercourse during the day. One shall eschew infliction of pain on animals, and all other activities that cause distress and sorrow to others. In the case of the people of all castes, a woman in her monthly course should be avoided for the first four nights. To prevent the birth of a female child, one shall avoid the fifth night also.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शेषाय प्रददौ शूलं जह्य् अनेनारिपुंगवान् ततः प्रोक्तः शिवेनासौ शेषः शूलेन भोगिभिः
verses.transliteration: śeṣāya pradadau śūlaṃ jahy anenāripuṃgavān tataḥ proktaḥ śivenāsau śeṣaḥ śūlena bhogibhiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter he shall carnally approach her on the sixth night or other excellent nights even in number. Boys will be Unrighteous persons indulge in sexual intercourse on Parvan and other days and impotent persons during dusk time. A clever man shall avoid Rikta days.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रसातलम् अथो गत्वा निजघान रिपून् रणे निहत्य नागः शूलेन दैत्यदानवराक्षसान्
verses.transliteration: rasātalam atho gatvā nijaghāna ripūn raṇe nihatya nāgaḥ śūlena daityadānavarākṣasān
verses.translation: Even if rude people speak a lot, one shall never lisen to them. After shaving, vomitting or sexual intercourse with a woman an intelligent person shall take bath along with the clothe worn. He shall take bath also after going to the cremation ground. One shall stand up while meeting friends, persons who are initiated, kings, religious students who have finished studies and become householders and the father-in-law. When they come to one's house one shall greet them in accordance with one's affluences.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न्यवर्तत पुनर् देवो यत्र शेषेश्वरो हरः पथा येन समायातो देवं द्रष्टुं स नागराट्
verses.transliteration: nyavartata punar devo yatra śeṣeśvaro haraḥ pathā yena samāyāto devaṃ draṣṭuṃ sa nāgarāṭ
verses.translation: O brahmins, after honouring and worshipping them in accordance with his capacity he shall bid them farewell to their respective places, after they had stayed for a year. No shrewd man shall hold water and fire together. One shall not stretch one's legs in front of one's preceptors, Devas, Pitrs and brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रसातलाद् यत्र देवो बिलं तत्र व्यजायत तस्माद् बिलतलाद् यातं गाङ्गं वार्य् अतिपुण्यदम्
verses.transliteration: rasātalād yatra devo bilaṃ tatra vyajāyata tasmād bilatalād yātaṃ gāṅgaṃ vāry atipuṇyadam
verses.translation: One should not look at a cow suckling her calf; one should not drink water with the palms joined together to form a cup; an intelligent man shall not cause delay in the short and long periods of cleaning. One shall not blow fire with the mouth. O brahmins, one should not stay in a place where the following four are not present, viz. one who offers debt; a physician, a brahmin well-versed in the Vedas and a river abound¬ ing in water. An intelligent man shall always stay there where the king is strong, interested in virtue and has conquered his ser¬ vants. Whence can one have happiness if the king is bad.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् वारि गङ्गाम् अगमद् गङ्गायाः संगमस् ततः देवस्य पुरतश् चापि कुण्डं तत्र सुविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tad vāri gaṅgām agamad gaṅgāyāḥ saṃgamas tataḥ devasya purataś cāpi kuṇḍaṃ tatra suvistaram
verses.translation: A shrewd man shall live in that country where the husbandmen are generally not very arrogant* and where all medi¬ cines are available. O brahmins, one shall not stay in that place where the following three exist together: one who is eager to conquer; a previous enemy and people who continuously celebrate the festivals.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नागस् तत्राकरोद् धोमं यत्र चाग्निः सदा स्थितः सोष्णं तद् अभवद् वारि गङ्गायास् तत्र संगमः
verses.transliteration: nāgas tatrākarod dhomaṃ yatra cāgniḥ sadā sthitaḥ soṣṇaṃ tad abhavad vāri gaṅgāyās tatra saṃgamaḥ
verses.translation: A learned man shall stay among his fellow travellers of very good conduct. One shall always stay at a place where the king cannot be thwarted and where the earth yields plenty of vegetables. Thus, O brahmins, everything has been mentioned by me for the welfare of you all. Henceforth I shall state the rules of procedure regarding the food-intake. Cooked rice, though stale, can be taken in if it is soak¬ ed in oil. It can be kept thus for a long time. Wheat products, barley products and milk products, kept for a long time can be eaten even if they are devoid of oiliness.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवदेवं समाराध्य नागः प्रीतो महायशाः रसातलं ततो ऽभीष्टं शिवात् प्राप्य तलं ययौ
verses.transliteration: devadevaṃ samārādhya nāgaḥ prīto mahāyaśāḥ rasātalaṃ tato 'bhīṣṭaṃ śivāt prāpya talaṃ yayau
verses.translation: The following can be eaten: hare, tortoise, alliga¬ tor, porcupine and the fish with darts (?) The village boar and the cock should be avoided. In the following circumstances, even if one eats meat, one is not defiled: if it is the remnant/ of offerings unto the Pitrs, Devas etc. or if it is cooked in Sraddha at the request of the brahmins and is sprinkled with holy water or if it is taken as a medicine.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं नागतीर्थम् उदाहृतम् सर्वकामप्रदं पुण्यं रोगदारिद्र्यनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ nāgatīrtham udāhṛtam sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ rogadāridryanāśanam
verses.translation: The cleansing of stony vessels may be with water or by scrubbing with a stone. The cleansing of oily vessels is by means of hot water. The flowing waters devoid of odour are pure. A plot of land becomes pure by the efflux of time, by being burnt, by being swept or when herds of cows pass over it. One shall take bath in natural water reservoirs (lite¬ rally, those dug by gods), in eddies and Ganga (and other) rivers.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आयुर्लक्ष्मीकरं पुण्यं स्नानदानाच् च मुक्तिदम् शृणुयाद् वा पठेद् भक्त्या यो वापि स्मरते तु तत्
verses.transliteration: āyurlakṣmīkaraṃ puṇyaṃ snānadānāc ca muktidam śṛṇuyād vā paṭhed bhaktyā yo vāpi smarate tu tat
verses.translation: (In similar circumstances) a Ksatriya shall remain without performing the Nitya rites for twelve days, a Vaisyafor half a month and a Sudra for a month. After the rite of Sancayana (collection of bones after cremation) the touch of their limbs is laid down in the Sastras. The rites should be performed by the members of the Gotra, after the rite of Sancayana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं शेषेश्वरो यत्र यत्र शक्तिप्रदः शिवः एकविंशतितीर्थानाम् उभयोस् तत्र तीरयोः शतानि मुनिशार्दूल सर्वसंपत्प्रदायिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tīrthaṃ śeṣeśvaro yatra yatra śaktipradaḥ śivaḥ ekaviṃśatitīrthānām ubhayos tatra tīrayoḥ śatāni muniśārdūla sarvasaṃpatpradāyinām
verses.translation: Thereafter the rite of Ekoddista Sraddha should be performed by learned men in regard to the dead man and gifts should be given to the brahmins. When the days are completed the people shall touch water by their vehicles and weapons. After giving water liba¬ tions and Pindas to the dead men people of all castes would have fulfilled all their due rites. They shall perform all rites maintaining purity for prosperity here and hereafter. The Vedas should be studied everyday. One should try to be a learned scholar.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महानलम् इति ख्यातं वडवानलम् उच्यते महानलो यत्र देवो वडवा यत्र सा नदी
verses.transliteration: mahānalam iti khyātaṃ vaḍavānalam ucyate mahānalo yatra devo vaḍavā yatra sā nadī
verses.translation: O holy one, we wish to hear about the special duties of different castes. O excellent brahmin, recount the duties of four Asramas also.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत् तीर्थं पुत्र वक्ष्यामि मृत्युदोषजरापहम् पुरासन् नैमिषारण्ये ऋषयः सत्त्रकारिणः
verses.transliteration: tat tīrthaṃ putra vakṣyāmi mṛtyudoṣajarāpaham purāsan naimiṣāraṇye ṛṣayaḥ sattrakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Listen with restraint to the duties of different castes, Brahmins, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras in due order as they are being recounted by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शमितारं च ऋषयो मृत्युं चक्रुस् तपस्विनः वर्तमाने सत्त्रयागे मृत्यौ शमितरि स्थिते
verses.transliteration: śamitāraṃ ca ṛṣayo mṛtyuṃ cakrus tapasvinaḥ vartamāne sattrayāge mṛtyau śamitari sthite
verses.translation: A Brahmin shall be devoted to (the practice of) sympathy, charitable gift, austerities, sacrifice unto the gods and study of his own branch of the Vedas. He shall regularly perform water libations. He shall maintain sacrificial fires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न ममार तदा कश्चिद् उभयं स्थास्नु जङ्गमम् विना पशून् मुनिश्रेष्ठ मर्त्यं चामर्त्यतां गतम्
verses.transliteration: na mamāra tadā kaścid ubhayaṃ sthāsnu jaṅgamam vinā paśūn muniśreṣṭha martyaṃ cāmartyatāṃ gatam
verses.translation: For his livelihood he shall perform sacrifices on behalf of others. He shall teach Vedic lore to the twice-born. O brahmins, for performing sacrifices he shall accept monetary gifts with discretion.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् त्रिविष्टपे शून्ये मर्त्ये चैवातिसंभृते मृत्युनोपेक्षिते देवा राक्षसान् ऊचिरे तदा
verses.transliteration: tatas triviṣṭape śūnye martye caivātisaṃbhṛte mṛtyunopekṣite devā rākṣasān ūcire tadā
verses.translation: O brahmins, he shall do everything beneficial to the world. He shall not perform what is detrimental to anyone. Friendliness to all living beings is the excellent asset of a Brahmin.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छध्वम् ऋषिसत्त्रं तन् नाशयध्वं महाध्वरम् इति देववचः श्रुत्वा प्रोचुस् ते राक्षसाः सुरान्
verses.transliteration: gacchadhvam ṛṣisattraṃ tan nāśayadhvaṃ mahādhvaram iti devavacaḥ śrutvā procus te rākṣasāḥ surān
verses.translation: O brahmins, he shall view a cow and another man's precious gem as equal. O brahmins, his carnal approach to his wife during the permissible period after the days of mens¬ truation, is commended.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विध्वंसयामस् तं यज्ञम् अस्माकं किं फलं ततः प्रवर्तते विना हेतुं न कोपि क्वापि जातुचित्
verses.transliteration: vidhvaṃsayāmas taṃ yajñam asmākaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tataḥ pravartate vinā hetuṃ na kopi kvāpi jātucit
verses.translation: A Ksatnya shall give charitable gifts to the brahmins as much as they wish. O brahmins, he should perform different sacrifices and read the Vedas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवा अप्य् असुरान् ऊचुर् यज्ञार्धं भवताम् अपि भवेद् एव ततो यान्तु ऋषीणां सत्त्रम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: devā apy asurān ūcur yajñārdhaṃ bhavatām api bhaved eva tato yāntu ṛṣīṇāṃ sattram uttamam
verses.translation: He shall maintain himself through his weapons. Protec¬ tion of Earth is his excellent means of livelihood. Sustenance of Earth is his primary duty.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ते श्रुत्वा त्वरिताः सर्वे यत्र यज्ञः प्रवर्तते जग्मुस् तत्र विनाशाय देववाक्याद् विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: te śrutvā tvaritāḥ sarve yatra yajñaḥ pravartate jagmus tatra vināśāya devavākyād viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Rulers of men (kings) are content only by due sus¬ tenance of the Earth, since the protection of the king himself is accomplished by such holy rites as sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तज् ज्ञात्वा ऋषयो मृत्युम् आहुः किं कुर्महे वयम् आगता देववचनाद् राक्षसा यज्ञनाशिनः
verses.transliteration: taj jñātvā ṛṣayo mṛtyum āhuḥ kiṃ kurmahe vayam āgatā devavacanād rākṣasā yajñanāśinaḥ
verses.translation: For him the following activities tnn..
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृत्युना सह संमन्त्र्य नैमिषारण्यवासिनः सर्वे त्यक्त्वा स्वाश्रमं तं शमित्रा सह नारद
verses.transliteration: mṛtyunā saha saṃmantrya naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ sarve tyaktvā svāśramaṃ taṃ śamitrā saha nārada
verses.translation: In times of adversity the vocation of a Ksatriya or a Vaisya is recommended for a Brahmin; the vocation of a Vais'ya to a Ksatriya and the jobs of a Sudra to both Ksatriyas and Vaisya s.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमात्रम् उपादाय त्यक्त्वा पात्रादिकं तु यत् क्रतुनिष्पत्तये जग्मुर् गौतमीं प्रति सत्वराः
verses.transliteration: agnimātram upādāya tyaktvā pātrādikaṃ tu yat kratuniṣpattaye jagmur gautamīṃ prati satvarāḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, in case of incompetence that shall be avoided. That alone shall be pursued during adversity, but chaotic mixing up of jobs shall not be effected.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा महेशानं रक्षणायोपतस्थिरे कृताञ्जलिपुटास् ते तु तुष्टुवुस् त्रिदशेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā maheśānaṃ rakṣaṇāyopatasthire kṛtāñjalipuṭās te tu tuṣṭuvus tridaśeśvaram
verses.translation: Thus, O brahmins, the duties of a Brahmin have been mentioned by me. Understand now the respective duties of the people of various stages of life even as I explain them well.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो लीलया विश्वम् इदं चकार धाता विधाता भुवनत्रयस्य यो विश्वरूपः सदसत्परो यः सोमेश्वरं तं शरणं व्रजामः
verses.transliteration: yo līlayā viśvam idaṃ cakāra dhātā vidhātā bhuvanatrayasya yo viśvarūpaḥ sadasatparo yaḥ someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, with concentration and purity of mind lie shall make obeisance to the sun-god and fire-god at dawn as well as at dusk. He shall salute the preceptor too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इच्छामात्रेण यः सर्वं हन्ति पाति करोति च तम् अहं त्रिदशेशानं शरणं यामि शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: icchāmātreṇa yaḥ sarvaṃ hanti pāti karoti ca tam ahaṃ tridaśeśānaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi śaṃkaram
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, he shall stand when the pre¬ ceptor remains standing. He shall follow when the preceptor goes ahead. When the teacher is seated he shall be seated on a lower level. He shall avoid what is contrary to the preceptor.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महानलं महाकायं महानागविभूषणम् महामूर्तिधरं देवं शरणं यामि शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: mahānalaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahānāgavibhūṣaṇam mahāmūrtidharaṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi śaṃkaram
verses.translation: He shall sit in front of him. Without his mind dwelling on anything else he shall repeat the Vedic text recited by the preceptor. Thereafter, on being permitted by him, he shall partake of the cooked food received as alms.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रोवाच भगवान् मृत्यो का प्रीतिर् अस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: tataḥ provāca bhagavān mṛtyo kā prītir astu te
verses.translation: He shall take bath in the water wherein the preceptor has taken bath. Early in the morning everyday he shall fetch water for libation and sacrificial twigs for the preceptor.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसेभ्यो भयं घोरम् आपन्नं त्रिदशेश्वर यज्ञम् अस्मांश् च रक्षस्व यावत् सत्त्रं समाप्यते
verses.transliteration: rākṣasebhyo bhayaṃ ghoram āpannaṃ tridaśeśvara yajñam asmāṃś ca rakṣasva yāvat sattraṃ samāpyate
verses.translation: Having learnt the requisite Vedic texts he shall pay fees to his preceptor. On getting his permission he shall enter the stage of a householder. He shall duly acquire a wife. O brahmins, after earning wealth by his own work he shall perform the duties of a householder.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा चकार भगवांस् त्रिनेत्रो वृषभध्वजः शमित्रा मृत्युना सत्त्रम् ऋषीणां पूर्णतां ययौ
verses.transliteration: tathā cakāra bhagavāṃs trinetro vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ śamitrā mṛtyunā sattram ṛṣīṇāṃ pūrṇatāṃ yayau
verses.translation: The recluses and religious students who sustain them- selves by cooked food received as alms depend on the householder. Hence the stage of householder is the noblest.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हविषां भागधेयाय आजग्मुर् अमराः क्रमात् तान् अवोचन् मुनिगणाः संक्षुब्धा मृत्युना सह
verses.transliteration: haviṣāṃ bhāgadheyāya ājagmur amarāḥ kramāt tān avocan munigaṇāḥ saṃkṣubdhā mṛtyunā saha
verses.translation: For a householder the following arc despicable: Dishonouring (others), egotism, arrogance, slandering, attacking and speaking harsh words to others. At a ripe old age, O brahmins, the householder who has duly fulfilled his duties shall entrust his sons with the duty of looking after his wife and himself retire and go to the forest. Or he can allow his wife to accompany him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अस्मन्मखविनाशाय राक्षसाः प्रेषिता यतः तस्माद् भवद्भ्यः पापिष्ठा राक्षसाः सन्तु शत्रवः
verses.transliteration: asmanmakhavināśāya rākṣasāḥ preṣitā yataḥ tasmād bhavadbhyaḥ pāpiṣṭhā rākṣasāḥ santu śatravaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, his wearing apparel and upper garment shall consist of leather, Darbha grass or Kasa plants. Taking head bath thrice a day (in rivers or lakes) is recommen¬ ded for him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति देवानां राक्षसा वैरिणो ऽभवन् कृत्यां च वडवां तत्र देवाश् च ऋषयो ऽमलाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti devānāṃ rākṣasā vairiṇo 'bhavan kṛtyāṃ ca vaḍavāṃ tatra devāś ca ṛṣayo 'malāḥ
verses.translation: The following are highly recommended in his case: Worship of the deities, offering ghee into the fire, greeting and honouring visitors and guests, begging alms and offering oblations. Massaging his limbs by means of oil obtained from forest products is also commended. O leading brahmins, ability to bear the extremes of chilliness and heat is a form of penance unto him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृत्योर् भार्या भव त्वं ताम् इत्य् उक्त्वा ते ऽभ्यषेचयन् अभिषेकोदकं यत् तु सा नदी वडवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: mṛtyor bhāryā bhava tvaṃ tām ity uktvā te 'bhyaṣecayan abhiṣekodakaṃ yat tu sā nadī vaḍavābhavat
verses.translation: The forest-dwelling recluse who ■ regularly preforms
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृत्युना स्थापितं लिङ्गं महानलम् इति श्रुतम् ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं वडवासंगमं विदुः
verses.transliteration: mṛtyunā sthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ mahānalam iti śrutam tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ vaḍavāsaṃgamaṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: O excellent ones, follow me even as I O excellent brahmins, a mendicant shall., affection and attacliment unto his sons wife mri * eschew
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महानलो यत्र देवस् तत् तीर्थं भुक्तिमुक्तिदम् सहस्रं तत्र तीर्थानां सर्वाभीष्टप्रदायिनाम् उभयोस् तीरयोस् तत्र स्मरणाद् अघघातिनाम्
verses.transliteration: mahānalo yatra devas tat tīrthaṃ bhuktimuktidam sahasraṃ tatra tīrthānāṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinām ubhayos tīrayos tatra smaraṇād aghaghātinām
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, he shall leave off th~.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आत्मतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं नृणाम् तस्य प्रभावं वक्ष्यामि यत्र ज्ञानेश्वरः शिवः
verses.transliteration: ātmatīrtham iti khyātaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi yatra jñāneśvaraḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: The Brahmins fall off from their status by performing evil deeds. For the same reason one is forced down again even after attaining the most excellent of castes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दत्त इत्य् अपि विख्यातः सो ऽत्रिपुत्रो हरप्रियः दुर्वाससः प्रियो भ्राता सर्वज्ञानविशारदः स गत्वा पितरं प्राह विनयेन प्रणम्य च
verses.transliteration: datta ity api vikhyātaḥ so 'triputro harapriyaḥ durvāsasaḥ priyo bhrātā sarvajñānaviśāradaḥ sa gatvā pitaraṃ prāha vinayena praṇamya ca
verses.translation: One who adheres to the characteristics of a Brahmin, whether a Ksatriya or a Vaisya, attains Brahminhood.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मज्ञानं कथं मे स्यात् कं पृच्छामि क्व यामि च
verses.transliteration: brahmajñānaṃ kathaṃ me syāt kaṃ pṛcchāmi kva yāmi ca
verses.translation: He who forsakes brahminhood and resorts to the acti¬ vities and features of a Ksatriya incurs a downfall from the status of a Brahmin and is bom of a Ksatriya womb.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वात्रिः पुत्रवाक्यं ध्यात्वा वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvātriḥ putravākyaṃ dhyātvā vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: O goddess, this too, another thing pertaining to the Atman has been cited by Brahma. Eternal achievement is re¬ sorted to by those who are desirous of righteous activities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतमीं पुत्र गच्छ त्वं तत्र स्तुहि महेश्वरम् स तु प्रीतो यदैव स्यात् तदा ज्ञानम् अवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: gautamīṃ putra gaccha tvaṃ tatra stuhi maheśvaram sa tu prīto yadaiva syāt tadā jñānam avāpsyasi
verses.translation: O goddess, the food cooked by the mixed caste Ugra is despicable. The food collectively cooked, the food pertaining to Sraddha, the food defiled by pollution due to the birth or death of someone in the family and the food that is loudly proclaim¬ ed should not be eaten. The food cooked by a Sfidra should never be eaten.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा तदात्रेयो गङ्गां गत्वा शुचिर् यतः कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा भक्त्या तुष्टाव शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā tadātreyo gaṅgāṃ gatvā śucir yataḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā bhaktyā tuṣṭāva śaṃkaram
verses.translation: 1 he food cooked by a Sudra is despised by gods and noble men, O goddess. That which is uttered by Brahma is authoritative.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संसारकूपे पतितो ऽस्मि दैवान् मोहेन गुप्तो भवदुःखपङ्के अज्ञाननाम्ना तमसावृतो ऽहं परं न विन्दामि सुराधिनाथ
verses.transliteration: saṃsārakūpe patito 'smi daivān mohena gupto bhavaduḥkhapaṅke ajñānanāmnā tamasāvṛto 'haṃ paraṃ na vindāmi surādhinātha
verses.translation: A Brahmin, a person who maintains sacrificial fires and one who performs sacrifice attain the goal of Sudras if they were to die with the remnants of the food cooked by a Sudra within the stomach.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भिन्नस् त्रिशूलेन बलीयसाहं पापेन चिन्ताक्षुरपाटितश् च तप्तो ऽस्मि पञ्चेन्द्रियतीव्रतापैः श्रान्तो ऽस्मि संतारय सोमनाथ
verses.transliteration: bhinnas triśūlena balīyasāhaṃ pāpena cintākṣurapāṭitaś ca tapto 'smi pañcendriyatīvratāpaiḥ śrānto 'smi saṃtāraya somanātha
verses.translation: A Brahmin, who has been ousted from Brahma's abode by the remnants of food cooked by a Sudra attains the state of a Sudra. This is certain.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बद्धो ऽस्मि दारिद्र्यमयैश् च बन्धैर् हतो ऽस्मि रोगानलतीव्रतापैः क्रान्तो ऽस्म्य् अहं मृत्युभुजंगमेन भीतो भृशं किं करवाणि शंभो
verses.transliteration: baddho 'smi dāridryamayaiś ca bandhair hato 'smi rogānalatīvratāpaiḥ krānto 'smy ahaṃ mṛtyubhujaṃgamena bhīto bhṛśaṃ kiṃ karavāṇi śaṃbho
verses.translation: A Brahmin takes birth in the womb of a lady of the same caste as the person whose food he uses for sustenance or the remnants of whose food remain undigested in his stomach at the time of his death.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भवाभवाभ्याम् अतिपीडितो ऽहं तृष्णाक्षुधाभ्यां च रजस्तमोभ्याम् ईदृक्षया जरया चाभिभूतः पश्यावस्थां कृपया मे ऽद्य नाथ
verses.transliteration: bhavābhavābhyām atipīḍito 'haṃ tṛṣṇākṣudhābhyāṃ ca rajastamobhyām īdṛkṣayā jarayā cābhibhūtaḥ paśyāvasthāṃ kṛpayā me 'dya nātha
verses.translation: After happily attaining the rare privilege of being born as a Brahmin, if anyone slights it or if he partakes of forbidden food, he falls off from the status of a Brahmin.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कामेन कोपेन च मत्सरेण दम्भेन दर्पादिभिर् अप्य् अनेकैः एकैकशः कष्टगतो ऽस्मि विद्धस् त्वं नाथवद् वारय नाथ शत्रून्
verses.transliteration: kāmena kopena ca matsareṇa dambhena darpādibhir apy anekaiḥ ekaikaśaḥ kaṣṭagato 'smi viddhas tvaṃ nāthavad vāraya nātha śatrūn
verses.translation: A Brahmin who defiles the bed of his preceptor, who hates his preceptor, who delights in despising his preceptor or who is hostile to Brahmins, falls from Brahminical birth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कस्यापि कश्चित् पतितस्य पुंसो दुःखप्रणोदी भवतीति सत्यम् विना भवन्तं मम सोमनाथ कुत्रापि कारुण्यवचो ऽपि नास्ति
verses.transliteration: kasyāpi kaścit patitasya puṃso duḥkhapraṇodī bhavatīti satyam vinā bhavantaṃ mama somanātha kutrāpi kāruṇyavaco 'pi nāsti
verses.translation: O goddess, by preforming these splendid holy rites a Sudra attains Brahminhood and a Vaisya the status of a Ksatriya.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तावत् स कोपो भयमोहदुःखान्य् अज्ञानदारिद्र्यरुजस् तथैव कामादयो मृत्युर् अपीह यावन् नमः शिवायेति न वच्मि वाक्यम्
verses.transliteration: tāvat sa kopo bhayamohaduḥkhāny ajñānadāridryarujas tathaiva kāmādayo mṛtyur apīha yāvan namaḥ śivāyeti na vacmi vākyam
verses.translation: O gentle lady, a virtuous Vaisya shall become a Ksa¬ triya by performing his own duties. By the fruits of these acti¬ vities of a lower birth he can become so.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न मे ऽस्ति धर्मो न च मे ऽस्ति भक्तिर् नाहं विवेकी करुणा कुतो मे दातासि तेनाशु शरण्य चित्ते निधेहि सोमेति पदं मदीये
verses.transliteration: na me 'sti dharmo na ca me 'sti bhaktir nāhaṃ vivekī karuṇā kuto me dātāsi tenāśu śaraṇya citte nidhehi someti padaṃ madīye
verses.translation: O gentle lady, a virtuous Vaisya shall become a Ksa¬ triya by performing his own duties. By the fruits of these acti¬ vities of a lower birth he can become so.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: याचे न चाहं सुरभूपतित्वं हृत्पद्ममध्ये मम सोमनाथ श्रीसोमपादाम्बुजसंनिधानं याचे विचार्यैव च तत् कुरुष्व
verses.transliteration: yāce na cāhaṃ surabhūpatitvaṃ hṛtpadmamadhye mama somanātha śrīsomapādāmbujasaṃnidhānaṃ yāce vicāryaiva ca tat kuruṣva
verses.translation: O gentle lady, a virtuous Vaisya shall become a Ksa¬ triya by performing his own duties. By the fruits of these acti¬ vities of a lower birth he can become so.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथा तवाहं विदितो ऽस्मि पापस् तथापि विज्ञापनम् आशृणुष्व संश्रूयते यत्र वचः शिवेति तत्र स्थितिः स्यान् मम सोमनाथ
verses.transliteration: yathā tavāhaṃ vidito 'smi pāpas tathāpi vijñāpanam āśṛṇuṣva saṃśrūyate yatra vacaḥ śiveti tatra sthitiḥ syān mama somanātha
verses.translation: O gentle lady, a virtuous Vaisya shall become a Ksa¬ triya by performing his own duties. By the fruits of these acti¬ vities of a lower birth he can become so.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौरीपते शंकर सोमनाथ विश्वेश कारुण्यनिधे ऽखिलात्मन् संस्तूयते यत्र सदेति तत्र केषाम् अपि स्यात् कृतिनां निवासः
verses.transliteration: gaurīpate śaṃkara somanātha viśveśa kāruṇyanidhe 'khilātman saṃstūyate yatra sadeti tatra keṣām api syāt kṛtināṃ nivāsaḥ
verses.translation: O gentle lady, a virtuous Vaisya shall become a Ksa¬ triya by performing his own duties. By the fruits of these acti¬ vities of a lower birth he can become so.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् आत्रेयस्तुतिं श्रुत्वा तुतोष भगवान् हरः वरदो ऽस्मीति तं प्राह योगिनं विश्वकृद् भवः
verses.transliteration: ity ātreyastutiṃ śrutvā tutoṣa bhagavān haraḥ varado 'smīti taṃ prāha yoginaṃ viśvakṛd bhavaḥ
verses.translation: O gentle lady, a virtuous Vaisya shall become a Ksa¬ triya by performing his own duties. By the fruits of these acti¬ vities of a lower birth he can become so.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आत्मज्ञानं च मुक्तिं च भुक्तिं च विपुलां त्वयि तीर्थस्यापि च माहात्म्यं वरो ऽयं त्रिदशार्चित
verses.transliteration: ātmajñānaṃ ca muktiṃ ca bhuktiṃ ca vipulāṃ tvayi tīrthasyāpi ca māhātmyaṃ varo 'yaṃ tridaśārcita
verses.translation: O gentle lady, a virtuous Vaisya shall become a Ksa¬ triya by performing his own duties. By the fruits of these acti¬ vities of a lower birth he can become so.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् अस्त्व् इति तं शंभुर् उक्त्वा चान्तरधीयत ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थम् आत्मतीर्थं विदुर् बुधाः तत्र स्नानेन दानेन मुक्तिः स्याद् इह नारद
verses.transliteration: evam astv iti taṃ śaṃbhur uktvā cāntaradhīyata tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham ātmatīrthaṃ vidur budhāḥ tatra snānena dānena muktiḥ syād iha nārada
verses.translation: O gentle lady, a virtuous Vaisya shall become a Ksa¬ triya by performing his own duties. By the fruits of these acti¬ vities of a lower birth he can become so.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थतीर्थम् आख्यातं पिप्पलं च ततः परम् उत्तरे मन्दतीर्थं तु तत्र व्युष्टिम् इतः शृणु
verses.transliteration: aśvatthatīrtham ākhyātaṃ pippalaṃ ca tataḥ param uttare mandatīrthaṃ tu tatra vyuṣṭim itaḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: O lord of all living beings, O lord saluted by Devas and
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरा त्व् अगस्त्यो भगवान् दक्षिणाशापतिः प्रभुः देवैस् तु प्रेरितः पूर्वं विन्ध्यस्य प्रार्थनं प्रति
verses.transliteration: purā tv agastyo bhagavān dakṣiṇāśāpatiḥ prabhuḥ devais tu preritaḥ pūrvaṃ vindhyasya prārthanaṃ prati
verses.translation: All embodied beings are bound by three kinds of bonds, viz. thought, speech and physical action. How are they released therefrom?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स शनैर् विन्ध्यम् अभ्यागात् सहस्रमुनिभिर् वृतः तम् आगत्य नगश्रेष्ठं बहुवृक्षसमाकुलम्
