verses.transliteration: sa śanair vindhyam abhyāgāt sahasramunibhir vṛtaḥ tam āgatya nagaśreṣṭhaṃ bahuvṛkṣasamākulam
verses.translation: O lord, by what habitual practice, by what holy rite, by what sort of conduct and good quality do men go to heaven? MaheSvara said:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्पर्धिनं मेरुभानुभ्यां विन्ध्यं शृङ्गशतैर् वृतम् अत्युन्नतं नगं धीरो लोपामुद्रापतिर् मुनिः
verses.transliteration: spardhinaṃ merubhānubhyāṃ vindhyaṃ śṛṅgaśatair vṛtam atyunnataṃ nagaṃ dhīro lopāmudrāpatir muniḥ
verses.translation: O goddess Uma of perfect v knowledge of the principles of piety, O gentle lady of permanent adherence to virtue, your question is conducive to welfare and wisdom of all living beings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृतातिथ्यो द्विजैः सार्धं प्रशस्य च नगं पुनः इदम् आह मुनिश्रेष्ठो देवकार्यार्थसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: kṛtātithyo dvijaiḥ sārdhaṃ praśasya ca nagaṃ punaḥ idam āha muniśreṣṭho devakāryārthasiddhaye
verses.translation: Persons of tranquillity, engaged in truth and piety and devoid of all external symbols are free from doubts. They are fettered neither by piety nor by blasphemy.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहं यामि नगश्रेष्ठ मुनिभिस् तत्त्वदर्शिभिः तीर्थयात्रां करोमीति दक्षिणाशां व्रजाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ yāmi nagaśreṣṭha munibhis tattvadarśibhiḥ tīrthayātrāṃ karomīti dakṣiṇāśāṃ vrajāmy aham
verses.translation: Those persons who are omniscient, who are conversant with the principles of creation and annihilation, who see every¬ thing and who are devoid of passionate attachment are released from the bonds of Karmans.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देहि मार्गं नगपते आतिथ्यं देहि याचते यावद् आगमनं मे स्यात् स्थातव्यं तावद् एव हि
verses.transliteration: dehi mārgaṃ nagapate ātithyaṃ dehi yācate yāvad āgamanaṃ me syāt sthātavyaṃ tāvad eva hi
verses.translation: Those who do not injure anything whatsoever, men¬ tally, verbally or physically, those who are not involved in any¬ thing, are not bound by Karmans.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नान्यथा भवितव्यं ते तथेत्य् आह नगोत्तमः आक्रामन् दक्षिणाम् आशां तैर् वृतो मुनिभिर् मुनिः
verses.transliteration: nānyathā bhavitavyaṃ te tathety āha nagottamaḥ ākrāman dakṣiṇām āśāṃ tair vṛto munibhir muniḥ
verses.translation: Those who refrain from violence to lives, who possess good conduct and mercifulness, and who are equally amiable to others' hatred and love are released from the bondage of Karmans. They have self-control.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शनैः स गौतमीम् आगात् सत्त्रयागाय दीक्षितः यावत् संवत्सरं सत्त्रम् अकरोद् ऋषिभिर् वृतः
verses.transliteration: śanaiḥ sa gautamīm āgāt sattrayāgāya dīkṣitaḥ yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ sattram akarod ṛṣibhir vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Those who are merciful toliving beings, who are worthy of being trusted by living creatures and who have eschewed violent activities go to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कैटभस्य सुतौ पापौ राक्षसौ धर्मकण्टकौ अश्वत्थः पिप्पलश् चेति विख्यातौ त्रिदशालये
verses.transliteration: kaiṭabhasya sutau pāpau rākṣasau dharmakaṇṭakau aśvatthaḥ pippalaś ceti vikhyātau tridaśālaye
verses.translation: Those who are indifferent to others' assets, who always avoid other men's wives and who enjoy the riches virtuously acquired by themselves go to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थो ऽश्वत्थरूपेण पिप्पलो ब्रह्मरूपधृक् ताव् उभाव् अन्तरं प्रेप्सू यज्ञविध्वंसनाय तु
verses.transliteration: aśvattho 'śvattharūpeṇa pippalo brahmarūpadhṛk tāv ubhāv antaraṃ prepsū yajñavidhvaṃsanāya tu
verses.translation: Those men who always associate with other men's wives as though they were their own mothers, sisters and daughters, go to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुरुतां काङ्क्षितं रूपं दानवौ पापचेतसौ अश्वत्थो वृक्षरूपेण पिप्पलो ब्राह्मणाकृतिः
verses.transliteration: kurutāṃ kāṅkṣitaṃ rūpaṃ dānavau pāpacetasau aśvattho vṛkṣarūpeṇa pippalo brāhmaṇākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Those who cling to their own wives, who carnally approach them only during the prescribed period after the days of menstruation and who never indulge themselves in vulgar lechery, go to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उभौ तौ ब्राह्मणान् नित्यं पीडयेतां तपोधन आलभन्ते च ये ऽश्वत्थं तांस् तान् अश्नात्य् असौ तरुः
verses.transliteration: ubhau tau brāhmaṇān nityaṃ pīḍayetāṃ tapodhana ālabhante ca ye 'śvatthaṃ tāṃs tān aśnāty asau taruḥ
verses.translation: Those who desist from stealth, who are content with their own wealth and who enjoy their own good luck go to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पिप्पलः सामगो भूत्वा शिष्यान् अश्नाति राक्षसः तस्माद् अद्यापि विप्रेषु सामगो ऽतीव निष्कृपः
verses.transliteration: pippalaḥ sāmago bhūtvā śiṣyān aśnāti rākṣasaḥ tasmād adyāpi vipreṣu sāmago 'tīva niṣkṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Those who view other men's wives with eyes enveloped by chastity, who have conquered their sense organs and who value good conduct very much, go to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्षीयमाणान् द्विजान् दृष्ट्वा मुनयो राक्षसाव् इमौ इति बुद्ध्वा महाप्राज्ञा दक्षिणं तीरम् आश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: kṣīyamāṇān dvijān dṛṣṭvā munayo rākṣasāv imau iti buddhvā mahāprājñā dakṣiṇaṃ tīram āśritam
verses.translation: O sinless lord of living beings, recount to me those activities wherein a man is fettered verbally but is again re¬ leased therefrom. Those who never utter a sin-based lie either for their
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सौरिं शनैश्चरं मन्दं तपस्यन्तं धृतव्रतम् गत्वा मुनिगणाः सर्वे रक्षःकर्म न्यवेदयन्
verses.transliteration: sauriṃ śanaiścaraṃ mandaṃ tapasyantaṃ dhṛtavratam gatvā munigaṇāḥ sarve rakṣaḥkarma nyavedayan
verses.translation: Those who welcome others speaking sweet, sinless and polished words with clearly pronounced syllables, go to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सौरिर् मुनिगणान् आह पूर्णे तपसि मे द्विजाः राक्षसौ हन्म्य् अपूर्णे तु तपस्य् अक्षम एव हि
verses.transliteration: saurir munigaṇān āha pūrṇe tapasi me dvijāḥ rākṣasau hanmy apūrṇe tu tapasy akṣama eva hi
verses.translation: Those who never speak harsh, incisive and cruel words and who never indulge in slanderous gossip are good men who go to heaven. Those who do not speak calumnious words or words that antagonise their friends or inflict pain on others, go to
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनः प्रोचुर् मुनिगणा दास्यामस् ते तपो महत् इत्य् उक्तो ब्राह्मणैः सौरिः कृतम् इत्य् आह तान् अपि
verses.transliteration: punaḥ procur munigaṇā dāsyāmas te tapo mahat ity ukto brāhmaṇaiḥ sauriḥ kṛtam ity āha tān api
verses.translation: O gentle lady, this act of piety relating to speech, should
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सौरिर् ब्राह्मणवेषेण प्रायाद् अश्वत्थरूपिणम् राक्षसं ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा प्रदक्षिणम् अथाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: saurir brāhmaṇaveṣeṇa prāyād aśvattharūpiṇam rākṣasaṃ brāhmaṇo bhūtvā pradakṣiṇam athākarot
verses.translation: O highly blessed lord of gods, O Pinaka-wielding lord, tell me those mental-acts whereby a man is held in bondage. O lady of weal, those who possess virtues of thought do always go to heaven. Listen, even as I narrate them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणं तु कुर्वाणं मेने ब्राह्मणम् एव तम् नित्यवद् राक्षसः पापो भक्षयाम् आस मायया
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇaṃ tu kurvāṇaṃ mene brāhmaṇam eva tam nityavad rākṣasaḥ pāpo bhakṣayām āsa māyayā
verses.translation: Good men do not become overjoyed on seeing other men's property left in a lonely place whether in the village or in the house (nor do they think of appropriating it). They go to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य कायं समाविश्य चक्षुषान्त्राण्य् अपश्यत दृष्टः स राक्षसः पापो मन्देन रविसूनुना
verses.transliteration: tasya kāyaṃ samāviśya cakṣuṣāntrāṇy apaśyata dṛṣṭaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ pāpo mandena ravisūnunā
verses.translation: Similarly, good men do not even think of molesting lcchcrouslv the wives of others (on meeting them) in lonely spots. They go to heaven. Good men mentally view friends and enemies alike. They have a friendly attitude towards them. They go to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भस्मीभूतः क्षणेनैव गिरिर् वज्रहतो यथा अश्वत्थं भस्मसात् कृत्वा अन्यं ब्राह्मणरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: bhasmībhūtaḥ kṣaṇenaiva girir vajrahato yathā aśvatthaṃ bhasmasāt kṛtvā anyaṃ brāhmaṇarūpiṇam
verses.translation: Good men are learned, merciful, pure and truthful; they arc contented with their own riches. They go to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसं पापनिलयम् एक एव तम् अभ्यगात् अधीयानो विप्र इव शिष्यरूपो विनीतवत्
verses.transliteration: rākṣasaṃ pāpanilayam eka eva tam abhyagāt adhīyāno vipra iva śiṣyarūpo vinītavat
verses.translation: Good men are devoid of enmity. They do not over¬ strain themselves (?) They always maintain a friendly attitude. They are merciful towards all living beings. They go to heaven. They possess knowledge. They perform holy rites. They are fond of their friends. They understand piety and sin. They go to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पिप्पलः पूर्ववच् चापि भक्षयाम् आस भानुजम् स भक्षितः पूर्ववच् च कुक्षाव् अन्त्राण्य् अवैक्षत
verses.transliteration: pippalaḥ pūrvavac cāpi bhakṣayām āsa bhānujam sa bhakṣitaḥ pūrvavac ca kukṣāv antrāṇy avaikṣata
verses.translation: Good men, O gentle lady, arc indifferent to the accumu¬ lating fruits of auspicious and inauspicious deeds. They go to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेनालोकितमात्रो ऽसौ राक्षसो भस्मसाद् अभूत् उभौ हत्वा भानुसुतः किं कृत्यं मे वदन्त्व् अथ
verses.transliteration: tenālokitamātro 'sau rākṣaso bhasmasād abhūt ubhau hatvā bhānusutaḥ kiṃ kṛtyaṃ me vadantv atha
verses.translation: After attainingprosperity good men arc devoted to gods and learned brahmins. They shun the sinful. They go to heaven. They go to heaven due to the splendid results of holy rites. O gentle lady, those who tread the path of heaven have been enumerated by me. VVliat more do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मुनयो जातसंहर्षाः सर्व एव तपस्विनः ततः प्रसन्ना ह्य् अभवन्न् ऋषयो ऽगस्त्यपूर्वकाः
verses.transliteration: munayo jātasaṃharṣāḥ sarva eva tapasvinaḥ tataḥ prasannā hy abhavann ṛṣayo 'gastyapūrvakāḥ
verses.translation: O great lord, I have a certain doubt concerning mortals Hence it behoves you to explain it fully.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वरान् ददुर् यथाकामं सौरये मन्दगामिने स प्रीतो ब्राह्मणान् आह शनिः सूर्यसुतो बली
verses.transliteration: varān dadur yathākāmaṃ sauraye mandagāmine sa prīto brāhmaṇān āha śaniḥ sūryasuto balī
verses.translation: O lord, by means of what holy rite does a man attain a long life? By what type of penance, O lord of gods, does he obtain a great span of life? By means of what activity does man on Earth get long¬ evity reduced? O uncensured lord, it beloves you to narrate the consequences of actions.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मद्द्वारे नियता ये च कुर्वन्त्य् अश्वत्थलम्भनम् तेषां सर्वाणि कार्याणि स्युः पीडा मद्भवा न च
verses.transliteration: maddvāre niyatā ye ca kurvanty aśvatthalambhanam teṣāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi syuḥ pīḍā madbhavā na ca
verses.translation: Differences are observed in men. Some are highly for¬ tunate. Others are less fortunate. Some are born noble and others are ignoble.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थे चाश्वत्थसंज्ञे वै स्नानं कुर्वन्ति ये नराः तेषां सर्वाणि कार्याणि भवेयुर् अपरो वरः
verses.transliteration: tīrthe cāśvatthasaṃjñe vai snānaṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ teṣāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi bhaveyur aparo varaḥ
verses.translation: Some are very odious in appearance as if they are made of wood. Others are very pleasing to behold. Some appear to be evil-minded. Some appear to be highly learned. Others have highly developed intellect with pure wisdom and prescience.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मन्दवारे तु ये ऽश्वत्थं प्रातर् उत्थाय मानवाः आलभन्ते च तेषां वै ग्रहपीडा व्यपोहतु
verses.transliteration: mandavāre tu ye 'śvatthaṃ prātar utthāya mānavāḥ ālabhante ca teṣāṃ vai grahapīḍā vyapohatu
verses.translation: O lord, some are men of few words. Others are highly eloquent. Hence it behoves you to explain this diversity.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थम् अश्वत्थं पिप्पलं विदुः तीर्थं शनैश्चरं तत्र तत्रागस्त्यं च सात्त्रिकम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham aśvatthaṃ pippalaṃ viduḥ tīrthaṃ śanaiścaraṃ tatra tatrāgastyaṃ ca sāttrikam
verses.translation: A man of violent nature goes to hell a „„„ •, man goes to!,«,«„ mi, 8 ro neu ' A nonviolent If anyone, by any means, survives and comes out of hell and attains human birth, lie becomes short-lived.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: याज्ञिकं चापि तत् तीर्थं सामगं तीर्थम् एव च इत्याद्यष्टोत्तराण्य् आसन् सहस्राण्य् अथ षोडश तेषु स्नानं च दानं च सत्त्रयागफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: yājñikaṃ cāpi tat tīrthaṃ sāmagaṃ tīrtham eva ca ityādyaṣṭottarāṇy āsan sahasrāṇy atha ṣoḍaśa teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sattrayāgaphalapradam
verses.translation: O gentle lady, one who commits sinful actions, violence etc. is inimical to all living beings and becomes short¬ lived.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं तद् अप्य् उक्तं महात्मभिः तत्र स्नानेन दानेन सोमपानफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: somatīrtham iti khyātaṃ tad apy uktaṃ mahātmabhiḥ tatra snānena dānena somapānaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: What are those things which a man should regularly do in order to attain heaven? What should be his conduct and what holy rites should he perform? What should he give in charity?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जगतां मातरः पूर्वम् ओषध्यो जीवसंमताः ममापि मातरो देव्यः पूर्वासां पूर्ववत्तराः
verses.transliteration: jagatāṃ mātaraḥ pūrvam oṣadhyo jīvasaṃmatāḥ mamāpi mātaro devyaḥ pūrvāsāṃ pūrvavattarāḥ
verses.translation: There, he will be possessed of desirable qualities. He will be joyous. The man becomes rich. He enjoys great plea¬ sures and accomplishes great deeds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आसु प्रतिष्ठितो धर्मः स्वाध्यायो यज्ञकर्म च आभिर् एव धृतं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: āsu pratiṣṭhito dharmaḥ svādhyāyo yajñakarma ca ābhir eva dhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: These highly blessed living beings of charitable disposi¬ tion are those spoken of formerly by Brahma as men of pleas¬ ing appearance liked by all.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अशेषरोगोपशमो भवत्य् आभिर् असंशयम् अन्नम् एताभिर् एव स्याद् अशेषप्राणरक्षणम् अत्रौषध्यो जगद्वन्द्या माम् ऊचुर् अनहंकृताः
verses.transliteration: aśeṣarogopaśamo bhavaty ābhir asaṃśayam annam etābhir eva syād aśeṣaprāṇarakṣaṇam atrauṣadhyo jagadvandyā mām ūcur anahaṃkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Other men, O gentle lady, arc the twice-born ones of miserly nature who do not give anything to anyone. Those tho¬ ughtless ones do not give foodstuffs even when they have them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकं त्वं पतिं देहि राजानं सुरसत्तम
verses.transliteration: asmākaṃ tvaṃ patiṃ dehi rājānaṃ surasattama
verses.translation: Even after seeing the poor, the blind and the wretched mendicants, even on being requested by them, they turn away because they are gluttonous and so covetous of palatable things.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा वचनं तासां मयोक्ता ओषधीर् इदम् पतिं प्राप्स्यथ सर्वाश् च राजानं प्रीतिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā vacanaṃ tāsāṃ mayoktā oṣadhīr idam patiṃ prāpsyatha sarvāś ca rājānaṃ prītivardhanam
verses.translation: They never give away money, garments, means of enjoyment, gold, cows or items of cooked food.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राजानम् इति तच् छ्रुत्वा ता माम् ऊचुः पुनर् मुने गन्तव्यं क्व पुनश् चोक्ता गौतमीं यान्तु मातरः
verses.transliteration: rājānam iti tac chrutvā tā mām ūcuḥ punar mune gantavyaṃ kva punaś coktā gautamīṃ yāntu mātaraḥ
verses.translation: They are highly greedy and covetous, atheists, devoid of liberal-mindedness. Men of this nature, O gentle lady, are the thoughtless ones who go to hell.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टायाम् अथ तस्यां वो राजा स्याल् लोकपूजितः ताश् च गत्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठ तुष्टुवुर् गौतमीं नदीम्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭāyām atha tasyāṃ vo rājā syāl lokapūjitaḥ tāś ca gatvā muniśreṣṭha tuṣṭuvur gautamīṃ nadīm
verses.translation: After the lapse of some time when they take human birth those men of deficient intellect are born in some family devoid of wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं वाकरिष्यन् भववर्तिनो जना नानाघसंघाभिभवाच् च दुःखिताः न चागमिष्यद् भवती भुवं चेत् पुण्योदके गौतमि शंभुकान्ते
verses.transliteration: kiṃ vākariṣyan bhavavartino janā nānāghasaṃghābhibhavāc ca duḥkhitāḥ na cāgamiṣyad bhavatī bhuvaṃ cet puṇyodake gautami śaṃbhukānte
verses.translation: They are tormented by hunger and thirst. They are boycotted by the world. Devoid of any hope for the enjoyment oi pleasure they keep on living their evil lives.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: को वेत्ति भाग्यं नरदेहभाजां महीगतानां सरिताम् अधीशे एषां महापातकसंघहन्त्री त्वम् अम्ब गङ्गे सुलभा सदैव
verses.transliteration: ko vetti bhāgyaṃ naradehabhājāṃ mahīgatānāṃ saritām adhīśe eṣāṃ mahāpātakasaṃghahantrī tvam amba gaṅge sulabhā sadaiva
verses.translation: They aie born of families of inferior worldly pleasures. Those men are engrossed in spurious pleasures. O gentle lady, it is oy these activities that men become devoid of wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न ते विभूतिं ननु वेत्ति को ऽपि त्रैलोक्यवन्द्ये जगदम्ब गङ्गे गौरीसमालिङ्गितविग्रहो ऽपि धत्ते स्मरारिः शिरसापि यत् त्वाम्
verses.transliteration: na te vibhūtiṃ nanu vetti ko 'pi trailokyavandye jagadamba gaṅge gaurīsamāliṅgitavigraho 'pi dhatte smarāriḥ śirasāpi yat tvām
verses.translation: Those who cast their evil eye on other men's wives are born blind due to that evil conduct.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते मातर् अभीष्टदायिनि नमो ऽस्तु ते ब्रह्ममये ऽघनाशिनि नमो ऽस्तु ते विष्णुपदाब्जनिःसृते नमो ऽस्तु ते शंभुजटाविनिःसृते
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te mātar abhīṣṭadāyini namo 'stu te brahmamaye 'ghanāśini namo 'stu te viṣṇupadābjaniḥsṛte namo 'stu te śaṃbhujaṭāviniḥsṛte
verses.translation: Men of sinful actions who look at a naked woman with a defiled mind become distressed due to sickness.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवं स्तुवताम् ईशा किं ददामीत्य् अवोचत
verses.transliteration: ity evaṃ stuvatām īśā kiṃ dadāmīty avocata
verses.translation: Foolish men of evil conduct who indulge in the sexual act with beasts become deficient and defiled in wisdom as well as impotent. They become eunuchs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पतिं देहि जगन्माता राजानम् अतितेजसम्
verses.transliteration: patiṃ dehi jaganmātā rājānam atitejasam
verses.translation: Men who bind animals or embrace them closely, men who defile their preceptor's bed and men who scatter their seminal discharge are born as eunuchs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदोवाच नदी गङ्गा ओषधीस् ता इदं वचः
verses.transliteration: tadovāca nadī gaṅgā oṣadhīs tā idaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: O the most excellent one among the gods, what is a despicable action? What is it that is not despicable, by doing which a man attains prosperity and renown?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहं चामृतरूपास्मि ओषध्यो मातरो ऽमृताः तादृशं चामृतात्मानं पतिं सोमं ददामि वः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ cāmṛtarūpāsmi oṣadhyo mātaro 'mṛtāḥ tādṛśaṃ cāmṛtātmānaṃ patiṃ somaṃ dadāmi vaḥ
verses.translation: He who seeks the path of prosperity and asks brah¬ mins about it, he who seeks virtue and he who yearns for good qualities attains heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवाश् च ऋषयो वाक्यं मेनिरे सोम एव च ओषध्यश् चापि तद् वाक्यं ततो जग्मुः स्वम् आलयम्
verses.transliteration: devāś ca ṛṣayo vākyaṃ menire soma eva ca oṣadhyaś cāpi tad vākyaṃ tato jagmuḥ svam ālayam
verses.translation: If at any time he takes up human birth, O gentle lady, he is born highly intelligent, wise and endowed with memory.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र चापुर् महौषध्यो राजानम् अमृतात्मकम् सोमं समस्तसंतापपापसंघनिवारकम्
verses.transliteration: yatra cāpur mahauṣadhyo rājānam amṛtātmakam somaṃ samastasaṃtāpapāpasaṃghanivārakam
verses.translation: There are other men of deficient wisdom who hate virtue. They do not wish to approach brahmins well-versed in the Vedas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमतीर्थं तु तत् ख्यातं सोमपानफलप्रदम् तत्र स्नानेन दानेन पितरः स्वर्गम् आप्नुयुः
verses.transliteration: somatīrthaṃ tu tat khyātaṃ somapānaphalapradam tatra snānena dānena pitaraḥ svargam āpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: Some men observe holy rites. They have faith and they
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयान् नित्यं पठेद् वा भक्तितः स्मरेत् दीर्घम् आयुर् अवाप्नोति स पुत्री धनवान् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ paṭhed vā bhaktitaḥ smaret dīrgham āyur avāpnoti sa putrī dhanavān bhavet
verses.translation: Still others are regular performers of holy sacrifices. There are others devoid of delusion. Tell me how they become so. What is that action as a result of which they become so.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धान्यतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वकामप्रदं नृणाम् सुभिक्षं क्षेमदं पुंसां सर्वापद्विनिवारणम्
verses.transliteration: dhānyatīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām subhikṣaṃ kṣemadaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvāpadvinivāraṇam
verses.translation: O Brahmins, I do not see any means other than the son of Vasudeva for the liberation of men bound by the noose of action (and reactions) who undergo misery.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ओषध्यः सोमराजानं पतिं प्राप्य मुदान्विताः ऊचुः सर्वस्य लोकस्य गङ्गायाश् चेप्सितं वचः
verses.transliteration: oṣadhyaḥ somarājānaṃ patiṃ prāpya mudānvitāḥ ūcuḥ sarvasya lokasya gaṅgāyāś cepsitaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: Those who worship well that lord who wields conch, discus and club, byword, deeds and thoughts attain the highest region.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैदिकी पुण्यगाथास्ति यां वै वेदविदो विदुः भूमिं सस्यवतीं कश्चिन् मातरं मातृसंमिताम्
verses.transliteration: vaidikī puṇyagāthāsti yāṃ vai vedavido viduḥ bhūmiṃ sasyavatīṃ kaścin mātaraṃ mātṛsaṃmitām
verses.translation: O Pinaka-bearing Sankara, O destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga, O lord adored by the worlds, wc wish to hear the great¬ ness of Vasudeva.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गासमीपे यो दद्यात् सर्वकामान् अवाप्नुयात् भूमिं सस्यवतीं गाश् च ओषधीश् च मुदान्वितः
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāsamīpe yo dadyāt sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt bhūmiṃ sasyavatīṃ gāś ca oṣadhīś ca mudānvitaḥ
verses.translation: He has ten arms. He has great splendour. He is the destroyer of the enemies of gods. He is Hrslkes'a marked by the scar Srivatsa. He is the leader of gods.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुब्रह्मेशरूपाय यो दद्याद् भक्तिमान् नरः सर्वं तद् अक्षयं विद्यात् सर्वकामान् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇubrahmeśarūpāya yo dadyād bhaktimān naraḥ sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ vidyāt sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: The sages and the eternal worlds are born of his body. He is the abode of Brahma himself and of Devas too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ओषध्यः सोमराजन्याः सोमश् चाप्य् ओषधीपतिः इति ज्ञात्वा ब्रह्मविद ओषधीर् यः प्रदास्यति
verses.transliteration: oṣadhyaḥ somarājanyāḥ somaś cāpy oṣadhīpatiḥ iti jñātvā brahmavida oṣadhīr yaḥ pradāsyati
verses.translation: For the fulfilment of the task of gods he takes up human form. He bestows honour on others. He will be killing all kings in battle.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नोति ब्रह्मलोके महीयते ता एव सोमराजन्याः प्रीताः प्रोचुः पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: sarvān kāmān avāpnoti brahmaloke mahīyate tā eva somarājanyāḥ prītāḥ procuḥ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Without the help of Trivikrama, the hosts of Devas will be leaderless and they will be incapable of performing their divine functions.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽस्मान् ददाति गङ्गायां तं राजन् पारयामसि त्वम् उत्तमश् चौषधीश त्वदधीनं चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: yo 'smān dadāti gaṅgāyāṃ taṃ rājan pārayāmasi tvam uttamaś cauṣadhīśa tvadadhīnaṃ carācaram
verses.translation: The gods are comfortably stationed in his body. That lotus-eyed lord has goddess LaksmI in his belly. He stays in the company of Sri.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ओषधयः संवदन्ते सोमेन सह राज्ञा यो ऽस्मान् ददाति विप्रेभ्यस् तं राजन् पारयामसि
verses.transliteration: oṣadhayaḥ saṃvadante somena saha rājñā yo 'smān dadāti viprebhyas taṃ rājan pārayāmasi
verses.translation: That lord has ample forbearance. He does not boast of himself. He bestows (the power to realise) Brahman. He removes the fear of those who are distressed by fear. He increases the delight of his friends.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वयं च ब्रह्मरूपिण्यः प्राणरूपिण्य एव च यो ऽस्मान् ददाति विप्रेभ्यस् तं राजन् पारयामसि
verses.transliteration: vayaṃ ca brahmarūpiṇyaḥ prāṇarūpiṇya eva ca yo 'smān dadāti viprebhyas taṃ rājan pārayāmasi
verses.translation: He helps those who resort to him. He causes fear in the minds of his enemies. He is conversant with polity. He is richly
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अस्मान् ददाति यो नित्यं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो जितव्रतः उपास्तिर् अस्ति सास्माकं तं राजन् पारयामसि
verses.transliteration: asmān dadāti yo nityaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo jitavrataḥ upāstir asti sāsmākaṃ taṃ rājan pārayāmasi
verses.translation: Acyuta, that lord of Devas, should be worshipped by a person conversant with virtue. When this lord is worshipped he will always possess virtue.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्थावरं जङ्गमं किंचिद् अस्माभिर् व्यापृतं जगत् यो ऽस्मान् ददाति विप्रेभ्यस् तं राजन् पारयामसि
verses.transliteration: sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ kiṃcid asmābhir vyāpṛtaṃ jagat yo 'smān dadāti viprebhyas taṃ rājan pārayāmasi
verses.translation: They, beginning with Sanatkumara, duly created by him, stay on the Gandhamadana mountain, performing austeri¬ ties.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हव्यं कव्यं यद् अमृतं यत् किंचिद् उपभुज्यते तद्गरीयश् च यो दद्यात् तं राजन् पारयामसि
verses.transliteration: havyaṃ kavyaṃ yad amṛtaṃ yat kiṃcid upabhujyate tadgarīyaś ca yo dadyāt taṃ rājan pārayāmasi
verses.translation: Hence, O leading twice-born, that eloquent lord con¬ versant with Dharma should be bowed to. He shall salute on being saluted; he shall honour, on being honoured.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एतां वैदिकीं गाथां यः शृणोति स्मरेत वा पठते भक्तिम् आपन्नस् तं राजन् पारयामसि
verses.transliteration: ity etāṃ vaidikīṃ gāthāṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti smareta vā paṭhate bhaktim āpannas taṃ rājan pārayāmasi
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, that lord shall see on being seen; he shall offer refuge everyday, on being sought refuge in; On being worshipped regularly he shall accept worship.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्रैषा पठिता गाथा सोमेन सह राज्ञा गङ्गातीरे चौषधीभिर् धान्यतीर्थं तद् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: yatraiṣā paṭhitā gāthā somena saha rājñā gaṅgātīre cauṣadhībhir dhānyatīrthaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: That son of Devaki should always be bowed to, by thought, by speech and by deeds by brahmins exerting them¬ selves. He should necessarily be seen.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थम् औषध्यं सौम्यम् एव च अमृतं वेदगाथं च मातृतीर्थं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham auṣadhyaṃ saumyam eva ca amṛtaṃ vedagāthaṃ ca mātṛtīrthaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: I too always worship and bow to that lord, the grand¬ father of the worlds, the great Boar, lord of the universe.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एषु स्नानं जपो होमो दानं च पितृतर्पणम् अन्नदानं तु यः कुर्यात् तद् आनन्त्याय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: eṣu snānaṃ japo homo dānaṃ ca pitṛtarpaṇam annadānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tad ānantyāya kalpate
verses.translation: The ploughshare-wielding lord, well-known as Bala,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: षट्शताधिकसाहस्रं तीर्थानां तीरयोर् द्वयोः सर्वपापनिहन्तॄणां सर्वसंपद्विवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṭśatādhikasāhasraṃ tīrthānāṃ tīrayor dvayoḥ sarvapāpanihantṝṇāṃ sarvasaṃpadvivardhanam
verses.translation: The ploughshare-wielding lord, well-known as Bala,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विदर्भासंगमं पुण्यं रेवतीसंगमं तथा तत्र यद् वृत्तम् आख्यास्ये यत् पुराणविदो विदुः
verses.transliteration: vidarbhāsaṃgamaṃ puṇyaṃ revatīsaṃgamaṃ tathā tatra yad vṛttam ākhyāsye yat purāṇavido viduḥ
verses.translation: Oh, the wonderful greatness of Krsna has been heard by us. It is holy. It dispels sins. It is conducive to wealth. It des¬ troys the round of births and deaths.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भरद्वाज इति ख्यात ऋषिर् आसीत् तपोधिकः तस्य स्वसा रेवतीति कुरूपा विकृतस्वरा
verses.transliteration: bharadvāja iti khyāta ṛṣir āsīt tapodhikaḥ tasya svasā revatīti kurūpā vikṛtasvarā
verses.translation: O great sage, after worshipping Vasudeva, duly and with devotion what goal do the men who are engaged in the worship of Vasudeva attain?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा विकृतां भ्राता भरद्वाजः प्रतापवान् चिन्तया परया युक्तो गङ्गाया दक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtāṃ bhrātā bharadvājaḥ pratāpavān cintayā parayā yukto gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: Do they attain liberation or heaven, O great sage? Or, O excellent sage, do they obtain both the fruits?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कस्मै दद्याम् इमां कन्यां स्वसारं भीषणाकृतिम् न कश्चित् प्रतिगृह्णाति दातव्या च स्वसा तथा
verses.transliteration: kasmai dadyām imāṃ kanyāṃ svasāraṃ bhīṣaṇākṛtim na kaścit pratigṛhṇāti dātavyā ca svasā tathā
verses.translation: O omniscient one, it behoves you to dispel this doubt lurking in our hearts. O excellent sage, excepting you there is noone else in this world who can dispel it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहो भूयान् न कस्यापि कन्या दुःखैककारणम् मरणं जीवतो ऽप्य् अस्य प्राणिनस् तु पदे पदे
verses.transliteration: aho bhūyān na kasyāpi kanyā duḥkhaikakāraṇam maraṇaṃ jīvato 'py asya prāṇinas tu pade pade
verses.translation: Well done, well-done, O excellent sages! What has been uttered by you is quite pertinent. Now listen to all those things
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं विमृशतस् तस्य स्वाश्रमे चातिशोभने द्रष्टुं मुनिवरः प्रायाद् भरद्वाजं यतव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vimṛśatas tasya svāśrame cātiśobhane draṣṭuṃ munivaraḥ prāyād bharadvājaṃ yatavratam
verses.translation: By the mere initiation (into the fold) of Krsna, men attain salvation. What then, in regard to those who devotedly worship Visnu always!
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्व्यष्टवर्षः शुभवपुः शान्तो दान्तो गुणाकरः नाम्ना कठ इति ख्यातो भरद्वाजं ननाम सः
verses.transliteration: dvyaṣṭavarṣaḥ śubhavapuḥ śānto dānto guṇākaraḥ nāmnā kaṭha iti khyāto bharadvājaṃ nanāma saḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, neither heaven nor salvation is inac¬ cessible to them. Devotees of Visnu obtain even the rarest things, would they desire them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विधिवत् पूज्य तं विप्रं भरद्वाजः कठं तदा तस्यागमनकार्यं च पप्रच्छ पुरतः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: vidhivat pūjya taṃ vipraṃ bharadvājaḥ kaṭhaṃ tadā tasyāgamanakāryaṃ ca papraccha purataḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Just as after climbing the mountain of jewels one can take away any number as one pleases, so also O leading sages, one can obtain the cherished things from Kr$na.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कठो ऽप्य् आह भरद्वाजं विद्यार्थ्य् अहम् उपागतः तथा च दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी यद् युक्तं तद् विधीयताम्
verses.transliteration: kaṭho 'py āha bharadvājaṃ vidyārthy aham upāgataḥ tathā ca darśanākāṅkṣī yad yuktaṃ tad vidhīyatām
verses.translation: Just as, after reaching the wish-yielding Kalpa tree, O brahmins, a person plucks the fruits as he pleases, so also one can take one's cherished things from Krsna.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भरद्वाजः कठं प्राह अधीष्व यद् अभीप्सितम् पुराणं स्मृतयो वेदा धर्मस्थानान्य् अनेकशः
verses.transliteration: bharadvājaḥ kaṭhaṃ prāha adhīṣva yad abhīpsitam purāṇaṃ smṛtayo vedā dharmasthānāny anekaśaḥ
verses.translation: By duly and faithfully worshipping Vasudcva, the pre¬ ceptor of the universe, men attain the fruit of virtue, wealth, love and salvation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं वेद्मि महाप्राज्ञ रुचिरं वद मा चिरम् कुलीनो धर्मनिरतो गुरुशुश्रूषणे रतः अभिमानी श्रुतधरः शिष्यः पुण्यैर् अवाप्यते
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ vedmi mahāprājña ruciraṃ vada mā ciram kulīno dharmanirato guruśuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ abhimānī śrutadharaḥ śiṣyaḥ puṇyair avāpyate
verses.translation: By propitiating that lord of the universe with a puri¬ fied inner soul men obtain desirable things difficult of access even unto Devas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अध्यापयस्व भो ब्रह्मञ् शिष्यं मां वीतकल्मषम् शुश्रूषणरतं भक्तं कुलीनं सत्यवादिनम्
verses.transliteration: adhyāpayasva bho brahmañ śiṣyaṃ māṃ vītakalmaṣam śuśrūṣaṇarataṃ bhaktaṃ kulīnaṃ satyavādinam
verses.translation: To those who devotedly worship the Imperishable lord Vasudcva there is nothing inaccessible in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा भरद्वाजः प्रादाद् विद्याम् अशेषतः प्राप्तविद्यः कठः प्रीतो भरद्वाजम् अथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā bharadvājaḥ prādād vidyām aśeṣataḥ prāptavidyaḥ kaṭhaḥ prīto bharadvājam athābravīt
verses.translation: Blessed are those persons in the world who worship Lord Hari who dispels all sins and who bestows the desired benefits.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इच्छेयं दक्षिणां दातुं गुरो तव मनःप्रियाम् वदस्व दुर्लभं वापि गुरो तुभ्यं नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: iccheyaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dātuṃ guro tava manaḥpriyām vadasva durlabhaṃ vāpi guro tubhyaṃ namo 'stu te
verses.translation: By worshipping the most excellent lord of Devas, brahmins, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas, women, Sudras and men of low castes attain the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विद्यां प्राप्यापि ये मोहात् स्वगुरोः पारितोषिकम् न प्रयच्छन्ति निरयं ते यान्त्य् आचन्द्रतारकम्
verses.transliteration: vidyāṃ prāpyāpi ye mohāt svaguroḥ pāritoṣikam na prayacchanti nirayaṃ te yānty ācandratārakam
verses.translation: Hence, O sinless sages, listen. I shall expound what you ask. I shall succinctly narrate the goal of those noble souls.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गृहाण कन्यां विधिवद् भार्यां कुरु मम स्वसाम् अस्यां प्रीत्या वर्तितव्यं याचेयं दक्षिणाम् इमाम्
verses.transliteration: gṛhāṇa kanyāṃ vidhivad bhāryāṃ kuru mama svasām asyāṃ prītyā vartitavyaṃ yāceyaṃ dakṣiṇām imām
verses.translation: They take up divine bodies of great strength bedecked by earrings. Huge bodies, O excellent brahmins, they assume with a four-armed form, and sport there.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातृवत् पुत्रवच् चापि शिष्यः स्यात् तु गुरोः सदा गुरुश् च पितृवच् च स्यात् संबन्धो ऽत्र कथं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: bhrātṛvat putravac cāpi śiṣyaḥ syāt tu guroḥ sadā guruś ca pitṛvac ca syāt saṃbandho 'tra kathaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, in their eternal state they re¬ main for ten thousand crores of years and are bowed to by all Devas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मद्वाक्यं कुरु सत्यं त्वं ममाज्ञा तव दक्षिणा सर्वं स्मृत्वा कठाद्य त्वं रेवतीं भर तन्मनाः
verses.transliteration: madvākyaṃ kuru satyaṃ tvaṃ mamājñā tava dakṣiṇā sarvaṃ smṛtvā kaṭhādya tvaṃ revatīṃ bhara tanmanāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O brahmins, those magnificent self-posses¬ sed men go to the abode of Narasimha. There they rejoice and sport for about ten thousand crores of years
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा गुरोर् वाक्यात् कठो जग्राह पाणिना रेवतीं विधिवद् दत्तां तां समीक्ष्य कठस् त्व् अथ
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā guror vākyāt kaṭho jagrāha pāṇinā revatīṃ vidhivad dattāṃ tāṃ samīkṣya kaṭhas tv atha
verses.translation: At the end of that period they go to the abode of
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव पूजयाम् आस देवेशं शंकरं तदा रेवत्या रूपसंपत्त्यै शिवप्रीत्यै च रेवती
verses.transliteration: tatraiva pūjayām āsa deveśaṃ śaṃkaraṃ tadā revatyā rūpasaṃpattyai śivaprītyai ca revatī
verses.translation: Thereafter they go to the city of Pradyumna. Free of
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुरूपा चारुसर्वाङ्गी न रूपेणोपमीयते अभिषेकोदकं तत्र रेवत्या यद् विनिःसृतम्
verses.transliteration: surūpā cārusarvāṅgī na rūpeṇopamīyate abhiṣekodakaṃ tatra revatyā yad viniḥsṛtam
verses.translation: They are delighted. They are endowed with strength and power. They can go anywhere as they please. Thereafter those Yogins go to the place where lord Sankarsana rules.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: साभवत् तत्र गङ्गायां तस्मात् तन्नामतो नदी रेवतीति समाख्याता रूपसौभाग्यदायिनी
verses.transliteration: sābhavat tatra gaṅgāyāṃ tasmāt tannāmato nadī revatīti samākhyātā rūpasaubhāgyadāyinī
verses.translation: They are delighted. They are endowed with strength and power. They can go anywhere as they please. Thereafter those Yogins go to the place where lord Sankarsana rules.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् दर्भैश् च विविधैर् अभिषेकं चकार सः पुण्यरूपत्वसंसिद्ध्यै विदर्भा तद् अभून् नदी
verses.transliteration: punar darbhaiś ca vividhair abhiṣekaṃ cakāra saḥ puṇyarūpatvasaṃsiddhyai vidarbhā tad abhūn nadī
verses.translation: They are delighted. They are endowed with strength and power. They can go anywhere as they please. Thereafter those Yogins go to the place where lord Sankarsana rules.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धया संगमे स्नात्वा रेवतीगङ्गयोर् नरः सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: śraddhayā saṃgame snātvā revatīgaṅgayor naraḥ sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate
verses.translation: They are delighted. They are endowed with strength and power. They can go anywhere as they please. Thereafter those Yogins go to the place where lord Sankarsana rules.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा विदर्भागौतम्योः संगमे श्रद्धया मुने स्नानं करोत्य् असौ याति भुक्तिं मुक्तिं च तत्क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: tathā vidarbhāgautamyoḥ saṃgame śraddhayā mune snānaṃ karoty asau yāti bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca tatkṣaṇāt
verses.translation: They are delighted. They are endowed with strength and power. They can go anywhere as they please. Thereafter those Yogins go to the place where lord Sankarsana rules.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उभयोस् तीरयोस् तत्र तीर्थानां शतम् उत्तमम् सर्वपापक्षयकरं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: ubhayos tīrayos tatra tīrthānāṃ śatam uttamam sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam
verses.translation: They are delighted. They are endowed with strength and power. They can go anywhere as they please. Thereafter those Yogins go to the place where lord Sankarsana rules.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं गङ्गाया उत्तरे तटे तत्र स्नात्वा नरो ऽज्ञानात् तथापि शुभम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: pūrṇatīrtham iti khyātaṃ gaṅgāyā uttare taṭe tatra snātvā naro 'jñānāt tathāpi śubham āpnuyāt
verses.translation: O great sage, describe to us the benefit of the chorus song of Visnu while keeping awake. Great is our eagerness to hear the same.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णतीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं वर्ण्यते केन जन्तुना स्वयं संस्थीयते यत्र चक्रिणा च पिनाकिना
verses.transliteration: pūrṇatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ varṇyate kena jantunā svayaṃ saṃsthīyate yatra cakriṇā ca pinākinā
verses.translation: Listen, O excellent sages. I shall describe duly the benefit of the chorus song of Visnu while keeping awake, as mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरा धन्वन्तरिर् नाम कल्पादाव् आयुषः सुतः इष्ट्वा बहुविधैर् यज्ञैर् अश्वमेधपुरःसरैः
verses.transliteration: purā dhanvantarir nāma kalpādāv āyuṣaḥ sutaḥ iṣṭvā bahuvidhair yajñair aśvamedhapuraḥsaraiḥ
verses.translation: His songs in praise of Visnu were sung in various notes such as Gandhara, Sadja, Nisada, Pancama, Dhaivata etc.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा दानान्य् अनेकानि भुक्त्वा भोगांश् च पुष्कलान् विज्ञाय भोगवैषम्यं परं वैराग्यम् आश्रितः
verses.transliteration: dattvā dānāny anekāni bhuktvā bhogāṃś ca puṣkalān vijñāya bhogavaiṣamyaṃ paraṃ vairāgyam āśritaḥ
verses.translation: Many years of his life were thus spent by him in propitiating Visnu by means of different types of songs (of prayer).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गिरिशृङ्गे ऽम्बुधेः पारे तथा गङ्गानदीतटे शिवविष्ण्वोर् गृहे वापि विशेषात् पुण्यसंगमे
verses.transliteration: giriśṛṅge 'mbudheḥ pāre tathā gaṅgānadītaṭe śivaviṣṇvor gṛhe vāpi viśeṣāt puṇyasaṃgame
verses.translation: Once, on the eleventh day in the dark half of the month of Caitrahc went to the excellent forest for the purpose of serving Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तप्तं हुतं च जप्तं च सर्वम् अक्षयतां व्रजेत् धन्वन्तरिर् इति ज्ञात्वा तत्र तेपे तपो महत्
verses.transliteration: taptaṃ hutaṃ ca japtaṃ ca sarvam akṣayatāṃ vrajet dhanvantarir iti jñātvā tatra tepe tapo mahat
verses.translation: Engrossed in devotion, he wanted to gather flowers from the forest. He reached the foot ol a Vibhltaka tree in the great forest on the banks of Ksipra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानवैराग्यसंपन्नो भीमेशचरणाश्रयः तपश् चकार विपुलं गङ्गासागरसंगमे
verses.transliteration: jñānavairāgyasaṃpanno bhīmeśacaraṇāśrayaḥ tapaś cakāra vipulaṃ gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame
verses.translation: "O good Sir, you shall devour me (tomorrow) in the morning. In truth I will come back again. O Raksasa, I have a great task to be performed today. So release me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरा च निकृतो राज्ञा रणं हित्वा महासुरः सहस्रम् एकं वर्षाणां समुद्रं प्राविशद् भयात्
verses.transliteration: purā ca nikṛto rājñā raṇaṃ hitvā mahāsuraḥ sahasram ekaṃ varṣāṇāṃ samudraṃ prāviśad bhayāt
verses.translation: "In truth, I will come tomorrow. You will then cat me. For the purpose of serving Visnu I have to keep awake in the
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धन्वन्तरौ वनं प्राप्ते राज्यं प्राप्ते तु तत्सुते विरागं च गते राज्ञि ततः प्रायाद् अथार्णवात्
verses.transliteration: dhanvantarau vanaṃ prāpte rājyaṃ prāpte tu tatsute virāgaṃ ca gate rājñi tataḥ prāyād athārṇavāt
verses.translation: The Raksasa said in reply: "O Candala, I have not taken food for the last ten days and today you have come across me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तपस्यन्तं तमो नाम बलवान् असुरो मुने गङ्गातीरं समाश्रित्य राजा धन्वन्तरिर् यतः
verses.transliteration: tapasyantaṃ tamo nāma balavān asuro mune gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritya rājā dhanvantarir yataḥ
verses.translation: I shall not set you free. I shall devour you. I am over¬ whelmed by hunger".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जपहोमरतो नित्यं ब्रह्मज्ञानपरायणः तं रिपुं नाशयामीति तमः प्रायाद् अथार्णवात्
verses.transliteration: japahomarato nityaṃ brahmajñānaparāyaṇaḥ taṃ ripuṃ nāśayāmīti tamaḥ prāyād athārṇavāt
verses.translation: O Brahmaraksasa, the entire world has its root in truth. Hence, listen, on truth I promise my return.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नाशितो बहुशो ऽनेन राज्ञा बलवता त्व् अहम् तं रिपुं नाशयामीति तमः प्रायाद् अथार्णवात्
verses.transliteration: nāśito bahuśo 'nena rājñā balavatā tv aham taṃ ripuṃ nāśayāmīti tamaḥ prāyād athārṇavāt
verses.translation: All these know each and every action of men, viz. the sun, moon, fire, wind, earth, firmament, water, mind, day, night, the two junctions (i.e. dawn and dusk) and Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मायया प्रमदारूपं कृत्वा राजानम् अभ्यगात् नृत्यगीतवती सुभ्रूर् हसन्ती चारुदर्शना
verses.transliteration: māyayā pramadārūpaṃ kṛtvā rājānam abhyagāt nṛtyagītavatī subhrūr hasantī cārudarśanā
verses.translation: On being told thus by the gathered flowers and went to the temple of Visnu
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा चारुसर्वाङ्गीं बहुकालं नयान्विताम् शान्ताम् अनुव्रतां भक्तां कृपया चाब्रवीन् नृपः
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṅgīṃ bahukālaṃ nayānvitām śāntām anuvratāṃ bhaktāṃ kṛpayā cābravīn nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: He handed over flowers to a brahmin ' who washed
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कासि त्वं कस्य हेतोर् वा वर्तसे गहने वने कं दृष्ट्वा हर्षसीव त्वं वद कल्याणि पृच्छते
verses.transliteration: kāsi tvaṃ kasya hetor vā vartase gahane vane kaṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣasīva tvaṃ vada kalyāṇi pṛcchate
verses.translation: As the ntght dawned into day he eulogised and made
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रमदा चापि तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा राजानम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: pramadā cāpi tadvākyaṃ śrutvā rājānam abravīt
verses.translation: "Since the body is the means of acquiring virtue wealth love and liberation, an intelligent man should maintain his body with great care.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वयि तिष्ठति को लोके हेतुर् हर्षस्य मे भवेत् अहम् इन्द्रस्य या लक्ष्मीस् त्वां दृष्ट्वा कामसंभृतम्
verses.transliteration: tvayi tiṣṭhati ko loke hetur harṣasya me bhavet aham indrasya yā lakṣmīs tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmasaṃbhṛtam
verses.translation: The man said again unto him: ''Don't be a fool. O my good man, haven't you heard what has been uttered by Manu?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हर्षाच् चरामि पुरतो राजंस् तव पुनः पुनः अगण्यपुण्यविरहाद् अहं सर्वस्य दुर्लभा
verses.transliteration: harṣāc carāmi purato rājaṃs tava punaḥ punaḥ agaṇyapuṇyavirahād ahaṃ sarvasya durlabhā
verses.translation: (Learned men) say that the following five untruths are not sinful, viz. the lie that has been uttered for affording protection to cows, women and brahmins; the lie uttered while celebrating a marriage; the lie that lias been uttered for the sake of friends; the lie uttered when one is faced with death; and the lie uttered when one is being robbed of all riches.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वचो निशम्याशु तपस् त्यक्त्वा सुदुष्करम् ताम् एव मनसा ध्यायंस् तन्निष्ठस् तत्परायणः
verses.transliteration: etad vaco niśamyāśu tapas tyaktvā suduṣkaram tām eva manasā dhyāyaṃs tanniṣṭhas tatparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: (?) Injunctionsregarding righteousness are not applic¬ able in the case of untrue statements to women, and enemies or those uttered when one is faced with death or destruction of wealth or when one is being deceived".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदेकशरणो राजा बभूव स यदा तमः अन्तर्धानं गतो ब्रह्मन् नाशयित्वा तपो बृहत्
verses.transliteration: tadekaśaraṇo rājā babhūva sa yadā tamaḥ antardhānaṃ gato brahman nāśayitvā tapo bṛhat
verses.translation: The achievement of virtue, wealth and love and the rare acquisition of liberation becomes possible due to the truth of men. Hence one shall never forsake truth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे ऽहं वै वरान् दातुं समभ्यगाम् तं दृष्ट्वा विह्वलीभूतं तपोभ्रष्टं यथा मृतम्
verses.transliteration: etasminn antare 'haṃ vai varān dātuṃ samabhyagām taṃ dṛṣṭvā vihvalībhūtaṃ tapobhraṣṭaṃ yathā mṛtam
verses.translation: Saying this, the Canqlala ignored that excellent man and went to the place where the Rrahmaraksasa, the slayer of living beings, was waiting.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तम् आश्वास्याथ विविधैर् हेतुभिर् नृपसत्तमम् तव शत्रुस् तमो नाम कृत्वा तां तपसश् च्युतिम्
verses.transliteration: tam āśvāsyātha vividhair hetubhir nṛpasattamam tava śatrus tamo nāma kṛtvā tāṃ tapasaś cyutim
verses.translation: On seeing that the Candala had come, his eyes beamed with wonder. Shaking his head (approvingly) he told him:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चरितार्थो गतो राजन् न त्वं शोचितुम् अर्हसि आनन्दयन्ति प्रमदास् तापयन्ति च मानवम्
verses.transliteration: caritārtho gato rājan na tvaṃ śocitum arhasi ānandayanti pramadās tāpayanti ca mānavam
verses.translation: Well done, well done, O highly blessed one. You have kept your promise. I do not consider you a mere Candala since you have distinguished yourself due to your truthfulness.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वा एव विशेषेण किम् उ मायामयी तु सा ततः कृताञ्जली राजा माम् आह विगतभ्रमः
verses.transliteration: sarvā eva viśeṣeṇa kim u māyāmayī tu sā tataḥ kṛtāñjalī rājā mām āha vigatabhramaḥ
verses.translation: Due to this action I think that you are a brahmin pure andnotfit to be disposed of. I shall tell you, gentle sir, something
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं करोमि कथं ब्रह्मंस् तपसः पारम् आप्नुयाम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ karomi kathaṃ brahmaṃs tapasaḥ pāram āpnuyām
verses.translation: Tell me. How long have you been observing this rite of keeping awake devotedly in the abode ofVisnu?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तस्योत्तरं प्रादां देवदेवं जनार्दनम् स्तुहि सर्वप्रयत्नेन ततः सिद्धिम् अवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: tatas tasyottaraṃ prādāṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam stuhi sarvaprayatnena tataḥ siddhim avāpsyasi
verses.translation: He replied smilingly, "O Raksasa, I have been observ¬ ing this rite of keeping awake every month on Ekadasi day, for twenty years" On hearing the words of the Candala, theBrahma- raksasa said:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स ह्य् अशेषजगत्स्रष्टा वेदवेद्यः पुरातनः सर्वार्थसिद्धिदः पुंसां नान्यो ऽस्ति भुवनत्रये
verses.transliteration: sa hy aśeṣajagatsraṣṭā vedavedyaḥ purātanaḥ sarvārthasiddhidaḥ puṃsāṃ nānyo 'sti bhuvanatraye
verses.translation: It behoves you to carry out what I am going to tell
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स जगाम नगश्रेष्ठं हिमवन्तं नृपोत्तमः कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा विष्णुं तुष्टाव भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: sa jagāma nagaśreṣṭhaṃ himavantaṃ nṛpottamaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā viṣṇuṃ tuṣṭāva bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: In that case I shall set you free. I shall not leave you otherwise, O highly blessed one. I have vowed thrice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय विष्णो जयाचिन्त्य जय जिष्णो जयाच्युत जय गोपाल लक्ष्मीश जय कृष्ण जगन्मय
verses.transliteration: jaya viṣṇo jayācintya jaya jiṣṇo jayācyuta jaya gopāla lakṣmīśa jaya kṛṣṇa jaganmaya
verses.translation: The Candala said to him: "O night-prowler, my own self has been surrendered to you. What is the use of talking much? Eat me up as you please".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय भूतपते नाथ जय पन्नगशायिने जय सर्वग गोविन्द जय विश्वकृते नमः
verses.transliteration: jaya bhūtapate nātha jaya pannagaśāyine jaya sarvaga govinda jaya viśvakṛte namaḥ
verses.translation: The Raksasa said to him again: "Give me (the benefit of) keeping awake for two yamas (six hours) along with the songs sung by you. It behoves you to take pity on me."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय विश्वभुजे देव जय विश्वधृते नमः जयेश सदसत् त्वं वै जय माधव धर्मिणे
verses.transliteration: jaya viśvabhuje deva jaya viśvadhṛte namaḥ jayeśa sadasat tvaṃ vai jaya mādhava dharmiṇe
verses.translation: Why this irrelevant talk? Eat me up as you please. I will not give you the benefit of keeping awake.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय कामद काम त्वं जय राम गुणार्णव जय पुष्टिद पुष्टीश जय कल्याणदायिने
verses.transliteration: jaya kāmada kāma tvaṃ jaya rāma guṇārṇava jaya puṣṭida puṣṭīśa jaya kalyāṇadāyine
verses.translation: On hearing his words the Brahmaraksasa remembered e evi a- ctl ons committed by himself and became extremely distressed. He then said to the Candala:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय भूतप भूतेश जय मानविधायिने जय कर्मद कर्म त्वं जय पीताम्बरच्छद
verses.transliteration: jaya bhūtapa bhūteśa jaya mānavidhāyine jaya karmada karma tvaṃ jaya pītāmbaracchada
verses.translation: Afflicted by greed and delusion I performed the duty of Agnidhra m the sacrifice. When it was concluded I perform an arrogant rite due to my folly. F rmea
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय सर्वेश सर्वस् त्वं जय मङ्गलरूपिणे जय सत्त्वाधिनाथाय जय वेदविदे नमः
verses.transliteration: jaya sarveśa sarvas tvaṃ jaya maṅgalarūpiṇe jaya sattvādhināthāya jaya vedavide namaḥ
verses.translation: I am therefore immersed'in the great ocean of sin. Lift me up therefrom. It behoves you to give me the benefit of the last song of prayer at the holy rite of keeping awake.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय जन्मद जन्मिस्थ परमात्मन् नमो ऽस्तु ते जय मुक्तिद मुक्तिस् त्वं जय भुक्तिद केशव
verses.transliteration: jaya janmada janmistha paramātman namo 'stu te jaya muktida muktis tvaṃ jaya bhuktida keśava
verses.translation: Even as I narrate listen to the rest of the story of
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय लोकद लोकेश जय पापविनाशन जय वत्सल भक्तानां जय चक्रधृते नमः
verses.transliteration: jaya lokada lokeśa jaya pāpavināśana jaya vatsala bhaktānāṃ jaya cakradhṛte namaḥ
verses.translation: Beginning with Kokamukha (holy centre) he went up to the holy shrine of Skanda. After visiting Skanda heperformed the rite of circumambulation in Dharacakra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय मानद मानस् त्वं जय लोकनमस्कृत जय धर्मद धर्मस् त्वं जय संसारपारग
verses.transliteration: jaya mānada mānas tvaṃ jaya lokanamaskṛta jaya dharmada dharmas tvaṃ jaya saṃsārapāraga
verses.translation: O brahmins, he then came to the lofty rocky top of the excellent mountain Vindhya and reached the holy spot Papapramocana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय अन्नद अन्नं त्वं जय वाचस्पते नमः जय शक्तिद शक्तिस् त्वं जय जैत्रवरप्रद
verses.transliteration: jaya annada annaṃ tvaṃ jaya vācaspate namaḥ jaya śaktida śaktis tvaṃ jaya jaitravaraprada
verses.translation: That scion of a Candala family performed the holy dip that dispelled his sins. Freed from sins he remembered many of his previous births.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय यज्ञद यज्ञस् त्वं जय पद्मदलेक्षण जय दानद दानं त्वं जय कैटभसूदन
verses.transliteration: jaya yajñada yajñas tvaṃ jaya padmadalekṣaṇa jaya dānada dānaṃ tvaṃ jaya kaiṭabhasūdana
verses.translation: In a previous birth he had been a mendicant who had restrained his body and controlled his speech and mind. He was intelligent and he mastered the Vedas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय कीर्तिद कीर्तिस् त्वं जय मूर्तिद मूर्तिधृक् जय सौख्यद सौख्यात्मञ् जय पावनपावन
verses.transliteration: jaya kīrtida kīrtis tvaṃ jaya mūrtida mūrtidhṛk jaya saukhyada saukhyātmañ jaya pāvanapāvana
verses.translation: Once while cows were being taken away by thieves the alms became defiled by dust and they were discarded by the mendicant.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय शान्तिद शान्तिस् त्वं जय शंकरसंभव जय पानद पानस् त्वं जय ज्योतिःस्वरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: jaya śāntida śāntis tvaṃ jaya śaṃkarasaṃbhava jaya pānada pānas tvaṃ jaya jyotiḥsvarūpiṇe
verses.translation: She said to that excellent Siddha: "I do not know the brahmin who is the ruler of Kasl. The truth has been mention¬ ed to you. The fact is not retained in my mind."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जय वामन वित्तेश जय धूमपताकिने जय सर्वस्य जगतो दातृमूर्ते नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: jaya vāmana vitteśa jaya dhūmapatākine jaya sarvasya jagato dātṛmūrte namo 'stu te
verses.translation: On being told thus the Siddha returned. After some time he went to Varanasi and was again met by the foolish brahmin.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वम् एव लोकत्रयवर्तिजीव निकायसंक्लेशविनाशदक्ष श्रीपुण्डरीकाक्ष कृपानिधे त्वं निधेहि पाणिं मम मूर्ध्नि विष्णो
verses.transliteration: tvam eva lokatrayavartijīva nikāyasaṃkleśavināśadakṣa śrīpuṇḍarīkākṣa kṛpānidhe tvaṃ nidhehi pāṇiṃ mama mūrdhni viṣṇo
verses.translation: On seeing him he asked again: "What did the lady born of the thighs,, say to you?" The Siddha said: "Urvasi spoke to me thus, T do not know' ",
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुवन्तं भगवाञ् शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः वरेण च्छन्दयाम् आस सर्वकामसमृद्धिदः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ stuvantaṃ bhagavāñ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ vareṇa cchandayām āsa sarvakāmasamṛddhidaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the Siddha he said again with a gentle smile separating his lips: "Urvasi should be told thus by you—'How will you know?' '*
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धन्वन्तरिः प्रीतमना वरदानेन चक्रिणः वरदानाय देवेशं गोविन्दं संस्थितं पुरः
verses.transliteration: dhanvantariḥ prītamanā varadānena cakriṇaḥ varadānāya deveśaṃ govindaṃ saṃsthitaṃ puraḥ
verses.translation: "Of course I will do this." After saying this the Siddha went to heaven and saw Urvasi coming out of Indra's abode.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तम् आह नृपतिः प्रह्वः सुरराज्यं ममेप्सितम् तच् च दत्तं त्वया विष्णो प्राप्तो ऽस्मि कृतकृत्यताम्
verses.transliteration: tam āha nṛpatiḥ prahvaḥ surarājyaṃ mamepsitam tac ca dattaṃ tvayā viṣṇo prāpto 'smi kṛtakṛtyatām
verses.translation: He showed many gestures and pranks befitting a foolish person. UrvasI understood him. Coming to know that he was the selfsame fool as mentioned by Siddha she smilingly spoke:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्तुतः संपूजितो विष्णुस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत तथैव त्रिदशेशत्वम् अवाप नृपतिः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: stutaḥ saṃpūjito viṣṇus tatraivāntaradhīyata tathaiva tridaśeśatvam avāpa nṛpatiḥ kramāt
verses.translation: O highly blessed one, what do you desire from me? Let it be mentioned quickly. I shall carry out your injunctions. Rest assured.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रागर्जितानेककर्मपरिपाकवशात् ततः त्रिःकृत्वो नाशम् अगमत् सहस्राक्षः स्वकात् पदात्
verses.transliteration: prāgarjitānekakarmaparipākavaśāt tataḥ triḥkṛtvo nāśam agamat sahasrākṣaḥ svakāt padāt
verses.translation: O lady of pure smiles, save my life by surrendering yourself. &
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नहुषाद् वृत्रहत्यायाः सिन्धुसेनवधात् ततः अहल्यायां च गमनाद् येन केन च हेतुना
verses.transliteration: nahuṣād vṛtrahatyāyāḥ sindhusenavadhāt tataḥ ahalyāyāṃ ca gamanād yena kena ca hetunā
verses.translation: Then UrvasI said to the brahmin: "I am now in the
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्मारं स्मारं तत् तद् इन्द्रश् चिन्तासंतापदुर्मनाः ततः सुरपतिः प्राह वाचस्पतिम् इदं वचः
verses.transliteration: smāraṃ smāraṃ tat tad indraś cintāsaṃtāpadurmanāḥ tataḥ surapatiḥ prāha vācaspatim idaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing that the brahmin remembered what had happened before. Although he was afflicted by hunger he said: "O gentle lady, I cannot accept this. In front of the ex¬ cellent Siddha, the holy vow that I will not eat the mixture had been undertaken by me in order that Urvasi might recollect me. Give this to someone else."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हेतुना केन वागीश भ्रष्टराज्यो भवाम्य् अहम् मध्ये मध्ये पदभ्रंशाद् वरं निःश्रीकता नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: hetunā kena vāgīśa bhraṣṭarājyo bhavāmy aham madhye madhye padabhraṃśād varaṃ niḥśrīkatā nṛṇām
verses.translation: She said: "O gentle Sir, the observance undertaken by you refers to the wooden one. This is not made of wood. You have been extremely afflicted by hunger. Eat this".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गहनां कर्मणां जीवगतिं को वेत्ति तत्त्वतः रहस्यं सर्वभावानां ज्ञातुं नान्यः प्रगल्भते
verses.transliteration: gahanāṃ karmaṇāṃ jīvagatiṃ ko vetti tattvataḥ rahasyaṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ jñātuṃ nānyaḥ pragalbhate
verses.translation: The brahmin replied to her: "O gentle lady, the statement had not been qualified by me. A general vow had been undertaken by me."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिर् हरिं प्राह ब्रह्माणं पृच्छ गच्छ तम् स तु जानाति यद् भूतं भविष्यच् चापि वर्तनम्
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatir hariṃ prāha brahmāṇaṃ pṛccha gaccha tam sa tu jānāti yad bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyac cāpi vartanam
verses.translation: That lady then said again: "O brahmin, if you do not want to eat take this home. Your family shall partake of it."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स तु वक्ष्यति येनेदं जातं तच् च महामते ताव् आगत्य महाप्राज्ञौ नमस्कृत्य ममान्तिकम् कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा माम् ऊचतुर् इदं वचः
verses.transliteration: sa tu vakṣyati yenedaṃ jātaṃ tac ca mahāmate tāv āgatya mahāprājñau namaskṛtya mamāntikam kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā mām ūcatur idaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words,. Urvasi resumed her excellent form. Smiling with a majestic grandeur she said to the brahmin:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् केन दोषेण शचीभर्ता उदारधीः राज्यात् प्रभ्रश्यते नाथ संशयं छेत्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: bhagavan kena doṣeṇa śacībhartā udāradhīḥ rājyāt prabhraśyate nātha saṃśayaṃ chettum arhasi
verses.translation: O brahmins, after saying this UrvasI flew up to heaven. That brahmin of truthful austerity went to Rupatlrtha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदाहम् अब्रवं ब्रह्मंश् चिरं ध्यात्वा बृहस्पतिम् खण्डधर्माख्यदोषेण तेन राज्यपदाच् च्युतः
verses.transliteration: tadāham abravaṃ brahmaṃś ciraṃ dhyātvā bṛhaspatim khaṇḍadharmākhyadoṣeṇa tena rājyapadāc cyutaḥ
verses.translation: For a period of one hundred Manvantaras he ex¬ perienced all pleasures and then was born as a king in an ex¬ cellent dynasty. He was eager in delighting and encouraging his subjects.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देशकालादिदोषेण श्रद्धामन्त्रविपर्ययात् यथावद्दक्षिणादानाद् असद्द्रव्यप्रदानतः
verses.transliteration: deśakālādidoṣeṇa śraddhāmantraviparyayāt yathāvaddakṣiṇādānād asaddravyapradānataḥ
verses.translation: He performed various sacrifices, concluding them with excellent monetary gifts. After entrusting his sons with the work of ruling the realm he went again to Saukarava.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवभूदेवतावज्ञापातकाच् च विशेषतः यत् खण्डत्वं स्वधर्मस्य देहिनाम् उपजायते
verses.transliteration: devabhūdevatāvajñāpātakāc ca viśeṣataḥ yat khaṇḍatvaṃ svadharmasya dehinām upajāyate
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेनातिमानसस् तापः पदहानिश् च दुस्त्यजा कृतो ऽपि धर्मो ऽनिष्टाय जायते क्षुब्धचेतसा
verses.transliteration: tenātimānasas tāpaḥ padahāniś ca dustyajā kṛto 'pi dharmo 'niṣṭāya jāyate kṣubdhacetasā
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कार्यस्य न भवेत् सिद्ध्यै तस्माद् अव्याकुलाय च असंपूर्णे स्वधर्मे हि किम् अनिष्टं न जायते
verses.transliteration: kāryasya na bhavet siddhyai tasmād avyākulāya ca asaṃpūrṇe svadharme hi kim aniṣṭaṃ na jāyate
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां यत् पूर्ववृत्तान्तं तद् अप्य् उक्तं मयानघ आयुषस् तु सुतः श्रीमान् धन्वन्तरिर् उदारधीः
verses.transliteration: tābhyāṃ yat pūrvavṛttāntaṃ tad apy uktaṃ mayānagha āyuṣas tu sutaḥ śrīmān dhanvantarir udāradhīḥ
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तमसा च कृतं विघ्नं विष्णुना तच् च नाशितम् पूर्वजन्मसु वृत्तान्तम् इत्यादि परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: tamasā ca kṛtaṃ vighnaṃ viṣṇunā tac ca nāśitam pūrvajanmasu vṛttāntam ityādi parikīrtitam
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा विस्मितौ चोभौ माम् एव पुनर् ऊचतुः
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā vismitau cobhau mām eva punar ūcatuḥ
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद्दोषप्रतिबन्धस् तु केन स्यात् सुरसत्तम
verses.transliteration: taddoṣapratibandhas tu kena syāt surasattama
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् ध्यात्वा ताव् अवदं श्रूयतां दोषकारकम् कारणं सर्वसिद्धीनां दुःखसंसारतारणम्
verses.transliteration: punar dhyātvā tāv avadaṃ śrūyatāṃ doṣakārakam kāraṇaṃ sarvasiddhīnāṃ duḥkhasaṃsāratāraṇam
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शरणं तप्तचित्तानां निर्वाणं जीवताम् अपि गत्वा तु गौतमीं देवीं स्तूयेतां हरिशंकरौ
verses.transliteration: śaraṇaṃ taptacittānāṃ nirvāṇaṃ jīvatām api gatvā tu gautamīṃ devīṃ stūyetāṃ hariśaṃkarau
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नोपायो ऽन्यो ऽस्ति संशुद्ध्यै तौ तां हित्वा जगत्त्रये तदैव जग्मतुर् उभौ गौतमीं मुनिसत्तम स्नातौ कृतक्षणौ चोभौ देवौ तुष्टुवतुर् मुदा
verses.transliteration: nopāyo 'nyo 'sti saṃśuddhyai tau tāṃ hitvā jagattraye tadaiva jagmatur ubhau gautamīṃ munisattama snātau kṛtakṣaṇau cobhau devau tuṣṭuvatur mudā
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमो मत्स्याय कूर्माय वराहाय नमो नमः नरसिंहाय देवाय वामनाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: namo matsyāya kūrmāya varāhāya namo namaḥ narasiṃhāya devāya vāmanāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु हयरूपाय त्रिविक्रम नमो ऽस्तु ते नमो ऽस्तु बुद्धरूपाय रामरूपाय कल्किने
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu hayarūpāya trivikrama namo 'stu te namo 'stu buddharūpāya rāmarūpāya kalkine
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तायाच्युतायेश जामदग्न्याय ते नमः वरुणेन्द्रस्वरूपाय यमरूपाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: anantāyācyutāyeśa jāmadagnyāya te namaḥ varuṇendrasvarūpāya yamarūpāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: परमेशाय देवाय नमस् त्रैलोक्यरूपिणे बिभ्रत्सरस्वतीं वक्त्रे सर्वज्ञो ऽसि नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: parameśāya devāya namas trailokyarūpiṇe bibhratsarasvatīṃ vaktre sarvajño 'si namo 'stu te
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मीवान् अस्य् अतो लक्ष्मीं बिभ्रद् वक्षसि चानघ बहुबाहूरुपादस् त्वं बहुकर्णाक्षिशीर्षकः त्वाम् एव सुखिनं प्राप्य बहवः सुखिनो ऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: lakṣmīvān asy ato lakṣmīṃ bibhrad vakṣasi cānagha bahubāhūrupādas tvaṃ bahukarṇākṣiśīrṣakaḥ tvām eva sukhinaṃ prāpya bahavaḥ sukhino 'bhavan
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तावन् निःश्रीकता पुंसां मालिन्यं दैन्यम् एव वा यावन् न यान्ति शरणं हरे त्वां करुणार्णवम्
verses.transliteration: tāvan niḥśrīkatā puṃsāṃ mālinyaṃ dainyam eva vā yāvan na yānti śaraṇaṃ hare tvāṃ karuṇārṇavam
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्मं परं जोतिर् अनन्तरूपम् ॐकारमात्रं प्रकृतेः परं यत् चिद्रूपम् आनन्दमयं समस्तम् एवं वदन्तीश मुमुक्षवस् त्वाम्
verses.transliteration: sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ jotir anantarūpam oṃkāramātraṃ prakṛteḥ paraṃ yat cidrūpam ānandamayaṃ samastam evaṃ vadantīśa mumukṣavas tvām
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आराधयन्त्य् अत्र भवन्तम् ईशं महामखैः पञ्चभिर् अप्य् अकामाः संसारसिन्धोः परम् आप्तकामा विशन्ति दिव्यं भुवनं वपुस् ते
verses.transliteration: ārādhayanty atra bhavantam īśaṃ mahāmakhaiḥ pañcabhir apy akāmāḥ saṃsārasindhoḥ param āptakāmā viśanti divyaṃ bhuvanaṃ vapus te
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषु सत्त्वेषु समत्वबुद्ध्या संवीक्ष्य षट्सूर्मिषु शान्तभावाः ज्ञानेन ते कर्मफलानि हित्वा ध्यानेन ते त्वां प्रविशन्ति शंभो
