verses.transliteration: sarveṣu sattveṣu samatvabuddhyā saṃvīkṣya ṣaṭsūrmiṣu śāntabhāvāḥ jñānena te karmaphalāni hitvā dhyānena te tvāṃ praviśanti śaṃbho
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न जातिधर्माणि न वेदशास्त्रं न ध्यानयोगो न समाधिधर्मः रुद्रं शिवं शंकरं शान्तिचित्तं भक्त्या देवं सोमम् अहं नमस्ये
verses.transliteration: na jātidharmāṇi na vedaśāstraṃ na dhyānayogo na samādhidharmaḥ rudraṃ śivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śānticittaṃ bhaktyā devaṃ somam ahaṃ namasye
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मूर्खो ऽपि शंभो तव पादभक्त्या समाप्नुयान् मुक्तिमयीं तनुं ते ज्ञानेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव ध्यानेषु होमेषु महाफलेषु
verses.transliteration: mūrkho 'pi śaṃbho tava pādabhaktyā samāpnuyān muktimayīṃ tanuṃ te jñāneṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva dhyāneṣu homeṣu mahāphaleṣu
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संपन्नम् एतत् फलम् उत्तमं यत् सोमेश्वरे भक्तिर् अहर्निशं यत् सर्वस्य जीवस्य सदा प्रियस्य फलस्य दृष्टस्य तथा श्रुतस्य
verses.transliteration: saṃpannam etat phalam uttamaṃ yat someśvare bhaktir aharniśaṃ yat sarvasya jīvasya sadā priyasya phalasya dṛṣṭasya tathā śrutasya
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गस्य मोक्षस्य जगन्निवास सोपानपङ्क्तिस् तव भक्तिर् एषा त्वत्पादसंप्राप्तिफलाप्तये तु सोपानपङ्क्तिं न वदन्ति धीराः
verses.transliteration: svargasya mokṣasya jagannivāsa sopānapaṅktis tava bhaktir eṣā tvatpādasaṃprāptiphalāptaye tu sopānapaṅktiṃ na vadanti dhīrāḥ
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् दयालो मम भक्तिर् अस्तु नैवास्त्य् उपायस् तव रूपसेवा आत्मीयम् आलोक्य महत्त्वम् ईश पापेषु चास्मासु कुरु प्रसादम्
verses.transliteration: tasmād dayālo mama bhaktir astu naivāsty upāyas tava rūpasevā ātmīyam ālokya mahattvam īśa pāpeṣu cāsmāsu kuru prasādam
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्थूलं च सूक्ष्मं त्वम् अनादि नित्यं पिता च माता यद् असच् च सच् च एवं स्तुतो यः श्रुतिभिः पुराणैर् नमामि सोमेश्वरम् ईशितारम्
verses.transliteration: sthūlaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ tvam anādi nityaṃ pitā ca mātā yad asac ca sac ca evaṃ stuto yaḥ śrutibhiḥ purāṇair namāmi someśvaram īśitāram
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रीतौ हरिहराव् ऊचतुस् त्रिदशेश्वरौ
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prītau hariharāv ūcatus tridaśeśvarau
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: व्रियतां यन् मनोभीष्टं यद् वरं चातिदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: vriyatāṃ yan manobhīṣṭaṃ yad varaṃ cātidurlabham
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः प्राह सुरेशानं मद्राज्यं तु पुनः पुनः जायते भ्रश्यते चैव तत् पापम् उपशाम्यताम्
verses.transliteration: indraḥ prāha sureśānaṃ madrājyaṃ tu punaḥ punaḥ jāyate bhraśyate caiva tat pāpam upaśāmyatām
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथा स्थिरो ऽहं राज्ये स्यां सर्वं स्यान् निश्चलं मम सुप्रीतौ यदि देवेशौ सर्वं स्यान् निश्चलं सदा
verses.transliteration: yathā sthiro 'haṃ rājye syāṃ sarvaṃ syān niścalaṃ mama suprītau yadi deveśau sarvaṃ syān niścalaṃ sadā
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेति हरिवाक्यं ताव् अभिनन्द्येदम् ऊचतुः परं प्रसादम् आपन्नौ ताव् आलोक्य स्मिताननौ
verses.transliteration: tatheti harivākyaṃ tāv abhinandyedam ūcatuḥ paraṃ prasādam āpannau tāv ālokya smitānanau
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निरपायनिराधारनिर्विकारस्वरूपिणौ शरण्यौ सर्वलोकानां भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदाव् उभौ
verses.transliteration: nirapāyanirādhāranirvikārasvarūpiṇau śaraṇyau sarvalokānāṃ bhuktimuktipradāv ubhau
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रिदैवत्यं महातीर्थं गौतमी वाञ्छितप्रदा तस्याम् अनेन मन्त्रेण कुरुतां स्नानम् आदरात्
verses.transliteration: tridaivatyaṃ mahātīrthaṃ gautamī vāñchitapradā tasyām anena mantreṇa kurutāṃ snānam ādarāt
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अभिषेकं महेन्द्रस्य मङ्गलाय बृहस्पतिः करोतु संस्मरन्न् आवां संपदां स्थैर्यसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: abhiṣekaṃ mahendrasya maṅgalāya bṛhaspatiḥ karotu saṃsmarann āvāṃ saṃpadāṃ sthairyasiddhaye
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इह जन्मनि पूर्वस्मिन् यत् किंचित् सुकृतं कृतम् तत् सर्वं पूर्णताम् एतु गोदावरि नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: iha janmani pūrvasmin yat kiṃcit sukṛtaṃ kṛtam tat sarvaṃ pūrṇatām etu godāvari namo 'stu te
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्मृत्वा तु यः कश्चिद् गौतम्यां स्नानम् आचरेत् आवाभ्यां तु प्रसादेन धर्मः संपूर्णताम् इयात् पूर्वजन्मकृताद् दोषात् स मुक्तः पुण्यवान् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ smṛtvā tu yaḥ kaścid gautamyāṃ snānam ācaret āvābhyāṃ tu prasādena dharmaḥ saṃpūrṇatām iyāt pūrvajanmakṛtād doṣāt sa muktaḥ puṇyavān bhavet
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेति चक्रतुः प्रीतौ सुरेन्द्रधिषणौ ततः महाभिषेकम् इन्द्रस्य चकार द्युसदां गुरुः
verses.transliteration: tatheti cakratuḥ prītau surendradhiṣaṇau tataḥ mahābhiṣekam indrasya cakāra dyusadāṃ guruḥ
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेनाभूद् या नदी पुण्या मङ्गलेत्य् उदिता तु सा तया च संगमः पुण्यो गङ्गायाः शुभदस् त्व् असौ
verses.transliteration: tenābhūd yā nadī puṇyā maṅgalety uditā tu sā tayā ca saṃgamaḥ puṇyo gaṅgāyāḥ śubhadas tv asau
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रेण संस्तुतो विष्णुः प्रत्यक्षो ऽभूज् जगन्मयः त्रिलोकसंमितां शक्रो भूमिं लेभे जगत्पतेः
verses.transliteration: indreṇa saṃstuto viṣṇuḥ pratyakṣo 'bhūj jaganmayaḥ trilokasaṃmitāṃ śakro bhūmiṃ lebhe jagatpateḥ
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तन्नाम्ना चापि विख्यातो गोविन्द इति तत्र च त्रिलोकसंमिता लब्धा तेन गौर् वज्रधारिणा
verses.transliteration: tannāmnā cāpi vikhyāto govinda iti tatra ca trilokasaṃmitā labdhā tena gaur vajradhāriṇā
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दत्ता च हरिणा तत्र गोविन्दस् तद् अभूद् धरिः त्रैलोक्यराज्यं यत् प्राप्तं हरिणा च हरेर् मुने
verses.transliteration: dattā ca hariṇā tatra govindas tad abhūd dhariḥ trailokyarājyaṃ yat prāptaṃ hariṇā ca harer mune
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निश्चलं येन संजातं देवदेवान् महेश्वरात् बृहस्पतिर् देवगुरुर् यत्रास्तौषीन् महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: niścalaṃ yena saṃjātaṃ devadevān maheśvarāt bṛhaspatir devagurur yatrāstauṣīn maheśvaram
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राज्यस्य स्थिरभावाय देवेन्द्रस्य महात्मनः सिद्धेश्वरस् तत्र देवो लिङ्गं तु त्रिदशार्चितम्
verses.transliteration: rājyasya sthirabhāvāya devendrasya mahātmanaḥ siddheśvaras tatra devo liṅgaṃ tu tridaśārcitam
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं गोविन्दम् इति विश्रुतम् मङ्गलासंगमं चैव पूर्णतीर्थं ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ govindam iti viśrutam maṅgalāsaṃgamaṃ caiva pūrṇatīrthaṃ tataḥ param
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं बार्हस्पत्यं च विश्रुतम् यत्र सिद्धेश्वरो देवो विष्णुर् गोविन्द एव च
verses.transliteration: indratīrtham iti khyātaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ ca viśrutam yatra siddheśvaro devo viṣṇur govinda eva ca
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेषु स्नानं च दानं च यत् किंचित् सुकृतार्जनम् सर्वं तद् अक्षयं विद्यात् पितॄणाम् अतिवल्लभम्
verses.transliteration: teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca yat kiṃcit sukṛtārjanam sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ vidyāt pitṝṇām ativallabham
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणोति यश् चापि पठेद् यश् च स्मरति नित्यशः तस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं भ्रष्टराज्यप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇoti yaś cāpi paṭhed yaś ca smarati nityaśaḥ tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ bhraṣṭarājyapradāyakam
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सप्तत्रिंशत् सहस्राणि तीर्थानां तीरयोर् द्वयोः उभयोर् मुनिशार्दूल सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायिनाम्
verses.transliteration: saptatriṃśat sahasrāṇi tīrthānāṃ tīrayor dvayoḥ ubhayor muniśārdūla sarvasiddhipradāyinām
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न पूर्णतीर्थसदृशं तीर्थम् अस्ति महाफलम् निष्फलं तस्य जन्मादि यो न सेवेत तन् नरः
verses.transliteration: na pūrṇatīrthasadṛśaṃ tīrtham asti mahāphalam niṣphalaṃ tasya janmādi yo na seveta tan naraḥ
verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रामतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं भ्रूणहत्याविनाशनम् तस्य श्रवणमात्रेण सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: rāmatīrtham iti khyātaṃ bhrūṇahatyāvināśanam tasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Listen, O leading sages. I shall mention in due order how a person shall attain devotion to Visnu with great benefit.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवः क्षत्रियो लोकविश्रुतः बलवान् मतिमाञ् शूरो यथा शक्रः पुरंदरः
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākuvaṃśaprabhavaḥ kṣatriyo lokaviśrutaḥ balavān matimāñ śūro yathā śakraḥ puraṃdaraḥ
verses.translation: After human birth he attains brahminhood, power of discrimination, sense of piety and happiness in successive births.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पितृपैतामहं राज्यं कुर्वन्न् आस्ते यथा बलिः तस्य तिस्रो महिष्यः स्यू राज्ञो दशरथस्य हि
verses.transliteration: pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ kurvann āste yathā baliḥ tasya tisro mahiṣyaḥ syū rājño daśarathasya hi
verses.translation: Until the ultimate destruction of all sins of men accumu¬ lated in different births, devotion to Vasudeva identical with the universe, is not possible.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कौशल्या च सुमित्रा च कैकेयी च महामते एताः कुलीनाः सुभगा रूपलक्षणसंयुताः
verses.transliteration: kauśalyā ca sumitrā ca kaikeyī ca mahāmate etāḥ kulīnāḥ subhagā rūpalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ
verses.translation: Then, O brahmins, with great concentration and purity of mind be begins to love the fire-god. When the fire-god is pro¬ pitiated he becomes a devotee of sun.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् राजनि राज्ये तु स्थिते ऽयोध्यापतौ मुने वसिष्ठे ब्रह्मविच्छ्रेष्ठे पुरोधसि विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: tasmin rājani rājye tu sthite 'yodhyāpatau mune vasiṣṭhe brahmavicchreṣṭhe purodhasi viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, he worships sun-god regularly. When that god is pleased he becomes devoted to Sankara.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न च व्याधिर् न दुर्भिक्षं न चावृष्टिर् न चाधयः ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशां नित्यं शूद्राणां च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: na ca vyādhir na durbhikṣaṃ na cāvṛṣṭir na cādhayaḥ brahmakṣatraviśāṃ nityaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: He performs the worship of Sambhu duly and strenuo¬ usly. When the three-eyed god is satisfied he becomes devoted to Kesava.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमाणां तु सर्वेषाम् आनन्दो ऽभूत् पृथक् पृथक् तस्मिञ् शासति राजेन्द्र इक्ष्वाकूणां कुलोद्वहे
verses.transliteration: āśramāṇāṃ tu sarveṣām ānando 'bhūt pṛthak pṛthak tasmiñ śāsati rājendra ikṣvākūṇāṃ kulodvahe
verses.translation: By worshipping the imperishable lord of the universe named Vasudeva, O excellent brahmins, he attains worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवानां दानवानां तु राज्यार्थे विग्रहो ऽभवत् क्वापि तत्र जयं प्रापुर् देवाः क्वापि तथेतरे
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ dānavānāṃ tu rājyārthe vigraho 'bhavat kvāpi tatra jayaṃ prāpur devāḥ kvāpi tathetare
verses.translation: O great sage, some men are averse to devotion of Visnu. O brahmin, tell us why they do not worship Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रवर्तमाने तु त्रैलोक्यम् अतिपीडितम् अभून् नारद तत्राहम् अवदं दैत्यदानवान्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pravartamāne tu trailokyam atipīḍitam abhūn nārada tatrāham avadaṃ daityadānavān
verses.translation: In this world, O excellent sages, two types of created be¬ ings are well-known, viz. Asura (demonic) and Daiva (di¬ vine). They are created formerly by the self-born lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवांश् चापि विशेषेण न कृतं तैर् मदीरितम् पुनश् च संगरस् तेषां बभूव सुमहान् मिथः
verses.transliteration: devāṃś cāpi viśeṣeṇa na kṛtaṃ tair madīritam punaś ca saṃgaras teṣāṃ babhūva sumahān mithaḥ
verses.translation: By attaining the divine nature men worship Acyuta. Those who have attained the demonic nature slander Hari.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुं गत्वा सुराः प्रोचुस् तथेशानं जगन्मयम् ताव् ऊचतुर् उभौ देवान् असुरान् दैत्यदानवान्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuṃ gatvā surāḥ procus tatheśānaṃ jaganmayam tāv ūcatur ubhau devān asurān daityadānavān
verses.translation: We all wish to comprehend that insurmountable Maya of Visnu. Osage conversant with details of virtue, it behoves you to narrate. Our eagerness is great.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तपसा बलिनो यान्तु पुनः कुर्वन्तु संगरम् तथेत्य् आहुर् ययुः सर्वे तपसे नियतव्रताः
verses.transliteration: tapasā balino yāntu punaḥ kurvantu saṃgaram tathety āhur yayuḥ sarve tapase niyatavratāḥ
verses.translation: The father endeavoured to cclehmt P u.v
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ययुस् तु राक्षसान् देवाः पुनस् ते मत्सरान्विताः देवानां दानवानां च संगरो ऽभूत् सुदारुणः
verses.transliteration: yayus tu rākṣasān devāḥ punas te matsarānvitāḥ devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca saṃgaro 'bhūt sudāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: Even after hearing the words of h;. r, tained silence with solemnity Oku- h f her he mam " him frequently. rahmins, the father urged
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र देवा जेतारो नैव दैत्याश् च दानवाः संयुगे वर्तमाने तु वाग् उवाचाशरीरिणी
verses.transliteration: na tatra devā jetāro naiva daityāś ca dānavāḥ saṃyuge vartamāne tu vāg uvācāśarīriṇī
verses.translation: On hearing the behest of his father the son of perfect self-control was reminded of the old strange ways of the world He said:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: येषां दशरथो राजा ते जेतारो न चेतरे
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ daśaratho rājā te jetāro na cetare
verses.translation: I have acquired thousands of births, hundreds of deaths and old age and acquisitions of and separation from wives in all of them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा जयायोभौ जग्मतुर् देवदानवौ तत्र वायुस् त्वरन् प्राप्तो राजानम् अवदत् तदा
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā jayāyobhau jagmatur devadānavau tatra vāyus tvaran prāpto rājānam avadat tadā
verses.translation: Hundreds of different states have been attained by me —like those of grass, shrubs, creepers, winding plants, reptiles, animals, birds, beasts, women, men etc.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आगन्तव्यं त्वया राजन् देवदानवसंगरे यत्र राजा दशरथो जयस् तत्रेति विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: āgantavyaṃ tvayā rājan devadānavasaṃgare yatra rājā daśaratho jayas tatreti viśrutam
verses.translation: In view of my being united with a wife I had been
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् त्वं देवपक्षे स्या भवेयुर् जयिनः सुराः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt tvaṃ devapakṣe syā bhaveyur jayinaḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: After passing through many births as man, god, Gan-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् वायुवचनं श्रुत्वा राजा दशरथो नृपः आगम्यते मया सत्यं गच्छ वायो यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: tad vāyuvacanaṃ śrutvā rājā daśaratho nṛpaḥ āgamyate mayā satyaṃ gaccha vāyo yathāsukham
verses.translation: Then my devotion to Visnu, the slayer of Madhu and the lord of worlds, was very steady. By means of devotion and different holy rites and fasts, the wielder of discus, club and other miraculous weapons was propitiated by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गते वायौ तदा दैत्या आजग्मुर् भूपतिं प्रति ते ऽप्य् ऊचुर् भगवन्न् अस्मत्साहाय्यं कर्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: gate vāyau tadā daityā ājagmur bhūpatiṃ prati te 'py ūcur bhagavann asmatsāhāyyaṃ kartum arhasi
verses.translation: The delighted noble Visnu came there riding on the lord of birds (Garuda) (with the intention of) granting me boons. He said in a loud voice: Cf O twice-born one, let any boon be prayed for. I shall give you whatever you desire."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राजन् दशरथ श्रीमन् विजयस् त्वयि संस्थितः तस्मात् त्वं वै दैत्यपतेः साहाय्यं कर्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: rājan daśaratha śrīman vijayas tvayi saṃsthitaḥ tasmāt tvaṃ vai daityapateḥ sāhāyyaṃ kartum arhasi
verses.translation: Then I said to lord Hari: "O Kes'ava, if you are pleased I shall choose a boon. O Janardana, I wish to know that great Maya belonging to you".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रोवाच नृपतिर् वायुना प्रार्थितः पुरा प्रतिज्ञातं मया तच् च यान्तु दैत्याश् च दानवाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ provāca nṛpatir vāyunā prārthitaḥ purā pratijñātaṃ mayā tac ca yāntu daityāś ca dānavāḥ
verses.translation: The enemy of Madhu and Kaitabha then said to me: "O brahmin, of what avail is that Maya to you? I shall give unto you virtue, wealth and love, prominent sons and freedom from sickness.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स तु राजा तथा चक्रे गत्वा चैव त्रिविष्टपम् युद्धं चक्रे तथा दैत्यैर् दानवैः सह राक्षसैः
verses.transliteration: sa tu rājā tathā cakre gatvā caiva triviṣṭapam yuddhaṃ cakre tathā daityair dānavaiḥ saha rākṣasaiḥ
verses.translation: Then I said again to the enemy of Mura: "This is my desire to conquer wealth and virtue. I wish to know your Maya, O Puskaraksa (Lotus-eyed one). Show that unto me 55.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पश्यत्सु देवसंघेषु नमुचेर् भ्रातरस् तदा विविधुर् निशितैर् बाणैर् अथाक्षं नृपतेस् तथा
verses.transliteration: paśyatsu devasaṃgheṣu namucer bhrātaras tadā vividhur niśitair bāṇair athākṣaṃ nṛpates tathā
verses.translation: Then lord Visnu, the prominent Man-Lion, the lord of goddess of wealth said these words to me: "No one knows my Maya nor will any one ever know it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भिन्नाक्षं तं रथं राजा न जानाति स संभ्रमात् राजान्तिके स्थिता सुभ्रूः कैकेय्याज्ञायि नारद
verses.transliteration: bhinnākṣaṃ taṃ rathaṃ rājā na jānāti sa saṃbhramāt rājāntike sthitā subhrūḥ kaikeyyājñāyi nārada
verses.translation: Then I said: "O Narada, sink unto the water and you
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न ज्ञापितं तया राज्ञे स्वयम् आलोक्य सुव्रता भग्नम् अक्षं समालक्ष्य चक्रे हस्तं तदा स्वकम्
verses.transliteration: na jñāpitaṃ tayā rājñe svayam ālokya suvratā bhagnam akṣaṃ samālakṣya cakre hastaṃ tadā svakam
verses.translation: When she reached the prime of youth (the king of Kasi) gave her in marriage to Sudharma of fine virtue, the son of the king of Vidarbha. O great sage, in her company he indulged in unsurpassed pleasures.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अक्षवन् मुनिशार्दूल तद् एतन् महद् अद्भुतम् रथेन रथिनां श्रेष्ठस् तया दत्तकरेण च
verses.transliteration: akṣavan muniśārdūla tad etan mahad adbhutam rathena rathināṃ śreṣṭhas tayā dattakareṇa ca
verses.translation: When his father passed away, on to him. Sudharma of great valour ruled over the Vidarbha kingdom. He i and grandsons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जितवान् दैत्यदनुजान् देवैः प्राप्य वरान् बहून् ततो देवैर् अनुज्ञातस् त्व् अयोध्यां पुनर् अभ्यगात्
verses.transliteration: jitavān daityadanujān devaiḥ prāpya varān bahūn tato devair anujñātas tv ayodhyāṃ punar abhyagāt
verses.translation: (Defective text) Susila came to know that her father and her husband were killed along with sons and grandsons. She set off from the city and went to the battlefield. On seeing her dead father and husband along with their sons and grandsons Susila grieved much.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स तु मध्ये महाराजो मार्गे वीक्ष्य तदा प्रियाम् कैकेय्याः कर्म तद् दृष्ट्वा विस्मयं परमं गतः
verses.transliteration: sa tu madhye mahārājo mārge vīkṣya tadā priyām kaikeyyāḥ karma tad dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: "Who is your son? Tell me, O great sage. With your senses gone whom do you bevail?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तस्यै वरान् प्रादात् त्रींस् तु नारद सा अपि अनुमान्य नृपप्रोक्तं कैकेयी वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tatas tasyai varān prādāt trīṃs tu nārada sā api anumānya nṛpaproktaṃ kaikeyī vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: On hearing my words the great sage said: "O Lord Visnu, grant me (the boon of) devotion to you. Whenever opportunity arrives let me remember you. Let me have your perpetual vision.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वयि तिष्ठन्तु राजेन्द्र त्वया दत्ता वरा अमी
verses.transliteration: tvayi tiṣṭhantu rājendra tvayā dattā varā amī
verses.translation: O Acyuta, let the place where, in my grief, I had stepped on to the funeral pyre become a holy spot. Let it be presided over by you, O Kesava, together with the lotus-born lord Brahma."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विभूषणानि राजेन्द्रो दत्त्वा स प्रियया सह रथेन विजयी राजा ययौ स्वनगरं सुखी
verses.transliteration: vibhūṣaṇāni rājendro dattvā sa priyayā saha rathena vijayī rājā yayau svanagaraṃ sukhī
verses.translation: After cutting off that head of Brahma which uttered harsh words, the three-eyed lord will come to this holy spot of thine for casting off the skull.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: योषितां किम् अदेयं हि प्रियाणाम् उचितागमे स कदाचिद् दशरथो मृगयाशीलिभिर् वृतः
verses.transliteration: yoṣitāṃ kim adeyaṃ hi priyāṇām ucitāgame sa kadācid daśaratho mṛgayāśīlibhir vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: When the destroyer of the three cities, Siva, takes his holy dip in this Tirtha, the skull will drop down on the ground. Thereafter, this holy spot will become well known all over the Earth as Kapalamocana."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अटन्न् अरण्ये शर्वर्यां वारिबन्धम् अथाकरोत् सप्तव्यसनहीनेन भवितव्यं तु भूभुजा
verses.transliteration: aṭann araṇye śarvaryāṃ vāribandham athākarot saptavyasanahīnena bhavitavyaṃ tu bhūbhujā
verses.translation: Ever since then the cloud-vehicled Lord India has never forsaken this holy spot. O brahmin, say that the sin of the slaughter of a brahmin ceased to become fierce in him (defective verse).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति जानन्न् अपि च तच् चकार तु विधेर् वशात् गर्तं प्रविश्य पानार्थम् आगतान् निशितैः शरैः
verses.transliteration: iti jānann api ca tac cakāra tu vidher vaśāt gartaṃ praviśya pānārtham āgatān niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
verses.translation: As long as the slayer of the enemies of Indra does not forsake that holy spot it will continue to be great and sacred. This secret holy spot has been eulogised by Devas as Avimukta.' It is called Imperishable. It bestows merit.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृगान् हन्ति महाबाहुः शृणु कालविपर्ययम् गर्तं प्रविष्टे नृपतौ तस्मिन्न् एव नगोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: mṛgān hanti mahābāhuḥ śṛṇu kālaviparyayam gartaṃ praviṣṭe nṛpatau tasminn eva nagottame
verses.translation: Even after committing sins, if a man enters that Tirtha
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धो वैश्रवणो नाम न शृणोति न पश्यति तस्य भार्या तथाभूता ताव् अब्रूतां तदा सुतम्
verses.transliteration: vṛddho vaiśravaṇo nāma na śṛṇoti na paśyati tasya bhāryā tathābhūtā tāv abrūtāṃ tadā sutam
verses.translation: Once she went to the river taking the water pot with her. In order to take her bath she entered the water but was immediately transformed into her original form of a brahmin of good conduct engaged in holy rites and yogic practice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आवां तृषार्तौ रात्रिश् च कृष्णा चापि प्रवर्तते वृद्धानां जीवितं कृत्स्नं बालस् त्वम् असि पुत्रक
verses.transliteration: āvāṃ tṛṣārtau rātriś ca kṛṣṇā cāpi pravartate vṛddhānāṃ jīvitaṃ kṛtsnaṃ bālas tvam asi putraka
verses.translation: As a long time passed by after her departure, her husband came to the holy river in search of her. He saw the water pot but not her on the bank. Thereupon in his excess of grief he lamented loudly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्धानां बधिराणां च वृद्धानां धिक् च जीवितम् जराजर्जरदेहानां धिग् धिक् पुत्रक जीवितम्
verses.transliteration: andhānāṃ badhirāṇāṃ ca vṛddhānāṃ dhik ca jīvitam jarājarjaradehānāṃ dhig dhik putraka jīvitam
verses.translation: Then the two blind sons and the deaf daughter came there. They too were distressed and on perceiving their crying father they wept bitterly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तावत् पुंभिर् जीवितव्यं यावल् लक्ष्मीर् दृढं वपुः यावद् आज्ञाप्रतिहता तीर्थादाव् अन्यथा मृतिः
verses.transliteration: tāvat puṃbhir jīvitavyaṃ yāval lakṣmīr dṛḍhaṃ vapuḥ yāvad ājñāpratihatā tīrthādāv anyathā mṛtiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him cry along with his daughter and sons I too became distressed. Grief reminded me, O King, that I was myself the Canclala maiden.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एतद् वचनं श्रुत्वा वृद्धयोर् गुरुवत्सलः पुत्रः प्रोवाच तद् दुःखं गिरा मधुरया हरन्
verses.transliteration: ity etad vacanaṃ śrutvā vṛddhayor guruvatsalaḥ putraḥ provāca tad duḥkhaṃ girā madhurayā haran
verses.translation: Then, O King, I said to that Candala: "Why do you cry in distress? You are not going to get her back by your foolish cries. It is in vain. Of what avail to you is this lamen¬ tation?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मयि जीवति किं नाम युवयोर् दुःखम् ईदृशम् न हरत्य् आत्मजः पित्रोर् यश् चरित्रैर् मनोरुजम्
verses.transliteration: mayi jīvati kiṃ nāma yuvayor duḥkham īdṛśam na haraty ātmajaḥ pitror yaś caritrair manorujam
verses.translation: He said to me: "Both these sons are blind. The only girl is deaf. How can I, O brahmin, console these and biing them up?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेन किं तनुजेनेह कुलोद्वेगविधायिना
verses.transliteration: tena kiṃ tanujeneha kulodvegavidhāyinā
verses.translation: After saying this he cried all the more loudly along with his children. The longer I watched the Candala crying the more I pitied him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा पितरौ नत्वा ताव् आश्वास्य महामनाः तरुस्कन्धे समारोप्य वृद्धौ च पितरौ तदा
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā pitarau natvā tāv āśvāsya mahāmanāḥ taruskandhe samāropya vṛddhau ca pitarau tadā
verses.translation: Preventing him frpm crying further in his grief, I nari'ated to him the incidents of my life. Thereupon the dis¬ tressed man entered the waters of Kokamukha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हस्ते गृहीत्वा कलशं जगाम ऋषिपुत्रकः स ऋषिर् न तु राजानं जानाति नृपतिर् द्विजम्
verses.transliteration: haste gṛhītvā kalaśaṃ jagāma ṛṣiputrakaḥ sa ṛṣir na tu rājānaṃ jānāti nṛpatir dvijam
verses.translation: Immediately after his entry into the water the Can¬ dala became free from sins by the efficacy of the Tlrtha. Even
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उभौ सरभसौ तत्र द्विजो वारि समाविशत् सत्वरं कलशे न्युब्जे वारि गृह्णन्तम् आशुगैः
verses.transliteration: ubhau sarabhasau tatra dvijo vāri samāviśat satvaraṃ kalaśe nyubje vāri gṛhṇantam āśugaiḥ
verses.translation: After his entering the water and passing away my grief increased causing me great delusion. Then, O excellent king, I dived into the sacred waters of the Koka and went to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्विजं राजा द्विपं मत्वा विव्याध निशितैः शरैः वनद्विपो ऽपि भूपानाम् अवध्यस् तद् विदन्न् अपि
verses.transliteration: dvijaṃ rājā dvipaṃ matvā vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ vanadvipo 'pi bhūpānām avadhyas tad vidann api
verses.translation: I observed holy rites and'made my body emaciated. Then I went to heaven. Coming down therefrom I am now born in your, abode. O father, I can remember my previous births by the grace of Hari.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विव्याध तं नृपः कुर्यान् न किं किं विधिवञ्चितः स विद्धो मर्मदेशे तु दुःखितो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vivyādha taṃ nṛpaḥ kuryān na kiṃ kiṃ vidhivañcitaḥ sa viddho marmadeśe tu duḥkhito vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: केनेदं दुःखदं कर्म कृतं सद्ब्राह्मणस्य मे मैत्रो ब्राह्मण इत्य् उक्तो नापराधो ऽस्ति कश्चन
verses.transliteration: kenedaṃ duḥkhadaṃ karma kṛtaṃ sadbrāhmaṇasya me maitro brāhmaṇa ity ukto nāparādho 'sti kaścana
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् एतद् वचनं श्रुत्वा मुनेर् आर्तस्य भूपतिः निश्चेष्टश् च निरुत्साहो शनैस् तं देशम् अभ्यगात्
verses.transliteration: tad etad vacanaṃ śrutvā muner ārtasya bhūpatiḥ niśceṣṭaś ca nirutsāho śanais taṃ deśam abhyagāt
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तं तु दृष्ट्वा द्विजवरं ज्वलन्तम् इव तेजसा असाव् अप्य् अभवत् तत्र सशल्य इव मूर्च्छितः
verses.transliteration: taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā dvijavaraṃ jvalantam iva tejasā asāv apy abhavat tatra saśalya iva mūrcchitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानम् आत्मना कृत्वा स्थिरं राजाब्रवीद् इदम्
verses.transliteration: ātmānam ātmanā kṛtvā sthiraṃ rājābravīd idam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: को भवान् द्विजशार्दूल किमर्थम् इह चागतः वद पापकृते मह्यं वद मे निष्कृतिं पराम्
verses.transliteration: ko bhavān dvijaśārdūla kimartham iha cāgataḥ vada pāpakṛte mahyaṃ vada me niṣkṛtiṃ parām
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महा वर्णिभिः किंतु श्वपचैर् अपि जातुचित् न स्प्रष्टव्यो महाबुद्धे द्रष्टव्यो न कदाचन
verses.transliteration: brahmahā varṇibhiḥ kiṃtu śvapacair api jātucit na spraṣṭavyo mahābuddhe draṣṭavyo na kadācana
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् राजवचनं श्रुत्वा मुनिपुत्रो ऽब्रवीद् वचः
verses.transliteration: tad rājavacanaṃ śrutvā muniputro 'bravīd vacaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्क्रमिष्यन्ति मे प्राणा अतो वक्ष्यामि किंचन स्वच्छन्दवृत्तिताज्ञाने विद्धि पाकं च कर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: utkramiṣyanti me prāṇā ato vakṣyāmi kiṃcana svacchandavṛttitājñāne viddhi pākaṃ ca karmaṇām
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आत्मार्थं तु न शोचामि वृद्धौ तु पितरौ मम तयोः शुश्रूषकः कः स्याद् अन्धयोर् एकपुत्रयोः
verses.transliteration: ātmārthaṃ tu na śocāmi vṛddhau tu pitarau mama tayoḥ śuśrūṣakaḥ kaḥ syād andhayor ekaputrayoḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विना मया महारण्ये कथं तौ जीवयिष्यतः ममाभाग्यम् अहो कीदृक् पितृशुश्रूषणे क्षतिः
verses.transliteration: vinā mayā mahāraṇye kathaṃ tau jīvayiṣyataḥ mamābhāgyam aho kīdṛk pitṛśuśrūṣaṇe kṣatiḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जाता मे ऽद्य विना प्राणैर् हा विधे किं कृतं त्वया तथापि गच्छ तत्र त्वं गृहीतकलशस् त्वरन्
verses.transliteration: jātā me 'dya vinā prāṇair hā vidhe kiṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā tathāpi gaccha tatra tvaṃ gṛhītakalaśas tvaran
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां देह्य् उदपानं त्वं यथा तौ न मरिष्यतः
verses.transliteration: tābhyāṃ dehy udapānaṃ tvaṃ yathā tau na mariṣyataḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवं ब्रुवतस् तस्य गताः प्राणा महावने विसृज्य सशरं चापम् आदाय कलशं नृपः
verses.transliteration: ity evaṃ bruvatas tasya gatāḥ prāṇā mahāvane visṛjya saśaraṃ cāpam ādāya kalaśaṃ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रागात् स तु वेगेन यत्र वृद्धौ महावने वृद्धौ चापि तदा रात्रौ ताव् अन्योन्यं समूचतुः
verses.transliteration: tatrāgāt sa tu vegena yatra vṛddhau mahāvane vṛddhau cāpi tadā rātrau tāv anyonyaṃ samūcatuḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उद्विग्नः कुपितो वा स्याद् अथवा भक्षितः कथम् न प्राप्तश् चावयोर् यष्टिः किं कुर्मः का गतिर् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: udvignaḥ kupito vā syād athavā bhakṣitaḥ katham na prāptaś cāvayor yaṣṭiḥ kiṃ kurmaḥ kā gatir bhavet
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न कोपि तादृशः पुत्रो विद्यते सचराचरे यः पित्रोर् अन्यथा वाक्यं न करोत्य् अपि निन्दितः
verses.transliteration: na kopi tādṛśaḥ putro vidyate sacarācare yaḥ pitror anyathā vākyaṃ na karoty api ninditaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वज्राद् अपि कठोरं वा जीवितं तम् अपश्यतोः शीघ्रं न यान्ति यत् प्राणास् तदेकायत्तजीवयोः
verses.transliteration: vajrād api kaṭhoraṃ vā jīvitaṃ tam apaśyatoḥ śīghraṃ na yānti yat prāṇās tadekāyattajīvayoḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं बहुविधा वाचो वृद्धयोर् वदतोर् वने तदा दशरथो राजा शनैस् तं देशम् अभ्यगात्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bahuvidhā vāco vṛddhayor vadator vane tadā daśaratho rājā śanais taṃ deśam abhyagāt
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पादसंचारशब्देन मेनाते सुतम् आगतम्
verses.transliteration: pādasaṃcāraśabdena menāte sutam āgatam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुतो वत्स चिरात् प्राप्तस् त्वं दृष्टिस् त्वं परायणम् न ब्रूषे किंतु रुष्टो ऽसि वृद्धयोर् अन्धयोः सुतः
verses.transliteration: kuto vatsa cirāt prāptas tvaṃ dṛṣṭis tvaṃ parāyaṇam na brūṣe kiṃtu ruṣṭo 'si vṛddhayor andhayoḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सशल्य इव दुःखार्तः शोचन् दुष्कृतम् आत्मनः स भीत इव राजेन्द्रस् ताव् उवाचाथ नारद
verses.transliteration: saśalya iva duḥkhārtaḥ śocan duṣkṛtam ātmanaḥ sa bhīta iva rājendras tāv uvācātha nārada
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उदपानं च कुरुतां तच् छ्रुत्वा नृपभाषितम् नायं वक्ता सुतो ऽस्माकं को भवांस् तत् पुरा वद
verses.transliteration: udapānaṃ ca kurutāṃ tac chrutvā nṛpabhāṣitam nāyaṃ vaktā suto 'smākaṃ ko bhavāṃs tat purā vada
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पश्चात् पिबावः पानीयं ततो राजाब्रवीच् च तौ
verses.transliteration: paścāt pibāvaḥ pānīyaṃ tato rājābravīc ca tau
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तिष्ठति वां पुत्रो यत्र वारिसमाश्रयः
verses.transliteration: tatra tiṣṭhati vāṃ putro yatra vārisamāśrayaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वोचतुर् आर्तौ तौ सत्यं ब्रूहि न चान्यथा आचचक्षे ततो राजा सर्वम् एव यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvocatur ārtau tau satyaṃ brūhi na cānyathā ācacakṣe tato rājā sarvam eva yathātatham
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तु पतितौ वृद्धौ तत्रावां नय मा स्पृश ब्रह्मघ्नस्पर्शनं पापं न कदाचिद् विनश्यति
verses.transliteration: tatas tu patitau vṛddhau tatrāvāṃ naya mā spṛśa brahmaghnasparśanaṃ pāpaṃ na kadācid vinaśyati
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निन्ये वै श्रवणं वृद्धं सभार्यं नृपसत्तमः यत्रासौ पतितः पुत्रस् तं स्पृष्ट्वा तौ विलेपतुः
verses.transliteration: ninye vai śravaṇaṃ vṛddhaṃ sabhāryaṃ nṛpasattamaḥ yatrāsau patitaḥ putras taṃ spṛṣṭvā tau vilepatuḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथा पुत्रवियोगेन मृत्युर् नौ विहितस् तथा त्वं चापि पाप पुत्रस्य वियोगान् मृत्युम् आप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: yathā putraviyogena mṛtyur nau vihitas tathā tvaṃ cāpi pāpa putrasya viyogān mṛtyum āpsyasi
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं तु जल्पतोर् ब्रह्मन् गताः प्राणास् ततो नृपः अग्निना योजयाम् आस वृद्धौ च ऋषिपुत्रकम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tu jalpator brahman gatāḥ prāṇās tato nṛpaḥ agninā yojayām āsa vṛddhau ca ṛṣiputrakam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो जगाम नगरं दुःखितो नृपतिर् मुने वसिष्ठाय च तत् सर्वं न्यवेदयद् अशेषतः
verses.transliteration: tato jagāma nagaraṃ duḥkhito nṛpatir mune vasiṣṭhāya ca tat sarvaṃ nyavedayad aśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नृपाणां सूर्यवंश्यानां वसिष्ठो हि परा गतिः वसिष्ठो ऽपि द्विजश्रेष्ठैः संमन्त्र्याह च निष्कृतिम्
verses.transliteration: nṛpāṇāṃ sūryavaṃśyānāṃ vasiṣṭho hi parā gatiḥ vasiṣṭho 'pi dvijaśreṣṭhaiḥ saṃmantryāha ca niṣkṛtim
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गालवं वामदेवं च जाबालिम् अथ कश्यपम् एतान् अन्यान् समाहूय हयमेधाय यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: gālavaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca jābālim atha kaśyapam etān anyān samāhūya hayamedhāya yatnataḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यजस्व हयमेधैश् च बहुभिर् बहुदक्षिणैः
verses.transliteration: yajasva hayamedhaiś ca bahubhir bahudakṣiṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अकरोद् धयमेधांश् च राजा दशरथो द्विजैः एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तत्र वाग् उवाचाशरीरिणी
verses.transliteration: akarod dhayamedhāṃś ca rājā daśaratho dvijaiḥ etasminn antare tatra vāg uvācāśarīriṇī
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूतं शरीरम् अभवद् राज्ञो दशरथस्य हि व्यवहार्यश् च भविता भविष्यन्ति तथा सुताः ज्येष्ठपुत्रप्रसादेन राजापापो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: pūtaṃ śarīram abhavad rājño daśarathasya hi vyavahāryaś ca bhavitā bhaviṣyanti tathā sutāḥ jyeṣṭhaputraprasādena rājāpāpo bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो बहुतिथे काले ऋष्यशृङ्गान् मुनीश्वरात् देवानां कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं सुता आसन् सुरोपमाः
verses.transliteration: tato bahutithe kāle ṛṣyaśṛṅgān munīśvarāt devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ sutā āsan suropamāḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कौशल्यायां तथा रामः सुमित्रायां च लक्ष्मणः शत्रुघ्नश् चापि कैकेय्यां भरतो मतिमत्तरः
verses.transliteration: kauśalyāyāṃ tathā rāmaḥ sumitrāyāṃ ca lakṣmaṇaḥ śatrughnaś cāpi kaikeyyāṃ bharato matimattaraḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ते सर्वे मतिमन्तश् च प्रिया राज्ञो वशे स्थिताः तं राजानम् ऋषिः प्राप्य विश्वामित्रः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: te sarve matimantaś ca priyā rājño vaśe sthitāḥ taṃ rājānam ṛṣiḥ prāpya viśvāmitraḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रामं च लक्ष्मणं चापि अयाचत महामते यज्ञसंरक्षणार्थाय ज्ञाततन्महिमा मुनिः
verses.transliteration: rāmaṃ ca lakṣmaṇaṃ cāpi ayācata mahāmate yajñasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya jñātatanmahimā muniḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.

verses.sanskrit: चिरप्राप्तसुतो वृद्धो राजा नैवेत्य् अभाषत
verses.transliteration: ciraprāptasuto vṛddho rājā naivety abhāṣata
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महता दैवयोगेन कथंचिद् वार्धके मुने जाताव् आनन्दसंदोहदायकौ मम बालकौ
verses.transliteration: mahatā daivayogena kathaṃcid vārdhake mune jātāv ānandasaṃdohadāyakau mama bālakau
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सशरीरम् इदं राज्यं दास्ये नैव सुताव् इमौ
verses.transliteration: saśarīram idaṃ rājyaṃ dāsye naiva sutāv imau
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठेन तदा प्रोक्तो राजा दशरथस् त्व् इति
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhena tadā prokto rājā daśarathas tv iti
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रघवः प्रार्थनाभङ्गं न राजन् क्वापि शिक्षिताः
verses.transliteration: raghavaḥ prārthanābhaṅgaṃ na rājan kvāpi śikṣitāḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रामं च लक्ष्मणं चैव कथंचिद् अवदन् नृपः
verses.transliteration: rāmaṃ ca lakṣmaṇaṃ caiva kathaṃcid avadan nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रस्य ब्रह्मर्षेः कुरुतां यज्ञरक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitrasya brahmarṣeḥ kurutāṃ yajñarakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वदन्न् इति सुतौ सोष्णं निश्वसन् ग्लपिताधरः पुत्रौ समर्पयाम् आस विश्वामित्रस्य शास्त्रकृत्
verses.transliteration: vadann iti sutau soṣṇaṃ niśvasan glapitādharaḥ putrau samarpayām āsa viśvāmitrasya śāstrakṛt
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा दशरथं नमस्य च पुनः पुनः जग्मतू रक्षणार्थाय विश्वामित्रेण तौ मुदा
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā daśarathaṃ namasya ca punaḥ punaḥ jagmatū rakṣaṇārthāya viśvāmitreṇa tau mudā
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रहृष्टः स मुनिर् मुदा प्रादात् तदोभयोः माहेश्वरीं महाविद्यां धनुर्विद्यापुरःसराम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ sa munir mudā prādāt tadobhayoḥ māheśvarīṃ mahāvidyāṃ dhanurvidyāpuraḥsarām
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शास्त्रीम् आस्त्रीं लौकिकीं च रथविद्यां गजोद्भवाम् अश्वविद्यां गदाविद्यां मन्त्राह्वानविसर्जने
verses.transliteration: śāstrīm āstrīṃ laukikīṃ ca rathavidyāṃ gajodbhavām aśvavidyāṃ gadāvidyāṃ mantrāhvānavisarjane
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वविद्याम् अथावाप्य उभौ तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ वनौकसां हितार्थाय जघ्नतुस् ताटकां वने
verses.transliteration: sarvavidyām athāvāpya ubhau tau rāmalakṣmaṇau vanaukasāṃ hitārthāya jaghnatus tāṭakāṃ vane
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहल्यां शापनिर्मुक्तां पादस्पर्शाच् च चक्रतुः यज्ञविध्वंसनायाताञ् जघ्नतुस् तत्र राक्षसान्
verses.transliteration: ahalyāṃ śāpanirmuktāṃ pādasparśāc ca cakratuḥ yajñavidhvaṃsanāyātāñ jaghnatus tatra rākṣasān
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृतविद्यौ धनुष्पाणी चक्रतुर् यज्ञरक्षणम् ततो महामखे वृत्ते विश्वामित्रो मुनीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kṛtavidyau dhanuṣpāṇī cakratur yajñarakṣaṇam tato mahāmakhe vṛtte viśvāmitro munīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्राभ्यां सहितो राज्ञो जनकं द्रष्टुम् अभ्यगात् चित्राम् अदर्शयत् तत्र राजमध्ये नृपात्मजः
verses.transliteration: putrābhyāṃ sahito rājño janakaṃ draṣṭum abhyagāt citrām adarśayat tatra rājamadhye nṛpātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रामः सौमित्रिसहितो धनुर्विद्यां गुरोर् मताम् तत्प्रीतो जनकः प्रादात् सीतां लक्ष्मीम् अयोनिजाम्
verses.transliteration: rāmaḥ saumitrisahito dhanurvidyāṃ guror matām tatprīto janakaḥ prādāt sītāṃ lakṣmīm ayonijām
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथैव लक्ष्मणस्यापि भरतस्यानुजस्य च शत्रुघ्नभरतादीनां वसिष्ठादिमते स्थितः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva lakṣmaṇasyāpi bharatasyānujasya ca śatrughnabharatādīnāṃ vasiṣṭhādimate sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राजा दशरथः श्रीमान् विवाहम् अकरोन् मुने ततो बहुतिथे काले राज्यं तस्य प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: rājā daśarathaḥ śrīmān vivāham akaron mune tato bahutithe kāle rājyaṃ tasya prayacchati
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नृपतौ सर्वलोकानाम् अनुमत्या गुरोर् अपि मन्थरात्मकदुर्दैवप्रेरिता मत्सराकुला
verses.transliteration: nṛpatau sarvalokānām anumatyā guror api mantharātmakadurdaivapreritā matsarākulā
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कैकेयी विघ्नम् आतस्थे वनप्रव्राजनं तथा भरतस्य च तद् राज्यं राजा नैव च दत्तवान्
verses.transliteration: kaikeyī vighnam ātasthe vanapravrājanaṃ tathā bharatasya ca tad rājyaṃ rājā naiva ca dattavān
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पितरं सत्यवाक्यं तं कुर्वन् रामो महावनम् विवेश सीतया सार्धं तथा सौमित्रिणा सह
verses.transliteration: pitaraṃ satyavākyaṃ taṃ kurvan rāmo mahāvanam viveśa sītayā sārdhaṃ tathā saumitriṇā saha
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सतां च मानसं शुद्धं स विवेश स्वकैर् गुणैः तस्मिन् विनिर्गते रामे वनवासाय दीक्षिते
verses.transliteration: satāṃ ca mānasaṃ śuddhaṃ sa viveśa svakair guṇaiḥ tasmin vinirgate rāme vanavāsāya dīkṣite
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: समं लक्ष्मणसीताभ्यां राज्यतृष्णाविवर्जिते तं रामं चापि सौमित्रिं सीतां च गुणशालिनीम्
verses.transliteration: samaṃ lakṣmaṇasītābhyāṃ rājyatṛṣṇāvivarjite taṃ rāmaṃ cāpi saumitriṃ sītāṃ ca guṇaśālinīm
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दुःखेन महताविष्टो ब्रह्मशापं च संस्मरन् तदा दशरथो राजा प्राणांस् तत्याज दुःखितः
verses.transliteration: duḥkhena mahatāviṣṭo brahmaśāpaṃ ca saṃsmaran tadā daśaratho rājā prāṇāṃs tatyāja duḥkhitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृतकर्मविपाकेन राजा नीतो यमानुगैः तस्मै राज्ञे महाप्राज्ञ यावत् स्थावरजङ्गमे
verses.transliteration: kṛtakarmavipākena rājā nīto yamānugaiḥ tasmai rājñe mahāprājña yāvat sthāvarajaṅgame
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यमसद्मन्य् अनेकानि तामिस्रादीनि नारद नरकाण्य् अथ घोराणि भीषणानि बहूनि च
verses.transliteration: yamasadmany anekāni tāmisrādīni nārada narakāṇy atha ghorāṇi bhīṣaṇāni bahūni ca
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र क्षिप्तस् तदा राजा नरकेषु पृथक् पृथक् पच्यते छिद्यते राजा पिष्यते चूर्ण्यते तथा
verses.transliteration: tatra kṣiptas tadā rājā narakeṣu pṛthak pṛthak pacyate chidyate rājā piṣyate cūrṇyate tathā
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शोष्यते दश्यते भूयो दह्यते च निमज्ज्यते एवमादिषु घोरेषु नरकेषु स पच्यते
verses.transliteration: śoṣyate daśyate bhūyo dahyate ca nimajjyate evamādiṣu ghoreṣu narakeṣu sa pacyate
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रामो ऽपि गच्छन्न् अध्वानं चित्रकूटम् अथागमत् तत्रैव त्रीणि वर्षाणि व्यतीतानि महामते
verses.transliteration: rāmo 'pi gacchann adhvānaṃ citrakūṭam athāgamat tatraiva trīṇi varṣāṇi vyatītāni mahāmate
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनः स दक्षिणाम् आशाम् आक्रामद् दण्डकं वनम् विख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु देशानां तद् धि पुण्यदम्
verses.transliteration: punaḥ sa dakṣiṇām āśām ākrāmad daṇḍakaṃ vanam vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu deśānāṃ tad dhi puṇyadam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्राविशत् तन् महारण्यं भीषणं दैत्यसेवितम् तद्भयाद् ऋषिभिस् त्यक्तं हत्वा दैत्यांस् तु राक्षसान्
verses.transliteration: prāviśat tan mahāraṇyaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ daityasevitam tadbhayād ṛṣibhis tyaktaṃ hatvā daityāṃs tu rākṣasān
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विचरन् दण्डकारण्ये ऋषिसेव्यम् अथाकरोत् तत्रेदं वृत्तम् आख्यास्ये शृणु नारद यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: vicaran daṇḍakāraṇye ṛṣisevyam athākarot tatredaṃ vṛttam ākhyāsye śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तावच् छनैस् त्व् अगाद् रामो यावद् योजनपञ्चकम् गौतमीं समनुप्राप्तो राजापि नरके स्थितः
verses.transliteration: tāvac chanais tv agād rāmo yāvad yojanapañcakam gautamīṃ samanuprāpto rājāpi narake sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यमः स्वकिंकरान् आह रामो दशरथात्मजः गौतमीम् अभितो याति पितरं तस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: yamaḥ svakiṃkarān āha rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ gautamīm abhito yāti pitaraṃ tasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आकर्षन्त्व् अथ राजानं नरकान् नात्र संशयः उत्तीर्य गौतमीं याति यावद् योजनपञ्चकम्
verses.transliteration: ākarṣantv atha rājānaṃ narakān nātra saṃśayaḥ uttīrya gautamīṃ yāti yāvad yojanapañcakam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रामस् तावत् तस्य पिता नरके नैव पच्यताम् यद् एतन् मद्वचः पुण्यं न कुर्युर् यदि दूतकाः
verses.transliteration: rāmas tāvat tasya pitā narake naiva pacyatām yad etan madvacaḥ puṇyaṃ na kuryur yadi dūtakāḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततश् च नरके घोरे यूयं सर्वे निमज्जथ या काप्य् उक्ता परा शक्तिः शिवस्य समवायिनी
verses.transliteration: tataś ca narake ghore yūyaṃ sarve nimajjatha yā kāpy uktā parā śaktiḥ śivasya samavāyinī
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताम् एव गौतमीं सन्तो वदन्त्य् अम्भःस्वरूपिणीम् हरिब्रह्ममहेशानां मान्या वन्द्या च सैव यत्
verses.transliteration: tām eva gautamīṃ santo vadanty ambhaḥsvarūpiṇīm haribrahmamaheśānāṃ mānyā vandyā ca saiva yat
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निस्तीर्यते न केनापि तद् अतिक्रमजं त्व् अघम् पापिनो ऽप्य् आत्मजः कश्चिद् यश् च गङ्गाम् अनुस्मरेत्
verses.transliteration: nistīryate na kenāpi tad atikramajaṃ tv agham pāpino 'py ātmajaḥ kaścid yaś ca gaṅgām anusmaret
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽनेकदुर्गनिरयान् निर्गतो मुक्ततां व्रजेत् किं पुनस् तादृशः पुत्रो गौतमीनिकटे स्थितः
verses.transliteration: so 'nekadurganirayān nirgato muktatāṃ vrajet kiṃ punas tādṛśaḥ putro gautamīnikaṭe sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्यासौ नरके पक्तुं न कैरपि हि शक्यते दक्षिणाशापतेर् वाक्यं निशम्य यमकिंकराः
verses.transliteration: yasyāsau narake paktuṃ na kairapi hi śakyate dakṣiṇāśāpater vākyaṃ niśamya yamakiṃkarāḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नरके पच्यमानं तम् अयोध्याधिपतिं नृपम् उत्तार्य घोरनरकाद् वचनं चेदम् अब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: narake pacyamānaṃ tam ayodhyādhipatiṃ nṛpam uttārya ghoranarakād vacanaṃ cedam abruvan
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धन्यो ऽसि नृपशार्दूल यस्य पुत्रः स तादृशः इह चामुत्र विश्रान्तिः सुपुत्रः केन लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: dhanyo 'si nṛpaśārdūla yasya putraḥ sa tādṛśaḥ iha cāmutra viśrāntiḥ suputraḥ kena labhyate
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स विश्रान्तः शनै राजा किंकरान् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sa viśrāntaḥ śanai rājā kiṃkarān vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
