verses.sanskrit: नरकेष्व् अथ घोरेषु पच्यमानः पुनः पुनः कथं त्व् आकर्षितः शीघ्रं तन् मे वक्तुम् इहार्हथ
verses.transliteration: narakeṣv atha ghoreṣu pacyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ kathaṃ tv ākarṣitaḥ śīghraṃ tan me vaktum ihārhatha
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र कश्चिच् छान्तमना राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tatra kaścic chāntamanā rājānam idam abravīt
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वेदशास्त्रपुराणादाव् एतद् गोप्यं प्रयत्नतः प्रकाश्यते तद् अपि ते सामर्थ्यं पुत्रतीर्थयोः
verses.transliteration: vedaśāstrapurāṇādāv etad gopyaṃ prayatnataḥ prakāśyate tad api te sāmarthyaṃ putratīrthayoḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रामस् तव सुतः श्रीमान् गौतमीतीरम् आगतः तस्मात् त्वं नरकाद् घोराद् आकृष्टो ऽसि नरोत्तम
verses.transliteration: rāmas tava sutaḥ śrīmān gautamītīram āgataḥ tasmāt tvaṃ narakād ghorād ākṛṣṭo 'si narottama
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यदि त्वां तत्र गौतम्यां स्मरेद् रामः सलक्ष्मणः स्नानं कृत्वाथ पिण्डादि ते दद्यात् स नृपोत्तम ततस् त्वं सर्वपापेभ्यो मुक्तो यासि त्रिविष्टपम्
verses.transliteration: yadi tvāṃ tatra gautamyāṃ smared rāmaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvātha piṇḍādi te dadyāt sa nṛpottama tatas tvaṃ sarvapāpebhyo mukto yāsi triviṣṭapam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा भवद्वाक्यम् आख्यास्ये स्वसुतौ प्रति भवन्त एव शरणम् अनुज्ञां दातुम् अर्हथ
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvā bhavadvākyam ākhyāsye svasutau prati bhavanta eva śaraṇam anujñāṃ dātum arhatha
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् राजवचनं श्रुत्वा कृपया यमकिंकराः आज्ञां च प्रददुस् तस्मै राजा प्रागात् सुतौ प्रति
verses.transliteration: tad rājavacanaṃ śrutvā kṛpayā yamakiṃkarāḥ ājñāṃ ca pradadus tasmai rājā prāgāt sutau prati
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भीषणं यातनादेहम् आपन्नो निःश्वसन् मुहुः निरीक्ष्य स्वं लज्जमानः कृतं कर्म च संस्मरन्
verses.transliteration: bhīṣaṇaṃ yātanādeham āpanno niḥśvasan muhuḥ nirīkṣya svaṃ lajjamānaḥ kṛtaṃ karma ca saṃsmaran
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वेच्छया विहरन् गङ्गाम् आससाद च राघवः गौतम्यास् तटम् आश्रित्य रामो लक्ष्मण एव च
verses.transliteration: svecchayā viharan gaṅgām āsasāda ca rāghavaḥ gautamyās taṭam āśritya rāmo lakṣmaṇa eva ca
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सीतया सह वैदेह्या सस्नौ चैव यथाविधि नैव तत्राभवद् भोज्यं भक्ष्यं वा गौतमीतटे
verses.transliteration: sītayā saha vaidehyā sasnau caiva yathāvidhi naiva tatrābhavad bhojyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ vā gautamītaṭe
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद्दिने तत्र वसतां गौतमीतीरवासिनाम् तद् दृष्ट्वा दुःखितो भ्राता लक्ष्मणो रामम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: taddine tatra vasatāṃ gautamītīravāsinām tad dṛṣṭvā duḥkhito bhrātā lakṣmaṇo rāmam abravīt
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रौ दशरथस्यावां तवापि बलम् ईदृशम् नास्ति भोज्यम् अथास्माकं गङ्गातीरनिवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration: putrau daśarathasyāvāṃ tavāpi balam īdṛśam nāsti bhojyam athāsmākaṃ gaṅgātīranivāsinām
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातर् यद् विहितं कर्म नैव तच् चान्यथा भवेत् पृथिव्याम् अन्नपूर्णायां वयम् अन्नाभिलाषिणः
verses.transliteration: bhrātar yad vihitaṃ karma naiva tac cānyathā bhavet pṛthivyām annapūrṇāyāṃ vayam annābhilāṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सौमित्रे नूनम् अस्माभिर् न ब्राह्मणमुखे हुतम् अवज्ञया महीदेवांस् तर्पयन्त्य् अर्चयन्ति न
verses.transliteration: saumitre nūnam asmābhir na brāhmaṇamukhe hutam avajñayā mahīdevāṃs tarpayanty arcayanti na
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ते ये लक्ष्मण जायन्ते सर्वदैव बुभुक्षिताः स्नात्वा देवान् अथाभ्यर्च्य होतव्यश् च हुताशनः ततः स्वसमये देवो विधास्यत्य् अशनं तु नौ
verses.transliteration: te ye lakṣmaṇa jāyante sarvadaiva bubhukṣitāḥ snātvā devān athābhyarcya hotavyaś ca hutāśanaḥ tataḥ svasamaye devo vidhāsyaty aśanaṃ tu nau
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भ्रात्रोः संजल्पतोर् एवं पश्यतोः कर्मणो गतिम् शनैर् दशरथो राजा तं देशम् उपजग्मिवान्
verses.transliteration: bhrātroḥ saṃjalpator evaṃ paśyatoḥ karmaṇo gatim śanair daśaratho rājā taṃ deśam upajagmivān
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणः शीघ्रं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् धनुर् आकृष्य कोपेन रक्षस् त्वं दानवो ऽथवा
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaḥ śīghraṃ tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt dhanur ākṛṣya kopena rakṣas tvaṃ dānavo 'thavā
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आसन्नं च पुनर् दृष्ट्वा याहि याह्य् अत्र पुण्यभाक् रामो दाशरथी राजा धर्मभाक् पश्य वर्तते
verses.transliteration: āsannaṃ ca punar dṛṣṭvā yāhi yāhy atra puṇyabhāk rāmo dāśarathī rājā dharmabhāk paśya vartate
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गुरुभक्तः सत्यसंधो देवब्राह्मणसेवकः त्रैलोक्यरक्षादक्षो ऽसौ वर्तते यत्र राघवः
verses.transliteration: gurubhaktaḥ satyasaṃdho devabrāhmaṇasevakaḥ trailokyarakṣādakṣo 'sau vartate yatra rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र त्वादृशाम् अस्ति प्रवेशः पापकर्मणाम् यदि प्रविशसे पाप ततो वधम् अवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: na tatra tvādṛśām asti praveśaḥ pāpakarmaṇām yadi praviśase pāpa tato vadham avāpsyasi
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत् पुत्रवचनं श्रुत्वा शनैर् आहूय वाचया उवाचाधोमुखो भूत्वा स्नुषां पुत्रौ कृताञ्जलिः मुहुर् अन्तर् विनिध्यायन् गतिं दुष्कृतकर्मणः
verses.transliteration: tat putravacanaṃ śrutvā śanair āhūya vācayā uvācādhomukho bhūtvā snuṣāṃ putrau kṛtāñjaliḥ muhur antar vinidhyāyan gatiṃ duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहं दशरथो राजा पुत्रौ मे शृणुतं वचः तिसृभिर् ब्रह्महत्याभिर् वृतो ऽहं दुःखम् आगतः छिन्नं पश्यत मे देहं नरकेषु च पातितम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ daśaratho rājā putrau me śṛṇutaṃ vacaḥ tisṛbhir brahmahatyābhir vṛto 'haṃ duḥkham āgataḥ chinnaṃ paśyata me dehaṃ narakeṣu ca pātitam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः कृताञ्जली रामः सीतया लक्ष्मणेन च भूमौ प्रणेमुस् ते सर्वे वचनं चैतद् अब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kṛtāñjalī rāmaḥ sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca bhūmau praṇemus te sarve vacanaṃ caitad abruvan
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कस्येदं कर्मणस् तात फलं नृपतिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: kasyedaṃ karmaṇas tāta phalaṃ nṛpatisattama
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स च प्राह यथावृत्तं ब्रह्महत्यात्रयं तथा
verses.transliteration: sa ca prāha yathāvṛttaṃ brahmahatyātrayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निष्कृतिर् ब्रह्महन्तॄणां पुत्रौ क्वापि न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: niṣkṛtir brahmahantṝṇāṃ putrau kvāpi na vidyate
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो दुःखेन महतावृताः सर्वे भुवं गताः राजानं वनवासं च मातरं पितरं तथा
verses.transliteration: tato duḥkhena mahatāvṛtāḥ sarve bhuvaṃ gatāḥ rājānaṃ vanavāsaṃ ca mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दुःखागमं कर्मगतिं नरके पातनं तथा एवमाद्य् अथ संस्मृत्य मुमोह नृपतेः सुतः विसंज्ञं नृपतिं दृष्ट्वा सीता वाक्यम् अथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: duḥkhāgamaṃ karmagatiṃ narake pātanaṃ tathā evamādy atha saṃsmṛtya mumoha nṛpateḥ sutaḥ visaṃjñaṃ nṛpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā sītā vākyam athābravīt
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न शोचन्ति महात्मानस् त्वादृशा व्यसनागमे चिन्तयन्ति प्रतीकारं दैव्यम् अप्य् अथ मानुषम्
verses.transliteration: na śocanti mahātmānas tvādṛśā vyasanāgame cintayanti pratīkāraṃ daivyam apy atha mānuṣam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शोचद्भिर् युगसाहस्रं विपत्तिर् नैव तीर्यते व्यामोहम् आप्नुवन्तीह न कदाचिद् विचक्षणाः
verses.transliteration: śocadbhir yugasāhasraṃ vipattir naiva tīryate vyāmoham āpnuvantīha na kadācid vicakṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किम् अनेनात्र दुःखेन निष्फलेन जनेश्वर देहि हत्यां प्रथमतो या जाता ह्य् अतिभीषणा
verses.transliteration: kim anenātra duḥkhena niṣphalena janeśvara dehi hatyāṃ prathamato yā jātā hy atibhīṣaṇā
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पितृभक्तः पुण्यशीलो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः अनागा यो हतो विप्रस् तत्पापस्यात्र निष्कृतिम्
verses.transliteration: pitṛbhaktaḥ puṇyaśīlo vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ anāgā yo hato vipras tatpāpasyātra niṣkṛtim
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आचरामि यथाशास्त्रं मा शोकं कुरुतं युवाम् द्वितीयां लक्ष्मणो हत्यां गृह्णातु त्व् अपरां भवान्
verses.transliteration: ācarāmi yathāśāstraṃ mā śokaṃ kurutaṃ yuvām dvitīyāṃ lakṣmaṇo hatyāṃ gṛhṇātu tv aparāṃ bhavān
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतद् धर्मयुतं वाक्यं सीतया भाषितं दृढम् तथेति चाहतुर् उभौ ततो दशरथो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: etad dharmayutaṃ vākyaṃ sītayā bhāṣitaṃ dṛḍham tatheti cāhatur ubhau tato daśaratho 'bravīt
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि ब्रह्मविदः कन्या जनकस्य त्व् अयोनिजा भार्या रामस्य किं चित्रं यद् युक्तम् अनुभाषसे
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi brahmavidaḥ kanyā janakasya tv ayonijā bhāryā rāmasya kiṃ citraṃ yad yuktam anubhāṣase
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न कोपि भवतां किंतु श्रमः स्वल्पो ऽपि विद्यते गौतम्यां स्नानदानेन पिण्डनिर्वपणेन च
verses.transliteration: na kopi bhavatāṃ kiṃtu śramaḥ svalpo 'pi vidyate gautamyāṃ snānadānena piṇḍanirvapaṇena ca
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तिसृभिर् ब्रह्महत्याभिर् मुक्तो यामि त्रिविष्टपम् त्वया जनकसंभूते स्वकुलोचितम् ईरितम्
verses.transliteration: tisṛbhir brahmahatyābhir mukto yāmi triviṣṭapam tvayā janakasaṃbhūte svakulocitam īritam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रापयन्ति परं पारं भवाब्धेः कुलयोषितः गोदावर्याः प्रसादेन किं नामास्त्य् अत्र दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: prāpayanti paraṃ pāraṃ bhavābdheḥ kulayoṣitaḥ godāvaryāḥ prasādena kiṃ nāmāsty atra durlabham
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेति क्रियमाणे तु पिण्डदानाय शत्रुहा नैवापश्यद् भक्ष्यभोज्यं ततो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tatheti kriyamāṇe tu piṇḍadānāya śatruhā naivāpaśyad bhakṣyabhojyaṃ tato lakṣmaṇam abravīt
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मणः प्राह विनयाद् इङ्गुद्याश् च फलानि च सन्ति तेषां च पिण्याकम् आनीतं तत्क्षणाद् इव
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇaḥ prāha vinayād iṅgudyāś ca phalāni ca santi teṣāṃ ca piṇyākam ānītaṃ tatkṣaṇād iva
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पिण्याकेनाथ गङ्गायां पिण्डं दातुं तथा पितुः मनः कुर्वंस् ततो रामो मन्दो ऽभूद् दुःखितस् तदा
verses.transliteration: piṇyākenātha gaṅgāyāṃ piṇḍaṃ dātuṃ tathā pituḥ manaḥ kurvaṃs tato rāmo mando 'bhūd duḥkhitas tadā
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दैवी वाग् अभवत् तत्र दुःखं त्यज नृपात्मज राज्यभ्रष्टो वनं प्राप्तः किं वै निष्किंचनो भवान्
verses.transliteration: daivī vāg abhavat tatra duḥkhaṃ tyaja nṛpātmaja rājyabhraṣṭo vanaṃ prāptaḥ kiṃ vai niṣkiṃcano bhavān
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अशठो धर्मनिरतो न शोचितुम् इहार्हसि वित्तशाठ्येन यो धर्मं करोति स तु पातकी
verses.transliteration: aśaṭho dharmanirato na śocitum ihārhasi vittaśāṭhyena yo dharmaṃ karoti sa tu pātakī
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयते सर्वशास्त्रेषु यद् राम शृणु यत्नतः यदन्नः पुरुषो राजंस् तदन्नास् तस्य देवताः
verses.transliteration: śrūyate sarvaśāstreṣu yad rāma śṛṇu yatnataḥ yadannaḥ puruṣo rājaṃs tadannās tasya devatāḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डे निपतिते भूमौ नापश्यत् पितरं तदा शवं च पतितं यत्र शवतीर्थम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: piṇḍe nipatite bhūmau nāpaśyat pitaraṃ tadā śavaṃ ca patitaṃ yatra śavatīrtham anuttamam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महापातकसंघातविघातकृद् अनुस्मृतिः तत्रागच्छंल् लोकपाला रुद्रादित्यास् तथाश्विनौ
verses.transliteration: mahāpātakasaṃghātavighātakṛd anusmṛtiḥ tatrāgacchaṃl lokapālā rudrādityās tathāśvinau
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वं स्वं विमानम् आरूढास् तेषां मध्ये ऽतिदीप्तिमान् विमानवरम् आरूढः स्तूयमानश् च किंनरैः
verses.transliteration: svaṃ svaṃ vimānam ārūḍhās teṣāṃ madhye 'tidīptimān vimānavaram ārūḍhaḥ stūyamānaś ca kiṃnaraiḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यसदृशाकारस् तेषां मध्ये बभौ पिता तम् अदृष्ट्वा स्वपितरं देवान् दृष्ट्वा विमानिनः
verses.transliteration: ādityasadṛśākāras teṣāṃ madhye babhau pitā tam adṛṣṭvā svapitaraṃ devān dṛṣṭvā vimāninaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिपुटो रामः पिता मे क्वेत्य् अभाषत इति दिव्याभवद् वाणी रामं संबोध्य सीतया
verses.transliteration: kṛtāñjalipuṭo rāmaḥ pitā me kvety abhāṣata iti divyābhavad vāṇī rāmaṃ saṃbodhya sītayā
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तिसृभिर् ब्रह्महत्याभिर् मुक्तो दशरथो नृपः वृतं पश्य सुरैस् तात देवा अप्य् ऊचिरे च तम्
verses.transliteration: tisṛbhir brahmahatyābhir mukto daśaratho nṛpaḥ vṛtaṃ paśya surais tāta devā apy ūcire ca tam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धन्यो ऽसि कृतकृत्यो ऽसि राम स्वर्गं गतः पिता नानानिरयसंघातात् पूर्वजान् उद्धरेत् तु यः
verses.transliteration: dhanyo 'si kṛtakṛtyo 'si rāma svargaṃ gataḥ pitā nānānirayasaṃghātāt pūrvajān uddharet tu yaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स धन्यो ऽलंकृतं तेन कृतिना भुवनत्रयम् एनं पश्य महाबाहो मुक्तपापं रविप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: sa dhanyo 'laṃkṛtaṃ tena kṛtinā bhuvanatrayam enaṃ paśya mahābāho muktapāpaṃ raviprabham
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसंपत्तियुक्तो ऽपि पापी दग्धद्रुमोपमः निष्किंचनो ऽपि सुकृती दृश्यते चन्द्रमौलिवत्
verses.transliteration: sarvasaṃpattiyukto 'pi pāpī dagdhadrumopamaḥ niṣkiṃcano 'pi sukṛtī dṛśyate candramaulivat
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वाब्रवीत् सुतं राजा आशीर्भिर् अभिनन्द्य च
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvābravīt sutaṃ rājā āśīrbhir abhinandya ca
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृतकृत्यो ऽसि भद्रं ते तारितो ऽहं त्वयानघ धन्यः स पुत्रो लोके ऽस्मिन् पितॄणां यस् तु तारकः
verses.transliteration: kṛtakṛtyo 'si bhadraṃ te tārito 'haṃ tvayānagha dhanyaḥ sa putro loke 'smin pitṝṇāṃ yas tu tārakaḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरगणाः प्रोचुर् देवानां कार्यसिद्धये रामं च पुरुषश्रेष्ठं गच्छ तात यथासुखम् ततस् तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रामस् तान् अब्रवीत् सुरान्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ suragaṇāḥ procur devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye rāmaṃ ca puruṣaśreṣṭhaṃ gaccha tāta yathāsukham tatas tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāmas tān abravīt surān
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गुरौ पितरि मे देवाः किं कृत्यम् अवशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: gurau pitari me devāḥ kiṃ kṛtyam avaśiṣyate
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नदी न गङ्गया तुल्या न त्वया सदृशः सुतः न शिवेन समो देवो न तारेण समो मनुः
verses.transliteration: nadī na gaṅgayā tulyā na tvayā sadṛśaḥ sutaḥ na śivena samo devo na tāreṇa samo manuḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वया राम गुरूणां च कार्यं सर्वम् अनुष्ठितम् तारिताः पितरो राम त्वया पुत्रेण मानद गच्छन्तु सर्वे स्वस्थानं त्वं च गच्छ यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: tvayā rāma gurūṇāṃ ca kāryaṃ sarvam anuṣṭhitam tāritāḥ pitaro rāma tvayā putreṇa mānada gacchantu sarve svasthānaṃ tvaṃ ca gaccha yathāsukham
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् देववचनाद् धृष्टः सीतया लक्ष्मणाग्रजः तद् दृष्ट्वा गङ्गामाहात्म्यं विस्मितो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tad devavacanād dhṛṣṭaḥ sītayā lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ tad dṛṣṭvā gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ vismito vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहो गङ्गाप्रभावो ऽयं त्रैलोक्ये नोपमीयते वयं धन्या यतो गङ्गा दृष्टास्माभिस् त्रिपावनी
verses.transliteration: aho gaṅgāprabhāvo 'yaṃ trailokye nopamīyate vayaṃ dhanyā yato gaṅgā dṛṣṭāsmābhis tripāvanī
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हर्षेण महता युक्तो देवं स्थाप्य महेश्वरम् तं षोडशभिर् ईशानम् उपचारैः प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: harṣeṇa mahatā yukto devaṃ sthāpya maheśvaram taṃ ṣoḍaśabhir īśānam upacāraiḥ prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संपूज्यावरणैर् युक्तं षट्त्रिंशत्कलम् ईश्वरम् कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा रामस् तुष्टाव शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: saṃpūjyāvaraṇair yuktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatkalam īśvaram kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā rāmas tuṣṭāva śaṃkaram
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमामि शंभुं पुरुषं पुराणं नमामि सर्वज्ञम् अपारभावम् नमामि रुद्रं प्रभुम् अक्षयं तं नमामि शर्वं शिरसा नमामि
verses.transliteration: namāmi śaṃbhuṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ namāmi sarvajñam apārabhāvam namāmi rudraṃ prabhum akṣayaṃ taṃ namāmi śarvaṃ śirasā namāmi
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमामि देवं परम् अव्ययं तम् उमापतिं लोकगुरुं नमामि नमामि दारिद्र्यविदारणं तं नमामि रोगापहरं नमामि
verses.transliteration: namāmi devaṃ param avyayaṃ tam umāpatiṃ lokaguruṃ namāmi namāmi dāridryavidāraṇaṃ taṃ namāmi rogāpaharaṃ namāmi
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमामि कल्याणम् अचिन्त्यरूपं नमामि विश्वोद्भवबीजरूपम् नमामि विश्वस्थितिकारणं तं नमामि संहारकरं नमामि
verses.transliteration: namāmi kalyāṇam acintyarūpaṃ namāmi viśvodbhavabījarūpam namāmi viśvasthitikāraṇaṃ taṃ namāmi saṃhārakaraṃ namāmi
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमामि गौरीप्रियम् अव्ययं तं नमामि नित्यं क्षरम् अक्षरं तम् नमामि चिद्रूपम् अमेयभावं त्रिलोचनं तं शिरसा नमामि
verses.transliteration: namāmi gaurīpriyam avyayaṃ taṃ namāmi nityaṃ kṣaram akṣaraṃ tam namāmi cidrūpam ameyabhāvaṃ trilocanaṃ taṃ śirasā namāmi
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमामि कारुण्यकरं भवस्य भयंकरं वापि सदा नमामि नमामि दातारम् अभीप्सितानां नमामि सोमेशम् उमेशम् आदौ
verses.transliteration: namāmi kāruṇyakaraṃ bhavasya bhayaṃkaraṃ vāpi sadā namāmi namāmi dātāram abhīpsitānāṃ namāmi someśam umeśam ādau
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमामि वेदत्रयलोचनं तं नमामि मूर्तित्रयवर्जितं तम् नमामि पुण्यं सदसद्व्यतीतं नमामि तं पापहरं नमामि
verses.transliteration: namāmi vedatrayalocanaṃ taṃ namāmi mūrtitrayavarjitaṃ tam namāmi puṇyaṃ sadasadvyatītaṃ namāmi taṃ pāpaharaṃ namāmi
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमामि विश्वस्य हिते रतं तं नमामि रूपाणि बहूनि धत्ते यो विश्वगोप्ता सदसत्प्रणेता नमामि तं विश्वपतिं नमामि
verses.transliteration: namāmi viśvasya hite rataṃ taṃ namāmi rūpāṇi bahūni dhatte yo viśvagoptā sadasatpraṇetā namāmi taṃ viśvapatiṃ namāmi
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञेश्वरं संप्रति हव्यकव्यं तथा गतिं लोकसदाशिवो यः आराधितो यश् च ददाति सर्वं नमामि दानप्रियम् इष्टदेवम्
verses.transliteration: yajñeśvaraṃ saṃprati havyakavyaṃ tathā gatiṃ lokasadāśivo yaḥ ārādhito yaś ca dadāti sarvaṃ namāmi dānapriyam iṣṭadevam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमामि सोमेश्वरम् अस्वतन्त्रम् उमापतिं तं विजयं नमामि नमामि विघ्नेश्वरनन्दिनाथं पुत्रप्रियं तं शिरसा नमामि
verses.transliteration: namāmi someśvaram asvatantram umāpatiṃ taṃ vijayaṃ namāmi namāmi vighneśvaranandināthaṃ putrapriyaṃ taṃ śirasā namāmi
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमामि देवं भवदुःखशोक विनाशनं चन्द्रधरं नमामि नमामि गङ्गाधरम् ईशम् ईड्यम् उमाधवं देववरं नमामि
verses.transliteration: namāmi devaṃ bhavaduḥkhaśoka vināśanaṃ candradharaṃ namāmi namāmi gaṅgādharam īśam īḍyam umādhavaṃ devavaraṃ namāmi
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमाम्य् अजादीशपुरंदरादि सुरासुरैर् अर्चितपादपद्मम् नमामि देवीमुखवादनानाम् ईक्षार्थम् अक्षित्रितयं य ऐच्छत्
verses.transliteration: namāmy ajādīśapuraṃdarādi surāsurair arcitapādapadmam namāmi devīmukhavādanānām īkṣārtham akṣitritayaṃ ya aicchat
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चामृतैर् गन्धसुधूपदीपैर् विचित्रपुष्पैर् विविधैश् च मन्त्रैः अन्नप्रकारैः सकलोपचारैः संपूजितं सोमम् अहं नमामि
verses.transliteration: pañcāmṛtair gandhasudhūpadīpair vicitrapuṣpair vividhaiś ca mantraiḥ annaprakāraiḥ sakalopacāraiḥ saṃpūjitaṃ somam ahaṃ namāmi
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवान् आह रामं शंभुः सलक्ष्मणम् वरान् वृणीष्व भद्रं ते रामः प्राह वृषध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhagavān āha rāmaṃ śaṃbhuḥ salakṣmaṇam varān vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te rāmaḥ prāha vṛṣadhvajam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रेणानेन ये भक्त्या तोष्यन्ति त्वां सुरोत्तम तेषां सर्वाणि कार्याणि सिद्धिं यान्तु महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: stotreṇānena ye bhaktyā toṣyanti tvāṃ surottama teṣāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi siddhiṃ yāntu maheśvara
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: येषां च पितरः शंभो पतिता नरकार्णवे तेषां पिण्डादिदानेन पूता यान्तु त्रिविष्टपम्
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ ca pitaraḥ śaṃbho patitā narakārṇave teṣāṃ piṇḍādidānena pūtā yāntu triviṣṭapam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जन्मप्रभृति पापानि मनोवाक्कायिकं त्व् अघम् अत्र तु स्नानमात्रेण तत् सद्यो नाशम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: janmaprabhṛti pāpāni manovākkāyikaṃ tv agham atra tu snānamātreṇa tat sadyo nāśam āpnuyāt
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अत्र ये भक्तितः शंभो ददत्य् अर्थिभ्य अण्व् अपि सर्वं तद् अक्षयं शंभो दातॄणां फलकृद् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: atra ye bhaktitaḥ śaṃbho dadaty arthibhya aṇv api sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ śaṃbho dātṝṇāṃ phalakṛd bhavet
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् अस्त्व् इति तं रामं शंकरो हृषितो ऽब्रवीत् गते तस्मिन् सुरश्रेष्ठे रामो ऽप्य् अनुचरैः सह
verses.transliteration: evam astv iti taṃ rāmaṃ śaṃkaro hṛṣito 'bravīt gate tasmin suraśreṣṭhe rāmo 'py anucaraiḥ saha
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतमी यत्र चोत्पन्ना शनैस् तं देशम् अभ्यगात् ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं रामतीर्थम् उदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: gautamī yatra cotpannā śanais taṃ deśam abhyagāt tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ rāmatīrtham udāhṛtam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दयालोर् अपतत् तत्र लक्ष्मणस्य कराच् छरः तद् बाणतीर्थम् अभवत् सर्वापद्विनिवारणम्
verses.transliteration: dayālor apatat tatra lakṣmaṇasya karāc charaḥ tad bāṇatīrtham abhavat sarvāpadvinivāraṇam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र सौमित्रिणा स्नानं शंकरस्यार्चनं कृतम् तत् तीर्थं लक्ष्मणं जातं तथा सीतासमुद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: yatra saumitriṇā snānaṃ śaṃkarasyārcanaṃ kṛtam tat tīrthaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ jātaṃ tathā sītāsamudbhavam
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नानाविधाशेषपापसंघनिर्मूलनक्षमम् यद् अङ्घ्रिसंगाद् अभवद् गङ्गा त्रैलोक्यपावनी
verses.transliteration: nānāvidhāśeṣapāpasaṃghanirmūlanakṣamam yad aṅghrisaṃgād abhavad gaṅgā trailokyapāvanī
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स यत्र स्नानम् अकरोत् तद् वैशिष्ट्यं किम् उच्यते तद् रामतीर्थसदृशं तीर्थं क्वापि न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: sa yatra snānam akarot tad vaiśiṣṭyaṃ kim ucyate tad rāmatīrthasadṛśaṃ tīrthaṃ kvāpi na vidyate
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं पुण्यतीर्थं तद् उच्यते सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नोति यन्महिम्नः श्रुतेर् अपि
verses.transliteration: putratīrtham iti khyātaṃ puṇyatīrthaṃ tad ucyate sarvān kāmān avāpnoti yanmahimnaḥ śruter api
verses.translation: From you, O great sage, we wish process of annihilation at the end of a pralaya.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य स्वरूपं वक्ष्यामि शृणु यत्नेन नारद दितेः पुत्राश् च दनुजाः परिक्षीणा यदाभवन् अदितेस् तु सुता ज्येष्ठाः सर्वभावेन नारद
verses.transliteration: tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu yatnena nārada diteḥ putrāś ca danujāḥ parikṣīṇā yadābhavan adites tu sutā jyeṣṭhāḥ sarvabhāvena nārada
verses.translation: Let it be heard precisely, O excellent sages, how the process of annihilation takes place at the end of a Kaloa as well as at the time of Prakrta Pralaya.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदा दितिः पुत्रवियोगदुःखात् संस्पर्धमाना दनुम् आजगाम
verses.transliteration: tadā ditiḥ putraviyogaduḥkhāt saṃspardhamānā danum ājagāma
verses.translation: Ki ta, Treta, Dvapara and Kali constitute a set of four Yugas containing twelve thousand Divine years.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्षीणाः सुता आवयोर् एव भद्रे किं कुर्महे कर्म लोके गरीयः पश्यादितेर् वंशम् अभिन्नम् उत्तमं सौराज्ययुक्तं यशसा जयश्रिया
verses.transliteration: kṣīṇāḥ sutā āvayor eva bhadre kiṃ kurmahe karma loke garīyaḥ paśyāditer vaṃśam abhinnam uttamaṃ saurājyayuktaṃ yaśasā jayaśriyā
verses.translation: The four Yugas are similar in form. K r ta is the Yua first. O sages, Kaliyuga is the last.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जितारिम् अभ्युन्नतकीर्तिधर्मं मच्चित्तसंहर्षविनाशदक्षम् समानभर्तृत्वसमानधर्मे समानगोत्रे ऽपि समानरूपे
verses.transliteration: jitārim abhyunnatakīrtidharmaṃ maccittasaṃharṣavināśadakṣam samānabhartṛtvasamānadharme samānagotre 'pi samānarūpe
verses.translation: O holy Sir, it beloves you to describe in detail the nature of Kaliyuga when the four-footed sacred Dharma undergoes deficiency.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न जीवयेयं श्रियम् उन्नतिं च जीर्णास्मि दृष्ट्वा त्व् अदितिप्रसूतान् काम् अप्य् अवस्थाम् अनुयामि दुःस्था ऽदितेर् विलोक्याथ परां समृद्धिम्
verses.transliteration: na jīvayeyaṃ śriyam unnatiṃ ca jīrṇāsmi dṛṣṭvā tv aditiprasūtān kām apy avasthām anuyāmi duḥsthā 'diter vilokyātha parāṃ samṛddhim
verses.translation: Understand the form of Kali, O sinless brahmins, about
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवाणाम् अतिदीनवक्त्रां विनिश्वसन्तीं परमेष्ठिपुत्रः कृताभिपूजो विगतश्रमस् तां स सान्त्वयन्न् आह मनोभिरामाम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bruvāṇām atidīnavaktrāṃ viniśvasantīṃ parameṣṭhiputraḥ kṛtābhipūjo vigataśramas tāṃ sa sāntvayann āha manobhirāmām
verses.translation: In the age of Kali the actions of men are not based on the conduct prescribed for Varnas and Asramas. Nor do they follow the specific injunctions of the Sama, Rk and Yajus Vedas as their guide.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: खेदो न कार्यः समभीप्सितं यत् तत् प्राप्यते पुण्यत एव भद्रे तत्साधनं वेत्ति महानुभावः प्रजापतिस् ते स तु वक्ष्यतीति
verses.transliteration: khedo na kāryaḥ samabhīpsitaṃ yat tat prāpyate puṇyata eva bhadre tatsādhanaṃ vetti mahānubhāvaḥ prajāpatis te sa tu vakṣyatīti
verses.translation: In Kaliyuga the strongest man, whoever he may be and in whichever family he is born, becomes the lord of all. Man maintains himself through girls taken from all the castes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: साध्व्य् एतत् सर्वभावेन प्रश्रयावनता सती
verses.transliteration: sādhvy etat sarvabhāvena praśrayāvanatā satī
verses.translation: Fast, exertion and charity constitute pious activities in Kali age and rites are performed as one pleases.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवाणां च दितिं दनुः प्रोवाच नारद
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bruvāṇāṃ ca ditiṃ danuḥ provāca nārada
verses.translation: In Kali age men become haughty and arrogant even with a little wealth. Pride of beauty in women will be on the basis of their tresses of hair.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भर्तारं कश्यपं भद्रे तोषयस्व निजैर् गुणैः तुष्टो यदि भवेद् भर्ता ततः कामान् अवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: bhartāraṃ kaśyapaṃ bhadre toṣayasva nijair guṇaiḥ tuṣṭo yadi bhaved bhartā tataḥ kāmān avāpsyasi
verses.translation: As gold, jewels, diamonds as well as garments dwindle in the Kali age, women will be embellished by their tresses.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सर्वभावैस् तोषयाम् आस कश्यपम् दितिं प्रोवाच भगवान् कश्यपो ऽथ प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā sarvabhāvais toṣayām āsa kaśyapam ditiṃ provāca bhagavān kaśyapo 'tha prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Women will forsake their husbands having no wealth. In Kali age it is the moneyed man who becomes the lord of damsels.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं ददामि वदाभीष्टं दिते वरय सुव्रते
verses.transliteration: kiṃ dadāmi vadābhīṣṭaṃ dite varaya suvrate
verses.translation: Women in Kali age will be harlots desirous of luxury. They covet men who have earned much by illegal means.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दितिर् अप्य् आह भर्तारं पुत्रं बहुगुणान्वितम् जेतारं सर्वलोकानां सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: ditir apy āha bhartāraṃ putraṃ bahuguṇānvitam jetāraṃ sarvalokānāṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam
verses.translation: At that time, O brahmins, no man will brook a loss to his vested interest even to the extent of a fourth of a Pana (the smallest coin) even when he is entreated by his own friend.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: येन जातेन लोके ऽस्मिन् भवेयं वीरपुत्रिणी तं वरेयं सुरपितर् इत्य् आह विनयान्विता
verses.transliteration: yena jātena loke 'smin bhaveyaṃ vīraputriṇī taṃ vareyaṃ surapitar ity āha vinayānvitā
verses.translation: O brahmins, in the Kali age, the mind will always be manly and courageous. Cows will be solemnly honoured as long as they yield milk.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपदेक्ष्ये व्रतं श्रेष्ठं द्वादशाब्दफलप्रदम् तत आगत्य ते गर्भम् आधास्ये यन् मनोगतम् निष्पापतायां जातायां सिध्यन्ति हि मनोरथाः
verses.transliteration: upadekṣye vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dvādaśābdaphalapradam tata āgatya te garbham ādhāsye yan manogatam niṣpāpatāyāṃ jātāyāṃ sidhyanti hi manorathāḥ
verses.translation: Fearing a drought the subjects will be afraid of hunger. They will then have their eyes riveted to the sky.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भर्तृवाक्याद् दितिः प्रीता तं नमस्यायतेक्षणा उपदिष्टं व्रतं चक्रे भर्त्रादिष्टं यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: bhartṛvākyād ditiḥ prītā taṃ namasyāyatekṣaṇā upadiṣṭaṃ vrataṃ cakre bhartrādiṣṭaṃ yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Like the sages of yore men will have roots, leaves and fruits for their food. They will think of killing themselves in their misery due to the absence of rain.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थसेवापात्रदानव्रतचर्यादिवर्जिताः कथम् आसादयिष्यन्ति प्राणिनो ऽत्र मनोरथान्
verses.transliteration: tīrthasevāpātradānavratacaryādivarjitāḥ katham āsādayiṣyanti prāṇino 'tra manorathān
verses.translation: They will have perpetual famine and pain. They will be incapable of mastering things. By virtue of their lapses their happiness will be spoiled.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततश् चीर्णे व्रते तस्यां दित्यां गर्भम् अधारयत् पुनः कान्ताम् अथोवाच कश्यपस् तां दितिं रहः
verses.transliteration: tataś cīrṇe vrate tasyāṃ dityāṃ garbham adhārayat punaḥ kāntām athovāca kaśyapas tāṃ ditiṃ rahaḥ
verses.translation: In Kali age women will be greedy and lecherous. Thev will have puny bodies but they will be gluttonous. They will have little good fortune but plenty of offsprings
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न प्राप्नुवन्ति यत्कामान् मुनयो ऽपि तपस्स्थिताः यथाविहितकर्माङ्गअवज्ञया तच् छुचिस्मिते
verses.transliteration: na prāpnuvanti yatkāmān munayo 'pi tapassthitāḥ yathāvihitakarmāṅgaavajñayā tac chucismite
verses.translation: Women will be furious. They will be more ' interested m sustaining themselves; they will be wanting in the puritv of bodies. They will habitually speak harsh and untruthful words
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निन्दितं च न कर्तव्यं संध्ययोर् उभयोर् अपि न स्वप्तव्यं न गन्तव्यं मुक्तकेशी च नो भव
verses.transliteration: ninditaṃ ca na kartavyaṃ saṃdhyayor ubhayor api na svaptavyaṃ na gantavyaṃ muktakeśī ca no bhava
verses.translation: Even the women of noble families will be ill-behaved. They will yearn for men of bad conduct. They will be unchaste and disloyal to their husbands.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भोक्तव्यं सुभगे नैव क्षुतं वा जृम्भणं तथा संध्याकाले न कर्तव्यं भूतसंघसमाकुले
verses.transliteration: bhoktavyaṃ subhage naiva kṣutaṃ vā jṛmbhaṇaṃ tathā saṃdhyākāle na kartavyaṃ bhūtasaṃghasamākule
verses.translation: Men of no holy rites will study the Vedas. Householders will not perform homas nor will they give appropriate things in charity.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सान्तर्धानं सदा कार्यं हसितं तु विशेषतः गृहान्तदेशे संध्यासु न स्थातव्यं कदाचन
verses.transliteration: sāntardhānaṃ sadā kāryaṃ hasitaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ gṛhāntadeśe saṃdhyāsu na sthātavyaṃ kadācana
verses.translation: Foi est-dwellers will take to the diet pertaining to.the villagers. Mendicants will be influenced by filial affection and other contacts towards sons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मुशलोलूखलादीनि शूर्पपीठपिधानकम् नैवातिक्रमणीयानि दिवा रात्रौ सदा प्रिये
verses.transliteration: muśalolūkhalādīni śūrpapīṭhapidhānakam naivātikramaṇīyāni divā rātrau sadā priye
verses.translation: At the advent of Kali age kings will no longer protect their subjects. They will take the wealth of common man under the pretext of taxes and fees.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उदक्शीर्षं तु शयनं न संध्यासु विशेषतः वक्तव्यं नानृतं किंचिन् नान्यगेहाटनं तथा
verses.transliteration: udakśīrṣaṃ tu śayanaṃ na saṃdhyāsu viśeṣataḥ vaktavyaṃ nānṛtaṃ kiṃcin nānyagehāṭanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Whoever happens to possess horses, chariots and ele¬ phants will become the king. In the Kali age, those who happen to be weak will be servants.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कान्ताद् अन्यो न वीक्ष्यस् तु प्रयत्नेन नरः क्वचित् इत्यादिनियमैर् युक्ता यदि त्वम् अनुवर्तसे ततस् ते भविता पुत्रस् त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यभाजनम्
verses.transliteration: kāntād anyo na vīkṣyas tu prayatnena naraḥ kvacit ityādiniyamair yuktā yadi tvam anuvartase tatas te bhavitā putras trailokyaiśvaryabhājanam
verses.translation: Harassed by the burden of taxes and famine, people w'll become miserable. They will migrate to those lands where wheat and barley abound.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेति प्रतिजज्ञे सा भर्तारं लोकपूजितम् गतश् च कश्यपो ब्रह्मन्न् इतश् चेतः सुरान् प्रति
verses.transliteration: tatheti pratijajñe sā bhartāraṃ lokapūjitam gataś ca kaśyapo brahmann itaś cetaḥ surān prati
verses.translation: As the Vedic path falls into disuse, as the people become more and more heretic, sins will increase and the span of life of the people will shrink.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दितेर् गर्भो ऽपि ववृधे बलवान् पुण्यसंभवः एतत् सर्वं मयो दैत्यो मायया वेत्ति तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: diter garbho 'pi vavṛdhe balavān puṇyasaṃbhavaḥ etat sarvaṃ mayo daityo māyayā vetti tattvataḥ
verses.translation: When men begin to undertake austerities not prescribed by sacred texts there will be infantile mortalily due to the fault of kings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य सख्यम् अभवन् मयेन प्रीतिपूर्वकम् मयो गत्वा रहः प्राह इन्द्रं स विनयान्वितः
verses.transliteration: indrasya sakhyam abhavan mayena prītipūrvakam mayo gatvā rahaḥ prāha indraṃ sa vinayānvitaḥ
verses.translation: Girls will give birth to children at the ages of five, six and seven years begotten by men of the ages ol eight, nine and ten.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दितेर् दनोर् अभिप्रायं व्रतं गर्भस्य वर्धनम् तस्य वीर्यं च विविधं प्रीत्येन्द्राय न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: diter danor abhiprāyaṃ vrataṃ garbhasya vardhanam tasya vīryaṃ ca vividhaṃ prītyendrāya nyavedayat
verses.translation: Hairs will begin to turn grey at the twelfth year. No one will live upto the twentieth year.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वासैकगृहं मित्रम् अपायत्रासवर्जितम् अर्जितं सुकृतं नानाविधं चेत् तद् अवाप्यते
verses.transliteration: viśvāsaikagṛhaṃ mitram apāyatrāsavarjitam arjitaṃ sukṛtaṃ nānāvidhaṃ cet tad avāpyate
verses.translation: Men will be destroyed in a short time because their wisdom and intelligence will be mediocre and their kings will be wicked. They will wear false marks.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमुचेश् च प्रियो भ्राता मयो दैत्यो महाबलः भ्रातृहन्त्रा कथं मैत्र्यं मयस्यासीत् सुरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: namuceś ca priyo bhrātā mayo daityo mahābalaḥ bhrātṛhantrā kathaṃ maitryaṃ mayasyāsīt sureśvara
verses.translation: The increase in the severity of the Kali age should be inferred by wise persons as the heretic activities are observed more and more.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यानाम् अधिपश् चासीद् बलवान् नमुचिः पुरा इन्द्रेण वैरम् अभवद् भीषणं लोमहर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: daityānām adhipaś cāsīd balavān namuciḥ purā indreṇa vairam abhavad bhīṣaṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam
verses.translation: When the undertakings of men of virtuous activities do not flourish, O brahmins, the prominence of Kali age should be inferred by wise persons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: युद्धं हित्वा कदाचिद् भो गच्छन्तं तु शतक्रतुम् दृष्ट्वा दैत्यपतिः शूरो नमुचिः पृष्ठतो ऽन्वगात्
verses.transliteration: yuddhaṃ hitvā kadācid bho gacchantaṃ tu śatakratum dṛṣṭvā daityapatiḥ śūro namuciḥ pṛṣṭhato 'nvagāt
verses.translation: When persons cease to perform sacrifices in the worship of Purusottama, lord of sacrifices, the influence of Kali age should be inferred.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तम् आयान्तम् अभिप्रेक्ष्य शचीभर्ता भयातुरः ऐरावतं गजं त्यक्त्वा इन्द्रः फेनम् अथाविशत्
verses.transliteration: tam āyāntam abhiprekṣya śacībhartā bhayāturaḥ airāvataṃ gajaṃ tyaktvā indraḥ phenam athāviśat
verses.translation: The increasein the severity of Kali should be inferred by wise and intelligent persons when there is no interest in Vedic discussions and heretical doctrines are entertained.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स वज्रपाणिस् तरसा फेनेनैवाहनद् रिपुम् नमुचिर् नाशम् अगमत् तस्य भ्राता मयो ऽनुजः
verses.transliteration: sa vajrapāṇis tarasā phenenaivāhanad ripum namucir nāśam agamat tasya bhrātā mayo 'nujaḥ
verses.translation: In the Kali age, O brahmins, men overpowered by heresy will never worship Visnu, the lord of the Universe, the Supreme lord, the Creator of everything.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातृहन्तृविनाशाय तपस् तेपे मयो महत् मायां च विविधाम् आप देवानाम् अतिभीषणाम्
verses.transliteration: bhrātṛhantṛvināśāya tapas tepe mayo mahat māyāṃ ca vividhām āpa devānām atibhīṣaṇām
verses.translation: Men influenced by heresy will prattle thus of what avail are Devas? Of what use are the brahmins and the Vedas? Of what avail is the purificatory wash with water?".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वरांश् चावाप्य तपसा विष्णोर् लोकपरायणात् दानशौण्डः प्रियालापी तदाभवद् असौ मयः
verses.transliteration: varāṃś cāvāpya tapasā viṣṇor lokaparāyaṇāt dānaśauṇḍaḥ priyālāpī tadābhavad asau mayaḥ
verses.translation: At the advent of Kali age, O brahmins, clouds will shower less rain, plants will produce less, and fruits will have less nutritional value.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्नींश् च ब्राह्मणान् पूज्य जेतुम् इन्द्रं कृतक्षणः दातारं च तदार्थिभ्यः स्तूयमानं च बन्दिभिः
verses.transliteration: agnīṃś ca brāhmaṇān pūjya jetum indraṃ kṛtakṣaṇaḥ dātāraṃ ca tadārthibhyaḥ stūyamānaṃ ca bandibhiḥ
verses.translation: In Kali age clothes will come down only upto the knees, the trees will be like the Sami tree, the castes will exhibit the characteristics of Sudras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विदित्वा मघवा वायोर् मयं मायाविनं रिपुम् उपक्रान्तं सुयुद्धाय विप्रो भूत्वा तम् अभ्यगात् शचीभर्ता मयं दैत्यं प्रोवाचेदं पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: viditvā maghavā vāyor mayaṃ māyāvinaṃ ripum upakrāntaṃ suyuddhāya vipro bhūtvā tam abhyagāt śacībhartā mayaṃ daityaṃ provācedaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: In the Kali age, O excellent sages, mothers- and fathers- in-law will be mainly considered elders. Men and women shall take food m open buildings (Eating Houses) along with their friends (?).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देहि दैत्यपते मह्यम् अर्थिने ऽपेक्षितं वरम् त्वां श्रुत्वा दातृतिलकम् आगतो ऽहं द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: dehi daityapate mahyam arthine 'pekṣitaṃ varam tvāṃ śrutvā dātṛtilakam āgato 'haṃ dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: Men following their fathers-in-law will say • "Whose mother? Whose father? A man is the product of his own Karman."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मयो ऽपि ब्राह्मणं मत्वा ऽवदद् दत्तं मया तव विचारयन्ति कृतिनो बह्व् अल्पं वा पुरो ऽर्थिनि
verses.transliteration: mayo 'pi brāhmaṇaṃ matvā 'vadad dattaṃ mayā tava vicārayanti kṛtino bahv alpaṃ vā puro 'rthini
verses.translation: Men of insignificant intellect will be afflicted again and again by verbal, mental and physical faults and they will commit sins everyday.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्ते तु हरिः प्राह सख्यम् इच्छे ह्य् अहं त्वया इन्द्रं मयः पुनः प्राह किम् अनेन द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: ity ukte tu hariḥ prāha sakhyam icche hy ahaṃ tvayā indraṃ mayaḥ punaḥ prāha kim anena dvijottama
verses.translation: In a short time he will perform an excellent meritorious lite which in the Krta yuga is done by hard penance.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न त्वया मम वैरं भोः स्वस्तीत्य् आह हरिर् मयम् तत्त्वं वदेति स हरिर् दैत्येनोक्तः स्वकं वपुः
verses.transliteration: na tvayā mama vairaṃ bhoḥ svastīty āha harir mayam tattvaṃ vadeti sa harir daityenoktaḥ svakaṃ vapuḥ
verses.translation: At what time does a simple act of piety yield a great benefit? It behoves you to mention it entirely. We have a keen desire to hear.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दर्शयाम् आस दैत्याय सहस्राक्षं यद् उच्यते ततः सविस्मयो दैत्यो मयो हरिम् उवाच ह
verses.transliteration: darśayām āsa daityāya sahasrākṣaṃ yad ucyate tataḥ savismayo daityo mayo harim uvāca ha
verses.translation: In the blessed Kali age, O brahmins, there shall be a great benefit through less strain. Women and Sudras shall be¬ come blessed. Understand one thing more.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किम् इदं वज्रपाणिस् त्वं तवायोग्या कृतिः सखे
verses.transliteration: kim idaṃ vajrapāṇis tvaṃ tavāyogyā kṛtiḥ sakhe
verses.translation: By singing songs in praise of Kesava in the Kali age one obtains what one obtains in the Krta yuga by meditation, in the Treta yuga by performing sacrifices and in the Dvapara by conducting worship.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: परिष्वज्य विहस्याथ वृत्तम् इत्य् अब्रवीद् धरिः केनापि साधयन्त्य् अत्र पण्डिताश् च समीहितम्
verses.transliteration: pariṣvajya vihasyātha vṛttam ity abravīd dhariḥ kenāpi sādhayanty atra paṇḍitāś ca samīhitam
verses.translation: In the Kali age, a person attains increased virtue by means of a simple effort. People become well-versed in piety with a little strain. Hence I am pleased with Kali age.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति शक्रस्य मयेन महती ह्य् अभूत् सुप्रीतिर् मुनिशार्दूल मयो हरिहितः सदा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti śakrasya mayena mahatī hy abhūt suprītir muniśārdūla mayo harihitaḥ sadā
verses.translation: But a Sudra achieves salvation merely by serving the twice-born. He is authorized in Pakayajna (mere cooking of his food is no less than a Yajna). Hence a Sudra is more blessed.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य भवनं गत्वा तस्मै सर्वं न्यवेदयत् किं मे कृत्यम् इति प्राह मयं मायाविनं हरिः
verses.transliteration: indrasya bhavanaṃ gatvā tasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayat kiṃ me kṛtyam iti prāha mayaṃ māyāvinaṃ hariḥ
verses.translation: Wealth should be acquired by men without a conflict with their duties; wealth should be distributed among deserving persons; sacrifices should be duly performed.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हरये च मयो मायां प्रादात् प्रीत्या तथा हरिः प्राप्तः संप्रीतिमान् आह किं कृत्यं मय तद् वद
verses.transliteration: haraye ca mayo māyāṃ prādāt prītyā tathā hariḥ prāptaḥ saṃprītimān āha kiṃ kṛtyaṃ maya tad vada
verses.translation: By means of these and other strenuous efforts, O excel¬ lent brahmins, people attain Prajapatya and other worlds in due order.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यस्याश्रमं गच्छ तत्रास्ते गर्भिणी दितिः तस्याः शुश्रूषणं कुर्वन्न् आस्स्व तत्र कियन्ति च
verses.transliteration: agastyasyāśramaṃ gaccha tatrāste garbhiṇī ditiḥ tasyāḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ kurvann āssva tatra kiyanti ca
verses.translation: A women attains other worlds by duly serving her hus¬ band by thoughts, words and deeds. That is because, O brahmins, she attains the same world as lie.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहानि मघवंस् तस्या गर्भम् आविश्य वज्रधृक् वर्धमानं च तं छिन्धि यावद् वश्यो ऽथवा मृतिम् प्राप्नोति तावद् वज्रेण ततो न भविता रिपुः
verses.transliteration: ahāni maghavaṃs tasyā garbham āviśya vajradhṛk vardhamānaṃ ca taṃ chindhi yāvad vaśyo 'thavā mṛtim prāpnoti tāvad vajreṇa tato na bhavitā ripuḥ
verses.translation: Thus she attains those worlds without much effort like the man.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा मयं पूज्य मघवान् एक एव हि विनीतवत् तदा प्रायाद् दितिं मातरम् अञ्जसा शुश्रूषमाणस् तां देवीं शक्रो दैतेयमातरम् सा न जानाति तच् चित्तं शक्रस्य द्विषतो दितिः
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā mayaṃ pūjya maghavān eka eva hi vinītavat tadā prāyād ditiṃ mātaram añjasā śuśrūṣamāṇas tāṃ devīṃ śakro daiteyamātaram sā na jānāti tac cittaṃ śakrasya dviṣato ditiḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गर्भे स्थितं तु यद् भूतं देवेन्द्रस्य विचेष्टितम् अमोघं तन् मुनेस् तेजः कश्यपस्य दुरासदम्
verses.transliteration: garbhe sthitaṃ tu yad bhūtaṃ devendrasya viceṣṭitam amoghaṃ tan munes tejaḥ kaśyapasya durāsadam
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रगृह्य कुलिशं सहस्राक्षः पुरंदरः अन्तःप्रवेशकामो ऽसौ बहुकालं समावसन्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pragṛhya kuliśaṃ sahasrākṣaḥ puraṃdaraḥ antaḥpraveśakāmo 'sau bahukālaṃ samāvasan
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संध्योदक्शीर्षनिद्रां ताम् अवेक्ष्य कुलिशायुधः इदम् अन्तरम् इत्य् उक्त्वा दित्याः कुक्षिं समाविशत्
verses.transliteration: saṃdhyodakśīrṣanidrāṃ tām avekṣya kuliśāyudhaḥ idam antaram ity uktvā dityāḥ kukṣiṃ samāviśat
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्वर्ति च यद् भूतम् इन्द्रं दृष्ट्वा धृतायुधम् हन्तुकामं तदोवाच पुनः पुनर् अभीतवत्
verses.transliteration: antarvarti ca yad bhūtam indraṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛtāyudham hantukāmaṃ tadovāca punaḥ punar abhītavat
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं मां न रक्षसे वज्रिन् भ्रातरं त्वं जिघांससि नारणे मारणाद् अन्यत् पातकं विद्यते महत्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ māṃ na rakṣase vajrin bhrātaraṃ tvaṃ jighāṃsasi nāraṇe māraṇād anyat pātakaṃ vidyate mahat
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋते युद्धान् महाबाहो शक्र युध्यस्व निर्गते मयि तस्मान् नैतद् एवं तव युक्तं भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: ṛte yuddhān mahābāho śakra yudhyasva nirgate mayi tasmān naitad evaṃ tava yuktaṃ bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शतक्रतुः सहस्राक्षः शचीभर्ता पुरंदरः वज्रपाणिः सुरेन्द्रस् त्वं ते न युक्तं भवेत् प्रभो
verses.transliteration: śatakratuḥ sahasrākṣaḥ śacībhartā puraṃdaraḥ vajrapāṇiḥ surendras tvaṃ te na yuktaṃ bhavet prabho
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अथवा युद्धकामस् त्वं मम निष्क्रमणं यथा तथा कुरु महाबाहो मार्गाद् अस्माद् अपासर
verses.transliteration: athavā yuddhakāmas tvaṃ mama niṣkramaṇaṃ yathā tathā kuru mahābāho mārgād asmād apāsara
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुमार्गे न प्रवर्तन्ते महान्तो ऽपि विपद्गताः अविद्यश् चाप्य् अशस्त्रश् च नैव चायुधसंग्रहः
verses.transliteration: kumārge na pravartante mahānto 'pi vipadgatāḥ avidyaś cāpy aśastraś ca naiva cāyudhasaṃgrahaḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वं विद्यावान् वज्रपाणे मां निघ्नन् किं न लज्जसे कुर्वन्ति गर्हितं कर्म न कुलीनाः कदाचन
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ vidyāvān vajrapāṇe māṃ nighnan kiṃ na lajjase kurvanti garhitaṃ karma na kulīnāḥ kadācana
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा वा किं तु जायेत यशो वा पुण्यम् एव वा वध्यन्ते भ्रातरः कामाद् गर्भस्थाः किं नु पौरुषम्
verses.transliteration: hatvā vā kiṃ tu jāyeta yaśo vā puṇyam eva vā vadhyante bhrātaraḥ kāmād garbhasthāḥ kiṃ nu pauruṣam
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यदि वा युद्धभक्तिस् ते मयि भ्रातर् असंशयम् ततो मुष्टिं पुरस्कृत्य वज्रिणे ऽसौ व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: yadi vā yuddhabhaktis te mayi bhrātar asaṃśayam tato muṣṭiṃ puraskṛtya vajriṇe 'sau vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बालघाती ब्रह्मघाती तथा विश्वासघातकः एवंभूतं फलं शक्र कस्मान् मां हन्तुम् उद्यतः
verses.transliteration: bālaghātī brahmaghātī tathā viśvāsaghātakaḥ evaṃbhūtaṃ phalaṃ śakra kasmān māṃ hantum udyataḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्याज्ञया सर्वम् इदं वर्तते सचराचरम् स हन्ता बालकं मां वै किं यशः किं तु पौरुषम्
verses.transliteration: yasyājñayā sarvam idaṃ vartate sacarācaram sa hantā bālakaṃ māṃ vai kiṃ yaśaḥ kiṃ tu pauruṣam
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवन्तं तं गर्भं चिच्छेद कुलिशेन सः क्रोधान्धानां लोभिनां च न घृणा क्वापि विद्यते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bruvantaṃ taṃ garbhaṃ ciccheda kuliśena saḥ krodhāndhānāṃ lobhināṃ ca na ghṛṇā kvāpi vidyate
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न ममार ततो दुःखाद् आहुस् ते भ्रातरो वयम् पुनश् चिच्छेद तान् खण्डान् मा वधीर् इति चाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: na mamāra tato duḥkhād āhus te bhrātaro vayam punaś ciccheda tān khaṇḍān mā vadhīr iti cābruvan
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वस्तान् मातृगर्भस्थान् निजभ्रातॄञ् शतक्रतो द्वेषविध्वस्तबुद्धीनां न चित्ते करुणाकणः
verses.transliteration: viśvastān mātṛgarbhasthān nijabhrātṝñ śatakrato dveṣavidhvastabuddhīnāṃ na citte karuṇākaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं तु खण्डितं खण्डं हस्तपादादिजीववत् निर्विकारं ततो दृष्ट्वा सप्तसप्त सुविस्मितः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tu khaṇḍitaṃ khaṇḍaṃ hastapādādijīvavat nirvikāraṃ tato dṛṣṭvā saptasapta suvismitaḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
