verses.sanskrit: एकवद् बहुरूपाणि गर्भस्थानि शुभानि च रुदन्ति बहुरूपाणि मा रुतेत्य् अब्रवीद् धरिः
verses.transliteration: ekavad bahurūpāṇi garbhasthāni śubhāni ca rudanti bahurūpāṇi mā rutety abravīd dhariḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् ते मरुतो जाता बलवन्तो महौजसः गर्भस्था एव ते ऽन्योन्यम् ऊचुः शक्रं गतभ्रमाः
verses.transliteration: tatas te maruto jātā balavanto mahaujasaḥ garbhasthā eva te 'nyonyam ūcuḥ śakraṃ gatabhramāḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यं मुनिशार्दूलं माता यस्याश्रमे स्थिता अस्मत्पिता तव भ्राता सख्यं ते बहु मन्यते
verses.transliteration: agastyaṃ muniśārdūlaṃ mātā yasyāśrame sthitā asmatpitā tava bhrātā sakhyaṃ te bahu manyate
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अस्मान् उपरि सस्नेहं मनस् ते विद्महे मुने न यत् करोति श्वपचः प्रवृत्तस् तत्र वज्रधृक्
verses.transliteration: asmān upari sasnehaṃ manas te vidmahe mune na yat karoti śvapacaḥ pravṛttas tatra vajradhṛk
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एतद् वचनं श्रुत्वा अगस्त्यो ऽगात् ससंभ्रमः दितिं संबोधयाम् आस व्यथितां गर्भवेदनात्
verses.transliteration: ity etad vacanaṃ śrutvā agastyo 'gāt sasaṃbhramaḥ ditiṃ saṃbodhayām āsa vyathitāṃ garbhavedanāt
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रागस्त्यः शचीकान्तम् अशपत् कुपितो भृशम्
verses.transliteration: tatrāgastyaḥ śacīkāntam aśapat kupito bhṛśam
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संग्रामे रिपवः पृष्ठं पश्येयुस् ते सदा हरे जीवताम् एव मरणम् एतद् एव हि मानिनाम् पृष्ठं पलायमानानां यत् पश्यन्त्य् अहिता रणे
verses.transliteration: saṃgrāme ripavaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ paśyeyus te sadā hare jīvatām eva maraṇam etad eva hi māninām pṛṣṭhaṃ palāyamānānāṃ yat paśyanty ahitā raṇe
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सापि तं गर्भसंस्थं च शशापेन्द्रं रुषा दितिः
verses.transliteration: sāpi taṃ garbhasaṃsthaṃ ca śaśāpendraṃ ruṣā ditiḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: adyaprabhṛti ye kuryur anayād bhrātṛghātanam vaṃśacchedo vipattiś ca nityaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यम् ऋषिशार्दूलं शंभुर् अप्य् आह यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: agastyam ṛṣiśārdūlaṃ śaṃbhur apy āha yatnataḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न कुर्यास् त्वं च कोपं च शचीभर्तरि वै मुने शमं व्रज महाप्राज्ञ मरुतस् त्व् अमरा भवन्
verses.transliteration: na kuryās tvaṃ ca kopaṃ ca śacībhartari vai mune śamaṃ vraja mahāprājña marutas tv amarā bhavan
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दितिं चापि शिवः प्राह प्रसन्नो वृषभध्वजः
verses.transliteration: ditiṃ cāpi śivaḥ prāha prasanno vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एको भूयान् मम सुतस् त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यमण्डितः इत्य् एवं चिन्तयन्ती त्वं तपसे नियताभवः
verses.transliteration: eko bhūyān mama sutas trailokyaiśvaryamaṇḍitaḥ ity evaṃ cintayantī tvaṃ tapase niyatābhavaḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् एतत् सफलं ते ऽद्य पुत्रा बहुगुणाः शुभाः अभवन् बलिनः शूरास् तस्माज् जहि मनोरुजम् अन्यान् अपि वरान् सुभ्रूर् याचस्व गतसंभ्रमा
verses.transliteration: tad etat saphalaṃ te 'dya putrā bahuguṇāḥ śubhāḥ abhavan balinaḥ śūrās tasmāj jahi manorujam anyān api varān subhrūr yācasva gatasaṃbhramā
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् एतद् वचनं श्रुत्वा देवदेवस्य सा दितिः कृताञ्जलिपुटा नत्वा शंभुं वाक्यम् अथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tad etad vacanaṃ śrutvā devadevasya sā ditiḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭā natvā śaṃbhuṃ vākyam athābravīt
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लोके यद् एतत् परमं यत् पित्रोः पुत्रदर्शनम् विशेषेण तु तन् मातुः प्रियं स्यात् सुरपूजित
verses.transliteration: loke yad etat paramaṃ yat pitroḥ putradarśanam viśeṣeṇa tu tan mātuḥ priyaṃ syāt surapūjita
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि रूपसंपत्तिशौर्यविक्रमवान् भवेत् एको ऽपि तनयः किंतु बहवश् चेत् किम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tatrāpi rūpasaṃpattiśauryavikramavān bhavet eko 'pi tanayaḥ kiṃtu bahavaś cet kim ucyate
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मत्पुत्रास् ते प्रभावाच् च जेतारो बलिनो ध्रुवम् इन्द्रस्य भ्रातरः सत्यं पुत्राश् चैव प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: matputrās te prabhāvāc ca jetāro balino dhruvam indrasya bhrātaraḥ satyaṃ putrāś caiva prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यस्य प्रसादाच् च गङ्गायाश् च प्रसादतः यत्र देव प्रसादस् ते तच् छुभं को ऽत्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: agastyasya prasādāc ca gaṅgāyāś ca prasādataḥ yatra deva prasādas te tac chubhaṃ ko 'tra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृतार्थाहं तथापि त्वां भक्त्या विज्ञापयाम्य् अहम् शृणुष्व देव वचनं कुरुष्व च जगद्धितम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtārthāhaṃ tathāpi tvāṃ bhaktyā vijñāpayāmy aham śṛṇuṣva deva vacanaṃ kuruṣva ca jagaddhitam
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वदेत्य् उक्ता जगद्धात्रा दितिर् नम्राब्रवीद् इदम्
verses.transliteration: vadety uktā jagaddhātrā ditir namrābravīd idam
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संततिप्रापणं लोके दुर्लभं सुरवन्दित विशेषेण प्रियं मातुः पुत्रश् चेत् किं नु वर्ण्यते
verses.transliteration: saṃtatiprāpaṇaṃ loke durlabhaṃ suravandita viśeṣeṇa priyaṃ mātuḥ putraś cet kiṃ nu varṇyate
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स चापि गुणवाञ् श्रीमान् आयुष्मान् यदि जायते किं तु स्वर्गेण देवेश पारमेष्ठ्यपदेन वा
verses.transliteration: sa cāpi guṇavāñ śrīmān āyuṣmān yadi jāyate kiṃ tu svargeṇa deveśa pārameṣṭhyapadena vā
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषाम् अपि भूतानाम् इहामुत्र फलैषिणाम् गुणवत्पुत्रसंप्राप्तिर् अभीष्टा सर्वदैव च तस्माद् आप्लवनाद् अत्र क्रियतां समनुग्रहः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣām api bhūtānām ihāmutra phalaiṣiṇām guṇavatputrasaṃprāptir abhīṣṭā sarvadaiva ca tasmād āplavanād atra kriyatāṃ samanugrahaḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महापापफलं चेदं यद् एतद् अनपत्यता स्त्रिया वा पुरुषस्यापि वन्ध्यत्वं यदि जायते
verses.transliteration: mahāpāpaphalaṃ cedaṃ yad etad anapatyatā striyā vā puruṣasyāpi vandhyatvaṃ yadi jāyate
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् अत्र स्नानमात्रेण तद्दोषो नाशम् आप्नुयात् स्नात्वा तत्र फलं दद्यात् स्तोत्रम् एतच् च यः पठेत्
verses.transliteration: tad atra snānamātreṇa taddoṣo nāśam āpnuyāt snātvā tatra phalaṃ dadyāt stotram etac ca yaḥ paṭhet
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स तु पुत्रम् अवाप्नोति त्रिमासस्नानदानतः अपुत्रिणी त्व् अत्र स्नानं कृत्वा पुत्रम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: sa tu putram avāpnoti trimāsasnānadānataḥ aputriṇī tv atra snānaṃ kṛtvā putram avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋतुस्नाता तु या काचित् तत्र स्नाता सुतांल् लभेत् त्रिमासाभ्यन्तरं या तु गुर्विणी भक्तितस् त्व् इह
verses.transliteration: ṛtusnātā tu yā kācit tatra snātā sutāṃl labhet trimāsābhyantaraṃ yā tu gurviṇī bhaktitas tv iha
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: फलैः स्नात्वा तु मां पश्येत् स्तोत्रेण स्तौति मां तथा तस्याः शक्रसमः पुत्रो जायते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: phalaiḥ snātvā tu māṃ paśyet stotreṇa stauti māṃ tathā tasyāḥ śakrasamaḥ putro jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पितृदोषैश् च ये पुत्रं न लभन्ते दिते शृणु धनापहारदोषैश् च तत्रैषा निष्कृतिः परा
verses.transliteration: pitṛdoṣaiś ca ye putraṃ na labhante dite śṛṇu dhanāpahāradoṣaiś ca tatraiṣā niṣkṛtiḥ parā
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैषां पिण्डदानेन पितॄणां प्रीणनेन च किंचित् सुवर्णदानेन ततः पुत्रो भवेद् ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: tatraiṣāṃ piṇḍadānena pitṝṇāṃ prīṇanena ca kiṃcit suvarṇadānena tataḥ putro bhaved dhruvam
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये न्यासाद्यपहर्तारो रत्नापह्नवकारकाः श्राद्धकर्मविहीनाश् च तेषां वंशो न वर्धते
verses.transliteration: ye nyāsādyapahartāro ratnāpahnavakārakāḥ śrāddhakarmavihīnāś ca teṣāṃ vaṃśo na vardhate
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दोषिणां तु परेतानां गतिर् एषा भवेद् इति संततिर् जायतां श्लाघ्या जीवतां तीर्थसेवनात्
verses.transliteration: doṣiṇāṃ tu paretānāṃ gatir eṣā bhaved iti saṃtatir jāyatāṃ ślāghyā jīvatāṃ tīrthasevanāt
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संगमे दितिगङ्गायाः स्नात्वा सिद्धेश्वरं प्रभुम् अनाद्यपारम् अजरं चित्सदानन्दविग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: saṃgame ditigaṅgāyāḥ snātvā siddheśvaraṃ prabhum anādyapāram ajaraṃ citsadānandavigraham
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षिसिद्धगन्धर्वयोगीश्वरनिषेवितम् लिङ्गात्मकं महादेवं ज्योतिर्मयम् अनामयम्
verses.transliteration: devarṣisiddhagandharvayogīśvaraniṣevitam liṅgātmakaṃ mahādevaṃ jyotirmayam anāmayam
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूजयित्वोपचारैश् च नित्यं भक्त्या यतव्रतः स्तोत्रेणानेन यः स्तौति चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च
verses.transliteration: pūjayitvopacāraiś ca nityaṃ bhaktyā yatavrataḥ stotreṇānena yaḥ stauti caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथाशक्त्या स्वर्णदानं ब्राह्मणानां च भोजनम् यः करोत्य् अत्र गङ्गायां स पुत्रशतम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: yathāśaktyā svarṇadānaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam yaḥ karoty atra gaṅgāyāṃ sa putraśatam āpnuyāt
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्य सकलान् कामान् अन्ते शिवपुरं व्रजेत् स्तोत्रेणानेन यः कश्चिद् यत्र क्वापि स्तवीति माम् षण्मासात् पुत्रम् आप्नोति अपि वन्ध्याप्य् अशङ्कितम्
verses.transliteration: saṃprāpya sakalān kāmān ante śivapuraṃ vrajet stotreṇānena yaḥ kaścid yatra kvāpi stavīti mām ṣaṇmāsāt putram āpnoti api vandhyāpy aśaṅkitam
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं पुत्रतीर्थम् उदाहृतम् तत्र तु स्नानदानाद्यैः सर्वकामान् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ putratīrtham udāhṛtam tatra tu snānadānādyaiḥ sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मरुद्भिः सह मैत्र्येण मित्रतीर्थं तद् उच्यते निष्पापत्वेन चेन्द्रस्य शक्रतीर्थं तद् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: marudbhiḥ saha maitryeṇa mitratīrthaṃ tad ucyate niṣpāpatvena cendrasya śakratīrthaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऐन्द्रीं श्रियं यत्र लेभे तत् तीर्थं कमलाभिधम् एतानि सर्वतीर्थानि सर्वाभीष्टप्रदानि हि
verses.transliteration: aindrīṃ śriyaṃ yatra lebhe tat tīrthaṃ kamalābhidham etāni sarvatīrthāni sarvābhīṣṭapradāni hi
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं भविष्यतीत्य् उक्त्वा शिवश् चान्तरधीयत कृतकृत्याश् च ते जग्मुः सर्व एव यथागतम् तीर्थानां पुण्यदं तत्र लक्षम् एकं प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ bhaviṣyatīty uktvā śivaś cāntaradhīyata kṛtakṛtyāś ca te jagmuḥ sarva eva yathāgatam tīrthānāṃ puṇyadaṃ tatra lakṣam ekaṃ prakīrtitam
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यमतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं पितॄणां प्रीतिवर्धनम् दृष्टादृष्टेष्टदं सर्वदेवर्षिगणसेवितम्
verses.transliteration: yamatīrtham iti khyātaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam dṛṣṭādṛṣṭeṣṭadaṃ sarvadevarṣigaṇasevitam
verses.translation: In the final Yuga will come up those kings who will cease to be protectors and take away the portion of oblations. They will be interested only in saving themselves.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य प्रभावं वक्ष्यामि सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् अनुह्राद इति ख्यातः कपोतो बलवान् अभूत्
verses.transliteration: tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam anuhrāda iti khyātaḥ kapoto balavān abhūt
verses.translation: In the final Yuga, non-Ksatriyas will become kings, brahmins will resort to Sudras for sustenance and Siidras will maintain the conduct and way of life of the brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्या हेतिनाम्नी पक्षिणी कामरूपिणी मृत्योः पौत्रो ह्य् अनुह्रादो दौहित्री हेतिर् एव च
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā hetināmnī pakṣiṇī kāmarūpiṇī mṛtyoḥ pautro hy anuhrādo dauhitrī hetir eva ca
verses.translation: Men will become ill-mannered. They will be devoted to the hoarding of wealth. They will be fond of liquor and meat. Base men will carnally approach the wives of their friends.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कालेनाथ तयोः पुत्राः पौत्राश् चैव बभूविरे तस्य शत्रुश् च बलवान् उलूको नाम पक्षिराट्
verses.transliteration: kālenātha tayoḥ putrāḥ pautrāś caiva babhūvire tasya śatruś ca balavān ulūko nāma pakṣirāṭ
verses.translation: In the final Yuga, wealth and assets will become impor¬ tant. The conduct and activities of the good will not be honoured. The fallen ones will not be rebuked and treated with contempt.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्राश् च पौत्राश् च आग्नेयास् ते बलोत्कटाः तयोश् च वैरम् अभवद् बहुकालं द्विजन्मनोः
verses.transliteration: tasya putrāś ca pautrāś ca āgneyās te balotkaṭāḥ tayoś ca vairam abhavad bahukālaṃ dvijanmanoḥ
verses.translation: Men will be ugly with the noses missing and the hairs in disarray. Girls less than sixteen in age will give birth to children.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाया उत्तरे तीरे कपोतस्याश्रमो ऽभवत् तस्याश् च दक्षिणे कूल उलूको नाम पक्षिराट्
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāyā uttare tīre kapotasyāśramo 'bhavat tasyāś ca dakṣiṇe kūla ulūko nāma pakṣirāṭ
verses.translation: In the final yuga, cooked food will be sold in the open
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वासं चक्रे तत्र पुत्रैः पौत्रैश् च द्विजसत्तम तयोश् च युद्धम् अभवद् बहुकालं विरुद्धयोः
verses.transliteration: vāsaṃ cakre tatra putraiḥ pautraiś ca dvijasattama tayoś ca yuddham abhavad bahukālaṃ viruddhayoḥ
verses.translation: Sudras will begin to expound Dharma. Their teeth 'vi be white. They will conquer their sense-organs. They will wear ocher robes They will sustain themselves with knavishness and crooked intellect.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रैः पौत्रैश् च वृतयोर् बलिनोर् बलिभिः सह उलूको वा कपोतो वा नैवाप्नोति जयाजयौ
verses.transliteration: putraiḥ pautraiś ca vṛtayor balinor balibhiḥ saha ulūko vā kapoto vā naivāpnoti jayājayau
verses.translation: The base ones will stay in the end. The subjects will lose bashfulncss. They are doomed in that final age.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कपोतो यमम् आराध्य मृत्युं पैतामहं तथा याम्यम् अस्त्रम् अवाप्याथ सर्वेभ्यो ऽप्य् अधिको ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: kapoto yamam ārādhya mṛtyuṃ paitāmahaṃ tathā yāmyam astram avāpyātha sarvebhyo 'py adhiko 'bhavat
verses.translation: Even the excellent brahmins sell fruits of their austeri¬ ties and sacrifices. The seasons will become adverse during that ultimate age.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथोलूको ऽग्निम् आराध्य बलवान् अभवद् भृशम् वरैर् उन्मत्तयोर् युद्धम् अभवच् चातिभीषणम्
verses.transliteration: tatholūko 'gnim ārādhya balavān abhavad bhṛśam varair unmattayor yuddham abhavac cātibhīṣaṇam
verses.translation: Similarly, steers under training will be yoked to the plough even when they are two years old. When the yuga comes to a close, the clouds will begin to shower in a quaint way
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्राग्नेयम् उलूको ऽपि कपोतायास्त्रम् आक्षिपत् कपोतो ऽप्य् अथ पाशान् वै याम्यान् आक्षिप्य शत्रवे
verses.transliteration: tatrāgneyam ulūko 'pi kapotāyāstram ākṣipat kapoto 'py atha pāśān vai yāmyān ākṣipya śatrave
verses.translation: Those who arc born in the family of heroes will become kings as the lower subjects become baser and baser at the close of the age.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उलूकायाथ दण्डं च मृत्युपाशान् अवासृजत् पुनस् तद् अभवद् युद्धं पुराडिबकयोर् यथा
verses.transliteration: ulūkāyātha daṇḍaṃ ca mṛtyupāśān avāsṛjat punas tad abhavad yuddhaṃ purāḍibakayor yathā
verses.translation: Charitable gifts will be obligatory on the parts of parents while the sons will never perform sacred rites as the age comes to a close.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हेतिः कपोतकी दृष्ट्वा ज्वलनं प्राप्तम् अन्तिके पतिव्रता महायुद्धे भर्तुः सा दुःखविह्वला
verses.transliteration: hetiḥ kapotakī dṛṣṭvā jvalanaṃ prāptam antike pativratā mahāyuddhe bhartuḥ sā duḥkhavihvalā
verses.translation: Sons will eagerly share the hereditary assets and charitable gifts. Urged by greed and other bad qualities they will be antagonistic to one another and will even attempt to take away other's shares.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्निना वेष्ट्यमानांश् च पुत्रान् दृष्ट्वा विशेषतः सा गत्वा ज्वलनं हेतिस् तुष्टाव विविधोक्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: agninā veṣṭyamānāṃś ca putrān dṛṣṭvā viśeṣataḥ sā gatvā jvalanaṃ hetis tuṣṭāva vividhoktibhiḥ
verses.translation: At the close ot the \uga when tenderness, beauty and jewellery cease to exist women will be decked by means of their tresses.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रूपं न दानं न परोक्षम् अस्ति यस्यात्मभूतं च पदार्थजातम् अश्नन्ति हव्यानि च येन देवाः स्वाहापतिं यज्ञभुजं नमस्ये
verses.transliteration: rūpaṃ na dānaṃ na parokṣam asti yasyātmabhūtaṃ ca padārthajātam aśnanti havyāni ca yena devāḥ svāhāpatiṃ yajñabhujaṃ namasye
verses.translation: A householder devoid of stamina and virility will attempt to have sexual pleasure. When the Yuga comes to a close no sexual indulgence will be on a par with that with one's own wife.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मुखभूतं च देवानां देवानां हव्यवाहनम् होतारं चापि देवानां देवानां दूतम् एव च
verses.transliteration: mukhabhūtaṃ ca devānāṃ devānāṃ havyavāhanam hotāraṃ cāpi devānāṃ devānāṃ dūtam eva ca
verses.translation: Population will consist mostly of beggars; people will never give anything to one another. They will perish on being harassed by kings and robbers or destroyed by fire or fighting.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तं देवं शरणं यामि आदिदेवं विभावसुम् अन्तः स्थितः प्राणरूपो बहिश् चान्नप्रदो हि यः यो यज्ञसाधनं यामि शरणं तं धनंजयम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi ādidevaṃ vibhāvasum antaḥ sthitaḥ prāṇarūpo bahiś cānnaprado hi yaḥ yo yajñasādhanaṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ taṃ dhanaṃjayam
verses.translation: When the Yuga comes to a close, plants will cease to bear fruits; young men will exhibit the characteristics of old men and men of no good conduct will be happy in the world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अमोघम् एतद् अस्त्रं मे न्यस्तं युद्धे कपोतकि यत्र विश्रमयेद् अस्त्रं तन् मे ब्रूहि पतिव्रते
verses.transliteration: amogham etad astraṃ me nyastaṃ yuddhe kapotaki yatra viśramayed astraṃ tan me brūhi pativrate
verses.translation: When the Yuga comes to a close rough and low winds showering hailstone will begin to blow in the rainy seasons; the other world will become of doubtful existence.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मयि विश्रम्यताम् अस्त्रं न पुत्रे न च भर्तरि सत्यवाग् भव हव्येश जातवेदो नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: mayi viśramyatām astraṃ na putre na ca bhartari satyavāg bhava havyeśa jātavedo namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Kings like the Vais'yas will maintain themselves with wealth and foodgrains. When the Yuga passes off, no one will behave like kinsman to anyone.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टो ऽस्मि तव वाक्येन भर्तृभक्त्या पतिव्रते तवापि भर्तृपुत्राणां हेति क्षेमं ददाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭo 'smi tava vākyena bhartṛbhaktyā pativrate tavāpi bhartṛputrāṇāṃ heti kṣemaṃ dadāmy aham
verses.translation: Agreements and promises will cease to function. When the Yuga comes to a close a debt will lose itself along with a sense of propriety and decorum.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयम् एतद् अस्त्रं मे न भर्तारं सुतान् अपि न त्वां दहेत् ततो याहि सुखेन त्वं कपोतकि
verses.transliteration: āgneyam etad astraṃ me na bhartāraṃ sutān api na tvāṃ dahet tato yāhi sukhena tvaṃ kapotaki
verses.translation: Delight of men will be fruitless and the anger of men will be fruitful. When the Yuga comes to a close people will begin to rear goats for getting milk.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तत्र उलूकी ददृशे पतिम् वेष्ट्यमानं याम्यपाशैर् यमदण्डेन ताडितम् उलूकी दुःखिता भूत्वा यमं प्रायाद् भयातुरा
verses.transliteration: etasminn antare tatra ulūkī dadṛśe patim veṣṭyamānaṃ yāmyapāśair yamadaṇḍena tāḍitam ulūkī duḥkhitā bhūtvā yamaṃ prāyād bhayāturā
verses.translation: Similarly, sacrifices will be performed not in accordance with the sacred texts. Men who profess to be scholars will be acting in an unauthorized manner.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्भीता अनुद्रवन्ते जनास् त्वद्भीता ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति त्वद्भीताः साधु चरन्ति धीरास् त्वद्भीताः कर्मनिष्ठा भवन्ति
verses.transliteration: tvadbhītā anudravante janās tvadbhītā brahmacaryaṃ caranti tvadbhītāḥ sādhu caranti dhīrās tvadbhītāḥ karmaniṣṭhā bhavanti
verses.translation: Without offering alms and oblations men will partake of their meals. Deceiving their husbands who are asleep women will go elsewhere.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्भीता अनाशकम् आचरन्ति ग्रामाद् अरण्यम् अभि यच् चरन्ति त्वद्भीताः सौम्यताम् आश्रयन्ते त्वद्भीताः सोमपानं भजन्ते
verses.transliteration: tvadbhītā anāśakam ācaranti grāmād araṇyam abhi yac caranti tvadbhītāḥ saumyatām āśrayante tvadbhītāḥ somapānaṃ bhajante
verses.translation: After this, when the virtue falls down the subjects will become devoid of good qualities. After attaining loss of good conduct they will attain deficiency in their longevity.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवत्यां तस्यां ताम् आह दक्षिणदिक्पतिः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bruvatyāṃ tasyāṃ tām āha dakṣiṇadikpatiḥ
verses.translation: They will incur decline in strength due to defi¬ ciency in longevity; pallor and discolouration due to decline in strength, sickness and pain due to pallor; and despondency due to pain of sickness.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वरं वरय भद्रं ते दास्ये ऽहं मनसः प्रियम्
verses.transliteration: varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te dāsye 'haṃ manasaḥ priyam
verses.translation: Due to despondency self-knowledge will be aroused in them; due to self-knowledge inclination towards piety (will be acquired by them). By attaining the highest point thus they will reach the Krta Yuga.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यमस्येति वचः श्रुत्वा सा तम् आह पतिव्रता
verses.transliteration: yamasyeti vacaḥ śrutvā sā tam āha pativratā
verses.translation: Some will be practising piety to a certain extent; some will attain a neutral state; some will follow misconceived piety; some will attain jolly temperament.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भर्ता मे वेष्टितः पाशैर् दण्डेनाभिहतस् तव तस्माद् रक्ष सुरश्रेष्ठ पुत्रान् भर्तारम् एव च
verses.transliteration: bhartā me veṣṭitaḥ pāśair daṇḍenābhihatas tava tasmād rakṣa suraśreṣṭha putrān bhartāram eva ca
verses.translation: Some will come to the conclusion that only perception and inference constitute true testimony; others will say that no¬ thing can be true testimony.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद्वाक्यात् कृपया युक्तो यमः प्राह पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tadvākyāt kṛpayā yukto yamaḥ prāha punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Some will be addicted to atheism and ruin piety; some will become deluded. Brahmins will profess to be great scholars.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पाशानां चापि दण्डस्य स्थानं वद शुभानने
verses.transliteration: pāśānāṃ cāpi daṇḍasya sthānaṃ vada śubhānane
verses.translation: People will be excluded from the knowledge of scrip¬ tures. They will retain faith only in what is current for the nonce. Men devoid of knowledge will become arrogant.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सा प्रोवाच यमं देवं मयि पाशास् त्वयेरिताः आविशन्तु जगन्नाथ दण्डो मय्य् एव संविशेत् ततः प्रोवाच भगवान् यमस् तां कृपया पुनः
verses.transliteration: sā provāca yamaṃ devaṃ mayi pāśās tvayeritāḥ āviśantu jagannātha daṇḍo mayy eva saṃviśet tataḥ provāca bhagavān yamas tāṃ kṛpayā punaḥ
verses.translation: When piety becomes unsteady and disarranged, there will still be people honoured by the noble ones who will prac¬ tise auspicious rites and resort to charitable deeds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तव भर्ता च पुत्राश् च सर्वे जीवन्तु विज्वराः
verses.transliteration: tava bhartā ca putrāś ca sarve jīvantu vijvarāḥ
verses.translation: When people begin to cat indiscriminately, when they think that they arc protected by themselves, when they conceal themselves, when they become devoid of mercy, when they are shameless in their character, these are the signs of Kali age.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न्यवारयद् यमः पाशान् आग्नेयास्त्रं तु हव्यवाट् कपोतोलूकयोश् चापि प्रीतिं वै चक्रतुः सुरौ आहतुश् च द्विजन्मानौ व्रियतां वर ईप्सितः
verses.transliteration: nyavārayad yamaḥ pāśān āgneyāstraṃ tu havyavāṭ kapotolūkayoś cāpi prītiṃ vai cakratuḥ surau āhatuś ca dvijanmānau vriyatāṃ vara īpsitaḥ
verses.translation: During the period of the onslaught of Kali that des¬ troys strict adherence to wisdom, even unprepared persons will attain Siddhi in a short while.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भवतोर् दर्शनं लब्धं वैरव्याजेन दुष्करम् वयं च पक्षिणः पापाः किं वरेण सुरोत्तमौ
verses.transliteration: bhavator darśanaṃ labdhaṃ vairavyājena duṣkaram vayaṃ ca pakṣiṇaḥ pāpāḥ kiṃ vareṇa surottamau
verses.translation: O brahmins, if the people of lower castes resort to the
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अथ देयो वरो ऽस्माकं भवद्भ्यां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् नात्मार्थम् अनुयाचावो दीयमानं वरं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: atha deyo varo 'smākaṃ bhavadbhyāṃ prītipūrvakam nātmārtham anuyācāvo dīyamānaṃ varaṃ śubham
verses.translation: When the Yuga comes to a close there will be great wars, heavy downpour, strong gusts of wind and scorching heat. It is the characteristic feature of Kali.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आत्मार्थं यस् तु याचेत स शोच्यो हि सुरेश्वरौ जीवितं सफलं तस्य यः परार्थोद्यतः सदा
verses.transliteration: ātmārthaṃ yas tu yāceta sa śocyo hi sureśvarau jīvitaṃ saphalaṃ tasya yaḥ parārthodyataḥ sadā
verses.translation: When a time characterized by worthlessness and full of disturbances comes and there arc no holy rites, men who are afflicted by the burden of taxes, will resort to the forest.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर् आपो रविः पृथ्वी धान्यानि विविधानि च परार्थं वर्तनं तेषां सतां चापि विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: agnir āpo raviḥ pṛthvī dhānyāni vividhāni ca parārthaṃ vartanaṃ teṣāṃ satāṃ cāpi viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: When the holy rites of sacrifices cease to be performed, demons, beasts of prey, worms, mice and serpents will attack men.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादयो ऽपि हि यतो युज्यन्ते मृत्युना सह एवं ज्ञात्वा तु देवेशौ वृथा स्वार्थपरिश्रमः
verses.transliteration: brahmādayo 'pi hi yato yujyante mṛtyunā saha evaṃ jñātvā tu deveśau vṛthā svārthapariśramaḥ
verses.translation: At the close of the Age some excellent men in certain places will enjoy prosperity, abundance of food, of good healt and self-sufficiency in the kinsmen.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जन्मना सह यत् पुंसां विहितं परमेष्ठिना कदाचिन् नान्यथा तद् वै वृथा क्लिश्यन्ति जन्तवः
verses.transliteration: janmanā saha yat puṃsāṃ vihitaṃ parameṣṭhinā kadācin nānyathā tad vai vṛthā kliśyanti jantavaḥ
verses.translation: In the different regions there will be separate groups of persons equipped with rafts and requisites. They will be protected by themselves as well as robbed by themselves.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् याचावहे किंचिद् धिताय जगतां शुभम् गुणदायि तु सर्वेषां तद् युवाम् अनुमन्यताम्
verses.transliteration: tasmād yācāvahe kiṃcid dhitāya jagatāṃ śubham guṇadāyi tu sarveṣāṃ tad yuvām anumanyatām
verses.translation: As time passes on, men will be dislodged from their countries; they will lose valuable things along with their kinsmen.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताव् आहतुर् उभौ देवौ पक्षिणौ लोकविश्रुतौ धर्मस्य यशसो ऽवाप्त्ये लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: tāv āhatur ubhau devau pakṣiṇau lokaviśrutau dharmasya yaśaso 'vāptye lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: They will be afflicted by starvation and they will run away in great fright taking their children' with them. They will cross the river Kausikl.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आवाभ्याम् आश्रमौ तीर्थे गङ्गाया उभये तटे भवेतां जगतां नाथाव् एष एव परो वरः
verses.transliteration: āvābhyām āśramau tīrthe gaṅgāyā ubhaye taṭe bhavetāṃ jagatāṃ nāthāv eṣa eva paro varaḥ
verses.translation: They will resort to the lands of Aiiga, Vahga, Kalinga, Kasmlra and Kosala. They will occupy valleys and chasms between the mountains abounding in sages.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं दानं जपो होमः पितॄणां चापि पूजनम् सुकृती दुष्कृती वापि यः करोति यथा तथा सर्वं तद् अक्षयं पुण्यं स्याद् इत्य् एष परो वरः
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṝṇāṃ cāpi pūjanam sukṛtī duṣkṛtī vāpi yaḥ karoti yathā tathā sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ puṇyaṃ syād ity eṣa paro varaḥ
verses.translation: The Earth will be neither void nor full of forests. Kings will be both protectors and non-protectors.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् अस्तु तथा चान्यत् सुप्रीतौ तु ब्रवावहै
verses.transliteration: evam astu tathā cānyat suprītau tu bravāvahai
verses.translation: Men will sustain themselves by means of deer, fish, birds, beasts of prey, serpents, insects, worms, honey, vegetables, green fruits and roots.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे गौतमीतीरे यमस्तोत्रं पठन्ति ये तेषां सप्तसु वंशेषु नाकाले मृत्युम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: uttare gautamītīre yamastotraṃ paṭhanti ye teṣāṃ saptasu vaṃśeṣu nākāle mṛtyum āpnuyāt
verses.translation: Like sages men will use barks of trees, skins of deer and will have for their food the rotting and decaying leaves and fruits.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषो भाजनं च स्यात् सर्वदा सर्वसंपदाम् यस् त्व् इदं पठते नित्यं मृत्युस्तोत्रं जितात्मवान्
verses.transliteration: puruṣo bhājanaṃ ca syāt sarvadā sarvasaṃpadām yas tv idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ mṛtyustotraṃ jitātmavān
verses.translation: The people will not be able to extract oil from seeds. They will be assailed and struck by darts fixed to wooden pieces. They will always rear goats, sheep, asses, mules and camels.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाशीतिसहस्रैश् च व्याधिभिर् न स बाध्यते अस्मिंस् तीर्थे द्विजश्रेष्ठौ त्रिमासाद् गुर्विणी सती
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāśītisahasraiś ca vyādhibhir na sa bādhyate asmiṃs tīrthe dvijaśreṣṭhau trimāsād gurviṇī satī
verses.translation: They will resort to the banks, of rivers and for the sake of diverting the course of water they will restrain the flow of currents. They will be engaged in mutual petty trade and deal in cooked food.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अर्वाग्वन्ध्या च षण्मासात् सप्ताहं स्नानम् आचरेत् वीरसूः सा भवेन् नारी शतायुः स सुतो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: arvāgvandhyā ca ṣaṇmāsāt saptāhaṃ snānam ācaret vīrasūḥ sā bhaven nārī śatāyuḥ sa suto bhavet
verses.translation: Due to the non-fulfilment of their desires thev will be pious m their conduct. Themselves afflicted by destruction they will perform coasccratory rites.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मीवान् मतिमाञ् शूरः पुत्रपौत्रविवर्धनः तत्र पिण्डादिदानेन पितरो मुक्तिम् आप्नुयुः मनोवाक्कायजात् पापात् स्नानान् मुक्तो भवेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: lakṣmīvān matimāñ śūraḥ putrapautravivardhanaḥ tatra piṇḍādidānena pitaro muktim āpnuyuḥ manovākkāyajāt pāpāt snānān mukto bhaven naraḥ
verses.translation: Due to the non-fulfilment of their desires thev will be pious m their conduct. Themselves afflicted by destruction they will perform coasccratory rites.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यमवाक्याद् अनु तथा हव्यवाड् आह पक्षिणौ
verses.transliteration: yamavākyād anu tathā havyavāḍ āha pakṣiṇau
verses.translation: Due to the non-fulfilment of their desires thev will be pious m their conduct. Themselves afflicted by destruction they will perform coasccratory rites.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्तोत्रं दक्षिणे तीरे ये पठन्ति यतव्रताः तेषाम् आरोग्यम् ऐश्वर्यं लक्ष्मीं रूपं ददाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: matstotraṃ dakṣiṇe tīre ye paṭhanti yatavratāḥ teṣām ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ lakṣmīṃ rūpaṃ dadāmy aham
verses.translation: Due to the non-fulfilment of their desires thev will be pious m their conduct. Themselves afflicted by destruction they will perform coasccratory rites.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इदं स्तोत्रं तु यः कश्चिद् यत्र क्वापि पठेन् नरः नैवाग्नितो भयं तस्य लिखिते ऽपि गृहे स्थिते
verses.transliteration: idaṃ stotraṃ tu yaḥ kaścid yatra kvāpi paṭhen naraḥ naivāgnito bhayaṃ tasya likhite 'pi gṛhe sthite
verses.translation: Due to the non-fulfilment of their desires thev will be pious m their conduct. Themselves afflicted by destruction they will perform coasccratory rites.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं दानं च यः कुर्याद् अग्नितीर्थे शुचिर् नरः अग्निष्टोमफलं तस्य भवेद् एव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ dānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryād agnitīrthe śucir naraḥ agniṣṭomaphalaṃ tasya bhaved eva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Due to the non-fulfilment of their desires thev will be pious m their conduct. Themselves afflicted by destruction they will perform coasccratory rites.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं याम्यम् आग्नेयम् एव च कपोतं च तथोलूकं हेत्युलूकं विदुर् बुधाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ yāmyam āgneyam eva ca kapotaṃ ca tatholūkaṃ hetyulūkaṃ vidur budhāḥ
verses.translation: Due to the non-fulfilment of their desires thev will be pious m their conduct. Themselves afflicted by destruction they will perform coasccratory rites.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र त्रीणि सहस्राणि तावन्त्य् एव शतानि च पुनर् नवतितीर्थानि प्रत्येकं मुक्तिभाजनम्
verses.transliteration: tatra trīṇi sahasrāṇi tāvanty eva śatāni ca punar navatitīrthāni pratyekaṃ muktibhājanam
verses.translation: Due to the non-fulfilment of their desires thev will be pious m their conduct. Themselves afflicted by destruction they will perform coasccratory rites.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेषु स्नानेन दानेन प्रेतीभूताश् च ये नराः पूतास् ते पुत्रवित्ताढ्या आक्रमेयुर् दिवं शुभाः
verses.transliteration: teṣu snānena dānena pretībhūtāś ca ye narāḥ pūtās te putravittāḍhyā ākrameyur divaṃ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: Due to the non-fulfilment of their desires thev will be pious m their conduct. Themselves afflicted by destruction they will perform coasccratory rites.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तपस्तीर्थम् इति ख्यातं तपोवृद्धिकरं महत् सर्वकामप्रदं पुण्यं पितॄणां प्रीतिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: tapastīrtham iti khyātaṃ tapovṛddhikaraṃ mahat sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam
verses.translation: Janasthana: A part of DaijiJaka forest which lies in the basin of Godavari. Rama had lived in this forest with Sita and Laksmana for a long time during the period of his exile.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस् तीर्थे तु यद् वृत्तं शृणु पापप्रणाशनम् अपाम् अग्नेश् च संवादम् ऋषीणां च परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃs tīrthe tu yad vṛttaṃ śṛṇu pāpapraṇāśanam apām agneś ca saṃvādam ṛṣīṇāṃ ca parasparam
verses.translation: The great Asura, the haughty son of Madhu, the Danava named Lavana, the heroic demon, proud of his boons was killed in the forest (named) Madhuvana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अपो ज्येष्ठतमाः केचिन् मेनिरे ऽग्निं तथापरे एवं ब्रुवन्तो मुनयः संवादं चाग्निवारिणोः
verses.transliteration: apo jyeṣṭhatamāḥ kecin menire 'gniṃ tathāpare evaṃ bruvanto munayaḥ saṃvādaṃ cāgnivāriṇoḥ
verses.translation: The tiger among men killed Viradha and Kabandha, the Raksasas of terrible exploits who had been formerly two Gandharvas deluded by imprecation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विनाग्निं जीवनं क्व स्याज् जीवभूतो यतो ऽनलः आत्मभूतो हव्यभूतश् चाग्निना जायते ऽखिलम्
verses.transliteration: vināgniṃ jīvanaṃ kva syāj jīvabhūto yato 'nalaḥ ātmabhūto havyabhūtaś cāgninā jāyate 'khilam
verses.translation: In the battle Rama killed his enemies by means of arrows, that had the lustre of fire, sun-rays and lightning streaks, that had the tail ends fitted with feathers of various kinds made of molten gold and the strength of which was like that of the thunderbolt of Mahendra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्निना ध्रियते लोको ह्य् अग्निर् ज्योतिर्मयं जगत् तस्माद् अग्नेः परं नास्ति पावनं दैवतं महत्
verses.transliteration: agninā dhriyate loko hy agnir jyotirmayaṃ jagat tasmād agneḥ paraṃ nāsti pāvanaṃ daivataṃ mahat
verses.translation: Weapons were given to him by Visvaraitra the intelli¬ gent sage for slaying the enemies who could not be assailed even by Devas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्ज्योतिः स एवोक्तः परं ज्योतिः स एव हि विनाग्निना किंचिद् अस्ति यस्य धाम जगत्त्रयम्
verses.transliteration: antarjyotiḥ sa evoktaḥ paraṃ jyotiḥ sa eva hi vināgninā kiṃcid asti yasya dhāma jagattrayam
verses.translation: Formerly, when a certain sacrifice yvas performed by Janaka the great Atman, the great bow belonging to Mahesvara was broken by him even as he playfully and sportingly touched it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् अग्नेः परं नास्ति भूतानां ज्यैष्ठ्यभाजनम् योषित्क्षेत्रे ऽर्पितं बीजं पुरुषेण यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: tasmād agneḥ paraṃ nāsti bhūtānāṃ jyaiṣṭhyabhājanam yoṣitkṣetre 'rpitaṃ bījaṃ puruṣeṇa yathā tathā
verses.translation: After performing these tasks Rama the most excellent among the virtuous performed ten horse-sacrifices where flesh was offered to the deities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देहादिका शक्तिः कृशानोर् एव नान्यथा देवानां हि मुखं वह्निस् तस्मान् नातः परं विदुः
verses.transliteration: tasya dehādikā śaktiḥ kṛśānor eva nānyathā devānāṃ hi mukhaṃ vahnis tasmān nātaḥ paraṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: No widow lamented. There were no calamities. Every¬ thing was auspicious when Rama was ruling over the earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अपरे तु ह्य् अपां ज्यैष्ठ्यं मेनिरे वेदवादिनः अद्भिः संपत्स्यते ह्य् अन्नं शुचिर् अद्भिः प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: apare tu hy apāṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ menire vedavādinaḥ adbhiḥ saṃpatsyate hy annaṃ śucir adbhiḥ prajāyate
verses.translation: No living being had any fear from water, fire, wind or blows (of any sort). Old men never performed the funeral rites of boys (i.e. boys never died before old men).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अद्भिर् एव धृतं सर्वम् आपो वै मातरः स्मृताः त्रैलोक्यजीवनं वारि वदन्तीति पुराविदः
verses.transliteration: adbhir eva dhṛtaṃ sarvam āpo vai mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ trailokyajīvanaṃ vāri vadantīti purāvidaḥ
verses.translation: The Ksatriyas were devoted to the Brahmins. The Vaisyas were devoted to the Ksatriyas. The Sudras served the three castes without any pride or egotism.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नम् अमृतं ह्य् अद्भ्यस् ताभ्यश् चौषधिसंभवः अग्निर् ज्येष्ठ इति प्राहुर् आपो ज्येष्ठतमाः परे
verses.transliteration: utpannam amṛtaṃ hy adbhyas tābhyaś cauṣadhisaṃbhavaḥ agnir jyeṣṭha iti prāhur āpo jyeṣṭhatamāḥ pare
verses.translation: Women did not stray from their husbands; the hus¬ band did not stray from his wife. The entire universe was restrained and subdued. The earth was rid of robbers.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं मीमांसमानास् ते ऋषयो वेदवादिनः विरुद्धवादिनो मां च समभ्येत्येदम् अब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ mīmāṃsamānās te ṛṣayo vedavādinaḥ viruddhavādino māṃ ca samabhyetyedam abruvan
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेर् अपां वद ज्यैष्ठ्यं त्रैलोक्यस्य भवान् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: agner apāṃ vada jyaiṣṭhyaṃ trailokyasya bhavān prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहम् अप्य् अब्रवं प्राप्तान् ऋषीन् सर्वान् यतव्रतान् उभौ पूज्यतमौ लोक उभाभ्यां जायते जगत्
verses.transliteration: aham apy abravaṃ prāptān ṛṣīn sarvān yatavratān ubhau pūjyatamau loka ubhābhyāṃ jāyate jagat
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उभाभ्यां जायते हव्यं कव्यं चामृतम् एव च उभाभ्यां जीवनं लोके शरीरस्य च धारणम्
verses.transliteration: ubhābhyāṃ jāyate havyaṃ kavyaṃ cāmṛtam eva ca ubhābhyāṃ jīvanaṃ loke śarīrasya ca dhāraṇam
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नानयोश् च विशेषो ऽस्ति ततो ज्यैष्ठ्यं समं मतम् ततो मद्वचनाज् ज्यैष्ठ्यम् उभयोर् नैव कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: nānayoś ca viśeṣo 'sti tato jyaiṣṭhyaṃ samaṃ matam tato madvacanāj jyaiṣṭhyam ubhayor naiva kasyacit
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ज्यैष्ठ्यम् अन्यतरस्येति मेनिरे ऋषिसत्तमाः न तृप्ता मम वाक्येन जग्मुर् वायुं तपस्विनः
verses.transliteration: jyaiṣṭhyam anyatarasyeti menire ṛṣisattamāḥ na tṛptā mama vākyena jagmur vāyuṃ tapasvinaḥ
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कस्य ज्यैष्ठ्यं भवान् प्राणो वायो सत्यं त्वयि स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: kasya jyaiṣṭhyaṃ bhavān prāṇo vāyo satyaṃ tvayi sthitam
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वायुर् आहानलो ज्येष्ठः सर्वम् अग्नौ प्रतिष्ठितम् नेत्य् उक्त्वान्योन्यम् ऋषयो जग्मुस् ते ऽपि वसुंधराम्
verses.transliteration: vāyur āhānalo jyeṣṭhaḥ sarvam agnau pratiṣṭhitam nety uktvānyonyam ṛṣayo jagmus te 'pi vasuṃdharām
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं भूमे वद ज्यैष्ठ्यम् आधारासि चराचरे
verses.transliteration: satyaṃ bhūme vada jyaiṣṭhyam ādhārāsi carācare
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भूमिर् अप्य् आह विनयाद् आगतांस् तान् ऋषीन् इदम्
verses.transliteration: bhūmir apy āha vinayād āgatāṃs tān ṛṣīn idam
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ममाप्य् आधारभूताः स्युर् आपो देव्यः सनातनाः अद्भ्यस् तु जायते सर्वं ज्यैष्ठ्यम् अप्सु प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: mamāpy ādhārabhūtāḥ syur āpo devyaḥ sanātanāḥ adbhyas tu jāyate sarvaṃ jyaiṣṭhyam apsu pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नेत्य् उक्त्वान्योन्यम् ऋषयो जग्मुः क्षीरोदशायिनम् तुष्टुवुर् विविधैः स्तोत्रैः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम्
verses.transliteration: nety uktvānyonyam ṛṣayo jagmuḥ kṣīrodaśāyinam tuṣṭuvur vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो वेद सर्वं भुवनं भविष्यद् यज् जायमानं च गुहानिविष्टम् लोकत्रयं चित्रविचित्ररूपम् अन्ते समस्तं च यम् आविवेश
verses.transliteration: yo veda sarvaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhaviṣyad yaj jāyamānaṃ ca guhāniviṣṭam lokatrayaṃ citravicitrarūpam ante samastaṃ ca yam āviveśa
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यद् अक्षरं शाश्वतम् अप्रमेयं यं वेदवेद्यम् ऋषयो वदन्ति यम् आश्रिताः स्वेप्सितम् आप्नुवन्ति तद् वस्तु सत्यं शरणं व्रजामः
verses.transliteration: yad akṣaraṃ śāśvatam aprameyaṃ yaṃ vedavedyam ṛṣayo vadanti yam āśritāḥ svepsitam āpnuvanti tad vastu satyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmaḥ
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भूतं महाभूतजगत्प्रधानं न विन्दते योगिनो विष्णुरूपम् तद् वक्तुम् एते ऋषयो ऽत्र याताः सत्यं वदस्वेह जगन्निवास
verses.transliteration: bhūtaṃ mahābhūtajagatpradhānaṃ na vindate yogino viṣṇurūpam tad vaktum ete ṛṣayo 'tra yātāḥ satyaṃ vadasveha jagannivāsa
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वम् अन्तरात्माखिलदेहभाजां त्वम् एव सर्वं त्वयि सर्वम् ईश तथापि जानन्ति न केअपि कुत्रापि अहो भवन्तं प्रकृतिप्रभावात्
verses.transliteration: tvam antarātmākhiladehabhājāṃ tvam eva sarvaṃ tvayi sarvam īśa tathāpi jānanti na keapi kutrāpi aho bhavantaṃ prakṛtiprabhāvāt
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्राह जगद्धात्री दैवी वाग् अशरीरिणी
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prāha jagaddhātrī daivī vāg aśarīriṇī
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उभाव् आराध्य तपसा भक्त्या च नियमेन च यस्य स्यात् प्रथमं सिद्धिस् तद् भूतं ज्येष्ठम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: ubhāv ārādhya tapasā bhaktyā ca niyamena ca yasya syāt prathamaṃ siddhis tad bhūtaṃ jyeṣṭham ucyate
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् तथा ययुः सर्वे ऋषयो लोकपूजिताः श्रान्ताः खिन्नान्तरात्मानः परं वैराग्यम् आश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: tathety tathā yayuḥ sarve ṛṣayo lokapūjitāḥ śrāntāḥ khinnāntarātmānaḥ paraṃ vairāgyam āśritāḥ
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकैकजननीं भुवनत्रयपावनीम् गौतमीम् अगमन् सर्वे तपस् तप्तुं यतव्रताः
verses.transliteration: sarvalokaikajananīṃ bhuvanatrayapāvanīm gautamīm agaman sarve tapas taptuṃ yatavratāḥ
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अब्दैवतं तथाग्निं च पूजनायोद्यतास् तदा अग्नेश् च पूजका ये च अपां वै पूजने स्थिताः तत्र वाग् अब्रवीद् दैवी वेदमाता सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: abdaivataṃ tathāgniṃ ca pūjanāyodyatās tadā agneś ca pūjakā ye ca apāṃ vai pūjane sthitāḥ tatra vāg abravīd daivī vedamātā sarasvatī
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेर् आपस् तथा योनिर् अद्भिः शौचम् अवाप्यते अग्नेश् च पूजका ये च विनाद्भिः पूजनं कथम्
verses.transliteration: agner āpas tathā yonir adbhiḥ śaucam avāpyate agneś ca pūjakā ye ca vinādbhiḥ pūjanaṃ katham
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अप्सु जातासु सर्वत्र कर्मण्य् अधिकृतो भवेत् तावत् कर्मण्य् अनर्हो ऽयम् अशुचिर् मलिनो नरः
verses.transliteration: apsu jātāsu sarvatra karmaṇy adhikṛto bhavet tāvat karmaṇy anarho 'yam aśucir malino naraḥ
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न मग्नः श्रद्धया यावद् अप्सु शीतासु वेदवित् तस्माद् आपो वरिष्ठाः स्युर् मातृभूता यतः स्मृताः तस्माज् ज्यैष्ठ्यम् अपाम् एव जनन्यो ऽग्नेर् विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: na magnaḥ śraddhayā yāvad apsu śītāsu vedavit tasmād āpo variṣṭhāḥ syur mātṛbhūtā yataḥ smṛtāḥ tasmāj jyaiṣṭhyam apām eva jananyo 'gner viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वचः शुश्रुवुस् ते ऋषयो वेदवादिनः निश्चयं च ततश् चक्रुर् भवेज् ज्यैष्ठ्यम् अपाम् इति
verses.transliteration: etad vacaḥ śuśruvus te ṛṣayo vedavādinaḥ niścayaṃ ca tataś cakrur bhavej jyaiṣṭhyam apām iti
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र तीर्थे वृत्तम् इदम् ऋषिसत्त्रे च नारद तपस्तीर्थं तु तत् प्रोक्तं सत्त्रतीर्थं तद् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: yatra tīrthe vṛttam idam ṛṣisattre ca nārada tapastīrthaṃ tu tat proktaṃ sattratīrthaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्नितीर्थं च तत् प्रोक्तं तथा सारस्वतं विदुः तेषु स्नानं च दानं च सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: agnitīrthaṃ ca tat proktaṃ tathā sārasvataṃ viduḥ teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दश शतान्य् अत्र तीर्थानां पुण्यदायिनाम् तेषु स्नानं च दानं च स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: caturdaśa śatāny atra tīrthānāṃ puṇyadāyinām teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca svargamokṣapradāyakam
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृतं संदेहहरणम् ऋषीणां यत्र भाषया सरस्वत्य् अभवत् तत्र गङ्गया संगता नदी माहात्म्यं तस्य को वक्तुं संगमस्य क्षमो नरः
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ saṃdehaharaṇam ṛṣīṇāṃ yatra bhāṣayā sarasvaty abhavat tatra gaṅgayā saṃgatā nadī māhātmyaṃ tasya ko vaktuṃ saṃgamasya kṣamo naraḥ
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं गङ्गाया उत्तरे तटे तस्य प्रभावं वक्ष्यामि सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: devatīrtham iti khyātaṃ gaṅgāyā uttare taṭe tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, when the water encroaches upon the abode of seven sages (Great Bear) the entire area of the three worlds becomes a vast sheet of water.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आर्ष्टिषेण इति ख्यातो राजा सर्वगुणान्वितः तस्य भार्या जया नाम साक्षाल् लक्ष्मीर् इवापरा
verses.transliteration: ārṣṭiṣeṇa iti khyāto rājā sarvaguṇānvitaḥ tasya bhāryā jayā nāma sākṣāl lakṣmīr ivāparā
verses.translation: Then, O brahmins, the wind arising out of the expiration of Visnu destroys those clouds in the course of hundred years and more.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रो भरो नाम मतिमान् पितृवत्सलः धनुर्वेदे च वेदे च निष्णातो दक्ष एव च
verses.transliteration: tasya putro bharo nāma matimān pitṛvatsalaḥ dhanurvede ca vede ca niṣṇāto dakṣa eva ca
verses.translation: He then employs the divine Yoganidra (yogic slumber) consisting of Maya of the Atman (soul). He is the Supreme lord pondering over himself with the appellation of Vasudeva.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्या रूपवती सुप्रभेत्य् अभिविश्रुता आर्ष्टिषेणस् ततो राजा पुत्रे राज्यं निवेश्य सः
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā rūpavatī suprabhety abhiviśrutā ārṣṭiṣeṇas tato rājā putre rājyaṃ niveśya saḥ
verses.translation: A thousand sets of four Yugas constitute a day of the lotus-born Brahma. When the whole universe becomes a vast sheet of water, a period of as much duration is said to be his night.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरोधसा च मुख्येन दीक्षां चक्रे नरेश्वरः सरस्वत्यास् ततस् तीरे हयमेधाय यत्नवान्
verses.transliteration: purodhasā ca mukhyena dīkṣāṃ cakre nareśvaraḥ sarasvatyās tatas tīre hayamedhāya yatnavān
verses.translation: Waking up at the close of the night, Brahma continues the work of creation. As mentioned to you before, it is Visnu who assumes this form of'Brahma and continues the work of creation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋत्विग्भिर् ऋषिमुख्यैश् च वेदशास्त्रपरायणैः दीक्षितं तं नृपश्रेष्ठं ब्राह्मणाग्निसमीपतः
verses.transliteration: ṛtvigbhir ṛṣimukhyaiś ca vedaśāstraparāyaṇaiḥ dīkṣitaṃ taṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ brāhmaṇāgnisamīpataḥ
verses.translation: The (special) quality of the waters (i.e. taste) is drunk (consumed and destroyed) by the Fire element. When the Rasatanmatra (the subtle primary element of taste) is destroyed, the heated waters perish.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मिथुर् दानवराट् शूरः पापबुद्धिः प्रतापवान् मखं विध्वस्य नृपतिं सभार्यं सपुरोहितम्
verses.transliteration: mithur dānavarāṭ śūraḥ pāpabuddhiḥ pratāpavān makhaṃ vidhvasya nṛpatiṃ sabhāryaṃ sapurohitam
verses.translation: It spreads everywhere, at the sides, above and below along with its rays. The fire-element has its great quality, rupa (colour), that causes lustre, that is destroyed by Vayu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आदाय वेगात् स प्रागाद् रसातलतलं मुने नीते तस्मिन् नृपवरे यज्ञे नष्टे ततो ऽमराः
verses.transliteration: ādāya vegāt sa prāgād rasātalatalaṃ mune nīte tasmin nṛpavare yajñe naṣṭe tato 'marāḥ
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋत्विजश् च ययुः सर्वे स्वं स्वं स्थानं मखात् ततः पुरोहितसुतो राज्ञो देवापिर् इति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: ṛtvijaś ca yayuḥ sarve svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ makhāt tataḥ purohitasuto rājño devāpir iti viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बालस् तां मातरं दृष्ट्वा आत्मनः पितरं न च दृष्ट्वा सविस्मयो भूत्वा दुःखितो ऽतीव चाभवत्
verses.transliteration: bālas tāṃ mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā ātmanaḥ pitaraṃ na ca dṛṣṭvā savismayo bhūtvā duḥkhito 'tīva cābhavat
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स मातरं तु पप्रच्छ पिता मे क्व गतो ऽम्बिके पितृहीनो न जीवेयं मातः सत्यं वदस्व मे
verses.transliteration: sa mātaraṃ tu papraccha pitā me kva gato 'mbike pitṛhīno na jīveyaṃ mātaḥ satyaṃ vadasva me
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धिग् धिक् पितृविहीनानां जीवितं पापकर्मणाम् न वक्षि यदि मे मातर् जलम् अग्निम् अथाविशे
verses.transliteration: dhig dhik pitṛvihīnānāṃ jīvitaṃ pāpakarmaṇām na vakṣi yadi me mātar jalam agnim athāviśe
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रं प्रोवाच सा माता राज्ञो भार्या पुरोधसः दानवेन तलं नीतो राज्ञा सह पिता तव
verses.transliteration: putraṃ provāca sā mātā rājño bhāryā purodhasaḥ dānavena talaṃ nīto rājñā saha pitā tava
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्व नीतः केन वा नीतः कथं नीतः क्व कर्मणि केषु पश्यत्सु किं स्थानं दानवस्य वदस्व मे
verses.transliteration: kva nītaḥ kena vā nītaḥ kathaṃ nītaḥ kva karmaṇi keṣu paśyatsu kiṃ sthānaṃ dānavasya vadasva me
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दीक्षितं यज्ञसदसि सभार्यं सपुरोधसम् राजानं तं मिथुर् दैत्यो नीतवान् स रसातलम् पश्यत्सु देवसंघेषु वह्निब्राह्मणसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration: dīkṣitaṃ yajñasadasi sabhāryaṃ sapurodhasam rājānaṃ taṃ mithur daityo nītavān sa rasātalam paśyatsu devasaṃgheṣu vahnibrāhmaṇasaṃnidhau
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तन् मातृवचनं श्रुत्वा देवापिः कृत्यम् अस्मरत् देवान् पश्ये ऽथवाग्निं वा ऋत्विजो वासुरांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: tan mātṛvacanaṃ śrutvā devāpiḥ kṛtyam asmarat devān paśye 'thavāgniṃ vā ṛtvijo vāsurāṃs tathā
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतेष्व् एव पितान्वेष्यो नान्यत्रेति मतिर् मम इति निश्चित्य देवापिर् भरं प्राह नृपात्मजम्
verses.transliteration: eteṣv eva pitānveṣyo nānyatreti matir mama iti niścitya devāpir bharaṃ prāha nṛpātmajam
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण व्रतेन नियमेन च आनेतव्या मया सर्वे नीता ये च रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: tapasā brahmacaryeṇa vratena niyamena ca ānetavyā mayā sarve nītā ye ca rasātalam
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जाते पराभवे घोरे यो न कुर्यात् प्रतिक्रियाम् नराधमेन किं तेन जीवता वा मृतेन वा
verses.transliteration: jāte parābhave ghore yo na kuryāt pratikriyām narādhamena kiṃ tena jīvatā vā mṛtena vā
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वं प्रशाधि महीं कृत्स्नाम् आर्ष्टिषेणः पिता यथा माता मम त्वया पाल्या राजन् यावन् ममागतिः भवेच् च कृतकार्यस्य अनुजानीहि मां भर
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ praśādhi mahīṃ kṛtsnām ārṣṭiṣeṇaḥ pitā yathā mātā mama tvayā pālyā rājan yāvan mamāgatiḥ bhavec ca kṛtakāryasya anujānīhi māṃ bhara
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भरेणोक्तः स देवापिः सर्वं निश्चित्य यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: bhareṇoktaḥ sa devāpiḥ sarvaṃ niścitya yatnataḥ
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धिं कुरु सुखं याहि मा चिन्ताम् अल्पिकां भज
verses.transliteration: siddhiṃ kuru sukhaṃ yāhi mā cintām alpikāṃ bhaja
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवापिर् अमरराजाङ्घ्रिध्यानतत्परः ऋत्विजो ऽन्वेष्य यत्नेन नत्वा तान् ऋत्विजः पृथक् कृताञ्जलिपुटो बालो देवापिर् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tato devāpir amararājāṅghridhyānatatparaḥ ṛtvijo 'nveṣya yatnena natvā tān ṛtvijaḥ pṛthak kṛtāñjalipuṭo bālo devāpir vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भवद्भिश् च मखो रक्ष्यो यजमानश् च दीक्षितः पुरोधाश् च तथा रक्ष्यः पत्नी या दीक्षितस्य तु
verses.transliteration: bhavadbhiś ca makho rakṣyo yajamānaś ca dīkṣitaḥ purodhāś ca tathā rakṣyaḥ patnī yā dīkṣitasya tu
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भवत्सु तत्र पश्यत्सु यज्ञं विध्वस्य दैत्यराट् राजादयस् तेन नीतास् तन् न युक्ततमं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: bhavatsu tatra paśyatsu yajñaṃ vidhvasya daityarāṭ rājādayas tena nītās tan na yuktatamaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अथाप्य् एतद् अहं मन्ये भवन्तस् तान् अरोगिणः दातुम् अर्हन्ति तान् सर्वान् अन्यथा शापम् अर्हथ
verses.transliteration: athāpy etad ahaṃ manye bhavantas tān arogiṇaḥ dātum arhanti tān sarvān anyathā śāpam arhatha
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मखे ऽग्निः प्रथमं पूज्यो ह्य् अग्निर् एवात्र दैवतम् तस्माद् वयं न जानीमो ह्य् अग्नीनां परिचारकाः
verses.transliteration: makhe 'gniḥ prathamaṃ pūjyo hy agnir evātra daivatam tasmād vayaṃ na jānīmo hy agnīnāṃ paricārakāḥ
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स एव दाता भोक्ता च हर्ता कर्ता च हव्यवाट्
verses.transliteration: sa eva dātā bhoktā ca hartā kartā ca havyavāṭ
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋत्विजः पृष्ठतः कृत्वा देवापिर् जातवेदसम् पूजयित्वा यथान्यायम् अग्नये तन् न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: ṛtvijaḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā devāpir jātavedasam pūjayitvā yathānyāyam agnaye tan nyavedayat
