verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथर्त्विजस् तथा चाहं देवानां परिचारकः हव्यं वहामि देवानां भोक्तारो रक्षकाश् च ते
verses.transliteration: yathartvijas tathā cāhaṃ devānāṃ paricārakaḥ havyaṃ vahāmi devānāṃ bhoktāro rakṣakāś ca te
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवान् आहूय यत्नेन हविर्भागान् पृथक् पृथक् दास्ये ऽहम् एष दोषो मे तस्माद् याहि सुरान् प्रति
verses.transliteration: devān āhūya yatnena havirbhāgān pṛthak pṛthak dāsye 'ham eṣa doṣo me tasmād yāhi surān prati
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवापिः स सुरान् प्राप्य नत्वा तेभ्यः पृथक् पृथक् ऋत्विग्वाक्यं चाग्निवाक्यं शापं चापि न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: devāpiḥ sa surān prāpya natvā tebhyaḥ pṛthak pṛthak ṛtvigvākyaṃ cāgnivākyaṃ śāpaṃ cāpi nyavedayat
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आहूता वैदिकैर् मन्त्रैर् ऋत्विग्भिश् च यथाक्रमम् भोक्ष्यामहे हविर्भागान् न स्वतन्त्रा द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: āhūtā vaidikair mantrair ṛtvigbhiś ca yathākramam bhokṣyāmahe havirbhāgān na svatantrā dvijottama
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् वेदानुगा नित्यं वयं वेदेन चोदिताः परतन्त्रास् ततो विप्र वेदेभ्यस् तन् निवेदय
verses.transliteration: tasmād vedānugā nityaṃ vayaṃ vedena coditāḥ paratantrās tato vipra vedebhyas tan nivedaya
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स देवापिः शुचिर् भूत्वा वेदान् आहूय यत्नतः ध्यानेन तपसा युक्तो वेदाश् चापि पुरो ऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: sa devāpiḥ śucir bhūtvā vedān āhūya yatnataḥ dhyānena tapasā yukto vedāś cāpi puro 'bhavan
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वेदान् उवाच देवापिर् नमस्य तु पुनः पुनः ऋत्विग्वाक्यं चाग्निवाक्यं देववाक्यं न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: vedān uvāca devāpir namasya tu punaḥ punaḥ ṛtvigvākyaṃ cāgnivākyaṃ devavākyaṃ nyavedayat
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: परतन्त्रा वयं तात ईश्वरस्य वशानुगाः अशेषजगदाधारो निराधारो निरञ्जनः
verses.transliteration: paratantrā vayaṃ tāta īśvarasya vaśānugāḥ aśeṣajagadādhāro nirādhāro nirañjanaḥ
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशक्त्यैकसदनं निधानं सर्वसंपदाम् स तु कर्ता महादेवः संहर्ता स महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sarvaśaktyaikasadanaṃ nidhānaṃ sarvasaṃpadām sa tu kartā mahādevaḥ saṃhartā sa maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वयं शब्दमया ब्रह्मन् वदामो विद्म एव च अस्माकम् एतत् कृत्यं स्याद् वदामो यत् तु पृच्छसि
verses.transliteration: vayaṃ śabdamayā brahman vadāmo vidma eva ca asmākam etat kṛtyaṃ syād vadāmo yat tu pṛcchasi
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: केन नीतास् तस्य नाम तत्पुरं तद्बलं तथा भक्षिताः किं तु नो नष्टा एतज् जानीमहे वयम्
verses.transliteration: kena nītās tasya nāma tatpuraṃ tadbalaṃ tathā bhakṣitāḥ kiṃ tu no naṣṭā etaj jānīmahe vayam
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथा च तव सामर्थ्यं यम् आराध्य च यत्र च स्याद् इत्य् एतच् च जानीमो यथा प्राप्स्यसि तान् पुरः
verses.transliteration: yathā ca tava sāmarthyaṃ yam ārādhya ca yatra ca syād ity etac ca jānīmo yathā prāpsyasi tān puraḥ
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वावदद् वेदान् विचार्य सुचिरं हृदि
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvāvadad vedān vicārya suciraṃ hṛdi
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वेदा वदन्त्व् एतद् एव सर्वम् एव यथार्थतः सर्वान् प्राप्स्ये तलं नीतान् अलं तेभ्यो नमो ऽस्तु वः
verses.transliteration: vedā vadantv etad eva sarvam eva yathārthataḥ sarvān prāpsye talaṃ nītān alaṃ tebhyo namo 'stu vaḥ
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतमीं गच्छ देवापे तत्र स्तुहि महेश्वरम् सुप्रसन्नस् तवाभीष्टं दास्यत्य् एव कृपाकरः
verses.transliteration: gautamīṃ gaccha devāpe tatra stuhi maheśvaram suprasannas tavābhīṣṭaṃ dāsyaty eva kṛpākaraḥ
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भवेद् देवः शिवः प्रीतः स्तुतः सत्यं महामते आर्ष्टिषेणश् च नृपतिस् तस्य जाया जया सती
verses.transliteration: bhaved devaḥ śivaḥ prītaḥ stutaḥ satyaṃ mahāmate ārṣṭiṣeṇaś ca nṛpatis tasya jāyā jayā satī
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पिता तवाप्य् उपमन्युस् तले तिष्ठन्त्य् अरोगिणः वरदानान् महेशस्य मिथुं हत्वा च राक्षसम् यशः प्राप्स्यसि धर्मं च एतच् छक्यं न चेतरत्
verses.transliteration: pitā tavāpy upamanyus tale tiṣṭhanty arogiṇaḥ varadānān maheśasya mithuṃ hatvā ca rākṣasam yaśaḥ prāpsyasi dharmaṃ ca etac chakyaṃ na cetarat
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् वेदवचनाद् बालो देवापिर् गौतमीं गतः स्नात्वा कृतक्षणो विप्रस् तुष्टाव च महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tad vedavacanād bālo devāpir gautamīṃ gataḥ snātvā kṛtakṣaṇo vipras tuṣṭāva ca maheśvaram
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बालो ऽहं देवदेवेश गुरूणां त्वं गुरुर् मम न मे शक्तिस् त्वत्स्तवने तुभ्यं शंभो नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: bālo 'haṃ devadeveśa gurūṇāṃ tvaṃ gurur mama na me śaktis tvatstavane tubhyaṃ śaṃbho namo 'stu te
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न त्वां जानन्ति निगमा न देवा मुनयो न च न ब्रह्मा नापि वैकुण्ठो यो ऽसि सो ऽसि नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: na tvāṃ jānanti nigamā na devā munayo na ca na brahmā nāpi vaikuṇṭho yo 'si so 'si namo 'stu te
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽनाथा ये च कृपणा ये दरिद्राश् च रोगिणः पापात्मानो ये च लोके तांस् त्वं पासि महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: ye 'nāthā ye ca kṛpaṇā ye daridrāś ca rogiṇaḥ pāpātmāno ye ca loke tāṃs tvaṃ pāsi maheśvara
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तपसा नियमैर् मन्त्रैः पूजितास् त्रिदिवौकसः त्वया दत्तं फलं तेभ्यो दास्यन्ति जगतां पते
verses.transliteration: tapasā niyamair mantraiḥ pūjitās tridivaukasaḥ tvayā dattaṃ phalaṃ tebhyo dāsyanti jagatāṃ pate
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: याचितारश् च दातारस् तेभ्यो यद् यन् मनीषितम् भवतीति न चित्रं स्यात् त्वं विपर्ययकारकः
verses.transliteration: yācitāraś ca dātāras tebhyo yad yan manīṣitam bhavatīti na citraṃ syāt tvaṃ viparyayakārakaḥ
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽज्ञानिनो ये च पापा ये मग्ना नरकार्णवे शिवेति वचनान् नाथ तान् पासि त्वं जगद्गुरो
verses.transliteration: ye 'jñānino ye ca pāpā ye magnā narakārṇave śiveti vacanān nātha tān pāsi tvaṃ jagadguro
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं तु स्तुवतस् तस्य पुरः प्राह त्रिलोचनः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tu stuvatas tasya puraḥ prāha trilocanaḥ
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वरं ब्रूह्य् अथ देवापे अलं दैन्येन बालक
verses.transliteration: varaṃ brūhy atha devāpe alaṃ dainyena bālaka
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राजानं राजपत्नीं च पितरं च गुरुं मम प्राप्तुम् इच्छे जगन्नाथ निधनं च रिपोर् मम
verses.transliteration: rājānaṃ rājapatnīṃ ca pitaraṃ ca guruṃ mama prāptum icche jagannātha nidhanaṃ ca ripor mama
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवापिवचनं श्रुत्वा तथेत्य् आहाखिलेश्वरः देवापेः सर्वम् अभवद् आज्ञया शंकरस्य तत्
verses.transliteration: devāpivacanaṃ śrutvā tathety āhākhileśvaraḥ devāpeḥ sarvam abhavad ājñayā śaṃkarasya tat
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् अप्य् आह तं शंभुर् देवापिकरुणाकरः नन्दिनं प्रेषयाम् आस शंभुः शूलेन नारद
verses.transliteration: punar apy āha taṃ śaṃbhur devāpikaruṇākaraḥ nandinaṃ preṣayām āsa śaṃbhuḥ śūlena nārada
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रसातलं मिथुं नन्दी हत्वा चासुरपुंगवान् तत्पित्रादीन् समानीय तस्मै तान् स न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: rasātalaṃ mithuṃ nandī hatvā cāsurapuṃgavān tatpitrādīn samānīya tasmai tān sa nyavedayat
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हयमेधश् च तत्रासीद् आर्ष्टिषेणस्य धीमतः अग्निश् च ऋत्विजो देवा वेदाश् च ऋषयो ऽब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: hayamedhaś ca tatrāsīd ārṣṭiṣeṇasya dhīmataḥ agniś ca ṛtvijo devā vedāś ca ṛṣayo 'bruvan
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र साक्षाद् अभूच् छंभुर् देवापे भक्तवत्सलः देवदेवो जगन्नाथो देवतीर्थम् अभूच् च तत्
verses.transliteration: yatra sākṣād abhūc chaṃbhur devāpe bhaktavatsalaḥ devadevo jagannātho devatīrtham abhūc ca tat
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापक्षयकरं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदं नृणाम् पुण्यदं तीर्थम् एतत् स्यात् तव कीर्तिश् च शाश्वती
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇām puṇyadaṃ tīrtham etat syāt tava kīrtiś ca śāśvatī
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधे निवृत्ते तु सुरास् तेभ्यो वरान् ददुः स्नात्वा कृतार्था गङ्गायां ततस् ते दिवम् आक्रमन्
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhe nivṛtte tu surās tebhyo varān daduḥ snātvā kṛtārthā gaṅgāyāṃ tatas te divam ākraman
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत्रासंस् तीर्थानि दश पञ्च च सहस्राणि शतान्य् अष्टाव् उभयोर् अपि तीरयोः तेषु स्नानं च दानं च ह्य् अतीव फलदं विदुः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tatrāsaṃs tīrthāni daśa pañca ca sahasrāṇi śatāny aṣṭāv ubhayor api tīrayoḥ teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca hy atīva phaladaṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तपोवनम् इति ख्यातं नन्दिनीसंगमं तथा सिद्धेश्वरं तत्र तीर्थं गौतम्या दक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: tapovanam iti khyātaṃ nandinīsaṃgamaṃ tathā siddheśvaraṃ tatra tīrthaṃ gautamyā dakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: After understanding the three types of suffering, O brahmins, beginning with the Adhyatmika (i.e. the organic), a learned man realises perfect knowledge and has Vairagya (detachment). He then attains the ultimate re-absorption.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शार्दूलं चेति विख्यातं तेषां वृत्तम् इदं शृणु यस्याकर्णनमात्रेण सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: śārdūlaṃ ceti vikhyātaṃ teṣāṃ vṛttam idaṃ śṛṇu yasyākarṇanamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: The Adhibhautika (extraneous and material) suffering occurs to men from animals, birds, men, evil spirits, serpents, ogres, reptiles and other beings..
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर् होता पुरा त्व् आसीद् देवानां हव्यवाहनः भार्यां प्राप्तो दक्षसुतां स्वाहानाम्नीं सुरूपिणीम्
verses.transliteration: agnir hotā purā tv āsīd devānāṃ havyavāhanaḥ bhāryāṃ prāpto dakṣasutāṃ svāhānāmnīṃ surūpiṇīm
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, the suffering arising from cold¬ ness, heat, winds, rains, water, lightning etc. is called Adhi- daivika.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सानपत्या पुरा चासीत् पुत्रार्थं तप आविशत् तपश् चरन्तीं विपुलं तोषयन्तीं हुताशनम् स भर्ता हुतभुक् प्राह भार्यां स्वाहाम् अनिन्दिताम्
verses.transliteration: sānapatyā purā cāsīt putrārthaṃ tapa āviśat tapaś carantīṃ vipulaṃ toṣayantīṃ hutāśanam sa bhartā hutabhuk prāha bhāryāṃ svāhām aninditām
verses.translation: On being touched by the external wind he attains an extremely senseless state. On being born, O excellent sages, he attains the loss of special knowledge (of the previous births).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अपत्यानि भविष्यन्ति मा तपः कुरु शोभने
verses.transliteration: apatyāni bhaviṣyanti mā tapaḥ kuru śobhane
verses.translation: His limbs are afflicted as it were by thorns. I~Ie is pierced and split as it were by saws. He is just like a worm that has fallen on the ground from a pus-discharging foul ulcer.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा भर्तृवाक्यं निवृत्ता तपसो ऽभवत् स्त्रीणाम् अभीष्टदं नान्यद् भर्तृवाक्यं विना क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā bhartṛvākyaṃ nivṛttā tapaso 'bhavat strīṇām abhīṣṭadaṃ nānyad bhartṛvākyaṃ vinā kvacit
verses.translation: (Thus) the miseries at the time of birth are many. Similarly those Adhibhautika (extraneous and material) mise¬ ries too that he undergoes after his birth in the course of his childhood, are many.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः कतिपये काले तारकाद् भय आगते अनुत्पन्ने कार्त्तिकेये चिरकालरहोगते
verses.transliteration: tataḥ katipaye kāle tārakād bhaya āgate anutpanne kārttikeye cirakālarahogate
verses.translation: "What is good?" "What is evil?" "In what does it consist and how?" "What is our duty?" "What is it that we should refrain from?" "What is it that is meritorious?" "What is it that is faulty?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरे भवान्या च त्रस्ता देवाः समागताः देवानां कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थम् अग्निं प्रोचुर् दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: maheśvare bhavānyā ca trastā devāḥ samāgatāḥ devānāṃ kāryasiddhyartham agniṃ procur divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: Thus foolish men who like animals are given to sex and eating suffer great pain resulting from ignorance.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देव गच्छ महाभाग शंभुं त्रैलोक्यपूजितम् तारकाद् भयम् उत्पन्नं शंभवे त्वं निवेदय
verses.transliteration: deva gaccha mahābhāga śaṃbhuṃ trailokyapūjitam tārakād bhayam utpannaṃ śaṃbhave tvaṃ nivedaya
verses.translation: Sages say that the result of omission of duty is (fall¬ ing into) hell. Hence ignorant people experience excessive misery both here and hereafter.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न गन्तव्यं तत्र देशे दंपत्योः स्थितयो रहः सामान्यमात्रतो न्यायः किं पुनः शूलपाणिनि
verses.transliteration: na gantavyaṃ tatra deśe daṃpatyoḥ sthitayo rahaḥ sāmānyamātrato nyāyaḥ kiṃ punaḥ śūlapāṇini
verses.translation: Then, during old age man undergoes many miseries as follows: His body is shattered by old age. His limbs are en¬ feebled and flaccid. His teeth are broken and loose. He is covered by wrinkles and protruding sinews and neves and veins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकान्तस्थितयोः स्वैरं जल्पतोर् यः सरागयोः दंपत्योः शृणुयाद् वाक्यं निरयात् तस्य नोद्धृतिः
verses.transliteration: ekāntasthitayoḥ svairaṃ jalpator yaḥ sarāgayoḥ daṃpatyoḥ śṛṇuyād vākyaṃ nirayāt tasya noddhṛtiḥ
verses.translation: His eyes are incapable of seeing far off. His pupils are fixed to the sky. Clusters of hair come out of his nostrils. The whole of his body shakes and shivers.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स स्वाम्य् अखिललोकानां महाकालस् त्रिशूलवान् निरीक्षणीयः केन स्याद् भवान्या रहसि स्थितः
verses.transliteration: sa svāmy akhilalokānāṃ mahākālas triśūlavān nirīkṣaṇīyaḥ kena syād bhavānyā rahasi sthitaḥ
verses.translation: His bones are laid bare. The bones at his back are bent. Since his gastric fire does not function, he takes but little food. He is capable of only a few movements.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महाभये चानुगते न्यायः को ऽन्व् अत्र वर्ण्यते तारकाद् भय उत्पन्ने गच्छ त्वं तारको भवान्
verses.transliteration: mahābhaye cānugate nyāyaḥ ko 'nv atra varṇyate tārakād bhaya utpanne gaccha tvaṃ tārako bhavān
verses.translation: He experiences difficulties in rising up, in moving about, in lying down, in sitting and in his movements. His eyes and ears become less keen. Saliva exudes from his mouth and defiles his face.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महाभयाब्धौ साधूनां यत् परार्थाय जीवितम् रूपेणान्येन वा गच्छ वाचं वद यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: mahābhayābdhau sādhūnāṃ yat parārthāya jīvitam rūpeṇānyena vā gaccha vācaṃ vada yathā tathā
verses.translation: With his sense organs intractable he looks up to his early death. He is not capable of remembering anything experienced at the very same moment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्राव्य देववचनं शंभुम् आगच्छ सत्वरः ततो दास्यामहे पूजाम् उभयोर् लोकयोः कवे
verses.transliteration: viśrāvya devavacanaṃ śaṃbhum āgaccha satvaraḥ tato dāsyāmahe pūjām ubhayor lokayoḥ kave
verses.translation: In uttering a sentence even once he has to put in great effort. He spends sleepless nights due to the strain of ail¬ ments such as asthma, bronchitis (cough) etc.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शुको भूत्वा जगामाशु देववाक्याद् धुताशनः यत्रासीज् जगतां नाथो रममाणस् तदोमया
verses.transliteration: śuko bhūtvā jagāmāśu devavākyād dhutāśanaḥ yatrāsīj jagatāṃ nātho ramamāṇas tadomayā
verses.translation: The old man has to be lifted up or laid to rest with the help of another man. He is disdained and insulted by his ser¬ vants, sons and wife.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स भीतवद् अथ प्रायाच् छुको भूत्वा तदानलः नाशकद् द्वारदेशे तु प्रवेष्टुं हव्यवाहनः
verses.transliteration: sa bhītavad atha prāyāc chuko bhūtvā tadānalaḥ nāśakad dvāradeśe tu praveṣṭuṃ havyavāhanaḥ
verses.translation: Remembering the activities of his own youth as though they were experienced in another birth he is all the more dis¬ tressed. He then heaves deep sighs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो गवाक्षदेशे तु तस्थौ धुन्वन्न् अधोमुखः तं दृष्ट्वा प्रहसञ् शंभुर् उमां प्राह रहोगतः
verses.transliteration: tato gavākṣadeśe tu tasthau dhunvann adhomukhaḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā prahasañ śaṃbhur umāṃ prāha rahogataḥ
verses.translation: These and similar ones are the miseries he experiences in the old age. Now listen to those miseries which he experiences at the time of death.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पश्य देवि शुकं प्राप्तं देववाक्याद् धुताशनम्
verses.transliteration: paśya devi śukaṃ prāptaṃ devavākyād dhutāśanam
verses.translation: His bones and joints are torn and shorn as it were by great and terrible ailments like the saws that appear to be the arrows of the god of death. They pierce the vulnerable spots of his body.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लज्जिता चावदद् देवम् अलं देवेति पार्वती पुरश्चरन्तं देवेशो ह्य् अग्निं तं द्विजरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: lajjitā cāvadad devam alaṃ deveti pārvatī puraścarantaṃ deveśo hy agniṃ taṃ dvijarūpiṇam
verses.translation: The puplis of his eyes roll. He begins to beat and kick with his hands and feet. His palate, lips and throat become parched and he begins to snort and grumble.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आहूय बहुशश् चापि ज्ञातो ऽस्य् अग्ने ऽत्र मा वद विदारयस्व स्वमुखं गृहाणेदं नयस्व तत्
verses.transliteration: āhūya bahuśaś cāpi jñāto 'sy agne 'tra mā vada vidārayasva svamukhaṃ gṛhāṇedaṃ nayasva tat
verses.translation: The organic Udana wind afflicts him by choking his throat. An excessive heat spreads over him. He becomes dis¬ tressed due to thirst and hunger.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा तस्य चास्ये ऽग्ने रेतः स प्राक्षिपद् बहु रेतोगर्भस् तदा चाग्निर् गन्तुं नैव च शक्तवान्
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā tasya cāsye 'gne retaḥ sa prākṣipad bahu retogarbhas tadā cāgnir gantuṃ naiva ca śaktavān
verses.translation: These and other similar ones are the miseries of men at the time of death. Now listen to those miseries which are experienced in hell by the persons who die.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुरनद्यास् ततस् तीरं श्रान्तो ऽग्निर् उपतस्थिवान् कृत्तिकासु च तद् रेतः प्रक्षेपात् कार्त्तिको ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: suranadyās tatas tīraṃ śrānto 'gnir upatasthivān kṛttikāsu ca tad retaḥ prakṣepāt kārttiko 'bhavat
verses.translation: The dead undergoes tortures in various ways. The servants of Yama catch him by means of noose etc. They strike him with sticks. The very sight of Yama is terrible. It is terrible to behold even the path (leading to Yama's place).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अवशिष्टं च यत् किंचिद् अग्नेर् देहे च शांभवम् तद् एव रेतो वह्निस् तु स्वभार्यायां द्विधाक्षिपत्
verses.transliteration: avaśiṣṭaṃ ca yat kiṃcid agner dehe ca śāṃbhavam tad eva reto vahnis tu svabhāryāyāṃ dvidhākṣipat
verses.translation: O exellecnt brahmins, the tortures in different hells are different. They are terrible and the means employed are mud, sand, fire, mechanical devices, weapons etc.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहायां प्रियभूतायां पुत्रार्थिन्यां विशेषतः पुरा साश्वासिता तेन संततिस् ते भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: svāhāyāṃ priyabhūtāyāṃ putrārthinyāṃ viśeṣataḥ purā sāśvāsitā tena saṃtatis te bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Again he becomes a foetus in the womb. The man is born again. Again he gets merged into the womb on being born. He then perishes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् वह्निनाथ संस्मृत्य तत् क्षिप्तं शांभवं महः तद् अग्ने रेतसस् तस्यां जज्ञे मिथुनम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tad vahninātha saṃsmṛtya tat kṣiptaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ mahaḥ tad agne retasas tasyāṃ jajñe mithunam uttamam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, the means of attaining the same is said to be knowledge as well as holy rites. Knowledge is mentioned as twofold: 1) arising from scriptural texts and 2) arising from discrimination.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णश् च सुवर्णा च रूपेणाप्रतिमं भुवि अग्नेः प्रीतिकरं नित्यं लोकानां प्रीतिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: suvarṇaś ca suvarṇā ca rūpeṇāpratimaṃ bhuvi agneḥ prītikaraṃ nityaṃ lokānāṃ prītivardhanam
verses.translation: HeisSaguna (having attributes) and transcends all beings, Prakrti, Gunas and Dosas (merits and demerits). Since the entire inside of the universe is enveloped by him, he is Akhilatman (soul of all). He transcends all other coverings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः प्रीत्या सुवर्णां तां प्रादाद् धर्माय धीमते सुवर्णस्याथ पुत्रस्य संकल्पाम् अकरोत् प्रियाम् एवं पुत्रस्य पुत्र्याश् च विवाहम् अकरोत् कविः
verses.transliteration: agniḥ prītyā suvarṇāṃ tāṃ prādād dharmāya dhīmate suvarṇasyātha putrasya saṃkalpām akarot priyām evaṃ putrasya putryāś ca vivāham akarot kaviḥ
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यरेतोव्यतिषङ्गदोषाद् अग्नेर् अपत्यम् उभयं तथैव पुत्रः सुवर्णो बहुरूपरूपी रूपाणि कृत्वा सुरसत्तमानाम्
verses.transliteration: anyonyaretovyatiṣaṅgadoṣād agner apatyam ubhayaṃ tathaiva putraḥ suvarṇo bahurūparūpī rūpāṇi kṛtvā surasattamānām
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य वायोर् धनदस्य भार्यां जलेश्वरस्यापि मुनीश्वराणाम् भार्यास् तु गच्छत्य् अनिशं सुवर्णो यस्याः प्रियं यच् च वपुः स कृत्वा
verses.transliteration: indrasya vāyor dhanadasya bhāryāṃ jaleśvarasyāpi munīśvarāṇām bhāryās tu gacchaty aniśaṃ suvarṇo yasyāḥ priyaṃ yac ca vapuḥ sa kṛtvā
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: याति क्वचिच् चापि कवेस् तनूजस् तद्भर्तृरूपं च पतिव्रतासु कृत्वानिशं ताभिर् उदारभावः कुर्वन् कृतार्थं मदनं स रेमे
verses.transliteration: yāti kvacic cāpi kaves tanūjas tadbhartṛrūpaṃ ca pativratāsu kṛtvāniśaṃ tābhir udārabhāvaḥ kurvan kṛtārthaṃ madanaṃ sa reme
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा गता क्वापि चैवं सुवर्णा धर्मस्य भार्यापि सुवर्णनाम्नी स्वाहासुता स्वैरिणी सा बभूव यस्यापि यस्यापि मनोगता या
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā gatā kvāpi caivaṃ suvarṇā dharmasya bhāryāpi suvarṇanāmnī svāhāsutā svairiṇī sā babhūva yasyāpi yasyāpi manogatā yā
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भार्यास्वरूपा सैव भूत्वा सुवर्णा रेमे पतीन् मानुषान् आसुरांश् च देवान् ऋषीन् पितृरूपांस् तथान्यान् रूपौदार्यस्थैर्यगाम्भीर्ययुक्तान्
verses.transliteration: bhāryāsvarūpā saiva bhūtvā suvarṇā reme patīn mānuṣān āsurāṃś ca devān ṛṣīn pitṛrūpāṃs tathānyān rūpaudāryasthairyagāmbhīryayuktān
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: याभिप्रेता यस्य देवस्य भार्या तद्रूपा सा रमते तेन सार्धम् नानाभेदैः करणैश् चाप्य् अनेकैर् आकर्षन्ती तन्मनः कामसिद्धिम्
verses.transliteration: yābhipretā yasya devasya bhāryā tadrūpā sā ramate tena sārdham nānābhedaiḥ karaṇaiś cāpy anekair ākarṣantī tanmanaḥ kāmasiddhim
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं सुवर्णस्य निरीक्ष्य चेष्टाम् अग्नेः सूनोः पुत्रिकायास् तथाग्नेः सर्वे च शेपुः कुपितास् तदाग्नेः पुत्रं च पुत्रीं च सुरासुरास् ते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ suvarṇasya nirīkṣya ceṣṭām agneḥ sūnoḥ putrikāyās tathāgneḥ sarve ca śepuḥ kupitās tadāgneḥ putraṃ ca putrīṃ ca surāsurās te
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृतं यद् एतद् व्यभिचाररूपं यच् छद्मना वर्तनं पापरूपम् तस्मात् सुतस् ते व्यभिचारवांश् च सर्वत्र गामी जायतां हव्यवाह
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ yad etad vyabhicārarūpaṃ yac chadmanā vartanaṃ pāparūpam tasmāt sutas te vyabhicāravāṃś ca sarvatra gāmī jāyatāṃ havyavāha
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा सुवर्णापि न चैकनिष्ठा भूयाद् अग्ने नैकतृप्ता बहूंश् च नानाजातीन् निन्दितान् देहभाजो भजित्री स्याद् एष दोषश् च पुत्र्याः
verses.transliteration: tathā suvarṇāpi na caikaniṣṭhā bhūyād agne naikatṛptā bahūṃś ca nānājātīn ninditān dehabhājo bhajitrī syād eṣa doṣaś ca putryāḥ
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एतच् छापवचनं श्रुत्वाग्निर् अतिभीतवत् माम् अभ्येत्य तदोवाच निष्कृतिं वद पुत्रयोः
verses.transliteration: ity etac chāpavacanaṃ śrutvāgnir atibhītavat mām abhyetya tadovāca niṣkṛtiṃ vada putrayoḥ
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदाहम् अब्रवं वह्ने गौतमीं गच्छ शंकरम् स्तुत्वा तत्र महाबाहो निवेदय जगत्पतेः
verses.transliteration: tadāham abravaṃ vahne gautamīṃ gaccha śaṃkaram stutvā tatra mahābāho nivedaya jagatpateḥ
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: माहेश्वरेण वीर्येण तव देहस्थितेन च एवंविधं त्व् अपत्यं ते जातं वह्ने ततो भवान्
verses.transliteration: māheśvareṇa vīryeṇa tava dehasthitena ca evaṃvidhaṃ tv apatyaṃ te jātaṃ vahne tato bhavān
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निवेदयस्व देवाय देवानां शापम् ईदृशम् स्वापत्यरक्षणायासौ शंभुः श्रेयः करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: nivedayasva devāya devānāṃ śāpam īdṛśam svāpatyarakṣaṇāyāsau śaṃbhuḥ śreyaḥ kariṣyati
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्तुहि देवं च देवीं च भक्त्या प्रीतो भवेच् छिवः ततस् त्व् अपत्यविषये प्रियान् कामान् अवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: stuhi devaṃ ca devīṃ ca bhaktyā prīto bhavec chivaḥ tatas tv apatyaviṣaye priyān kāmān avāpsyasi
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो मद्वचनाद् अग्निर् गङ्गां गत्वा महेश्वरम् तुष्टाव नियतो वाक्यैः स्तुतिभिर् वेदसंमितैः
verses.transliteration: tato madvacanād agnir gaṅgāṃ gatvā maheśvaram tuṣṭāva niyato vākyaiḥ stutibhir vedasaṃmitaiḥ
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वस्य जगतो धाता विश्वमूर्तिर् निरञ्जनः आदिकर्ता स्वयंभूश् च तं नमामि जगत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: viśvasya jagato dhātā viśvamūrtir nirañjanaḥ ādikartā svayaṃbhūś ca taṃ namāmi jagatpatim
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽग्निर् भूत्वा संहरति स्रष्टा वै जलरूपतः सूर्यरूपेण यः पाति तं नमामि च त्र्यम्बकम्
verses.transliteration: yo 'gnir bhūtvā saṃharati sraṣṭā vai jalarūpataḥ sūryarūpeṇa yaḥ pāti taṃ namāmi ca tryambakam
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान् अनन्तः शंभुर् अव्ययः वरेण च्छन्दयाम् आस पावकं सुरपूजितम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno bhagavān anantaḥ śaṃbhur avyayaḥ vareṇa cchandayām āsa pāvakaṃ surapūjitam
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स विनीतः शिवं प्राह तव वीर्यं मयि स्थितम् तेन जातः सुतो रम्यः सुवर्णो लोकविश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: sa vinītaḥ śivaṃ prāha tava vīryaṃ mayi sthitam tena jātaḥ suto ramyaḥ suvarṇo lokaviśrutaḥ
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा सुवर्णा पुत्री च तस्माद् एव जगत्प्रभो अन्योन्यवीर्यसङ्गाच् च तद्दोषाद् उभयं त्व् इदम्
verses.transliteration: tathā suvarṇā putrī ca tasmād eva jagatprabho anyonyavīryasaṅgāc ca taddoṣād ubhayaṃ tv idam
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: व्यभिचारात् सदोषं च अपत्यम् अभवच् छिव शापं ददुः सुराः सर्वे तयोः शान्तिं कुरु प्रभो
verses.transliteration: vyabhicārāt sadoṣaṃ ca apatyam abhavac chiva śāpaṃ daduḥ surāḥ sarve tayoḥ śāntiṃ kuru prabho
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदग्निवचनाच् छंभुः प्रोवाचेदं शुभोदयम्
verses.transliteration: tadagnivacanāc chaṃbhuḥ provācedaṃ śubhodayam
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मद्वीर्याद् अभवत् त्वत्तः सुवर्णो भूरिविक्रमः समग्रा ऋद्धयः सर्वाः सुवर्णे ऽस्मिन् समाहिताः
verses.transliteration: madvīryād abhavat tvattaḥ suvarṇo bhūrivikramaḥ samagrā ṛddhayaḥ sarvāḥ suvarṇe 'smin samāhitāḥ
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यन्ति न संदेहो वह्ने शृणु वचो मम त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानां पावनः स भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyanti na saṃdeho vahne śṛṇu vaco mama trayāṇām api lokānāṃ pāvanaḥ sa bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स एव चामृतं लोके स एव सुरवल्लभः स एव भुक्तिमुक्ती च स एव मखदक्षिणा
verses.transliteration: sa eva cāmṛtaṃ loke sa eva suravallabhaḥ sa eva bhuktimuktī ca sa eva makhadakṣiṇā
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).

verses.sanskrit: स एव रूपं सर्वस्य गुरूणाम् अप्य् असौ गुरुः वीर्यं श्रेष्ठतमं विद्याद् वीर्यं मत्तो यद् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sa eva rūpaṃ sarvasya gurūṇām apy asau guruḥ vīryaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ vidyād vīryaṃ matto yad uttamam
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विशेषतस् त्वयि क्षिप्तं तस्य का स्याद् विचारणा हीनं तेन विना सर्वं संपूर्णास् तेन संपदः
verses.transliteration: viśeṣatas tvayi kṣiptaṃ tasya kā syād vicāraṇā hīnaṃ tena vinā sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇās tena saṃpadaḥ
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जीवन्तो ऽपि मृताः सर्वे सुवर्णेन विना नराः निर्गुणो ऽपि धनी मान्यः सगुणो ऽप्य् अधनो नहि
verses.transliteration: jīvanto 'pi mṛtāḥ sarve suvarṇena vinā narāḥ nirguṇo 'pi dhanī mānyaḥ saguṇo 'py adhano nahi
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान् नातः परं किंचित् सुवर्णाद् धि भविष्यति तथा चैषा सुवर्णापि स्याद् उत्कृष्टापि चञ्चला
verses.transliteration: tasmān nātaḥ paraṃ kiṃcit suvarṇād dhi bhaviṣyati tathā caiṣā suvarṇāpi syād utkṛṣṭāpi cañcalā
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनया वीक्षितं सर्वं न्यूनं पूर्णं भविष्यति तपसा जपहोमैश् च येयं प्राप्या जगत्त्रये
verses.transliteration: anayā vīkṣitaṃ sarvaṃ nyūnaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati tapasā japahomaiś ca yeyaṃ prāpyā jagattraye
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः प्रभावं प्राशस्त्यम् अग्ने किंचिच् च कीर्त्यते सर्वत्र या तु संतिष्ठेद् आयातु विचरिष्यति
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ prabhāvaṃ prāśastyam agne kiṃcic ca kīrtyate sarvatra yā tu saṃtiṣṭhed āyātu vicariṣyati
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णा कमला साक्षात् पवित्रा च भविष्यति अद्य प्रभृत्य् आत्मजयोस् तथा स्वैरं विचेष्टतोः
verses.transliteration: suvarṇā kamalā sākṣāt pavitrā ca bhaviṣyati adya prabhṛty ātmajayos tathā svairaṃ viceṣṭatoḥ
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथापि चैतयोः पुण्यं न भूतं न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tathāpi caitayoḥ puṇyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा ततः शंभुः साक्षात् तत्राभवच् छिवः लिङ्गरूपेण सर्वेषां लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ sākṣāt tatrābhavac chivaḥ liṅgarūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वरान् प्राप्य सुताभ्यां स अग्निस् तुष्टो ऽभवत् ततः स्वभर्त्रा च सुवर्णा सा धर्मेणाग्निसुता मुदा
verses.transliteration: varān prāpya sutābhyāṃ sa agnis tuṣṭo 'bhavat tataḥ svabhartrā ca suvarṇā sā dharmeṇāgnisutā mudā
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वर्तयाम् आस पुत्रो ऽपि वह्नेः संकल्पया मुदा एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे स्वर्णाम् अग्नेर् दुहितरं मुने
verses.transliteration: vartayām āsa putro 'pi vahneḥ saṃkalpayā mudā etasminn antare svarṇām agner duhitaraṃ mune
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: परिभूय च धर्मं तं शार्दूलो दानवेश्वरः अहरद् भाग्यसौभाग्यविलासवसतिं छलात्
verses.transliteration: paribhūya ca dharmaṃ taṃ śārdūlo dānaveśvaraḥ aharad bhāgyasaubhāgyavilāsavasatiṃ chalāt
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नीता रसातलं तेन सुवर्णा लोकविश्रुता जामाताग्नेः स धर्मश् च अग्निश् चैव स हव्यवाट्
verses.transliteration: nītā rasātalaṃ tena suvarṇā lokaviśrutā jāmātāgneḥ sa dharmaś ca agniś caiva sa havyavāṭ
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विष्णवे लोकनाथाय स्तुत्वा चैव पुनः पुनः कार्यविज्ञापनं चोभौ चक्रतुः प्रभविष्णवे
verses.transliteration: viṣṇave lokanāthāya stutvā caiva punaḥ punaḥ kāryavijñāpanaṃ cobhau cakratuḥ prabhaviṣṇave
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततश् चक्रेण चिच्छेद शार्दूलस्य शिरो हरिः सानीता विष्णुना देवी सुवर्णा लोकसुन्दरी
verses.transliteration: tataś cakreṇa ciccheda śārdūlasya śiro hariḥ sānītā viṣṇunā devī suvarṇā lokasundarī
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरसुता चैव अग्नेश् चैव तथा प्रिया महेश्वराय तां विष्णुर् दर्शयाम् आस नारद
verses.transliteration: maheśvarasutā caiva agneś caiva tathā priyā maheśvarāya tāṃ viṣṇur darśayām āsa nārada
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतो ऽभवन् महेशो ऽपि सस्वजे तां पुनः पुनः चक्रं प्रक्षालितं यत्र शार्दूलच्छेदि दीप्तिमत्
verses.transliteration: prīto 'bhavan maheśo 'pi sasvaje tāṃ punaḥ punaḥ cakraṃ prakṣālitaṃ yatra śārdūlacchedi dīptimat
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चक्रतीर्थं तु विख्यातं शार्दूलं चेति तद् विदुः यत्र नीता सुवर्णा सा विष्णुना शंकरान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: cakratīrthaṃ tu vikhyātaṃ śārdūlaṃ ceti tad viduḥ yatra nītā suvarṇā sā viṣṇunā śaṃkarāntikam
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत् तीर्थं शांकरं ज्ञेयं वैष्णवं सिद्धम् एव तु यत्रानन्दम् अनुप्राप्तो ह्य् अग्निर् धर्मश् च शाश्वतः
verses.transliteration: tat tīrthaṃ śāṃkaraṃ jñeyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ siddham eva tu yatrānandam anuprāpto hy agnir dharmaś ca śāśvataḥ
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दाश्रूणि न्यपतन् यत्राग्नेर् मुनिसत्तम आनन्देति नदी जाता तथा वै नन्दिनीति च
verses.transliteration: ānandāśrūṇi nyapatan yatrāgner munisattama ānandeti nadī jātā tathā vai nandinīti ca
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश् च संगमः पुण्यो गङ्गायां तत्र वै शिवः तत्रैव संगमे साक्षात् सुवर्णाद्यापि संस्थिता
verses.transliteration: tasyāś ca saṃgamaḥ puṇyo gaṅgāyāṃ tatra vai śivaḥ tatraiva saṃgame sākṣāt suvarṇādyāpi saṃsthitā
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दाक्षायणी सैव शिवा आग्नेयी चेति विश्रुता अम्बिका जगदाधारा शिवा कात्यायनीश्वरी
verses.transliteration: dākṣāyaṇī saiva śivā āgneyī ceti viśrutā ambikā jagadādhārā śivā kātyāyanīśvarī
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भक्ताभीष्टप्रदा नित्यम् अलंकृत्योभयं तटम् तपस् तेपे यत्र चाग्निस् तत् तीर्थं तु तपोवनम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktābhīṣṭapradā nityam alaṃkṛtyobhayaṃ taṭam tapas tepe yatra cāgnis tat tīrthaṃ tu tapovanam
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवमादीनि तीर्थानि तीरयोर् उभयोर् मुने तेषु स्नानं च दानं च सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: evamādīni tīrthāni tīrayor ubhayor mune teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे चैव पारे च सहस्राणि चतुर्दश दक्षिणे च तथा पारे सहस्राण्य् अथ षोडश
verses.transliteration: uttare caiva pāre ca sahasrāṇi caturdaśa dakṣiṇe ca tathā pāre sahasrāṇy atha ṣoḍaśa
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तत्र च तीर्थानि साभिज्ञानानि सन्ति वै नामानि च पृथक् सन्ति संक्षेपात् तन् मयोच्यते
verses.transliteration: tatra tatra ca tīrthāni sābhijñānāni santi vai nāmāni ca pṛthak santi saṃkṣepāt tan mayocyate
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतानि यश् च शृणुयाद् यश् च वा पठति स्मरेत् सर्वेषु तत्र काम्येषु परिपूर्णो भवेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: etāni yaś ca śṛṇuyād yaś ca vā paṭhati smaret sarveṣu tatra kāmyeṣu paripūrṇo bhaven naraḥ
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वृत्तं तु यो ज्ञात्वा तत्र स्नानादिकं चरेत् लक्ष्मीवाञ् जायते नित्यं धर्मवांश् च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: etad vṛttaṃ tu yo jñātvā tatra snānādikaṃ caret lakṣmīvāñ jāyate nityaṃ dharmavāṃś ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अब्जकात् पश्चिमे तीर्थं तच् छार्दूलम् उदाहृतम् वाराणस्यादितीर्थेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यो ह्य् अधिकं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: abjakāt paścime tīrthaṃ tac chārdūlam udāhṛtam vārāṇasyāditīrthebhyaḥ sarvebhyo hy adhikaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा पितॄन् देवान् वन्दते तर्पयत्य् अपि सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā pitṝn devān vandate tarpayaty api sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तपोवनाच् च शार्दूलान् मध्ये तीर्थान्य् अशेषतः तस्यैकैकस्य माहात्म्यं न केनाप्य् अत्र वर्ण्यते
verses.transliteration: tapovanāc ca śārdūlān madhye tīrthāny aśeṣataḥ tasyaikaikasya māhātmyaṃ na kenāpy atra varṇyate
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं तत्रैव च वृषाकपम् फेनायाः संगमो यत्र हनूमतं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: indratīrtham iti khyātaṃ tatraiva ca vṛṣākapam phenāyāḥ saṃgamo yatra hanūmataṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: On hearing their words, the highly delighted Krsna- Dvaipayana, the Yogin, the most excellent among those who understand Yoga, said thus:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अब्जकं चापि यत् प्रोक्तं यत्र देवस् त्रिविक्रमः तत्र स्नानं च दानं च पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: abjakaṃ cāpi yat proktaṃ yatra devas trivikramaḥ tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca punarāvṛttidurlabham
verses.translation: O brahmins, listen. I shall recount Yoga that destroys worldly existence. By practising it, a Yogin shall attain liberation which is extremely difficult of access.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र वृत्तान्य् अथाख्यास्ये गङ्गाया दक्षिणे तटे इन्द्रेश्वरं चोत्तरे च शृणु भक्त्या यतव्रतः
verses.transliteration: tatra vṛttāny athākhyāsye gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe indreśvaraṃ cottare ca śṛṇu bhaktyā yatavrataḥ
verses.translation: If out, of foolishness, anyone were to practise Yoga without taking into consideration these restrictions as to places, cei tain defects are produced and they cause obstacles. I shall describe them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमुचिर् बलवान् आसीद् इन्द्रशत्रुर् मदोत्कटः तस्येन्द्रेणाभवद् युद्धं फेनेनेन्द्रो ऽहरच् छिरः
verses.transliteration: namucir balavān āsīd indraśatrur madotkaṭaḥ tasyendreṇābhavad yuddhaṃ phenenendro 'harac chiraḥ
verses.translation: Deafness, sluggishness, loss of memory, dumbness, blindness and fever are produced immediately. Similarly ignor- ance is caused.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अपां च नमुचेः शत्रोस् तत्फेनवज्ररूपधृक् शिरश् छित्त्वा तच् च फेनं गङ्गाया दक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: apāṃ ca namuceḥ śatros tatphenavajrarūpadhṛk śiraś chittvā tac ca phenaṃ gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: Hence (arrangement for) safety should always be made
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न्यपतद् भूमिं भित्त्वा तु रसातलम् अथाविशत् रसातलभवं गाङ्गं वारि यद् विश्वपावनम्
verses.transliteration: nyapatad bhūmiṃ bhittvā tu rasātalam athāviśat rasātalabhavaṃ gāṅgaṃ vāri yad viśvapāvanam
verses.translation: At the outset he shall fix the sense organs, the organs of action and the elements in his soul. He should unite his soul
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वज्रादिष्टेन मार्गेण व्यगमद् भूमिमण्डलम् तज् जलं फेननाम्ना तु नदी फेनेति गद्यते
verses.transliteration: vajrādiṣṭena mārgeṇa vyagamad bhūmimaṇḍalam taj jalaṃ phenanāmnā tu nadī pheneti gadyate
verses.translation: By the power of Yoga the Yogin attains the pure Purusottama who is termed the "fourth" and who transcends the three states (viz. wakeful, dreaming and slumbering). There is no doubt in this that he is liberated.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास् तु संगमः पुण्यो गङ्गया लोकविश्रुतः सर्वपापक्षयकरो गङ्गायमुनयोर् इव
verses.transliteration: tasyās tu saṃgamaḥ puṇyo gaṅgayā lokaviśrutaḥ sarvapāpakṣayakaro gaṅgāyamunayor iva
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हनूमदुपमाता वै यत्राप्लवनमात्रतः मार्जारत्वाद् अभून् मुक्ता विष्णुगङ्गाप्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: hanūmadupamātā vai yatrāplavanamātrataḥ mārjāratvād abhūn muktā viṣṇugaṅgāprasādataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मार्जारं चेति तत् तीर्थं पुरा प्रोक्तं मया तव हनूमतं च तत् प्रोक्तं तत्राख्यानं पुरोदितम्
verses.transliteration: mārjāraṃ ceti tat tīrthaṃ purā proktaṃ mayā tava hanūmataṃ ca tat proktaṃ tatrākhyānaṃ puroditam
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वृषाकपं चाब्जकं च तत्रेदं प्रयतः शृणु हिरण्य इति विख्यातो दैत्यानां पूर्वजो बली
verses.transliteration: vṛṣākapaṃ cābjakaṃ ca tatredaṃ prayataḥ śṛṇu hiraṇya iti vikhyāto daityānāṃ pūrvajo balī
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तपस् तप्त्वा सुरैः सर्वैर् अजेयो ऽभूत् सुदारुणः तस्यापि बलवान् पुत्रो देवानां दुर्जयः सदा
verses.transliteration: tapas taptvā suraiḥ sarvair ajeyo 'bhūt sudāruṇaḥ tasyāpi balavān putro devānāṃ durjayaḥ sadā
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महाशनिर् इति ख्यातस् तस्य भार्या पराजिता तेनेन्द्रस्याभवद् युद्धं बहुकालं निरन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: mahāśanir iti khyātas tasya bhāryā parājitā tenendrasyābhavad yuddhaṃ bahukālaṃ nirantaram
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महाशनिर् महावीर्यः सततं रणमूर्धनि जित्वा नागेन सहितं शक्रं पित्रे न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: mahāśanir mahāvīryaḥ satataṃ raṇamūrdhani jitvā nāgena sahitaṃ śakraṃ pitre nyavedayat
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बद्ध्वा हस्तिसमायुक्तं स्वसारं वीक्ष्य तां तदा विहाय क्रूरतां दैत्यो हिरण्याय न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: baddhvā hastisamāyuktaṃ svasāraṃ vīkṣya tāṃ tadā vihāya krūratāṃ daityo hiraṇyāya nyavedayat
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महाशनिपिता दैत्यः पूर्वेषां पूर्ववत्तरः शचीकान्तं तले स्थाप्य तस्य रक्षाम् अथाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: mahāśanipitā daityaḥ pūrveṣāṃ pūrvavattaraḥ śacīkāntaṃ tale sthāpya tasya rakṣām athākarot
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महाशनिर् हरिं जित्वा जेतुं वरुणम् अभ्यगात् वरुणो ऽपि महाबुद्धिः प्रादात् कन्यां महाशनेः
verses.transliteration: mahāśanir hariṃ jitvā jetuṃ varuṇam abhyagāt varuṇo 'pi mahābuddhiḥ prādāt kanyāṃ mahāśaneḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उदधिं स्वालयं प्रादाद् वरुणस् तु महाशनेः तयोश् च सख्यम् अभवद् वरुणस्य महाशनेः
verses.transliteration: udadhiṃ svālayaṃ prādād varuṇas tu mahāśaneḥ tayoś ca sakhyam abhavad varuṇasya mahāśaneḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वारुणी चापि या कन्या सा प्रियाभून् महाशनेः वीर्येण यशसा चापि शौर्येण च बलेन च
verses.transliteration: vāruṇī cāpi yā kanyā sā priyābhūn mahāśaneḥ vīryeṇa yaśasā cāpi śauryeṇa ca balena ca
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महाशनिर् महादैत्यस् त्रैलोक्ये नोपमीयते निरिन्द्रत्वं गते लोके देवाः सर्वे न्यमन्त्रयन्
verses.transliteration: mahāśanir mahādaityas trailokye nopamīyate nirindratvaṃ gate loke devāḥ sarve nyamantrayan
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुर् एवेन्द्रदाता स्याद् दैत्यहन्ता स एव च मन्त्रदृग् वा स एव स्याद् इन्द्रं चान्यं करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: viṣṇur evendradātā syād daityahantā sa eva ca mantradṛg vā sa eva syād indraṃ cānyaṃ kariṣyati
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं संमन्त्र्य ते देवा विष्णोर् मन्त्रं न्यवेदयन् ममावध्यो महादैत्यो महाशनिर् इति ब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃmantrya te devā viṣṇor mantraṃ nyavedayan mamāvadhyo mahādaityo mahāśanir iti bruvan
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रायाद् वारीश्वरं विष्णुः श्वशुरं वरुणं तदा केशवो वरुणं गत्वा प्राहेन्द्रस्य पराभवम्
verses.transliteration: prāyād vārīśvaraṃ viṣṇuḥ śvaśuraṃ varuṇaṃ tadā keśavo varuṇaṃ gatvā prāhendrasya parābhavam
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: तथा त्वयैतत् कर्तव्यं यथायाति पुरंदरः तद्विष्णुवचनाच् छीघ्रं ययौ जलपतिर् मुने
verses.transliteration: tathā tvayaitat kartavyaṃ yathāyāti puraṃdaraḥ tadviṣṇuvacanāc chīghraṃ yayau jalapatir mune
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: सुतापतिं हिरण्यसुतं विक्रान्तं तं महाशनिम् अतिसंमानितस् तेन जामात्रा वरुणः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sutāpatiṃ hiraṇyasutaṃ vikrāntaṃ taṃ mahāśanim atisaṃmānitas tena jāmātrā varuṇaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
