verses.sanskrit: पप्रच्छागमनं दैत्यो विनयाच् छ्वशुरं तदा वरुणः प्राह तं दैत्यं यद् आगमनकारणम्
verses.transliteration: papracchāgamanaṃ daityo vinayāc chvaśuraṃ tadā varuṇaḥ prāha taṃ daityaṃ yad āgamanakāraṇam
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं देहि महाबाहो यस् त्वया निर्जितः पुरा बद्धं रसातलस्थं तं देवानाम् अधिपं सखे
verses.transliteration: indraṃ dehi mahābāho yas tvayā nirjitaḥ purā baddhaṃ rasātalasthaṃ taṃ devānām adhipaṃ sakhe
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकं सर्वदा मान्यं देहि त्वं मम शत्रुहन् बद्ध्वा विमोक्षणं शत्रोर् महते यशसे सताम्
verses.transliteration: asmākaṃ sarvadā mānyaṃ dehi tvaṃ mama śatruhan baddhvā vimokṣaṇaṃ śatror mahate yaśase satām
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा कथंचित् स दैत्येशो वरुणाय तम् प्रादाद् इन्द्रं शचीकान्तं वारणेन समन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā kathaṃcit sa daityeśo varuṇāya tam prādād indraṃ śacīkāntaṃ vāraṇena samanvitam
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स दैत्यमध्ये ऽतिविराजमानो हरिं तदोवाच जलेशसंनिधौ संपूज्य चैवाथ महोपचारैर् महाशनिर् मघवन्तं बभाषे
verses.transliteration: sa daityamadhye 'tivirājamāno hariṃ tadovāca jaleśasaṃnidhau saṃpūjya caivātha mahopacārair mahāśanir maghavantaṃ babhāṣe
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: केन त्वम् इन्द्रो ऽद्य कृतो ऽसि केन वीर्यं तवेदृग् बहु भाषसे च त्वं संगरे शत्रुभिर् बाध्यसे च तथापि चेन्द्रो भवसीति चित्रम्
verses.transliteration: kena tvam indro 'dya kṛto 'si kena vīryaṃ tavedṛg bahu bhāṣase ca tvaṃ saṃgare śatrubhir bādhyase ca tathāpi cendro bhavasīti citram
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अथापि बद्धा पुरुषेण काचित् तस्याः पतिस् तां मोचयतीति युक्तम् स्त्रियो ऽस्वतन्त्राः पुरुषप्रधानास् त्वं वै पुमान् भविता शक्र साधो
verses.transliteration: athāpi baddhā puruṣeṇa kācit tasyāḥ patis tāṃ mocayatīti yuktam striyo 'svatantrāḥ puruṣapradhānās tvaṃ vai pumān bhavitā śakra sādho
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बद्धो मया संगरे वाहनेन क्वाप्य् अस्त्रं ते वज्रम् उद्दामशक्ति चिन्तारत्नं नन्दनं योषितस् ता यशो बलं देवराजोपभोग्यम्
verses.transliteration: baddho mayā saṃgare vāhanena kvāpy astraṃ te vajram uddāmaśakti cintāratnaṃ nandanaṃ yoṣitas tā yaśo balaṃ devarājopabhogyam
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तज् जीवनं यत् तु यशोनिधानं स एव मृत्युर् यशसो यद् विरोधि एवं जानञ् शक्र कथं जलेशान् मुक्तिं प्राप्तो नैव लज्जां भजेथाः
verses.transliteration: taj jīvanaṃ yat tu yaśonidhānaṃ sa eva mṛtyur yaśaso yad virodhi evaṃ jānañ śakra kathaṃ jaleśān muktiṃ prāpto naiva lajjāṃ bhajethāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रिविष्टपस्थः परिवेष्टितः सन् सर्वैः सुरैः कान्तया वीज्यमानः संस्तूयमानश् च तथाप्सरोभिर् नूनं लज्जा ते बिभेतीति मन्ये
verses.transliteration: triviṣṭapasthaḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ san sarvaiḥ suraiḥ kāntayā vījyamānaḥ saṃstūyamānaś ca tathāpsarobhir nūnaṃ lajjā te bibhetīti manye
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वं वृत्रहा नमुचेश् चापि हन्ता पुरां भेत्ता गोत्रभिद् वज्रबाहुः एवं सुरास् त्वां परिपूजयन्तीत्य् अतो जिष्णो सर्वम् एतत् त्यजस्व
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ vṛtrahā namuceś cāpi hantā purāṃ bhettā gotrabhid vajrabāhuḥ evaṃ surās tvāṃ paripūjayantīty ato jiṣṇo sarvam etat tyajasva
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विकारम् आप्याप्य् अहितोद्भवं ये जीवन्ति लोकान् अनुसंविशन्ति भवादृशां दुश्च्यवनाब्जजन्मा कथं न हृद्भेदम् अवाप कर्ता
verses.transliteration: vikāram āpyāpy ahitodbhavaṃ ye jīvanti lokān anusaṃviśanti bhavādṛśāṃ duścyavanābjajanmā kathaṃ na hṛdbhedam avāpa kartā
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा तु दैत्येशो वरुणाय महात्मने प्रादाद् इन्द्रं पुनश् चेदं वचनं तद् अभाषत
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā tu daityeśo varuṇāya mahātmane prādād indraṃ punaś cedaṃ vacanaṃ tad abhāṣata
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अद्य प्रभृत्य् असौ शिष्य इन्द्रः स्याद् वरुणो गुरुः श्वशुरो मम येन त्वं मुक्तिम् आप्तो ऽसि वासव
verses.transliteration: adya prabhṛty asau śiṣya indraḥ syād varuṇo guruḥ śvaśuro mama yena tvaṃ muktim āpto 'si vāsava
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: तथा त्वं भृत्यभावेन वर्तेथा वरुणं प्रति नो चेद् बद्ध्वा पुनस् त्वां वै क्षेप्स्ये चैव रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: tathā tvaṃ bhṛtyabhāvena vartethā varuṇaṃ prati no ced baddhvā punas tvāṃ vai kṣepsye caiva rasātalam
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं निर्भर्त्स्य तं शक्रं हसंश् चापि पुनः पुनः अब्रवीद् गच्छ गच्छेति वरुणं चानुमन्य तु
verses.transliteration: evaṃ nirbhartsya taṃ śakraṃ hasaṃś cāpi punaḥ punaḥ abravīd gaccha gaccheti varuṇaṃ cānumanya tu
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स तु प्राप्तः स्वनिलयं लज्जया कलुषीकृतः पौलोम्यां प्राह तत् सर्वं यत् तच् छत्रुपराभवम्
verses.transliteration: sa tu prāptaḥ svanilayaṃ lajjayā kaluṣīkṛtaḥ paulomyāṃ prāha tat sarvaṃ yat tac chatruparābhavam
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः कृतश् चैव शत्रुणाहं वरानने निर्वापयामि येन स्वम् आत्मानं सुभगे वद
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ kṛtaś caiva śatruṇāhaṃ varānane nirvāpayāmi yena svam ātmānaṃ subhage vada
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: दानवानाम् अथोद्भूतिं शक्र मायां पराभवम् वरदानं तथा मृत्युं जाने ऽहं बलसूदन
verses.transliteration: dānavānām athodbhūtiṃ śakra māyāṃ parābhavam varadānaṃ tathā mṛtyuṃ jāne 'haṃ balasūdana
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् यस्मात् तस्य मृत्युर् अथवापि पराभवः जायेत शृणु तत् सर्वं वक्ष्ये ऽहं प्रीतये तव
verses.transliteration: tasmād yasmāt tasya mṛtyur athavāpi parābhavaḥ jāyeta śṛṇu tat sarvaṃ vakṣye 'haṃ prītaye tava
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यस्य सुतो वीरः पितृव्यस्य सुतो बली तस्मान् मम स्यात् स भ्राता वरदानाच् च दर्पितः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyasya suto vīraḥ pitṛvyasya suto balī tasmān mama syāt sa bhrātā varadānāc ca darpitaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं तोषयाम् आस तपसा नियमेन च ईदृशं बलम् आपन्नं तपसा किं न सिध्यति
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ toṣayām āsa tapasā niyamena ca īdṛśaṃ balam āpannaṃ tapasā kiṃ na sidhyati
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पतिव्रता प्रिया मे त्वं धर्मे मन्त्रे सहायिनी सापत्या च कुलीना च त्वत्तो ऽन्या का प्रिया मम
verses.transliteration: pativratā priyā me tvaṃ dharme mantre sahāyinī sāpatyā ca kulīnā ca tvatto 'nyā kā priyā mama

verses.transliteration: tathā śivasya devasya prasādāc ca vṛṣākapeḥ jalodbhavāc ca me mitrād abjakāl lokaviśrutāt

verses.sanskrit: उत्तीर्णदुःखः सुभगे इत इन्द्रो ऽहम् अच्युतः किं न साध्यं यत्र भार्या भर्तृचित्तानुगामिनी
verses.transliteration: uttīrṇaduḥkhaḥ subhage ita indro 'ham acyutaḥ kiṃ na sādhyaṃ yatra bhāryā bhartṛcittānugāminī
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: दुष्करा तत्र नो मुक्तिः किंत्व् अर्थादित्रयं शुभे जायैव परमं मित्रं लोकद्वयहितैषिणी
verses.transliteration: duṣkarā tatra no muktiḥ kiṃtv arthāditrayaṃ śubhe jāyaiva paramaṃ mitraṃ lokadvayahitaiṣiṇī
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: सा चेत् कुलीना प्रियभाषिणी च पतिव्रता रूपवती गुणाढ्या संपत्सु चापत्सु समानरूपा तया ह्य् असाध्यं किम् इह त्रिलोक्याम्
verses.transliteration: sā cet kulīnā priyabhāṣiṇī ca pativratā rūpavatī guṇāḍhyā saṃpatsu cāpatsu samānarūpā tayā hy asādhyaṃ kim iha trilokyām

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् तव धिया कान्ते ममेदं शुभम् आगतम् इतस् तवोदितं चैव कर्तव्यं नान्यद् अस्ति मे
verses.transliteration: tasmāt tava dhiyā kānte mamedaṃ śubham āgatam itas tavoditaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ nānyad asti me
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: परलोके च धर्मे च सत्पुत्रसदृशं न च आर्तस्य पुरुषस्येह भार्यावद् भेषजं नहि
verses.transliteration: paraloke ca dharme ca satputrasadṛśaṃ na ca ārtasya puruṣasyeha bhāryāvad bheṣajaṃ nahi
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: निःश्रेयसपदप्राप्त्यै तथा पापस्य मुक्तये गङ्गया सदृशं नास्ति शृणु चान्यद् वरानने
verses.transliteration: niḥśreyasapadaprāptyai tathā pāpasya muktaye gaṅgayā sadṛśaṃ nāsti śṛṇu cānyad varānane
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां प्राप्तये पापमुक्तये शिवविष्ण्वोर् अनन्यत्वज्ञानान् नास्त्य् अत्र मुक्तये
verses.transliteration: dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ prāptaye pāpamuktaye śivaviṣṇvor ananyatvajñānān nāsty atra muktaye
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् तव धिया साध्वि सर्वम् एतन् मनोगतम् अवाप्तं च शिवाद् विष्णोर् गङ्गायाश् च प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt tava dhiyā sādhvi sarvam etan manogatam avāptaṃ ca śivād viṣṇor gaṅgāyāś ca prasādataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रत्वं मे स्थिरं चेतो मन्ये मित्रबलात् पुनः वृषाकपिर् मम सखा यो जातस् त्व् अप्सु भामिनि
verses.transliteration: indratvaṃ me sthiraṃ ceto manye mitrabalāt punaḥ vṛṣākapir mama sakhā yo jātas tv apsu bhāmini
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं च प्रियसखी नित्यं नान्यत् प्रियतरं मम तीर्थानां गौतमी गङ्गा देवानां हरिशंकरौ
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ ca priyasakhī nityaṃ nānyat priyataraṃ mama tīrthānāṃ gautamī gaṅgā devānāṃ hariśaṃkarau
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् एभ्यः प्रसादेन सर्वं चेप्सितम् आप्तवान् मम प्रीतिकरं चेदं तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: tasmād ebhyaḥ prasādena sarvaṃ cepsitam āptavān mama prītikaraṃ cedaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् एतद् धि याचिष्ये देवान् सर्वान् अनुक्रमात् अनुमन्यन्तु ऋषयो गङ्गा च हरिशंकरौ
verses.transliteration: tasmād etad dhi yāciṣye devān sarvān anukramāt anumanyantu ṛṣayo gaṅgā ca hariśaṃkarau
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रेश्वरे चाब्जके च उभयोस् तीरयोः सुराः एकत्र शंकरो देवो ह्य् अपरत्र जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: indreśvare cābjake ca ubhayos tīrayoḥ surāḥ ekatra śaṃkaro devo hy aparatra janārdanaḥ

verses.transliteration: pāvayan daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ sākṣād viṣṇus trivikramaḥ antare yāni tīrthāni sarvapuṇyapradāni ca

verses.sanskrit: अत्र तु स्नानमात्रेण सर्वे ते मुक्तिम् आप्नुयुः पापिष्ठाः पापतो मुक्तिम् आप्नुयुर् ये च धर्मिणः
verses.transliteration: atra tu snānamātreṇa sarve te muktim āpnuyuḥ pāpiṣṭhāḥ pāpato muktim āpnuyur ye ca dharmiṇaḥ

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तु परमा मुक्तिः पितृभिः पञ्चपञ्चभिः अत्र किंचिच् च ये दद्युर् अर्थिभ्यस् तिलमात्रकम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tu paramā muktiḥ pitṛbhiḥ pañcapañcabhiḥ atra kiṃcic ca ye dadyur arthibhyas tilamātrakam
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: दातृभ्यो ह्य् अक्षयं तत् स्यात् कामदं मोक्षदं तथा धन्यं यशस्यम् आयुष्यम् आरोग्यं पुण्यवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: dātṛbhyo hy akṣayaṃ tat syāt kāmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyam ārogyaṃ puṇyavardhanam

verses.sanskrit: आख्यानं विष्णुशंभ्वोश् च ज्ञात्वा स्नानाच् च मुक्तिदम् अस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं ये शृण्वन्ति पठन्ति च
verses.transliteration: ākhyānaṃ viṣṇuśaṃbhvoś ca jñātvā snānāc ca muktidam asya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ ye śṛṇvanti paṭhanti ca

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यभाजो भवेयुस् ते तेभ्यो ऽत्रैव स्मृतिर् भवेत् शिवविष्ण्वोर् अशेषाघसंघविच्छेदकारिणी यां प्रार्थयन्ति मुनयो विजितेन्द्रियमानसाः
verses.transliteration: puṇyabhājo bhaveyus te tebhyo 'traiva smṛtir bhavet śivaviṣṇvor aśeṣāghasaṃghavicchedakāriṇī yāṃ prārthayanti munayo vijitendriyamānasāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यत्य् एवम् एवेति तं देवा ऋषयो ऽब्रुवन् गौतम्या उत्तरे पारे तीर्थानां मोक्षदायिनाम्
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyaty evam eveti taṃ devā ṛṣayo 'bruvan gautamyā uttare pāre tīrthānāṃ mokṣadāyinām
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.
