verses.transliteration: etac chāpaṃ viditvā tu tau devau praṇatā tadā viśāpatvaṃ prārthayantī tuṣṭāva ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the wise persons say that salvation is
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तुष्टौ देवदेवौ प्रार्थितौ त्रिदशार्चितौ प्रीत्या हरिहराव् एवं वाचं वाचम् अथोचतुः
verses.transliteration: tatas tuṣṭau devadevau prārthitau tridaśārcitau prītyā hariharāv evaṃ vācaṃ vācam athocatuḥ
verses.translation: Thus the wise persons say that salvation is
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गया संगता भद्रे यदा त्वं लोकपावनी तदा पुनर् वपुस् ते स्यात् पवित्रं हि सुशोभने
verses.transliteration: gaṅgayā saṃgatā bhadre yadā tvaṃ lokapāvanī tadā punar vapus te syāt pavitraṃ hi suśobhane
verses.translation: Thus the wise persons say that salvation is
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सापि देवी गङ्गया संगताभवत् भागीरथी गौतमी च ततश् चापि स्वकं वपुः
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā sāpi devī gaṅgayā saṃgatābhavat bhāgīrathī gautamī ca tataś cāpi svakaṃ vapuḥ
verses.translation: Thus the wise persons say that salvation is
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवी सा व्यगमद् ब्रह्मन् देवानाम् अपि दुर्लभम् गौतम्यां सैव विख्याता नाम्ना वाणीति पुण्यदा
verses.transliteration: devī sā vyagamad brahman devānām api durlabham gautamyāṃ saiva vikhyātā nāmnā vāṇīti puṇyadā
verses.translation: Thus the wise persons say that salvation is
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भागीरथ्यां सैव देवी सरस्वत्य् अभिधीयते उभयत्रापि विख्यातः संगमो लोकपूजितः
verses.transliteration: bhāgīrathyāṃ saiva devī sarasvaty abhidhīyate ubhayatrāpi vikhyātaḥ saṃgamo lokapūjitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the wise persons say that salvation is
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वतीसंगमश् च वाणीसंगम एव च गौतम्या संगता देवी वाणी वाचा सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: sarasvatīsaṃgamaś ca vāṇīsaṃgama eva ca gautamyā saṃgatā devī vāṇī vācā sarasvatī
verses.translation: Thus the wise persons say that salvation is
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र पूजितं तीर्थं तत्र वाचा शिवं प्रभुम् देवेश्वरं पूजयित्वा विशापम् अगमद् यतः
verses.transliteration: sarvatra pūjitaṃ tīrthaṃ tatra vācā śivaṃ prabhum deveśvaraṃ pūjayitvā viśāpam agamad yataḥ
verses.translation: Thus the wise persons say that salvation is
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा विधूय वाग्दौष्ट्यं स्वं च धामागमत् पुनः तस्मात् तत्र शुचिर् भूत्वा स्नात्वा तत्र च संगमे
verses.transliteration: brahmā vidhūya vāgdauṣṭyaṃ svaṃ ca dhāmāgamat punaḥ tasmāt tatra śucir bhūtvā snātvā tatra ca saṃgame
verses.translation: Thus the wise persons say that salvation is
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वागीश्वरं ततो दृष्ट्वा तावता मुक्तिम् आप्नुयात् दानहोमादिकं किंचिद् उपवासादिकां क्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: vāgīśvaraṃ tato dṛṣṭvā tāvatā muktim āpnuyāt dānahomādikaṃ kiṃcid upavāsādikāṃ kriyām
verses.translation: Thus the wise persons say that salvation is
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यः कुर्यात् संगमे पुण्ये संसारे न भवेत् पुनः एकोनविंशतिशतं तीर्थानां तीरयोर् द्वयोः नानाजन्मार्जिताशेषपापक्षयविधायिनाम्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ kuryāt saṃgame puṇye saṃsāre na bhavet punaḥ ekonaviṃśatiśataṃ tīrthānāṃ tīrayor dvayoḥ nānājanmārjitāśeṣapāpakṣayavidhāyinām
verses.translation: Thus the wise persons say that salvation is
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं तत्र वृत्तम् इदं शृणु मौद्गल्य इति विख्यातो मुद्गलस्य सुतो ऋषिः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇutīrtham iti khyātaṃ tatra vṛttam idaṃ śṛṇu maudgalya iti vikhyāto mudgalasya suto ṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: On account of its acquisition of penance or decrease of good qualities the soul sometimes takes up bodies among gods or among lower creatures.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्या तु जाबाला नाम्ना ख्याता सुपुत्रिणी पिता ऋषिस् तथा वृद्धो मुद्गलो लोकविश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā tu jābālā nāmnā khyātā suputriṇī pitā ṛṣis tathā vṛddho mudgalo lokaviśrutaḥ
verses.translation: From human birth it proceeds to heaven and from god it becomes a human being. From the state of man it proceeds to hell.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्या तथा ख्याता नाम्ना भागीरथी शुभा स मौद्गल्यः प्रातर् एव गङ्गां स्नाति यतव्रतः
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā tathā khyātā nāmnā bhāgīrathī śubhā sa maudgalyaḥ prātar eva gaṅgāṃ snāti yatavrataḥ
verses.translation: Just as the silk worm wraps itself by its thread-like fibres so also this soul though devoid of Gunas wraps itself by means of Gunas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नित्यम् एव त्व् इदं कर्म तस्यासीन् मुनिसत्तम गङ्गातीरे कुशैर् मृद्भिः शमीपुष्पैर् अहर्निशम्
verses.transliteration: nityam eva tv idaṃ karma tasyāsīn munisattama gaṅgātīre kuśair mṛdbhiḥ śamīpuṣpair aharniśam
verses.translation: Though the soul is devoid of mutually opposed pairs it is affected by them in different births. At the time when a person suffers from ailments such as headache, eye-pain, tooth¬ ache, sore throat, dropsy, diarrhoea, Gandamala, Vicarcika, leukoderma, burns, scalds, epileptic fils etc., the characteristic symptoms of diverse types appear in the bodies of these souls. The soul identifies itself with the bodies. As in the case of identification so also in regard to meritorious deeds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गुरूदितेन मार्गेण स्वमानससरोरुहे आवाहनं नित्यम् एव विष्णोश् चक्रे स मौद्गलिः
verses.transliteration: gurūditena mārgeṇa svamānasasaroruhe āvāhanaṃ nityam eva viṣṇoś cakre sa maudgaliḥ
verses.translation: He may wear lion hide or silken garment. Plank may
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेनाहूतस् त्वरन्न् एति लक्ष्मीभर्ता जगत्पतिः वैनतेयम् अथारुह्य शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः
verses.transliteration: tenāhūtas tvarann eti lakṣmībhartā jagatpatiḥ vainateyam athāruhya śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
verses.translation: Mat alone may be his garment or he may be wearing bark garment. We may take pride in wearing other types of clothes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूजितस् तेन ऋषिणा स मौद्गल्येन यत्नतः प्रब्रूते च कथाश् चित्रा मौद्गल्याय जगत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: pūjitas tena ṛṣiṇā sa maudgalyena yatnataḥ prabrūte ca kathāś citrā maudgalyāya jagatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: He may have diverse types of food and different kinds of jewels. He may take food once a day or on different nights with intervals of a night in between.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽपराह्णसमये विष्णुः प्राह स मौद्गलिम् याहि वत्स स्वभवनं श्रान्तो ऽसीति पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tato 'parāhṇasamaye viṣṇuḥ prāha sa maudgalim yāhi vatsa svabhavanaṃ śrānto 'sīti punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Some may take in cow's urine; some the Kasa flower.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः स देवेन विष्णुना याति स द्विजः जगत्प्रभुस् ततो याति देवैर् युक्तः स्वमन्दिरम्
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ sa devena viṣṇunā yāti sa dvijaḥ jagatprabhus tato yāti devair yuktaḥ svamandiram
verses.translation: He may rkort to lonely river bank, diffcn, foreslr
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मौद्गल्यो ऽपि तथाभ्येत्य किंचिद् आदाय नित्यशः स्वम् एव भवनं विद्वान् भार्यायै स्वार्जितं धनम्
verses.transliteration: maudgalyo 'pi tathābhyetya kiṃcid ādāya nityaśaḥ svam eva bhavanaṃ vidvān bhāryāyai svārjitaṃ dhanam
verses.translation: He may adopt different types of holy rites and obeer vancea and var.ou, kmda of austerities, sacrifices of varioa types and different kinds of scholarly arts.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ददाति स महाविष्णुचरणाब्जपरायणः मौद्गल्यस्य प्रिया सापि पतिव्रतपरायणा
verses.transliteration: dadāti sa mahāviṣṇucaraṇābjaparāyaṇaḥ maudgalyasya priyā sāpi pativrataparāyaṇā
verses.translation: Divine Prakrti causes fear and annihilation. At the end of the day, he passes beyond Gunas and remains single.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शाकं मूलं फलं वापि भर्त्रानीतं तु यत्नतः सुसंस्कृत्याप्य् अतिथीनां बालानां भर्तुर् एव च
verses.transliteration: śākaṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ vāpi bhartrānītaṃ tu yatnataḥ susaṃskṛtyāpy atithīnāṃ bālānāṃ bhartur eva ca
verses.translation: Just as the sun controls at the proper time the cluster of his rays, so also the soul controls all these and identifies itself with them for the sake of sport.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा तु भोजनं तेभ्यः पश्चाद् भुङ्क्ते यतव्रता भुक्तवत्स्व् अथ सर्वेषु रात्रौ नित्यं स मौद्गलिः
verses.transliteration: dattvā tu bhojanaṃ tebhyaḥ paścād bhuṅkte yatavratā bhuktavatsv atha sarveṣu rātrau nityaṃ sa maudgaliḥ
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोः श्रुताः कथाश् चित्रास् तेभ्यो वक्त्य् अथ हर्षितः एवं बहुतिथे काले व्यतीते चातिविस्मिता मौद्गल्यस्य रहो भार्या भर्तारं वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇoḥ śrutāḥ kathāś citrās tebhyo vakty atha harṣitaḥ evaṃ bahutithe kāle vyatīte cātivismitā maudgalyasya raho bhāryā bhartāraṃ vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-

verses.sanskrit: यदि ते विष्णुर् अभ्येति समीपं त्रिदशार्चितः तथापि कष्टम् अस्माकं कस्माद् इति जगत्प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: yadi te viṣṇur abhyeti samīpaṃ tridaśārcitaḥ tathāpi kaṣṭam asmākaṃ kasmād iti jagatprabhum
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-

verses.sanskrit: तत् पृच्छ त्वं महाप्राज्ञ यदासौ विष्णुर् एति च यस्मिंश् च स्मृतमात्रे तु जराजन्मरुजो मृतिः नाशं यान्ति कुतो दृष्टे तस्मात् पृच्छ जगत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: tat pṛccha tvaṃ mahāprājña yadāsau viṣṇur eti ca yasmiṃś ca smṛtamātre tu jarājanmarujo mṛtiḥ nāśaṃ yānti kuto dṛṣṭe tasmāt pṛccha jagatpatim
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा प्रियावाक्यान् मौद्गल्यो नित्यवद् धरिम् पूजयित्वा विनीतश् च पप्रच्छ स कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā priyāvākyān maudgalyo nityavad dharim pūjayitvā vinītaś ca papraccha sa kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-

verses.sanskrit: त्वयि स्मृते जगन्नाथ शोकदारिद्र्यदुष्कृतम् नाशं याति विपत्तिर् मे त्वयि दृष्टे कथं स्थिता
verses.transliteration: tvayi smṛte jagannātha śokadāridryaduṣkṛtam nāśaṃ yāti vipattir me tvayi dṛṣṭe kathaṃ sthitā

verses.sanskrit: यादृशं चोप्यते बीजं फलं भवति तादृशम् रसालः स्यान् न निम्बस्य बीजाज् जात्व् अपि कुत्रचित्

verses.sanskrit: न कृता गौतमीसेवा नार्चितौ हरिशंकरौ न दत्तं यैश् च विप्रेभ्यस् ते कथं भाजनं श्रियः
verses.transliteration: na kṛtā gautamīsevā nārcitau hariśaṃkarau na dattaṃ yaiś ca viprebhyas te kathaṃ bhājanaṃ śriyaḥ

verses.sanskrit: त्वया न दत्तं किंचिच् च ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ममापि च यद् दीयते तद् एवेह परस्मिंश् चोपतिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: tvayā na dattaṃ kiṃcic ca brāhmaṇebhyo mamāpi ca yad dīyate tad eveha parasmiṃś copatiṣṭhati

verses.sanskrit: मृद्भिर् वार्भिः कुशैर् मन्त्रैः शुचिकर्म सदैव यत् करोति तस्मात् पूतात्मा शरीरस्य च शोषणात्
verses.transliteration: mṛdbhir vārbhiḥ kuśair mantraiḥ śucikarma sadaiva yat karoti tasmāt pūtātmā śarīrasya ca śoṣaṇāt
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-

verses.sanskrit: विना दानेन न क्वापि भोगावाप्तिर् नृणां भवेत् सत्कर्माचरणाच् छुद्धो विरक्तः स्यात् ततो नरः
verses.transliteration: vinā dānena na kvāpi bhogāvāptir nṛṇāṃ bhavet satkarmācaraṇāc chuddho viraktaḥ syāt tato naraḥ

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽप्रतिहतज्ञानो जीवन्मुक्तस् ततो भवेत् सर्वेषां सुलभा मुक्तिर् मद्भक्त्या चेह पूर्ततः
verses.transliteration: tato 'pratihatajñāno jīvanmuktas tato bhavet sarveṣāṃ sulabhā muktir madbhaktyā ceha pūrtataḥ
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-

verses.sanskrit: भुक्तिर् दानादिना सर्वभूतदुःखनिबर्हणात् अथवा लप्स्यसे मुक्तिं भक्त्या भुक्तिं न लप्स्यसे
verses.transliteration: bhuktir dānādinā sarvabhūtaduḥkhanibarhaṇāt athavā lapsyase muktiṃ bhaktyā bhuktiṃ na lapsyase
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या मुक्तिः कथं भूयाद् भुक्तेर् मुक्तिः सुदुर्लभा जाता चेद् देहिनां मुक्तिः किम् अन्येन प्रयोजनम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā muktiḥ kathaṃ bhūyād bhukter muktiḥ sudurlabhā jātā ced dehināṃ muktiḥ kim anyena prayojanam
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या मुक्तिः सर्वपूज्या ताम् इच्छेयं जगन्मय
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā muktiḥ sarvapūjyā tām iccheyaṃ jaganmaya
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतद् एवान्तरं ब्रह्मन् दीयते माम् अनुस्मरन् ब्राह्मणायाथवार्थिभ्यस् तद् एवाक्षयतां व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: etad evāntaraṃ brahman dīyate mām anusmaran brāhmaṇāyāthavārthibhyas tad evākṣayatāṃ vrajet
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: माम् अध्यात्वाथ यद् दद्यात् तत् तन्मात्रफलप्रदम् तत् पुनर् दत्तम् एवेह न भोगायात्र कल्पते
verses.transliteration: mām adhyātvātha yad dadyāt tat tanmātraphalapradam tat punar dattam eveha na bhogāyātra kalpate
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् देहि महाबुद्धे भोज्यं किंचिन् मम ध्रुवम् अथवा विप्रमुख्याय गौतमीतीरम् आश्रितः
verses.transliteration: tasmād dehi mahābuddhe bhojyaṃ kiṃcin mama dhruvam athavā vipramukhyāya gautamītīram āśritaḥ
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मौद्गल्यः प्राह तं विष्णुं देयं मम न विद्यते नान्यत् किंचन देहादि यत् तत् त्वयि समर्पितम्
verses.transliteration: maudgalyaḥ prāha taṃ viṣṇuṃ deyaṃ mama na vidyate nānyat kiṃcana dehādi yat tat tvayi samarpitam
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो विष्णुर् गरुत्मन्तं प्राह शीघ्रं जगत्पतिः इहानयस्व कणिशं ममायं चार्पयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: tato viṣṇur garutmantaṃ prāha śīghraṃ jagatpatiḥ ihānayasva kaṇiśaṃ mamāyaṃ cārpayiṣyati

verses.sanskrit: ततो योग्यान् अयं भोगान् प्राप्स्यते मनसः प्रियान् आकर्ण्य स्वामिनादिष्टं तथा चक्रे स पक्षिराट्
verses.transliteration: tato yogyān ayaṃ bhogān prāpsyate manasaḥ priyān ākarṇya svāminādiṣṭaṃ tathā cakre sa pakṣirāṭ

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुहस्ते कणान् प्रादात् स मौद्गल्यो यतव्रतः एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे विष्णुर् विश्वकर्माणम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuhaste kaṇān prādāt sa maudgalyo yatavrataḥ etasminn antare viṣṇur viśvakarmāṇam abravīt

verses.sanskrit: यावच् चास्य कुले सप्त पुरुषास् तावद् एव तु भवितारो महाबुद्धे तावत् कामा मनीषिताः गावो हिरण्यं धान्यानि वस्त्राण्य् आभरणानि च
verses.transliteration: yāvac cāsya kule sapta puruṣās tāvad eva tu bhavitāro mahābuddhe tāvat kāmā manīṣitāḥ gāvo hiraṇyaṃ dhānyāni vastrāṇy ābharaṇāni ca
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-

verses.sanskrit: यच् च किंचिन् मनःप्रीत्यै लोके भवति भूषणम् तत् सर्वम् आप मौद्गल्यो विष्णुगङ्गाप्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: yac ca kiṃcin manaḥprītyai loke bhavati bhūṣaṇam tat sarvam āpa maudgalyo viṣṇugaṅgāprabhāvataḥ

verses.sanskrit: गृहं गच्छेति मौद्गल्यो विष्णुनोक्तस् ततो ययौ आश्रमे स्वस्य सर्वर्द्धिं दृष्ट्वा ऋषिर् अभाषत
verses.transliteration: gṛhaṃ gaccheti maudgalyo viṣṇunoktas tato yayau āśrame svasya sarvarddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṣir abhāṣata
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-

verses.sanskrit: अहो दानप्रभावो ऽयम् अहो विष्णोर् अनुस्मृतिः अहो गङ्गाप्रभावश् च कैर् विचार्यो महान् अयम्
verses.transliteration: aho dānaprabhāvo 'yam aho viṣṇor anusmṛtiḥ aho gaṅgāprabhāvaś ca kair vicāryo mahān ayam
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मौद्गल्यो भार्यया सार्धं पुत्रैः पौत्रैश् च बन्धुभिः पितृभ्यां बुभुजे भोगान् भुक्तिं मुक्तिम् अवाप च
verses.transliteration: maudgalyo bhāryayā sārdhaṃ putraiḥ pautraiś ca bandhubhiḥ pitṛbhyāṃ bubhuje bhogān bhuktiṃ muktim avāpa ca
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं मौद्गल्यं वैष्णवं तथा तत्र स्नानं च दानं च भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ maudgalyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca bhuktimuktiphalapradam
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-

verses.sanskrit: तत्र श्रुतिः स्मृतिर् वापि तीर्थस्य स्यात् कथंचन तस्य विष्णुर् भवेत् प्रीतः पापैर् मुक्तः सुखी भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tatra śrutiḥ smṛtir vāpi tīrthasya syāt kathaṃcana tasya viṣṇur bhavet prītaḥ pāpair muktaḥ sukhī bhavet
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकादश सहस्राणि तीर्थानां तीरयोर् द्वयोः सर्वार्थदायिनां तत्र स्नानदानजपादिभिः
verses.transliteration: ekādaśa sahasrāṇi tīrthānāṃ tīrayor dvayoḥ sarvārthadāyināṃ tatra snānadānajapādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Therefore the attainment of hell by gods and human beings is relevant. Being overwhelmed by the sense of "My-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मीतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं साक्षाल् लक्ष्मीविवर्धनम् अलक्ष्मीनाशनं पुण्यम् आख्यानं शृणु नारद
verses.transliteration: lakṣmītīrtham iti khyātaṃ sākṣāl lakṣmīvivardhanam alakṣmīnāśanaṃ puṇyam ākhyānaṃ śṛṇu nārada
verses.translation: The relationship between the two viz., the Imperishable and (Perishable) is to be wished for. It is essential that there
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संवादश् च पुरा त्व् आसील् लक्ष्म्याः पुत्र दरिद्रया परस्परविरोधिन्याव् उभे विश्वं समीयतुः
verses.transliteration: saṃvādaś ca purā tv āsīl lakṣmyāḥ putra daridrayā parasparavirodhinyāv ubhe viśvaṃ samīyatuḥ
verses.translation: Without a man no woman conceives. Without a woman no man is able to evolve a form.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्याम् अव्यापृतं वस्तु तन् नास्ति भुवनत्रये मम ज्यैष्ठ्यं मम ज्यैष्ठ्यम् इत्य् ऊचतुर् उभे मिथः अहं पूर्वं समुद्भूता इत्य् आह श्रियम् ओजसा
verses.transliteration: tābhyām avyāpṛtaṃ vastu tan nāsti bhuvanatraye mama jyaiṣṭhyaṃ mama jyaiṣṭhyam ity ūcatur ubhe mithaḥ ahaṃ pūrvaṃ samudbhūtā ity āha śriyam ojasā
verses.translation: In all types ofliving beings the couple (i.e. male and female) evolve a new form by means of mutual contact. The new form evolved will have the features of both—the male and female.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुलं शीलं जीवितं वा देहिनाम् अहम् एव तु मया विना देहभाजो जीवन्तो ऽपि मृता इव
verses.transliteration: kulaṃ śīlaṃ jīvitaṃ vā dehinām aham eva tu mayā vinā dehabhājo jīvanto 'pi mṛtā iva
verses.translation: What Your Highness said, quoting the example from the Vedas and scriptures is quite apt. I shall add that you are a person who understands the real principle.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दरिद्रया च सा प्रोक्ता सर्वेभ्यो ह्य् अधिका ह्य् अहम् मुक्तिर् मदाश्रिता नित्यं दरिद्रैवं वचो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: daridrayā ca sā proktā sarvebhyo hy adhikā hy aham muktir madāśritā nityaṃ daridraivaṃ vaco 'bravīt
verses.translation: The texts of both, viz. the Vedas and other scriptures are held by you, O king. Be the person who understands the essence of the texts correctly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कामः क्रोधश् च लोभश् च मदो मात्सर्यम् एव च यत्राहम् अस्मि तत्रैते न तिष्ठन्ति कदाचन
verses.transliteration: kāmaḥ krodhaś ca lobhaś ca mado mātsaryam eva ca yatrāham asmi tatraite na tiṣṭhanti kadācana
verses.translation: He who docs not understand the meaning of those texts is merely a carrier of a burden. The acquisition of the texts is not in vain in regard to a person who is conversant with the meaning and principles of the texts.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न भयोद्भूतिर् उन्माद ईर्ष्या उद्धतवृत्तिता यत्राहम् अस्मि तत्रैते न तिष्ठन्ति कदाचन
verses.transliteration: na bhayodbhūtir unmāda īrṣyā uddhatavṛttitā yatrāham asmi tatraite na tiṣṭhanti kadācana
verses.translation: If a person who has not understood the basic prin¬ ciples of a scriptural text begins to explain it out of greed or arrogance, he is a sinner and he will fall into hell.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दरिद्राया वचः श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मीस् तां प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: daridrāyā vacaḥ śrutvā lakṣmīs tāṃ pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: A person of loopholes (i.e. imperfect knowledge) will never explain the text truthfully and confidently since he is neither self-possessed nor conversant with the meaning and basic principles of the text.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अलंकृतो मया जन्तुः सर्वो भवति पूजितः निर्धनः शिवतुल्यो ऽपि सर्वैर् अप्य् अभिभूयते
verses.transliteration: alaṃkṛto mayā jantuḥ sarvo bhavati pūjitaḥ nirdhanaḥ śivatulyo 'pi sarvair apy abhibhūyate
verses.translation: Whatever the followers of the Yoga system see (and understand), the Samkhyas too follow. He who sees the iden¬ tity of the Samkhya and Yoga systems is wise.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देहीति वचनद्वारा देहस्थाः पञ्च देवताः सद्यो निर्गत्य गच्छन्ति धीश्रीह्रीशान्तिकीर्तयः
verses.transliteration: dehīti vacanadvārā dehasthāḥ pañca devatāḥ sadyo nirgatya gacchanti dhīśrīhrīśāntikīrtayaḥ
verses.translation: Skin, flesh, blood, bile, marrow, bone and sinew— O dear one, these can be perceived by the sense-organs, as Your Highness has already told me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तावद् गुणा गुरुत्वं च यावन् नार्थयते परम् अर्थी चेत् पुरुषो जातः क्व गुणाः क्व च गौरवम्
verses.transliteration: tāvad guṇā gurutvaṃ ca yāvan nārthayate param arthī cet puruṣo jātaḥ kva guṇāḥ kva ca gauravam
verses.translation: How will there be Gunas in the great Atman because it is devoid of Gunas? How can this embodied soul devoid of sense-organs have the Gunas? How can there be Guna in a seed that is not solid?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तावत् सर्वोत्तमो जन्तुस् तावत् सर्वगुणालयः नमस्यः सर्वलोकानां यावन् नार्थयते परम्
verses.transliteration: tāvat sarvottamo jantus tāvat sarvaguṇālayaḥ namasyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ yāvan nārthayate param
verses.translation: Gunas are produced from Gunas and they cease to exist there itself. In the same manner the Gunas arising  out of Prakfti are produced from Prakrti but they end therein itself.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कष्टम् एतन् महापापं निर्धनत्वं शरीरिणाम् न मानयति नो वक्ति न स्पृशत्य् अधनं जनः
verses.transliteration: kaṣṭam etan mahāpāpaṃ nirdhanatvaṃ śarīriṇām na mānayati no vakti na spṛśaty adhanaṃ janaḥ
verses.translation: The Gunas exist in one with Guna. Plow can there be Gunas in one without Gunas? Hence those people who look at Gunas know thus.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहम् एव ततः श्रेष्ठा दरिद्रे शृणु मे वचः
verses.transliteration: aham eva tataḥ śreṣṭhā daridre śṛṇu me vacaḥ
verses.translation: When this soul identifies itself with the Gunas belong¬ ing to Prakrti it is one with Gunas and it observes the different Gunas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तल् लक्ष्मीवचनं श्रुत्वा दरिद्रा वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tal lakṣmīvacanaṃ śrutvā daridrā vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: This principle of perishable and Imperishahlp h n<! been mentioned to you. Thev call p tn. /, le has
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वक्तुं न लक्ष्मीर् ज्येष्ठाहम् इति वै लज्जसे मुहुः पापेषु रमसे नित्यं विहाय पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: vaktuṃ na lakṣmīr jyeṣṭhāham iti vai lajjase muhuḥ pāpeṣu ramase nityaṃ vihāya puruṣottamam
verses.translation: The learned men state that the twenty-fifth princmle is
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वस्तवञ्चका नित्यं भवती श्लाघसे कथम् सुखं न तादृक् त्वत्प्राप्तौ पश्चात्तापो यथा गुरुः
verses.transliteration: viśvastavañcakā nityaṃ bhavatī ślāghase katham sukhaṃ na tādṛk tvatprāptau paścāttāpo yathā guruḥ
verses.translation: What has been stated by you, O excellent brahmin, viz. diversity and unity (is not understood by me) even as I observe it. Their example is in doubt.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न तथा जायते पुंसां सुरया दारुणो मदः त्वत्संनिधानमात्रेण यथा वै विदुषाम् अपि
verses.transliteration: na tathā jāyate puṃsāṃ surayā dāruṇo madaḥ tvatsaṃnidhānamātreṇa yathā vai viduṣām api
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, with the gross intellect I do not see the leality, O sinless one, of that which is being known through Buddha (that which is understood) and Prabuddha (the enlightened).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सदैव रमसे लक्ष्मीः प्रायस् त्वं पापकारिषु अहं वसामि योग्येषु धर्मशीलेषु सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: sadaiva ramase lakṣmīḥ prāyas tvaṃ pāpakāriṣu ahaṃ vasāmi yogyeṣu dharmaśīleṣu sarvadā
verses.translation: The explanation too of the perishable and the im¬ perishable, given by you, O sinless one, has been missed by me due to the unsteadiness of intellect.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिवविष्ण्वनुरक्तेषु कृतज्ञेषु महत्सु च सदाचारेषु शान्तेषु गुरुसेवोद्यतेषु च
verses.transliteration: śivaviṣṇvanurakteṣu kṛtajñeṣu mahatsu ca sadācāreṣu śānteṣu gurusevodyateṣu ca
verses.translation: Therefore, I wish to hear this, viz. the philosophy of diversity and unity as well as the mutually opposite pairs that are to be understood essentially and unobstructedly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सत्सु विद्वत्सु शूरेषु कृतबुद्धिषु साधुषु निवसामि सदा लक्ष्मीस् तस्माज् ज्यैष्ठ्यं मयि स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: satsu vidvatsu śūreṣu kṛtabuddhiṣu sādhuṣu nivasāmi sadā lakṣmīs tasmāj jyaiṣṭhyaṃ mayi sthitam
verses.translation: O holy one, I wish to know separately the distinction between knowledge and ignorance, the Imperishable and the perishable, Samkhya and Yoga entirely, as well as the enlight¬ ened and the unenlightened.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणेषु शुचिष्मत्सु व्रतचारिषु भिक्षुषु निर्भयेषु वसिष्यामि लक्ष्मीस् त्वं शृणु ते स्थितिम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇeṣu śuciṣmatsu vratacāriṣu bhikṣuṣu nirbhayeṣu vasiṣyāmi lakṣmīs tvaṃ śṛṇu te sthitim
verses.translation: Oh, I shall narrate unto you what you ask me. O great king, listen separately from me the function of Yoga.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राजवर्तिषु पापेषु निष्ठुरेषु खलेषु च पिशुनेषु च लुब्धेषु विकृतेषु शठेषु च
verses.transliteration: rājavartiṣu pāpeṣu niṣṭhureṣu khaleṣu ca piśuneṣu ca lubdheṣu vikṛteṣu śaṭheṣu ca
verses.translation: (1) The concentration of mind, and (2) the control of breath. Pranayama is of two types, viz. Saguna and Nirguna. The Nirguna is mental.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनार्येषु कृतघ्नेषु धर्मघातिषु सर्वदा मित्रद्रोहिष्व् अनिष्टेषु भग्नचित्तेषु वर्तसे
verses.transliteration: anāryeṣu kṛtaghneṣu dharmaghātiṣu sarvadā mitradrohiṣv aniṣṭeṣu bhagnacitteṣu vartase
verses.translation: One should not practise Pranayama for two units of time,0 ruler of men, after passing urine, evacuating bowels and taking food. After that he shall do so with eagerness.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं विवदमाने ते जग्मतुर् माम् उभे अपि तयोर् वाक्यम् उपश्रुत्य मयोक्ते ते उभे अपि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vivadamāne te jagmatur mām ubhe api tayor vākyam upaśrutya mayokte te ubhe api
verses.translation: Persons who are conversant with truth and who arc masters of the Vcdic lore declare that it is far off from darkness. It has various appellations, viz. Vimala (Devoid of impurities), Vimata(One who is particularly honoured), Nirlinga (That which >'s beyond symbols) and Alinga (That which has no symbols).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मत्तः पूर्वतरा पृथ्वी आपः पूर्वतरास् ततः स्त्रीणां विवादं ता एव स्त्रियो जानन्ति नेतरे
verses.transliteration: mattaḥ pūrvatarā pṛthvī āpaḥ pūrvatarās tataḥ strīṇāṃ vivādaṃ tā eva striyo jānanti netare
verses.translation: So far the Yogic school of philosophy has been re¬ counted in essence to you by me. I shall now recount the Samkhya school which is an example of Parisamkhya (Enu¬ meration).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विशेषतः पुनस् ताभ्यः कमण्डलुभवाश् च याः तत्रापि गौतमी देवी निश्चयं कथयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: viśeṣataḥ punas tābhyaḥ kamaṇḍalubhavāś ca yāḥ tatrāpi gautamī devī niścayaṃ kathayiṣyati
verses.translation: They call the great Prakrti of the soul Avyakta (Un¬ manifest) and Prakhyana (Proclamation). From it originated the second principle Mahat, O most excellent king.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सैव सर्वार्तिसंहर्त्री सैव संदेहकर्तरी ते मद्वाक्याद् भुवं गत्वा भूम्या च सहिते अपि
verses.transliteration: saiva sarvārtisaṃhartrī saiva saṃdehakartarī te madvākyād bhuvaṃ gatvā bhūmyā ca sahite api
verses.translation: These eight are Prakrtis. The Vikaras (products) are sixteen in number. Five of them are Visesas and five are the sense-organs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अद्भिश् च सहिताः सर्वा गौतमीं ययुर् आपगाम् भूमिर् आपस् तयोर् वाक्यं गौतम्यै क्रमशः स्फुटम्
verses.transliteration: adbhiś ca sahitāḥ sarvā gautamīṃ yayur āpagām bhūmir āpas tayor vākyaṃ gautamyai kramaśaḥ sphuṭam
verses.translation: Those who are conversant with the arrangement of the followers of the Samkhya school, those who perpetually abide by the path of the Samkhyas, those who are learned scholars in the Samkhya school say that the number of principles is only this much.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं निवेदयाम् आसुर् यथावृत्तं प्रणम्य ताम् दरिद्रायाश् च लक्ष्म्याश् च वाक्यं मध्यस्थवत् तदा
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ nivedayām āsur yathāvṛttaṃ praṇamya tām daridrāyāś ca lakṣmyāś ca vākyaṃ madhyasthavat tadā
verses.translation: Everything gets dissolved in its respective source of origin wherefrom it has been produced. These principles get dissolved in the reverse order and they are apprehended by the immanent soul.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृण्वत्सु लोकपालेषु शृण्वत्यां भुवि नारद शृण्वतीष्व् अप्सु सा गङ्गा दरिद्रां वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् संप्रशस्य तथा लक्ष्मीं गौतमी वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇvatsu lokapāleṣu śṛṇvatyāṃ bhuvi nārada śṛṇvatīṣv apsu sā gaṅgā daridrāṃ vākyam abravīt saṃpraśasya tathā lakṣmīṃ gautamī vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: The Gunas (i.e. all evolved things) get dissolved in Gunas like the waves of ocean. They are produced in the or¬ dinary order and get dissolved in the reverse order.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मश्रीश् च तपःश्रीश् च यज्ञश्रीः कीर्तिसंज्ञिता धनश्रीश् च यशश्रीश् च विद्या प्रज्ञा सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: brahmaśrīś ca tapaḥśrīś ca yajñaśrīḥ kīrtisaṃjñitā dhanaśrīś ca yaśaśrīś ca vidyā prajñā sarasvatī
verses.translation: The creation and annihilation of Prakrti, O ex¬ cellent king, is this much. In the process of creation it has diversity and unity at the time of annihilation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भुक्तिश्रीश् चाथ मुक्तिश् च स्मृतिर् लज्जा धृतिः क्षमा सिद्धिस् तुष्टिस् तथा पुष्टिः शान्तिर् आपस् तथा मही
verses.transliteration: bhuktiśrīś cātha muktiś ca smṛtir lajjā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā siddhis tuṣṭis tathā puṣṭiḥ śāntir āpas tathā mahī
verses.translation: It has unity and diversity in the same manner as in the case of Prakrti. It has unity at the time of annihilation and multiplicity due to activity.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहंशक्तिर् अथौषध्यः श्रुतिः शुद्धिर् विभावरी द्यौर् ज्योत्स्ना आशिषः स्वस्तिर् व्याप्तिर् माया उषा शिवा
verses.transliteration: ahaṃśaktir athauṣadhyaḥ śrutiḥ śuddhir vibhāvarī dyaur jyotsnā āśiṣaḥ svastir vyāptir māyā uṣā śivā
verses.translation: The Atman shall evolve Prakrti at the time of creation in various ways. The great Atman, the twenty-fifth principle presides over that group.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत् किंचिद् विद्यते लोके लक्ष्म्या व्याप्तं चराचरम् ब्राह्मणेष्व् अथ धीरेषु क्षमावत्स्व् अथ साधुषु
verses.transliteration: yat kiṃcid vidyate loke lakṣmyā vyāptaṃ carācaram brāhmaṇeṣv atha dhīreṣu kṣamāvatsv atha sādhuṣu
verses.translation: It knows the Ksetra or the Avyakta. Hence it is called Ksetrajha. It lies down in the Pura (city) of Avyakta. There¬ fore it is called Purusa.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विद्यायुक्तेषु चान्येषु भुक्तिमुक्त्यनुसारिषु यद् यद् रम्यं सुन्दरं वा तत् तल् लक्ष्मीविजृम्भितम्
verses.transliteration: vidyāyukteṣu cānyeṣu bhuktimuktyanusāriṣu yad yad ramyaṃ sundaraṃ vā tat tal lakṣmīvijṛmbhitam
verses.translation: The number can be forty or twenty-four. After enu¬ merating factually (the principles are to be understood). The Samkhya has a thousand processes. The twenty-fifth principle is beyond the other principles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किम् अत्र बहुनोक्तेन सर्वं लक्ष्मीमयं जगत् यस्मिन् कस्मिंश् च यत् किंचिद् उत्कृष्टं परिदृश्यते
verses.transliteration: kim atra bahunoktena sarvaṃ lakṣmīmayaṃ jagat yasmin kasmiṃś ca yat kiṃcid utkṛṣṭaṃ paridṛśyate
verses.translation: Thus the Samkhya school of philosophy has been
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मीमयं तु तत् सर्वं तया हीनं न किंचन अत्रेमां सुन्दरीं देवीं स्पर्धयन्ती न लज्जसे
verses.transliteration: lakṣmīmayaṃ tu tat sarvaṃ tayā hīnaṃ na kiṃcana atremāṃ sundarīṃ devīṃ spardhayantī na lajjase
verses.translation: Thus the Samkhya school of philosophy has been
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ गच्छेति तां गङ्गा दरिद्रां वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ततः प्रभृति गङ्गाम्भो दरिद्रावैरकार्य् अभूत्
verses.transliteration: gaccha gaccheti tāṃ gaṅgā daridrāṃ vākyam abravīt tataḥ prabhṛti gaṅgāmbho daridrāvairakāry abhūt
verses.translation: Thus the Samkhya school of philosophy has been
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तावद् दरिद्राभिभवो गङ्गा यावन् न सेव्यते ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थम् अलक्ष्मीनाशनं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: tāvad daridrābhibhavo gaṅgā yāvan na sevyate tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham alakṣmīnāśanaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Thus the Samkhya school of philosophy has been
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नानेन दानेन लक्ष्मीवान् पुण्यवान् भवेत् तीर्थानां षट् सहस्राणि तस्मिंस् तीर्थे महामते देवर्षिमुनिजुष्टानां सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snānena dānena lakṣmīvān puṇyavān bhavet tīrthānāṃ ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi tasmiṃs tīrthe mahāmate devarṣimunijuṣṭānāṃ sarvasiddhipradāyinām
verses.translation: Thus the Samkhya school of philosophy has been
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भानुतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वसिद्धिकरं नृणाम् तत्रेदं वृत्तम् आख्यास्ये महापातकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: bhānutīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām tatredaṃ vṛttam ākhyāsye mahāpātakanāśanam
verses.translation: The Samkhya school of philosophy has so far been recounted unto you, O excellent king. Now listen to me and understand Vidya and Avidya in the proper order.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शर्यातिर् इति विख्यातो राजा परमधार्मिकः तस्य भार्या स्थविष्ठेति रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि
verses.transliteration: śaryātir iti vikhyāto rājā paramadhārmikaḥ tasya bhāryā sthaviṣṭheti rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi
verses.translation: Some principles are Vidyas and some are Avidyas; understand them in their proper order. O dear one, understand the recapitulation of the school of Samkhya, as mentioned by the sages.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मधुच्छन्दा इति ख्यातो वैश्वामित्रो द्विजोत्तमः पुरोधास् तस्य नृपतेर् ब्रह्मर्षिः शमिनां प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: madhucchandā iti khyāto vaiśvāmitro dvijottamaḥ purodhās tasya nṛpater brahmarṣiḥ śamināṃ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: The sense-organs are Vidya of the organs of action. Similarly (Tanmatras?) are the Vidya of the sense-organs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दिशो विजेतुं स जगाम राजा पुरोधसा तेन नृपप्रवीरः पुरोधसं प्राह महानुभावं जित्वा दिशश् चाध्वनि संनिविष्टः
verses.transliteration: diśo vijetuṃ sa jagāma rājā purodhasā tena nṛpapravīraḥ purodhasaṃ prāha mahānubhāvaṃ jitvā diśaś cādhvani saṃniviṣṭaḥ
verses.translation: Vidya and Avidya have been briefly mentioned by me. What is known as Aksara and Ksara, understand that from me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पप्रच्छेदं केन खेदं गतो ऽसि हेतुं वदस्वेति महानुभाव त्वम् एव राज्ये मम सर्वमान्यः समस्तविद्यानिरवद्यबोधः
verses.transliteration: papracchedaṃ kena khedaṃ gato 'si hetuṃ vadasveti mahānubhāva tvam eva rājye mama sarvamānyaḥ samastavidyāniravadyabodhaḥ
verses.translation: Both of these are called Ksara. Both of these are Anaksara. I shall mention the reason thereof in relation to
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विधूतपापः परितापशून्यः किम् अन्यचेता इव लक्ष्यसे त्वम् जितेयम् उर्वी विजिता नरेन्द्रा हर्षस्य हेतौ महतीह जाते
verses.transliteration: vidhūtapāpaḥ paritāpaśūnyaḥ kim anyacetā iva lakṣyase tvam jiteyam urvī vijitā narendrā harṣasya hetau mahatīha jāte
verses.translation: Both of them are without beginning and without end.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं त्वं कृशो मे वद सत्यम् एव द्विजातिवर्यातिमहानुभाव संबोध्य शर्यातिम् उवाच विप्रश् छन्दोमधुः प्रेममयीं प्रियोक्तिम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ tvaṃ kṛśo me vada satyam eva dvijātivaryātimahānubhāva saṃbodhya śaryātim uvāca vipraś chandomadhuḥ premamayīṃ priyoktim
verses.translation: Due to the function of creation and annihilation they call Avyakta as unchanging. For the creation of Gunas it undergoes change again and again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणु भूपाल मद्वाक्यं भार्यया यद् उदीरितम् स्थिते यामे वयं यामो यामिनी चार्धगामिनी
verses.transliteration: śṛṇu bhūpāla madvākyaṃ bhāryayā yad udīritam sthite yāme vayaṃ yāmo yāminī cārdhagāminī
verses.translation: One shall reduce the cluster of Gunas within, into the manifest Atman. Therefore the ego gets dissolved in the twenty- fifth principle along with its Gunas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वामिनी चास्य देहस्य कामिनी मां प्रतीक्षते स्मृत्वा तत् कामिनीवाक्यं शोषं याति कलेवरम् विकारे स्मरसंजाते जीवातुर् नलिनानना
verses.transliteration: svāminī cāsya dehasya kāminī māṃ pratīkṣate smṛtvā tat kāminīvākyaṃ śoṣaṃ yāti kalevaram vikāre smarasaṃjāte jīvātur nalinānanā
verses.translation: Gunas get dissolved in Gunas. Therefore, Prakrti shall be one. Even the Ksetrajna is made Ksetrajna (i.e. the individual soul).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विहस्य चाब्रवीद् राजा पुरोधसम् अरिंदमः
verses.transliteration: vihasya cābravīd rājā purodhasam ariṃdamaḥ
verses.translation: When Prakrti characterised by Gunas gets into the Aksara there is Nirgunatva (state of being devoid of Gunas) in the body because of alteration in Gunas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वं गुरुर् मम मित्रं च किम् आत्मानं विडम्बसे किम् अनेन महाप्राज्ञ मम वाक्येन मानद क्षणविध्वंसिनि सुखे का नामास्था महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ gurur mama mitraṃ ca kim ātmānaṃ viḍambase kim anena mahāprājña mama vākyena mānada kṣaṇavidhvaṃsini sukhe kā nāmāsthā mahātmanām
verses.translation: When this becomes Ksara it knows Prakrti possessed of Gunas, among Gunas and also Prakrti devoid of Gunas of the Atman.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतद् आकर्ण्य मतिमान् मधुच्छन्दा वचो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: etad ākarṇya matimān madhucchandā vaco 'bravīt
verses.translation: Morever, he becomes pure avoiding Prakrti and rea¬ lising "I am different from Prakrti".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्रानुकूल्यं दंपत्योस् त्रिवर्गस् तत्र वर्धते न चेदं दूषणं राजन् भूषणं चातिमन्यताम्
verses.transliteration: yatrānukūlyaṃ daṃpatyos trivargas tatra vardhate na cedaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ rājan bhūṣaṇaṃ cātimanyatām
verses.translation: Then he attains freedom from pain. It does not get
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आजगाम स्वकं देशं महत्या सेनया वृतः परीक्षार्थं च तत्प्रेम पुर्यां वार्त्ताम् अदीदिशत्
verses.transliteration: ājagāma svakaṃ deśaṃ mahatyā senayā vṛtaḥ parīkṣārthaṃ ca tatprema puryāṃ vārttām adīdiśat
verses.translation: When he treats with contempt the Gunas, pertaining to Prakrti, he secs the great one.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दिशो विजेतुं शर्यातौ याते राक्षसपुंगवः हत्वा रसातलं यातो राजानं सपुरोधसम्
verses.transliteration: diśo vijetuṃ śaryātau yāte rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ hatvā rasātalaṃ yāto rājānaṃ sapurodhasam
verses.translation: Fie upon me whose intellect has become vitiated and
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञो भार्या निश्चयाय प्रवृत्ता मुनिसत्तम वार्त्तां श्रुत्वा दूतमुखान् मधुच्छन्दःप्रिया पुनः
verses.transliteration: rājño bhāryā niścayāya pravṛttā munisattama vārttāṃ śrutvā dūtamukhān madhucchandaḥpriyā punaḥ
verses.translation: Due to the state of not being enlightened I had asso¬ ciated with Maya. Now I have become free.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदैवाभूद् गतप्राणा तद् विचित्रम् इवाभवत् तस्या वृत्तं तु ते दृष्ट्वा दूता राज्ञे न्यवेदयन्
verses.transliteration: tadaivābhūd gataprāṇā tad vicitram ivābhavat tasyā vṛttaṃ tu te dṛṣṭvā dūtā rājñe nyavedayan
verses.translation: After splitting itself into many he joins me once again. Now I am enlightened. I am devoid of my-ness. I am devoid of egoism.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत् कृतं राजपत्नीभिः प्रियया च पुरोधसः विस्मितो दुःखितो राजा पुनर् दूतान् अभाषत
verses.transliteration: yat kṛtaṃ rājapatnībhiḥ priyayā ca purodhasaḥ vismito duḥkhito rājā punar dūtān abhāṣata
verses.translation: I shall identify myself with this (i.e. the soul) and not with Prakfti which often misleads. My welfare is with the soul and not with Prakrti."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शीघ्रं गच्छन्तु हे दूता ब्राह्मण्या यत् कलेवरम् रक्षन्तु वार्त्तां कुरुत राजागन्ता पुरोधसा
verses.transliteration: śīghraṃ gacchantu he dūtā brāhmaṇyā yat kalevaram rakṣantu vārttāṃ kuruta rājāgantā purodhasā
verses.translation: Thus by addressing the greatest, the twenty-fifth prin¬ ciple is awakened. After abandoning the Ksara he attains the state of Aksara devoid of ailment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति चिन्तातुरे राज्ञि वाग् उवाचाशरीरिणी
verses.transliteration: iti cintāture rājñi vāg uvācāśarīriṇī
verses.translation: (He attains the state Aksara that is Avyakta (unmani¬ fest) and Nirguna (devoid of Gunas) after abandoning the Ksara that is Vyaktadharma (whose attributes are manifest) and Saguna (possessed of Gunas). After seeing the Nirguna first, O king of Mithila, he becomes similar to it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विधास्यत्य् अखिलं गङ्गा राजंस् तव समीहितम् सर्वाभिषङ्गशमनी पावनी भुवि गौतमी
verses.transliteration: vidhāsyaty akhilaṃ gaṅgā rājaṃs tava samīhitam sarvābhiṣaṅgaśamanī pāvanī bhuvi gautamī
verses.translation: Thus the example of Aksara and Ksara has been ex¬ plained to you by me as it has been expounded in the Vedas. It is richly endowed with knowledge.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा स शर्यातिर् गौतमीतटम् आश्रितः ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनं दत्त्वा तर्पयित्वा पितॄन् द्विजान्
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā sa śaryātir gautamītaṭam āśritaḥ brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dattvā tarpayitvā pitṝn dvijān
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरोहितं द्विजश्रेष्ठं प्रेषयित्वा धनान्वितम् अन्यत्र तीर्थे सार्थेषु दानं देहि प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: purohitaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ preṣayitvā dhanānvitam anyatra tīrthe sārtheṣu dānaṃ dehi prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतत् सर्वं न जानाति राज्ञः कृत्यं पुरोहितः गते तस्मिन् गुरौ राजा वैश्वामित्रे महात्मनि
verses.transliteration: etat sarvaṃ na jānāti rājñaḥ kṛtyaṃ purohitaḥ gate tasmin gurau rājā vaiśvāmitre mahātmani
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं बलं प्रेषयित्वा गङ्गातीरे ऽग्निम् आविशत् इत्य् उक्त्वा स तु राजेन्द्रो गङ्गां भानुं सुरान् अपि
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ balaṃ preṣayitvā gaṅgātīre 'gnim āviśat ity uktvā sa tu rājendro gaṅgāṃ bhānuṃ surān api
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यदि दत्तं यदि हुतं यदि त्राता प्रजा मया तेन सत्येन सा साध्वी ममायुष्येण जीवतु
verses.transliteration: yadi dattaṃ yadi hutaṃ yadi trātā prajā mayā tena satyena sā sādhvī mamāyuṣyeṇa jīvatu
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वाग्नौ प्रविष्टे तु शर्यातौ नृपसत्तमे तदैव जीविता भार्या राज्ञस् तस्य पुरोधसः
verses.transliteration: ity uktvāgnau praviṣṭe tu śaryātau nṛpasattame tadaiva jīvitā bhāryā rājñas tasya purodhasaḥ
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्निप्रविष्टं राजानं श्रुत्वा विस्मयकारणम् पतिव्रतां तथा भार्यां मृतां जीवान्वितां पुनः
verses.transliteration: agnipraviṣṭaṃ rājānaṃ śrutvā vismayakāraṇam pativratāṃ tathā bhāryāṃ mṛtāṃ jīvānvitāṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदर्थं चापि राजानं त्यक्तात्मानं विशेषतः आत्मनश् च पुनः कृत्यम् अस्मरन् नृपतेर् गुरुः
verses.transliteration: tadarthaṃ cāpi rājānaṃ tyaktātmānaṃ viśeṣataḥ ātmanaś ca punaḥ kṛtyam asmaran nṛpater guruḥ
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहम् अप्य् अग्निम् आवेक्ष्य उत यास्ये प्रियान्तिकम् अथवेह तपस् तप्स्ये ततो निश्चयवान् द्विजः
verses.transliteration: aham apy agnim āvekṣya uta yāsye priyāntikam athaveha tapas tapsye tato niścayavān dvijaḥ
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतद् एवात्मनः कृत्यं मन्ये सुकृतम् एव च जीवयामि च राजानं ततो यामि प्रियां पुनः
verses.transliteration: etad evātmanaḥ kṛtyaṃ manye sukṛtam eva ca jīvayāmi ca rājānaṃ tato yāmi priyāṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतद् एव शुभं मे स्यात् ततस् तुष्टाव भास्करम् न ह्य् अन्यः कोपि देवो ऽस्ति सर्वाभीष्टप्रदो रवेः
verses.transliteration: etad eva śubhaṃ me syāt tatas tuṣṭāva bhāskaram na hy anyaḥ kopi devo 'sti sarvābhīṣṭaprado raveḥ
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु तस्मै सूर्याय मुक्तये ऽमिततेजसे छन्दोमयाय देवाय ॐकारार्थाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu tasmai sūryāya muktaye 'mitatejase chandomayāya devāya oṃkārārthāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विरूपाय सुरूपाय त्रिगुणाय त्रिमूर्तये स्थित्युत्पत्तिविनाशानां हेतवे प्रभविष्णवे
verses.transliteration: virūpāya surūpāya triguṇāya trimūrtaye sthityutpattivināśānāṃ hetave prabhaviṣṇave
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नः सूर्यो ऽभूद् वरयस्वेत्य् अभाषत
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasannaḥ sūryo 'bhūd varayasvety abhāṣata
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राजानं देहि देवेश भार्यां च प्रियवादिनीम् आत्मनश् च शुभान् पुत्रान् राज्ञश् चैव शुभान् वरान्
verses.transliteration: rājānaṃ dehi deveśa bhāryāṃ ca priyavādinīm ātmanaś ca śubhān putrān rājñaś caiva śubhān varān
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रादाज् जगन्नाथः शर्यातिं रत्नभूषितम् तां च भार्यां वरान् अन्यान् सर्वं क्षेममयं तथा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prādāj jagannāthaḥ śaryātiṃ ratnabhūṣitam tāṃ ca bhāryāṃ varān anyān sarvaṃ kṣemamayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो यातः प्रियाविष्टः प्रीतेन च पुरोधसा ययौ सुखी स्वकं देशं तत् तु तीर्थं शुभं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: tato yātaḥ priyāviṣṭaḥ prītena ca purodhasā yayau sukhī svakaṃ deśaṃ tat tu tīrthaṃ śubhaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र त्रीणि सहस्राणि तीर्थानि गुणवन्ति च ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं भानुतीर्थम् उदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: tatra trīṇi sahasrāṇi tīrthāni guṇavanti ca tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ bhānutīrtham udāhṛtam
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृतसंजीवनं चैव शार्यातं चेति विश्रुतम् माधुच्छन्दसमाख्यातं स्मरणात् पापनुन् मुने
verses.transliteration: mṛtasaṃjīvanaṃ caiva śāryātaṃ ceti viśrutam mādhucchandasamākhyātaṃ smaraṇāt pāpanun mune
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेषु स्नानं च दानं च सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम् मृतसंजीवनं तत् स्याद् आयुरारोग्यवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam mṛtasaṃjīvanaṃ tat syād āyurārogyavardhanam
verses.translation: The philosophy of the schools of Sarhkhya and Yoga has been recounted by me with examples from the two systems. What is stated in the Sarhkhya is the same which is stated in the Yoga system.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: खड्गतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं गौतम्या उत्तरे तटे तत्र स्नानेन दानेन मुक्तिभागी भवेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: khaḍgatīrtham iti khyātaṃ gautamyā uttare taṭe tatra snānena dānena muktibhāgī bhaven naraḥ
verses.translation: Prakrti creates and seizes the unenlightened unmanifest storehouse of Gunas even as Gunas hold the Tattvas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र वृत्तं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु नारद यत्नतः पैलूष इति विख्यातः कवषस्य सुतो द्विजः
verses.transliteration: tatra vṛttaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ pailūṣa iti vikhyātaḥ kavaṣasya suto dvijaḥ
verses.translation: In a playful manner, O king, Aja the unborn attains the state of modification; splitting itself into many it is per¬ ceived as though it is really multifarious.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुटुम्बभारात् परितो ह्य् अर्थार्थी परिधावति न किमप्य् आससादासौ ततो वैराग्यम् आस्थितः
verses.transliteration: kuṭumbabhārāt parito hy arthārthī paridhāvati na kimapy āsasādāsau tato vairāgyam āsthitaḥ
verses.translation: Budhyamana that disturbs and stirs this up like this, is not comprehended. It creates, seizes and practices Gunas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तविमुखे दैवे व्यर्थीभूते तु पौरुषे न वैराग्याद् अन्यद् अस्ति पण्डितस्यावलम्बनम्
verses.transliteration: atyantavimukhe daive vyarthībhūte tu pauruṣe na vairāgyād anyad asti paṇḍitasyāvalambanam
verses.translation: They call this Budhyamana because it enlightens Avyakta. Avyakta is not comprehended in any other manner whether it is Saguna or Nirguna.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति संचिन्तयाम् आस तदासौ निःश्वसन् मुहुः क्रमागतं धनं नास्ति पोष्याश् च बहवो मम
verses.transliteration: iti saṃcintayām āsa tadāsau niḥśvasan muhuḥ kramāgataṃ dhanaṃ nāsti poṣyāś ca bahavo mama
verses.translation: The Budhyamana certainly becomes one with myness for its characteristic feature—so says the Veda. By becoming enlightened due to mutual endeavour it becomes Avyakta that never swerves—They say thus. The perceptible and the imperceptible, O king of great lustre, follow its nature. The Avyakta, O dear one, com¬ prehends that Brahman which is non-dual.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मानी चात्मा न कष्टार्हो हा धिग् दुर्दैवचेष्टितम् स कदाचिद् वृत्तियुतो वृत्तिभिः परिवर्तयन्
verses.transliteration: mānī cātmā na kaṣṭārho hā dhig durdaivaceṣṭitam sa kadācid vṛttiyuto vṛttibhiḥ parivartayan
verses.translation: After coming into contact with the Kevala it shall attain the liberated soul. They call this Tattva (principle) and (the soul) that is without old age and death, Nistattva (one that is beyond the principles).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न लेभे तद् धनं वृत्तेर् विरागम् अगमत् तदा सेवा निषिद्धा या काचिद् गहना दुष्करं तपः
verses.transliteration: na lebhe tad dhanaṃ vṛtter virāgam agamat tadā sevā niṣiddhā yā kācid gahanā duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: Only by duly listening to the description of the Tat- tvas docs the soul, O king, become conversant with the prin¬ ciples. Learned scholars speak about twenty-five principles. Never docs a person conversant with the Tattvas get immersed in the ocean of worldly existence, O dear one. The Tattvas approach these persons quickly. Now understand their
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बलाद् आकर्षतीयं मां तृष्णा सर्वत्र दुष्कृते त्वयापकृतम् अज्ञानात् तस्मात् तृष्णे नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: balād ākarṣatīyaṃ māṃ tṛṣṇā sarvatra duṣkṛte tvayāpakṛtam ajñānāt tasmāt tṛṣṇe namo 'stu te
verses.translation: It attains equality, O king of Mithila, with (the enlightened one) that is being comprehended. Although the Atman is devoid of attachment, O ruler of men, it has the features and characteristics of what is being attached.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं विचिन्त्य मेधावी तृष्णाछेदाय किं भवेत् इत्य् आलोच्य स पैलूषः पितरं वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vicintya medhāvī tṛṣṇāchedāya kiṃ bhavet ity ālocya sa pailūṣaḥ pitaraṃ vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: They understand that the twenty-sixth principle is evolved out of Karman, after attaining the Atman that is free from attachment. When this is enlightened the omnipresent soul abandons the Avyakta. O great king, the truth and the truthful reality have been recounted so far. By grasping with your intellect the eternal Brahman, the first pure one, you have become Amat- sara, devoid of jealousy.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानासिना क्रोधलोभौ संसृतिं चातिदुस्तराम् छेद्मीमां केन हे तात तम् उपायं वद प्रभो
verses.transliteration: jñānāsinā krodhalobhau saṃsṛtiṃ cātidustarām chedmīmāṃ kena he tāta tam upāyaṃ vada prabho
verses.translation: O king, this great truth should not be imparted to a person not abiding by the Vedas. It imparts enlightenment in regard to a person who is desirous of acting according to it. It admonishes one who bows down for enlightenment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वराज् ज्ञानम् अन्विच्छेद् इत्य् एषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः तस्माद् आराधयेशानं ततो ज्ञानम् अवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: īśvarāj jñānam anvicched ity eṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ tasmād ārādhayeśānaṃ tato jñānam avāpsyasi
verses.translation: This truth should not be imparted to a liar nor to a rogue, nor to an impotent person nor to a person of crooked intellect. It should not be imparted to a person who harasses scholars devoted to knowledge. It should be imparted for the enlightenment of the disciples. This secret should be imparted to a person who has discrimination, who is fond of injunctions, who is devoid of quarrelsome dispute, who has learned much, who has humble dress and demeanour and who has no selfish motive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा स पैलूषो ज्ञानायेश्वरम् आर्चयत् ततस् तुष्टो महेशानो ज्ञानं प्रादाद् द्विजातये प्राप्तज्ञानो महाबुद्धिर् गाथाः प्रोवाच मुक्तिदाः
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā sa pailūṣo jñānāyeśvaram ārcayat tatas tuṣṭo maheśāno jñānaṃ prādād dvijātaye prāptajñāno mahābuddhir gāthāḥ provāca muktidāḥ
verses.translation: They say that knowledge of this great Brahman should not be imparted to a person who is devoid of these qualities. The narration of virtue in regard to such person is not conducive to welfare, because it is like charity accorded to a person who does not deserve it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्रोधस् तु प्रथमं शत्रुर् निष्फलो देहनाशनः ज्ञानखड्गेन तं छित्त्वा परमं सुखम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: krodhas tu prathamaṃ śatrur niṣphalo dehanāśanaḥ jñānakhaḍgena taṃ chittvā paramaṃ sukham āpnuyāt
verses.translation: This should not be given to a person who has no sacred rites even if the entire earth full of jewels were given away. O leader of men, this great thing should be imparted to a per¬ son who has conquered his sense organs, who observes pure rites and who knows reality. O Karala, let there be no fear at all in you. This great Brahman has been heard by you today. It has been duly re¬ counted. It is extremely sacred. It is fully free from grief. It has neither beginning nor middle nor end.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तृष्णा बहुविधा माया बन्धनी पापकारिणी छित्त्वैतां ज्ञानखड्गेन सुखं तिष्ठति मानवः
verses.transliteration: tṛṣṇā bahuvidhā māyā bandhanī pāpakāriṇī chittvaitāṃ jñānakhaḍgena sukhaṃ tiṣṭhati mānavaḥ
verses.translation: I have been asked by you, O leader of men. So this has been recounted to you exclusively # as it had been obtained from Brahma. It is the great knowledge, the utmost resort of those who are conversant with salvation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सङ्गस् तु परमो ऽधर्मो देवादीनाम् इति श्रुतिः असङ्गस्यात्मनो ह्य् अस्य सङ्गो ऽयं परमो रिपुः
verses.transliteration: saṅgas tu paramo 'dharmo devādīnām iti śrutiḥ asaṅgasyātmano hy asya saṅgo 'yaṃ paramo ripuḥ
verses.translation: This great Brahman, the twenty-fifth principle, from which one does not return has now been recounted in the same manner as it had been recounted, O excellent sages, by Vasis- tha formerly. This eternal doctrine has been recounted to me and it has been obtained by me from Narada. After hearing about this great doctrine, O excellent sages, you will not feel sorry.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: छित्त्वैनं ज्ञानखड्गेन शिवैकत्वम् अवाप्नुयात् संशयः परमो नाशो धर्मार्थानां विनाशकृत्
verses.transliteration: chittvainaṃ jñānakhaḍgena śivaikatvam avāpnuyāt saṃśayaḥ paramo nāśo dharmārthānāṃ vināśakṛt
verses.translation: He has no fear who has understood that Ksara and Aksara are different. He has fear certainly who does not know this accurately.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: छित्त्वैनं संशयं जन्तुः परमेप्सितम् आप्नुयात् पिशाचीव विशत्य् आशा निर्दहत्य् अखिलं सुखम् पूर्णाहन्तासिना छित्त्वा जीवन् मुक्तिम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: chittvainaṃ saṃśayaṃ jantuḥ paramepsitam āpnuyāt piśācīva viśaty āśā nirdahaty akhilaṃ sukham pūrṇāhantāsinā chittvā jīvan muktim avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Due to the absence of perfect knowledge a person of confounded soul undergoes hardships again and again and attains thousands of births ending with death. Or he may go to the heavenly world or to the realm of low creatures or to the human world. Or perhaps he is released from that ocean of ignorance.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो ज्ञानम् अवाप्यासौ गङ्गातीरं समाश्रितः ज्ञानखड्गेन निर्मोहस् ततो मुक्तिम् अवाप सः
verses.transliteration: tato jñānam avāpyāsau gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritaḥ jñānakhaḍgena nirmohas tato muktim avāpa saḥ
verses.translation: In the terrible ocean of ignorance the unmanifest is called the unfathomable one. O brahmins, it is here that the living beings become immersed day by day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं खड्गतीर्थम् इति स्मृतम् ज्ञानतीर्थं च कवषं पैलूषं सर्वकामदम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ khaḍgatīrtham iti smṛtam jñānatīrthaṃ ca kavaṣaṃ pailūṣaṃ sarvakāmadam
verses.translation: Hence due to the destruction of the unfathomable Avyakta, the eternal one, all of you, O brahmins, have become free from Rajas and Tamas. Thus, O excellent sages, the great Liberation, the es¬ sence of essences, has been recounted by me. On realising it one does not return.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्यादिषट्सहस्राणि तीर्थान्य् आहुर् महर्षयः अशेषपापतापौघहराणीष्टप्रदानि च
verses.transliteration: ityādiṣaṭsahasrāṇi tīrthāny āhur maharṣayaḥ aśeṣapāpatāpaughaharāṇīṣṭapradāni ca
verses.translation: It should not be imparted to an atheist or to a person who is not a devotee. O brahmins, it should not be imparted to an evil-minded person nor to a person who has no faith and who is averse to everything good.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आत्रेयम् इति विख्यातम् अन्विन्द्रं तीर्थम् उत्तमम् तस्य प्रभावं वक्ष्यामि भ्रष्टराज्यप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: ātreyam iti vikhyātam anvindraṃ tīrtham uttamam tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi bhraṣṭarājyapradāyakam
verses.translation: O lord Boar, by your favour, we shall go to heaven. Let Soma (the Moon-god), the observer of Yoga be our guar¬ dian.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतम्या उत्तरे तीर आत्रेयो भगवान् ऋषिः अन्वारेभे ऽथ सत्त्राणि ऋत्विग्भिर् मुनिभिर् वृतः
verses.transliteration: gautamyā uttare tīra ātreyo bhagavān ṛṣiḥ anvārebhe 'tha sattrāṇi ṛtvigbhir munibhir vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Let Yama be your deity; Moon the preceptor; Fire the priest.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य होताभवत् त्व् अग्निर् हव्यवाहन एव च एवं सत्त्रे तु संपूर्ण इष्टिं माहेश्वरीं पुनः
verses.transliteration: tasya hotābhavat tv agnir havyavāhana eva ca evaṃ sattre tu saṃpūrṇa iṣṭiṃ māheśvarīṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: Let Fire, wind and Sun be your abodes; Brahma, \ isnu and Rudra be your guardians.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वैश्वर्यम् अगाद् विप्रः सर्वत्र गतिम् एव च इन्द्रस्य भवनं रम्यं स्वर्गलोकं रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvaiśvaryam agād vipraḥ sarvatra gatim eva ca indrasya bhavanaṃ ramyaṃ svargalokaṃ rasātalam
verses.translation: Let Aditiyas, Vasus and Rudras be your forms. Let \ ogis, embodying \ oga make yoga as your basis and observe
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वेच्छया याति विप्रेन्द्रः प्रभावात् तपसः शुभात् स कदाचिद् दिवं गत्वा इन्द्रलोकम् अगात् पुनः
verses.transliteration: svecchayā yāti viprendraḥ prabhāvāt tapasaḥ śubhāt sa kadācid divaṃ gatvā indralokam agāt punaḥ
verses.translation: Known as Koka, she will resort to Himalaya. She will be as efficacious as the crores of holy places all together.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापश्यत् सहस्राक्षं सुरैः परिवृतं शुभैः स्तूयमानं सिद्धसाध्यैः प्रेक्षन्तं नृत्यम् उत्तमम् शृण्वानं मधुरं गीतम् अप्सरोभिश् च वीजितम्
verses.transliteration: tatrāpaśyat sahasrākṣaṃ suraiḥ parivṛtaṃ śubhaiḥ stūyamānaṃ siddhasādhyaiḥ prekṣantaṃ nṛtyam uttamam śṛṇvānaṃ madhuraṃ gītam apsarobhiś ca vījitam
verses.translation: I shall stay in Koka from this very day, smashing sins of all mankind. The sight of lord Boar is holy. His worship grants worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपोपविष्टैः सुरनायकैस् तैः संपूज्यमानं महदासनस्थम् जयन्तम् अङ्के विनिधाय सूनुं शच्या युतं प्राप्तरतिं महिष्ठम्
verses.transliteration: upopaviṣṭaiḥ suranāyakais taiḥ saṃpūjyamānaṃ mahadāsanastham jayantam aṅke vinidhāya sūnuṃ śacyā yutaṃ prāptaratiṃ mahiṣṭham
verses.translation: Drinking the water of Koka destroys sins. The plunge yields merit. The fast leads to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सतां शरण्यं वरदं महेन्द्रं समीक्ष्य विप्राधिपतिर् महात्मा विमोहितो ऽसौ मुनिर् इन्द्रलक्ष्म्या समीहयाम् आस तद् इन्द्रराज्यम्
verses.transliteration: satāṃ śaraṇyaṃ varadaṃ mahendraṃ samīkṣya viprādhipatir mahātmā vimohito 'sau munir indralakṣmyā samīhayām āsa tad indrarājyam
verses.translation: Charity gives imperishable fruit; it destroys sins of birth, death and old age.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संपूजितो देवगणैर् यथावत् स्वम् आश्रमं वै पुनर् आजगाम समीक्ष्य तां शक्रपुरीं सुरम्यां रत्नैर् युतां पुण्यगुणैः सुपूर्णाम्
verses.transliteration: saṃpūjito devagaṇair yathāvat svam āśramaṃ vai punar ājagāma samīkṣya tāṃ śakrapurīṃ suramyāṃ ratnair yutāṃ puṇyaguṇaiḥ supūrṇām
verses.translation: He who fasts here reaps the fruit thereof as mentioned previously. O blessed ones, you are now free to go to your places at your will.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वम् आश्रमं निष्प्रभहेमवर्ज्यं समीक्ष्य विप्रो विरमं जगाम समीहमानः सुरराज्यम् आशु प्रियां तदोवाच महात्रिपुत्रः
verses.transliteration: svam āśramaṃ niṣprabhahemavarjyaṃ samīkṣya vipro viramaṃ jagāma samīhamānaḥ surarājyam āśu priyāṃ tadovāca mahātriputraḥ
verses.translation: "I too shall rest here", saying this lord Boar disappear¬ ed. When lord Boar had gone, the pitrs took leave of Koka and went away.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भोक्तुं न शक्तो ऽस्मि फलानि मूलान्य् अनुत्तमान्य् अप्य् अतिसंस्कृतानि स्मृत्वामृतं पुण्यतमं च तत्र भक्ष्यं च भोज्यं च वरासनानि
verses.transliteration: bhoktuṃ na śakto 'smi phalāni mūlāny anuttamāny apy atisaṃskṛtāni smṛtvāmṛtaṃ puṇyatamaṃ ca tatra bhakṣyaṃ ca bhojyaṃ ca varāsanāni
verses.translation: Thus have I described at Kokamukha the Boar incar¬ nate ofVisnu who confers boons to the people. On hearing this description, a man is purified from dirt, becomes devoid of sins, and obtains the merit of performing Asvamedha Sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो महात्मा तपसः प्रभावात् त्वष्टारम् आहूय वचो बभाषे
verses.transliteration: tato mahātmā tapasaḥ prabhāvāt tvaṣṭāram āhūya vaco babhāṣe
verses.translation: Thus have I described at Kokamukha the Boar incar¬ nate ofVisnu who confers boons to the people. On hearing this description, a man is purified from dirt, becomes devoid of sins, and obtains the merit of performing Asvamedha Sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इच्छेयम् इन्द्रत्वम् अहं महात्मन् कुरुष्व शीघ्रं पदम् ऐन्द्रम् अत्र ब्रूषे ऽन्यथा चेन् मदुदीरितं त्वं भस्मीकरोम्य् एव न संशयो ऽत्र
verses.transliteration: iccheyam indratvam ahaṃ mahātman kuruṣva śīghraṃ padam aindram atra brūṣe 'nyathā cen madudīritaṃ tvaṃ bhasmīkaromy eva na saṃśayo 'tra
verses.translation: Thus have I described at Kokamukha the Boar incar¬ nate ofVisnu who confers boons to the people. On hearing this description, a man is purified from dirt, becomes devoid of sins, and obtains the merit of performing Asvamedha Sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदत्रिवाक्यात् त्वरितः प्रजानां स्रष्टा विभुर् विश्वकर्मा तदैव चकार मेरुं च पुरीं सुराणां कल्पद्रुमान् कल्पलतां च धेनुम्
verses.transliteration: tadatrivākyāt tvaritaḥ prajānāṃ sraṣṭā vibhur viśvakarmā tadaiva cakāra meruṃ ca purīṃ surāṇāṃ kalpadrumān kalpalatāṃ ca dhenum
verses.translation: Thus have I described at Kokamukha the Boar incar¬ nate ofVisnu who confers boons to the people. On hearing this description, a man is purified from dirt, becomes devoid of sins, and obtains the merit of performing Asvamedha Sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चकार वज्रादिविभूषितानि गृहाणि शुभ्राण्य् अतिचित्रितानि चकार सर्वावयवानवद्यां शचीं स्मरस्येव विहारशालाम्
verses.transliteration: cakāra vajrādivibhūṣitāni gṛhāṇi śubhrāṇy aticitritāni cakāra sarvāvayavānavadyāṃ śacīṃ smarasyeva vihāraśālām
verses.translation: Thus have I described at Kokamukha the Boar incar¬ nate ofVisnu who confers boons to the people. On hearing this description, a man is purified from dirt, becomes devoid of sins, and obtains the merit of performing Asvamedha Sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सभां सुधर्माणम् अहो क्षणेन तथा चकाराप्सरसो मनोज्ञाः चकार चोच्चैःश्रवसं गजं च वज्रादि चास्त्राणि सुरान् अशेषान्
