verses.transliteration: aratiṃ durjayāṃ caiva ghorāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca bho dvijāḥ sparśaṃ nidrāṃ tathā tandrāṃ durjayāṃ munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: दीपयन्ति महात्मानं सूक्ष्मम् आत्मानम् आत्मना वीतरागा महाप्राज्ञा ध्यानाध्ययनसंपदा
verses.transliteration: dīpayanti mahātmānaṃ sūkṣmam ātmānam ātmanā vītarāgā mahāprājñā dhyānādhyayanasaṃpadā
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गस् त्व् एष मतः पन्था ब्राह्मणानां विपश्चिताम् यः कश्चिद् व्रजति क्षिप्रं क्षेमेण मुनिपुंगवाः
verses.transliteration: durgas tv eṣa mataḥ panthā brāhmaṇānāṃ vipaścitām yaḥ kaścid vrajati kṣipraṃ kṣemeṇa munipuṃgavāḥ
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यथा कश्चिद् वनं घोरं बहुसर्पसरीसृपम् श्वभ्रवत् तोयहीनं च दुर्गमं बहुकण्टकम्
verses.transliteration: yathā kaścid vanaṃ ghoraṃ bahusarpasarīsṛpam śvabhravat toyahīnaṃ ca durgamaṃ bahukaṇṭakam
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अभक्तम् अटवीप्रायं दावदग्धमहीरुहम् पन्थानं तस्कराकीर्णं क्षेमेणाभिपतेत् तथा
verses.transliteration: abhaktam aṭavīprāyaṃ dāvadagdhamahīruham panthānaṃ taskarākīrṇaṃ kṣemeṇābhipatet tathā
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: योगमार्गं समासाद्य यः कश्चिद् व्रजते द्विजः क्षेमेणोपरमेन् मार्गाद् बहुदोषो ऽपि संमतः
verses.transliteration: yogamārgaṃ samāsādya yaḥ kaścid vrajate dvijaḥ kṣemeṇoparamen mārgād bahudoṣo 'pi saṃmataḥ
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आस्थेयं क्षुरधारासु निशितासु द्विजोत्तमाः धारणा सा तु योगस्य दुर्गेयम् अकृतात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: āstheyaṃ kṣuradhārāsu niśitāsu dvijottamāḥ dhāraṇā sā tu yogasya durgeyam akṛtātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विषमा धारणा विप्रा यान्ति वै न शुभां गतिम् नेतृहीना यथा नावः पुरुषाणां तु वै द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: viṣamā dhāraṇā viprā yānti vai na śubhāṃ gatim netṛhīnā yathā nāvaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ tu vai dvijāḥ
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यस् तु तिष्ठति योगाधौ धारणासु यथाविधि मरणं जन्मदुःखित्वं सुखित्वं स विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: yas tu tiṣṭhati yogādhau dhāraṇāsu yathāvidhi maraṇaṃ janmaduḥkhitvaṃ sukhitvaṃ sa viśiṣyate
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: नानाशास्त्रेषु नियतं नानामुनिनिषेवितम् परं योगस्य पन्थानं निश्चितं तं द्विजातिषु
verses.transliteration: nānāśāstreṣu niyataṃ nānāmuniniṣevitam paraṃ yogasya panthānaṃ niścitaṃ taṃ dvijātiṣu
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: परं हि तद् ब्रह्ममयं मुनीन्द्रा ब्रह्माणम् ईशं वरदं च विष्णुम् भवं च धर्मं च महानुभावं यद् ब्रह्मपुत्रान् सुमहानुभावान्
verses.transliteration: paraṃ hi tad brahmamayaṃ munīndrā brahmāṇam īśaṃ varadaṃ ca viṣṇum bhavaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca mahānubhāvaṃ yad brahmaputrān sumahānubhāvān
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तमश् च कष्टं सुमहद् रजश् च सत्त्वं च शुद्धं प्रकृतिं परां च सिद्धिं च देवीं वरुणस्य पत्नीं तेजश् च कृत्स्नं सुमहच् च धैर्यम्
verses.transliteration: tamaś ca kaṣṭaṃ sumahad rajaś ca sattvaṃ ca śuddhaṃ prakṛtiṃ parāṃ ca siddhiṃ ca devīṃ varuṇasya patnīṃ tejaś ca kṛtsnaṃ sumahac ca dhairyam
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: ताराधिपं खे विमलं सुतारं विश्वांश् च देवान् उरगान् पितॄंश् च शैलांश् च कृत्स्नान् उदधींश् च वाचलान् नदीश् च सर्वाः सनगांश् च नागान्
verses.transliteration: tārādhipaṃ khe vimalaṃ sutāraṃ viśvāṃś ca devān uragān pitṝṃś ca śailāṃś ca kṛtsnān udadhīṃś ca vācalān nadīś ca sarvāḥ sanagāṃś ca nāgān
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: साध्यांस् तथा यक्षगणान् दिशश् च गन्धर्वसिद्धान् पुरुषान् स्त्रियश् च परस्परं प्राप्य महान् महात्मा विशेत योगी नचिराद् विमुक्तः
verses.transliteration: sādhyāṃs tathā yakṣagaṇān diśaś ca gandharvasiddhān puruṣān striyaś ca parasparaṃ prāpya mahān mahātmā viśeta yogī nacirād vimuktaḥ
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: कथा च या विप्रवराः प्रसक्ता दैवे महावीर्यमतौ शुभेयम् योगान् स सर्वान् अनुभूय मर्त्या नारायणं तं द्रुतम् आप्नुवन्ति
verses.transliteration: kathā ca yā vipravarāḥ prasaktā daive mahāvīryamatau śubheyam yogān sa sarvān anubhūya martyā nārāyaṇaṃ taṃ drutam āpnuvanti
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सम्यक् क्रियेयं विप्रेन्द्र वर्णिता शिष्टसंमता योगमार्गो यथान्यायं शिष्यायेह हितैषिणा
verses.transliteration: samyak kriyeyaṃ viprendra varṇitā śiṣṭasaṃmatā yogamārgo yathānyāyaṃ śiṣyāyeha hitaiṣiṇā
verses.translation: By performing penance he became invincible to all Devas. He became very terrible. His son also was very power¬ ful, difficult to be conquered by Devas.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सांख्ये त्व् इदानीं धर्मस्य विधिं प्रब्रूहि तत्त्वतः त्रिषु लोकेषु यज् ज्ञानं सर्वं तद् विदितं हि ते
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhye tv idānīṃ dharmasya vidhiṃ prabrūhi tattvataḥ triṣu lokeṣu yaj jñānaṃ sarvaṃ tad viditaṃ hi te
verses.translation: After conquering Indra Mahasani marched against Varuna in order to conquer him. Varuna of great intellect offered his daughter to Mahaiani.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं मुनयः सर्वम् आख्यानं विदितात्मनाम् विहितं यतिभिर् वृद्धैः कपिलादिभिर् ईश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarvam ākhyānaṃ viditātmanām vihitaṃ yatibhir vṛddhaiḥ kapilādibhir īśvaraiḥ
verses.translation: Varuna gave his own abode in ocean to Mahasani. Friendship was generated between Varuna and Mahasani in this way.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् सुविभ्रमाः केचिद् दृश्यन्ते मुनिसत्तमाः गुणाश् च यस्मिन् बहवो दोषहानिश् च केवला
verses.transliteration: yasmin suvibhramāḥ kecid dṛśyante munisattamāḥ guṇāś ca yasmin bahavo doṣahāniś ca kevalā
verses.translation: Visnu alone shall be the person to restore Indra. He alone is the slayer of Daityas. He alone shall be the seer of Mantras. He will create another Indra.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानेन परिसंख्याय सदोषान् विषयान् द्विजाः मानुषान् दुर्जयान् कृत्स्नान् पैशाचान् विषयांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: jñānena parisaṃkhyāya sadoṣān viṣayān dvijāḥ mānuṣān durjayān kṛtsnān paiśācān viṣayāṃs tathā
verses.translation: By whom have you been created, O Indra? Your valour is useless. Wherefore do you boast so much? You are being tormented by enemies in the battlefield. Still you continue to be Indra. This is ridiculous.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विषयान् औरगाञ् ज्ञात्वा गन्धर्वविषयांस् तथा पितॄणां विषयाञ् ज्ञात्वा तिर्यक्त्वं चरतां द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: viṣayān auragāñ jñātvā gandharvaviṣayāṃs tathā pitṝṇāṃ viṣayāñ jñātvā tiryaktvaṃ caratāṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: You have been caught and imprisoned by me in the battle along with your vehicle. Your miraculous weapon (Thunderbolt) of uncontrollable power has been (cast off) some¬ where. Fie upon your life! After being set free through the intercession of the lord of waters you still wish to live despite
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्णविषयाञ् ज्ञात्वा मरुतां विषयांस् तथा महर्षिविषयांश् चैव राजर्षिविषयांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: suparṇaviṣayāñ jñātvā marutāṃ viṣayāṃs tathā maharṣiviṣayāṃś caiva rājarṣiviṣayāṃs tathā
verses.translation: "That which is the storehouse of fame is life, that which is antagonistic to fame is death"—even after knowing this, O Indra, how did you get yourself released through the intercession of the lord of Waters? Why don't you feel ashamed?
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आसुरान् विषयाञ् ज्ञात्वा वैश्वदेवांस् तथैव च देवर्षिविषयाञ् ज्ञात्वा योगानाम् अपि वै परान्
verses.transliteration: āsurān viṣayāñ jñātvā vaiśvadevāṃs tathaiva ca devarṣiviṣayāñ jñātvā yogānām api vai parān
verses.translation: You were staying in heaven surrounded by Devas fanned by your beloved wife and eulogized by the celestial damsels. I think, indeed, bashfulness is afraid of you.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विषयांश् च प्रमाणस्य ब्रह्मणो विषयांस् तथा आयुषश् च परं कालं लोकैर् विज्ञाय तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: viṣayāṃś ca pramāṇasya brahmaṇo viṣayāṃs tathā āyuṣaś ca paraṃ kālaṃ lokair vijñāya tattvataḥ
verses.translation: "You are the slayer of Vj-tra, killer ofNamuci, breaker of cities; with the thunderbolt in your hand you have split the mountains". Thus Devas honour you. Hence, O victorious one I abandon all these.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सुखस्य च परं कालं विज्ञाय मुनिसत्तमाः प्राप्तकाले च यद् दुःखं पततां विषयैषिणाम्
verses.transliteration: sukhasya ca paraṃ kālaṃ vijñāya munisattamāḥ prāptakāle ca yad duḥkhaṃ patatāṃ viṣayaiṣiṇām
verses.translation: After saying this, the lord of Daityas gave Indra to the noble-souled Varuna. Thereafter, he said these words again.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तिर्यक्त्वे पततां विप्रास् तथैव नरकेषु यत् स्वर्गस्य च गुणाञ् ज्ञात्वा दोषान् सर्वांश् च भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tiryaktve patatāṃ viprās tathaiva narakeṣu yat svargasya ca guṇāñ jñātvā doṣān sarvāṃś ca bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: From now onwards Indra shall be the disciple and Varuna the preceptor—Varuna who is my father-in-law and through whom, O Indra, you have attained freedom.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: वेदवादे च ये दोषा गुणा ये चापि वैदिकाः ज्ञानयोगे च ये दोषा ज्ञानयोगे च ये गुणाः
verses.transliteration: vedavāde ca ye doṣā guṇā ye cāpi vaidikāḥ jñānayoge ca ye doṣā jñānayoge ca ye guṇāḥ
verses.translation: In the same manner you shall behave like a servant unto Varuna. Otherwise, I will be obliged to imprison you and hurl you into the nether worlds.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सांख्यज्ञाने च ये दोषांस् तथैव च गुणा द्विजाः सत्त्वं दशगुणं ज्ञात्वा रजो नवगुणं तथा
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyajñāne ca ye doṣāṃs tathaiva ca guṇā dvijāḥ sattvaṃ daśaguṇaṃ jñātvā rajo navaguṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: After rebuking Indra thus and laughing again and again he took leave of Varuna and said (to Indra) "Go, go".
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तमश् चाष्टगुणं ज्ञात्वा बुद्धिं सप्तगुणां तथा षड्गुणं च नभो ज्ञात्वा तमश् च त्रिगुणं महत्
verses.transliteration: tamaś cāṣṭaguṇaṃ jñātvā buddhiṃ saptaguṇāṃ tathā ṣaḍguṇaṃ ca nabho jñātvā tamaś ca triguṇaṃ mahat
verses.translation: Indra then reached his abode completely overwhelmed by shame. He told his wife the details of his defeat and discomfi¬ ture at the hands of the enemy.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: द्विगुणं च रजो ज्ञात्वा सत्त्वं चैकगुणं पुनः मार्गं विज्ञाय तत्त्वेन प्रलयप्रेक्षणेन तु
verses.transliteration: dviguṇaṃ ca rajo jñātvā sattvaṃ caikaguṇaṃ punaḥ mārgaṃ vijñāya tattvena pralayaprekṣaṇena tu
verses.translation: I have been told thus and treated thus, O lady of splen-
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानविज्ञानसंपन्नाः कारणैर् भावितात्मभिः प्राप्नुवन्ति शुभं मोक्षं सूक्ष्मा इव नभः परम्
verses.transliteration: jñānavijñānasaṃpannāḥ kāraṇair bhāvitātmabhiḥ prāpnuvanti śubhaṃ mokṣaṃ sūkṣmā iva nabhaḥ param
verses.translation: O Indra, the slayer of Bala, I know the origin of Danavas, their Maya, mortification, grant of boons as well as their death.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: रूपेण दृष्टिं संयुक्तां घ्राणं गन्धगुणेन च शब्दग्राह्यं तथा श्रोत्रं जिह्वां रसगुणेन च
verses.transliteration: rūpeṇa dṛṣṭiṃ saṃyuktāṃ ghrāṇaṃ gandhaguṇena ca śabdagrāhyaṃ tathā śrotraṃ jihvāṃ rasaguṇena ca
verses.translation: Hence, I shall say for your satisfaction everything necessary for the death or defeat of that demon.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: त्वचं स्पर्शं तथा शक्यं वायुं चैव तदाश्रितम् मोहं तमसि संयुक्तं लोभं मोहेषु संश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: tvacaṃ sparśaṃ tathā śakyaṃ vāyuṃ caiva tadāśritam mohaṃ tamasi saṃyuktaṃ lobhaṃ moheṣu saṃśritam
verses.translation: He propitiated Brahma by means of penance and obser¬ vances. He acquired a great power like this. What is it that cannot be achieved by means of penance?
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुं क्रान्ते बले शक्रं कोष्ठे सक्तं तथानलम् अप्सु देवीं समायुक्ताम् आपस् तेजसि संश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuṃ krānte bale śakraṃ koṣṭhe saktaṃ tathānalam apsu devīṃ samāyuktām āpas tejasi saṃśritāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, no undue worry or wonder should be entertained by you. Listen. This must be pursued as it is overdue.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तेजो वायौ तु संयुक्तं वायुं नभसि चाश्रितम् नभो महति संयुक्तं तमो महसि संस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tejo vāyau tu saṃyuktaṃ vāyuṃ nabhasi cāśritam nabho mahati saṃyuktaṃ tamo mahasi saṃsthitam
verses.translation: There too you shall go to that land which has become a holy centre. There you will attain all cherished desires by worshipping Visnu and Siva.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: रजः सत्त्वं तथा सक्तं सत्त्वं सक्तं तथात्मनि सक्तम् आत्मानम् ईशे च देवे नारायणे तथा
verses.transliteration: rajaḥ sattvaṃ tathā saktaṃ sattvaṃ saktaṃ tathātmani saktam ātmānam īśe ca deve nārāyaṇe tathā
verses.translation: Again this has been heard by me. Only those women who are chaste ladies know everything. The world consisting of the mobile and immobile is sustained by them.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: देवं मोक्षे च संयुक्तं ततो मोक्षं च न क्वचित् ज्ञात्वा सत्त्वगुणं देहं वृतं षोडशभिर् गुणैः
verses.transliteration: devaṃ mokṣe ca saṃyuktaṃ tato mokṣaṃ ca na kvacit jñātvā sattvaguṇaṃ dehaṃ vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhir guṇaiḥ
verses.translation: By means of devotion, penance or prayer perform the rite of propitiation along with me. Then you will attain welfare by the favour of lord Siva and lord Visnu.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावं भावनां चैव ज्ञात्वा देहसमाश्रिताम् मध्यस्थम् इव चात्मानं पापं यस्मिन् न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: svabhāvaṃ bhāvanāṃ caiva jñātvā dehasamāśritām madhyastham iva cātmānaṃ pāpaṃ yasmin na vidyate
verses.translation: If a man performs a good rite unknowingly the lord gives him as much benefit as he deserves; but if he performs it knowingly it shall be hundred times more beneficial. If a man performs a holy rite along with his wife it has everlasting benefit.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयं कर्म वै ज्ञात्वा विप्रेन्द्रा विषयैषिणाम् इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थांश् च सर्वान् आत्मनि संश्रितान्
verses.transliteration: dvitīyaṃ karma vai jñātvā viprendrā viṣayaiṣiṇām indriyāṇīndriyārthāṃś ca sarvān ātmani saṃśritān
verses.translation: If a man does any thing alone he gets only half the benefit, but if he does it along with his wife, O lord, the man gets abundant benefit.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: दुर्लभत्वं च मोक्षस्य विज्ञाय श्रुतिपूर्वकम् प्राणापानौ समानं च व्यानोदानौ च तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: durlabhatvaṃ ca mokṣasya vijñāya śrutipūrvakam prāṇāpānau samānaṃ ca vyānodānau ca tattvataḥ
verses.translation: This idea occurs in the Vedas too, which say that one who has understood holy rites very well takes the help of his wife.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आद्यं चैवानिलं ज्ञात्वा प्रभवं चानिलं पुनः सप्तधा तांस् तथा शेषान् सप्तधा विधिवत् पुनः
verses.transliteration: ādyaṃ caivānilaṃ jñātvā prabhavaṃ cānilaṃ punaḥ saptadhā tāṃs tathā śeṣān saptadhā vidhivat punaḥ
verses.translation: It subdues sins entirely. It bestows all cherished desires. Hence, go there along with me. Perform meritorious rites yield¬ ing great benefit.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतीन् ऋषींश् चैव सर्गांश् च सुबहून् वरान् सप्तर्षींश् च बहूञ् ज्ञात्वा राजर्षींश् च परंतपान्
verses.transliteration: prajāpatīn ṛṣīṃś caiva sargāṃś ca subahūn varān saptarṣīṃś ca bahūñ jñātvā rājarṣīṃś ca paraṃtapān
verses.translation: At the outset he bowed down to Gahga. After taking the holy bath he joined his palms in reverence. Seeking sole refuge in Siva he recited the following prayer:
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सुरर्षीन् मरुतश् चान्यान् ब्रह्मर्षीन् सूर्यसंनिभान् ऐश्वर्याच् च्यावितान् दृष्ट्वा कालेन महता द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: surarṣīn marutaś cānyān brahmarṣīn sūryasaṃnibhān aiśvaryāc cyāvitān dṛṣṭvā kālena mahatā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: May that Pinaka-bearing lord be pleased with us— the lord who creates, protects and devours the entire universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings through his own Maya but does not get entangled in it; who is single, who is independent and who is of the nature of non-dual knowledge and happiness.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: महतां भूतसंघानां श्रुत्वा नाशं च भो द्विजाः गतिं वाचां शुभां ज्ञात्वा अर्चार्हाः पापकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: mahatāṃ bhūtasaṃghānāṃ śrutvā nāśaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ gatiṃ vācāṃ śubhāṃ jñātvā arcārhāḥ pāpakarmaṇām
verses.translation: May that consort of Parvati be pleased with me, the lord whose reality even Sanaka and others conversant with the esoteric doctrine of Vedanta, do not know; who is the bestower of all cherished desires and who is the enemy of Demon Andhaka. 1
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: वैतरण्यां च यद् दुःखं पतितानां यमक्षये योनिषु च विचित्रासु संचारान् अशुभांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: vaitaraṇyāṃ ca yad duḥkhaṃ patitānāṃ yamakṣaye yoniṣu ca vicitrāsu saṃcārān aśubhāṃs tathā
verses.translation: The self-born lord created Brahma and saw his terrible head. He plucked it off with the tips of his nails. He hurled it when it stuck to his nails and from it the three objects 2 of worldly existence, viz., virtue, love and wealth, originated.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: जठरे चाशुभे वासं शोणितोदकभाजने श्लेष्ममूत्रपुरीषे च तीव्रगन्धसमन्विते
verses.transliteration: jaṭhare cāśubhe vāsaṃ śoṇitodakabhājane śleṣmamūtrapurīṣe ca tīvragandhasamanvite
verses.translation: Sin, poverty, greed, begging, delusion and adversity were born therefrom. Many other endless things also took shape from them. They became influential. They had the features of worldly misery. This entire visible world is pervaded by them.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रशोणितसंघाते मज्जास्नायुपरिग्रहे शिराशतसमाकीर्णे नवद्वारे पुरे ऽथ वै
verses.transliteration: śukraśoṇitasaṃghāte majjāsnāyuparigrahe śirāśatasamākīrṇe navadvāre pure 'tha vai
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञाय हितम् आत्मानं योगांश् च विविधान् द्विजाः तामसानां च जन्तूनां रमणीयानृतात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: vijñāya hitam ātmānaṃ yogāṃś ca vividhān dvijāḥ tāmasānāṃ ca jantūnāṃ ramaṇīyānṛtātmanām
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्विकानां च जन्तूनां कुत्सितं मुनिसत्तमाः गर्हितं महताम् अर्थे सांख्यानां विदितात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: sāttvikānāṃ ca jantūnāṃ kutsitaṃ munisattamāḥ garhitaṃ mahatām arthe sāṃkhyānāṃ viditātmanām
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: उपप्लवांस् तथा घोराञ् शशिनस् तेजसस् तथा ताराणां पतनं दृष्ट्वा नक्षत्राणां च पर्ययम्
verses.transliteration: upaplavāṃs tathā ghorāñ śaśinas tejasas tathā tārāṇāṃ patanaṃ dṛṣṭvā nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca paryayam
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: द्वंद्वानां विप्रयोगं च विज्ञाय कृपणं द्विजाः अन्योन्यभक्षणं दृष्ट्वा भूतानाम् अपि चाशुभम्
verses.transliteration: dvaṃdvānāṃ viprayogaṃ ca vijñāya kṛpaṇaṃ dvijāḥ anyonyabhakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūtānām api cāśubham
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: बाल्ये मोहं च विज्ञाय पक्षदेहस्य चाशुभम् रागं मोहं च संप्राप्तं क्वचित् सत्त्वं समाश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: bālye mohaṃ ca vijñāya pakṣadehasya cāśubham rāgaṃ mohaṃ ca saṃprāptaṃ kvacit sattvaṃ samāśritam
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रेषु नरः कश्चिन् मोक्षबुद्धिं समाश्रितः दुर्लभत्वं च मोक्षस्य विज्ञानं श्रुतिपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: sahasreṣu naraḥ kaścin mokṣabuddhiṃ samāśritaḥ durlabhatvaṃ ca mokṣasya vijñānaṃ śrutipūrvakam
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: बहुमानम् अलब्धेषु लब्धे मध्यस्थतां पुनः विषयाणां च दौरात्म्यं विज्ञाय च पुनर् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: bahumānam alabdheṣu labdhe madhyasthatāṃ punaḥ viṣayāṇāṃ ca daurātmyaṃ vijñāya ca punar dvijāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: गतासूनां च सत्त्वानां देहान् भित्त्वा तथा शुभान् वासं कुलेषु जन्तूनां मरणाय धृतात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: gatāsūnāṃ ca sattvānāṃ dehān bhittvā tathā śubhān vāsaṃ kuleṣu jantūnāṃ maraṇāya dhṛtātmanām
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्विकानां च जन्तूनां दुःखं विज्ञाय भो द्विजाः ब्रह्मघ्नानां गतिं ज्ञात्वा पतितानां सुदारुणाम्
verses.transliteration: sāttvikānāṃ ca jantūnāṃ duḥkhaṃ vijñāya bho dvijāḥ brahmaghnānāṃ gatiṃ jñātvā patitānāṃ sudāruṇām
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सुरापाने च सक्तानां ब्राह्मणानां दुरात्मनाम् गुरुदारप्रसक्तानां गतिं विज्ञाय चाशुभाम्
verses.transliteration: surāpāne ca saktānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ durātmanām gurudāraprasaktānāṃ gatiṃ vijñāya cāśubhām
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: जननीषु च वर्तन्ते येन सम्यग् द्विजोत्तमाः सदेवकेषु लोकेषु येन वर्तन्ति मानवाः
verses.transliteration: jananīṣu ca vartante yena samyag dvijottamāḥ sadevakeṣu lokeṣu yena vartanti mānavāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तेन ज्ञानेन विज्ञाय गतिं चाशुभकर्मणाम् तिर्यग्योनिगतानां च विज्ञाय च गतीः पृथक्
verses.transliteration: tena jñānena vijñāya gatiṃ cāśubhakarmaṇām tiryagyonigatānāṃ ca vijñāya ca gatīḥ pṛthak
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: वेदवादांस् तथा चित्रान् ऋतूनां पर्ययांस् तथा क्षयं संवत्सराणां च मासानां च क्षयं तथा
verses.transliteration: vedavādāṃs tathā citrān ṛtūnāṃ paryayāṃs tathā kṣayaṃ saṃvatsarāṇāṃ ca māsānāṃ ca kṣayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: पक्षक्षयं तथा दृष्ट्वा दिवसानां च संक्षयम् क्षयं वृद्धिं च चन्द्रस्य दृष्ट्वा प्रत्यक्षतस् तथा
verses.transliteration: pakṣakṣayaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā divasānāṃ ca saṃkṣayam kṣayaṃ vṛddhiṃ ca candrasya dṛṣṭvā pratyakṣatas tathā
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धिं दृष्ट्वा समुद्राणां क्षयं तेषां तथा पुनः क्षयं धनानां दृष्ट्वा च पुनर् वृद्धिं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: vṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā samudrāṇāṃ kṣayaṃ teṣāṃ tathā punaḥ kṣayaṃ dhanānāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca punar vṛddhiṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: संयोगानां तथा दृष्ट्वा युगानां च विशेषतः देहवैक्लव्यतां चैव सम्यग् विज्ञाय तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: saṃyogānāṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā yugānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ dehavaiklavyatāṃ caiva samyag vijñāya tattvataḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मदोषांश् च विज्ञाय सर्वान् आत्मनि संस्थितान् स्वदेहाद् उत्थितान् गन्धांस् तथा विज्ञाय चाशुभान्
verses.transliteration: ātmadoṣāṃś ca vijñāya sarvān ātmani saṃsthitān svadehād utthitān gandhāṃs tathā vijñāya cāśubhān
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: कान् उत्पातभवान् दोषान् पश्यसि ब्रह्मवित्तम एतं नः संशयं कृत्स्नं वक्तुम् अर्हस्य् अशेषतः
verses.transliteration: kān utpātabhavān doṣān paśyasi brahmavittama etaṃ naḥ saṃśayaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vaktum arhasy aśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्च दोषान् द्विजा देहे प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः मार्गज्ञाः कापिलाः सांख्याः शृणुध्वं मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: pañca doṣān dvijā dehe pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ mārgajñāḥ kāpilāḥ sāṃkhyāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: कामक्रोधौ भयं निद्रा पञ्चमः श्वास उच्यते एते दोषाः शरीरेषु दृश्यन्ते सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: kāmakrodhau bhayaṃ nidrā pañcamaḥ śvāsa ucyate ete doṣāḥ śarīreṣu dṛśyante sarvadehinām
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: छिन्दन्ति क्षमया क्रोधं कामं संकल्पवर्जनात् सत्त्वसंसेवनान् निद्राम् अप्रमादाद् भयं तथा
verses.transliteration: chindanti kṣamayā krodhaṃ kāmaṃ saṃkalpavarjanāt sattvasaṃsevanān nidrām apramādād bhayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: छिन्दन्ति पञ्चमं श्वासम् अल्पाहारतया द्विजाः गुणान् गुणशतैर् ज्ञात्वा दोषान् दोषशतैर् अपि
verses.transliteration: chindanti pañcamaṃ śvāsam alpāhāratayā dvijāḥ guṇān guṇaśatair jñātvā doṣān doṣaśatair api
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.

verses.sanskrit: हेतून् हेतुशतैश् चित्रैश् चित्रान् विज्ञाय तत्त्वतः अपां फेनोपमं लोकं विष्णोर् मायाशतैः कृतम्
verses.transliteration: hetūn hetuśataiś citraiś citrān vijñāya tattvataḥ apāṃ phenopamaṃ lokaṃ viṣṇor māyāśataiḥ kṛtam

verses.sanskrit: चित्रभित्तिप्रतीकाशं नलसारम् अनर्थकम् तमःसंभ्रमितं दृष्ट्वा वर्षबुद्बुदसंनिभम्
verses.transliteration: citrabhittipratīkāśaṃ nalasāram anarthakam tamaḥsaṃbhramitaṃ dṛṣṭvā varṣabudbudasaṃnibham
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.

verses.sanskrit: नाशप्रायं सुखाधानं नाशोत्तरमहाभयम् रजस् तमसि संमग्नं पङ्के द्विपम् इवावशम्
verses.transliteration: nāśaprāyaṃ sukhādhānaṃ nāśottaramahābhayam rajas tamasi saṃmagnaṃ paṅke dvipam ivāvaśam
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सांख्या विप्रा महाप्राज्ञास् त्यक्त्वा स्नेहं प्रजाकृतम् ज्ञानज्ञेयेन सांख्येन व्यापिना महता द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyā viprā mahāprājñās tyaktvā snehaṃ prajākṛtam jñānajñeyena sāṃkhyena vyāpinā mahatā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: राजसान् अशुभान् गन्धांस् तामसांश् च तथाविधान् पुण्यांश् च सात्त्विकान् गन्धान् स्पर्शजान् देहसंश्रितान्
verses.transliteration: rājasān aśubhān gandhāṃs tāmasāṃś ca tathāvidhān puṇyāṃś ca sāttvikān gandhān sparśajān dehasaṃśritān
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: छित्त्वात्मज्ञानशस्त्रेण तपोदण्डेन सत्तमाः ततो दुःखादिकं घोरं चिन्ताशोकमहाह्रदम्
verses.transliteration: chittvātmajñānaśastreṇa tapodaṇḍena sattamāḥ tato duḥkhādikaṃ ghoraṃ cintāśokamahāhradam
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: व्याधिमृत्युमहाघोरं महाभयमहोरगम् तमःकूर्मं रजोमीनं प्रज्ञया संतरन्त्य् उत
verses.transliteration: vyādhimṛtyumahāghoraṃ mahābhayamahoragam tamaḥkūrmaṃ rajomīnaṃ prajñayā saṃtaranty uta
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स्नेहपङ्कं जरादुर्गं स्पर्शद्वीपं द्विजोत्तमाः कर्मागाधं सत्यतीरं स्थितं व्रतमनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: snehapaṅkaṃ jarādurgaṃ sparśadvīpaṃ dvijottamāḥ karmāgādhaṃ satyatīraṃ sthitaṃ vratamanīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: हर्षसंघमहावेगं नानारससमाकुलम् नानाप्रीतिमहारत्नं दुःखज्वरसमीरितम्
verses.transliteration: harṣasaṃghamahāvegaṃ nānārasasamākulam nānāprītimahāratnaṃ duḥkhajvarasamīritam
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: शोकतृष्णामहावर्तं तीक्ष्णव्याधिमहारुजम् अस्थिसंघातसंघट्टं श्लेष्मयोगं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: śokatṛṣṇāmahāvartaṃ tīkṣṇavyādhimahārujam asthisaṃghātasaṃghaṭṭaṃ śleṣmayogaṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: दानमुक्ताकरं घोरं शोणितोद्गारविद्रुमम् हसितोत्क्रुष्टनिर्घोषं नानाज्ञानसुदुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: dānamuktākaraṃ ghoraṃ śoṇitodgāravidrumam hasitotkruṣṭanirghoṣaṃ nānājñānasuduṣkaram
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: रोदनाश्रुमलक्षारं सङ्गयोगपरायणम् प्रलब्ध्वा जन्मलोको यं पुत्रबान्धवपत्तनम्
verses.transliteration: rodanāśrumalakṣāraṃ saṅgayogaparāyaṇam pralabdhvā janmaloko yaṃ putrabāndhavapattanam
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसासत्यमर्यादं प्राणयोगमयोर्मिलम् वृन्दानुगामिनं क्षीरं सर्वभूतपयोदधिम्
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsāsatyamaryādaṃ prāṇayogamayormilam vṛndānugāminaṃ kṣīraṃ sarvabhūtapayodadhim
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षदुर्लभविषयं वाडवासुखसागरम् तरन्ति यतयः सिद्धा ज्ञानयोगेन चानघाः
verses.transliteration: mokṣadurlabhaviṣayaṃ vāḍavāsukhasāgaram taranti yatayaḥ siddhā jñānayogena cānaghāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तीर्त्वा च दुस्तरं जन्म विशन्ति विमलं नभः ततस् तान् सुकृतीञ् ज्ञात्वा सूर्यो वहति रश्मिभिः
verses.transliteration: tīrtvā ca dustaraṃ janma viśanti vimalaṃ nabhaḥ tatas tān sukṛtīñ jñātvā sūryo vahati raśmibhiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: पद्मतन्तुवद् आविश्य प्रवहन् विषयान् द्विजाः तत्र तान् प्रवहो वायुः प्रतिगृह्णाति चानघाः
verses.transliteration: padmatantuvad āviśya pravahan viṣayān dvijāḥ tatra tān pravaho vāyuḥ pratigṛhṇāti cānaghāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: वीतरागान् यतीन् सिद्धान् वीर्ययुक्तांस् तपोधनान् सूक्ष्मः शीतः सुगन्धश् च सुखस्पर्शश् च भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: vītarāgān yatīn siddhān vīryayuktāṃs tapodhanān sūkṣmaḥ śītaḥ sugandhaś ca sukhasparśaś ca bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सप्तानां मरुतां श्रेष्ठो लोकान् गच्छति यः शुभान् स तान् वहति विप्रेन्द्रा नभसः परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: saptānāṃ marutāṃ śreṣṭho lokān gacchati yaḥ śubhān sa tān vahati viprendrā nabhasaḥ paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: नभो वहति लोकेशान् रजसः परमां गतिम् रजो वहति विप्रेन्द्राः सत्त्वस्य परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: nabho vahati lokeśān rajasaḥ paramāṃ gatim rajo vahati viprendrāḥ sattvasya paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं वहति शुद्धात्मा परं नारायणं प्रभुम् प्रभुर् वहति शुद्धात्मा परमात्मानम् आत्मना
verses.transliteration: sattvaṃ vahati śuddhātmā paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum prabhur vahati śuddhātmā paramātmānam ātmanā
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: परमात्मानम् आसाद्य तद्भूता यतयो ऽमलाः अमृतत्वाय कल्पन्ते न निवर्तन्ति च द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: paramātmānam āsādya tadbhūtā yatayo 'malāḥ amṛtatvāya kalpante na nivartanti ca dvijāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: परमा सा गतिर् विप्रा निर्द्वंद्वानां महात्मनाम् सत्यार्जवरतानां वै सर्वभूतदयावताम्
verses.transliteration: paramā sā gatir viprā nirdvaṃdvānāṃ mahātmanām satyārjavaratānāṃ vai sarvabhūtadayāvatām
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स्थानम् उत्तमम् आसाद्य भगवन्तं स्थिरव्रताः आजन्ममरणं वा ते रमन्ते तत्र वा न वा
verses.transliteration: sthānam uttamam āsādya bhagavantaṃ sthiravratāḥ ājanmamaraṇaṃ vā te ramante tatra vā na vā
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.

verses.sanskrit: यद् अत्र तथ्यं तत्त्वं नो यथावद् वक्तुम् अर्हसि त्वदृते मानवं नान्यं प्रष्टुम् अर्हाम सत्तम
verses.transliteration: yad atra tathyaṃ tattvaṃ no yathāvad vaktum arhasi tvadṛte mānavaṃ nānyaṃ praṣṭum arhāma sattama
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षदोषो महान् एष प्राप्य सिद्धिं गतान् ऋषीन् यदि तत्रैव विज्ञाने वर्तन्ते यतयः परे
verses.transliteration: mokṣadoṣo mahān eṣa prāpya siddhiṃ gatān ṛṣīn yadi tatraiva vijñāne vartante yatayaḥ pare
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिलक्षणं धर्मं पश्याम परमं द्विज मग्नस्य हि परे ज्ञाने किंतु दुःखान्तरं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ paśyāma paramaṃ dvija magnasya hi pare jñāne kiṃtu duḥkhāntaraṃ bhavet
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यथान्यायं मुनिश्रेष्ठाः प्रश्नः पृष्टश् च संकटः बुधानाम् अपि संमोहः प्रश्ने ऽस्मिन् मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: yathānyāyaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ praśnaḥ pṛṣṭaś ca saṃkaṭaḥ budhānām api saṃmohaḥ praśne 'smin munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अत्रापि तत्त्वं परमं शृणुध्वं वचनं मम बुद्धिश् च परमा यत्र कपिलानां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: atrāpi tattvaṃ paramaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ vacanaṃ mama buddhiś ca paramā yatra kapilānāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाण्य् अपि बुध्यन्ते स्वदेहं देहिनां द्विजाः करणान्य् आत्मनस् तानि सूक्ष्मं पश्यन्ति तैस् तु सः
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇy api budhyante svadehaṃ dehināṃ dvijāḥ karaṇāny ātmanas tāni sūkṣmaṃ paśyanti tais tu saḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मना विप्रहीणानि काष्ठकुड्यसमानि तु विनश्यन्ति न संदेहो वेला इव महार्णवे
verses.transliteration: ātmanā viprahīṇāni kāṣṭhakuḍyasamāni tu vinaśyanti na saṃdeho velā iva mahārṇave
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियैः सह सुप्तस्य देहिनो द्विजसत्तमाः सूक्ष्मश् चरति सर्वत्र नभसीव समीरणः
verses.transliteration: indriyaiḥ saha suptasya dehino dvijasattamāḥ sūkṣmaś carati sarvatra nabhasīva samīraṇaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स पश्यति यथान्यायं स्मृत्वा स्पृशति चानघाः बुध्यमानो यथापूर्वम् अखिलेनेह भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sa paśyati yathānyāyaṃ smṛtvā spṛśati cānaghāḥ budhyamāno yathāpūrvam akhileneha bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि ह सर्वाणि स्वे स्वे स्थाने यथाविधि अनीशत्वात् प्रलीयन्ते सर्पा विषहता इव
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇi ha sarvāṇi sve sve sthāne yathāvidhi anīśatvāt pralīyante sarpā viṣahatā iva
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणां तु सर्वेषां स्वस्थानेष्व् एव सर्वशः आक्रम्य गतयः सूक्ष्मा वरत्य् आत्मा न संशयः
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ svasthāneṣv eva sarvaśaḥ ākramya gatayaḥ sūkṣmā varaty ātmā na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वस्य च गुणान् कृत्स्नान् रजसश् च गुणान् पुनः गुणांश् च तमसः सर्वान् गुणान् बुद्धेश् च सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sattvasya ca guṇān kṛtsnān rajasaś ca guṇān punaḥ guṇāṃś ca tamasaḥ sarvān guṇān buddheś ca sattamāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: गुणांश् च मनसश् चापि नभसश् च गुणांस् तथा गुणान् वायोश् च सर्वज्ञाः स्नेहजांश् च गुणान् पुनः
verses.transliteration: guṇāṃś ca manasaś cāpi nabhasaś ca guṇāṃs tathā guṇān vāyoś ca sarvajñāḥ snehajāṃś ca guṇān punaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अपां गुणास् तथा विप्राः पार्थिवांश् च गुणान् अपि सर्वान् एव गुणैर् व्याप्य क्षेत्रज्ञेषु द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: apāṃ guṇās tathā viprāḥ pārthivāṃś ca guṇān api sarvān eva guṇair vyāpya kṣetrajñeṣu dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मा चरति क्षेत्रज्ञः कर्मणा च शुभाशुभे शिष्या इव महात्मानम् इन्द्रियाणि च तं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: ātmā carati kṣetrajñaḥ karmaṇā ca śubhāśubhe śiṣyā iva mahātmānam indriyāṇi ca taṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिं चाप्य् अतिक्रम्य शुद्धं सूक्ष्मं परात् परम् नारायणं महात्मानं निर्विकारं परात् परम्
verses.transliteration: prakṛtiṃ cāpy atikramya śuddhaṃ sūkṣmaṃ parāt param nārāyaṇaṃ mahātmānaṃ nirvikāraṃ parāt param
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्तं सर्वपापेभ्यः प्रविष्टं च ह्य् अनामयम् परमात्मानम् अगुणं निर्वृतं तं च सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: vimuktaṃ sarvapāpebhyaḥ praviṣṭaṃ ca hy anāmayam paramātmānam aguṇaṃ nirvṛtaṃ taṃ ca sattamāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: श्रेष्ठं तत्र मनो विप्रा इन्द्रियाणि च भो द्विजाः आगच्छन्ति यथाकालं गुरोः संदेशकारिणः
verses.transliteration: śreṣṭhaṃ tatra mano viprā indriyāṇi ca bho dvijāḥ āgacchanti yathākālaṃ guroḥ saṃdeśakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: शक्यं वाल्पेन कालेन शान्तिं प्राप्तुं गुणांस् तथा एवम् उक्तेन विप्रेन्द्राः सांख्ययोगेन मोक्षिणीम्
verses.transliteration: śakyaṃ vālpena kālena śāntiṃ prāptuṃ guṇāṃs tathā evam uktena viprendrāḥ sāṃkhyayogena mokṣiṇīm
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सांख्या विप्रा महाप्राज्ञा गच्छन्ति परमां गतिम् ज्ञानेनानेन विप्रेन्द्रास् तुल्यं ज्ञानं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyā viprā mahāprājñā gacchanti paramāṃ gatim jñānenānena viprendrās tulyaṃ jñānaṃ na vidyate
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अत्र वः संशयो मा भूज् ज्ञानं सांख्यं परं मतम् अक्षरं ध्रुवम् एवोक्तं पूर्वं ब्रह्म सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: atra vaḥ saṃśayo mā bhūj jñānaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ paraṃ matam akṣaraṃ dhruvam evoktaṃ pūrvaṃ brahma sanātanam
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अनादिमध्यनिधनं निर्द्वंद्वं कर्तृ शाश्वतम् कूटस्थं चैव नित्यं च यद् वदन्ति शमात्मकाः
verses.transliteration: anādimadhyanidhanaṃ nirdvaṃdvaṃ kartṛ śāśvatam kūṭasthaṃ caiva nityaṃ ca yad vadanti śamātmakāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यतः सर्वाः प्रवर्तन्ते सर्गप्रलयविक्रियाः एवं शंसन्ति शास्त्रेषु प्रवक्तारो महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: yataḥ sarvāḥ pravartante sargapralayavikriyāḥ evaṃ śaṃsanti śāstreṣu pravaktāro maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे विप्राश् च वेदाश् च तथा सामविदो जनाः ब्रह्मण्यं परमं देवम् अनन्तं परमाच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: sarve viprāś ca vedāś ca tathā sāmavido janāḥ brahmaṇyaṃ paramaṃ devam anantaṃ paramācyutam
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रार्थयन्तश् च तं विप्रा वदन्ति गुणबुद्धयः सम्यग् उक्तास् तथा योगाः सांख्याश् चामितदर्शनाः
verses.transliteration: prārthayantaś ca taṃ viprā vadanti guṇabuddhayaḥ samyag uktās tathā yogāḥ sāṃkhyāś cāmitadarśanāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अमूर्तिस् तस्य विप्रेन्द्राः सांख्यं मूर्तिर् इति श्रुतिः अभिज्ञानानि तस्याहुर् महान्ति मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: amūrtis tasya viprendrāḥ sāṃkhyaṃ mūrtir iti śrutiḥ abhijñānāni tasyāhur mahānti munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: द्विविधानि हि भूतानि पृथिव्यां द्विजसत्तमाः अगम्यगम्यसंज्ञानि गम्यं तत्र विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: dvividhāni hi bhūtāni pṛthivyāṃ dvijasattamāḥ agamyagamyasaṃjñāni gamyaṃ tatra viśiṣyate
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं महद् वै महतश् च विप्रा वेदेषु सांख्येषु तथैव योगे यच् चापि दृष्टं विधिवत् पुराणे सांख्यागतं तन् निखिलं मुनीन्द्राः
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ mahad vai mahataś ca viprā vedeṣu sāṃkhyeṣu tathaiva yoge yac cāpi dṛṣṭaṃ vidhivat purāṇe sāṃkhyāgataṃ tan nikhilaṃ munīndrāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यच् चेतिहासेषु महत्सु दृष्टं यथार्थशास्त्रेषु विशिष्टदृष्टम् ज्ञानं च लोके यद् इहास्ति किंचित् सांख्यागतं तच् च महामुनीन्द्राः
verses.transliteration: yac cetihāseṣu mahatsu dṛṣṭaṃ yathārthaśāstreṣu viśiṣṭadṛṣṭam jñānaṃ ca loke yad ihāsti kiṃcit sāṃkhyāgataṃ tac ca mahāmunīndrāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: समस्तदृष्टं परमं बलं च ज्ञानं च मोक्षश् च यथावद् उक्तम् तपांसि सूक्ष्माणि च यानि चैव सांख्ये यथावद् विहितानि विप्राः
verses.transliteration: samastadṛṣṭaṃ paramaṃ balaṃ ca jñānaṃ ca mokṣaś ca yathāvad uktam tapāṃsi sūkṣmāṇi ca yāni caiva sāṃkhye yathāvad vihitāni viprāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विपर्ययं तस्य हितं सदैव गच्छन्ति सांख्याः सततं सुखेन तांश् चापि संधार्य ततः कृतार्थाः पतन्ति विप्रायतनेषु भूयः
verses.transliteration: viparyayaṃ tasya hitaṃ sadaiva gacchanti sāṃkhyāḥ satataṃ sukhena tāṃś cāpi saṃdhārya tataḥ kṛtārthāḥ patanti viprāyataneṣu bhūyaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: हित्वा च देहं प्रविशन्ति मोक्षं दिवौकसश् चापि च योगसांख्याः अतो ऽधिकं ते ऽभिरता महार्हे सांख्ये द्विजा भो इह शिष्टजुष्टे
verses.transliteration: hitvā ca dehaṃ praviśanti mokṣaṃ divaukasaś cāpi ca yogasāṃkhyāḥ ato 'dhikaṃ te 'bhiratā mahārhe sāṃkhye dvijā bho iha śiṣṭajuṣṭe
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तु तिर्यग्गमनं हि दृष्टं नाधो गतिः पापकृतां निवासः न वा प्रधाना अपि ते द्विजातयो ये ज्ञानम् एतन् मुनयो न सक्ताः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tu tiryaggamanaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ nādho gatiḥ pāpakṛtāṃ nivāsaḥ na vā pradhānā api te dvijātayo ye jñānam etan munayo na saktāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सांख्यं विशालं परमं पुराणं महार्णवं विमलम् उदारकान्तम् कृत्स्नं हि सांख्या मुनयो महात्म नारायणे धारयताप्रमेयम्
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyaṃ viśālaṃ paramaṃ purāṇaṃ mahārṇavaṃ vimalam udārakāntam kṛtsnaṃ hi sāṃkhyā munayo mahātma nārāyaṇe dhārayatāprameyam
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एतन् मयोक्तं परमं हि तत्त्वं नारायणाद् विश्वम् इदं पुराणम् स सर्गकाले च करोति सर्गं संहारकाले च हरेत भूयः
verses.transliteration: etan mayoktaṃ paramaṃ hi tattvaṃ nārāyaṇād viśvam idaṃ purāṇam sa sargakāle ca karoti sargaṃ saṃhārakāle ca hareta bhūyaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: किं तद् अक्षरम् इत्य् उक्तं यस्मान् नावर्तते पुनः किंस्वित् तत् क्षरम् इत्य् उक्तं यस्माद् आवर्तते पुनः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ tad akṣaram ity uktaṃ yasmān nāvartate punaḥ kiṃsvit tat kṣaram ity uktaṃ yasmād āvartate punaḥ
verses.translation: A demon with a thousand arms and heads, two thousands eyes and feet, so called because he walked like a blind man; killed by Siva when he attem¬ pted to carry off the Purijata tree from Svarga.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अक्षराक्षरयोर् व्यक्तिं पृच्छामस् त्वां महामुने उपलब्धुं मुनिश्रेष्ठ तत्त्वेन मुनिपुंगव
verses.transliteration: akṣarākṣarayor vyaktiṃ pṛcchāmas tvāṃ mahāmune upalabdhuṃ muniśreṣṭha tattvena munipuṃgava
verses.translation: Trivarga, i.e. the three supreme objects desired by worldly persons, vu., Dharma, Artha and Kama. The fourth is Moksa or ultimate deliverance from the world of transmigration. All the four together are know as caturvarga i.e. four kinds of highest objects or Purufdrthacatu}taya i.e. four supreme objects of human endeavour.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि ज्ञानविदां श्रेष्ठः प्रोच्यसे वेदपारगैः ऋषिभिश् च महाभागैर् यतिभिश् च महात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi jñānavidāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ procyase vedapāragaiḥ ṛṣibhiś ca mahābhāgair yatibhiś ca mahātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: O bestower of boons, the foundation of the universe, be victorious. You are the enjoyment of worldly pleasures, you are the concentration, you are the highest liberation. You were Svaha, Svadha, Svasti (hail), the primordial spiritual achieve¬ ment, the speech and the intellect, O immortal goddess, devoid of old age.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तद् एतच् छ्रोतुम् इच्छामस् त्वत्तः सर्वं महामते न तृप्तिम् अधिगच्छामः शृण्वन्तो ऽमृतम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tad etac chrotum icchāmas tvattaḥ sarvaṃ mahāmate na tṛptim adhigacchāmaḥ śṛṇvanto 'mṛtam uttamam
verses.translation: At my behest you accord protection to the three worlds. They shall be created by you alone as variegated and wonderful as the one created by Prakfti."
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अत्र वो वर्णयिष्यामि इतिहासं पुरातनम् वसिष्ठस्य च संवादं करालजनकस्य च
verses.transliteration: atra vo varṇayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam vasiṣṭhasya ca saṃvādaṃ karālajanakasya ca
verses.translation: On being told thus by lord Siva, the beloved wife of the lord became eager to embrace and chat lovingly to the lord. When she became tired she closely clung to half of the body of Siva and discharged drops of sweat from the tips of her fingers.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठं श्रेष्ठम् आसीनम् ऋषीणां भास्करद्युतिम् पप्रच्छ जनको राजा ज्ञानं नैःश्रेयसं परम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭham āsīnam ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāskaradyutim papraccha janako rājā jñānaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ param
verses.translation: Then Vi§nu became pleased and spoke, "What should be given?"
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: परमात्मनि कुशलम् अध्यात्मगतिनिश्चयम् मैत्रावरुणिम् आसीनम् अभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: paramātmani kuśalam adhyātmagatiniścayam maitrāvaruṇim āsīnam abhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: O IndranI, I do not seek refuge except in my friend Vr?akapi. Either libation of water or the Havis offering in fire had been my favourite always.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स्वच्छन्दं सुकृतं चैव मधुरं चाप्य् अनुल्बणम् पप्रच्छर्षिवरं राजा करालजनकः पुरा
verses.transliteration: svacchandaṃ sukṛtaṃ caiva madhuraṃ cāpy anulbaṇam papraccharṣivaraṃ rājā karālajanakaḥ purā
verses.translation: I do not go anywhere else. My beloved one, I swear so by your body. O beautiful lady, it does not behove you to think suspiciously about me.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: भगवञ् श्रोतुम् इच्छामि परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् यस्मिन् न पुनरावृत्तिं प्राप्नुवन्ति मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: bhagavañ śrotum icchāmi paraṃ brahma sanātanam yasmin na punarāvṛttiṃ prāpnuvanti manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: You are a chaste lady and my beloved one. You assist me in the performance of holy rites and advise me (on im¬ portant matters). You have children. You are of noble birth. Who else can be my beloved?
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यच् च तत् क्षरम् इत्य् उक्तं यत्रेदं क्षरते जगत् यच् चाक्षरम् इति प्रोक्तं शिवं क्षेमम् अनामयम्
verses.transliteration: yac ca tat kṣaram ity uktaṃ yatredaṃ kṣarate jagat yac cākṣaram iti proktaṃ śivaṃ kṣemam anāmayam
verses.translation: It may be difficult to attain liberation there (in a
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयतां पृथिवीपाल क्षरतीदं यथा जगत् यत्र क्षरति पूर्वेण यावत्कालेन चाप्य् अथ
verses.transliteration: śrūyatāṃ pṛthivīpāla kṣaratīdaṃ yathā jagat yatra kṣarati pūrveṇa yāvatkālena cāpy atha
verses.translation: For practice of piety and attainment of other world there is nothing equal to a good son. To a distressed man there is no other curative remedy than his wife.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: युगं द्वादशसाहस्र्यं कल्पं विद्धि चतुर्युगम् दशकल्पशतावर्तम् अहस् तद् ब्राह्मम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: yugaṃ dvādaśasāhasryaṃ kalpaṃ viddhi caturyugam daśakalpaśatāvartam ahas tad brāhmam ucyate
verses.translation: Hence, O chaste lady, due to your intellect all these mentally cherished things have been obtained by the grace of Siva, Visnu and Ganga.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: रात्रिश् चैतावती राजन् यस्यान्ते प्रतिबुध्यते सृजत्य् अनन्तकर्माणि महान्तं भूतम् अग्रजम्
verses.transliteration: rātriś caitāvatī rājan yasyānte pratibudhyate sṛjaty anantakarmāṇi mahāntaṃ bhūtam agrajam
verses.translation: You are my perpetual dear companion. There is nothing more endearing to me.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: मूर्तिमन्तम् अमूर्तात्मा विश्वं शंभुः स्वयंभुवः यत्रोत्पत्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि मूलतो नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: mūrtimantam amūrtātmā viśvaṃ śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ yatrotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi mūlato nṛpasattama
verses.translation: Hence, by the grace of all these I have acquired everything desired by me. This holy centre well known in the three worlds is pleasing to me.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अणिमा लघिमा प्राप्तिर् ईशानं ज्योतिर् अव्ययम् सर्वतःपाणिपादान्तं सर्वतोक्षिशिरोमुखम्
verses.transliteration: aṇimā laghimā prāptir īśānaṃ jyotir avyayam sarvataḥpāṇipādāntaṃ sarvatokṣiśiromukham
verses.translation: Hence, by the grace of all these I have acquired everything desired by me. This holy centre well known in the three worlds is pleasing to me.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतःश्रुतिमल् लोके सर्वम् आवृत्य तिष्ठति हिरण्यगर्भो भगवान् एष बुद्धिर् इति स्मृतिः
